paper_title: Effectiveness of acute L-arginine supplementation on physical performance in strength training: a systematic review and meta-analysis
paper_abstract:
Background:  The oral administration of L-arginine has been related to improved physical performance due to a likely reduction in muscle fatigue, resulting from the vasodilator effect of nitric oxide on skeletal muscle. However, there is no precise and quantitative analysis of the information in the literature. The main objective of this study was to assess the effectiveness of L-arginine supplementation on physical performance in strength training with a systematic review and meta-analysis. We hypothesized that L-arginine supplementation would improve performance capacity and the effects involved in strength training. 
 Methods:  The study period was from 2010 to 2020. The inclusion process established articles with well-designed human experiments that included only L-arginine supplementation (without any additional compounds) testing the effects of L-arginine supplementation on sports performance related to strength training; identical experimental conditions in placebo or control group; and publications in the last ten years (until December 31, 2020). Three studies were included that compared L-arginine supplementation with placebo in anaerobic performance tests. Test analysis supplementation with other supplements was removed and there was no gender, age, and ethnicity level. 
 Results:  There was no significant heterogeneity (p>0.05) in the analysis of the three selected articles and the effects of L-arginine supplementation in muscular endurance; performance had a mean of 0.26 (95% CI = -0.129; 0.649; p = 0.190), peak torque with a mean of -0.002 (95% CI = -0.531; 0.527; p = 0. 99) of the third series of exercises and, furthermore, when comparing the integrated effect (resistance rate with the peak torque) there was no difference with a mean of 0.168 (95% CI = -0.145; 0.481; p = 0.292). 
 Conclusions:  Acute L-arginine supplementation provides no ergogenic effect on strength training performance.
review_content:
In the current paper, the authors proposed to assess the effectiveness of the acute ingestion of L-arginine on muscle strength and other related to muscle performance. I found some serious limitations in the current version of the paper.

Major comments:

How can we trust the conclusions of a meta-analysis based on 3 studies and 30 subjects? This should be clear in the discussion. I noticed that the authors included this as a limitation, but there is no discussion about how serious this limitation is.

Authors should be able to justify grouping distinct muscle groups (i.e., upper and lower body) and variables in only one measure to conduct this meta-analysis.

Please be aware that heterogeneity I2 statistics is based on Cochran’s Q, which is hugely influenced by the number of studies. If the number of studies is too low (e.g. n=3), I2 will probably be low. Therefore, I am not sure if the result of this statistic can be trusted in the current paper.

Please provide a detailed search strategy for each database so readers can properly reproduce your search if needed.

Please describe the online tools or software used during the screening of the 1075 references.

Please include information about the model used for meta-analysis (e.g., fixed effect or random effects). In the methods, I found this only in the legend of figure 5. Also, I was not able to find information about what type of meta-analysis was conducted, is this a two-level or a three-level meta-analysis?

In the legend of figure 5, the authors stated that the fixed effect model was used. How can we use a fixed-effect model when study populations, doses, exercises, testing, and outcomes are not identical between studies? There are some relevant differences when comparing the 3 studies.

The authors stated using RoB2 tool to conduct RoB analysis (https://sites.google.com/site/riskofbiastool/welcome/rob-2-0-tool/current-version-of-rob-2?authuser=0). However, the domains and final reported RoB data do not match RoB2, but do match the original Cochrane RoB analysis (https://www.bmj.com/content/343/bmj.d5928)1. Please revise.

Please describe the software used to generate RoB figures.

It is not clear why the authors would use the "Assessment of Multiple Systematic Reviews (AMSTAR2)" in the current paper, since this is a tool to assess the quality of systematic reviews, not RCT (https://www.bmj.com/content/358/bmj.j4008)2. This tool is usually applied in umbrella reviews or reviews of systematic reviews. Please clarify why you are using this tool here. Also, there is no clear mention regarding the results of such analysis in the paper.

The authors state that "however, there was still good precision" in the quality of evidence analysis. What were the criteria for that? It is important to include in the methods what was considered a small, moderate, and big effect size or what would be considered as a relevant change.

A big part of the discussion does not fit the scope of the meta-analysis. The authors spent a lot of time citing and describing the use of L-arginine for other applications or other modalities of exercise.

General comments:

The version of figure 5 available to me does not look good for publication.

I found some minor punctuation and inconsistent use of "L-arg" in the text.

Overall, the authors should consider writing a paper including the systematic review and a narrative/scope review describing the 3 papers, but not a meta-analysis if we only have 3 studies on the topic.
paper_title_zh: 急性L-精氨酸补充对力量训练中身体表现的有效性：系统综述与荟萃分析
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：口服L-精氨酸被认为能通过一氧化氮对骨骼肌的血管舒张作用，可能减少肌肉疲劳，从而改善体能表现。然而，文献中缺乏精确和定量的分析。本研究的主要目的是通过系统综述和荟萃分析评估L-精氨酸补充剂对力量训练体能表现的有效性。我们假设L-精氨酸补充剂能提高表现能力和力量训练相关的效果。

方法：研究时间段为2010年至2020年。纳入标准为设计良好的人类实验文章，仅包含L-精氨酸补充剂（无其他附加化合物），测试L-精氨酸补充剂对与力量训练相关的运动表现的影响；安慰剂或对照组实验条件相同；以及近十年内的出版物（截至2020年12月31日）。纳入了三项研究，这些研究在无氧性能测试中比较了L-精氨酸补充剂与安慰剂的效果。排除了与其他补充剂联合使用的测试分析，且未考虑性别、年龄和种族水平。

结果：在选定的三篇文章的分析中，未发现显著异质性（p>0.05），L-精氨酸补充剂在肌肉耐力方面的效果平均值为0.26（95% CI = -0.129; 0.649; p = 0.190），第三组练习的峰值扭矩平均值为-0.002（95% CI = -0.531; 0.527; p = 0.99），此外，比较综合效果（阻力率与峰值扭矩）时，未发现差异，平均值为0.168（95% CI = -0.145; 0.481; p = 0.292）。

结论：急性L-精氨酸补充剂对力量训练表现无增强效果。
review_content_zh:
在当前论文中，作者提出评估急性摄入L-精氨酸对肌肉力量及其他与肌肉性能相关指标的有效性。我发现当前版本的论文存在一些严重局限性。

主要意见：

我们如何能信任基于3项研究和30名受试者的荟萃分析的结论？这一点应在讨论中明确。我注意到作者已将此作为局限性提及，但未讨论这一局限性的严重程度。

作者应能证明将不同肌肉群（即上肢和下肢）及变量仅用一个指标进行荟萃分析的合理性。

请注意，异质性I²统计基于Cochran’s Q，其受研究数量影响极大。若研究数量过少（例如n=3），I²可能较低。因此，我不确定当前论文中这一统计结果的可信度。

请提供每个数据库的详细检索策略，以便读者在需要时能正确复现您的检索。

请描述在筛选1075篇参考文献过程中使用的在线工具或软件。

请在文中包含用于荟萃分析的模型信息（例如，固定效应或随机效应）。在方法部分，我只在图5的图例中找到这一点。此外，我未能找到关于所进行荟萃分析类型的信息，这是二级还是三级荟萃分析？

在图5的图例中，作者指出使用了固定效应模型。当研究人群、剂量、锻炼、测试和结果在各研究间不一致时，我们如何能使用固定效应模型？比较这3项研究时存在一些相关差异。

作者提到使用RoB2工具进行RoB分析（https://sites.google.com/site/riskofbiastool/welcome/rob-2-0-tool/current-version-of-rob-2?authuser=0）。然而，所报告的领域和最终RoB数据与RoB2不符，而与原始Cochrane RoB分析相符（https://www.bmj.com/content/343/bmj.d5928）1。请修订。

请描述用于生成RoB图表的软件。

目前尚不清楚为何作者在当前论文中使用“系统评价的多系统评估（AMSTAR2）”，因为这是一个用于评估系统评价质量的工具，而非RCT（https://www.bmj.com/content/358/bmj.j4008）2。该工具通常应用于伞形评价或系统评价的再评价。请澄清为何在此使用该工具。此外，文中未明确提及此类分析的结果。

作者指出在证据质量分析中“然而，仍具有较好的精确度”。其标准是什么？在方法部分中，重要的是要包括何为小、中、大效应量或何为相关变化的定义。

讨论的很大一部分不符合荟萃分析的范围。作者花费大量时间引用和描述L-精氨酸在其他应用或其它锻炼方式中的使用。

一般意见：

我收到的图5版本不适合发表。

我发现文中存在一些轻微的标点错误和不一致的“L-arg”使用。

总体而言，如果该主题仅有3项研究，作者应考虑撰写一篇包括系统评价和描述这3篇论文的叙述/范围综述，而非荟萃分析。

paper_title: Video Diffusion Models: A Survey
paper_abstract: Diffusion generative models have recently become a powerful technique for creating and modifying high-quality, coherent video content. This survey provides a comprehensive overview of the critical components of diffusion models for video generation, including their applications, architectural design, and temporal dynamics modeling. The paper begins by discussing the core principles and mathematical formulations, then explores various architectural choices and methods for maintaining temporal consistency. A taxonomy of applications is presented, categorizing models based on input modalities such as text prompts, images, videos, and audio signals. Advancements in text-to-video generation are discussed to illustrate the state-of-the-art capabilities and limitations of current approaches. Additionally, the survey summarizes recent developments in training and evaluation practices, including the use of diverse video and image datasets and the adoption of various evaluation metrics to assess model performance. The survey concludes with an examination of ongoing challenges, such as generating longer videos and managing computational costs, and offers insights into potential future directions for the field. By consolidating the latest research and developments, this survey aims to serve as a valuable resource for researchers and practitioners working with video diffusion models. Website: \url{https://github.com/ndrwmlnk/Awesome-Video-Diffusion-Models}
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
The paper presents a survey of recent advances in diffusion models in the video domain. It covers, e.g., model architectures, different application areas, and how to handle temporal dynamics in video streams. The survey is very up-to-date in the sense that a majority of the covered papers are from 2022-2024, which is important since the field is moving forward fast. The survey provides a good overview over recent advances at a level suitable for a person new to the field, i.e., a reasonable taxonomy and a good division of topics that are covered. Each paper's contributions are summarized briefly but still highlights the main importance of each paper.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
**Strengths** + Generally well-written and easy to read. + A timely survey that provides a good overview of the area, especially for someone who would like get into the latest advancements + Up-to-date reference list that covers the most recent years (2022-2024). + Generally well-structured, but with som necessary changes (see below) **Weaknesses** - Very shallow background on how diffusion models actually work. The authors claim that they have added Section 3 with more background. However, Section 3 is just a reformatted version of Section 3.1 from the previous submission, no new information as far as I can see. - A method section is missing, i.e., how was the survey conducted, how were the papers selected, which search terms were used for database searches, which reference databases were searched, etc. - Several of the Tables and Figures are not referenced from the main text or very far from the figure, e.g., Fig 4 is on page 6 and referenced from page 19, Figs 9, 10, 11 and Table 3 are not referenced at all. In addition, it is quite annoying that the Figures often come before the main text where they are referenced. - The paper lacks a more general and reflective summary of all the papers discussed. For example, what shall we have learnt from reading the paper, which are the most important trends, methods, etc. - I was excited in the beginning when reading the paper, but after a while the paper looked more and more as a very large related work section. What I mean is that for each topic, e.g., Section 8 on Video completion, the referenced papers are just summarized in a paragraph (looks like a compressed abstract of each paper) but there is no high-level observation for each topic. - Unclear what Sections 7.2. and 7.3 contribute (not clear how the techniques in the cited papers work). - Very unclear what the differences between a data set and benchmark are. In both sections, the same data set a referenced in several cases, e.g, UCF-101, Sky Time-Lapse, MSR-VTT, and Tai-Chi-HD. - Table 4 would fit much better after the models presented in the Table are described in Sections 7, 8, 9, and 10. - Section 11 (Video Diffusion Models for Intelligent Decision Making) feels a bit of topic for me, but that might be a personal preference. - Section 13 (Outlook and Challenges) are short and to some extent a disappointment. No real outlook or reflection is presented, no overall summary of the area or general insights, and only three challenges are listed. Table 3 could be a good starting point for such a section.

**Requested Changes:**
* Background section of diffusion models should be expended and improved. * A method section should be included, describing how the survey was conducted etc. * Make structural changes so figures and tables come after where they are reference from the main text (and make sure all of them are connected to the main text). * Write a proper summary / discussion section, where trends, insights, general observations, etc. are presented and discussed.

**Broader Impact Concerns:**
No ethical concerns

**Claims And Evidence:**
Yes

**Audience:**
Yes

**Rebuttal Comments:**
Improvements: Dear reviewer, thank you very much for your time and thoughtful feedback. > Very shallow background on how diffusion models actually work. The authors claim that they have added Section 3 with more background. However, Section 3 is just a reformatted version of Section 3.1 from the previous submission, no new information as far as I can see. We have added more background knowledge in Section 3, especially a new subsection Score-based Model Formulation, to connect the DDPM and score-based models such as Score SDEs. We also improve the writing of the DDPM background to improve clarify. > A method section is missing, i.e., how was the survey conducted, how were the papers selected, which search terms were used for database searches, which reference databases were searched, etc. We have added a paragraph in Section 2, Taxonomy of Applications, to explain the methodology we adopted for conducting the literature review. > Several of the Tables and Figures are not referenced from the main text or very far from the figure, e.g., Fig 4 is on page 6 and referenced from page 19, Figs 9, 10, 11 and Table 3 are not referenced at all. In addition, it is quite annoying that the Figures often come before the main text where they are referenced. We have relocated and referenced all Tables and Figures in the text. > The paper lacks a more general and reflective summary of all the papers discussed. For example, what shall we have learnt from reading the paper, which are the most important trends, methods, etc. We've added more technical insights in the text and introduced the flow-matching method for the next wave of generative modeling in the outlook section. > I was excited in the beginning when reading the paper, but after a while the paper looked more and more as a very large related work section. What I mean is that for each topic, e.g., Section 8 on Video completion, the referenced papers are just summarized in a paragraph (looks like a compressed abstract of each paper) but there is no high-level observation for each topic. Thank you for pointing this out. We intended to use the first paragraph of each section to provide some high-level overview and motivation of the topic related to that section. For example, in Section 8, we mentioned in the first paragraph that video diffusion models are limited to generating videos with fixed lengths, and thus motivates the literatures in the section to propose different methods to generate longer video sequences. We have expanded the first paragraph of Section 8 to make the high-level motivation clearer. > Unclear what Sections 7.2. and 7.3 contribute (not clear how the techniques in the cited papers work). Thank you for raising this concern. We agree that while literatures in Section 7.2 and 7.3 focus on different aspects of video generation such as training-free methods and personalized generation methods, in general they still belong to the broader categories of text-to-video generation. We have merged Section 7.2 and 7.3 to 7.1.3 in the revision and also added more technical details regarding these methods. > Very unclear what the differences between a data set and benchmark are. In both sections, the same data set a referenced in several cases, e.g, UCF-101, Sky Time-Lapse, MSR-VTT, and Tai-Chi-HD. We acknowledge that the term "benchmark" can have different meanings, which may lead to a misunderstanding. In our case, we use it to refer to a data benchmark, i.e. a dataset that is commonly used for evalution of and comparison across models: "Data benchmarks focus on the datasets used in AI training and evaluation. They provide standardized datasets the community can use to train and test models, ensuring a level playing field for comparisons" (https://harvard-edge.github.io/cs249r_book/contents/benchmarking/benchmarking.html#data-benchmarks). This explains why the same datasets appear in the training data and benchmarks sections. We have added a paragraph to the benchmarks section that hopefully clarifies this. > Table 4 would fit much better after the models presented in the Table are described in Sections 7, 8, 9, and 10. We relocated Table 4 below the presentation of the models in the text. > Section 11 (Video Diffusion Models for Intelligent Decision Making) feels a bit of topic for me, but that might be a personal preference. Thank you for raising this point. We believe that this section is very relevant as it simply another application of video diffusion models for various tasks, and also serves to relate VDMs to the wider machine learning literature. Indeed, Reviewer GaEp noted that they “found it very interesting to read that one way to use trained diffusion models for downstream tasks is to use their latent representations.”
paper_title_zh: 视频扩散模型：综述
paper_abstract_zh: 扩散生成模型最近已成为创建和修改高质量、连贯视频内容的强大技术。本综述全面概述了视频生成扩散模型的关键组成部分，包括其应用、架构设计和时态动力学建模。论文首先讨论了核心原理和数学公式，然后探讨了各种架构选择和维持时态一致性的方法。提出了应用分类法，根据输入模态（如文本提示、图像、视频和音频信号）对模型进行分类。讨论了文本到视频生成的进展，以说明当前方法的最新能力和局限性。此外，综述总结了近期在训练和评估实践中的发展，包括使用多样化的视频和图像数据集以及采用各种评估指标来评估模型性能。综述最后考察了当前面临的挑战，如生成更长的视频和管理计算成本，并提供了对领域未来潜在方向的见解。通过整合最新研究和进展，本综述旨在为研究和应用视频扩散模型的研究人员和从业者提供宝贵资源。网址：\url{https://github.com/ndrwmlnk/Awesome-Video-Diffusion-Models}
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
本文综述了视频领域中扩散模型的最新进展。涵盖了例如模型架构、不同的应用领域以及如何处理视频流中的时间动态等内容。该综述非常及时，因为所涵盖的大部分论文来自2022-2024年，这对于快速发展的领域来说非常重要。综述为初入该领域的人提供了良好的最新进展概览，即合理的分类和良好的主题划分。每篇论文的贡献都进行了简要总结，但仍突出了每篇论文的主要重要性。

**优点和缺点：**
**优点** + 总体上写作良好，易于阅读。 + 及时综述，为希望了解最新进展的人提供了该领域的良好概览。 + 更新的参考文献列表，涵盖了最近几年（2022-2024）。 + 总体结构良好，但需要进行一些必要的调整（见下文）。
**缺点** - 对扩散模型实际工作原理的背景介绍非常浅显。作者声称他们已添加了包含更多背景信息的第3节。然而，第3节只是之前提交的第3.1节的重新格式化版本，据我所见没有新信息。 - 缺少方法部分，即如何进行综述，如何选择论文，数据库搜索使用了哪些关键词，搜索了哪些参考文献数据库等。 - 多个表格和图表在正文中未引用或引用位置相隔甚远，例如，图4在第6页，而引用在第19页；图9、10、11和表3根本未引用。此外，图表经常出现在引用它们的正文之前，这非常令人烦恼。 - 论文缺乏对所有讨论论文的更一般和反思性的总结。例如，阅读论文后我们应学到什么，哪些是最重要的趋势、方法等。 - 我在开始阅读论文时很兴奋，但后来发现论文越来越像一个非常大的相关工作部分。我的意思是，对于每个主题，例如第8节关于视频补全，引用的论文只是在一段中进行了总结（看起来像是每篇论文的压缩摘要），但没有对每个主题进行高层次的观察。 - 不清楚第7.2节和第7.3节的贡献（不清楚所引用论文中的技术如何工作）。 - 非常不清楚数据集和基准之间的区别。在这两节中，相同的数据集在多个案例中被引用，例如UCF-101、Sky Time-Lapse、MSR-VTT和Tai-Chi-HD。 - 表4在描述了表中模型的第7、8、9和10节之后会更合适。 - 第11节（用于智能决策的视频扩散模型）对我来说有点离题，但这可能是个人偏好。 - 第13节（展望与挑战）简短且在一定程度上令人失望。没有提出真正的展望或反思，没有对该领域的总体总结或一般见解，只列出了三个挑战。表3可以作为这样一节的良好起点。

**请求的修改：**
* 扩散模型的背景部分应扩展和改进。 * 应包括方法部分，描述如何进行综述等。 * 进行结构调整，使图表出现在正文引用之后（并确保所有图表与正文相连）。 * 写一个适当的总结/讨论部分，其中呈现和讨论趋势、见解、一般观察等。

paper_title: A dynamic architecture of life
paper_abstract: In recent decades, a profound conceptual transformation has occurred comprising different areas of biological research, leading to a novel understanding of life processes as much more dynamic and changeable. Discoveries in plants and animals, as well as novel experimental approaches, have prompted the research community to reconsider established concepts and paradigms. This development was taken as an incentive to organise a workshop in May 2014 at the Academia Nazionale dei Lincei in Rome. There, experts on epigenetics, regeneration, neuroplasticity, and computational biology, using different animal and plant models, presented their insights on important aspects of a dynamic architecture of life, which comprises all organisational levels of the organism. Their work demonstrates that a dynamic nature of life persists during the entire existence of the organism and permits animals and plants not only to fine-tune their response to particular environmental demands during development, but underlies their continuous capacity to do so. Here, a synthesis of the different findings and their relevance for biological thinking is presented.
review_content: This report summarises the key points of a recent meeting bringing together scientists working on diverse biological systems linked mainly by their approach to understanding the dynamic aspects of biological states. The report highlights the importance of reversibility of differentiation states and cellular responses to external stimuli as well as the importance of this in the context of adaptive evolution. Clearly there are many unanswered questions and the historian’s perspective pointed out that there is much more experimental work required to formulate general principles linking the described systems. Meetings such as these are of great value in allow abstraction of such principles and are to be encouraged. The inclusion of an historian in such meetings is an innovative approach which could be developed further to allow a real in-depth analysis of how ideas evolve over time.
paper_title_zh: 生命的动态架构
paper_abstract_zh: 在近几十年中，生物学研究的不同领域发生了一场深刻的概念性转变，导致了对生命过程的新理解，认为其远比以往所认为的更为动态和可变。植物和动物领域的发现，以及新颖的实验方法，促使研究界重新审视既定的概念和范式。这一发展被视为契机，促成了2014年5月在罗马的林琴科学院（Academia Nazionale dei Lincei）举办的一场研讨会。会上，表观遗传学、再生、神经可塑性和计算生物学领域的专家们，利用不同的动植物模型，展示了他们对生命动态架构重要方面的见解，这一架构涵盖了生物体的所有组织层次。他们的工作表明，生命的动态特性贯穿于生物体存在的全过程，不仅使动植物能够在发育过程中精细调整其对特定环境需求的响应，而且是其持续具备这种能力的根本。本文综合了不同的研究成果，并探讨了其对生物学思维的深远意义。
review_content_zh: 本报告总结了最近一次会议的关键要点，该会议汇集了研究多种生物系统的科学家，这些系统主要通过其理解生物状态动态方面的方法而联系在一起。报告强调了分化状态的逆转性和细胞对外部刺激的反应的重要性，以及这在适应性进化背景下的重要性。显然，仍有许多未解之谜，历史学家的观点指出，需要更多的实验工作来制定将所描述系统联系起来的普遍原理。此类会议对于抽象出这些原理具有巨大价值，应予以鼓励。在会议中纳入历史学家是一种创新方法，可以进一步发展，以便对思想随时间演变的进行真正深入的分析。

paper_title: Mitochondrial DNA in human identification: a review
paper_abstract: Mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) presents several characteristics useful for forensic studies, especially related to the lack of recombination, to a high copy number, and to matrilineal inheritance. mtDNA typing based on sequences of the control region or full genomic sequences analysis is used to analyze a variety of forensic samples such as old bones, teeth and hair, as well as other biological samples where the DNA content is low.
review_content: Reviewer 1 There are some points that should be revised: Introduction Lines 33, 39: it's not very clear the difference between "medico-legal purposes" and "forensic purposes". Please explain why you used both terms. Since Forensic purposes include the Medico legal issues we removed all mention to “medico-legal purposes”. Line 41: references 1-4 are related to guidelines for mitochondrial DNA typing and they not seem very pertinent in this point of introduction. I suggest to mention other general reviews regarding the use of mtDNA in forensics. Agreeing with the reviewer, we removed references 1-4 and leave only a single reference that support the first paragraph of the introduction and was the main starting point for our paper: “Budowle B, Allard MW, Wilson MR, Chakraborty R. FORENSICS AND MITOCHONDRIAL DNA: Applications, Debates, and Foundations*. Annu Rev Genomics Hum Genet. 2003;4(1):119–41”. Lines 42-50: This paragraph is identical to the abstract in the previous page. I suggest that you improve the introduction to better explain that mtDNA data cannot be applied to the identification of individuals in the same way that nuclear marker can, but it can be used to make inference about the maternal lineage. I suppose that this review is addressed to not expert users in forensic mtDNA, so this important point should be emphasized. It is not unusual to have paragraphs of the paper in the abstract. However, to comply with the comment of the reviewer we removed the mentioned paragraph and inserted a new sentence at the end of the introduction (line 37-40) that stress the idea that mtDNA data cannot be applied to the identification of individuals in the same way that nuclear marker can, but it can be used only to make inference about the maternal lineage. Survey methodology Lines, 57-59: If not those cited, what are the selection criteria used? We used all papers returned by PubMed Advanced Search Builder as now specified in the paper. Mitochondrial DNA biology and genetics Line 84: Reference number 10 isn't Andrews et al. Please correct. Moreover the revised mtDNA sequence (rCRS) published by Andrews et al. in 1999 is the reference sequence currently used. Therefore Authors should replace CRS with rCRS throughout the text (e.g lines 161 and 165). Agreeing with the reviewer we changed the previous ref 10 to Andrews et al (now line 73), and replaced CRS by rCRS everywhere in the paper after line 74 when we make the first mention to rCRS. Line 116: The term "haplogroups" need explanation and definition. Agreeing with the reviewer we introduced a new explanation paragraph in lines 88-92. Lines 132-141: The sequences comparison issue seems to be not inherent in this paragraph. I suggest to put this issue in another specific paragraph related to forensic interpretation and reporting results of mtDNA typing. Moreover it could be appropriate to mention also the SWGDAM mtDNA interpretation guidelines 2013. Agreeing with the reviewer we transferred the sequences comparison paragraph to the section “Mitochondrial DNA in Forensic Human Identification”, now lines 326-335. Mitochondrial DNA Nomenclature Authors describe in this chapter the issue of mtDNA polymorphisms nomenclature, however the topic has not been exhaustively handled, it has poorly precise and it has not updated. For these reasons, this section requires a thorough and wide review. First of all, authors mentioned the nomenclature approach of Wilson et al (ref 37) based of a set of formal rules that was later modified by Budowle et al in 2010, but only the first version of this approach is describe in this review, so it isn't update. Moreover, the ISFG proposed another kind of nomenclature, based on phylogenetic approach (see guidelines in ref. 4) and it has not even been mentioned. It would be appropriate to mention both and discuss the difference. Otherwise the Authors explain why describe only one approach. Actually, Authors mentioned the phylogenetic approach in Table 2, in the context of ISFG guidelines, but without a discussion. Moreover, the revised mtDNA sequence (rCRS) is the reference sequence used for comparison and notation of polymorphisms and not the CRS. Deletions are annotated as "DEL" or "-" , and not with a "D", to avoid confusing with IUB code, where D is considered a mixture of A, G, and T. Agreeing with the reviewer the entire section “Mitochondrial DNA Nomenclature” was reformulated. Mitochondrial DNA typing guidelines Line 197: Table 1 is cited after Table 2.it could be better to rename tables in order of appearance in the text. Agreeing with the reviewer we renamed the tables by order of appearance. Mitochondrial DNA sequencing methodology In this chapter Authors provide an overview of the DNA sequencing methods used in forensic, but I suggest to limit the text only to sequencing methods used for mtDNA typing. The text will appear more fluid and a more detailed description of Sanger sequencing by capillary electrophoresis, which is the most widely used method, would be useful. Moreover, the use of terms like "second generation", "third generation" seems to be a little confused, please revised to provide more clear definitions. Lastly, the review lacks of information about mtDNA amplification strategies ( e.g complete mtGenome amplification, or entire control region (CR) amplification in a single PCR reaction, or CR region amplification in different overlapping fragments, or HVI-HVII-HVII in separate amplification) which could improve this chapter. Lines 236-240: reference 53 could be cited together with other ref at line 246, as it isn't one of the first study of mtDNA sequencing by MPS and it is relative to heteroplasmy issue. Agreeing with the reviewer almost the entire section “Mitochondrial DNA sequencing methodology” was reformulated. Mitochondrial DNA population data and databases The text needs a different organization. I suggest to move the EMPOP section after line 257, as it represent the most important mtDNA haplotypes database for forensic purposes, among those mentioned in the text. Agreeing with the reviewer the section was reformulated and we begin with EMPOP now in line 269. Lines 258-269: I suggest to eliminate this part, as it seems to be not pertinent in this chapter, and to move it to another chapter. Agreeing with the reviewer the paragraph was changed to section “Mitochondrial DNA Nomenclature” now relocated to line 184-195 Mitochondrial DNA population data and databases Line 385: reference 97 isn't relative to Park et al. and it isn't cited in table 1. Please insert in table 1 reference numbers of cited papers. Agreeing with the reviewer the reference was substituted for Ambers et al, now line 393. This reference was also included in Table 2. ________________________________
paper_title_zh: 人类识别中的线粒体DNA：综述
paper_abstract_zh: 线粒体DNA（mtDNA）具有多个对法医学研究有用的特性，尤其是与其缺乏重组、高拷贝数以及母系遗传相关。基于控制区序列或全基因组序列分析的mtDNA分型，用于分析各种法医学样本，如古老骨骼、牙齿和毛发，以及其他DNA含量低的生物样本。
review_content_zh:
审稿人1：有一些需要修改的点：

引言
第33、39行：关于“医学法律目的”和“法医目的”之间的区别不太清楚。请解释为什么使用这两个术语。由于法医目的包括医学法律问题，我们已删除所有提及“医学法律目的”的内容。
第41行：参考文献1-4与线粒体DNA分型指南相关，似乎在此处引言中不太相关。我建议提及其他关于线粒体DNA在法医学中应用的综述。同意审稿人的意见，我们删除了参考文献1-4，仅保留一个支持引言第一段且为本文主要起点的参考文献：“Budowle B, Allard MW, Wilson MR, Chakraborty R. FORENSICS AND MITOCHONDRIAL DNA: Applications, Debates, and Foundations*. Annu Rev Genomics Hum Genet. 2003;4(1):119–41”。
第42-50行：此段落与前一页的摘要相同。我建议改进引言，更好地解释线粒体DNA数据不能像核标记那样应用于个体识别，但可以用于推断母系血统。我推测这篇综述是针对非法医线粒体DNA专家读者的，因此这一点应强调。虽然论文中的段落出现在摘要中并不罕见，但为了符合审稿人的意见，我们删除了提到的段落，并在引言末尾（第37-40行）插入了一个新句子，强调线粒体DNA数据不能像核标记那样应用于个体识别，但只能用于推断母系血统。

调查方法
第57-59行：如果不是所引用的，那么使用的选择标准是什么？我们使用了PubMed高级搜索构建器返回的所有论文，现已在论文中说明。

线粒体DNA生物学和遗传学
第84行：参考文献10不是Andrews等人。请更正。此外，Andrews等人在1999年发表的修订线粒体DNA序列（rCRS）是当前使用的参考序列。因此，作者应在全文中（例如第161和165行）将CRS替换为rCRS。同意审稿人的意见，我们将之前的参考文献10改为Andrews等人（现第73行），并在第74行首次提及rCRS后，全文将CRS替换为rCRS。
第116行：“单倍群”这一术语需要解释和定义。同意审稿人的意见，我们在第88-92行引入了一个新的解释段落。
第132-141行：序列比较问题似乎与该段落无关。我建议将此问题放在与法医解释和报告线粒体DNA分型结果相关的特定段落中。此外，提及2013年SWGDAM线粒体DNA解释指南也是适当的。同意审稿人的意见，我们将序列比较段落移至“线粒体DNA在法医人类识别中的应用”部分，现第326-335行。

线粒体DNA命名法
作者在本章中描述了线粒体DNA多态性命名法的问题，但该主题处理得不够全面，不够精确且未更新。因此，这一部分需要彻底和广泛的审查。首先，作者提到了Wilson等人（参考文献37）基于一套正式规则的命名法，该命名法后来在2010年被Budowle等人修改，但在此综述中仅描述了该方法的第一个版本，因此未更新。此外，ISFG提出了另一种基于系统发育方法的命名法（见参考文献4中的指南），但甚至未提及。应提及两者并讨论其差异。否则，作者应解释为何仅描述一种方法。实际上，作者在表2中提到了系统发育方法，在ISFG指南的背景下，但没有讨论。此外，修订的线粒体DNA序列（rCRS）是用于比较和标记多态性的参考序列，而不是CRS。缺失被注释为“DEL”或“-”，而不是“D”，以避免与IUB代码混淆，其中D被认为是A、G和T的混合。同意审稿人的意见，整个“线粒体DNA命名法”部分被重新编写。

线粒体DNA分型指南

paper_title: A Survey of Lottery Ticket Hypothesis
paper_abstract: The Lottery Ticket Hypothesis (LTH) states that a dense neural network model contains a highly sparse subnetwork (i.e., winning tickets) that can achieve even better performance than the original model when trained in isolation. While LTH has been proved both empirically and theoretically in many works, there still are some open issues, such as efficiency and scalability, to be addressed. Also, the lack of open-source frameworks and consensual experimental setting poses a challenge to future research on LTH. For the first time, we examine previous research and studies on LTH from different perspectives. We also discuss issues in existing works and list potential directions for further exploration. This survey provides an in-depth look at the state of LTH.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
This survey provides a comprehensive introduction of lottery ticket hypothesis, which refers to the existence of a subnetwork of much smaller size in a large network with comparable (or even better) performance. The paper defines clearly on the lottery ticket hypothesis and introduces different lines of work around it, including theory, relevance to network architectures, algorithms for finding the winning ticket, and connection to broader concepts.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
I believe the authors have made great efforts in summarizing different aspects of lottery ticket hypothesis. The paper is well organized and easy-to-follow for audiences. Table 1 can be particularly helpful for researchers or incoming researchers in the field, which lists information of existing works with code. I have some comments around the introduction and theory sections, which is detailed in the requested changes section. Due to my background, I am not able to provide a comprehensive review on all the aspects of lottery ticket hypothesis. I believe other reviewers will provide valuable comments.

**Requested Changes:**
It is really nice to categorize the discussion on lottery ticket hypothesis into 8 topics on Page 2. I am wondering what are the inner connections between these topics and are there particular reasons to consider these 8 topics instead of potentially others? I found it hard to parse the information provided after "The mechanism behind finding winning tickets using iterative magnitude-based pruning (IMP) is identified as three key inquiries" on Page 3. This sentence seems to be a bit disconnected with the context around it. Moreover, the explanation following this sentence consists of many jargons for me to understand. Turning towards the introduction of theoretical study on Page 3, the sentence "By approximating ReLU networks, This work proves that optimizing the weights is equivalent to pruning entire neurons of a sufficiently large random network" seems unclear to me. What is approximating ReLU networks referring to and how does it connects to optimizing the weights? In addition, does the result depend on the optimization algorithm and the loss function? Following the above, in "a sufficiently over-parameterized neural network with random weights contains a subnetwork with roughly the same accuracy as the target network, without any further training. However, the polynomial over-parameterization ...", polynomial overparameterization might need a definition. In "An exponential improvement to the over-parameterization requirement is offered in Pensia et al. (2020)" on Page 3, what does exponential improvement mean here? The previous sentence only says polynomial overparameterization. The sentence "Instead of providing significantly tighter bounds, (Orseau et al., 2020) points out that the overparameterized network only needs a logarithmic factor number of neurons per weight of the target subnetwork" is not very clear. What is the logarithmic factor? "per weight" should be "per layer"? The sentence "This discovery implies effective lottery tickets can be identified at frequently used depths, necessitating only logarithmic levels of overparameterization" needs further elaboration. From my understanding, lottery ticket hypothesis says that a smaller subnetwork can be extracted from a pre-trained larger network. However, the existing theory shows the existence of a smaller network inside a larger network, which yields approximately the same level of accurate outputs when the weight parameters are randomly initialized. If I were correct, there is still a gap between theory and the lottery ticket hypothesis. I am not following the sentence "The strong lottery ticket hypothesis is extended functions that maintain the operation of the group, known as G-equivariant networks". What do you mean by extended functions? The likelihood in this sentence "The study establishes, with a high likelihood" is confusing. Do you want to say "with a high probability"?

**Broader Impact Concerns:**
No concern.

**Claims And Evidence:**
No

**Audience:**
Yes
paper_title_zh: 彩票假设综述
paper_abstract_zh: 彩票假说（Lottery Ticket Hypothesis, LTH）指出，一个密集的神经网络模型中包含一个高度稀疏的子网络（即“中奖票”），当单独训练时，该子网络能够实现比原始模型更好的性能。尽管LTH已经在许多工作中得到了实证和理论上的证明，但仍存在一些待解决的问题，如效率和可扩展性。此外，缺乏开源框架和共识的实验设置对LTH的未来研究构成了挑战。我们首次从不同角度审视了以往关于LTH的研究和探讨。我们还讨论了现有工作中的问题，并列出了进一步探索的潜在方向。本综述深入探讨了LTH的现状。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
本综述全面介绍了彩票假说，即在一个大型网络中存在一个规模小得多的子网络，其性能相当（甚至更优）。论文清晰地定义了彩票假说，并介绍了围绕该假说的不同研究方向，包括理论、与网络架构的相关性、寻找中奖彩票的算法，以及与更广泛概念的关联。

**优点与不足：**
我认为作者在总结彩票假说的不同方面上付出了巨大努力。论文组织良好，易于读者理解。表1对领域内研究人员或新入门的研究者尤为有帮助，其中列出了现有工作的信息及代码。我对引言和理论部分有一些评论，具体见“请求的更改”部分。由于我的背景限制，无法对彩票假说的所有方面进行全面的评审。我相信其他评审者会提供有价值的意见。

**请求的更改：**
将彩票假说的讨论分为第2页的8个主题非常不错。我想知道这些主题之间的内在联系是什么，以及选择这8个主题而非其他主题的特定原因是什么？在第3页“使用迭代基于幅度的剪枝（IMP）寻找中奖彩票的机制被识别为三个关键探究”之后的信息难以理解。这句话似乎与周围的语境有些脱节。此外，随后的解释包含许多术语，难以理解。转向第3页的理论研究介绍，“通过近似ReLU网络，这项工作证明了优化权重等同于剪枝一个足够大的随机网络的整个神经元”这句话对我来说不够清晰。近似ReLU网络指的是什么，以及它如何与优化权重相关联？此外，结果是否依赖于优化算法和损失函数？紧接着，“一个足够过参数化的随机权重神经网络包含一个与目标网络精度大致相同的子网络，而无需进一步训练。然而，多项式过参数化……”中，多项式过参数化可能需要定义。在第3页“Pensia等人（2020）提供了一个对过参数化要求的指数改进”中，指数改进在这里是什么意思？前一句只提到了多项式过参数化。“（Orseau等人，2020）指出，过参数化网络仅需要目标子网络每权重对数因子数量的神经元”这句话不太清楚。对数因子是什么？“每权重”应该是“每层”吗？“这一发现意味着有效的彩票可以在常用深度被识别，仅需要指数级的过参数化水平”需要进一步阐述。据我理解，彩票假说认为可以从预训练的大型网络中提取出一个更小的子网络。然而，现有理论显示，在大型网络中存在一个更小的网络，当权重参数随机初始化时，其输出精度大致相同。如果我的理解正确，理论和彩票假说之间仍存在差距。我不太理解“强彩票假说扩展到维持组操作的函数，即G-等变网络”这句话。扩展函数是什么意思？这句话“研究表明，具有高可能性”中的可能性令人困惑。你是想表达“具有高概率”吗？

**更广泛的影响关注：**
无关注。

**主张与证据：**
无

**受众：**
是

paper_title: Perspectives on automated composition of workflows in the life sciences
paper_abstract:
Scientific data analyses often combine several computational tools in automated pipelines, or workflows. Thousands of such workflows have been used in the life sciences, though their composition has remained a cumbersome manual process due to a lack of standards for annotation, assembly, and implementation. Recent technological advances have returned the long-standing vision of automated workflow composition into focus. 
This article summarizes a recent Lorentz Center workshop dedicated to automated composition of workflows in the life sciences. We survey previous initiatives to automate the composition process, and discuss the current state of the art and future perspectives. We start by drawing the “big picture” of the scientific workflow development life cycle, before surveying and discussing current methods, technologies and practices for semantic domain modelling, automation in workflow development, and workflow assessment. Finally, we derive a roadmap of individual and community-based actions to work toward the vision of automated workflow development in the forthcoming years. 
A central outcome of the workshop is a general description of the workflow life cycle in six stages: 1) scientific question or hypothesis, 2) conceptual workflow, 3) abstract workflow, 4) concrete workflow, 5) production workflow, and 6) scientific results. The transitions between stages are facilitated by diverse tools and methods, usually incorporating domain knowledge in some form. Formal semantic domain modelling is hard and often a bottleneck for the application of semantic technologies. However, life science communities have made considerable progress here in recent years and are continuously improving, renewing interest in the application of semantic technologies for workflow exploration, composition and instantiation. Combined with systematic benchmarking with reference data and large-scale deployment of production-stage workflows, such technologies enable a more systematic process of workflow development than we know today. We believe that this can lead to more robust, reusable, and sustainable workflows in the future.
review_content:
This paper presents a summary of the discussions and findings from a Lorentz Center workshop organized in March 2020, with the focus on automated workflow development in the life sciences.

Overall, the paper is well written and presents a community view on the current state-of-the-art, challenges, and perspectives for research efforts. Another key contribution of the paper is the development of a schematic process of the scientific workflow life cycle, which is comprised of six principal stages, each with their associated artifacts. Although a survey of state-of-the-art technologies is not the goal of the paper, it still provides a reasonable amount of background information.

On the downside, the paper could better articulate which properties are inherent to each of the aforementioned stages, and organize the discussions around them.

Specific comments:
  * I would recommend authors to identify common properties for the set of tools described in the paper. The current text alludes to individual tool functionalities but does not clearly discuss their common ground / specificities.
  * It is not clear to me how "workflow benchmarks" are defined. At some moments I see them as "reference workflows" for validating the workflow structure and data, while at other sections I see them as performance drivers. It might be good to provide an actual definition of the term, or even separate them (as they seem to measure different properties).
  * The proposed future work (foundations, tooling and infrastructure, community, and applications) could leverage several ongoing efforts from the scientific workflows community such as in [1, 2, 3].
paper_title_zh: 生命科学中工作流自动组合的视角
paper_abstract_zh:
科学数据分析通常将多个计算工具结合在自动化管道或工作流中。在生命科学中已经使用了数千个这样的工作流，但由于缺乏注释、组装和实施的标准，它们的组成仍然是一个繁琐的手动过程。最近的技术进步使得自动化工作流组成的长期愿景重新成为焦点。

本文总结了最近在洛伦兹中心举办的关于生命科学中自动化工作流组成的研讨会。我们回顾了以往自动化组成过程的倡议，并讨论了当前的技术现状和未来前景。我们首先绘制了科学工作流开发生命周期的“大图景”，然后概述和讨论了当前用于语义领域建模、工作流开发自动化和工作流评估的方法、技术和实践。最后，我们制定了一个个人和社区行动路线图，以在未来几年内实现自动化工作流开发的愿景。

研讨会的一个核心成果是对工作流生命周期的一般描述，分为六个阶段：1）科学问题或假设，2）概念工作流，3）抽象工作流，4）具体工作流，5）生产工作流，以及6）科学结果。各阶段之间的转换由多种工具和方法促进，通常以某种形式融入领域知识。形式化语义领域建模难度较大，通常是应用语义技术的瓶颈。然而，近年来生命科学社区在这方面取得了显著进展，并持续改进，重新激发了将语义技术应用于工作流探索、组成和实例化的兴趣。结合参考数据的系统基准测试和生产阶段工作流的大规模部署，这些技术能够实现比目前更系统的工作流开发过程。我们相信，这可以导致未来更稳健、可重用和可持续的工作流。
review_content_zh:
本文总结了2020年3月举办的洛伦兹中心研讨会上的讨论和发现，重点关注生命科学领域的自动化工作流开发。

总体而言，本文撰写质量高，呈现了社区对当前技术水平、挑战和研究前景的见解。文章的另一重要贡献是提出了科学工作流生命周期的示意图，包括六个主要阶段，每个阶段都有其相关的产物。尽管本文的目标并非综述现有技术，但仍提供了适量的背景信息。

不足之处在于，文章可以更清晰地阐述每个上述阶段的固有属性，并围绕这些属性组织讨论。

具体意见：
* 建议作者识别文中描述的工具集的共有属性。当前文本提及了单个工具的功能，但未明确讨论它们的共同点和特异性。
* “工作流基准”的定义不明确。在某些部分，它们被视为验证工作流结构和数据的“参考工作流”，而在其他部分则被视为性能驱动因素。最好提供该术语的实际定义，或将它们分开（因为它们似乎衡量不同的属性）。
* 提出的未来工作（基础、工具和基础设施、社区和应用）可以借鉴科学工作流社区的若干正在进行的工作，如[1, 2, 3]。

paper_title: In-context Learning with Retrieved Demonstrations for Language Models: A Survey
paper_abstract: Large language models have demonstrated remarkable few-shot in-context learning (ICL) capabilities, adapting to new tasks with few-shots demonstrations. However, the efficacy of ICL is highly dependent on the selection of these demonstrations. Recent developments have introduced retrieval-based in-context learning (RetICL), which dynamically retrieves demonstrations tailored to each input query. This approach leverages existing databases and retrieval systems, enhancing efficiency and scalability while mitigating biases inherent in manual example selection. Given the promising results and growing interest in RetICL, we present a comprehensive survey of this field. Our review encompasses: design choices for ICL demonstration retrieval models, retrieval training procedures, inference strategies and current applications of RetICL. In the end, we explore future directions for this emerging technology.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
This paper summarizes how to retrieve examples for in-context learning. It starts by reviewing in-context learning and demonstration retrieval, summarizing the main approaches in retrieval algorithms, and what tasks one would apply this framework to in practice.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
Strengths - The paper is quite comprehensive, covering a lot of papers within this space - The paper is well organized, allowing for a reader to look at what aspects are important to them Weaknesses - I find survey papers most helpful when they can synthesize viewpoints about the field and consider the connections between different works. This paper gave great summaries of all the contributions, but I do not feel like I was left with a greater sense of understanding of how all the works interact with each other. This is partially addressed in places like Section 5.3, but in my opinion, this could be a bigger emphasis. - I believe this paper would be useful to a practitioner who would like to know the methods used for in-context demonstration retrieval. Its harder for me to see which communities outside of this group would benefit from the aggregation of summaries of methods in the current manuscript.

**Requested Changes:**
1. [Major] I hope for a better guide on which method to pick for practical use cases and how different losses on fine-tuning affect the downstream model. In my opinion, this would be the main practical relevance of this paper. 2. The following works might help contextualize the effect of demonstrations on in-context learning: https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.03846, https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.09731 3. Though more recent than your submission, these works discuss using larger context windows to fit more in-context learning examples which would remove the need for selection of examples: https://cdn.sanity.io/files/4zrzovbb/website/af5633c94ed2beb282f6a53c595eb437e8e7b630.pdf, https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.00200 4. General formatting errors throughout the document. For example, SBERT citation in Section 3.2, numbering of application domains at the start of Section 6...

**Claims And Evidence:**
Yes

**Audience:**
Yes

**Rebuttal Comments:**
Response to Reviewer 8UR5: We appreciate your feedback and we have reposed to every point and the new manuscript reflected your suggestion. Particularly, our response are given in the following. 1. [Major] Thank you for your comments and suggestions. We indeed want the paper to be useful for general NLP practitioners who use in-context learning. We have added a section (7.1 Guidelines for Choosing the Methods) that gives guidelines on the modeling choices to use, based on the works surveyed in the paper. As for how different fine-tuning losses affect the model, based on the works that linearly combine multiple losses ([Wang et al., 2023](https://aclanthology.org/2024.eacl-long.105/) and [Li et al., 2023](https://aclanthology.org/2023.acl-long.256/)), all of the losses have additive effects. We have added this comment to the paper in Section 5.2 (Multiple Objectives paragraph). We also added comparisons between fine-tuning losses in Section 5.3. 2. Thank you for the extra references. We discussed the two references for contextualizing the effect of demonstrations in section 2.1. The new text reads as follows: “The demonstrations serve as a few examples of the task helping the LLMs learn both the input and label space as well as the mapping from the inputs to the labels \citep{wei2023larger,pan2023context} both in context (without any weight updates), so a similar mapping can be applied to $q_*$. …” 3. We added a paragraph (Many-Shot Prompting) to our “Discussion and Future Direction” section referencing several many-shot ICL papers (including the ones you suggested) and explained the possible interplay between many-shot ICL and RetICL. The paragraph reads as follows: “With the rapid increase in the context length of the frontier LLMs \citep{reid2024gemini,anthropic2024claude}, a new ICL paradigm has emerged where instead of providing only few demonstrations to the models, one can provide many shots. It has been observed that this approach can provide substantial boost in performance \citep{agarwal2024many,jiang2024many,anil2024many}, and also alleviate some of the issues with few-shot ICL such as sensitivity to the order \citep{bertsch2024context}. However, the increased context size in many-shot ICL introduces an extra inference cost. An interesting area for future research is to find ways of combining many-shot ICL and RetICL to get similar predictive performance with a lower inference cost.” 4. We fixed this citation format error and added the number in section 6. 5. Thank you for pointing the typo, and they have been fixed in the new manuscript.
paper_title_zh: 《基于检索演示的语言模型在上下文学习中的研究综述》
paper_abstract_zh: 大型语言模型已展现出卓越的少样本上下文学习（ICL）能力，能够通过少量示例适应新任务。然而，ICL的效能高度依赖于这些示例的选择。近期发展引入了基于检索的上下文学习（RetICL），该方法动态检索针对每个输入查询定制的示例。这种方法利用现有数据库和检索系统，提升了效率和可扩展性，同时减轻了手动示例选择中固有的偏见。鉴于RetICL的显著成果和日益增长的兴趣，我们对该领域进行了全面综述。我们的回顾包括：ICL示例检索模型的设计选择、检索训练流程、推理策略以及RetICL的当前应用。最后，我们探讨了这一新兴技术的未来发展方向。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
本文总结了如何检索用于上下文学习的示例。首先回顾了上下文学习和示例检索，概括了检索算法的主要方法，以及在实际中应用该框架的任务。

**优点和缺点：**
优点 - 论文内容相当全面，涵盖了该领域的许多论文 - 论文组织良好，读者可以轻松找到他们感兴趣的重要方面
缺点 - 我认为综述性论文最有帮助的是它们能够综合该领域的观点并考虑不同工作之间的联系。本文对所有的贡献进行了很好的总结，但我并没有感觉到对所有工作之间的相互作用有了更深入的理解。这在第5.3节等部分有所涉及，但在我看来，这一点可以更加突出。 - 我认为本文对于希望了解上下文示例检索方法的实践者来说是有用的。但对于该群体之外的社区，从当前手稿中汇总的方法总结中受益的情况，我看得不太清楚。

**请求的修改：**
1. [重要] 我希望有一个更好的指南，说明在实际用例中应选择哪种方法，以及不同的微调损失如何影响下游模型。在我看来，这将是本文的主要实际意义。 2. 以下工作可能有助于将演示对上下文学习的影响情境化：https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.03846, https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.09731 3. 虽然这些工作比您的提交时间更近，但它们讨论了使用更大的上下文窗口来容纳更多的上下文学习示例，这将消除选择示例的需要：https://cdn.sanity.io/files/4zrzovbb/website/af5633c94ed2beb282f6a53c595eb437e8e7b630.pdf, https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.00200 4. 文档中存在一些格式错误。例如，第3.2节中的SBERT引用，第6节开头的应用领域编号...

**主张和证据：**
是

**受众：**
是

**反驳评论：**
对评审员8UR5的回应：我们感谢您的反馈，并对每一点进行了回应，新稿反映了您的建议。特别是，我们的回应如下。 1. [重要] 感谢您的评论和建议。我们确实希望本文对使用上下文学习的普通NLP实践者有所帮助。我们增加了一节（7.1 选择方法的指南），根据论文中综述的工作，给出了建模选择的指南。至于不同的微调损失如何影响模型，基于线性组合多个损失的工作（[Wang et al., 2023](https://aclanthology.org/2024.eacl-long.105/) 和 [Li et al., 2023](https://aclanthology.org/2023.acl-long.256/)），所有的损失都有叠加效应。我们已在第5.2节（多目标段落）中添加了这一评论，并在第5.3节中增加了微调损失的比较。 2. 感谢额外的参考文献。我们在第2.1节中讨论了这两篇参考文献，以情境化演示的影响。新文本如下：“演示作为任务的一些示例，帮助LLMs学习输入和标签空间以及从输入到标签的映射 \citep{wei2023larger,pan2023context}（均在上下文中，没有任何权重更新），以便类似的映射可以应用于$q_*$。…” 3. 我们在“讨论和未来方向”部分增加了一段（多示例提示），引用了几篇多示例ICL论文（包括您建议的），并解释了多示例ICL和RetICL之间可能的相互作用。段落如下：“随着前沿LLMs上下文长度的快速增加 \citep{reid2024gemini,anthropic2024claude}，一种新的ICL范式已经出现，即不再只向模型提供少量演示，而是可以提供多示例。观察发现，这种方法可以显著提升性能 \citep{agarwal2024many,jiang2024many,anil2024many}，并减轻一些少示例ICL的问题，如对顺序的敏感性 \citep{bertsch2024context}。然而，多示例ICL中增加的上下文大小引入了额外的推理成本。未来研究的一个有趣领域是找到结合多示例ICL和RetICL的方法，以在更低的推理成本下获得类似的预测性能。” 4. 我们修复了这一引用格式错误，并在第6节中添加了编号。 5. 感谢指出错别字，它们已在新的手稿中修复。

paper_title: Mechanisms Behind the Pharmacological Application of Biochanin-A: A review
paper_abstract: This review was aimed at summarizing the cellular and molecular mechanisms behind the various pharmacological actions of biochanin-A. Many studies have been reported claiming its application in cancers, metabolic disorders, airway hyperresponsiveness, cardiac disorders, neurological disorders, etc. With regard to hormone-dependent cancers like breast, prostate, and other malignancies like pancreatic, colon, lung, osteosarcoma, glioma that has limited treatment options, biochanin-A revealed agreeable results in arresting cancer development. Biochanin-A has also shown therapeutic benefits when administered for neurological disorders, diabetes, hyperlipidaemia, and other chronic diseases/disorders. Isoflavones are considered phenomenal due to their high efficiency in modifying the physiological functions of the human body. Biochanin-A is one among the prominent isoflavones found in soy (glycine max), red clover (Trifolium pratense), and alfalfa sprouts, etc., with proven potency in modulating vital cellular mechanisms in various diseases. It has been popular for ages among menopausal women in controlling symptoms. In view of the multi-targeted functions of biochanin-A, it is essential to summarize it's mechanism of action in various disorders. The safety and efficacy of biochanin-A needs to be established in clinical trials involving human subjects. Biochanin-A might be able to modify various systems of the human body like the cardiovascular system, CNS, respiratory system, etc. It has shown a remarkable effect on hormonal cancers and other cancers. Many types of research on biochanin-A, particularly in breast, lung, colon, prostate, and pancreatic cancers, have shown a positive impact. Through modulating oxidative stress, SIRT-1 expression, PPAR gamma receptors, and other multiple mechanisms biochanin-A produces anti-diabetic action. The diverse molecular mechanistic pathways involved in the pharmacological ability of biochanin-A indicate that it is a very promising molecule and can play a major impact in modifying several physiological functions.
review_content:
I have gone through the article entitled 'Mechanisms behind the pharmacological application of biochanin-A'. It was written well however, the authors need to address the following comments and need additions in a few places.
 1. On page no. 3, biochanin shows therapeutic actions in various cancers, need to mention about multiple myeloma as well, because biochanin-A showed anti-MM activity, and need to describe in the blood cancer section or wherever it is appropriate.
 2. On page no. 3, the authors wrote: "During breast cancer development the normal signalling pathways are interrupted, stimulating the refractory growth, no cell death, and progressive invasion to neighbouring tissues. Soy-rich diets in controlling hormone-dependent cancers have gained wide attention lately." This can happen in the majority of solid cancers, is there any specific reason to specify only breast cancer?
 3. On page no. 5, the authors wrote: "Biochanin-A has shown synergism with 5-fluorouracil (5FU) in oestrogen receptor (ER) positive breast cancer cell lines such as triple-negative breast cancer cells, MDA-MB231 and MCF7." But MCF7 cells are not triple-negative cells, authors need to check and re-write these sentences.
 4. On page no. 6, the authors mentioned: "The patients with clinically significant prostate cancer were treated with red clover isoflavones such as biochanin-A before surgical intervention. Markedly, higher apoptosis was found in the treatment group, indicates cessation of prostate cancer progression in low- moderate grade malignancy (Jarred et al., 2002)." I failed to understand if is a clinical study or in vitro study, the first sentence shows as a clinical study, but the second sentence is depicted as an in vitro study. Please clarify, such confusion is there in multiple places...please correct it.
 5. On page no. 6, the authors wrote: "Soy-rich foods may reduce the likelihood of lung malignant growth in the general population, according to epidemiology researches..." Maybe it should be written as: "Soy-rich foods may reduce the occurrence of getting cancer in the general population, according to epidemiology researches", please check it.
 6. On page no. 9, it's written that "biochanin-A exhibits neuroprotective effect" and gave references for cancer studies, please give references for neuroprotective not for neuro cancer.
 7. Few of the references are not suitable, please check it.
 8. Biochanin-A is known to show anti-fibrotic activity as well, especially lung (IPF) and liver, authors should explore that as well.
 9. Adding limitations of biochanin-A would improve the manuscript.
Overall the review is good.
paper_title_zh: "生物chanin-A药理学应用的机制：综述"
paper_abstract_zh: 本综述旨在总结生物chanin-A各种药理作用背后的细胞和分子机制。许多研究报道了其在癌症、代谢紊乱、气道高反应性、心脏疾病、神经系统疾病等领域的应用。对于激素依赖性癌症如乳腺癌、前列腺癌以及其他恶性肿瘤如胰腺癌、结肠癌、肺癌、骨肉瘤、胶质瘤等治疗选择有限的疾病，生物chanin-A在抑制癌症发展方面显示出令人满意的结果。生物chanin-A在治疗神经系统疾病、糖尿病、高脂血症和其他慢性疾病/紊乱中也显示出治疗益处。异黄酮因其高效调节人体生理功能而被认为是非凡的。生物chanin-A是存在于大豆（Glycine max）、红三叶草（Trifolium pratense）和苜蓿芽等中的主要异黄酮之一，已被证实具有调节多种疾病中关键细胞机制的潜力。长期以来，它一直被用于控制更年期妇女的症状。鉴于生物chanin-A的多靶向功能，总结其在各种疾病中的作用机制至关重要。生物chanin-A的安全性和有效性需要在涉及人类受试者的临床试验中加以确立。生物chanin-A可能能够修饰人体的多种系统，如心血管系统、中枢神经系统、呼吸系统等。它对激素依赖性癌症和其他癌症显示出显著效果。许多关于生物chanin-A的研究，特别是在乳腺癌、肺癌、结肠癌、前列腺癌和胰腺癌中，均显示出积极影响。通过调节氧化应激、SIRT-1表达、PPARγ受体等多元机制，生物chanin-A产生抗糖尿病作用。生物chanin-A药理能力涉及的多样化分子机制途径表明，它是一个非常具有前景的分子，能够在修饰多种生理功能中发挥重要作用。
review_content_zh:
我已经阅读了题为《生物chanin-A药理应用的机制》的文章。文章写得很好，但作者需要解决以下评论，并在一些地方进行补充。
1. 在第3页，生物chanin显示出对多种癌症的治疗作用，需要提及多发性骨髓瘤，因为生物chanin-A显示出抗-MM活性，并在血液癌部分或适当的地方进行描述。
2. 在第3页，作者写道：“在乳腺癌发展过程中，正常的信号通路被中断，刺激耐药性生长，无细胞死亡，并逐渐侵袭邻近组织。富含大豆的饮食在控制激素依赖性癌症方面最近受到了广泛关注。”这在大多数实体癌中也可能发生，是否有特定原因只提及乳腺癌？
3. 在第5页，作者写道：“生物chanin-A在雌激素受体（ER）阳性的乳腺癌细胞系中，如三阴性乳腺癌细胞MDA-MB231和MCF7，显示出与5-氟尿嘧啶（5FU）的协同作用。”但MCF7细胞不是三阴性细胞，作者需要检查并重写这些句子。
4. 在第6页，作者提到：“临床上显著的前列腺癌患者在手术干预前接受了红车轴草异黄酮如生物chanin-A的治疗。显著地，治疗组中凋亡率更高，表明在低-中等级别恶性前列腺癌进展中的停止（Jarred等，2002）。”我不明白这是临床研究还是体外研究，第一句显示为临床研究，但第二句描述为体外研究。请澄清，这种混淆在多个地方存在...请纠正。
5. 在第6页，作者写道：“根据流行病学研究，富含大豆的食物可能降低普通人群患肺癌的可能性...”也许应该写成：“根据流行病学研究，富含大豆的食物可能降低普通人群患癌症的发生率”，请检查。
6. 在第9页，写道“生物chanin-A具有神经保护作用”，并引用了癌症研究的相关文献，请提供神经保护作用的参考文献，而不是神经癌的。
7. 一些参考文献不合适，请检查。
8. 生物chanin-A也已知具有抗纤维化作用，尤其是肺（IPF）和肝，作者也应探讨这一点。
9. 添加生物chanin-A的局限性将改进手稿。
总体而言，这篇综述是好的。

paper_title: Polymorphism studies and candidate genes associated with litter size traits in Indonesian goats. a systematic review
paper_abstract:
Background : Litter size (LS) is a significant, challenging, and economical aspect of the goat industry in Indonesia. It is influenced by several different factors and genes; consequently, identifying potential genes and loci associated with litter size has become a genetic problem. Several genetic indicators have been found to be associated with litter size in goats. This has prompted the need to discuss candidate genes associated with litter size in goats in Indonesia. 
 Methods : A systematic review was conducted using critical databases including ResearchGate, Google Scholar, PubMed, Google search engine and Science direct. There were any exclusion criteria, they were as follows: articles published in languages other than English, Conference papers, short communication papers and papers not related to animals. After reviewing the abstracts of 42 publications, the remaining 17 investigations were chosen for full paper evaluation. A further eight studies were removed after a comprehensive evaluation of the publications because they did not match our inclusion criteria. 
 Results : These markers include growth differentiation factor 9 ( GDF9 ), bone morphogenetic protein 15 ( BMP15 ), bone morphogenetic protein receptor type IB ( BMPR1B ), and kisspeptin ( KISS1 ). Single nucleotide polymorphisms in these genes contribute to the development of novel genetic markers that helps in the selection of goats with the most favorable genotypes for litter size. This type of genetic selection is more successful than the traditional way of selecting animals for reproductive traits, particularly litter size. 
 Conclusions : As a result, this study summarizes the genetic impacts of polymorphisms in candidate genes associated with litter size features in Indonesian goats.

paper_title_zh: 印尼山羊产仔数性状的多态性研究及相关候选基因：系统综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：产仔数（LS）是印度尼西亚山羊产业中一个重要、具有挑战性且经济相关的方面。它受多种不同因素和基因的影响；因此，识别与产仔数相关的潜在基因和位点已成为一个遗传学问题。已发现几种遗传指标与山羊的产仔数相关。这促使有必要讨论印度尼西亚山羊中与产仔数相关的候选基因。

方法：通过系统综述，使用了关键的数据库，包括ResearchGate、Google Scholar、PubMed、Google搜索引擎和Science Direct。排除标准如下：非英文发表的文章、会议论文、简讯论文以及与动物无关的论文。在审查了42篇出版物的摘要后，选择了剩余的17项研究进行全文评估。在对出版物进行综合评估后，又排除了8项不符合纳入标准的研究。

结果：这些标记包括生长分化因子9（GDF9）、骨形态发生蛋白15（BMP15）、骨形态发生蛋白受体IB型（BMPR1B）和 kisspeptin（KISS1）。这些基因中的单核苷酸多态性有助于开发新型遗传标记，从而帮助选择具有最有利产仔数基因型的山羊。这种遗传选择方法比传统的选择动物繁殖性状，尤其是产仔数的方法更为成功。

结论：因此，本研究总结了印度尼西亚山羊中与产仔数特征相关的候选基因多态性的遗传影响。
review_content_zh:

3. 摘要-结果：

paper_title: The imperative to find the courage to redesign the biomedical research enterprise
paper_abstract: Medical research aims to improve health for everyone. While its advances are undeniable, the pace and cost of the progress are not optimal. For example, independent analyses concluded that at least half of the published biomedical research findings are irreproducible, and most scientific papers are never read or cited. This paper examines biomedical research holistically, as a system of incentives that shape the behavior of scientists, administrators, publishers, and funders, and are detrimental to medical progress. We identify opportunities to change and improve those incentives by altering the way research output is disseminated and evaluated, and recommend transparent, data-driven measures of methodological rigor, reproducibility, and societal value of scientific discoveries. Embracing these opportunities would maximize our investments in biomedical research and optimize its value to human health, while simultaneously increasing freedom, creativity, and satisfaction of the scientific workforce.
review_content:
This is an interesting and valuable article which looks at the current problems in the health and medical research systematic such as (lack of) reproducibility, accessibility, and relevance. Importantly, the paper considers the research enterprise as a system - of researchers, funders, publishers etc., with varying incentives and motivations - and examines potential solutions at this systems level. This is neatly illustrated by Figure 1 showing the poor alignment of the various elements and actors within the research system. There are the seeds of many good ideas within this paper. However considerable meta-research would be necessary before implementing the metrics and solutions proposed - for the detailed development and testing.

I had a few suggestions to consider for changes:
 1. Alongside the Manhattan project an Apollo mission examples, given the current pandemic it would be useful to mention the CEPI vaccine collaboration - Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations (CEPI) which was launched at Davos 2017 and without which we would not have the vaccines we now have - CEPI
 2. The proposed solutions rightly focus on aligning incentives with the need for impactful research requiring collaborations, and well-functioning teams. In "COM-B" terms (Capability + Opportunity + Motivation = Behaviour) the authors' focus is particularly on Motivation. However, it would be helpful to consider some of the Capability and Opportunity elements, such as skills, training, infrastructure, tools, access, etc.
 3. The authors also proposes three new measures: methodological rigour score, a reproducibility score, and a societal impact score - again aimed at incentives/motivation. This is worthwhile, but a complex task and some suggestions on who and how the needed meta-research and experimental studies could be done would be helpful.
 4. There are a number of important initiatives already underway which are aligned with the ideas presented here and it would be useful to set those out in a table, with examples such as:
  * DORA: The Declaration on Research Assessment (DORA) which set out principles addressing the need to improve the ways in which researchers and the outputs of scholarly research are evaluated.
  * The Hong Kong principles: which provide a more detailed set of criteria for assessing researchers for promotion and tenure.
  * The EQUATOR Network centres - for Enhancing the QUAlity and Transparency Of health Research which develop and disseminate the reporting guidelines (CONSORT, PRISMA, etc).
  * EVIR forum - a forum of over 40 research founders founded in 2017 to help health-related research funders increase the value of their research.
  * The evidence based research network - which aims to reduce waste in research by promoting: (a) No new studies without prior systematic review of existing evidence, (b) Efficient production, updating and dissemination of systematic reviews.
paper_title_zh: 重设计生物医药研究体系的勇气之必要
paper_abstract_zh: 医学研究的目的是改善每个人的健康状况。尽管其进步不可否认，但进展的速度和成本并非最优。例如，独立分析得出结论，至少有一半已发表的生物医学研究成果无法重现，而且大多数科学论文从未被阅读或引用。本文全面审视生物医学研究，将其视为一个激励系统，这些激励塑造了科学家、管理者、出版商和资助者的行为，并对医学进步产生不利影响。我们识别了通过改变研究成果的传播和评估方式来改变和改进这些激励的机会，并推荐透明、数据驱动的方法来衡量方法论严谨性、可重现性以及科学发现的社会价值。抓住这些机会将最大化我们对生物医学研究的投资，并优化其对人类健康的价值，同时增加科学工作者的自由、创造力和满意度。
review_content_zh:
这是一篇有趣且具有价值的文章，探讨了当前健康和医学研究系统中的问题，如（缺乏）可重复性、可获取性和相关性。重要的是，该论文将研究事业视为一个系统——包括研究人员、资助者、出版商等，各自有不同的激励和动机——并在系统层面探讨了潜在的解决方案。图1清晰地展示了研究系统内各要素和参与者之间的不良对齐情况。本文蕴含了许多好想法的种子。然而，在实施所提出的指标和解决方案之前，需要进行大量的元研究——以便进行详细的开发和测试。

我有几点修改建议供考虑：
1. 除了曼哈顿项目和阿波罗任务示例之外，鉴于当前的疫情，有必要提及CEPI疫苗合作——流行病防范创新联盟（CEPI），该联盟于2017年在达沃斯启动，没有它我们不会有现在的疫苗——CEPI。
2. 所提出的解决方案正确地聚焦于将激励与需要产生影响的 research 需要的合作和高效运作的团队相匹配。在“COM-B”术语（能力 + 机会 + 动机 = 行为）中，作者特别关注动机。然而，考虑一些能力和机会要素会很有帮助，如技能、培训、基础设施、工具、获取等。
3. 作者还提出了三项新措施：方法严谨性评分、可重复性评分和社会影响评分——同样旨在激励/动机。这是有价值的，但任务复杂，提供一些关于谁以及如何进行所需的元研究和实验研究的建议会很有帮助。
4. 已经有一些重要倡议正在进行中，这些倡议与本文提出的想法相一致，将其列在表格中会很有用，例如：
  * DORA：研究评估宣言（DORA），提出了改进评估研究人员和学术研究成果方式的原则。
  * 香港原则：提供了更详细的评估研究人员晋升和终身教职的标准。
  * EQUATOR网络中心——旨在提高健康研究质量和透明度的中心，开发和传播报告指南（CONSORT, PRISMA等）。
  * EVIR论坛——成立于2017年，由40多个研究资助者组成的论坛，旨在帮助健康相关研究资助者提高其研究的价值。
  * 基于证据的研究网络——旨在通过促进以下方面减少研究浪费：（a）在没有对现有证据进行系统回顾之前不进行新研究，（b）高效地生产、更新和传播系统回顾。

paper_title: Group B Streptococcus vaccine development: present status and future considerations, with emphasis on perspectives for low and middle income countries
paper_abstract:
Globally, group B Streptococcus (GBS) remains the leading cause of sepsis and meningitis in young infants, with its greatest burden in the first 90 days of life. Intrapartum antibiotic prophylaxis (IAP) for women at risk of transmitting GBS to their newborns has been effective in reducing, but not eliminating, the young infant GBS disease burden in many high income countries. However, identification of women at risk and administration of IAP is very difficult in many low and middle income country (LMIC) settings, and is not possible for home deliveries. Immunization of pregnant women with a GBS vaccine represents an alternate pathway to protecting newborns from GBS disease, through the transplacental antibody transfer to the fetus in utero. This approach to prevent GBS disease in young infants is currently under development, and is approaching late stage clinical evaluation. 
This manuscript includes a review of the natural history of the disease, global disease burden estimates, diagnosis and existing control options in different settings, the biological rationale for a vaccine including previous supportive studies, analysis of current candidates in development, possible correlates of protection and current status of immunogenicity assays. Future potential vaccine development pathways to licensure and use in LMICs, trial design and implementation options are discussed, with the objective to provide a basis for reflection, rather than recommendations.
review_content:
This is an excellent review article summarizing the status of GBS vaccine development for global use. This manuscript, in a logical and practical way, lays out the case for further development and testing of a GBS vaccine to be given to mothers primarily for the protection of their neonates.

The burden of maternal and neonatal disease is thoroughly discussed and highlights the paucity of epidemiological data in many resource limited settings. This is the critical data needed to determine the contribution of GBS to overall neonatal morbidity and mortality in low and middle income countries where a candidate vaccine is most likely to be beneficial.

There is an excellent list and discussion of previous GBS vaccine trials and outcomes. Even more useful is the discussion of challenges going forward with GBS vaccine trials, including a review of potential trial endpoints, challenges of any maternal vaccination program, and potential ethical and regulatory hurdles.
paper_title_zh: B族链球菌疫苗研发：现状与未来考量，重点关注低收入和中等收入国家的前景
paper_abstract_zh:
全球范围内，B族链球菌（GBS）仍然是新生儿败血症和脑膜炎的主要致病原因，其最大负担出现在出生后的前90天内。对于有将GBS传给新生儿风险的妇女，产时抗生素预防（IAP）在许多高收入国家已有效减少了新生儿GBS疾病的负担，但并未完全消除。然而，在许多低收入和中等收入国家（LMIC）的环境中，识别有风险的妇女和实施IAP非常困难，对于家庭分娩更是不可能。通过孕妇接种GBS疫苗，通过胎盘抗体转移至胎儿体内，为保护新生儿免受GBS疾病侵害提供了另一种途径。这种预防新生儿GBS疾病的方法目前正在开发中，并即将进入后期临床试验评估阶段。

本文综述了该疾病的自然史、全球疾病负担估计、不同环境下的诊断和现有控制措施、疫苗的生物合理性包括以往的支持性研究、当前开发中的候选疫苗分析、可能的保护相关性状以及免疫原性检测的当前状况。讨论了未来潜在疫苗开发途径以获得许可和在LMIC中的使用、试验设计和实施选项，旨在提供一个反思的基础，而非具体建议。
review_content_zh:
这是一篇优秀的综述文章，总结了全球范围内GBS疫苗开发的现状。该手稿以逻辑性和实践性的方式，阐述了进一步开发和测试GBS疫苗的必要性，该疫苗主要提供给母亲，以保护其新生儿。

文章全面讨论了母婴疾病的负担，并突显了在许多资源有限地区流行病学数据的匮乏。这是确定GBS对低收入和中等收入国家新生儿发病率和死亡率贡献的关键数据，而这些国家最有可能从候选疫苗中受益。

paper_title: A comprehensive review of circRNA: from purification and identification to disease marker potential
paper_abstract: Circular RNA (circRNA) is an endogenous noncoding RNA with a covalently closed cyclic structure. Based on their components, circRNAs are divided into exonic circRNAs, intronic circRNAs and exon-intron circRNAs. CircRNAs have well-conserved sequences and often have high stability due to their resistance to exonucleases. Depending on their sequence, circRNAs are involved in different biological functions, including microRNA sponge activity, modulation of alternative splicing or transcription, interaction with RNA-binding proteins, and rolling translation, and are a derivative of pseudogenes. CircRNAs are involved in the development of a variety of pathological conditions, such as cardiovascular diseases, diabetes, neurological diseases and cancer. Emerging evidence has shown that circRNAs are likely to be new potential clinical diagnostic markers or treatments for many diseases.

paper_title_zh: 环状RNA综合综述：从纯化与鉴定到疾病标志物潜力
paper_abstract_zh: 环状RNA（circRNA）是一种具有共价闭合环状结构的内源性非编码RNA。根据其组成成分，circRNA可分为外显子circRNA、内含子circRNA和外显子-内含子circRNA。circRNA具有高度保守的序列，并且由于其对抗外切酶的特性，通常具有较高的稳定性。根据其序列的不同，circRNA参与多种生物学功能，包括微小RNA海绵活性、调控可变剪接或转录、与RNA结合蛋白相互作用以及滚环翻译，并且是假基因的衍生物。circRNA参与多种病理状态的发展，如心血管疾病、糖尿病、神经性疾病和癌症。越来越多的证据表明，circRNA可能是许多疾病新的潜在临床诊断标志物或治疗靶点。

paper_title: Machine learning algorithms: their applications in plant omics and agronomic traits’ improvement
paper_abstract: Agronomic traits of plants especially those of economic or aesthetic importance are threatened by climatic and environmental factors such as climate change, biotic, and abiotic stresses. These threats are now being mitigated through the analyses of omics data like genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics, and phenomics. The emergence of high-throughput omics technology has led to an avalanche of plant omics data. Plant research demands novel analytical paradigms to extract and harness large plant omics data for plant improvement effectively and efficiently. Machine learning algorithms are well-suited analytical and computational approaches for the integrative analysis of large unstructured, heterogeneous datasets. This study presents an overview of omics approaches to improve plant agronomic traits and crucial curated plant genomic data sources. Furthermore, we summarize machine learning algorithms and software tools/programming packages used in plant omics research. Lastly, we discuss advancements in machine learning algorithms' applications in improving agronomic traits of economically important plants. Extensive application of machine learning would advance plant omics studies. These advancements would consequently help agricultural scientists improve economically important plants’ quality, yield, and tolerance against abiotic and biotic stresses and other plant health-threatening issues.
review_content:
The review paper prepared by Isewon et al. tried to summarize how machine learning models applied to agriculture. This manuscript is not well-structured, many sentences are unclear for me. There are many review papers on this topic in different particular focuses, I did not see the novelty this general review paper contributed to this topic.
 1. It is better to begin with why we need to use machine learning models in agriculture in introduction section, instead of using nearly half of manuscripts to summarize the dataset.
 2. The Table 1 needs to be better organized to include what species and omics data. Also, some links are not working when I click it, need to be double-checked for updates. The title is for plant genomics database, while some are not for genome but for proteomic data, for instance.
 3. It would be more helpful that the authors summarize the database not only for genomic data, but also database have multiple omics data.
 4. Just given definitions of many omics data is not so useful. It would be great to see how to integrate multiple omics data in machine learning to solve agriculture questions.
 5. The sentence “Quality traits encompass morphological features like plant height, seed weight” is incorrect. These traits are quantitative traits in the context of quantitative genetics.
 6. By given the definition of supervised, unsupervised machine leaning models, you should also be mentioned in your following example studies, which are supervised or unsupervised.
 7. In the context of genomic selection, the most common used models, rrBLUP or Bayes models should be mentioned and even compared with any machine learning models.
 8. In the studies you mentioned, it would be better to state the predictability in the main text.
 9. Many statements are unclear for me. For instance, “the lack of robust phenotypic data limits the efficient utilization of available genomic information …”. Why the lack of robust phenotypic data, is it from the measurement error or environmental factors?
10. Many statements need reference paper to support. For instance, “deep learning generated a robust prediction accuracy in grain yield compared to the conventional linear statistical methods…”. The authors need to carefully check the entire manuscripts.
paper_title_zh: 机器学习算法：在植物组学和农艺性状改良中的应用
paper_abstract_zh: 植物的农艺性状，尤其是那些具有经济或美学重要性的性状，正受到气候变化、生物和非生物胁迫等气候和环境因素的影响。这些威胁目前正通过基因组学、转录组学、蛋白质组学、代谢组学和表型组学等组学数据的分析得到缓解。高通量组学技术的出现导致了植物组学数据的激增。植物研究需要新颖的分析范式，以高效地提取和利用大量植物组学数据，从而有效改善植物性状。机器学习算法非常适合于对大型非结构化、异构数据集进行综合分析和计算。本研究概述了用于改善植物农艺性状的组学方法及关键的精选植物基因组数据源。此外，我们总结了在植物组学研究中所使用的机器学习算法及软件工具/编程包。最后，我们讨论了机器学习算法在改善经济重要植物农艺性状方面的应用进展。广泛应用机器学习将推进植物组学研究。这些进展将有助于农业科学家提高经济重要植物的质量、产量以及对非生物和生物胁迫及其他植物健康威胁问题的耐受性。
review_content_zh:
由Isewon等人准备的综述论文试图总结机器学习模型在农业中的应用情况。该手稿结构不佳，许多句子对我来说不够清晰。关于这一主题已有许多不同特定焦点的综述论文，我并未看到这篇综合性综述论文对此主题的贡献有何新颖之处。
1. 在引言部分最好先说明为什么我们需要在农业中使用机器学习模型，而不是用近一半的手稿来总结数据集。
2. 表格1需要更好地组织，以包含物种和组学数据。此外，当我点击某些链接时，它们无法工作，需要仔细检查更新。标题是关于植物基因组数据库的，但有些数据并非基因组数据，而是蛋白质组数据，例如。
3. 如果作者不仅总结基因组数据库，还总结包含多种组学数据的数据库，将更有帮助。
4. 仅给出许多组学数据的定义并不太有用。如果能展示如何将多种组学数据整合到机器学习中以解决农业问题，将更为理想。
5. “质量性状包括形态学特征，如植株高度、种子重量”这一句子是错误的。在数量遗传学的背景下，这些性状属于数量性状。
6. 在给出监督学习和无监督学习模型的定义后，应在后续的示例研究中提及哪些属于监督学习，哪些属于无监督学习。
7. 在基因组选择的背景下，最常用的模型如rrBLUP或贝叶斯模型应被提及，并与任何机器学习模型进行比较。
8. 在你提到的各项研究中，最好在正文部分说明其预测能力。
9. 许多陈述对我来说不够清晰。例如，“缺乏稳健的表型数据限制了现有基因组信息的有效利用……”。为何缺乏稳健的表型数据，是由于测量误差还是环境因素？
10. 许多陈述需要引用文献来支持。例如，“与传统的线性统计方法相比，深度学习在谷物产量预测中产生了稳健的预测准确性……”。作者需要仔细检查整篇手稿。

paper_title: Non-invasive imaging to monitor lupus nephritis and neuropsychiatric systemic lupus erythematosus
paper_abstract: Systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) is an autoimmune disease that can affect multiple different organs, including the kidneys and central nervous system (CNS). Conventional radiological examinations in SLE patients include volumetric/ anatomical computed tomography (CT), magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and ultrasound (US). The utility of these modalities is limited, however, due to the complexity of the disease. Furthermore, standard CT and MRI contrast agents are contraindicated in patients with renal impairment. Various radiologic methods are currently being developed to improve disease characterization in patients with SLE beyond simple anatomical endpoints. Physiological non-contrast MRI protocols have been developed to assess tissue oxygenation, glomerular filtration, renal perfusion, interstitial diffusion, and inflammation-driven fibrosis in lupus nephritis (LN) patients. For neurological symptoms, vessel size imaging (VSI, an MRI approach utilizing T2-relaxing iron oxide nanoparticles) has shown promise as a diagnostic tool. Molecular imaging probes (mostly for MRI and nuclear medicine imaging) have also been developed for diagnosing SLE with high sensitivity, and for monitoring disease activity. This paper reviews the challenges in evaluating disease activity in patients with LN and neuropsychiatric systemic lupus erythematosus (NPSLE). We describe novel MRI and positron-emission tomography (PET) molecular imaging protocols using targeted iron oxide nanoparticles and radioactive ligands, respectively, for detection of SLE-associated inflammation.
review_content:
This well-written review article by Thurman and Serkova focuses on the utility and the potential of non-invasive imaging techniques to monitor two common yet severe manifestations of systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), lupus nephritis (LN) and neuro-psychiatric SLE (NPSLE). The authors summarize the clinical challenges posed by the unpredictable course of SLE, explain the need for better biomarkers of disease activity in LN and NPSLE, critically review both the utility and limitations of conventional radiologic imaging, and discuss the promise of molecular imaging for monitoring LN and NPSLE.

Minor points to consider:
 1. When introducing lupus nephritis (page 3), the WHO classification is mentioned only in passing. More detail will help orient the reader and provide context when discussing "proliferative LN" in the next paragraph.
 2. Page 4, when discussing particular autoAbs associated with LN, the authors may consider referencing very recent studies identifying IgG2 autoAbs to alpha-enolase or annexin AI are a major component of immune deposits in kidney biopsies from LN patients (Bruschi et al, 2014).
 3. Page 5, C3b and C3d are introduced without providing much background information how this fragments arise.
 4. On page 3, paragraph 7: NPLSE should be NPSLE.
paper_title_zh: 无创成像监测狼疮肾炎和神经精神系统性红斑狼疮
paper_abstract_zh: 系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）是一种可影响多个不同器官的自身免疫性疾病，包括肾脏和中枢神经系统（CNS）。SLE患者的常规放射学检查包括容积/解剖计算机断层扫描（CT）、磁共振成像（MRI）和超声（US）。然而，由于疾病的复杂性，这些检查手段的效用有限。此外，标准CT和MRI对比剂在肾功能受损的患者中是禁忌的。目前，正在开发各种放射学方法，以改善SLE患者的疾病特征描述，超越简单的解剖学终点。已开发出生理性无对比剂MRI协议，用于评估狼疮肾炎（LN）患者的组织氧合、肾小球滤过、肾脏灌注、间质扩散和炎症驱动的纤维化。对于神经系统症状，血管大小成像（VSI，一种利用T2弛豫铁氧化纳米颗粒的MRI方法）显示出作为诊断工具的潜力。分子成像探针（主要用于MRI和核医学成像）也已开发，用于高灵敏度诊断SLE，并监测疾病活动。本文综述了评估LN和神经精神系统性红斑狼疮（NPSLE）患者疾病活动的挑战。我们描述了使用靶向铁氧化纳米颗粒和放射性配体的新型MRI和正电子发射断层扫描（PET）分子成像协议，分别用于检测SLE相关炎症。
review_content_zh:
这篇由瑟曼和塞尔科娃撰写的综述文章文笔流畅，重点探讨了非侵入性成像技术监测系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）两种常见且严重的表现——狼疮肾炎（LN）和神经精神狼疮（NPSLE）的实用性和潜力。作者总结了SLE不可预测病程带来的临床挑战，解释了在LN和NPSLE中需要更好疾病活动生物标志物的必要性，批判性地回顾了传统放射影像学的实用性和局限性，并讨论了分子成像在监测LN和NPSLE方面的前景。

需考虑的次要问题：
1. 在介绍狼疮肾炎（第3页）时，仅简要提及了WHO分类。更多细节将有助于读者定位并提供在下一段落讨论“增殖性LN”时的背景。
2. 第4页，在讨论与LN相关的特定自身抗体时，作者可以考虑引用非常近期的研究，指出IgG2自身抗体针对α-烯醇酶或膜联蛋白AI是LN患者肾活检中免疫沉积物的主要成分（Bruschi等人，2014年）。
3. 第5页，C3b和C3d的引入未提供这些片段如何产生的背景信息。
4. 第3页，第7段：NPLSE应为NPSLE。
