The review covers an impressive number of things: 50+ models, 30+ evaluation tasks, 170+ datasets, and 700+ related works.

paper_title: A systematic review on hand gesture recognition techniques, challenges and applications
paper_abstract: Background. With the development of today's technology, and as humans tend to naturally use hand gestures in their communication process to clarify their intentions, hand gesture recognition is considered to be an important part of Human Computer Interaction (HCI), which gives the computers the ability of capturing and interpreting hand gestures, and executing commands afterwards. The aim of this study is to perform a systematic literature review for identifying the most prominent techniques, applications and challenges in hand gesture recognition.
review_content: Reviewer 2 (Anonymous) Basic reporting The paper follows the appropriate structure for a review paper. In the main, the English language is easy to read, however, it would benefit from proofreading particularly for grammatical errors. For example, (1) there are multiple examples of run-on sentences (e.g. line 79 “In artificial intelligence, machine learning enables the computers to learn without being explicitly programmed (Margaret, 2016), there are two types of learning; the process when algorithms ….), (2) incomplete sentences (e.g. line 82: “Classification aims of building a model based on previous training hand gestures to classify new hand gestures.” and (3) poor/incorrect wording, including use of the word “researches” where “research” would be more appropriate (e.g. in the abstract’s Conclusion “We shall also introduce the most recent researches..” and reference to “unwell-organized documents” in line 122 and elsewhere. • To make the text more readable: Sentences were reconstructed and further explanations were provided. Run-on sentences, incorrect wordings, and incomplete sentences were fixed. Overviews and introductions were added to subsections. Furthermore, illustrative images were added. The raw data is supplied as a link to a .rar file, which I did not seem to be able to open without downloading and installing additional software. • To make raw data available: a zip file of raw data was also provided, and a link to a public share. Experimental design This paper presents a review of prior work on hand-gesture recognition. The topic is timely and interesting, however I feel the survey methodology has a number of important limitations: 1. The search was limited to IEEE Explore, and hence would have missed a large body of related literature outside of IEEE, for example, papers in the ACM Digital Library. • To explain why the area of study was from IEEE and was focused on 2016-2018: (line 97) The reason why the most recent research from IEEE were chosen to be studied is that we wanted to construct a valid base of the current situation and technologies of hand gesture recognition. Furthermore, the works from IEEE in the year 2016 to 2018 were considered to increase the intensity and focus of this study, and because the recent works were not sufficiently studied before, where the older ones were studied and compared more such as in (Rafiqul & Noor, 2012; Arpita. G. & S., 2013; Deepali & J., 2012). 2. Two main “keywords” were used: “hand gesture recognition” and “hand gesture techniques.” It’s unclear if these search terms would have found papers that use other related terminology (e.g. in-air gestures) or terms that describe some of the common technologies (e.g. Leap motion). It is also important to clarify if touchscreen gestures are included in this review or not. • To explain the search keywords used: (line 121) Two main keywords were used for the search process: hand gesture recognition and hand gesture techniques, other keywords were also used to include synonyms, where the keywords focused on the domain of research questions. 3. The methodology needs further elaboration and examples of exclusion criteria, for the reader to be able to understand fully and have confidence in the method. For example “after removing duplicates” – how were duplicates defined? • To explain what duplicate removal is: (line 126) After removing duplicates 560 titles were screened, there were duplicates because of using multiple keywords to gather the related works thus the same work would appear under more than one keyword. “papers were excluded for having titles with no relevance to the review” – what were the criteria for relevance, who applied them, are they unambiguous and repeatable by different reviewers? This also calls into question the appropriateness of the search terms (see #2 above). • To explain what title scanning is: (line 128) Then 316 papers were excluded for having titles with no relevance to the review questions in general, where titles were scanned and processed by authors to specify whether the works are pertinent to any chosen subcategory of hand gesture recognition. • To address researchers involved in the process of final selection: (line 142) Overall, the selection was made by the authors based on two criteria; relevance to the research questions, organization and form of writing of the papers studied. “unwell-organized documents were removed” – again, how was this defined and applied? • To explain what full document scanning is: (line 135) Full papers of 144 potentially relevant references were selected for further examination. After reading the full papers, 49 unwell-organized documents that do not have a clear methodology justification were removed due to lack of validation and weakness of results justification, for example some of the works excluded did not explain why they chose their approach of acquisition or classification in comparison with all the possible approaches available in the recent technology, or did not explain why their proposed approach performed in the way they provide. It would also be good to see some further explanation of how many researchers reviewed the final list of included papers and what were the steps involved in reviewing the papers. • To address researchers involved in the process of final selection: (line 142) Overall, the selection was made by the authors based on two criteria; relevance to the research questions, organization and form of writing of the papers studied. I also wonder if “scoping review” or “state of the art review” would be a more accurate reflection of this work, since “systematic review” often suggests a review of studies that have a common aim of answering a (healthcare-related) question. • To explain why this is a systematic literature review: This is one of the popular literature review types which has been applied on many fields including Human Computer Interaction. The process of the systematic literature review is illustrated in Fig. 2 “PRISMA flow diagram of the study selection process”. Validity of the findings The authors present a substantial body of literature. To a large degree, it reads as a list of who did what and it would be more valuable to the reader if there was greater synthesis of the literature, drawing out insights derived from having oversight of the field. • To visualize the outcomes of the work and draw out insights: (line 172) Fig. 4 demonstrates the results of this review, answering each research question by showing the most popular method used in each subcategory. The authors have grouped the results/analysis into headings and subheadings, which is important for a review. However, I felt the chosen structure of headings and subheadings did not work very well, particularly for section 1 and its subsections. For example, the choice of features depends very much on the underlying data that has been captured – and so it does not seem to make much sense to list features used by computer-vision based systems alongside EMG features, without the context of what each system is aiming to achieve. One suggestion is to organise the literature in terms of the acquisition systems, and then present the features and classification methods that have been investigated for each acquisition system. This would enable like-for-like comparisons to be made, and also enable comparisons across different acquisition systems. • To solve the subsections problem in section 1: Context of what each system is aiming to achieve along with the feature extraction methods are relocated before mentioning the features extracted or classification algorithms. Similarly, the technical challenges are highly-dependent on the type of system being used, and so again, it would make more sense to present the challenges by system, and then draw out common themes within and across types of system. • To solve the challenges subsection problem: From the study we preformed it was clear that the challenges authors faced were dependent on certain factors such as; the acquisition tool, if not then the data type, the environmental surrounding, …etc., thus it is difficult to subcategorize the challenges based on the system used due to the variety of recent systems, but on the other hand it is applicable to subcategorize them based on the challenges themselves because they are more limited. The section on applications presents a very limited view of where gestures are being used and explored currently, and I suspect is a result of the search being limited to IEEE Xplore. It does not seem to reflect the current state of the art, and I think it likely that expanding the search would enable the authors to expand out the “Others” section quite substantially. • To clarify the applications section: Gestures are surely being explored in many applications currently due to the technological advances, however this section reflects the most commonly and recently applied gestures rather than all of the available gestures in todays technology. • To explain why the area of study was from IEEE and was focused on 2016-2018: (line 97) The reason why the most recent research from IEEE were chosen to be studied is that we wanted to construct a valid base of the current situation and technologies of hand gesture recognition. Furthermore, the works from IEEE in the year 2016 to 2018 were considered to increase the intensity and focus of this study, and because the recent works were not sufficiently studied before, where the older ones were studied and compared more such as in (Rafiqul & Noor, 2012; Arpita. G. & S., 2013; Deepali & J., 2012). The section on “the future of hand gesture recognition” is quite speculative, and while I understand speculation is acceptable and welcomed in PeerJ, I feel it still needs a good grounding in the literature and this grounding is not evident in this section. • To ground the section of the future of hand gesture recognition: Evidence references were added. The conclusions don’t all seem to follow from the literature – for example, much of the literature presented in the paper appears to use camera sensors, whereas the paper concludes that surface EMG “were the most acquisition tools used”. • To clarify the most used acquisition tool: the surface electromyography (sEMG) sensors with wearable hand gesture devices were the most acquisition tools used in the works studied, not the camera based. Comments for the Author The topic of this paper is timely and would be of interest and value to the research community. • This is what we aim for, thank you. All the changes are marked red in a highlighted manuscript. We appreciate the time reviewers spent on this manuscript; all of their suggestions noticeably enhanced the work. We hope the manuscript is now in a form acceptable for publication in PeerJ. Yours Sincerely, Mais Yasen, Dr. Shaidah Jusoh
paper_title_zh: 手部手势识别技术、挑战及应用的系统综述
paper_abstract_zh: 背景。随着当今技术的发展，以及人类在交流过程中自然倾向于使用手势来明确其意图，手势识别被认为是人机交互（HCI）的重要组成部分，它赋予计算机捕捉和解释手势的能力，并在此后执行命令。本研究的目的是通过系统文献综述，识别手势识别中最突出的技术、应用和挑战。
review_content_zh:
审稿人2（匿名）基本报告
本文遵循了综述论文的适当结构。总体而言，英语语言易于阅读，但会从校对中受益，尤其是语法错误。例如：(1) 存在多个流水句的例子（例如，第79行“在人工智能中，机器学习使计算机能够在未经明确编程的情况下学习（Margaret, 2016），存在两种学习类型；算法的过程……），(2) 不完整的句子（例如，第82行：“分类旨在基于先前训练的手势构建模型以分类新的手势。”），(3) 不当/错误的用词，包括使用“researches”一词，而“research”更为合适（例如，在摘要的结论中“我们还将介绍最新的研究……”以及在122行及其他地方提到的“组织不善的文档”）。
• 为使文本更易读：句子进行了重构，并提供了进一步的解释。修正了流水句、不当用词和不完整句子。子部分添加了概述和引言。此外，还添加了说明性图片。原始数据以.rar文件链接的形式提供，我似乎无法在不下载和安装额外软件的情况下打开。
• 为使原始数据可用：还提供了原始数据的zip文件，并附上了公共分享链接。
实验设计
本文对先前关于手势识别的工作进行了综述。该主题及时且有趣，但我认为调查方法存在一些重要局限性：
1. 搜索仅限于IEEE Explore，因此可能错过了大量IEEE以外的相关文献，例如，ACM数字图书馆中的论文。
• 解释为何研究范围来自IEEE并聚焦于2016-2018年：（第97行）选择研究IEEE的最新研究的原因是我们希望构建一个关于当前手势识别现状和技术的有效基础。此外，考虑2016年至2018年IEEE的工作是为了增加本研究的强度和焦点，并且因为近期的工作尚未充分研究，而较早期的工作已被研究和比较较多，如（Rafiqul & Noor, 2012; Arpita. G. & S., 2013; Deepali & J., 2012）。
2. 使用了两个主要“关键词”：“手势识别”和“手势技术”。不清楚这些搜索词是否能够找到使用其他相关术语（例如，空中手势）或描述一些常见技术（例如，Leap运动）的论文。还需要澄清是否包含触摸屏手势在本综述中。 • 解释所使用的搜索关键词：（第121行）搜索过程中使用了两个主要关键词：手势识别和手势技术，还使用了其他关键词以包含同义词，这些关键词集中在研究问题的领域。3. 研究方法需要进一步详细说明，并提供排除标准的示例，以便读者能够完全理解并对该方法有信心。例如“在去除重复项后”——如何定义重复项？• 解释什么是去除重复项：（第126行）去除重复项后，筛选了560个标题，由于使用多个关键词收集相关作品，因此同一作品会在多个关键词下出现。“由于标题与综述无关而排除的论文”——相关性的标准是什么，谁应用的这些标准，它们是否明确且可由不同评审者重复？这也引发了搜索术语适当性的问题（见上述第2点）。• 解释什么是标题扫描：（第128行）然后排除了316篇标题与研究问题无关的论文，标题由作者扫描和处理，以确定作品是否与所选手势识别的任何子类别相关。• 涉及最终选择过程的研究人员：（第142行）总体而言，选择由作者基于两个标准进行：与研究问题的相关性，以及所研究论文的组织和写作形式。“组织不当的文档被移除”——再次，这是如何定义和应用的？• 解释什么是全文扫描：（第135行）选择了144篇潜在相关参考文献的全文进行进一步检查。阅读全文后，移除了49篇组织不当、缺乏明确方法论依据的文档，由于缺乏验证和结果论证的薄弱，例如一些被排除的作品没有解释为什么选择他们的采集或分类方法，与现有技术中所有可能的方法相比，或者没有解释为什么他们提出的方法按他们提供的方式表现。还希望看到更多关于多少研究人员审查了最终包含的论文列表以及审查论文所涉及步骤的解释。• 涉及最终选择过程的研究人员：（第142行）总体而言，选择由作者基于两个标准进行：与研究问题的相关性，以及所研究论文的组织和写作形式。我还想知道“范围综述”或“最新进展综述”是否更能准确反映这项工作，因为“系统综述”通常意味着对具有共同目标（如回答与健康相关的问题）的研究进行综述。 • 解释为何这是一篇系统性的文献综述：这是文献综述中较为流行的一种类型，已被应用于包括人机交互在内的多个领域。系统性文献综述的过程在图2“PRISMA研究选择流程图”中进行了说明。研究发现的效度：作者呈现了大量的文献。在很大程度上，它读起来像是一份“谁做了什么”的清单，如果能够对文献进行更深入的整合，提炼出对领域的整体洞察，对读者将更有价值。• 可视化工作成果并提炼洞察：（第172行）图4展示了本次综述的结果，通过显示每个子类别中最常用的方法来回答每个研究问题。作者将结果/分析分成了标题和子标题，这对综述来说很重要。然而，我觉得所选择的标题和子标题结构并不太理想，尤其是第1节及其子节。例如，特征的选择很大程度上取决于所捕获的底层数据——因此，在没有了解每个系统目标的情况下，将计算机视觉系统使用的特征与EMG特征并列列出，似乎不太合理。一个建议是按照采集系统来组织文献，然后呈现每个采集系统所研究的特征和分类方法。这将使得可以进行同类比较，也能在不同采集系统之间进行比较。• 解决第1节子节问题：将每个系统的目标背景及特征提取方法提前说明，然后再提及提取的特征或分类算法。同样，技术挑战也高度依赖于所使用的系统类型，因此，按系统类型呈现挑战，然后提炼出系统内和跨系统类型的共同主题，将更为合理。• 解决挑战子节问题：从我们进行的研究中可以看出，作者面临的挑战依赖于某些因素，如采集工具、数据类型、环境等，因此，由于近期系统的多样性，很难根据系统类型对挑战进行子分类，但另一方面，根据挑战本身进行子分类是可行的，因为挑战更为有限。应用部分对当前手势使用和探索的视角非常有限，我怀疑这是由于搜索仅限于IEEE Xplore所致。这似乎未能反映当前的技术前沿，我认为扩大搜索范围将使作者能够大幅扩展“其他”部分的内容。 • 为了澄清应用部分：由于技术进步，手势确实在许多当前应用中得到了探索，然而这一部分反映的是最常见和最近应用的手势，而不是当今技术中所有可用的手势。• 解释为什么研究范围来自IEEE并集中在2016-2018年：（第97行）选择研究IEEE最新研究的原因是我们希望构建一个关于当前手势识别现状和技术的有效基础。此外，选择2016年至2018年IEEE的工作是为了增加这项研究的强度和焦点，并且因为最近的工作之前没有得到充分研究，而较旧的工作则被更深入地研究和比较，例如（Rafiqul & Noor, 2012; Arpita. G. & S., 2013; Deepali & J., 2012）。关于“手势识别的未来”的部分相当具有推测性，虽然我理解在PeerJ中推测是可接受和欢迎的，但我认为这一部分仍需在文献中有良好的基础，而这一基础在这一部分中并不明显。• 为手势识别未来的部分提供依据：添加了证据参考文献。结论并不都似乎来自文献——例如，论文中呈现的许多文献似乎使用的是摄像头传感器，而论文却得出表面肌电图（surface EMG）“是最常用的采集工具”。• 澄清最常用的采集工具：表面肌电图（sEMG）传感器与可穿戴手势设备是最常用于所研究工作中的采集工具，而不是基于摄像头的。对作者的评论 这篇论文的主题及时，对研究社区具有兴趣和价值。• 这正是我们的目标，谢谢。所有更改都在高亮的手稿中以红色标记。我们感谢审稿人为此手稿所花费的时间；他们的所有建议明显提升了这项工作。我们希望手稿现在已符合PeerJ的发表要求。此致，Mais Yasen，Shaidah Jusoh博士

reasons: The search was limited to IEEE Explore, and hence would have missed a large body of related literature outside of IEEE, for example, papers in the ACM Digital Library.
It’s unclear if these search terms would have found papers that use other related terminology (e.g. in-air gestures) or terms that describe some of the common technologies (e.g. Leap motion).
The section on applications presents a very limited view of where gestures are being used and explored currently, and I suspect is a result of the search being limited to IEEE Xplore.
It does not seem to reflect the current state of the art, and I think it likely that expanding the search would enable the authors to expand out the “Others” section quite substantially.

The section on “the future of hand gesture recognition” is quite speculative, and while I understand speculation is acceptable and welcomed in PeerJ, I feel it still needs a good grounding in the literature and this grounding is not evident in this section.
The topic is timely and interesting, however I feel the survey methodology has a number of important limitations
how were duplicates defined?
what were the criteria for relevance, who applied them, are they unambiguous and repeatable by different reviewers?
To explain what title scanning is: (line 128)
again, how was this defined and applied?
The paper follows the appropriate structure for a review paper.
The methodology needs further elaboration and examples of exclusion criteria, for the reader to be able to understand fully and have confidence in the method.

paper_title: The science of printing and polishing 3D printed dentures
paper_abstract:
Objective 
 To analyze the effectiveness of various techniques available for printing, finishing and polishing of 3D printed prosthesis. 
 
 
 Methods 
 The articles were selected from electronic databases including PubMed and Scopus. Recently, lot of advancements have been observed in the field of 3D printing in dentistry. 
 
 
 Results 
 Numerous studies were found explaining the factors affecting the surface roughness such as printing speed, direction, layer thickness, post curing, etc., and the significance in achieving a smooth surface finish of a 3D printed prosthesis. The methods employed to achieve this range, similar to conventional and chairside polishing, are to use advanced coating materials such as light cured glazes to nanoparticles. 
 
 
 Conclusion 
 3D printing is being used in day-to-day practice and the prosthesis must be aesthetic looking to satisfy the patients’ expectations. There is a lack of data supporting any one polishing method for the prosthesis. There is a need for further research on the existing techniques and newer advancements yielding aesthetic prostheses with an optimal surface finish.
review_content:
This article presents a well-structured review on 3D-printed denture techniques, analyzing printing and polishing methods and their impact on surface roughness, though some details could be further elaborated.

'Some of the methods used for printing complete dentures include…'
Can these technologies, such as FDM and MJ, be used directly to fabricate dentures for clinical use or only for making trial dentures or custom trays? It is recommended that this part be combined with practical clinical applications.

DLP is the most commonly used printing technology and should be introduced in more detail.

The author states that '... which impacts the precision of the final product'. According to ISO 5725-4, accuracy includes both trueness and precision. Does the author mean accuracy?

Currently, studies on build orientation and layer thicknesses are carried out using standardized specimens made of denture material in the form of discs. When such specimens are placed and sliced horizontally (0°), the stepwise effect is not generated on some of their surfaces, possibly including the surface being tested. However, the morphology of dentures is an irregular geometry, and the authors are advised to specify this, and it cannot be argued that the surface properties of horizontally printed dentures are more advantageous.
Similarly, when the specimen is placed horizontally, the effect of the layer thickness on the surface morphology will not be demonstrated on the surface tested but on the sidewalls.
paper_title_zh: 3D打印义齿的打印与抛光科学
paper_abstract_zh:
目标
分析可用于3D打印义肢打印、加工和抛光的各项技术的有效性。

方法
文章选自PubMed和Scopus等电子数据库。近年来，在牙科3D打印领域观察到许多进步。

结果
发现了许多研究，解释了影响表面粗糙度的因素，如打印速度、方向、层厚、后固化等，以及这些因素在实现3D打印义肢光滑表面处理中的重要性。为实现这一目标所采用的方法与传统的椅旁抛光类似，包括使用先进的涂层材料，如光固化釉料到纳米粒子。

结论
3D打印正在日常实践中得到应用，义肢必须外观美观以满足患者的期望。缺乏支持任何一种抛光方法的数据。需要进一步研究现有技术和新的进步，以产生具有最佳表面处理的审美义肢。
review_content_zh:
本文对3D打印义齿技术进行了结构严谨的综述，分析了打印和抛光方法及其对表面粗糙度的影响，尽管某些细节可以进一步阐述。

“用于打印全口义齿的一些方法包括…”
这些技术，如FDM和MJ，能否直接用于制造临床使用的义齿，还是仅用于制作试戴义齿或定制托盘？建议将这部分内容与实际临床应用相结合。

DLP是最常用的打印技术，应进行更详细的介绍。

作者指出“…这影响了最终产品的精度”。根据ISO 5725-4，准确性包括真实度和精度。作者是否指的是准确性？

目前，关于构建方向和层厚的研究是使用标准化的圆盘状义齿材料试件进行的。当此类试件水平放置并水平切片（0°）时，其某些表面（可能包括被测试的表面）不会产生阶梯效应。然而，义齿的形态是不规则的几何形状，建议作者明确这一点，不能断言水平打印义齿的表面性能更具优势。
同样，当试件水平放置时，层厚对表面形态的影响不会在被测试的表面上显示，而会在侧壁上显示。

reasons: Article covers relevant methods of polishing 3D dentures.
There is a comprehensive discussion of all the methods including glazing.
The facts are adequately supported by the current literature.
However, the morphology of dentures is an irregular geometry, and the authors are advised to specify this

This article presents a well-structured review on 3D-printed denture techniques, analyzing printing and polishing methods and their impact on surface roughness, though some details could be further elaborated.

paper_title: Comparison of the Informed Health Choices Key Concepts Framework to other frameworks relevant to teaching and learning how to think critically about health claims and choices: a systematic review
paper_abstract:
Background: The Informed Health Choices (IHC) Key Concepts are principles for evaluating the trustworthiness of claims about treatment effects. The Key Concepts provide a framework for developing learning-resources to help people use the concepts when treatment claims are made, and when they make health choices. 
 Objective: To compare the framework provided by the IHC Key Concepts to other frameworks intended to promote critical thinking about treatment (intervention) claims and choices. 
 Methods: We identified relevant frameworks from reviews of frameworks, searching Google Scholar, citation searches, and contact with key informants. We included frameworks intended to provide a structure for teaching or learning to think critically about the basis for claims, evidence used to support claims, or informed choices. For a framework to be included, there had to be a description of its purpose; a list of concepts, competences, or dispositions; and definitions of key terms. We made independent assessments of framework eligibility and extracted data for each included framework using standardised forms. 
 Results: Twenty-two frameworks met our inclusion criteria. The purpose of the IHC Framework is similar to that of two frameworks for critical thinking and somewhat similar to that of a framework for evidence-based practice. Those frameworks have broader scopes than the IHC Framework. An important limitation of broad frameworks is that they do not provide an adequate basis (concepts) for deciding which claims to believe and what to do. There was at most some overlap between the concepts, competences, and dispositions in each of the 22 included frameworks and those in the IHC Framework. 
 Conclusions: The IHC Key Concepts Framework appears to be unique.  Our review has shown how it and other frameworks can be improved by taking account of the ways in which other related frameworks have been developed, evaluated, and made useful.
review_content:
Thanks to the authors for this important and interesting paper.

The Informed Health Choices (IHC) project aims to support people to evaluate the trustworthiness of health claims and to make informed choices. The IHC Key Concepts provide a framework for designing curricula, learning resources and evaluation tools. The framework has been updated and extended regularly. It comprises several concepts, competences and dispositions in different groups.

Objective of this systematic review was to compare the IHC Key Concepts Framework to other frameworks that are relevant to teaching and learning how to think critically about treatment claims, evidence and choices.

The frameworks were mainly identified from reviews of frameworks and by searching Google Scholar. Twenty-two frameworks were included. Two authors independently extracted information on purposes, definitions of key terms, included elements, methods of development and evaluation, and the way the frameworks were used to develop curricula, learning resources and assessment tools. Strengths and weaknesses of each framework were assessed. The authors described the frameworks in detail and displayed differences and similarities in comparison to the IHC Key Concepts Framework. They concluded that the IHC Key Concepts Framework is unique and that it can be improved by taking account of the ways in which other related frameworks have been developed, evaluated, and made useful. The findings can also be used to improve other frameworks.

A possible limitation of the manuscript is the exclusively search in Google Scholar. Underlying algorithms are unknown and searches cannot be replicated reliably. The authors themselves stated that they may have missed frameworks. We agree with them that it is unlikely that additional frameworks would substantially change the findings of the review.
paper_title_zh: 《知情健康选择关键概念框架与其他相关框架的比较：用于教学和学习如何批判性地思考健康声明和选择的系统综述》
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：知情健康选择（IHC）关键概念是评估治疗效果声明的可信度的原则。这些关键概念提供了一个框架，用于开发学习资源，帮助人们在面对治疗声明和做出健康选择时使用这些概念。

目的：比较IHC关键概念提供的框架与其他旨在促进对治疗（干预）声明和选择进行批判性思考的框架。

方法：我们从框架综述、Google Scholar搜索、引文搜索和与关键信息提供者的联系中识别相关框架。我们纳入了旨在为教授或学习批判性思考声明基础、支持声明的证据或知情选择提供结构的框架。要纳入框架，必须有其目的描述；概念、能力或倾向的列表；以及关键术语的定义。我们独立评估了框架的资格，并使用标准化表格提取了每个纳入框架的数据。

结果：有22个框架符合我们的纳入标准。IHC框架的目的与两个批判性思维框架相似，与一个基于证据的实践框架有些相似。这些框架的范围比IHC框架更广。广泛框架的一个重要局限是，它们没有提供足够的基础（概念）来决定相信哪些声明以及该做什么。在22个纳入框架中的每个框架的概念、能力和倾向与IHC框架中的概念、能力和倾向之间最多只有部分重叠。

结论：IHC关键概念框架似乎独一无二。我们的综述展示了如何通过考虑其他相关框架的开发、评估和实用化方式来改进IHC框架和其他框架。
review_content_zh:
感谢作者们撰写了这篇重要且有趣的论文。

“知情健康选择”（Informed Health Choices, IHC）项目旨在支持人们评估健康声明的可信度，并做出明智的选择。IHC关键概念提供了一个框架，用于设计课程、学习资源和评估工具。该框架定期更新和扩展，包含不同组别中的多个概念、能力和倾向。

本系统综述的目的是将IHC关键概念框架与其他与教授和学习如何批判性地思考治疗声明、证据和选择相关的框架进行比较。

这些框架主要通过框架综述和搜索Google Scholar来识别。共纳入了22个框架。两位作者独立提取了关于目的、关键术语定义、包含元素、开发和方法评估以及框架用于开发课程、学习资源和评估工具的方式的信息。评估了每个框架的优势和劣势。作者详细描述了这些框架，并与IHC关键概念框架比较了其差异和相似之处。他们得出结论，IHC关键概念框架是独特的，并且可以通过借鉴其他相关框架的开发、评估和实用化方式来改进。这些发现也可以用于改进其他框架。

手稿的一个可能局限性是仅搜索了Google Scholar。其底层算法未知，搜索结果无法可靠地复制。作者自己也表示他们可能遗漏了一些框架。我们同意他们的观点，即额外的框架不太会实质性改变综述的发现。

reasons: A possible limitation of the manuscript is the exclusively search in Google Scholar.
The authors themselves stated that they may have missed frameworks.
Underlying algorithms are unknown and searches cannot be replicated reliably.

Comparisons between the IHC framework and the included frameworks in the review are tabulated clearly and the accompanying figures demonstrating relationships between, for example, critical thinking and the key concepts framework are welcomed.

paper_title: Economic evaluations of peritoneal dialysis and hemodialysis: 2004-2012
paper_abstract: Background : End-stage renal disease (ESRD) is a debilitating condition resulting in death unless treated. Treatment options include conservative care, transplantation, and dialysis. Major alternative dialysis modalities include peritoneal dialysis (PD) and in-center hemodialysis (ICHD), which have been shown to produce similar outcomes and survival. The need to provide dialysis treatment for patients with ESRD represents a significant financial challenge for global health care systems. Changes in clinically-appropriate dialysis delivery leading to more efficient use of resources would increase health systems’ ability to meet that challenge. The purpose of this paper is to evaluate the economic literature of PD and ICHD within the context of continued economic uncertainty and pressure on healthcare resource use. Methods: A systematic literature search was conducted for studies published between 2004 and 2012.  Articles are included if they were original research studies in English which reported costs and/or cost effectiveness associated with PD and ICHD. Results: Twenty-four articles are included in our review, six of which are cost effectiveness studies comparing PD and ICHD. Conclusions: Our findings echo those of prior published reviews, showing that PD is significantly cost-saving compared to ICHD therapy in most developed countries and some developing countries. Increasing the use of clinically-appropriate PD would substantially reduce healthcare costs.
review_content:
This paper is a systematic review of the comparative cost of dialysis modalities. In some ways it is a self-fulfilling prophecy- led by Baxter, clearly with a strong proprietary interest in seeing expansion of peritoneal dialysis. Having said that, however, the authors do a reasonable job of articulating the limitations of the current analysis. There are a number of issues, however, that need to be addressed for the conclusions to be supportable:
 1. The authors need to more clearly distinguish between “cost” and “payment”. Although this is complex and may be difficult with the papers that were available for analysis, this is key if the purpose is to inform policy makers or clinicians in various countries about the relative value provided by ICHD vs. PD. For example, despite being “less costly” than ICHD, PD may not be viable in a country where the actual payment is less than the actual cost of delivering the modality.
 2. It is not clear how the comparison of total costs is accounted for vs. the costs of the modality per se. It would be much more useful to provide information on the distribution of costs by category and how these differ by modality and country. At the end of the day it is the total costs of care that matter- one might envision a country where there is little payment for in-patient care. Any differences in hospitalization rates might not be reflected in the data presented but may be important in determining which modality is most cost effective.
 3. In addition to the comment above, the authors very glibly state that clinical outcomes for ICHD and PD are the same. This may not be the same in all countries, however. For example, if peritonitis rates are high and hospitalizations are frequent for infection or catheter malfunctions the total costs of PD may be significantly higher than ICHD.
 4. The paragraph in the Introduction about the changing reimbursement systems is too simplistic and rapidly becoming outdated. The authors need to contextualize this work by clearly discussing the need to examine total costs of care and the overall value of competing modalities (quality/cost).
 5. The tables would be easier to interpret if the currency were normalized. I understand the complexity of this, but just showing the comparison between ICHD and PD within a country and not among countries seems to be a missed opportunity.
paper_title_zh: 腹膜透析与血液透析的经济评估：2004-2012
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：终末期肾病（ESRD）是一种致残性疾病，若不治疗将导致死亡。治疗选项包括保守治疗、移植和透析。主要的替代透析方式包括腹膜透析（PD）和中心血液透析（ICHD），研究表明这两种方式在疗效和生存率上相似。为ESRD患者提供透析治疗对全球卫生保健系统构成了显著的经济挑战。改变临床适宜的透析方式，以更高效地利用资源，将增强卫生系统应对这一挑战的能力。本文旨在评估在持续经济不确定性和医疗资源使用压力背景下，PD和ICHD的经济文献。

方法：系统检索了2004年至2012年间发表的研究文献。纳入标准为英文原创研究，报告了与PD和ICHD相关的成本和/或成本效益。

结果：共有24篇文章纳入我们的综述，其中6篇为比较PD和ICHD的成本效益研究。

结论：我们的发现与前人发表的综述一致，显示在大多数发达国家和一些发展中国家，PD相比ICHD治疗显著节省成本。增加临床适宜的PD使用将大幅降低医疗费用。
review_content_zh:
本文是对透析方式比较成本的系统性综述。在某些方面，它是一种自我实现的预言——由 Baxter 领导，显然对腹膜透析的扩展有着强烈的专有利益。尽管如此，作者们还是合理地阐述了当前分析的局限性。然而，为了使结论具有支持性，仍需解决一些问题：

1. 作者需要更明确地区分“成本”和“支付”。尽管这在分析的论文中可能复杂且困难，但如果目的是向各国政策制定者或临床医生提供 ICHD 与 PD 相对价值的参考，这一点至关重要。例如，尽管 PD 比 ICHD“成本更低”，但在实际支付低于该方式实际成本的国家，PD 可能并不可行。

2. 不清楚总成本与方式本身成本的比较是如何计算的。提供按类别划分的成本分布信息以及这些成本在不同方式和国家的差异将更有用。最终，重要的是护理的总成本——可以想象一个国家对住院护理支付很少的国家。任何住院率的差异可能不会在所提供的数据中反映出来，但在确定哪种方式最具成本效益时可能很重要。

3. 除了上述评论外，作者轻率地表示 ICHD 和 PD 的临床结果相同。然而，这在所有国家可能并不相同。例如，如果腹膜炎发生率高且因感染或导管故障频繁住院，PD 的总成本可能显著高于 ICHD。

4. 引言中关于报销制度变化的段落过于简单化，且迅速过时。作者需要通过明确讨论检查护理总成本和竞争方式的整体价值（质量/成本）来将这项工作置于背景中。

5. 如果货币标准化，表格将更容易解读。我理解这其中的复杂性，但仅展示 ICHD 和 PD 在一个国家内的比较，而非国家间的比较，似乎是一个错失的机会。

reasons: The paragraph in the Introduction about the changing reimbursement systems is too simplistic and rapidly becoming outdated.
The authors need to more clearly distinguish between “cost” and “payment”.
It is not clear how the comparison of total costs is accounted for vs. the costs of the modality per se.
The paragraph in the Introduction about the changing reimbursement systems is too simplistic and rapidly becoming outdated.
The authors need to contextualize this work by clearly discussing the need to examine total costs of care and the overall value of competing modalities (quality/cost).
It would be much more useful to provide information on the distribution of costs by category and how these differ by modality and country.
The tables would be easier to interpret if the currency were normalized.

paper_title: Resilience and entrepreneurship: a systematic review
paper_abstract:
Background: The concept of resilience runs through an array of disciplines, consisting of engineering, public health, ecology, psychology, sociology, disaster management, and business administration. Researchers have tries to explain the relationship amongst connected ideas such as resiliency, adaptability, transformability, and vulnerability but their varied definitions and differences between them remain fuzzy. There are two reasons why resilience theory is important in entrepreneurship. Firstly, researchers generally employ the term resilience to mean consciousness, determination, perseverance, or self-value to justify why some entrepreneurs and their firms achieve better results than their non-resilient counterparts. Secondly, there are cognitive and behavioral entrepreneurial traits that strengthen a firm’s capability to adapt to varying conditions. 
The aim of this study is to review the literature that intercepts resilience and entrepreneurship. The study will attempt to identify scholarly conversations to construct notions of resilience and entrepreneurship. Therefore, limitations in the current literature will be examined and directions for future studies would be highlighted. 
 Methods: This paper adopted a systematic interdisciplinary review of relevant studies that is patterned using the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses ( PRISMA ). 
 Results: The scholarly works selected from the literature portrayed six emerging colloquies or research tributaries that intercept entrepreneurship and resilience: 
 
 
	 Resilience as a function of entrepreneurial individuals or firms, 
	 Resilience generating entrepreneurial intentions, 
	 Entrepreneurial behavior boosting organizational resilience and, 
	 Resilience in the framework of entrepreneurial failure, 
	 Entrepreneurship and culture, 
	 Resilience as a process of recovery and transformation. 
 
 Conclusions: This study serves as a backdrop for the emergence of more nuanced debates on the relationship that exists between different streams of conversations on resilience. In addition, this  paper shows how entrepreneurs contribute towards promoting a constructively sustainable means for socio-economic development.
review_content:
The study is qualitative and it tries to analyze some of the literatures in the intersection between entrepreneurship and resilience.
The rationale of the study is good and the methodology is adequate. However, it seems that most of the literatures used in the study are a little bit fuzzy as many of them came from 'under 2000'. Besides, the literature used is very small in number (only 32 studies). It would be better if the authors expand their work into more literatures and start with up to date literatures.
paper_title_zh: 韧性与企业精神：系统综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：韧性概念贯穿于多个学科，包括工程学、公共卫生、生态学、心理学、社会学、灾害管理和工商管理。研究者们试图解释韧性、适应性、可转化性和脆弱性等相互关联概念之间的关系，但它们之间的定义差异和区别仍然模糊不清。韧性理论在创业领域的重要性有两个原因。首先，研究者通常使用韧性一词来指代意识、决心、毅力或自我价值，以解释为什么一些创业者及其企业比缺乏韧性的同行取得更好的成果。其次，存在认知和行为上的创业特质，这些特质增强了一个企业适应不同条件的能力。

本研究旨在回顾截取韧性和创业的文献。研究将尝试识别学术对话，以构建韧性和创业的概念。因此，将审视当前文献中的局限性，并突出未来研究的方向。

方法：本文采用系统性的跨学科综述方法，对相关研究进行了梳理，遵循系统综述和荟萃分析的首选报告项目（PRISMA）。

结果：从文献中选出的学术作品描绘了六个新兴的对话或研究支流，这些支流截取了创业和韧性：

- 韧性作为创业个体或企业的功能，
- 韧性产生创业意图，
- 创业行为提升组织韧性，
- 创业失败框架中的韧性，
- 创业与文化，
- 韧性作为恢复和转化的过程。

结论：本研究为更细致地探讨不同对话流中韧性关系提供了背景。此外，本文展示了创业者如何为促进社会经济发展的建设性可持续手段做出贡献。
review_content_zh:
该研究是定性的，旨在分析创业与韧性交叉领域的一些文献。
研究的理论基础良好，方法论也适当。然而，研究中使用的大部分文献似乎有些模糊，因为许多文献来自“2000年以前”。此外，所使用的文献数量非常少（仅32项研究）。如果作者能将研究扩展到更多文献，并从最新的文献开始，将会更好。

reasons: However, it seems that most of the literatures used in the study are a little bit fuzzy as many of them came from 'under 2000'.
Besides, the literature used is very small in number (only 32 studies).
It would be better if the authors expand their work into more literatures and start with up to date literatures.
The rationale of the study is good and the methodology is adequate.

paper_title: Polygenic Risk Score in African populations: progress and challenges
paper_abstract: Polygenic Risk Score (PRS) analysis is a method that predicts the genetic risk of an individual towards targeted traits. Even when there are no significant markers, it gives evidence of a genetic effect beyond the results of Genome-Wide Association Studies (GWAS). Moreover, it selects  single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) that  contribute to the disease with low effect size  making it more precise at individual level risk prediction. PRS  analysis addresses the shortfall of GWAS by taking into account the SNPs/alleles with  low effect size but play an indispensable role to the observed phenotypic/trait variance.  PRS analysis has  applications that investigate the genetic basis of several traits, which includes rare diseases. However, the accuracy of PRS analysis depends on the genomic data of the underlying population. For instance, several studies  show   that obtaining higher prediction power of PRS analysis is challenging for non-Europeans. In this manuscript, we review the conventional PRS methods and their application to sub-Saharan African communities. We conclude that  lack of sufficient GWAS data and tools is  the limiting factor of applying PRS analysis to sub-Saharan populations.   We recommend developing Africa-specific PRS methods and tools for estimating and analyzing  African population data   for clinical  evaluation of PRSs of interest and predicting  rare diseases.
review_content:
General:

Adam et al. provide an extensive review of the important topic of PRS methods, and their applications in African ancestry populations. The paper summarises the various approaches to calculating PRS and provides a fair assessment of the advantages and disadvantages of each method. It also describes the challenges associated with calculating PRS in African populations and the approaches currently being undertaken to address these. The paper is comprehensive and a useful addition to the literature, pulling together a large amount of information across methods for calculating polygenic scores, and their applications in African populations.

Major comments:

To make the application of polygenic scores more accessible the authors could summarise the findings from studies conducted in Sub-Saharan African populations. For example, a table that orders studies by outcome/disease type and summarises key study parameters: methods (cohort/populations, LD reference panel, method) and results (variance explained) would be useful to readers.

When referring to predictive power being limited in African populations, additional detail as to what the AUC or equivalents are would be useful to contextualize the scores and provide comparisons to scores in non-African populations e.g. scores in EUR and AFR for a similar trait.

We suggest that the authors could also address the variability in transferability of scores not only between super-populations (eg. AFR and EUR) but also between SSA populations and the potential contributory role of environmental factors. Potential paper to do this includes Kamiza, A.B. et al. Transferability of genetic risk scores in African populations.1

One of the most recent useful advances in PRS development for ancestrally diverse populations is the PRS-CSx method.2 Although this new method was published after the date cut-off for the manuscript, a comment could be added in the Discussion.

Minor comments:

Introduction:
  * Table 1 is a comprehensive summary of PRS tools. How are these ordered? Given the authors have previously classified the methods into four groups (p3), it might be useful to use this information in structuring the table. In addition, what parameters/factors were used to determine whether an approach was user-friendly?
  * P3 “PRS analysis is used to predict an individual heritability by incorporating all selected SNPs.” What do the authors mean here by the phrase ‘individual heritability’? PRS methods that incorporate LD. In practice, when the markers are LD pruned…
PRS analysis on African populations:
  * This number represents about 4.553483% of total hits that - this number represents about 4.55% or 4.6% of total hits that
  * They observed that the predictive power of genetic risk scores was higher among African Americans (n=9139) and European Americans (n=9594) relative to the sub-Saharan African populations (n=5200).
    - Consistency in number formatting: They observed that the predictive power of genetic risk scores was higher among African Americans (n=9139) and European Americans (n=9594) relative to the sub-Saharan African populations (n=5200).
paper_title_zh: 非洲人群多基因风险评分：进展与挑战
paper_abstract_zh: 多基因风险评分（PRS）分析是一种预测个体对目标性状遗传风险的方法。即使在没有显著标记的情况下，它也能提供超出全基因组关联研究（GWAS）结果的遗传效应证据。此外，它选择对疾病有低效应大小的单核苷酸多态性（SNPs），使其在个体水平风险预测上更为精确。PRS分析通过考虑具有低效应大小但在观察到的表型/性状变异中发挥不可或缺作用的SNPs/等位基因，弥补了GWAS的不足。PRS分析应用于研究多种性状的遗传基础，包括罕见疾病。然而，PRS分析的准确性取决于底层人群的基因组数据。例如，多项研究表明，对于非欧洲人群，获得PRS分析的高预测能力具有挑战性。在本手稿中，我们回顾了传统的PRS方法及其在撒哈拉以南非洲社区的应用。我们得出结论，缺乏足够的GWAS数据和工具是限制PRS分析应用于撒哈拉以南人群的主要因素。我们建议开发针对非洲的PRS方法和工具，用于估计和分析非洲人群数据，以进行感兴趣PRS的临床评估和预测罕见疾病。
review_content_zh:
综述：

Adam等人对PRS方法这一重要主题及其在非洲血统人群中的应用进行了广泛的综述。该论文总结了计算PRS的各种方法，并对每种方法的优缺点进行了公正的评估。它还描述了在非洲人群中计算PRS所面临的挑战以及目前为解决这些挑战所采取的方法。该论文内容全面，是对文献的有益补充，汇集了大量关于计算多基因评分的方法及其在非洲人群中的应用信息。

主要评论：

为了使多基因评分的应用更加易于理解，作者可以总结在撒哈拉以南非洲人群中进行的各项研究的结果。例如，一个按结局/疾病类型排序并总结关键研究参数（方法：队列/人群、连锁不平衡参考面板、方法；结果：解释的方差）的表格将对读者有所帮助。

在提到非洲人群中预测能力有限时，提供AUC或等效指标的额外细节将有助于将评分置于具体情境中，并与非非洲人群中的评分进行比较，例如EUR和AFR中相似特征的评分。

我们建议作者还可以探讨评分的可转移性不仅在超人群（例如AFR和EUR）之间存在差异，而且在撒哈拉以南非洲人群之间也存在差异，以及环境因素的潜在贡献作用。可能涉及这一点的论文包括Kamiza, A.B.等人的《非洲人群中遗传风险评分的可转移性》。1

在为祖先多样化的群体开发PRS方面的最新有用进展是PRS-CSx方法。2尽管这一新方法在稿件截止日期后才发表，但在讨论部分可以添加一条评论。

次要评论：

引言：
  * 表1是对PRS工具的全面总结。这些工具是如何排序的？鉴于作者之前将方法分为四组（第3页），利用这些信息来构建表格可能是有用的。此外，使用了哪些参数/因素来确定一种方法是否用户友好？
  * 第3页“PRS分析通过整合所有选定的SNPs来预测个体遗传力。”作者在这里所说的“个体遗传力”是什么意思？结合连锁不平衡的PRS方法。在实践中，当标记物经过连锁不平衡修剪时……
非洲人群的PRS分析：
  * 这个数字约占总命中数的4.553483%——这个数字约占总命中数的4.55%或4.6%
  * 他们观察到，与非裔美国人（n=9139）和欧裔美国人（n=9594）相比，撒哈拉以南非洲人群（n=5200）的遗传风险评分的预测能力更高。
    - 数字格式的一致性：他们观察到，与非裔美国人（n=9139）和欧裔美国人（n=9594）相比，撒哈拉以南非洲人群（n=5200）的遗传风险评分的预测能力更高。

One of the most recent useful advances in PRS development for ancestrally diverse populations is the PRS-CSx method

When referring to predictive power being limited in African populations, additional detail as to what the AUC or equivalents are would be useful to contextualize the scores and provide comparisons to scores in non-African populations e.g. scores in EUR and AFR for a similar trait.
P3 “PRS analysis is used to predict an individual heritability by incorporating all selected SNPs.” What do the authors mean here by the phrase ‘individual heritability’?

For example, a table that orders studies by outcome/disease type and summarises key study parameters: methods (cohort/populations, LD reference panel, method) and results (variance explained) would be useful to readers.

paper_title: Adaptations of data mining methodologies: A systematic literature review
paper_abstract: The use of end-to-end data mining methodologies such as CRISP-DM, KDD process, and SEMMA, has grown substantially over the past decade. However, little is known as to how these methodologies are used in practice. In particular, the question of whether data mining methodologies are used 'as-is' or adapted for specific purposes, has not been thoroughly investigated. This paper addresses this gap via a systematic literature review focused on the context in which data mining methodologies are used and the adaptations they undergo. The literature review covers 207 peer-reviewed and 'grey' publications. We find that data mining methodologies are primarily applied 'as-is'. At the same time, we also identify various adaptations of data mining methodologies and we note that their number is growing rapidly. The dominant adaptations pattern is related to methodology adjustments at a granular level (modifications) followed by extensions of existing methodologies with additional elements. Further, we identify two recurrent purposes for adaptation: (1) adaptations to handle Big Data technologies, tools and environments (technological adaptations); and (2) adaptations for context-awareness and for integrating data mining solutions into business processes and IT systems (organizational adaptations).
review_content: Reviewer 2 Basic reporting This submission is a revised version, in which the authors seem to have dealt with most of the concerns of the reviewers. I am seeing this paper for the first time. This paper has provided a review of different data mining methodologies. Overall, the paper is well written and has covered well the current state-of-the-art on data mining methodologies. Although there are already many review papers on the topic, I believe that the way that the authors are discussing data mining methodologies is novel and very interesting. Experimental design The design of the study is correct from my point of view. Validity of the findings The main conclusions and findings of this work are certainly valid, and well supported by the literature. Comments for the author 1) “C1” - I believe that it is worth including a note on machine learning techniques and their differences with data mining. “R1” – We fully agree, we have included explanation on machine learning technique in the context of data mining, as well as shortly related their usage, benefits in comparison to traditional statistical methods. 2) “C2” - Page 3 – line 122. I disagree with the term big data. Data analytics does not need to analyse big datasets, it could be small datasets as well. Please consider rewording this sentence. “R2” – We fully agree to the comment, we now relate more generic and broad term of “data” to data analytics term. We use “big data” term as subcategory of data on which data analytics respectively performed. 3) “C3” - Page 16 – line 510. I am not sure I agree with the KDD processes being changed because of Big Data. The workflow remains the same, but there are differences (other challenges) to be addressed in terms of preprocessing, gathering information, storing information, and mining the data. The reader would benefit from some related references in this regard. “R3” – Yes, we support the viewpoint that Big Data per se is not the only driver behind the evolution of data mining methodologies, including evolutions beyond the KDD process. We have expanded and rephrased the confusing sentence to clearly emphasize the role of emerging technologies, tools and environments in the way how the data mining process is conducted now, and we also emphasize that some of them are Big Data-related, and some are not. We also agree with the Reviewer that the key phases of the process largely stay the same, but the tasks, subproceses, process outcomes have changed dramatically. We followed the recommendation and highlighted the Hadoop platform (as new processing environment) and real-time front-end customer applications (as a new deployment environment), as examples of evolutions that have an impact on the data processing, modeling and deployment phases of the data mining life-cycle. 4) “C4”- Be careful with the use of double quotes, they seem to be incorrect. “R4” – We replaced all double quotes with single quote mark, and overall we have made 220+ replacements. Due to their high number and for the sake of readability, we did not highlight all the replaced symbols with Track Changes. 5) “C5” - Modelling vs modelling (please stick to American English). “R5” – We have made the respective replacements throughout the publication including in the CRISP-DM diagram.
paper_title_zh: 数据挖掘方法论的适应性研究：系统文献综述
paper_abstract_zh: 过去十年间，端到端数据挖掘方法（如CRISP-DM、KDD流程和SEMMA）的使用显著增长。然而，关于这些方法在实际中的使用情况却知之甚少。特别是，数据挖掘方法是否被“原样”使用或为特定目的进行适应性调整的问题，尚未得到彻底研究。本文通过系统文献综述填补了这一空白，重点关注数据挖掘方法的使用背景及其所经历的调整。文献综述涵盖了207篇同行评审和“灰色”出版物。我们发现，数据挖掘方法主要被“原样”应用。同时，我们也识别了数据挖掘方法的多种适应性调整，并注意到其数量正在迅速增长。主要的调整模式与在细粒度层面（修改）的方法调整相关，其次是通过对现有方法添加额外元素进行扩展。此外，我们确定了两种反复出现的调整目的：（1）为应对大数据技术、工具和环境的调整（技术性调整）；（2）为情境感知以及将数据挖掘解决方案整合到业务流程和IT系统中的调整（组织性调整）。
review_content_zh: 审稿人2 基本报告 这篇投稿是修订版，作者似乎已经处理了审稿人提出的大部分问题。我是第一次看到这篇论文。该论文对不同数据挖掘方法进行了综述。总体而言，论文写得很好，全面覆盖了当前数据挖掘方法的前沿状态。尽管已有许多关于该主题的综述论文，但我认为作者讨论数据挖掘方法的方式是新颖且非常有趣的。 实验设计 从我的角度看，研究设计是正确的。 研究发现的可靠性 该工作的主要结论和发现无疑是可靠的，并且得到了文献的充分支持。 对作者的建议 1) “C1” - 我认为值得加入关于机器学习技术及其与数据挖掘差异的说明。“R1” – 我们完全同意，我们已在数据挖掘的背景下加入了关于机器学习技术的解释，并简要关联了其使用、与传统统计方法相比的优势。 2) “C2” - 第3页 - 第122行。我不同意“大数据”这一术语。数据分析不必分析大数据集，也可以是小数据集。请考虑重写这句话。“R2” – 我们完全同意该评论，现在我们将更通用和广泛的“数据”术语与数据分析术语相关联。我们将“大数据”术语作为数据分析所针对的数据的子类别。 3) “C3” - 第16页 - 第510行。我不确定是否同意KDD流程因大数据而改变的观点。工作流程保持不变，但在预处理、收集信息、存储信息和挖掘数据方面存在差异（其他挑战）。读者将受益于相关参考文献。“R3” – 是的，我们支持大数据本身并非数据挖掘方法演变的唯一驱动力的观点，包括KDD流程之外的演变。我们扩展并重写了令人困惑的句子，以明确强调新兴技术、工具和环境在当前数据挖掘过程实施方式中的角色，并强调其中一些与大数据相关，一些则不相关。我们也同意审稿人的观点，即流程的关键阶段大体保持不变，但任务、子流程、流程结果发生了巨大变化。我们遵循建议，并以Hadoop平台（作为新的处理环境）和实时前端客户应用（作为新的部署环境）为例，突出了对数据处理、建模和部署阶段有影响的演变。 4) “C4” - 注意双引号的使用，它们似乎不正确。“R4” – 我们将所有双引号替换为单引号，总共进行了220多次替换。由于数量众多且为了可读性，我们没有用“跟踪更改”功能突出显示所有替换的符号。 5) “C5” - Modelling与modelling（请统一使用美式英语）。“R5” – 我们在整个出版物中进行了相应的替换，包括在CRISP-DM图表中。

reasons: I believe that it is worth including a note on machine learning techniques and their differences with data mining

paper_title: Studying ancient human oral microbiomes could yield insights into the evolutionary history of noncommunicable diseases
paper_abstract: Noncommunicable diseases (NCDs) have played a critical role in shaping human evolution and societies. Despite the exceptional impact of NCDs economically and socially, little is known about the prevalence or impact of these diseases in the past as most do not leave distinguishing features on the human skeleton and are not directly associated with unique pathogens. The inability to identify NCDs in antiquity precludes researchers from investigating how changes in diet, lifestyle, and environments modulate NCD risks in specific populations and from linking evolutionary processes to modern health patterns and disparities. In this review, we highlight how recent advances in ancient DNA (aDNA) sequencing and analytical methodologies may now make it possible to reconstruct NCD-related oral microbiome traits in past populations, thereby providing the first proxies for ancient NCD risk. First, we review the direct and indirect associations between modern oral microbiomes and NCDs, specifically cardiovascular disease, diabetes mellitus, rheumatoid arthritis, and Alzheimer's disease. We then discuss how oral microbiome features associated with NCDs in modern populations may be used to identify previously unstudied sources of morbidity and mortality differences in ancient groups. Finally, we conclude with an outline of the challenges and limitations of employing this approach, as well as how they might be circumvented. While significant experimental work is needed to verify that ancient oral microbiome markers are indeed associated with quantifiable health and survivorship outcomes, this new approach is a promising path forward for evolutionary health research.
review_content:
This paper reviews and synthesizes the literature linking the oral microbiome to various non-communicable diseases, and additionally provides some intriguing paths forward on how to study these connections in skeletal remains to illuminate another dimension of NCDs in past human populations. I really enjoyed this interesting, well-written, and well-researched paper, and I think the authors have significant contributions to make to the body of literature on ancient human health.

I have listed some of my more detailed thoughts below on the paper, some small and some more significant. Some of these comments are comments on mere spelling/style issues, but I have also included a couple larger items that I hope the authors consider, if not in this revision, then as the research progresses.
  * First paragraph of introduction: Consider listing at least a couple of the seven of the top ten causes of death in 2019. Also, I do not suspect that the top ten causes of death would have changed substantially from 2019 to 2023 (other than the inclusion of COVID, of course), but do you have an updated source? I know that WHO has just a little bit of a lag, but there should be updated numbers from 2019 by now.
  * Second paragraph of introduction: One of the reasons listed for why the trend of studying NCDs through aDNA is that “infectious diseases can often be identified through distinctive mass-death burials or specific skeletal pathologies”. Certainly, for major epidemic/pandemic events, the mass death burials will be essential, but I do not agree that infectious diseases appearing in skeletal remains would be a major contributor to this. Overwhelmingly, acute infectious disease progression is too short to leave any real traces on skeletons. Infectious diseases like tuberculosis and leprosy are (sometimes) identifiable with some difficulty in skeletal material, but only after a very long period of infection and disease progression. Skeletal pathogolies like markers of frailty could suggest potential susceptibility to acute infectious diseases, but infectious diseases overwhelmingly do not manifest in the skeleton. Because of the previous mention of Donoghue (2017), I suspect tuberculosis and leprosy are top of mind here, but this should be more carefully stated in the text.
  * End of first paragraph of background: consider capitalizing “native” and “indigenous.”
  * Last full paragraph on page 4: The osteological paradox is mentioned very fleetingly, and although it is a popular concept and likely well known to your audience who studies skeletal material, it might be a good idea to define it briefly. Additionally, the citation of DeWitte & Stojanowski (2015) is good, but if you do dedicate space to the osteological paradox, it would be good practice to reference the original paper (Wood et al., 1992) as well.
  * First paragraph on page 5 under “Cardiovascular disease”: in the list of conditions that make up CVD, “stroke” is listed twice.
  * First paragraph, 3rd line on page 7: “Actinobacteira” should be “Actinobacteria”
  * First paragraph in “Applying the present to the past” page 9: I see here that you do go ahead and cite the Wood et al. (1992) paper in reference to the osteological paradox! Just a small semantics thing in this sentence: I am not sure that the osteological paradox as a concept has “goals” per se, it would be more like the goals of understanding the nuances of the osteological paradox and the reality of the lived experiences of past populations.
  * Second paragraph in “Applying the present to the past” on page 9: It occurred to me while reading this paragraph (which I really like, because it provides some clear steps forward), that the issue of the prevalence of NCDs in historical and/or prehistoric populations will be really dependent on how industrialized/urbanized/modernized a particular population is. I would not recommend going into a detailed discussion of epidemiological or health transitions in this paper, but briefly: there were major shifts in the proportionate mortality of NCDs and infectious diseases that align pretty well with major transitions in human behavior and culture in lots of places throughout the world, roughly aligning with the agricultural revolution, industrial revolution, and globalization. Before the industrial revolution in lots of places, NCD mortality was relatively small, although we don’t know that much about the prevalence. There is some big message in here for you to think about in your research and potentially acknowledge here, in which the ability to actually study NCDs via the oral microbiome to uncover the nature of NCDs in historical/pre-historic populations will be a major contribution to our understanding of health in those populations, since we have these preconceived notions about their relative prevalence using mortality as a proxy—which is probably not going to be as good of a proxy as actual biological data.
  * Second paragraph on page 10: You discuss some limitations of using aDNA, specifically in that it is often fragmented and prone to contamination. Pathogens like Mycobacterium tuberculosis, Mycobacterium bovis, Mycobacterium leprae, etc. have been studied using molecular clock calibration with aDNA. Given the fact that you are discussing the bacteria that make up the microbiome throughout this article, would that method be useful for what you are describing here? Could it improve upon the fragmentation and contamination issues that plague other aDNA methods?
paper_title_zh: 研究古代人类口腔微生物组可能揭示非传染性疾病的进化历史
paper_abstract_zh: 非传染性疾病（NCDs）在塑造人类进化和社会方面发挥了关键作用。尽管NCDs在经济和社会方面具有显著影响，但由于大多数NCDs在人类骨骼上不留下明显特征，且不直接与独特病原体相关联，因此关于这些疾病在过去的发生率或影响知之甚少。无法识别古代NCDs使研究人员无法探究饮食、生活方式和环境变化如何调节特定人群的NCD风险，也无法将进化过程与现代健康模式和差异联系起来。在这篇综述中，我们重点介绍了近年来古代DNA（aDNA）测序和分析方法学的进步，这些进步可能使重建过去人群NCD相关口腔微生物组特征成为可能，从而为古代NCD风险提供了首个代理指标。首先，我们回顾了现代口腔微生物组与NCDs之间的直接和间接关联，特别是心血管疾病、糖尿病、类风湿性关节炎和阿尔茨海默病。接着，我们讨论了如何利用现代人群中与NCDs相关的口腔微生物组特征来识别古代群体中先前未研究的疾病和死亡差异来源。最后，我们概述了采用这种方法所面临的挑战和局限性，以及如何克服这些挑战。尽管需要大量实验工作来验证古代口腔微生物组标记是否确实与可量化的健康和生存结果相关，但这一新方法为进化健康研究提供了有前景的前进路径。
review_content_zh:
本文回顾并综合了将口腔微生物组与各种非传染性疾病联系起来的文献，并额外提供了一些引人入胜的前进路径，探讨如何通过骨骼遗骸研究这些联系，以揭示过去人类群体中非传染性疾病的另一维度。我非常享受这篇有趣、文笔优美且研究扎实的论文，并且我认为作者们对古代人类健康文献体系做出了重要贡献。

以下是我对论文的一些更详细的思考，有些是细节问题，有些则更为重要。其中一些评论仅涉及拼写/风格问题，但我还包含了一两个较大的事项，希望作者们考虑，即使不在这次修订中，也在研究进展中加以考虑。
* 引言第一段：考虑列出2019年十大死因中的至少两三个。此外，我怀疑2019年至2023年间十大死因不会有太大变化（当然，除了新增的COVID之外），但你们是否有更新的数据来源？我知道世界卫生组织的数据稍有滞后，但现在应该有2019年之后的更新数据了。
* 引言第二段：列出的通过古DNA研究非传染性疾病趋势的原因之一是“传染病通常可以通过独特的集体墓葬或特定的骨骼病理学来识别”。当然，对于重大流行/大流行事件，集体墓葬是至关重要的，但我不同意传染病在骨骼遗骸中的出现会是主要贡献因素。绝大多数急性传染病的病程太短，无法在骨骼上留下真正痕迹。像结核病和麻风病这样的传染病（有时）在骨骼材料中可以困难地识别，但只有在非常长的感染和疾病进展期后才能识别。像脆弱性标志物这样的骨骼病理学可能暗示对急性传染病的潜在易感性，但传染病绝大多数不会在骨骼中显现。由于之前提到了Donoghue（2017），我怀疑这里主要考虑的是结核病和麻风病，但应在文本中更谨慎地表述这一点。
* 背景第一段末尾：考虑将“native”和“indigenous”大写。
* 第4页最后一段：骨骼悖论被非常简略地提及，尽管这是一个流行的概念，并且可能为研究骨骼材料的读者所熟知，但简要定义它可能是个好主意。此外，引用DeWitte & Stojanowski（2015）是好的，但如果你们确实要讨论骨骼悖论，引用原始论文（Wood et al., 1992）也是好的做法。
* 第5页“心血管疾病”下的第一段：在构成心血管疾病的条件列表中，“中风”被列了两次。
* 第7页第一段第3行：“Actinobacteira”应为“Actinobacteria”。
* 第9页“将现在应用于过去”的第一段：我看到你们确实引用了Wood et al.（1992）的论文来讨论骨骼悖论！只是这句话中的一个小语义问题：我不确定骨骼悖论作为一个概念是否有“目标”本身，更像是对理解骨骼悖论的细微差别和过去人群实际生活经历的目标。
* 第9页“将现在应用于过去”的第二段：阅读这段（我非常喜欢，因为它提供了一些清晰的步骤）时，我突然想到，历史上和/或史前人群中非传染性疾病的流行程度将非常依赖于特定人群的工业化/城市化/现代化程度。我不建议在这篇论文中详细讨论流行病学或健康转型，但简而言之：非传染性疾病和传染病的比例死亡率发生了重大变化，这与世界各地人类行为和文化的重大转变相当吻合，大致与农业革命、工业革命和全球化相对应。在许多地方的工业革命之前，非传染性疾病死亡率相对较小，尽管我们对流行程度了解不多。这里有一个重要的信息供你们在研究中思考，并可能在此处承认，即通过口腔微生物组实际研究非传染性疾病，以揭示历史上/史前人群非传染性疾病的本质，将对我们理解这些人群的健康状况做出重大贡献，因为我们使用死亡率作为代理的先入为主的观念——这可能不如实际生物数据那样好的代理。
* 第10页第二段：你们讨论了使用古DNA的一些局限性，特别是它通常片段化且易受污染。像结核分枝杆菌、牛分枝杆菌、麻风分枝杆菌等病原体已经通过分子钟校准与古DNA进行了研究。鉴于你们在整篇文章中讨论了构成微生物组的细菌，这种方法对你们所描述的内容有用吗？它能否改善困扰其他古DNA方法的片段化和污染问题？

Additionally, the citation of DeWitte & Stojanowski (2015) is good, but if you do dedicate space to the osteological paradox, it would be good practice to reference the original paper (Wood et al., 1992) as well.

paper_title: The prognostic and clinicopathological significance of desmoglein 2 in human cancers: a systematic review and meta-analysis
paper_abstract: The survival and clinicopathological significance of desmoglein 2 (DSG2) in various cancers is controversial. Thus, we performed this systematic review and meta-analysis to explore the preliminary prognostic value of DSG2.
review_content: Reviewer 2 Basic reporting Wang and colleagues have investigated the prognostic potential of DSG2 in different types of cancer by a systematic review and meta-analysis. Although this is an interesting topic, there are several major issues that should be taken into consideration before the paper is published. There are several grammatical and syntax errors, and typos (e.g., “no-small” (line 149), “meat-analysis” (line 294)). The entire manuscript should undergo thorough revision.
paper_title_zh: "桥粒芯蛋白2在人类癌症中的预后及临床病理意义：一项系统综述与荟萃分析"
paper_abstract_zh: 桥粒芯蛋白2（DSG2）在不同癌症中的生存及临床病理学意义存在争议。因此，我们进行了这项系统综述和荟萃分析，以探讨DSG2的初步预后价值。
review_content_zh: 审稿人2 基本报告 王及其同事通过系统综述和荟萃分析研究了DSG2在不同类型癌症中的预后潜力。尽管这是一个有趣的话题，但在论文发表之前，有几个主要问题需要考虑。存在多处语法和句法错误，以及打字错误（例如，“no-small”（第149行），“meat-analysis”（第294行））。整篇手稿应进行全面修订。

reasons: Reviewer 1 Basic reporting In the article the authors have reviewed the current literature to establish the prognostic value of DSG2.
The results are interesting and useful to understand the relationship between the level of DSG2 expression and prognosis of cancer patients.
Yet, English language should be improved.

For example, Line 50: ...as it can be functional...” could be changed to “can function as both...”; Line 80: diagnosed with cancer via pathology...” A more accurate technical term should be used to describe the method used for cancer diagnosis.
Moreover, assertive language should be avoided like “Based on currently available evidence, the association of DSG2 expression with prognosis was context dependent.”

Given also the relatively small number of eligible studies, this sentence could be revised “Based on the findings of this study, high DSG2 expression is associated with worse prognosis in patients with nonsmall-cell lung cancer.”

paper_title: A comprehensive systematic scoping review for physiotherapy interventions for people living with long COVID
paper_abstract:
Background: A diverse spectrum of long COVID symptoms (LCS) have the scope of physical rehabilitation. Due to limited resources, very little is known about the physiotherapy and rehabilitation interventions for LCS and their clinical application. This study aims to explore the role of physiotherapy and rehabilitation interventions in the management of musculoskeletal, neurological, cognitive, cardiorespiratory, mental health, and functional impairments of LCS. 
 Methods: The study was a systematic scoping review of the literature published between April 2020 and July 2022. 
 Results: 87 articles were extracted followed by a standard process of The Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic reviews and meta-analysis (PRISMA) extension for Scoping reviews (PRISMA-ScR). The included studies had a 3223 LCS population. All types of primary and secondary articles were retrieved except for qualitative studies. The evidence was evaluated by an appraisal scoring tool followed by the guidelines of the “Enhancing the Quality and Transparency of Health Research ( EQUATOR ) network”. The included papers had a mean appraisal score of 0.7807 on a 0 to 1 scale (SD 0.08), the minimum score was for study protocols (0.5870), and the maximum score was for Cohort studies (.8977). Sixty seven (67) evidence-based interventions were documented from 17 clinical categories. The most weighted interventions were treating underlying symptoms of long COVID (Adjusted score 1/1), management of fatigue (Adjusted score 0.963/1), aerobic exercise and balance training (Adjusted score 0.951/1), multidisciplinary rehabilitation (Adjusted score 0.926/1), and low resistance training and aerobic exercise (Adjusted score 0.889/1). 
 Conclusion: We recommend Long COVID rehabilitation in a multidisciplinary approach by treating the individual symptoms, especially fatigue. Physiotherapy interventions play a significant role as most of the recommended interventions were exercise, modalities, patient education, respiratory rehabilitation, and telerehabilitation 
Scoping reviews do not require protocol registration from PROSPERO .
review_content:
A scoping review on physiotherapy interventions for long COVID is timely and the authors have attempted a comprehensive search of the contemporary evidence-base, which should be commended. There are however, a number of limitation in conduct/reporting when comparing to methodological and reporting guidance for scoping reviews. I would suggest that the manuscript is revised in keeping with such guidance to enhance its rigor (see citations below).
TITLE
Use of the terms comprehensive, systematic and scoping are unnecessary - simply describing the review as a Scoping review would be appropriate
INTRODUCTION
The sentence ‘the respondents’ needs some context – which respondents? Is a particular study being referred to?
Reconsider the repeated use of the term ‘scope’. It is not clear what is means by ‘50% of the people living in LMIC are out of reach of the scope’ and the section that follows.
What does ‘shreds of evidence’ mean?
The justification for conducting a scoping review is not clearly presented – if there is a research gap in studies focussing on physiotherapy, how can a scoping review be conducted – when a scoping review requires literature to be available to be included in the review?
Moreover, the aims of the scoping review are not clear – is it to map what interventions have been reported? The authors might find this guidance useful: Scoping reviews: reinforcing and advancing the methodology and application | Systematic Reviews | Full Text (biomedcentral.com)
METHODS
Was there an a priori protocol published or registered that guided this scoping review – as is accepted good practice?
Suggest that the PICO is re-considered in light of the review aims – if the aim is to map physiotherapy interventions that have been reported for managing Long COVID symptoms then it is not clear why an ‘outcome’ is required – this would of course be relevant in a systematic review of effectiveness, but a scoping review cannot draw conclusions on the effectiveness of interventions.
It is interesting that qualitative studies were excluded – these might be qualitative studies where patients or staff describe their experiences of physiotherapy interventions.
Search strategy is not presented in a wat that it could be replicated – not clear what grid 1,2,3 mean and which terms are subject headings, keywords etc.
Did 2 reviewers independently conduct all stages of the review (title/abstract screening, full-text screening, data extraction, critical appraisal)? This is not clear from the manuscript.
RESULTS
Please use standard terminology to refer to literature included in the review – the PRISMA flow diagram uses records (results of searching), reports (i.e., articles) and studies – with studies referring to research. You introduce the terms ‘papers’ in the results section, which is not consistent with the flow diagram. You also have other types of reports (i.e., editorials, communication, letters to the editor) – this needs to be considered throughout the reporting.
Assessing quality is not common on a scoping review. I remain unclear as to what the quality assessments add to the review – if its purpose is to map what interventions have been reported. I am also not clear on the weighting of interventions section – how it has been calculated and what the difference between ‘review’ and ‘systematic review’ are in the table.
Rather than the quality & weighting, what would be far more useful is a table of included studies detailing the interventions that have been reported – this seems to be entirely missing from the review.
DISCUSSION
The discussion seems to discuss the type of information that I would expect – but without there being a table of included studies it is difficult as a reader to pass comment on its appropriateness.
I would suggest that if the comments above are addressed, then the discussion will likely need to be revised accordingly. The same will apply to the abstract.
paper_title_zh: 长期新冠患者物理治疗干预的全面系统范围综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：长期新冠症状（LCS）的多样化谱系具有物理康复的范畴。由于资源有限，关于LCS的物理治疗和康复干预及其临床应用知之甚少。本研究旨在探讨物理治疗和康复干预在管理LCS的肌肉骨骼、神经、认知、心肺、心理健康和功能障碍中的作用。

方法：本研究是对2020年4月至2022年7月间发表的文献进行的系统性范围综述。

结果：根据系统综述和荟萃分析的首选报告项目（PRISMA）范围综述扩展（PRISMA-ScR）的标准流程，提取了87篇文章。纳入研究涵盖了3223名LCS人群。检索了所有类型的一手和二手文章，不包括定性研究。证据通过评估评分工具进行评估，并遵循“提高健康研究质量和透明度（EQUATOR）网络”的指南。纳入论文的平均评估得分为0.7807（0至1量表，SD 0.08），最低分为研究方案（0.5870），最高分为队列研究（0.8977）。从17个临床类别中记录了67项基于证据的干预措施。权重最高的干预措施包括治疗长期新冠的潜在症状（调整得分1/1）、疲劳管理（调整得分0.963/1）、有氧运动和平衡训练（调整得分0.951/1）、多学科康复（调整得分0.926/1）以及低阻力训练和有氧运动（调整得分0.889/1）。

结论：我们建议通过多学科方法进行长期新冠康复，治疗个体症状，尤其是疲劳。物理治疗干预发挥了重要作用，因为大多数推荐的干预措施包括运动、治疗方式、患者教育、呼吸康复和远程康复。

范围综述不需要在PROSPERO进行方案注册。
review_content_zh:
关于长期新冠物理治疗干预的范畴审查是及时的，作者试图对当代证据基础进行全面搜索，这一点值得称赞。然而，在与方法学和报告指南相比，在实施/报告方面存在一些局限性。我建议根据此类指南修订手稿，以增强其严谨性（见下文引用）。

标题
使用“全面的”、“系统的”和“范畴的”这些术语是不必要的——简单地将审查描述为“范畴审查”是恰当的。

引言
“受访者”这句话需要一些上下文——哪些受访者？是否指特定研究？
重新考虑“范畴”一词的重复使用。不清楚“50%生活在低收入和中等收入国家的人超出了范畴”是什么意思，以及随后部分的内容。
“shreds of evidence”是什么意思？
进行范畴审查的理由没有明确呈现——如果在专注于物理治疗的研究中存在研究空白，如何进行范畴审查——当范畴审查需要文献可用以纳入审查时？

此外，范畴审查的目标不明确——是为了绘制已报告的干预措施吗？作者可能会发现以下指南有用：范畴审查：加强和推进方法学和应用 | 系统审查 | 全文（biomedcentral.com）

方法
是否有预先发布的或注册的协议指导此次范畴审查——这是公认的良好实践？
建议根据审查目标重新考虑PICO——如果目标是绘制已报告的用于管理长期新冠症状的物理治疗干预措施，那么不清楚为什么需要“结果”——这在有效性系统审查中当然是相关的，但范畴审查不能对干预措施的有效性得出结论。

有趣的是，定性研究被排除在外——这些可能是患者或工作人员描述他们物理治疗干预经验的定性研究。
搜索策略的呈现方式无法复制——不清楚网格1、2、3是什么意思，哪些术语是主题词、关键词等。
是否有2名评审员独立进行审查的所有阶段（标题/摘要筛选、全文筛选、数据提取、批判性评估）？手稿中对此不清楚。

结果
请使用标准术语来指代审查中包含的文献——PRISMA流程图使用记录（搜索结果）、报告（即文章）和研究——研究指研究。你在结果部分引入了“论文”一词，这与流程图不一致。你还有其他类型的报告（即社论、通讯、致编辑的信）——这在整个报告中需要考虑。

在范畴审查中通常不进行质量评估。我不清楚质量评估对审查有何贡献——如果其目的是绘制已报告的干预措施。我也不清楚干预措施权重部分——如何计算以及表中“审查”和“系统审查”之间的区别。

与其关注质量和权重，更有用的是包含研究的表格，详细说明已报告的干预措施——这似乎在审查中完全缺失。

讨论
讨论似乎讨论了我所期望的信息类型——但没有包含研究的表格，作为读者很难对其适当性发表评论。

我建议如果上述评论得到解决，那么讨论可能需要相应修订。摘要也同样适用。

paper_title: A Survey on Causal Discovery Methods for I.I.D. and Time Series Data
paper_abstract: The ability to understand causality from data is one of the major milestones of human-level intelligence. Causal Discovery (CD) algorithms can identify the cause-effect relationships among the variables of a system from related observational data with certain assumptions. Over the years, several methods have been developed primarily based on the statistical properties of data to uncover the underlying causal mechanism. In this study, we present an extensive discussion on the methods designed to perform causal discovery from both independent and identically distributed (I.I.D.) data and time series data. For this purpose, we first introduce the common terminologies used in causal discovery literature and then provide a comprehensive discussion of the algorithms designed to identify causal relations in different settings. We further discuss some of the benchmark datasets available for evaluating the algorithmic performance, off-the-shelf tools or software packages to perform causal discovery readily, and the common metrics used to evaluate these methods. We also evaluate some widely used causal discovery algorithms on multiple benchmark datasets and compare their performances. Finally, we conclude by discussing the research challenges and the applications of causal discovery algorithms in multiple areas of interest.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
This paper provides a comprehensive review of causal discovery methods, including well-known methods and some new ones. This survey can help beginners quickly become familiar with the methods of causal discovery.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
Strengths: The survey is easy to follow and the writing is clear. It covers most of the well-known methods in causal discovery and some new ones. This survey can help beginners quickly become familiar with the methods of causal discovery. Weaknesses: This survey is more like a list of causal discovery approaches, but it falls short in terms of in-depth analysis and comparisons among these methods. Furthermore, it may be also important to provide some comments about future research directions.

**Requested Changes:**
This survey lacks in-depth analysis and comparisons among the different causal discovery approaches. Therefore, it is recommended that the authors incorporate more comprehensive analyses of the advantages and disadvantages associated with each method, along with guidance on selecting appropriate approaches based on different conditions. Additionally, the inclusion of more empirical results would greatly enhance the overall quality and usefulness of the survey.

**Claims And Evidence:**
Yes

**Audience:**
Yes

**Rebuttal Comments:**
Addressing the requested changes: We are really thankful for such valuable suggestions and comments. We highly appreciate these comments as we believe they are really essential to improve the overall quality of the survey. We have addressed the requested changes and comments below: #Requested Change: This survey lacks in-depth analysis and comparisons among the different causal discovery approaches. Therefore, it is recommended that the authors incorporate more comprehensive analyses of the advantages and disadvantages associated with each method. +Reply: We really appreciate pointing out this important analysis. We agree with the comment that an in-depth analysis about the advantages and disadvantages associated with the methods is needed. Hence, we updated the paper by adding the comparison tables, Table 6 in page no. 28 and Table 7 in page no. 37 for I.I.D. and time series causal discovery algorithms respectively where we specify the advantages and disadvantages of the approaches as well as compare them on the basis of some important criteria. We would also like to mention that while we discussed each of the approaches, we included their advantages and disadvantages too in those discussions. #Requested Change: Incorporation of the guidance on selecting appropriate approaches based on different conditions. +Reply: We are very thankful for this suggestion. We have included a discussion on how to select the appropriate approach based on different scenarios at the end of the first paragraph of Section 10 (Discussion). We believe this guidance will help readers to select the appropriate method. #Requested Change: Additionally, the inclusion of more empirical results would greatly enhance the overall quality and usefulness of the survey. +Reply: We agree that inclusion of more empirical results would greatly enhance the overall quality of the survey. Therefore, we have done some new experiments to compare the performance of different temporal causal discovery algorithms on some benchmark datasets, and reported the corresponding evaluation metrics (Table 9) and a discussion of the results too in Section 7.2. . #Requested Change: Furthermore, it may be also important to provide some comments about future research directions. +Reply: Thanks for the valuable suggestion. We extended our discussion on the important future research directions in the second paragraph of Section 10 (Discussion) in page no. 50. We understand the importance of such discussion, and hence highlighted them well in italic for the ease of readability.
paper_title_zh: 对独立同分布和时间序列数据的因果发现方法综述
paper_abstract_zh: 从数据中理解因果关系是人类水平智能的主要里程碑之一。因果发现（Causal Discovery，CD）算法可以在一定假设下，从相关的观测数据中识别系统变量之间的因果关系。多年来，已经发展出多种主要基于数据统计属性的方法来揭示潜在的因果机制。在本研究中，我们对设计用于从独立同分布（I.I.D.）数据和时间序列数据中进行因果发现的方法进行了广泛的讨论。为此，我们首先介绍了因果发现文献中常用的术语，然后对在不同设置中识别因果关系的算法进行了全面的讨论。我们进一步讨论了一些用于评估算法性能的基准数据集、现成的工具或软件包以便于进行因果发现，以及用于评估这些方法的常见指标。我们还对多个基准数据集上一些广泛使用的因果发现算法进行了评估，并比较了它们的性能。最后，我们通过讨论研究挑战和因果发现算法在多个感兴趣领域的应用来总结全文。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
本文对因果发现方法进行了全面综述，包括知名方法和一些新方法。该综述可以帮助初学者快速熟悉因果发现的方法。

**优点与不足：**
优点：综述易于理解，写作清晰。涵盖了因果发现中的大多数知名方法及一些新方法。该综述可以帮助初学者快速熟悉因果发现的方法。不足：该综述更像是一个因果发现方法的列表，但在对这些方法的深入分析和比较方面有所欠缺。此外，提供一些关于未来研究方向的意见可能也很重要。

**建议修改：**
该综述缺乏对不同因果发现方法的深入分析和比较。因此，建议作者加入对每种方法优缺点的更全面分析，并提供基于不同条件选择合适方法的指导。此外，包含更多实证结果将大大提升综述的整体质量和实用性。

**主张与证据：**
是

**受众：**
是

**反驳意见：**
针对建议修改：我们非常感谢这些宝贵的建议和意见。我们高度重视这些意见，因为我们相信它们对提升综述的整体质量至关重要。我们已对建议修改和意见进行了回应：#建议修改：该综述缺乏对不同因果发现方法的深入分析和比较。因此，建议作者加入对每种方法优缺点的更全面分析。+回复：我们非常感谢指出这一重要分析。我们同意需要深入分析每种方法的优缺点。因此，我们在第28页的表6和第37页的表7中分别更新了I.I.D.和时间序列因果发现算法的比较表格，其中我们指出了各方法的优缺点，并基于一些重要标准进行了比较。我们还想提到，在讨论每种方法时，我们也包括了它们的优缺点。#建议修改：基于不同条件选择合适方法的指导。+回复：我们非常感谢这一建议。我们在第10节（讨论）第一段末尾加入了对如何根据不同场景选择合适方法的讨论。我们相信这一指导将帮助读者选择合适的方法。#建议修改：此外，包含更多实证结果将大大提升综述的整体质量和实用性。+回复：我们同意包含更多实证结果将大大提升综述的整体质量。因此，我们进行了一些新实验，比较了不同时间因果发现算法在一些基准数据集上的性能，并报告了相应的评估指标（表9）及在第7.2节中对结果的讨论。#建议修改：此外，提供一些关于未来研究方向的意见可能也很重要。+回复：感谢宝贵的建议。我们在第10节（讨论）第50页的第二段中扩展了对重要未来研究方向的讨论。我们理解这种讨论的重要性，因此用斜体突出显示以便于阅读。
