paper_title: The ELIXIR Biodiversity Community: Understanding short- and long-term changes in biodiversity
paper_abstract: Biodiversity loss is now recognised as one of the major challenges for humankind to address over the next few decades. Unless major actions are taken, the sixth mass extinction will lead to catastrophic effects on the Earth’s biosphere and human health and well-being. ELIXIR can help address the technical challenges of biodiversity science, through leveraging its suite of services and expertise to enable data management and analysis activities that enhance our understanding of life on Earth and facilitate biodiversity preservation and restoration. This white paper, prepared by the ELIXIR Biodiversity Community, summarises the current status and responses, and presents a set of plans, both technical and community-oriented, that should both enhance how ELIXIR Services are applied in the biodiversity field and how ELIXIR builds connections across the many other infrastructures active in this area. We discuss the areas of highest priority, how they can be implemented in cooperation with the ELIXIR Platforms, and their connections to existing ELIXIR Communities and international consortia. The article provides a preliminary blueprint for a Biodiversity Community in ELIXIR and is an appeal to identify and involve new stakeholders.
review_content:
Peer Review: The ELIXIR Biodiversity Community: Understanding short- and long-term changes in biodiversity – RM Waterhouse et al
This article provides a concise overview of the ELIXIR Biodiversity Community which can serve as a hub for the molecular sciences and bioinformatics as it applies to biodiversity science. ELIXIR’s overarching mission has been stated to “support the management of public research data, integrate and coordinate life science resources, and foster the development of innovative services and technical solutions in Europe” (Harrow et al., 20211). Given unprecedented and escalating loss in biodiversity, there is increasing urgency for new scientific discovery, data processing, and data sharing of biodiversity information among scientists, conservation practitioners, and policy makers. This opinion piece summarizes biodiversity threats, societal challenges and global responses, and scientific opportunities in biodiversity research. It then discusses informatics challenges facing biodiversity infrastructures and resources, organizational opportunities for ELIXIR partners, and connections with ELIXIR platforms and communities. The piece concludes with a roadmap listing key goals and long-term objectives for the ELIXIR Biodiversity Community.

The article might best be viewed in the context of the large and growing field of scientists, practitioners, and policy analysts, in government, academic, and non-government (NGO) sectors responding to the emerging crisis of biodiversity loss. Starting in the mid-20th century with many academic researchers who initially documented biodiversity declines, biodiversity science - and biodiversity conservation - has been steadily mainstreamed worldwide (Locke et al.,20192). One of the founders of “conservation biology” the late Michael Soulé described this science as a “discipline with a deadline” working against accelerating extinctions to sustain the wellbeing of society and the environment (Soulé and Wilcox,19803). While encompassing the full spectrum from basic to applied, biodiversity conservation science has often emphasized practical ways to identify key information suitable for action on the ground. One good example coming from the North American NGO NatureServe network is the practical methods for systematic field inventories for natural communities and species to characterize their location, health, and status (Stein et al., 20004). In full disclosure, I have spent most of my working life in this network, first established by The Nature Conservancy in the 1970s.

With much biodiversity conservation initially focused on identifying local areas for nature preserves, the maturing disciplines of landscape ecology, meta-population dynamics, and now climate change research, forced consideration of increasing broader scales of conservation action (Lindenmayer and Franklin, 20135). With rapidly advancing technology and data, and emphasis on remote sensing and modeling with spatial data have become routine (Wiens et al., 20096). And increasingly (one could say belatedly), the value of social science been acknowledged as it has deepened our understanding of complex interactions of people and nature that underlay nearly all conservation strategies (Sandbrook et al., 20137).

Therefore, while I found this piece to be factual, accurate, and well supported by the current literature, it would benefit from a broader interpretation of biodiversity science and more directed treatment of ELIXIR’s potential contributions to the “broader ecosystem” of biodiversity conservation. For example, the rapid advances in genomic science and its application to biodiversity conservation has many parallels to several allied fields previously mentioned, such as in remote sensing and several variants of the social sciences. The ELIXIR Biodiversity Community could gain by considering this prior experience. Thus, avoiding prior mistakes and replicating prior successes. Among the many ways expanding genomic science could affect biodiversity conservation include ecosystem characterization and monitoring, support to biodiversity status assessment, and evaluating progress of conservation actions.

The article states that “A long-term vision sees a future where sequence-based biodiversity monitoring at scale becomes the default and provides the means for ecosystem biodiversity characterisation in space and time.” One area where we may see near-term progress here is in the links between genomic data and remote sensing; where our current forms of ecosystem characterization centered on measures of species composition, ecosystem structure, and environmental setting may be enhanced by remotely-sensed data (hyperspectral and others) indicating patterns within and among readily observed communities and species (Yamasaki et al., 20178). Relationships between measurable genetic diversity and detectable light spectra will always be complex and challenging, but with increasing frequency of remote data collection one can now envision substantial opportunities to identify leading indicators of ecosystem change through their combination.

Current standards to assess and document endangerment status of species and ecosystems – such as those of red listing under IUCN - require documented knowledge of changing health of populations and communities (IUCN 20129; Bland et al., 201710). These standards attempt to simplify complex ecological phenomena into standard categories to provide a reliable status assessment for use by policy makers and engaged stakeholders. Once clear health markers are identified with genomic data, this could contribute substantially to the rigor, efficiency, and impact of biodiversity status assessment.

This naturally follows on to the potential benefit of genomic data to contribute to evaluating success (or failure) of conservation actions. As noted in the article, that these data should contribute to understanding “population-level adaptation and migration processes, in the context of anthropogenic activities (e.g., climate change and urbanisation consequences), and understand[ing] key aspects necessary to restore ecosystem functions.” It is in planning and implementation of conservation actions where one can surely recognize biodiversity conservation as inherently a human-driven process, so once again, the information used must be clear and compelling to all involved, regardless of their interests and biases.

Prior experience in related fields suggest at least several considerations for the ELIXIR Biodiversity Community. As noted in the article, “ELIXIR can serve a critical function here, as a fundamental aspect of its mission is to make connections and coordinate across complex activities.” And “the biodiversity community needs to proactively seek common solutions (without unnecessary duplication of effort) that enable molecular technologies to advance biodiversity research. I would underscore the importance of limiting duplication of effort. Much of the history of biodiversity conservation in marked by unnecessary competition, stove-piping, and duplicated effort among those involved.

And while ELIXIR’s “current focus is on the informatics, databases, and tools more than on the biological questions, . . . as the Community grows, it will be important to widen the diversity of its membership to ensure that the technical developments will serve the needs of biodiversity researchers,” I would encourage this community to begin early to seek out and identify feedback loops from the full spectrum of user communities. As noted above, the users of genomic data for biodiversity conservation will be diverse and demanding, so deeper consideration of user needs (Dubois et al., 202011), and participatory biodiversity science (Zoellick et al., 201212) could have substantial payoffs into the future.

Biodiversity conservation is based on both ecological and social science that is both urgent and time sensitive. It is that applied side of the spectrum that requires urgent support from the ELIXIR Biodiversity Community.
paper_title_zh: ELIXIR生物多样性社区：理解生物多样性的短期和长期变化
paper_abstract_zh: 生物多样性丧失现已被公认为人类在未来几十年内必须应对的主要挑战之一。除非采取重大行动，否则第六次大灭绝将给地球生物圈以及人类健康和福祉带来灾难性影响。ELIXIR可以通过利用其一系列服务和专业知识，帮助解决生物多样性科学的技术挑战，从而实现数据管理和分析活动，增强我们对地球生命的理解，并促进生物多样性的保护和恢复。这份由ELIXIR生物多样性社区准备的白皮书，总结了当前状况和应对措施，并提出了一套计划，既包括技术方面的，也包括面向社区的，这些计划应能提升ELIXIR服务在生物多样性领域的应用，并促进ELIXIR与该领域内众多其他活跃基础设施之间的连接。我们讨论了最高优先级的领域，以及如何通过与ELIXIR平台合作实施这些领域，并探讨它们与现有ELIXIR社区和国际联盟的联系。本文为ELIXIR中的生物多样性社区提供了一个初步蓝图，并呼吁识别和涉及新的利益相关者。
review_content_zh:
同行评审：ELIXIR生物多样性社区：理解生物多样性的短期和长期变化——RM Waterhouse等

本文对ELIXIR生物多样性社区进行了简洁的概述，该社区可以作为分子科学和生物信息学在生物多样性科学应用中的枢纽。ELIXIR的总体使命已被阐述为“支持公共研究数据的管理，整合和协调生命科学资源，并在欧洲促进创新服务和技术的开发”（Harrow et al., 20211）。鉴于生物多样性的前所未有的且不断加剧的损失，科学家、保护实践者和政策制定者之间对新的科学发现、数据处理和生物多样性信息共享的需求日益迫切。这篇观点文章总结了生物多样性威胁、社会挑战和全球响应，以及生物多样性研究中的科学机遇。接着讨论了生物多样性基础设施和资源面临的信息学挑战，ELIXIR合作伙伴的组织机遇，以及与ELIXIR平台和社区的连接。文章最后以路线图的形式列出了ELIXIR生物多样性社区的关键目标和长期目标。

这篇文章最好在应对生物多样性损失这一新兴危机的广大且不断增长的科学家、实践者和政策分析师的背景下进行审视，这些人员分布在政府、学术界和非政府组织（NGO）部门。从20世纪中叶开始，许多学术研究人员最初记录了生物多样性的下降，生物多样性科学——以及生物多样性保护——在全球范围内逐渐主流化（Locke et al., 20192）。“保护生物学”的创始人之一、已故的Michael Soulé将这门科学描述为“有截止期限的学科”，旨在对抗加速的灭绝以维持社会和环境的福祉（Soulé and Wilcox, 19803）。虽然涵盖了从基础到应用的整个范围，生物多样性保护科学通常强调识别适合地面行动的关键信息的实用方法。来自北美非政府组织NatureServe网络的一个良好示例是，系统野外清查的自然群落和物种的实用方法，以表征其位置、健康状况和状态（Stein et al., 20004）。需要完全披露的是，我的大部分工作时间都在这个网络中度过，该网络最初由大自然保护协会在1970年代建立。

最初，生物多样性保护主要集中在识别自然保护区的局部区域，但随着景观生态学、meta-种群动力学以及现在的气候变化研究的成熟学科的发展，迫使人们考虑更大范围的保护区行动（Lindenmayer and Franklin, 20135）。随着技术的快速进步和数据的发展，对遥感技术和空间数据建模的重视已成为常规（Wiens et al., 20096）。而且，社会科学的价值也越来越多地（可以说是迟来的）得到认可，因为它加深了我们对支撑几乎所有保护策略的人和自然复杂相互作用的理解（Sandbrook et al., 20137）。

因此，虽然我发现这篇文章内容真实、准确，并且得到了当前文献的充分支持，但它将从对生物多样性科学的更广泛解释和更直接地处理ELIXIR对生物多样性保护“更广泛生态系统”的潜在贡献中受益。例如，基因组科学的快速进步及其在生物多样性保护中的应用与前面提到的几个相关领域有许多相似之处，如遥感和社会科学的几个变体。ELIXIR生物多样性社区可以通过考虑这一先前经验而获益，从而避免过去的错误并复制过去的成功。扩展基因组科学可能影响生物多样性保护的多种方式包括生态系统特征描述和监测、支持生物多样性状况评估以及评估保护行动的进展。

文章指出，“长期愿景是看到一个未来，即大规模的基于序列的生物多样性监测成为默认方式，并提供在空间和时间上表征生态系统生物多样性的手段。”我们可能在此看到近期进展的一个领域是基因组数据与遥感之间的联系；我们当前以物种组成、生态系统结构和环境设置为中心的生态系统特征描述可以通过遥感数据（高光谱和其他）得到增强，这些数据表明了易于观察的群落和物种内部和之间的模式（Yamasaki et al., 20178）。可测量的遗传多样性与可检测的光谱之间的关系总是复杂且具有挑战性，但随着遥感数据收集频率的增加，现在可以设想通过它们的结合来识别生态系统变化的领先指标的重大机会。

当前评估和记录物种和生态系统濒危状况的标准——如IUCN红色名录标准——需要记录种群和群落健康状况变化的知识（IUCN 20129; Bland et al., 201710）。这些标准试图将复杂的生态现象简化为标准类别，以提供可靠的状态评估供政策制定者和相关利益相关者使用。一旦通过基因组数据明确健康标志，这将对生物多样性状况评估的严谨性、效率和影响力做出重大贡献。

这自然引出了基因组数据对评估保护行动成功（或失败）的潜在益处。正如文章所指出的，这些数据应有助于理解“在人为活动（例如，气候变化和城市化的后果）背景下种群水平的适应和迁移过程，并理解恢复生态系统功能所必需的关键方面。”在保护行动的规划和实施中，人们当然可以认识到生物多样性保护本质上是一个人为驱动的过程，因此，所使用的信息必须对所有相关人员清晰且具有说服力，无论他们的兴趣和偏见如何。

相关领域的先前经验至少为ELIXIR生物多样性社区提供了几个考虑因素。正如文章所指出的，“ELIXIR可以在此发挥关键作用，因为其使命的一个基本方面是建立联系并协调复杂的活动。”并且“生物多样性社区需要主动寻求共同的解决方案（避免不必要的重复努力），以使分子技术能够推进生物多样性研究。”我要强调限制重复努力的重要性。生物多样性保护的历史在很大程度上标志着不必要的竞争、各自为政和参与者的重复努力。

虽然ELIXIR的“当前重点在于信息学、数据库和工具，而不是生物学问题，……但随着社区的发展，扩大其成员的多样性以确保技术发展满足生物多样性研究者的需求将非常重要”，我鼓励这个社区尽早寻求并识别来自整个用户社区的反馈循环。如上所述，基因组数据用于生物多样性保护的用户将是多样且要求严格的，因此，更深入地考虑用户需求（Dubois et al., 202011），以及参与式生物多样性科学（Zoellick et al., 201212）可能会在未来带来巨大的回报。

生物多样性保护基于既紧迫又时间敏感的生态和社会科学。正是光谱的应用侧需要来自ELIXIR生物多样性社区的紧急支持。

reasons: The ELIXIR Biodiversity Community could gain by considering this prior experience. Thus, avoiding prior mistakes and replicating prior successes.

As noted above, the users of genomic data for biodiversity conservation will be diverse and demanding, so deeper consideration of user needs (Dubois et al., 202011), and participatory biodiversity science (Zoellick et al., 201212) could have substantial payoffs into the future.

paper_title: Searching basic units in memory traces: associative memory cells
paper_abstract: The acquisition of associated signals is commonly seen in life. The integrative storage of these exogenous and endogenous signals is essential for cognition, emotion and behaviors. In terms of basic units of memory traces or engrams, associative memory cells are recruited in the brain during learning, cognition and emotional reactions. The recruitment and refinement of associative memory cells facilitate the retrieval of memory-relevant events and the learning of reorganized unitary signals that have been acquired. The recruitment of associative memory cells is fulfilled by generating mutual synapse innervations among them in coactivated brain regions. Their axons innervate downstream neurons convergently and divergently to recruit secondary associative memory cells. Mutual synapse innervations among associative memory cells confer the integrative storage and reciprocal retrieval of associated signals. Their convergent synapse innervations to secondary associative memory cells endorse integrative cognition. Their divergent innervations to secondary associative memory cells grant multiple applications of associated signals. Associative memory cells in memory traces are defined to be nerve cells that are able to encode multiple learned signals and receive synapse innervations carrying these signals. An impairment in the recruitment and refinement of associative memory cells will lead to the memory deficit associated with neurological diseases and psychological disorders. This review presents a comprehensive diagram for the recruitment and refinement of associative memory cells for memory-relevant events in a lifetime.
review_content:
In the review, Dr. Wang has significantly expanded discussion on associative memory cells in the brain from the molecular and cellular levels to functional outcomes. The proposed model for learning and memory was supported by work from the author’s own laboratory, as well as from accumulated literature. This is a timely update that will help reveal novel mechanisms in learning and memory formation and loss, which may help to advance understanding of memory deficits in neurodegenerative disorders, such as Alzheimer’s disease.

In addition to general comments above, the following some suggestions that the author may consider for the future studies.
 1. The author has simply discussed the possible relationship between associative memory cells and affective disorders such as anxiety and major depression. It sounds interesting but lacks experimental support. I would suggest the author to give more literature view or conduct some proof-and-concept experiments on this aspect the future.
 2. Although the author intends to establish that basic units of memory traces, or engrams, are associative memory cells named by author’s laboratory. It would be more supportive if the author makes the systemic and comprehensive comparisons between cell assemblies in memory traces and associative memory cells. It seems to me that associative memory cells encode the storage of multiple signals, which has not been emphasized by the studies of engrams. As the author states that almost all of learning activities are associative learning, the units to memorize particular associative signals are called as associative memory cells is straight forward. Has the author thought to make a mutual agreement in that associative memory cells and engrams are presenting the same cell ensemble in relevance to memory formation?
 3. The theory of associative memory cells may apply in psychology, although numerous terms and theoretical models about learning and memory have been suggested in this field. Hopefully the author and the team would provide more evidence and information to support this theory.
paper_title_zh: 在记忆痕迹中寻找基本单元：联想记忆细胞
paper_abstract_zh: 关联信号的获取在日常生活中普遍存在。这些外源性和内源性信号的整合存储对于认知、情感和行为至关重要。就记忆痕迹或记忆印记的基本单元而言，关联记忆细胞在学习、认知和情绪反应过程中被招募到大脑中。关联记忆细胞的招募和精细化促进了与记忆相关事件的检索以及对已获取的重组单一信号的学习。关联记忆细胞的招募通过在共同激活的大脑区域之间生成相互的突触支配来实现。它们的轴突会聚和发散地支配下游神经元，以招募次级关联记忆细胞。关联记忆细胞之间的相互突触支配赋予了关联信号的整合存储和互惠检索。它们对次级关联记忆细胞的会聚突触支配支持整合认知。它们对次级关联记忆细胞的发散支配则允许多种关联信号的应用。记忆痕迹中的关联记忆细胞被定义为能够编码多个学习信号并接收携带这些信号的突触支配的神经细胞。关联记忆细胞的招募和精细化受损将导致与神经疾病和心理障碍相关的记忆缺陷。本文综述了关联记忆细胞在一生中与记忆相关事件的招募和精细化的全面图景。
review_content_zh:
在综述中，王博士显著扩展了从分子和细胞水平到功能结果的关于大脑联想记忆细胞的讨论。所提出的学习和记忆模型得到了作者自己实验室的工作以及累积文献的支持。这是一个及时的更新，有助于揭示学习和记忆形成及丧失的新机制，这可能有助于推进对神经退行性疾病（如阿尔茨海默病）中记忆缺陷的理解。

除了上述总体评论外，以下是一些建议，作者可能在未来的研究中考虑：
1. 作者简单地讨论了联想记忆细胞与焦虑和重度抑郁等情感障碍之间可能的关系。这听起来很有趣，但缺乏实验支持。我建议作者在未来提供更多的文献综述或进行一些概念验证实验。
2. 尽管作者试图确立记忆痕迹的基本单位，即记忆印迹，是由作者实验室命名的联想记忆细胞。如果作者对记忆痕迹中的细胞组合和联想记忆细胞进行系统和全面的比较，将更有支持力。在我看来，联想记忆细胞编码了多种信号的存储，这一点在记忆印迹的研究中并未强调。正如作者所言，几乎所有的学习活动都是联想学习，记忆特定联想信号的单元被称为联想记忆细胞是直接明了的。作者是否考虑过联想记忆细胞和记忆印迹在记忆形成的相关性上呈现相同的细胞组合这一相互认同？
3. 联想记忆细胞的理论可能适用于心理学，尽管该领域已提出了众多关于学习和记忆的术语和理论模型。希望作者和团队能提供更多证据和信息来支持这一理论。

reasons: The proposed model for learning and memory was supported by work from the author’s own laboratory, as well as from accumulated literature.
I would suggest the author to give more literature view or conduct some proof-and-concept experiments on this aspect the future.
This is a timely and well written review on associative memory from an expert.
All three figures are well presented.
In order to have these diagrams to be generalized truth, the author should also conduct his studies in other areas, such as the visual cortex and auditory cortex.
Although the author has assumed potential processes for the integration and memory of visual images, I feel that the hypothesized diagram is not perfect and remains to be experimentally tested.

The author should design experiments to examine how associative memory cells become dysfunctional under pathological conditions in relevance to memory deficits or amnesia, and are influenced by abnormal internal environments, such as Alzheimer’s disease and Parkinson’s disease.

paper_title: Epidemiological evidence relating environmental smoke to COPD in lifelong non-smokers: a systematic review
paper_abstract:
Background: Some evidence suggests environmental tobacco smoke (ETS) might cause chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). We reviewed available epidemiological data in never smokers. 
 Methods:  We identified epidemiological studies providing estimates of relative risk (RR) with 95% confidence interval (CI) for various ETS exposure indices. Confounder-adjusted RRs for COPD were extracted, or derived using standard methods. 
Meta-analyses were conducted for each exposure index, with tests for heterogeneity and publication bias. For the main index (spouse ever smoked or nearest equivalent), analyses investigated variation in RR by location, publication period, study type, sex, diagnosis, study size, confounder adjustment, never smoker definition, and exposure index definition. 
 Results : Twenty-eight relevant studies were identified; nine European or Middle Eastern, nine Asian, eight American and two from multiple countries. Five were prospective, seven case-control and 16 cross-sectional. The COPD definition involved death or hospitalisation in seven studies, GOLD stage 1+ criteria in twelve, and other definitions in nine. For the main index, random-effects meta-analysis of 33 heterogeneous (p<0.001) estimates gave a RR of 1.20 (95%CI 1.08-1.34). Higher estimates for females (1.59,1.16-2.19, n=11) than males (1.29,0.94-1.76, n=7) or sexes combined (1.10,0.99-1.22, n=15 where sex-specific not available), and lower estimates for studies of 150+ cases (1.08,0.97-1.20, n=13) partly explained the heterogeneity. Estimates were higher for Asian studies (1.34,1.08-1.67, n=10), case-control studies (1.55,1.04-2.32, n=8), and COPD mortality or hospitalisation (1.40,1.12-1.74, n=11). Some increase was seen for severer COPD (1.29,1.10-1.52, n=7). Dose-response evidence was heterogeneous. Evidence for childhood (0.88,0.72-1.07, n=2) and workplace (1.12,0.77-1.64, n=4) exposure was limited, but an increase was seen for overall adulthood exposure (1.20,1.03-1.39, n=17). We discuss study weaknesses that may bias estimation of the association of COPD with ETS. 
 Conclusions : Although the evidence strongly suggests that ETS increases COPD, study weaknesses and absence of well-designed large studies preclude reliable effect estimation. More definitive evidence is required.
review_content:
The review is interesting, because it highlights methodological issues and gaps in surveys assessing the impact of environmental tobacco smoke on COPD incidence. These gaps and inconsistencies in surveys, lead to inadequacy on assessing the impact, and showing non-confirmative results (OR, RR, etc) on the association between ETS exposure and COPD.

I recommend it for indexing with minor changes.

However, the article should address three additional paragraphs or remark on:
 1. Public health message of awareness, it should address that, even if non association is found between ETS and COPD, it is still that ETS kills 90,0000 people per year and it is a global public health issue. Haahtela et al. Helsinki by nature. The nature step for respiratory health,Clinical and Transitional Allergy1.
 2. Should mention water pipe because it is wide spreading: Yousser Mohammad, Rafea Shaaban, Bassam Abou Al-Zahab, Nikolai Khaltaev, Jean Bousquet, Basim Dubaybo. Impact of active and passive smoking as risk factors for asthma and COPD in women presenting to primary care in Syria: first report by the WHO-GARD survey group2. WHO Advisory note 2015: waterpipe tobacco smoking: health effects, research needs and recommended actions by regulators – 2nd ed. World Health Organization. II.WHO Study Group on Tobacco Product Regulation. ISBN 978 92 4 150846 9 (NLM classification: QV 137)3.
 3. Should discuss the difference in the quality of ETS
Not only nicotine but how the smoke is modified in the air and becoming may be more harmful to small airways:
  * Lower ignition temperature
  * Particles become smaller
  * Higher proportion of CO, VOC
Ref found in the article: Mohammad Y. Passive smoking interference with wheezing and asthma Short Review of current knowledge4.

Wirth et al. Respiratory diseases related to passive smoking5.

Beside that, in one study6 the duration of exposure is 2 weeks, maybe we should omit it.
paper_title_zh: 终生非吸烟者中环境烟雾与慢性阻塞性肺疾病相关的流行病学证据：系统综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：一些证据表明，环境烟草烟雾（ETS）可能导致慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）。我们回顾了从未吸烟者的流行病学数据。

方法：我们识别了提供各种ETS暴露指数相对风险（RR）及95%置信区间（CI）的流行病学研究。提取或使用标准方法推导出经混杂因素调整后的COPD的RR。对每个暴露指数进行荟萃分析，并进行异质性和发表偏倚的检验。对于主要指数（配偶曾吸烟或最接近的等价物），分析探讨了RR在不同地点、发表时期、研究类型、性别、诊断、研究规模、混杂因素调整、从未吸烟者定义和暴露指数定义中的变异。

结果：共识别了28项相关研究；其中9项来自欧洲或中东，9项来自亚洲，8项来自美洲，2项来自多个国家。5项为前瞻性研究，7项为病例对照研究，16项为横断面研究。COPD的定义在7项研究中涉及死亡或住院，12项采用GOLD 1+标准，9项采用其他定义。对于主要指数，随机效应荟萃分析33个异质性（p<0.001）估计值得出RR为1.20（95%CI 1.08-1.34）。女性（1.59, 1.16-2.19, n=11）高于男性（1.29, 0.94-1.76, n=7）或性别合并（1.10, 0.99-1.22, n=15，性别特异性不可用），以及病例数超过150的研究（1.08, 0.97-1.20, n=13）部分解释了异质性。亚洲研究（1.34, 1.08-1.67, n=10）、病例对照研究（1.55, 1.04-2.32, n=8）和COPD死亡或住院（1.40, 1.12-1.74, n=11）的估计值较高。较严重COPD（1.29, 1.10-1.52, n=7）也见增加。剂量-反应证据异质性较大。儿童期（0.88, 0.72-1.07, n=2）和工作场所（1.12, 0.77-1.64, n=4）暴露的证据有限，但成年期总体暴露（1.20, 1.03-1.39, n=17）见增加。我们讨论了可能导致COPD与ETS关联估计偏倚的研究弱点。

结论：尽管证据强烈表明ETS会增加COPD风险，但研究弱点和缺乏设计良好的大型研究使得难以进行可靠的效应估计。需要更确凿的证据。
review_content_zh:
该评论很有趣，因为它突出了在评估环境烟草烟雾对慢性阻塞性肺病（COPD）发病率影响的研究中所存在的方法论问题和空白。这些调查中的空白和不一致性导致了评估影响的不足，并且在环境烟草烟雾（ETS）暴露与COPD之间的关联上显示出非确凿的结果（如OR、RR等）。

我建议对其进行少量修改后进行索引。

然而，文章应增加三个额外的段落或评论：
1. 公共卫生意识的宣传信息，应指出即使未发现ETS与COPD之间的关联，ETS每年仍导致90万人死亡，这是一个全球性的公共卫生问题。参见Haahtela等人的《Helsinki by nature. The nature step for respiratory health》，Clinical and Transitional Allergy1。
2. 应提及水烟，因为其广泛传播：参见Yousser Mohammad, Rafea Shaaban, Bassam Abou Al-Zahab, Nikolai Khaltaev, Jean Bousquet, Basim Dubaybo的《Impact of active and passive smoking as risk factors for asthma and COPD in women presenting to primary care in Syria: first report by the WHO-GARD survey group2》。WHO 2015年咨询报告：《水烟烟草吸烟：健康影响、研究需求和监管机构推荐行动》第二版。世界卫生组织。II.WHO烟草产品监管研究组。ISBN 978 92 4 150846 9（NLM分类：QV 137）3。
3. 应讨论ETS质量上的差异
不仅仅是尼古丁，还有烟雾在空气中如何变化，可能对小气道更具危害性：
  * 点火温度更低
  * 颗粒变得更小
  * 一氧化碳（CO）、挥发性有机化合物（VOC）的比例更高

paper_title: Sustainability communication on social media in the last decade: A review of research perspectives from Asia
paper_abstract: The past decade has been marked by increased discussions on sustainability; some of the prominent accelerators being, mounting natural disasters, vocal climate activism, and the UN Agenda 2030 for Sustainable Development. The interest has crossed over from deliberations in global summits to grassroots-level communication. Additionally, the literature points to the increasing usage of social media in communicating sustainability with an increase of interest in this area among Asian researchers. This paper aims to understand the direction of sustainability communication and the usage of social media in the communication of sustainability, in the last decade (2013-2023), from an Asian perspective – researchers and respondents from Asia. A comprehensive search of the literature by Asian researchers on sustainability communication on social media in the past decade was conducted using the Scopus database. The studies were clustered around common directions and terminologies, basis an in-depth content analysis. Based on the analysis, the study presents the current direction of research in sustainability communication on social media in the areas of brand-generated sustainability communication, cause-generated content and user-generated content. Few prominent themes that emerged were of green marketing, greenwashing, social media as a platform for active engagement and environment related discussions. The studies analyzed in the scoping review affirm that sustainability communication on social media in Asia has substantial potential to improve the environmental awareness of the public and promote actual pro-environmental behavior in the broad areas of green purchase and conservation behavior. The review provides a holistic view of the recent trends and possible future directions for sustainability communication on social media.

paper_title_zh: 过去十年社交媒体上的可持续性传播：亚洲研究视角综述
paper_abstract_zh: 过去十年，关于可持续性的讨论显著增加，其中一些主要的推动因素包括频发的自然灾害、积极的气候行动主义以及联合国2030年可持续发展议程。这一兴趣已从全球峰会的审议扩展到基层水平的交流。此外，文献指出，社交媒体在传播可持续性方面的使用日益增加，亚洲研究人员对此领域的兴趣也在提升。本文旨在从亚洲视角（亚洲的研究人员和受访者）理解过去十年（2013-2023年）可持续性传播的方向以及社交媒体在可持续性传播中的使用。通过Scopus数据库，对亚洲研究人员在过去十年关于社交媒体上可持续性传播的文献进行了全面检索。基于深入的内容分析，将这些研究按共同方向和术语进行聚类。根据分析，研究呈现了社交媒体上可持续性传播研究的当前方向，涉及品牌生成的可持续性传播、由议题生成的内容以及用户生成的内容。一些突出的主题包括绿色营销、漂绿行为、社交媒体作为积极参与和环境相关讨论的平台。在范围综述中分析的研究证实，亚洲社交媒体上的可持续性传播具有显著潜力，能够提高公众的环保意识，并在绿色购买和环保行为等广泛领域促进实际的亲环境行为。该综述提供了社交媒体上可持续性传播近期趋势和未来可能方向的全面视角。

paper_title: A Unified Survey on Anomaly, Novelty, Open-Set, and Out- of-Distribution Detection: Solutions and Future Challenges
paper_abstract: Machine learning models often encounter samples that are diverged from the training distribution. Failure to recognize an out-of-distribution (OOD) sample, and consequently assign that sample to an in-class label significantly compromises the reliability of a model. The problem has gained significant attention due to its importance for safety deploying models in open-world settings. Detecting OOD samples is challenging due to the intractability of modeling all possible unknown distributions. To date, several research domains tackle the problem of detecting unfamiliar samples, including anomaly detection, novelty detection, one-class learning, open set recognition, and out-of-distribution detection. Despite having similar and shared concepts, out-of-distribution, open-set, and anomaly detection have been investigated independently. Accordingly, these research avenues have not cross-pollinated, creating research barriers. While some surveys intend to provide an overview of these approaches, they seem to only focus on a specific domain without examining the relationship between different domains. This survey aims to provide a cross-domain and comprehensive review of numerous eminent works in respective areas while identifying their commonalities. Researchers can benefit from the overview of research advances in different fields and develop future methodology synergistically. Furthermore, to the best of our knowledge, while there are surveys in anomaly detection or one-class learning, there is no comprehensive or up-to-date survey on out-of-distribution detection, which our survey covers extensively. Finally, having a unified cross-domain perspective, we discuss and shed light on future lines of research, intending to bring these fields closer together.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
The paper aims to provide a comprehensive review of relevant works in out-of-distribution, open-set, and anomaly detection. The paper highlights an important concern with other survey papers in the field, i.e., the existing survey papers only focus on a specific domain without examining the relationship between different domains. This paper provides a cross-domain and comprehensive review of the literature across these areas and at the same time identifies common ideas.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
**Strengths** - Survey paper is clearly written and easy to follow. The exposition is clear and situated nicely. Methods are described both mathematically and visually. This survey paper can help newcomers reduce their barriers to entry. - Explanation for each method covered in the paper is clear. To the best of my knowledge, the survey does a good job of covering relevant papers with diverse ideas in each field. - Discussion in the future work section is interesting and insightful. **Weaknesses** - While the survey paper discusses methods for all three different fields, it doesn't delineate the relationship between different research areas. Currently, the methods in each category are discussed in a separate section. - Contribution bullet 2 can be misguiding. "Comprehensive methodological analysis of recent eminent research, and providing a clear theoretical and visual explanation for methods reviewed". Authors should be careful about mentioning theoretical explanations. Not all the methods discussed have theoretical justification. Perhaps clarifying and situating this contribution in light of the absence of theoretical justification is important. - Figure 1 is not clear. See more below in the Requested Changes section. At a high level, the categorization in Figure 1 is not clear. It seems that as one moves away from the center of the figure the semantic similarity with classes in the center decreases. However, it is not clear what this is intended to capture. - Paper also fails to cover the literature on identifiability questions. In particular, questions like: when is the anomaly detection or outlier detection problem identifiable? Under what conditions between source and target data distribution, one can hope to tackle the open set classification problem. In general, the anomaly detection, outlier classification, or open set classification problem in high dimensions (for overparameterized problems) can be hopeless.

**Requested Changes:**
It would be great if the following changes/suggestions can be incorporated into the paper before it is ready for publication: - (Critical to securing your recommendation for acceptance) Figure 1 is unclear. I have two kinds of concerns: (i) presentation/clarity concerns and (ii) concerns with categorization. First, it is not clear what the circles are intended to capture. It would be great to add an annotation to the figure itself. Second and more importantly, it seems that different circles capture different problems with strictly increasing order of how the outlier classes are defined. It is unclear if this categorization is strictly followed in previous work, or is it a proposed categorization to clean the field? - (Critical to securing your recommendation for acceptance) Identifiability of the problem. The paper doesn't discuss any paper on identifiability questions, mainly, when is the anomaly detection or outlier detection problem identifiable? Under what conditions between source and target data distribution, one can hope to tackle the open set classification problem? - (Critical to securing your recommendation for acceptance) Paper presents several experimental results in Tables 1-6. It would be great if the implementation of baseline methods can be released in form of a codebase. Ideally, a repository of implementation of these baseline methods with a collection of datasets on which the methods were tested. I believe this can benefit the community a lot and is in line with the motivation of the survey paper of reducing barriers to entry. - (Critical to securing your recommendation for acceptance) The paper discusses different methods in different subsections for each of the survey topics. Currently, it seems that the discussion of each method is fairly disjoint without a clear connection between different methods. I encourage authors to provide summary unifying ideas across similar methods in form of flow charts and tables at the beginning of sections 3,4 and 5. - (Not so critical to securing your recommendation for acceptance) While the survey paper discusses methods for all three different fields, it doesn't delineate the relationship between different research areas. Currently, the methods in each category are discussed in a separate section. It would be great to summarize (either before or after Sections 3,4 and 5) common ideas in separate fields and how ideas can be borrowed from different fields.

**Broader Impact Concerns:**
This paper surveys the existing literature on anomaly detection, open-set classification, and out-of-distribution detection. Since the paper surveys existing literature, I think a broader impact statement is not needed.
paper_title_zh: 异常、新奇性、开放集及分布外检测的统一综述：解决方案与未来挑战
paper_abstract_zh: 机器学习模型经常遇到与训练分布偏离的样本。未能识别出分布外（OOD）样本，并因此将该样本分配到类内标签，会显著降低模型的可靠性。由于在开放世界环境中安全部署模型的重要性，这一问题已引起广泛关注。由于建模所有可能的未知分布的不可处理性，检测OOD样本具有挑战性。迄今为止，多个研究领域都在解决检测不熟悉样本的问题，包括异常检测、新颖性检测、单类学习、开放集识别和分布外检测。尽管分布外、开放集和异常检测具有相似和共享的概念，但它们一直是独立研究的。因此，这些研究途径未能相互借鉴，形成了研究壁垒。虽然一些综述旨在提供这些方法的概述，但它们似乎只关注特定领域，而没有考察不同领域之间的关系。本综述旨在提供一个跨领域且全面的回顾，涵盖各领域众多杰出工作，同时识别它们的共同点。研究人员可以从不同领域的研究进展概览中受益，并协同开发未来的方法。此外，据我们所知，尽管存在关于异常检测或单类学习的综述，但还没有关于分布外检测的全面或最新的综述，而我们的综述对此进行了广泛覆盖。最后，通过统一的跨领域视角，我们讨论并阐明未来的研究方向，旨在使这些领域更加紧密地结合在一起。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
本文旨在对分布外检测、开放集检测和异常检测的相关工作进行全面综述。文章指出了该领域其他综述论文的一个重要问题，即现有综述论文仅关注特定领域，未考察不同领域之间的关系。本文对这些领域的文献进行了跨领域且全面的综述，并识别了其中的共同思想。

**优点与不足：**
**优点** - 综述论文撰写清晰，易于理解。论述明确，结构合理。方法描述既有数学表达也有视觉呈现。该综述论文可以帮助初学者降低入门门槛。 - 对文中涵盖的每种方法的解释清晰。据我所知，该综述很好地覆盖了各领域中具有不同思想的相关论文。 - 未来工作部分的讨论有趣且富有洞察力。
**不足** - 虽然综述论文讨论了三个不同领域的方法，但未明确不同研究领域之间的关系。目前，每个类别的方法在单独的章节中讨论。 - 贡献点2可能具有误导性。“对近期杰出研究的全面方法学分析，并为所综述的方法提供清晰的理论和视觉解释”。作者应谨慎提及理论解释。并非所有讨论的方法都有理论依据。或许在缺乏理论依据的情况下，澄清并定位这一贡献点很重要。 - 图1不清晰。详见下文“请求的修改”部分。总体而言，图1中的分类不清晰。似乎离图中心越远，与中心类别的语义相似度越低。然而，不清楚这意图捕捉什么。 - 论文未涵盖可识别性问题的文献。特别是，诸如：异常检测或离群检测问题何时可识别？在源数据和目标数据分布之间的什么条件下，可以期望解决开放集分类问题。一般来说，在高维度（对于过参数化问题）中的异常检测、离群分类或开放集分类问题可能无解。

**请求的修改：**
在论文准备发表之前，若能纳入以下修改/建议将非常有益： - （对获得接受推荐至关重要）图1不清晰。我有两种担忧：（一）呈现/清晰度问题；（二）分类问题。首先，不清楚圆圈意图捕捉什么。最好在图本身添加注释。其次，更重要的是，似乎不同圆圈捕捉不同问题，且离群类别的定义顺序严格递增。不清楚这种分类是否严格遵循了先前工作，还是为清理领域而提出的分类？ - （对获得接受推荐至关重要）问题的可识别性。论文未讨论任何关于可识别性问题的论文，主要是，异常检测或离群检测问题何时可识别？在源数据和目标数据分布之间的什么条件下，可以期望解决开放集分类问题？ - （对获得接受推荐至关重要）论文在表1-6中呈现了多项实验结果。若能以代码库形式发布基线方法的实现将非常有益。理想情况下，是一个包含这些基线方法实现的存储库，以及测试这些方法的数据集集合。我相信这可以极大地造福社区，并与综述论文降低入门门槛的动机一致。 - （对获得接受推荐至关重要）论文在不同小节中讨论了每个综述主题的不同方法。目前，每种方法的讨论似乎相当独立，缺乏不同方法之间的清晰联系。我鼓励作者在3、4和5节的开始提供总结性统一思想，以流程图和表格的形式呈现相似方法。 - （对获得接受推荐不那么关键）虽然综述论文讨论了所有三个不同领域的方法，但未明确不同研究领域之间的关系。目前，每个类别的方法在单独的章节中讨论。最好在3、4和5节之前或之后总结不同领域的共同思想，以及如何从不同领域借鉴思想。

**更广泛影响关切：**
本文综述了现有关于异常检测、开放集分类和分布外检测的文献。由于论文综述了现有文献，我认为不需要更广泛影响声明。

paper_title: Review of the Genus Loimia Malmgren, 1866 (Annelida, Terebellidae) from China seas with recognition of two new species based on integrative taxonomy
paper_abstract: Specimens of the genus Loimia (Annelida, Terebellidae) deposited in the Marine Biological Museum of the Chinese Academy of Sciences (MBMCAS) together with materials newly collected from China seas were examined. Based on morphological comparisons and molecular analysis, some specimens collected from the coasts of Shandong province and Guangxi province were confirmed as two new Loimia species respectively (Loimia borealis sp. n. and Loimia macrobranchia sp. n.). Morphologically, L. borealis sp. n. is distinguished from previously known species of this genus by having seven equal sized ventral shields, with length five times the width; this species was retrieved as sister to the clades of Loimia arborea <ref type="bibr" target="#b33">Moore, 1903 and</ref> Loimia bandera Hutchings, 1990  in the phylogenetic tree, which was reconstructed based on mitochondrial COI gene. Loimia macrobranchia sp. n. differs from congeners by the large size of its first pair of branchiae with a thick main stem and about 18 dendritic branches arranged in two levels. A key to identifying Loimia species found in Chinese seas is given.

paper_title: A Short Survey on Importance Weighting for Machine Learning
paper_abstract: Importance weighting is a fundamental procedure in statistics and machine learning that weights the objective function or probability distribution based on the importance of the instance in some sense. The simplicity and usefulness of the idea has led to many applications of importance weighting. For example, it is known that supervised learning under an assumption about the difference between the training and test distributions, called distribution shift, can guarantee statistically desirable properties through importance weighting by their density ratio. This survey summarizes the broad applications of importance weighting in machine learning and related research.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
This paper provides an overview of the concept of importance weighting, its applications, and related research in machine learning. The paper discusses various methods for handling distribution shift, such as covariate shift, target shift, and sample selection bias, highlighting the effectiveness of importance weighting in these scenarios. The authors also present the role of importance weighting in addressing various machine learning tasks such as active learning, model calibration and so on.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
Strengths: 1. This survey covers a broad range of topics related to importance weighting, making it a valuable resource for researchers and practitioners. 2. The authors provide a clear and accessible explanation of complex concepts, making the material understandable to readers with varying levels of expertise. The inclusion of both theoretical and practical aspects of importance weighting offers a good view. Weaknesses: 1. While the survey is comprehensive, it may benefit from more detailed case studies or examples to illustrate the practical applications of importance weighting in real-world scenarios. This survey covers a broad range of importance weighting methods but none of these has been formally introduced in details. 2. There are several confused points about the paper structure: (a) Why Density Ratio Estimation is missed from the structural diagram in Figure 1? (b) Domain Adaptation, which is inherently a specific type of Distribution Shift Adaptation, is presented as a separate entity in the paper. (c) It seems that Distributionally Robust Optimization is one part of Distribution Shift Adaptation within the diagram (Figure 1), but the Section of Distributionally Robust Optimization is positioned between Active Learning and Model Calibration sections. 3. The paper could potentially include a more extensive discussion on the computational complexity and scalability of the various importance weighting methods, which are crucial considerations for large-scale machine learning tasks. 4. Although the survey mentions the use of importance weighting in deep learning, it may not fully capture the details of its utilization in deep learning. I think this part could be extend considering that deep learning is dominating modern machine learning.

**Requested Changes:**
Please refer to Weaknesses.

**Broader Impact Concerns:**
N/A.

**Claims And Evidence:**
Yes

**Audience:**
Yes

**Rebuttal Comments:**
Authors' Response: Let us thank you for your very informative comments. You have accurately grasped the content of our manuscript and have given us enough comments to improve our manuscript. The following is a list of our revisions in response to the points you have raised. 1. Illustration of practical applications and formal definitions of them. - To address these points, we first created and added new figures to provide a conceptual understanding of the problem settings for which importance weighting has been reported to be effective (see Figure 2 in p.6 and Figure 3 in p.12). In these figures, we have tried to show the relationships and connections between each problem setting, rather than presenting each problem setting independently. We believe these figures will help to understand what kinds of problem settings the importance weighting solves. Additionally, in response to your point about the lack of formal details, we have added formal definitions of the various problem settings (see Definition 6 in p.8, Definition 7 in p.9, Definition 8 in p.10, Definition 9 in p.11, Definition 10 in p.16 and Definition 11 in p.17). In these definitions, we have kept the symbols consistent with the other definitions, but have tried to distinguish them from other similar concepts. As above, we have attempted to help the reader by not only enumerating the concepts, but also by making explicit the connections between each of them. 2. Confusing structure: - a) Why Density Ratio Estimation is missed from the structural diagram in Figure 1? - While Figure 1 lists the applications of importance weighting, density ratio estimation was not originally included in Figure 1 because it is a technique that supports importance weighting. However, the original manuscript was confusing because the section on density ratio estimation was presented in parallel with the other sections. In light of this, we have moved this section to a subsection of the preliminary section in order to clarify the position of density ratio estimation as a fundamental technique for importance weighting in our revised version (see Section 2.1). We have also clarified the meaning of this subsection by writing at the end of this subsection that many importance-weighting-dependent techniques depend on density ratios. - b) Domain Adaptation, which is inherently a specific type of Distribution Shift Adaptation, is presented as a separate entity in the paper. - As you pointed out, it is reasonable to position domain adaptation as a sub-problem of distribution shift. Therefore, we have moved the Domain Adaptation section to a subsection of the Distribution Shift section (see 3.6). We have also clarified the distinction between other distribution shifts and domain adaptation assumptions by specifying the difference between them immediately below Definition 8 (domain adaptation) on p. 10. - c) It seems that Distributionally Robust Optimization is one part of Distribution Shift Adaptation within the diagram (Figure 1), but the Section of Distributionally Robust Optimization is positioned between Active Learning and Model Calibration sections. - As you pointed out, we have moved the Distributionally Robust Optimization section to a subsection of the Distributional Shifts section (see Section 3.7). At this point, we made sure that the order of the topics appearing in Figure 1 matches the order of the sections. 3. Discussion on the computational complexity. - Computational complexity is a very important issue, as you suggest, and we found it worth devoting a paragraph to in the Conclusion section. In particular, we mentioned an example of improved computational complexity for importance weighting and the need for such an analysis in future works. 4. More discussion on importance weighting and deep learning - Your comments on the usefulness of the section on importance weighting and deep learning are reasonable. We first tried to enhance the discussion on one of the most important topics in this section: the negative results of importance weighting. The point of this topic is that the effect of importance weighting is decaying in learning by gradient descent over long periods of time. This observation is so illuminating that we have decided to devote more space to it. Therefore, we contacted the authors of the original paper that reported these results and obtained permission to use the figures from their paper (see Figure 5). Next, we introduce the existing studies in more detail on learning weight estimators, which is an important issue for importance weighting in deep learning. Finally, we added a new paragraph on Importance Weighted VAE, which has many related studies and touches on the topics of importance weighting and generative models.
paper_title_zh: 机器学习中重要性加权方法的简要综述
paper_abstract_zh: 重要性加权是统计学和机器学习中的一种基本程序，它根据实例在某些意义上的重要性对目标函数或概率分布进行加权。这一思想的简洁性和实用性导致了重要性加权的广泛应用。例如，已知在关于训练和测试分布之间差异（称为分布偏移）的假设下进行监督学习，可以通过其密度比的重要性加权保证统计上理想的性质。本综述总结了重要性加权在机器学习及相关研究中的广泛应用。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
本文概述了重要性加权的概念、其应用以及机器学习中的相关研究。文章讨论了处理分布偏移的各种方法，例如协变量偏移、目标偏移和样本选择偏差，突出了重要性加权在这些场景中的有效性。作者还介绍了重要性加权在解决各种机器学习任务（如主动学习、模型校准等）中的作用。

**优点和缺点：**
优点：1. 本综述涵盖了与重要性加权相关的广泛主题，使其成为研究人员和从业者的宝贵资源。2. 作者对复杂概念进行了清晰且易于理解的解释，使不同专业水平的读者都能理解材料。包含重要性加权的理论和实践方面，提供了良好的视角。
缺点：1. 虽然综述内容全面，但可能需要更详细的案例研究或示例来说明重要性加权在实际场景中的应用。本综述涵盖了广泛的重要性加权方法，但没有详细正式地介绍这些方法。2. 论文结构存在一些混淆点：(a) 为什么密度比估计在图1的结构图中缺失？(b) 领域适应本质上是一种特定的分布偏移适应，但在论文中被作为独立实体呈现。(c) 分布鲁棒优化在图1中似乎是分布偏移适应的一部分，但分布鲁棒优化部分被放置在主动学习和模型校准部分之间。3. 论文可以更广泛地讨论各种重要性加权方法的计算复杂性和可扩展性，这对于大规模机器学习任务至关重要。4. 虽然综述提到了重要性加权在深度学习中的应用，但可能未能充分捕捉其在深度学习中的细节。我认为这部分可以扩展，考虑到深度学习在现代机器学习中的主导地位。

**请求的更改：**
请参考“缺点”部分。

**更广泛的影响关注：**
不适用。

**主张和证据：**
是

**受众：**

**反驳意见：**
作者回应：感谢您提供非常有见地的评论。您准确地把握了我们手稿的内容，并给出了足够的评论以改进我们的手稿。以下是针对您提出的问题我们所做的修订列表。1. 实际应用的说明和它们的正式定义。- 为解决这些问题，我们首先创建并添加了新图，以提供对重要性加权已被报道有效的各种问题设置的概念理解（见图2第6页和图3第12页）。在这些图中，我们试图展示每个问题设置之间的关系和联系，而不是独立地呈现每个问题设置。我们相信这些图将有助于理解重要性加权解决的是哪些类型的问题设置。此外，针对您关于缺乏正式细节的评论，我们添加了各种问题设置的正式定义（见定义6第8页、定义7第9页、定义8第10页、定义9第11页、定义10第16页和定义11第17页）。在这些定义中，我们保持了符号与其他定义的一致性，但试图将它们与其他类似概念区分开来。如上所述，我们不仅通过列举概念，还通过明确它们之间的联系，试图帮助读者理解。2. 混乱的结构：- a) 为什么密度比估计在图1的结构图中缺失？- 虽然图1列出了重要性加权的应用，但由于密度比估计是支持重要性加权的技术，因此最初并未包括在图1中。然而，原稿令人困惑，因为密度比估计部分与其他部分并列呈现。鉴于此，我们将这一部分移至初步部分的子部分，以澄清密度比估计作为重要性加权基本技术的地位（见第2.1节）。我们还在该子部分的末尾明确说明了这一子部分的意义，即许多依赖重要性加权的技术依赖于密度比。- b) 领域适应本质上是一种特定的分布偏移适应，但在论文中被作为独立实体呈现。- 如您所指出的，将领域适应定位为分布偏移的子问题是合理的。因此，我们将领域适应部分移至分布偏移部分的子部分（见3.6）。我们还在定义8（领域适应）下方第10页立即指出了其他分布偏移与领域适应假设之间的区别。- c) 分布鲁棒优化在图1中似乎是分布偏移适应的一部分，但分布鲁棒优化部分被放置在主动学习和模型校准部分之间。- 如您所指出的，我们将分布鲁棒优化部分移至分布偏移部分的子部分（见第3.7节）。在此过程中，我们确保图1中出现的主题顺序与各节的顺序相匹配。3. 关于计算复杂性的讨论。- 如您所建议的，计算复杂性是一个非常重要的问题，我们觉得在结论部分值得专门用一段来讨论。特别是，我们提到了一个关于重要性加权改进计算复杂性的例子，以及未来工作中需要进行此类分析的需求。4. 更多关于重要性加权和深度学习的讨论- 您关于重要性加权和深度学习部分有用性的评论是合理的。我们首先尝试增强该部分一个最重要主题的讨论：重要性加权的负面结果。这个主题的要点是，在长时间的梯度下降学习中，重要性加权的效果会衰减。这一观察非常具有启发性，我们决定为其分配更多篇幅。因此，我们联系了报告这些结果的原始论文的作者，并获得了使用他们论文中图件的许可（见图5）。接下来，我们更详细地介绍了学习权重估计器的研究，这是深度学习中重要性加权的重要问题。最后，我们添加了一个关于重要性加权VAE的新段落，该领域有许多相关研究，涉及重要性加权和生成模型的主题。

paper_title: Applications of MR Finger printing derived T1 and T2 values in Adult brain: A Systematic review
paper_abstract:
Introduction 
    Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is essential for brain imaging, but conventional methods rely on qualitative contrast, are time-intensive, and prone to variability. Magnetic resonance finger printing (MRF) addresses these limitations by enabling fast, simultaneous mapping of multiple tissue properties like T1, T2. Using dynamic acquisition parameters and a precomputed signal dictionary, MRF provides robust, qualitative maps, improving diagnostic precision and expanding clinical and research applications in brain imaging. 
  
  
    Methods 
    Database searches were performed through PubMed, Embase, Scopus, Web of science to identify relevant articles focusing on the application of MR finger printing in the adult brain. We utilized the preferred reporting items for systematic reviews and meta-analysis guidelines to extract data from the selected studies. 
  
  
    Results 
    Nine articles were included in the final review, with a total sample size of 332 participants. In healthy brains, notable regional, sex, age, and hemispheric variations were identified, particularly in the corpus callosum and thalamus. MRF effectively differentiated meningioma subtypes, glioma grades, and IDH mutation status, with T2 values providing particularly predictive for glioma classification. In brain metastases, significant relaxometry differences were noted between normal and lesional tissues. For multiple sclerosis, MRF values correlated with clinical and disability measures, distinguishing relapsing-remitting secondary progressive forms. In traumatic brain injury, longitudinal T1 changes strongly correlated with clinical recovery, surpassing T2 values. 
  
  
    Conclusions 
    The systematic review highlighted MRD as a groundbreaking technique that enhances neurological diagnosis by simultaneously quantifying T1 and T2 relaxation times. With reduced acquisition times, MRF outperforms conventional MRI in detecting subtle pathologies, distinguishing properties, and providing reliable biomarkers.
review_content:
Comments
 1. In the conclusion of the abstract, I noticed that "MRD" has been used, which I believe should be corrected to "MRF." Kindly correct it.
 2. The introduction is well-written, highlighting the limitations of conventional MRI and the advantages of Quantitative MRI. It provides a solid foundation for the study and conveys the significance of the topic.
 3. The study follows the well-established PRISMA guidelines, which enhances its methodological clarity.

 6. The rest of the Results, Discussion, and Conclusion sections are well-written. They provide a clear and comprehensive interpretation of the findings and study outcomes.
paper_title_zh: 基于MR指纹技术获得的T1和T2值在成人脑部应用：系统综述
paper_abstract_zh:
引言
磁共振成像（MRI）对于脑部成像至关重要，但传统方法依赖于定性对比，耗时且易变。磁共振指纹成像（MRF）通过快速、同时映射多种组织属性（如T1、T2）来解决这些局限性。利用动态采集参数和预计算的信号字典，MRF提供稳健的定性图谱，提高了诊断精度，并扩展了脑部成像在临床和研究中的应用。

方法
通过PubMed、Embase、Scopus、Web of Science数据库检索，识别专注于成人脑部磁共振指纹成像应用的相关文章。我们采用系统评价和荟萃分析的首选报告项目指南，从选定的研究中提取数据。

结果
最终纳入九篇文章，总样本量为332名参与者。在健康脑部中，特别是在胼胝体和丘脑中，发现了显著的区域性、性别、年龄和半球变异。MRF有效区分了脑膜瘤亚型、胶质瘤分级和IDH突变状态，其中T2值对胶质瘤分类具有特别预测性。在脑转移中，正常组织和病变组织之间存在显著的弛豫测量差异。对于多发性硬化症，MRF值与临床和残疾指标相关，区分了复发-缓解型和继发进展型。在创伤性脑损伤中，纵向T1变化与临床恢复强烈相关，超过T2值。

结论
系统评价突显了MRF作为一种突破性技术，通过同时量化T1和T2弛豫时间，增强了神经病学诊断。凭借缩短的采集时间，MRF在检测细微病理、区分属性和提供可靠生物标志物方面优于传统MRI。
review_content_zh:
评论
1. 在摘要的结论部分，我注意到使用了“MRD”，我认为应更正为“MRF”。请予以纠正。
2. 引言部分写得很好，突出了传统MRI的局限性以及定量MRI的优势。它为研究提供了坚实的基础，并传达了主题的重要性。
3. 该研究遵循了成熟的PRISMA指南，这增强了其方法论的清晰度。
4. 在表1（第4页）中，你提到研究的总数为252，包括来自PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science和Embase的研究。然而，在图1（第6页）中，列出的识别出的研究总数为256，包括数据库4，如果是这样，请问是哪些数据库？请澄清。
5. 在第5页的“研究选择”部分（第2行），请提及有5项研究因其他原因被移除，正如流程图（图1）所示。
6. 其余的结果、讨论和结论部分写得很好。它们对研究发现和研究结果提供了清晰且全面的解释。

reasons: The review emphasizes MR Finger printing as a groundbreaking technique for adult brain imaging, offering shift from qualitative to quantitative MRI.
Introduction provides an overview of the limitations of conventional MRI techniques and effectively sets the stage for the discussion on MR Fingerprinting (MRF).
Methodology is well written
Results section presents a detailed summary of the findings from the included studies, focusing on various applications of MR Fingerprinting (MRF) in the adult brain
Discussion consolidates the key results from the study, including the diagnostic advantages of MRF in conditions such as gliomas, meningiomas and traumatic brain injuries.

Conclusion succinctly reiterates the diagnostic and clinical advantages of MRF, particularly in providing quantitative metrics like T1 and T2 values that enhance diagnostic precision and reduce acquisition times.

paper_title: A review of creatine supplementation in age-related diseases: more than a supplement for athletes
paper_abstract: Creatine is an endogenous compound synthesized from arginine, glycine and methionine. This dietary supplement can be acquired from food sources such as meat and fish, along with athlete supplement powders. Since the majority of creatine is stored in skeletal muscle, dietary creatine supplementation has traditionally been important for athletes and bodybuilders to increase the power, strength, and mass of the skeletal muscle. However, new uses for creatine have emerged suggesting that it may be important in preventing or delaying the onset of neurodegenerative diseases associated with aging. On average, 30% of muscle mass is lost by age 80, while muscular weakness remains a vital cause for loss of independence in the elderly population. In light of these new roles of creatine, the dietary supplement’s usage has been studied to determine its efficacy in treating congestive heart failure, gyrate atrophy, insulin insensitivity, cancer, and high cholesterol. In relation to the brain, creatine has been shown to have antioxidant properties, reduce mental fatigue, protect the brain from neurotoxicity, and improve facets/components of neurological disorders like depression and bipolar disorder. The combination of these benefits has made creatine a leading candidate in the fight against age-related diseases, such as Parkinson’s disease, Huntington’s disease, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, long-term memory impairments associated with the progression of Alzheimer’s disease, and stroke. In this review, we explore the normal mechanisms by which creatine is produced and its necessary physiology, while paying special attention to the importance of creatine supplementation in improving diseases and disorders associated with brain aging and outlining the clinical trials involving creatine to treat these diseases.
review_content:
This is solid contribution to the literature on creatine and its possible beneficial role in acute and chronic neurodegenerative conditions.

I have one major comment and several minor issues:

Major: the manuscript does not, but should, deal to any extent with possible side-effects of creatine supplementation. Particularly since the population proposed for intervention are largely elderly and very ill. A paragraph stating this and possible side-effects should suffice.

Minor things:
 1. 'Parkinson’s disease' section, paragraph 2, sentence 7, please insert "not" before "results".
 2. 'Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis' section, second paragraph, SOD-1 is cytosolic, so more than just mitochondrial proteins would be affected. This paragraph should be changed to reflect this.
 3. 'Long-term memory' section, third sentence, I would replace the term "dramatic" with another term as little drama happens in results of studies.
 4. 'Alzheimer's disease' section, first sentence - the phrase should read "amyloid-containing plaques and neurofibrillary tangles".
 5. 'Alzheimer's disease' section - define CRT.
paper_title_zh: 年龄相关疾病中肌酸补充的综述：不仅仅是运动员的补充剂
paper_abstract_zh: 肌酸是一种由精氨酸、甘氨酸和蛋氨酸合成的内源性化合物。这种膳食补充剂可以通过食物来源如肉类和鱼类以及运动员补充粉获得。由于大部分肌酸储存在骨骼肌中，膳食肌酸补充剂传统上对运动员和健美者来说非常重要，可以增加骨骼肌的力量、强度和质量。然而，肌酸的新用途已经出现，表明它可能在预防或延缓与衰老相关的神经退行性疾病的发作中起重要作用。平均而言，到80岁时，肌肉质量会减少30%，而肌肉无力仍然是老年人丧失独立性的重要原因。鉴于肌酸的这些新作用，该膳食补充剂的使用已被研究，以确定其在治疗充血性心力衰竭、回旋状萎缩、胰岛素不敏感、癌症和高胆固醇中的有效性。在与大脑相关的研究中，肌酸已被证明具有抗氧化特性，减少精神疲劳，保护大脑免受神经毒性，并改善抑郁症和双相情感障碍等神经疾病的各个方面。这些益处的结合使肌酸成为对抗帕金森病、亨廷顿病、肌萎缩侧索硬化症、与阿尔茨海默病进展相关的长期记忆障碍和中风等与年龄相关疾病的主要候选药物。在这篇综述中，我们探讨了肌酸产生的正常机制及其必要的生理学，同时特别关注肌酸补充剂在改善与大脑衰老相关的疾病和障碍中的重要性，并概述了涉及肌酸治疗这些疾病的临床试验。
review_content_zh:
这是对肌酸及其在急性和慢性神经退行性疾病中可能有益作用文献的坚实贡献。

我有一个主要评论和一些次要问题：

主要评论：手稿没有，但应该，在一定程度上处理肌酸补充可能产生的副作用。特别是由于拟进行干预的人群主要是老年人和重病患者。一个段落说明这一点及可能的副作用应该足够。

次要问题：
1. “帕金森病”部分，第二段，第七句，请在“results”前插入“not”。
2. “肌萎缩侧索硬化症”部分，第二段，SOD-1是细胞质的，因此不仅线粒体蛋白会受到影响。这一段应修改以反映这一点。
3. “长期记忆”部分，第三句，我会用另一个词替换“dramatic”，因为研究结果中很少发生戏剧性变化。
4. “阿尔茨海默病”部分，第一句——该短语应读作“含淀粉样蛋白的斑块和神经纤维缠结”。
5. “阿尔茨海默病”部分——定义CRT。

paper_title: Rational use of SARS-CoV-2 polymerase chain reaction tests within institutions caring for the vulnerable
paper_abstract: Institutions such as hospitals and nursing or long-stay residential homes accommodate individuals at considerable risk of mortality should they acquire SARS-CoV-2 infection. In these settings, polymerase chain reaction tests play a central role in infection prevention and control. Here, we argue that both false negative and false positive tests are possible and that careful consideration of the prior probability of infection and of test characteristics are needed to prevent harm. We outline evidence suggesting that regular systematic testing of asymptomatic and pre-symptomatic individuals could play an important role in reducing transmission of SARS-CoV-2 within institutions. We discuss how such a programme might be organised, arguing that frequent testing and rapid reporting of results are particularly important. We highlight studies demonstrating that polymerase chain reaction testing of pooled samples can be undertaken with acceptable loss of sensitivity, and advocate such an approach where test capacity is limited. We provide an approach to calculating the most efficient pool size. Given the current limitations of tests for SARS-CoV-2 infection, physical distancing and meticulous infection prevention and control will remain essential in institutions caring for vulnerable people.
review_content:
Yates et al. discuss the current and highly topical issue of infection prevention control in institutional care facilities, focusing on the benefits of high frequency surveillance of asymptomatic and pre-symptomatic individuals, on absenteeism and infection prevention control. The article covers a range of important considerations, including sampling strategies (self-swabbing and saliva collection), testing strategies in particular pooling of samples, result interpretation given different population prevalence, and organisational considerations for implementing such a strategy. This article discusses how the pooling of samples might overcome the current capacity issues when implementing a high frequency mass screening strategy, given current constraints with NHS testing capacity to deliver screening programmes for large numbers of staff or patients.

A number of papers on screening programmes in healthcare workers show high rates of nosocomial acquisition in staff who were ‘COVID-facing’. Much of this occurred in the early part of the pandemic in the UK before the introduction of universal PPE, with individuals looking after elderly patients or those with atypical COVID-19 presentations in the early part of the pandemic, leading to mode of acquisition in line with the reference quoted (89% of infections in healthcare workers may be a result of nosocomial transmission). However, following the introduction of universal PPE, the literature also documents high rates of staff to staff transmission in non-patient facing areas likely due to a failure of staff to socially distance away from clinical areas. In a study of over 10000 healthcare workers in an acute Trust the greatest risk of staff infection was associated with having a Covid-19 infected contact in the household (eLife 2020;9:e60675 DOI: 10.7554/eLife.60675)1. Most Healthcare settings are now seeing lower rates of nosocomial and staff to staff transmission, given universal mask wearing in the UK. The authors’ intended audience is those designing testing strategies in health and social care settings, however, a number of the strategies discussed also have broader application for mass screening in lower prevalence settings such as workplaces and educational facilities. Expanding local/regional access to testing, testing capacity, improving turnaround time, maintaining analytic performance appropriate for the setting and population prevalence will contribute importantly to the current national effort to curb the pandemic.

Comments to address:
Turnaround times – a key factor in high frequency testing, including pre-shift testing, is short turnaround times. How does a pooling strategy effect this – it seems unlikely that the necessary turnaround times (i.e. results before returning for the next shift) could be met if samples are being analysed in a laboratory setting and repeat testing of individual samples from a positive pool is required. See: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC7325181/.2 Other assay formats could be considered such as point-of-care nucleic acid LAMP and rapid antigen tests – but given reduced sensitivity in comparison with laboratory based PCR assays modelling with respect to population prevalence would need to be carefully considered.

Referencing: The COVID literature is expanding at an exponential rate. As with much of current COVID literature, many papers already exist on similar topics, the context of this opinion article within the current literature isn’t clear in places, with some citations lacking. This article would benefit from a more thorough literature review in the following areas:
 1. Sample pooling is already used in a number of settings, with CDC guidance on the topic (https://www.cdc.gov/coronavirus/2019-ncov/lab/pooling-procedures.html). The widespread use isn’t represented in this paper, with only 1 reference. There are a number of other papers discussing pooling samples, more accurate representation of current literature is needed.
 2. Testing of saliva – there are multiple recent papers on this topic.

Please clarify this paragraph: '…high rates of false negative tests are seen when the prevalence of infection is high, and when the sensitivity of the test is low. The proportion of health and social care workers who have positive test results should be monitored with these data, ideally, disaggregated by symptoms. Where this proportion is high, there will be an unacceptable false negative rate and institutions should consider asking symptomatic staff to self isolate regardless of their test result.’ – when what proportion is high? The proportion of symptomatic vs asymptomatic? Proportion testing positive?

Serology: “Such a test could also identify individuals that would no longer need to be included in asymptomatic staff testing programmes” – this assumes that we know whether these individuals can be re-infected and still shed/transmit virus. The SIREN project (SARS-CoV-2 Immunity & REinfection EvaluatioN) includes those previously infected so we can gain a better understanding of what having evidence of previous exposure means with respect to re-infection.

The article would benefit from a discussion of the information technology constraints – these are huge. Patient/sample identification at the point of test, sample labelling with barcodes allowing easier run-through processes in diagnostic laboratories, IT to support pooling/separation of pools, result notification to allow responses on an individual level and for contact tracing.

Conclusion
At the time of writing this review (September 2020) the UK government is promising mass coronavirus testing (‘operation Moonshot’) but the technology to deliver this does not yet exist. It is vitally important to consider how mass-surveillance testing could be rolled out in institutional care settings. The pace at which testing is required to move forwards is unprecedented compared with anything we have seen before, and this opinion piece with its careful consideration of testing utility at different levels of population prevalence and assay sensitivity will be a useful article.
paper_title_zh: "脆弱人群照护机构内SARS-CoV-2聚合酶链反应检测的合理使用"
paper_abstract_zh: 医院、护理机构或长期居住的养老院等机构容纳了若感染SARS-CoV-2则面临显著死亡风险的个体。在这些环境中，聚合酶链反应（PCR）检测在感染预防和控制中扮演着核心角色。本文指出，假阴性和假阳性检测结果均有可能出现，因此需要仔细考虑感染的先验概率和检测特性，以防止造成伤害。我们概述了证据，表明对无症状和潜伏期症状个体进行定期系统性检测，可能在减少机构内SARS-CoV-2传播方面发挥重要作用。我们讨论了如何组织此类检测计划，强调频繁检测和快速报告结果尤为重要。我们突出了研究表明，对合并样本进行聚合酶链反应检测可以在可接受的灵敏度损失范围内进行，并倡导在检测能力有限的情况下采用这种方法。我们提供了一种计算最有效池大小的方法。鉴于当前SARS-CoV-2感染检测的局限性，物理隔离和细致的感染预防和控制措施在照顾弱势人群的机构中仍至关重要。
review_content_zh:
Yates等人讨论了当前在机构护理设施中备受关注的感染预防控制问题，重点关注对无症状和潜伏期个体的高频监测、缺勤以及感染预防控制的好处。文章涵盖了一系列重要考虑因素，包括采样策略（自我拭子和唾液收集）、特别是样本池化的检测策略、不同人群流行率下的结果解释，以及实施此类策略的组织考虑。本文讨论了在当前NHS检测能力受限的情况下，样本池化如何克服在实施高频大规模筛查策略时的容量问题，以便为大量员工或患者提供筛查计划。

一些关于医护人员筛查计划的文章显示，在“面对COVID”的员工中，医院内感染率很高。这种情况大多发生在英国大流行早期，在引入通用个人防护装备（PPE）之前，个体在照顾老年患者或在大流行早期表现出非典型COVID-19症状的患者时，感染方式与引用的参考文献一致（89%的医护人员感染可能是医院内传播的结果）。然而，在引入通用PPE之后，文献还记录了在非患者接触区域，员工之间的传播率也很高，这可能是由于员工在临床区域外未能保持社交距离所致。在一项针对超过10000名急性信托医护人员的调查中，员工感染的最大风险与家庭中有COVID-19感染接触者相关（eLife 2020;9:e60675 DOI: 10.7554/eLife.60675）1。鉴于英国普遍佩戴口罩，大多数医疗环境现在看到的医院内和员工之间的传播率较低。作者的预期读者是那些在健康和社会护理环境中设计检测策略的人，然而，所讨论的许多策略也适用于低流行率环境中的大规模筛查，如工作场所和教育设施。扩大本地/区域检测访问、检测能力、提高周转时间、保持适合环境和人群流行率的分析性能，将有助于当前国家遏制大流行的努力。

需要解决的评论：
周转时间——高频检测（包括换班前检测）的一个关键因素是短周转时间。池化策略如何影响这一点——如果样本在实验室环境中进行分析，并且需要重复检测阳性池中的单个样本，似乎不太可能满足必要的周转时间（即在下一次换班前获得结果）。参见：https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC7325181/。2 其他检测格式可以考虑，如现场核酸LAMP和快速抗原检测——但鉴于与实验室PCR检测相比灵敏度降低，建模时需要仔细考虑人群流行率。

参考文献：COVID文献正在以指数级速度增长。与当前许多COVID文献一样，已经存在许多关于类似主题的论文，这篇观点文章在当前文献中的背景在某些地方并不清晰，缺乏一些引用。本文将从更全面的文献综述中受益，特别是在以下领域：
1. 样本池化已经在多个环境中使用，CDC有相关指南（https://www.cdc.gov/coronavirus/2019-ncov/lab/pooling-procedures.html）。本文未体现其广泛使用，仅引用了1篇参考文献。还有其他多篇讨论样本池化的论文，需要更准确地反映当前文献。
2. 唾液检测——近期有多篇关于这一主题的论文。

请澄清以下段落：“……当感染流行率高且检测灵敏度低时，会出现高比例的假阴性检测结果。应监测健康和社会护理工作人员的阳性检测结果比例，理想情况下，按症状进行分解。当这一比例很高时，将存在不可接受的假阴性率，机构应考虑要求有症状的员工无论检测结果如何都进行自我隔离。”——当什么比例高？症状与无症状的比例？检测阳性的比例？

血清学：“此类检测还可以识别不再需要纳入无症状员工检测计划的人员”——这假设我们知道这些个体是否会被再次感染并仍能脱落/传播病毒。SIREN项目（SARS-CoV-2免疫与再感染评估）包括那些之前感染过的人，以便我们更好地了解有既往暴露证据对再感染意味着什么。

本文将从讨论信息技术限制中受益——这些限制是巨大的。在检测点的患者/样本识别、带有条形码的样本标签以便在诊断实验室中更容易地进行流程操作、支持池化/分离池的IT系统、结果通知以允许在个体层面和接触者追踪上进行响应。

结论
在撰写本评论时（2020年9月），英国政府承诺进行大规模冠状病毒检测（“月球射击行动”），但实现这一目标的技术尚不存在。考虑如何在机构护理环境中推广大规模监测检测至关重要。与以往我们所见相比，检测所需的推进速度是前所未有的，这篇观点文章仔细考虑了在不同人群流行率和检测灵敏度水平下的检测效用，将是一篇有用的文章。

reasons: As with much of current COVID literature, many papers already exist on similar topics, the context of this opinion article within the current literature isn’t clear in places, with some citations lacking.
The article would benefit from a discussion of the information technology constraints – these are huge.

The SIREN project (SARS-CoV-2 Immunity & REinfection EvaluatioN) includes those previously infected so we can gain a better understanding of what having evidence of previous exposure means with respect to re-infection.

Please clarify this paragraph: '…high rates of false negative tests are seen when the prevalence of infection is high, and when the sensitivity of the test is low. The proportion of health and social care workers who have positive test results should be monitored with these data, ideally, disaggregated by symptoms. Where this proportion is high, there will be an unacceptable false negative rate and institutions should consider asking symptomatic staff to self isolate regardless of their test result.’ – when what proportion is high?
The proportion of symptomatic vs asymptomatic?
Proportion testing positive?

paper_title: EPHect – the Endometriosis Phenome (and Biobanking) Harmonisation Project – may be very helpful for clinicians and the women they are treating
paper_abstract: This article acts as a summary of the recently published papers by the World Endometriosis Research Foundation aiming to set up the Endometriosis Phenome and Biobanking Harmonisation Project.  The objective of this project is to standardise recording of patient history and characteristics, recording of surgical procedure and extent of disease as well as collection, processing and storage of specimens and consequently create a reliable resource for research into endometriosis.
review_content:
This review article is a timely ‘call-to-arms’ to clinicians caring for women suffering from endometriosis world-wide to utilise the Endometriosis Phenome and Biobanking Harmonisation Project (EPHect).

Published by the World Endometriosis Research Foundation (WERF) in 2014, EPHect provides a fundamental framework for collaborative international endometriosis research through global standardization of phenotypic data compilation and biological sample collection and storage.

Concerned that the uptake of the EPHect has be sporadic and not uniform, the authors believe that the collection of “standardized detailed information”, using the standard surgical form (EPHect SSF) and standard endometriosis patient questionnaire (EPQ-S), should be ‘non-negotiable’ whenever surgery is undertaken for endometriosis.

In practice, there are a number of challenges to the uptake of the EPHect which this review article has not addressed. Firstly, the time taken for busy clinicians and surgeons to complete the standard surgical form (SSF) is a potential impediment. Secondly, the completion of the standard endometriosis patient questionnaire (EPQ-S) or the minimum (EPG-M) by patient also requires motivation and time. Thirdly, the storage of the large amount of paper-based information is space-consuming. Fourthly, the transfer of information collected onto an electronic database is time-consuming, with privacy coding an issue. Finally, the storage, extraction, collation and analysis of data for the purpose of collaborative international research is likely going to be an expensive endeavour.
paper_title_zh: 子宫内膜异位症表型（及生物样本库）协调项目（EPHect）——可能对临床医生及其治疗的女性患者非常有帮助
paper_abstract_zh: 本文总结了世界子宫内膜异位症研究基金会最近发表的论文，旨在建立子宫内膜异位症表型与生物样本库协调项目。该项目的目标是标准化患者病史和特征的记录、手术过程和疾病范围的记录，以及样本的收集、处理和储存，从而为子宫内膜异位症的研究创建一个可靠的资源。
review_content_zh:
这篇综述文章是及时地向全球范围内照顾子宫内膜异位症女性的临床医生发出的“行动号召”，呼吁他们利用子宫内膜异位症表型与生物样本库协调项目（EPHect）。

由世界子宫内膜异位症研究基金会（WERF）于2014年发布的EPHect，为通过全球标准化表型数据汇编和生物样本收集与储存的国际合作子宫内膜异位症研究提供了一个基本框架。

作者担心EPHect的采用一直零星且不统一，认为在为子宫内膜异位症进行手术时，使用标准手术表（EPHect SSF）和标准子宫内膜异位症患者问卷（EPQ-S）收集“标准化详细信息”应该是“不容商榷”的。

在实践中，采用EPHect存在一些挑战，而这篇综述文章并未涉及。首先，繁忙的临床医生和外科医生填写标准手术表（SSF）所需的时间是一个潜在的障碍。其次，患者完成标准子宫内膜异位症患者问卷（EPQ-S）或最小问卷（EPG-M）也需要动力和时间。第三，大量纸质信息的存储占用空间。第四，将收集到的信息转移到电子数据库是耗时的，且隐私编码是一个问题。最后，为国际合作研究目的而进行的数据存储、提取、整理和分析很可能是一项昂贵的努力。

reasons: In practice, there are a number of challenges to the uptake of the EPHect which this review article has not addressed.
Firstly, the time taken for busy clinicians and surgeons to complete the standard surgical form (SSF) is a potential impediment.
Secondly, the completion of the standard endometriosis patient questionnaire (EPQ-S) or the minimum (EPG-M) by patient also requires motivation and time.
Thirdly, the storage of the large amount of paper-based information is space-consuming.
Fourthly, the transfer of information collected onto an electronic database is time-consuming, with privacy coding an issue.
Finally, the storage, extraction, collation and analysis of data for the purpose of collaborative international research is likely going to be an expensive endeavour.

This paper offers a clear and comprehensible recapitulation of the standard surgical forms and standard endometriosis patient questionnaires to facilitate their use by the clinicians in the clinical practice.
