paper_title: Harmful effects of microplastic pollution on health of animals. A Literature Review
paper_abstract: Background.Environmental pollution by microplastics is a global problem that has arisen from the extensive production and use of plastics. Small particles of different types plastic with a diameter of less than 5 mm are found around the globe in water, air, soil, and various living organisms. An individual constantly absorbs microplastics with water and food, inhales with air. Therefore, an important issue of microplastic environmental pollution is whether it poses a risk to human health. Objectives:Experimental studies of the potential health risks of microplastic are now under the undoubted scientific interest.
review_content: Reviewer 1 Dear Nicolas, Thank you for the hard work with our article. We are very grateful to you for your comments and remarks. Without any doubt, they helped to make our work better and made it possible to pay attention to the shortcomings. We tried to take them into consideration in case to rework some mentioned points and hope that this will make it possible to publish our article. Please let us answer to your comments in details: Basic reporting The english language and writing quality is unequal along the paper. The introduction especially needs particular attention: L51 "The" term plastic – corrected to «The term "plastics"…» L57 1mm thick – corrected to «…of 1 mm thick plastic fragment …» L82 "different classes of animals" or "differentanimals" – corrected to «… of different animals …» L93: terms «soil», «air», «water», or «ocean» were used in the query – corrected to «…terms «soil», «air», «water», or «ocean» were used in the query» L114 microparticles of any polymer type – corrected to «…microparticles of any polymer types» L140 I suggest “Microplastics Environmental pollution” – corrected to «Microplastics environmental pollution» L323 define ICR at first occurrence – ICR is the common name for a mice strain, it is not defined. This name is derived from the place where mice were bred - Institute of Cancer Research in the USA. Literature is sometimes missing or not cited early enough. L165 References for the content of plastics in River? – added link to article (Sarijan et al., 2021) L176 reference of the article in sweden? – added link to article (Scheurer & Bigalke, 2018) L180 reference for the MP in the air? – added link to article (Dris et al., 2016) L211 refernce for the MP amount per year– added link to article (Danopoulus et al., 2020) L213, is this a percentage you calculated among all studies ? Or did you fin in a review? – this is data from literature. Corrected to «According to Kwon et al. (2020) more than 50% of the MP…» L239 Give the name of the review in the first sentence of the paragraph – we added references to Barboza et al., (2019) in the first sentence of this paragraph. The structure is globally fine. Some minor change could be made: L72. I recommend you first introduce the plastic composition with main polymers and additives and then the properties. – we’ve done it. L.201 I would present the MP in food and finish with the human feces and placenta – we’ve done it. The review is of broad and cross-disciplinary interest and within the scope of the journal. The field been reviewed recently. I suggest the authors focus on the plastic content in animals and the potential effects - Before describing the effect of plastic on animal health, we want that readers understand how much microplastic in environment and that this problem affects everyone. Additional figures and discussion would increase the interest for the review L260, add a table and/or figure to describe the effects in fish – «Figure 1. Effects of microplastics on fishes» added L331 discuss the applied doses and related effects in comparison with the environmental content in the matrices (soil, water) and animals you describe previously – a comparison with the content of microplastics in natural water bodies and with estimates of human MP consumption has been added. L337 It would be nice to have a figure to summarize the effects on mice – «Figure 2. Effects of microplastics on mice and rats» added Please also discuss other factors leading to toxicity that are not yet tested, for example the transport of sorbed contaminants or pathogens on the plastic particles and the degradation stage of the plastic. – “However, the data obtained are ambiguous and fragmented. Some parameters of microplastics that can influence its effects, such as transport of sorbed contaminants or pathogens on the plastic particles and the degradation stage of the plastic, have not been studied. Therefore, further research further research in this area is required.” added The title should be much more specific as the subject developed by the authors is clearly the effect of microplastics in animals.- changed name to " Harmful effects of microplastics pollution on animals health " Experimental design The Methods are not described with sufficient detail & information. L96 How many original papers and reviews were published on these topics?- added information about the number of publications: «…over the past 5 years from 2017 to 2021, 3569 publications were revealed in PubMed for the query "microplastic pollution", 584 belong to reviews, systematic reviews and meta-analysis. Accordingly, for the query "microplastic food" were found 986 publications and 194 of them were reviews, for the query "microplastic human" - 1040 and 292 respectively.»; «Over the past 5 years in PubMed there were more than 700 publications concerning the effects of microplastic only on fishes, 73 were reviews». L118 Why studies until 2017 are selected if you say you analysed from January 1st, 2010 onwards? – We provide a search from 2010 to 2021, but the earliest article that corresponds with our criteria was published in 2017. We’ve added the information in this section. Validity of the findings L65. Why would you include “particles formed as the result of automobile tires wear, some types of road surface” as primary MP. I doubt small plastic particles are deliberately created in these case. – According to literature data, “particles formed as the result of automobile tires wear, some types of road surface” is classified as primary microplastic. As to Boucher, J. and Friot D. (2017) “tyres and road markings are the major sources of primary microplastics” (Boucher, J. and Friot D. (2017). Primary Microplastics in the Oceans: A Global Evaluation of Sources. Gland, Switzerland: IUCN. 43pp.; p.11). However, the classification of microplastics is not the purpose of our review. Therefore, we removed the mention of tires and road surface from the article. L72. I suggest you also mention physical properties such as elasticity and shear strength. These properties will depend on the plastic polymers so I recommend you first introduce the plastic composition with main polymers and additives and then the properties. – «elasticity and shear strength» were added. L133 for water, dissolved sea salt and honey I would be surprise a digestion step would have been included. Pease check and give references. – water, sea salt and honey may contain natural polymers that make it difficult to study microplastics. Therefore, even in the study of water, a digestion step is included. «This method can be used for the analysis of plastic debris as suspended solids in water samples… The solids are subjected to wet peroxide oxidation (WPO) in the presence of a Fe(II) catalyst to digest labile organic matter» (Masura, J., et al. 2015. Laboratory methods for the analysis of microplastics in the marine environment: recommendations for quantifying synthetic particles in waters and sediments. NOAA Technical Memorandum NOS-OR&R-48.) «Eight commercial brands of sea salt… Thirty percent H2O2 (Merck, India) and distilled water were used for the digestion of organic compounds and salt dissolution, respectively…» (Seth CK, Shriwastav A. Contamination of Indian sea salts with microplastics and a potential prevention strategy. Environ Sci Pollut Res Int. 2018 Oct;25(30):30122-30131. doi: 10.1007/s11356-018-3028-5.), «Liquid honeys… Erlenmeyer beaker treated with 30% H2O2…» (Liebezeit G, Liebezeit E. Non-pollen particulates in honey and sugar. Food Addit Contam Part A Chem Anal Control Expo Risk Assess. 2013;30(12):2136-40. doi: 10.1080/19440049.2013.843025.) The technique is described in review Kwon et al. (2020), therefore, additional references were not added to the article. L137 I don’t think you mean “Then” may be “alternatively”: spectral method (FTIR or Raman) and visual counting give both the number of MP - FT-IR and Raman spectroscopy are methods for determining the chemical composition of a sample from the spectrum of light reflection or scattering. These methods cannot determine the number of particles in a sample. The number of particles is counted on the microscope image. Particle counting can be carried out on images obtained in the IR spectrum on a microscore with built-in FT-IR analysis. But particle counting is not part of the FT-IR study. L182 I would not consider cellulose fibers as MP – «The term "plastics" refers to any materials based on synthetic or natural high molecular weight compounds – polymers». Сellulose meets the definition of plastic. However, our review is focused on synthetic plastics. Therefore, we excluded cellulose from the article. Additional comments I thank the authors for their review of this very interesting topic. The authors describe the potential for microplastic in animals and expected harmful consequences. I suggest to define better the scope of the review, in the title and introduction. Annotated manuscript The reviewer has also provided an annotated manuscript as part of their review - all edits have been done
paper_title_zh: 微塑料污染对动物健康的有害影响：文献综述
paper_abstract_zh: 背景：由塑料的广泛生产和使用引发的环境微塑料污染已成为一个全球性问题。直径小于5毫米的不同类型塑料小颗粒在全球范围内的水、空气、土壤以及各种生物体中被发现。个体不断通过水和食物吸收微塑料，并通过空气吸入。因此，微塑料环境污染的一个重要问题是它是否对人类健康构成风险。目标：对微塑料潜在健康风险的实验研究目前无疑引起了科学界的关注。
review_content_zh:
审稿人1

亲爱的尼古拉斯：

感谢您对我们文章的辛勤工作。我们非常感激您提供的评论和意见。毫无疑问，这些评论和意见帮助我们的工作得到了改进，并使我们能够注意到其中的不足之处。我们尽力考虑这些意见，以重新修改一些提到的要点，并希望这能使我们的文章得以发表。请允许我们详细回答您的评论：

基本报告

文章中的英语语言和写作质量不均衡。特别是引言部分需要特别关注：
L51 “The” term plastic – 已更正为「The term "plastics"…」
L57 1mm thick – 已更正为「…of 1 mm thick plastic fragment …」
L82 "different classes of animals" 或 "differentanimals" – 已更正为「… of different animals …」
L93: 术语「soil」、「air」、「water」或「ocean」在查询中使用 – 已更正为「…terms 「soil」、「air」、「water」或「ocean」 were used in the query」
L114 microparticles of any polymer type – 已更正为「…microparticles of any polymer types」
L140 我建议“Microplastics Environmental pollution” – 已更正为「Microplastics environmental pollution」
L323 首次出现时定义ICR – ICR是一种小鼠品系的常用名称，未定义。该名称源自小鼠培育地——美国癌症研究所。
文献有时缺失或引用不够及时。
L165 河流中塑料含量的参考文献？ – 已添加文章链接（Sarijan等，2021）
L176 瑞典文章的参考文献？ – 已添加文章链接（Scheurer & Bigalke，2018）
L180 空气中MP的参考文献？ – 已添加文章链接（Dris等，2016）
L211 每年MP数量的参考文献 – 已添加文章链接（Danopoulus等，2020）
L213，这是您在所有研究中计算出的百分比吗？还是您在综述中找到的？ – 这是文献中的数据。已更正为「According to Kwon et al. (2020) more than 50% of the MP…」
L239 在段落的第一句给出综述的名称 – 我们在该段落的第一句添加了Barboza等（2019）的参考文献。

结构总体良好。可以进行一些小的修改：
L72. 我建议您首先介绍塑料的组成，包括主要聚合物和添加剂，然后再介绍其性质。 – 我们已按此修改。
L.201 我建议您先介绍食品中的MP，最后再介绍人类粪便和胎盘中的MP。 – 我们已按此修改。

该综述具有广泛和跨学科的兴趣，且在期刊范围内。该领域最近已有综述。我建议作者重点关注动物体内的塑料含量及其潜在影响 – 在描述塑料对动物健康的影响之前，我们希望读者了解环境中微塑料的量，以及这个问题影响到每个人。
额外的图表和讨论将增加综述的兴趣

paper_title: Exploring the anti-aging potential of natural products and plant extracts in budding yeast Saccharomyces cerevisiae: A review
paper_abstract: Historically, plant derived natural products and their crude extracts have been used to treat a wide range of ailments across the world. Biogerontology research aims to explore the molecular basis of aging and discover new anti-aging therapeutic compounds or formulations to combat the detrimental effects of aging and promote a healthy life span. The budding yeast Saccharomyces cerevisiae has been, and continues to be, an indispensable model organism in the field of biomedical research for discovering the molecular basis of aging S. cerevisiae has preserved nutritional signaling pathways (such as the target of rapamycin (TOR)-Sch9 and the Ras-AC-PKA (cAMP-dependent protein kinase) pathways, and shows two distinct aging paradigms chronological life span (CLS) and replicative life span (RLS). This review explores the anti-aging properties of natural products, predominantly derived from plants, and phytoextracts using S. cerevisiae as a model organism.
review_content:
The authors may want to consider more precise and directional adjectives, such as enhance, suppress, augment, alleviate, etc. Use of the word ‘ameliorate’ to qualify various biological effects, seemed vague, inconsistent, and sometimes incorrect. My suggestion would be to carefully proof-read again for grammar in places but also for biological clarity, for example, about relationships between TOR signaling and respiration.

Overall, I thought the review topic was very interesting - the authors have assembled a collection of papers about natural products (NPs) where biological activities have been studied using paradigms (RLS and CLS) of yeast aging.

The abstract and introduction could be greatly enhanced by removing much of the philosophical and physiological descriptions of aging, how it's fundamental to several diseases, and the utility and experimental benefits of model organisms, all of which have been made many times and are thus an unnecessary distraction. If condensed to a couple sentences and citations there would be much space cleared to focus more on the topic at hand which is already very rich and extensive and could stand to be expanded upon and further detailed.

Fig. 1 is awkward IMO (in a BioRender sort of way) and it's not really needed. To regain that space and maintain reader attention, a simple brief description of RLS and CLS would do (with just a few of many possible citations that could support the rare reader who may not be already familiar).

It would be helpful to organize the paper according to which NPs were studied in the context of RLS, CLS, or both. The models are quite different, though they involve related mechanisms as the authors point out. Clarifying and distinguishing (or unifying) between the RLS/CLS models over the course of the MS would be of interest (more to come on this and other factors that could be better organized in order to increase the impact of the work).

Fig. 2 is helpful, but should be expanded with regard to the genes and pathways (and the page space) and doesn't need to be rendered as an actual cell if removing the picturesque constraints of the cell and organelles would provide more flexibility to communicate important information about the literature.

The "conserved nutrient sensing aging regulatory pathways" section is critical and could be expanded substantially. "Conserved" presumably means "between" yeast and humans? This section seems woefully under-cited. If possible, all of the genes mentioned in the NP papers should be incorporated into this section and Fig. 2 and related to one another, which would ultimately help to relate the NPs to each other regarding their influences on cellular aging. There is an opportunity here to relate the yeast pathways to the human pathways (i.e. to relate the conserved pathways), and ultimately to suggest how some of the NPs, which influence yeast aging, could be related to benefits they are thought to putatively have in humans. I think that opportunity wasn't really capitalized on but would be great if the authors could. This would provide demonstrations for the significance of the topic and the importance of the review as a starting point to increase knowledge about relationships between NPs, yeast aging models, and human age-related disease.

The "Anti-Aging studies "of NPs" in S. cerevisiae" section should mention NPs in the section subtitle (just for clarity).

Rather than just a list of NPs - this section would be much more useful if organized by important factors. I'm not sure exactly how to do it, but a table would very helpful for handling this aspect. Strategies that could be used to organize this section include alphabetical order, whether influences are on CLS, RLS, or both; class of compounds; relevant sources of the compounds (foods, alternative medicines, natural metabolism, microbiome, etc); whether they have known or suspected effects on human health; MOA or genes and pathways they are thought to act or interact with; whether the NPs are easily obtained for research purposes (i.e. where to buy them); other factors that the authors may be aware of.

A table that synthesizes and distills the important factors relevant to each NP should be created (as also suggested by Reviewer 1). The table should have a field dedicated to each factor (see a few suggestions in paragraph above) and have concise record entries for each NP - one of the fields should be for the references for convenient lookup of information in the table context. If provided as a spreadsheet, it would be particularly useful.

Just my personal opinion, but I didn't see how descriptions of the advantages of yeast, emerging trends, cutting edge techniques, or future directions would be as helpful as more detail and better organization about the NPs, in-depth summary about the literature where yeast have been used to study them, and if possible where they are are also relevant to human and/or specific age-related diseases.

About "conclusions drawn being 'partly' supported" there can be large effects on CLS deriving from differing auxotrophic background of yeasts strain and media recipes. Things like glucose concentration, whether the media is buffered, amino acid compositions, the presence of ammonium sulfate, rich vs. synthetic/defined media, the list goes on. The interactions between the NPs and genetic background was discussed in the review, but these same types of interactions exist with auxotrophic mutations and media composition (which can vary dramatically between studies). This fact should be briefly mentioned in the manuscript and ideally accounted for in the proposed table by indicating the strain, auxotrophic background and media used in the studies employing particular NPs. Additives like H2O2 that are used to enhance characterization are mentioned in places and could also be accounted for in the table.

I appreciate the authors' efforts and insights hope they find this feedback useful.
paper_title_zh: 探索天然产物和植物提取物在酿酒酵母（Saccharomyces cerevisiae）中的抗衰老潜力：综述
paper_abstract_zh: 历史上，植物来源的天然产物及其粗提物在全球范围内被用于治疗多种疾病。生物老年学研究旨在探索衰老的分子基础，并发现新的抗衰老治疗化合物或配方，以对抗衰老的有害影响并促进健康寿命。酿酒酵母（Saccharomyces cerevisiae）一直是，并且继续是生物医学研究领域中探索衰老分子基础不可或缺的模型生物。酿酒酵母保留了营养信号通路（如雷帕霉素靶蛋白（TOR）-Sch9和Ras-AC-PKA（cAMP依赖性蛋白激酶）通路），并表现出两种不同的衰老范式：时序寿命（CLS）和复制寿命（RLS）。本综述利用酿酒酵母作为模型生物，探讨了主要源自植物的天然产物和植物提取物的抗衰老特性。
review_content_zh:
以下是对review_content的中文翻译，力求保持学术性和准确性：

作者可能需要考虑使用更精确和具有方向性的形容词，例如“增强”、“抑制”、“增加”、“缓解”等。使用“改善”一词来描述各种生物效应，显得模糊、不一致，有时甚至不正确。我的建议是再次仔细校对语法，同时确保生物学的清晰性，例如关于TOR信号通路与呼吸作用之间的关系。

总体而言，我认为这篇综述的主题非常有趣——作者汇集了一系列关于天然产物（NPs）的论文，其中生物活性已通过酵母衰老的范式（RLS和CLS）进行了研究。

摘要和引言可以通过删除大量关于衰老的哲学和生理学描述、其与多种疾病的基本关系以及模式生物的实用性和实验优势等内容而得到显著提升，这些内容已被多次提及，因此是不必要的干扰。如果将其精简为几句话并附上引用，将为手头的话题腾出更多空间，该话题本身已经非常丰富和广泛，可以进一步扩展和详细阐述。

在我看来，图1显得有些尴尬（类似于BioRender的风格），而且并非真正必要。为了重新获得这部分空间并保持读者的注意力，简单简要地描述RLS和CLS即可（只需引用少数几个可能的参考文献，以支持那些可能不太熟悉的罕见读者）。

根据NPs在RLS、CLS或两者背景下的研究情况来组织论文会很有帮助。尽管这些模型涉及相关机制，但它们确实存在显著差异。在全文中澄清和区分（或统一）RLS/CLS模型将是有趣的（关于这一点及其他可以更好地组织以增加工作影响力的因素，后续会有更多讨论）。

图2很有帮助，但应扩展关于基因和通路的内容（以及页面空间），并且不需要将其渲染为实际细胞，如果去除细胞和细胞器的图像约束，将提供更多灵活性来传达关于文献的重要信息。

“保守的营养感知衰老调控通路”这一部分至关重要，可以大幅扩展。“保守”一词大概是指“酵母和人类之间”？这一部分似乎引用严重不足。如果可能的话，所有在NP论文中提到的基因都应纳入这一部分和图2，并相互关联，这将最终有助于将NPs彼此关联起来，探讨它们对细胞衰老的影响。这里有一个机会可以将酵母通路与人类通路联系起来（即关联保守通路），并最终提出一些影响酵母衰老的NPs可能与其在人类中假定的益处相关。我认为这个机会没有被充分利用，但如果作者能够做到这一点，将非常出色。这将展示该主题的重要性以及本综述作为起点在增加关于NPs、酵母衰老模型和人类年龄相关疾病之间关系知识方面的重要性。

“NPs在S. cerevisiae中的抗衰老研究”部分应在小标题中提及NPs（仅为清晰起见）。

与其仅仅列出NPs，这一部分如果按重要因素组织将更有用。我不确定具体如何操作，但一个表格将非常有助于处理这一方面。可以用来组织这一部分的方法包括按字母顺序、影响是针对CLS、RLS还是两者；化合物类别；相关化合物来源（食物、替代药物、自然代谢、微生物组等）；它们是否对人类健康有已知或疑似影响；作用机制或其被认为作用的基因和通路；NPs是否易于获取用于研究目的（即从哪里购买）；以及作者可能了解的其他因素。

应创建一个表格，综合和提炼与每个NP相关的重要因素（正如审稿人1所建议的）。该表格应为每个因素设置一个字段（见上文几条建议），并为每个NP提供简洁的记录条目——其中一个字段应为参考文献，以便在表格上下文中方便查找信息。如果以电子表格形式提供，将特别有用。

这只是我的个人意见，但我认为描述酵母的优势、新兴趋势、尖端技术或未来方向并不如更详细和更好地组织NPs、深入总结使用酵母研究它们的文献，以及如果可能的话，它们也与人类和/或特定年龄相关疾病相关的内容来得有用。

关于“结论被‘部分’支持”的问题，酵母菌株的营养缺陷背景和培养基配方差异可能会对CLS产生重大影响。诸如葡萄糖浓度、培养基是否缓冲、氨基酸组成、硫酸铵的存在、丰富培养基与合成/定义培养基等，不胜枚举。综述中讨论了NPs与遗传背景之间的相互作用，但同样类型的相互作用也存在于营养缺陷突变和培养基组成之间（这在不同研究之间可能差异很大）。这一事实应在手稿中简要提及，并理想地在所提议的表格中通过指出使用特定NPs的研究中所用的菌株、营养缺陷背景和培养基来加以考虑。像H2O2这样的添加剂在某些地方被提及用于增强表征，也可以在表格中加以考虑。

我感谢作者的努力和见解，希望他们觉得这些反馈有用。

paper_title: Gradient-based Bi-level Optimization for Deep Learning: A Survey
paper_abstract: Bi-level optimization, especially the gradient-based category, has been widely used in the deep learning community including hyperparameter optimization and meta knowledge extraction. Bi-level optimization embeds one problem within another and the gradient-based category solves the outer level task by computing the hypergradient, which is much more efficient than classical methods such as the evolutionary algorithm. In this survey, we first give a formal definition of the gradient-based bi-level optimization. Secondly, we illustrate how to formulate a research problem as a bi-level optimization problem, which is of great practical use for beginners. More specifically, there are two formulations: the single-task formulation to optimize hyperparameters such as regularization parameters and the distilled data, and the multi-task formulation to extract meta knowledge such as the model initialization. With a bi-level formulation, we then discuss four bi-level optimization solvers to update the outer variable including explicit gradient update, proxy update, implicit function update, and closed-form update. Last but not least, we conclude the survey by pointing out the great potential of gradient-based bi-level optimization on science problems (AI4Science).
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
This paper provides a survey of gradient-based bi-level optimization for deep learning. It defines gradient-based bi-level optimization and then covers four paradigms for a setting of a single task and two paradigms for a setting of multi tasks. After that, the authors introduce some optimization strategies for the topics of this work. Eventually, future direction and conclusion are described.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
### Strengths * Gradient-based bi-level optimization is an important topic in a machine learning field. ### Weaknesses * I think that the structure of this survey paper is not well-organized. For example, although the number of tasks is one of criteria to classify strategies for the gradient-based bi-level optimization, there might be similar strategies in both single-task and multi-task settings. It should be covered in an integrated way. * Following the above concern, the taxonomy of gradient-based bi-level optimization should be revised. I think that the current taxonomy is too simple and not clear. * Writing and presentation can be improved more. * Discussion on future directions is weak. Since this paper is a survey paper, it should be carefully discussed.

**Requested Changes:**
To better this paper, the following points should be updated: * The taxonomy of gradient-based bi-level optimization should be improved more clearly. * Description of each category should be covered in a consolidated manner. * Discussion on challenging issues and future directions should be enhanced. * Writing and presentation should be improved. ### Minor Issues * Every equation is a sentence. A comma or period should be used appropriately. * Mathematical and regular fonts should be used appropriately. * I am not sure this sentence "In this paper, the hyperparameters are not limited to the regularization and the learning rate but refer to any knowledge in a single task formulation including network architecture, and distilled data samples, as we will illustrate more detailedly in Section 3." is required. Response to review questions 1/n: ## General Reply Thank you for taking the time to provide us with your valuable and constructive comments. We appreciate your feedback and insights and we have carefully revised the paper according to your comments, as outlined below. ## Weakness > I think that the structure of this survey paper is not well-organized. For example, although the number of tasks is one of criteria to classify strategies for the gradient-based bi-level optimization, there might be similar strategies in both single-task and multi-task settings. It should be covered in an integrated way. Following the above concern, the taxonomy of gradient-based bi-level optimization should be revised. We thank you for your feedback concerning the organization of our survey paper, particularly the taxonomy of gradient-based bi-level optimization strategies. In our classification of bi-level optimization tasks into single-task and multi-task categories, we extend beyond merely the number of tasks. This division is more fundamentally rooted in the different objectives and types of knowledge targeted by each setting. The single-task formulation primarily focuses on obtaining task-specific knowledge through hyperparameter tuning, while the multi-task formulation seeks to derive meta knowledge applicable across multiple tasks. This classification criterion, adopted from paper [1], is intended to give a clear overview to researchers in both the hyperparameter optimization and meta-learning fields, also demonstrating their unification potential through bi-level optimization. For example, a regularization parameter in a single-task setting serves to control overfitting and is task-specific. Conversely, in a multi-task setting, a learned optimizer aims to optimize task loss, representing meta knowledge acquired from different tasks. paper_title_zh: 基于梯度的双层优化在深度学习中的应用：综述
paper_abstract_zh: 双层优化，尤其是基于梯度的类别，已在深度学习社区中得到广泛应用，包括超参数优化和元知识提取。双层优化将一个问题嵌入到另一个问题中，而基于梯度的类别通过计算超梯度来解决外层任务，这比进化算法等经典方法要高效得多。在本综述中，我们首先给出了基于梯度的双层优化的正式定义。其次，我们阐述了如何将一个研究问题表述为双层优化问题，这对初学者具有极大的实用价值。更具体地说，有两种表述方式：单任务表述用于优化正则化参数和蒸馏数据等超参数，多任务表述用于提取模型初始化等元知识。有了双层表述后，我们讨论了四种双层优化求解器来更新外层变量，包括显式梯度更新、代理更新、隐函数更新和闭式更新。最后但同样重要的是，我们通过指出基于梯度的双层优化在科学问题（AI4Science）上的巨大潜力，总结了本综述。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
本文对深度学习中的基于梯度的双层优化进行了综述。首先定义了基于梯度的双层优化，然后涵盖了单一任务设置的四种范式和多任务设置的两种范式。随后，作者介绍了针对本文主题的一些优化策略。最后，描述了未来的研究方向和结论。

**优点与不足：**
### 优点
* 基于梯度的双层优化是机器学习领域的一个重要话题。

### 不足
* 我认为这篇综述的结构不够清晰。例如，尽管任务数量是分类基于梯度的双层优化策略的一个标准，但在单任务和多任务设置中可能存在类似的策略。应该以综合的方式加以涵盖。
* 基于上述关切，基于梯度的双层优化的分类法应进行修订。我认为目前的分类法过于简单且不清晰。
* 写作和呈现方式可以进一步改进。
* 对未来方向的讨论较弱。由于本文是一篇综述文章，应该进行更仔细的讨论。

**请求的更改：**
为了改进本文，以下内容应进行更新：
* 基于梯度的双层优化的分类法应更加清晰地改进。
* 每个类别的描述应以统一的方式涵盖。
* 对挑战性问题和未来方向的讨论应加强。
* 写作和呈现方式应改进。

### 小问题
* 每个方程式都是一个句子。应适当使用逗号或句号。
* 应适当使用数学和常规字体。
* 我不确定这句话“在本文中，超参数不仅限于正则化和学习率，而是指任何在单任务公式中的知识，包括网络架构和蒸馏数据样本，我们将在第3节中更详细地说明。”是否必要。网络架构和蒸馏数据样本显然是超参数。
* 我不确定这句话“单任务公式在单一任务上应用双层优化，旨在为任务学习超参数。”是否正确。它只与超参数优化相关吗？
* 图1不是关于基于梯度的双层优化的总结；它现在是关于本文的内容。应通过适当涵盖基于梯度的双层优化的分类法来修正。
* 应适当使用\citep和\citet。

**更广泛的影响关切：**
我没有任何更广泛的影响关切。

**主张与证据：**
无

**受众：**
是

## 总体回复
感谢您抽出宝贵时间为我们提供有价值和建设性的评论。我们感谢您的反馈和见解，并已根据您的评论仔细修订了论文，如下所述。

## 不足
> 我认为这篇综述的结构不够清晰。例如，尽管任务数量是分类基于梯度的双层优化策略的一个标准，但在单任务和多任务设置中可能存在类似的策略。应该以综合的方式加以涵盖。基于上述关切，基于梯度的双层优化的分类法应进行修订。我认为目前的分类法过于简单且不清晰。

我们感谢您对本文组织结构的反馈，特别是对基于梯度的双层优化策略分类法的意见。在我们将双层优化任务分类为单任务和多任务类别时，我们不仅仅是基于任务数量。这种划分更根本地植根于每种设置所针对的不同目标和知识类型。单任务公式主要侧重于通过超参数调整获得任务特定知识，而多任务公式则寻求推导出适用于多个任务的元知识。这一分类标准借鉴了论文[1]，旨在为超参数优化和元学习领域的研究人员提供一个清晰的概述，同时也展示了通过双层优化将两者统一的潜力。这使得不熟悉某一领域的研究人员能够清晰地了解两者，并突出它们之间的相互联系。

确实，在两种设置中都可能找到类似的策略，但它们在不同语境中具有不同的意义。例如，在单任务设置中的正则化参数用于控制过拟合，并且是任务特定的。相反，在多任务设置中，学习到的优化器旨在优化任务损失，代表了从不同任务中获得的元知识。

paper_title: Factors affecting community ambulation post-stroke: a mapping review protocol
paper_abstract:
Background 
    Most stroke survivors consider community ambulation an essential but unmet goal of their recovery. Historically, interventions to enhance community ambulation have focused on improving biomechanical impairments of gait; however, recent evidence suggests that biopsychosocial and environmental factors may impact community ambulation, even beyond more obvious physical impairments. The identification of factors that pose as significant facilitators or barriers to community ambulation may serve to guide stakeholders in designing relevant and evidence-based interventions for improving community ambulation post-stroke. 
  
  
    Objective 
    This review aims to map the type and extent of existing evidence on the physical, biopsychosocial, and environmental factors affecting community ambulation post-stroke. Additionally, this review will describe the various methods used to examine the extent to which stroke survivors are restricted to community ambulation. 
  
  
    Methods 
    Nine databases will be searched including CINAHL, PubMed, and Web of Science. We will include studies published in English during or after 2001. Studies that examine physical, biopsychosocial, and/or environmental factors affecting community ambulation in ambulatory adults at least six months post-stroke will be considered for inclusion. Studies that assess general physical activity or community mobility through transportation modes other than walking will be excluded. All identified records will be collated in citation management software, followed by steps of deduplication, title/abstract screening, and full-text reviews by at least two independent reviewers. The bibliographies of the extracted studies will also be reviewed for relevant articles. The extracted studies will be analyzed, critically appraised, and presented in tabular, narrative, and evidence map formats. 
  
  
    Discussion 
    The evidence gained will be used to build a framework for community ambulation, informing stakeholders to develop meaningful interventions to improve community ambulation. The mapped evidence will motivate future studies to develop holistic approaches that specifically focus on the most vital factors that influence post-stroke community ambulation.
review_content:
The authors intend to conduct a scoping (mapping) review with the purpose to report the physical, biopsychosocial, and environmental factors affecting community ambulation in persons' post-stroke. The topic is timely, relevant, and there will be an interested readership from any number of healthcare professions.

The introduction is well-written, logical, and provides sufficient evidence for the need for this mapping review.

The study design is robust and includes the relevant methodology. The search strategy, databases/search terms are appropriate. Whether or not the grey literature is being used was addressed. The data extraction process is described. Covidence is being used. There are safeguards by using pairs of reviewers and a third for addressing any discrepancies. Critical appraisal will be conducted. As such, methods are adequately described.
paper_title_zh: 影响卒中后社区步行能力的因素：一项映射综述方案
paper_abstract_zh:
背景
大多数中风幸存者认为社区步行是他们康复的一个重要但未实现的目标。历史上，增强社区步行的干预措施主要集中在改善步行的生物力学障碍；然而，最近的证据表明，生物心理社会和环境因素可能会影响社区步行，甚至超出了更明显的身体障碍。识别对社区步行构成显著促进因素或障碍的因素，可以指导相关利益方设计相关且有证据基础的干预措施，以改善中风后的社区步行。

目的
本综述旨在梳理现有关于影响中风后社区步行的物理、生物心理社会和环境因素的证据类型和范围。此外，本综述还将描述用于检查中风幸存者社区步行受限程度的不同方法。

方法
将搜索九个数据库，包括CINAHL、PubMed和Web of Science。我们将包括2001年或之后发表的英文研究。考虑纳入的研究是那些探讨在中风后至少六个月的可行走成人中，影响社区步行的物理、生物心理社会和/或环境因素的研究。通过除步行以外的交通方式评估一般身体活动或社区移动性的研究将被排除。所有识别的记录将汇总到引文管理软件中，随后进行去重、标题/摘要筛选和至少两名独立评审员的全文本审查。还将审查提取研究的参考文献以寻找相关文章。提取的研究将进行分析、批判性评估，并以表格、叙述和证据地图格式呈现。

讨论
所获得的证据将用于构建社区步行框架，为相关利益方提供信息，以开发有意义的干预措施来改善社区步行。映射的证据将激励未来的研究开发整体方法，特别关注影响中风后社区步行最关键的因素。

paper_title: Review of Deep Learning Performance in Wireless Capsule Endoscopy Images for GI Disease Classification
paper_abstract: Wireless capsule endoscopy is a non-invasive medical imaging modality used for diagnosing and monitoring digestive tract diseases. However, the analysis of images obtained from wireless capsule endoscopy is a challenging task, as the images are of low resolution and often contain a large number of artifacts. In recent years, deep learning has shown great promise in the analysis of medical images, including wireless capsule endoscopy images. This paper provides a review of the current trends and future directions in deep learning for wireless capsule endoscopy. We focus on the recent advances in transfer learning, attention mechanisms, multi-modal learning, automated lesion detection, interpretability and explainability, data augmentation, and edge computing. We also highlight the challenges and limitations of current deep learning methods and discuss the potential future directions for the field. Our review provides insights into the ongoing research and development efforts in the field of deep learning for wireless capsule endoscopy, and can serve as a reference for researchers, clinicians, and engineers working in this area inspection process.
review_content: The paper provides a comprehensive review of the current trends and future directions in deep learning for wireless capsule endoscopy (WCE). While it covers important advancements such as transfer learning, attention mechanisms, multimodal learning, automated lesion detection, interpretability and explainability, data augmentation, and edge computing,. The discussion on challenges and limitations is insightful, yet the paper would benefit significantly from a more explicit statement of how it advances the state of the art, addresses existing gaps, Additionally, more detailed comparisons of the methodologies and their practical implications for clinical practice would enhance the paper's relevance and impact. Therefore, a major revision is necessary to clearly define the paper's contribution and strengthen its analysis and conclusions.

paper_title: A Survey on Compositional Learning of AI Models: Theoretical and Experimental Practices
paper_abstract: Compositional learning, mastering the ability to combine basic concepts and construct more intricate ones, is crucial for human cognition, especially in human language comprehension and visual perception. This notion is tightly connected to generalization over unobserved situations. Despite its integral role in intelligence, there is a lack of systematic theoretical and experimental research methodologies, making it difficult to analyze the compositional learning abilities of computational models. In this paper, we survey the literature on compositional learning of AI models and the connections made to cognitive studies. We identify abstract concepts of compositionality in cognitive and linguistic studies and connect these to the computational challenges faced by language and vision models in compositional reasoning. We overview the formal definitions, tasks, evaluation benchmarks, various computational models, and theoretical findings. Our primary focus is on linguistic benchmarks and combining language and vision, though there is a large amount of research on compositional concept learning in the computer vision community alone. We cover modern studies on large language models to provide a deeper understanding of the cutting-edge compositional capabilities exhibited by state-of-the-art AI models and pinpoint important directions for future research.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
The paper discusses the cognitive aspects of compositional learning, how current evaluation protocols test for these aspects, and how current models perform under these evaluations.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
**Strengths** 1. The work defines which notions of compositionality it is studying. The sections are accordingly organized. 2. The work discusses a lot of prior research, datasets, and models concerning compositionality. **Weaknesses** 1. Figure 1 highlights the claims of the paper. These claims contain most of the novelty in the paper, but each only gets one paragraph of explanation in the discussion. Some of these claims are strong and unsubstantiated, while others do not offer strong insight. In general, I think these claims are the most important part of the paper, and should offer deep insight accrued from knowing all the related topics. - The paper claims there should be more research should be done in benchmarking the latter 3 aspects of compositional learning. Though they show there is a lack of evaluation here, why is it important to benchmark these aspects? Sharing these reasons is important for future research. - The paper claims there should be better benchmarks. They specifically say existing benchmarks are synthetic/unrealistic, while continuing to show many benchmarks that address their issues. What are the issues with current benchmarks then? - There is a single paragraph in the discussion concerning inconsistent theoretical methodology. It claims that this inconsistency is because some say compositional learning exists, while others say it is unpredictable (sidenote, there are factual errors here. Schaeffer et al does not claim it is unpredictable). Why is this inconsistent. - Where is it justified that task-specific models have better expressivity? 2. Outside of these claims, the main contribution seems to be classifying existing works under the compositional framework proposed in Dankers et al 2021. I find survey papers most helpful when they can synthesize new viewpoints about the field and consider the connections between different works. Though this paper summarized existing contributions, I do not feel like I was left with a greater sense of understanding of the current state of compositional learning. 3. What is the connection between emergence and compositional learning? I did not follow the connection at the start of 5.3 TLDR: Though the work is relatively comprehensive, its main claims are given less attention, while the rest of the work consists of more summary than synthesis.

**Requested Changes:**
I am happy to change my Claims and Evidence evaluation if the claims are better scoped or substantiated. This paper will be much better if these claims are better fleshed out to be accurate and meaningfully relevant for practitioners. Below are minor suggestions 1. When citations are not an object in the sentence (for example, the first four citations in this paper), ensure they are wrapped in parentheses. Based on your latex, this could be done using \citep instead of \citet or \cite. Other citations are not hyperlinked throughout the text. 2. The paper may want to discuss the recent empirical work of Skill-Mix (https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.17567) and corresponding theoretical work (https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.15936) that aim to quantify compositional learning for LLM's

Yes

paper_title_zh: AI模型组合学习的综述：理论与实践探索
paper_abstract_zh: 组合学习，即掌握将基本概念组合起来构建更复杂概念的能力，对人类认知至关重要，尤其是在人类语言理解和视觉感知方面。这一概念与对未观察情境的泛化能力紧密相关。尽管它在智能中扮演着不可或缺的角色，但缺乏系统的理论和实验研究方法，使得分析计算模型的组合学习能力变得困难。在本文中，我们综述了人工智能模型组合学习的文献及其与认知研究的联系。我们识别了认知和语言研究中组合性的抽象概念，并将其与语言和视觉模型在组合推理中面临的计算挑战联系起来。我们概述了形式化定义、任务、评估基准、各种计算模型和理论发现。我们的主要关注点是语言基准以及语言和视觉的结合，尽管仅在计算机视觉社区中就有大量关于组合概念学习的研究。我们涵盖了关于大型语言模型的现代研究，以深入理解最先进人工智能模型所展示的前沿组合能力，并指出未来研究的重要方向。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
本文讨论了组合学习的认知方面，当前评估协议如何测试这些方面，以及当前模型在这些评估下的表现。

**优点与缺点：**
**优点** 1. 该研究明确了其研究的组合性概念，并据此组织了各部分内容。2. 该研究讨论了大量关于组合性的先前研究、数据集和模型。
**缺点** 1. 图1突出了论文的论点。这些论点包含了论文的大部分创新性，但每个论点在讨论中仅有一段解释。其中一些论点强烈但缺乏证据，而其他论点则未能提供深刻的见解。总体而言，我认为这些论点是论文最重要的部分，应当提供从所有相关主题中积累的深刻见解。- 论文声称应更多研究基准测试组合学习的后三个方面。尽管他们展示了此处评估的不足，但为何要基准测试这些方面？分享这些原因对未来的研究很重要。- 论文声称应有更好的基准测试。他们特别指出现有基准测试是合成的/不现实的，同时继续展示了许多解决其问题的基准测试。那么当前基准测试的问题是什么？- 讨论中有一段关于理论方法不一致的内容。它声称这种不一致是因为有些人认为组合学习存在，而其他人认为它不可预测（旁注，这里有事实错误。Schaeffer等人并未声称它不可预测）。为什么这是不一致的。- 如何证明特定任务模型具有更好的表达性？2. 除了这些论点外，主要贡献似乎是将现有工作归类在Dankers等人2021年提出的组合框架下。我发现当调查论文能够综合关于该领域的新观点并考虑不同工作之间的联系时最有帮助。尽管本文总结了现有贡献，但我并不觉得我对组合学习的当前状态有了更深的理解。3. 突现与组合学习之间的联系是什么？我没有理解5.3节开头的联系。TLDR：尽管该研究相对全面，但其主要论点未得到足够关注，而其余部分更多的是总结而非综合。

**请求的修改：**
如果论点范围更明确或更有依据，我愿意更改我的“论点与证据”评估。如果这些论点能够更详细地展开，使其准确并对实践者有实际意义，论文将会更好。以下是 minor suggestions 1. 当引用不是句子中的对象时（例如，本文的前四个引用），确保它们用括号括起来。根据你的latex，这可以通过使用\citep而不是\citet或\cite来实现。其他引用在文本中未超链接。2. 论文可能需要讨论Skill-Mix的最新实证工作（https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.17567）及其相应的理论工作（https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.15936），旨在量化LLM的组合学习。

**论点与证据：**
是

**受众：**
是

reasons: The paper may want to discuss the recent empirical work of Skill-Mix (https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.17567) and corresponding theoretical work (https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.15936) that aim to quantify compositional learning for LLM's
Some of these claims are strong and unsubstantiated, while others do not offer strong insight.
In general, I think these claims are the most important part of the paper, and should offer deep insight accrued from knowing all the related topics.
- There is a single paragraph in the discussion concerning inconsistent theoretical methodology.

It claims that this inconsistency is because some say compositional learning exists, while others say it is unpredictable (sidenote, there are factual errors here. Schaeffer et al does not claim it is unpredictable).
- Where is it justified that task-specific models have better expressivity?
Outside of these claims, the main contribution seems to be classifying existing works under the compositional framework proposed in Dankers et al 2021.
Though this paper summarized existing contributions, I do not feel like I was left with a greater sense of understanding of the current state of compositional learning.
(sidenote, there are factual errors here. Schaeffer et al does not claim it is unpredictable).

paper_title: Phytochemicals With Anti 5-alpha-reductase Activity: A Prospective For Prostate Cancer Treatment
paper_abstract: Prostate cancer (CaP) is one of the leading causes of death in men worldwide. Much attention has been given on its prevention and treatment strategies, including targeting the regulation of 5-alpha-Reductase (5αR) enzyme activity, aimed to limit the progression of CaP by inhibiting the conversion of potent androgen dihydrotestosterone from testosterone that is thought to play a role in pathogenesis of CaP, by using the 5-alpha-Reductase inhibitors (5αRis) such as finasteride and dutasteride. However, 5αRis are reported to exhibit numerous adverse side effects, for instance erectile dysfunction, ejaculatory dysfunction and loss of libido. This has led to a surge of interest on plant-derived alternatives that might offer favourable side effects and less toxic profiles. Phytochemicals from plants are shown to exhibit numerous medicinal properties in various studies targeting many major illnesses including CaP. Therefore, in this review, we aim to discuss the use of phytochemicals namely phytosterols, polyphenols and fatty acids, found in various plants with proven anti-CaP properties, as an alternative herbal CaP medicines as well as to outline their inhibitory activities on 5αRs isozymes based on their structural similarities with current 5αRis as part of CaP treatment approaches.
review_content:
5-alpha-Reductase inhibitors (5αRis) used in the treatment of prostate cancer are reported to have numerous adverse side effects. Here, the authors report on plant-derived alternatives that might offer favourable side effects and less toxic profiles. In particular, the authors discuss the inhibitory activities of phytochemicals on 5αRs isozymes and their structural similarities with current 5αRis used in prostate cancer therapy. Overall, this review article is clear, follows a logical narrative, and is relatively well-written. I have a few minor suggestions:
 1. There are a few minor edits below that need to be made in the abstract and introduction to improve clarity:

    Abstract: “This has led to a surge of interests on plant-derived alternatives” should be “This has led to a surge of interest on plant-derived alternatives”.

    Abstract: “Therefore, in this review, we aim to discuss on the use of phytochemicals namely phytosterols” should be “Therefore, in this review, we aim to discuss the use of phytochemicals namely phytosterols”.

    Introduction: “The latter strategy was largely anticipated, considering CaP as being hormones-driven disease” should be “The latter strategy was largely anticipated, considering CaP is a hormones-driven disease”.

    Introduction: The authors should clarify the sentence “Testosterone (T), synthesised by the Leydig cells of the testes under the control of hypothalamus and anterior pituitary gland, is the most abundant circulating androgen in males, where from it, more potent form dihydrotestosterone (DHT) is synthesised”.
 2. It was unclear from Table 1 which type of phytochemical (i.e., PS, PP and FA) was the most effective at inhibiting the activity of 5αRs. Would it be possible for the authors to include some information (e.g., IC50 values or equivalent) to give an indication of the relative efficacies of the different phytochemicals in the inhibition of 5αRs (type I/II)? Information on the type of prostate cancer cell lines used in each study would also be helpful to include in Table 1.
 3. The data shown in Table 1 is based on in vitro data. It would be useful to the readers if the authors included a second table giving an overview of how the different phytochemicals (i.e., PS, PP and FA) have been studied in vivo (i.e., mice models). In particular, the table should include information on the types of prostate cancer mouse models, the type of anti-cancer mechanisms investigated, outcomes, etc. The inclusion of this table would give important context on how these phytochemicals (i.e., PS, PP and FA) have been investigated in vivo and how much more work is needed.
 4. It would be helpful if the authors provided additional context in the discussion and included a sentence on how many (if any) of the phytochemicals (i.e., PS, PP and FA) have been investigated in human clinical trials to inhibit 5αRs, and what still needs to be done in future studies.
paper_title_zh: 具有抗5-α还原酶活性的植物化学物质：前列腺癌治疗的前景
paper_abstract_zh: 前列腺癌（CaP）是全球男性主要死因之一。大量关注集中在其预防和治疗策略上，包括靶向调节5-α还原酶（5αR）酶活性，旨在通过抑制睾酮转化为强效雄激素二氢睾酮来限制CaP的进展，后者被认为在CaP的发病机制中起作用，使用的药物包括5-α还原酶抑制剂（5αRis）如非那雄胺和度他雄胺。然而，据报道5αRis存在众多不良反应，例如勃起功能障碍、射精功能障碍和性欲减退。这引发了人们对植物来源替代品的兴趣，这些替代品可能具有更佳的副作用和较低的毒性特征。研究表明，植物中的植物化学物质在针对包括CaP在内的多种重大疾病的试验中显示出多种药用特性。因此，在本综述中，我们旨在讨论使用具有抗CaP特性的植物中发现的植物化学物质，即植物甾醇、多酚和脂肪酸，作为替代性草药CaP药物，并概述它们基于与当前5αRis结构相似性对5αRs同工酶的抑制活性，作为CaP治疗策略的一部分。
review_content_zh:
用于治疗前列腺癌的5α-还原酶抑制剂（5αRis）据报道有许多不良反应。本文作者报道了可能具有更佳副作用和较低毒性特征的植物来源替代品。特别是，作者讨论了植物化学物质对5αR同工酶的抑制活性及其与当前用于前列腺癌治疗的5αRis的结构相似性。总体而言，这篇综述文章清晰、逻辑连贯且相对写得较好。我有几点小建议：

1. 摘要和引言中有几处小修改需要做出以提升清晰度：

   摘要：“This has led to a surge of interests on plant-derived alternatives”应改为“This has led to a surge of interest on plant-derived alternatives”。

   摘要：“Therefore, in this review, we aim to discuss on the use of phytochemicals namely phytosterols”应改为“Therefore, in this review, we aim to discuss the use of phytochemicals namely phytosterols”。

   引言：“The latter strategy was largely anticipated, considering CaP as being hormones-driven disease”应改为“The latter strategy was largely anticipated, considering CaP is a hormones-driven disease”。

   引言：作者应澄清句子“Testosterone (T), synthesised by the Leydig cells of the testes under the control of hypothalamus and anterior pituitary gland, is the most abundant circulating androgen in males, where from it, more potent form dihydrotestosterone (DHT) is synthesised”。

2. 从表1中不清楚哪种植物化学物质（即PS、PP和FA）在抑制5αR活性方面最有效。作者能否提供一些信息（如IC50值或等效值），以指示不同植物化学物质在抑制5αR（I/II型）方面的相对效力？在表1中包含所用前列腺癌细胞系类型的信息也会有所帮助。

3. 表1所示数据基于体外实验数据。如果作者能包含一个概述不同植物化学物质（即PS、PP和FA）在体内（即小鼠模型）研究情况的第二张表，对读者会很有帮助。特别是，该表应包含前列腺癌小鼠模型类型、研究的抗癌机制类型、结果等信息。包含此表将提供这些植物化学物质（即PS、PP和FA）在体内研究的重要背景，以及还需要做多少工作。

4. 如果作者在讨论中提供更多背景信息，并包含一句关于有多少（如果有的话）植物化学物质（即PS、PP和FA）已在人体临床试验中用于抑制5αR，以及未来研究中还需要做什么，将会很有帮助。

reasons: The overall content is good and comprehensive.
I believe that the researchers in the field will have a short comprehensive overview reflection from this review.
It would be useful to the readers if the authors included a second table giving an overview of how the different phytochemicals (i.e., PS, PP and FA) have been studied in vivo (i.e., mice models).

It would be helpful if the authors provided additional context in the discussion and included a sentence on how many (if any) of the phytochemicals (i.e., PS, PP and FA) have been investigated in human clinical trials to inhibit 5αRs, and what still needs to be done in future studies.

paper_title: Defining and conceptualizing patient-centered family planning counseling: A scoping review
paper_abstract:
Background 
     Family planning counseling has long been dominated by the tiered-effectiveness model, which discusses contraceptive methods in order of effectiveness. However, there is growing recognition that patients may prioritize factors other than method effectiveness. This scoping review identifies how patient-centered family planning care has been defined and conceptualized, and discusses the implications for measurement. 
   
   
     Methods 
     We systematically searched PubMed and SCOPUS for documents on “patient-centered family planning counseling or support” published between 2013 and 2022. Eligibility criteria included discussion of 1) strategies for providing patient-centered care, 2) interventions using a patient-centered approach, or 3) the impact of patient-centered approaches. We describe the definitions and domains of patient-centered family planning counseling addressed in the literature. 
   
   
     Results 
     Our scoping review is based on 33 documents. Only 18 documents clearly defined patient-centered family planning counseling or discussed what it entails. We identified important differences in how patient-centered family planning care was defined. However, most studies emphasized patients’ needs and preferences, respect for the patient, and informed decision-making and can be mapped against the McCormack’s framework for patient-centered communication. 
   
   
     Conclusions 
     It is important for studies to more clearly state how they define or conceptualize patient-centered family planning. Inconsistent use of indicators makes it difficult, if not impossible, to make generalized conclusions about the effectiveness of the patient-centered approach relative to the tiered-effectiveness approach. Consistent use of comparable indicators of key domains of patient-centered care is needed to address the gap in evidence about the effectiveness of patient-centered family planning counseling on various family planning outcomes, and to support future interventions. Wider use of existing scales to measure patient-centered family planning care may help standardize the definition of patient-centered care and strengthen the evidence base.
review_content:
Thank you for the opportunity to review this article. This scoping review provides a useful reflection on the current state of definitions related to patient-centered family planning counseling. With a few clarifications, the article will certainly be a useful reference. My recommendations are:
 1. The piece could benefit from more precision when defining the scope of the review. First, while the review focuses on counseling, in a few places the authors describe patient-centered contraception care more broadly. Second, in at least one place the authors refer to a systematic search, while this was a scoping review.
 2. It would be important to acknowledge that the tiered effectiveness counseling model has not, in fact, long dominated –rather, in the last 15 years, there has been increasing use of the WHO tiered effectiveness chart to justify directive emphasis on the most effective methods. Prior to this, an informed choice counseling model predominated.
 3. A reflection on human rights-based frameworks for how counseling should be approached is missing, and this is notable both 1) in the lack of acknowledgement of the updated Bruce framework to include a rights-based approach in the section discussing the Bruce framework (see Red[1]) and 2) the authors’ framing of the importance of patient-centered counseling as a means to encourage contraceptive continuation, which is antithetical to a rights-based approach that values individual autonomy in contraceptive decision-making and recognizes that contraceptive use is not a universal good (see for example Ref [2,3]). I recommend they clarify how rights-based frameworks are relevant for conceptualizing and defining patient-centered counseling.
 4. The focus on measures towards the end of the piece feels out of place given how the search strategy was defined. It does not appear that the review included a review of person-centered counseling measures, or a review of the impact of person-centered/high quality counseling on outcomes, judging by the search terms? I recommend the authors clarify whether a review of measures was in scope and whether a review of the impact of patient-centeredness on other outcomes was in scope. The lengthy discussion of the IQFP/PCCC measure towards the end of the piece makes important points but it is not clear why this one particular measure and study on its impact is emphasized when other person-centered counseling measures and studies of the impact of patient-centeredness exist in the literature.
 5. The Holt, Caglia, et al 2017 citation is the wrong one; should be Holt, Dehlendorf, Langer 2017
paper_title_zh: 定义和概念化以患者为中心的家庭计划生育咨询：一项范围综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景
计划生育咨询长期以来一直由分层有效性模型主导，该模型按有效性顺序讨论避孕方法。然而，越来越多的人认识到，患者可能会优先考虑除方法有效性之外的其他因素。本范围综述确定了以患者为中心的计划生育护理是如何被定义和概念化的，并讨论了其对测量的影响。

方法
我们系统地检索了PubMed和SCOPUS数据库中2013年至2022年间发表的关于“以患者为中心的计划生育咨询或支持”的文献。纳入标准包括讨论1）提供以患者为中心的护理策略，2）使用以患者为中心的方法的干预措施，或3）以患者为中心的方法的影响。我们描述了文献中涉及的以患者为中心的计划生育咨询的定义和领域。

结果
我们的范围综述基于33篇文献。仅有18篇文献明确定义了以患者为中心的计划生育咨询或讨论了其内涵。我们发现了在定义以患者为中心的计划生育护理方面的重要差异。然而，大多数研究强调患者的需求和偏好、尊重患者以及知情决策，并且可以与McCormack的患者中心沟通框架相对应。

结论
研究更清晰地说明其如何定义或概念化以患者为中心的计划生育非常重要。指标使用的不一致使得很难，甚至不可能，对以患者为中心的方法相对于分层有效性方法的有效性做出普遍性结论。需要一致使用患者中心护理关键领域的可比指标，以填补关于以患者为中心的计划生育咨询对各种计划生育结果有效性的证据空白，并支持未来的干预措施。更广泛地使用现有量表来测量以患者为中心的计划生育护理，可能有助于标准化患者中心护理的定义并加强证据基础。
review_content_zh:
感谢有机会审阅这篇文章。这篇范围综述对当前与以患者为中心的家庭规划咨询相关的定义现状进行了有用的反思。经过一些澄清，这篇文章无疑将成为一个有用的参考。我的建议如下：

1. 在定义综述范围时，文章可以更精确。首先，虽然综述聚焦于咨询，但在几处作者更广泛地描述了以患者为中心的避孕护理。其次，至少在一处作者提到了系统检索，而实际上这是一篇范围综述。

2. 重要的是要承认，分层有效性咨询模型实际上并没有长期占据主导地位——相反，在过去15年中，越来越多地使用WHO分层有效性图表来证明对最有效方法的指令性强调是合理的。在此之前，知情选择咨询模型占主导地位。

3. 缺乏对如何以人权为基础的框架来指导咨询的反思，这在以下两方面尤为显著：1）在讨论布鲁斯框架的部分未提及更新的布鲁斯框架以包括人权基础方法（参见Red[1]）；2）作者将患者中心咨询的重要性框定为鼓励避孕持续的手段，这与重视避孕决策中个人自主权并认识到避孕使用并非普遍好处的人权基础方法相悖（例如参见Ref [2,3]）。我建议他们澄清人权基础框架对于概念化和定义以患者为中心的咨询的相关性。

4. 文章末尾对措施的聚焦在定义搜索策略的情况下显得格格不入。从搜索术语来看，综述似乎并未包括对以人为中心的咨询措施的审查，或对以人为中心/高质量咨询对结果影响的审查？我建议作者澄清是否对措施进行了审查，以及是否对以患者为中心对其他结果的影响进行了审查。文章末尾对IQFP/PCCC措施的冗长讨论提出了重要观点，但不清楚为何在文献中存在其他以人为中心的咨询措施及其影响研究的情况下，特别强调这一特定措施及其影响的研究。

5. Holt, Caglia, et al 2017的引用是错误的；应为Holt, Dehlendorf, Langer 2017。

reasons: A reflection on human rights-based frameworks for how counseling should be approached is missing, and this is notable both 1) in the lack of acknowledgement of the updated Bruce framework to include a rights-based approach in the section discussing the Bruce framework (see Red[1]) and 2) the authors’ framing of the importance of patient-centered counseling as a means to encourage contraceptive continuation, which is antithetical to a rights-based approach that values individual autonomy in contraceptive decision-making and recognizes that contraceptive use is not a universal good (see for example Ref [2,3]).

The lengthy discussion of the IQFP/PCCC measure towards the end of the piece makes important points but it is not clear why this one particular measure and study on its impact is emphasized when other person-centered counseling measures and studies of the impact of patient-centeredness exist in the literature.

It does not appear that the review included a review of person-centered counseling measures, or a review of the impact of person-centered/high quality counseling on outcomes, judging by the search terms?
The Holt, Caglia, et al 2017 citation is the wrong one; should be Holt, Dehlendorf, Langer 2017

paper_title: Intrathecal Drug Delivery (ITDD) systems for cancer pain
paper_abstract: Intrathecal drug delivery is an effective pain management option for patients with chronic and cancer pain. The delivery of drugs into the intrathecal space provides superior analgesia with smaller doses of analgesics to minimize side effects while significantly improving quality of life. This article aims to provide a general overview of the use of intrathecal drug delivery to manage pain, dosing recommendations, potential risks and complications, and growing trends in the field.
review_content:
This article gives a broad overview of the various types of ITDD systems used in the management of complex cancer pain. It also discusses the advantages, the common side-effects and complications, the technique and cost-effectiveness of using ITDD systems. Overall the article is useful in providing an understanding for doctors and nurses not familiar with the intrathecal drug delivery systems.

The article is written at a basic level and although it is useful to beginners and people who are not well versed in ITDD, it does not deliver much to experienced practitioners. I have reservations as I feel that this review article would have been of a higher standard if it was more comprehensive.

paper_title: Direct aortic route versus transaxillary route for transcatheter aortic valve replacement: a systematic review and metaanalysis
paper_abstract: Background. The transfemoral route is contraindicated in nearly 10% of transcatheter aortic valve replacement (TAVR) candidates because of unsuitable iliofemoral vessels. Transaxillary (TAx) and direct aortic (DAo) routes are the principal nonfemoral TAVR routes; however, few studies have compared their outcomes.
review_content: Reviewer 1 (Anonymous) Basic reporting Please see below Experimental design Please see below Validity of the findings Please see below Comments for the Author In the manuscript by Lee et al, entitled “Direct aortic versus transaxillary transcatheter aortic valve replacement: a systematic review and meta-analysis”, the authors searched for studies reporting clinical outcomes after TAVI performed by direct aortic or transaxillary and analyzed 25 studies. Overall, mortality was similar, but post-procedural complications were higher with the transaxillary approach. The registration on PROSPERO, the inclusion of studies with VARC definition and the exclusion of very small studies are important elements of this study. Of course the study has important limitations, mainly the observational design of studies and the low number of patients nd events included. The search was performed until July 2017. To make this study more interesting and appealing for the contemporary practice, please update it to Oct 2019. Few more studies will be added but will provide more power and more contemporary data.

paper_title: Exploring predictors of psychological preparedness for flood victims: A conceptual framework for Malaysia
paper_abstract:
Background 
 Flooding is one of the most frequent and damaging disasters in Malaysia with major social, economic, and psychological consequences. Compared to material and logistical preparedness, the psychological aspects of disaster management are not given much emphasis. 
 
 
 Methods 
 This conceptual paper employs a systematic literature review to understand the factors that predict Malaysians psychological preparedness for floods. The literature search was conducted using databases such as PubMed, Academic Search Ultimate, Directory of Open Access Journals, Supplemental Index and Google Scholar with keywords including “disaster preparedness, flood, natural disaster and psychological preparedness”. Articles were included if they focused on preparedness towards disasters as well as examined coping mechanisms, perceptions and preparedness behaviours in the context of flood-related crises and excluded if they lack methodological rigor. The review synthesized findings using a thematic analysis approach, identifying psychological resilience and coping strategies in flood-affected populations, the role of social support networks in preparedness and recovery as well as mental health implications of floods, including anxiety, trauma, and post-disaster recovery. This synthesis informed the development of a conceptual model to address factors that predict Malaysians psychological preparedness for floods. 
 According to contemporary theories of catastrophe risk reduction and psychological resilience, critical variables included are risk perception, outcome expectancy, self-efficacy, anxiety, and social support. 
 
 
 Results 
 It was proposed that these factors work together to determine an individual’s psychological preparedness, enhancing their ability to cope with the psychological and emotional strain of a flood disaster. 
 
 
 Conclusions 
 By offering these perspectives, the study contributes to the limited academic discussion on psychological preparedness in Malaysia, which aims to improve the psychological resilience of communities vulnerable to flooding. The proposed framework emphasizes the importance of incorporating psychological preparedness into existing disaster management strategies to reduce the overall damage caused by floods.
review_content:
This article investigates the factors that may predict psychological preparedness among flood victims in Malaysia, a topic of considerable relevance given the increasing frequency and severity of floods, which are recognized as one of the most destructive natural disasters in the country. The authors provide a thorough overview of past flood events in Malaysia and their associated impacts. However, while studies on psychological preparedness for flooding in the Malaysian context have been limited, the authors could strengthen their analysis by synthesizing findings from prior research on psychological preparedness for disasters more generally. Notably, studies such as Boylan's (2016) investigation of psychological preparedness in the context of wildfires, and Zulch's (2019) broader examination of psychological preparedness for natural hazards, could offer valuable insights to enhance the current study.

The article employs a systematic literature review methodology, yet the authors do not provide sufficient detail regarding the process used to identify, evaluate, and synthesize relevant research on psychological preparedness for flood victims. To improve the transparency and rigor of the review process, the authors could adopt established guidelines, such as the PRISMA (Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses) framework, which is widely regarded as the gold standard for conducting systematic reviews. Adhering to PRISMA standards would enhance the reproducibility and reliability of the review process and ensure alignment with recognized methodological best practices.

Although the study would benefit from improvements in methodological transparency, particularly with respect to the reliability and rigor of the systematic review process, it nonetheless holds significant potential to contribute to disaster risk reduction efforts, particularly in the domain of psychological preparedness for natural disasters. By addressing these methodological gaps, the study could provide valuable insights that inform the development of more effective and comprehensive disaster preparedness strategies.
paper_title_zh: 探索洪水受害者心理准备的预测因素：马来西亚的概念框架
paper_abstract_zh:
背景
洪水是马来西亚最频繁且最具破坏性的灾害之一，对社会、经济和心理产生了重大影响。与物质和后勤准备相比，灾害管理的心理方面并未得到足够重视。

方法
本文采用系统文献综述的方法，探讨预测马来西亚人洪水心理准备的因素。文献检索通过PubMed、Academic Search Ultimate、Directory of Open Access Journals、Supplemental Index和Google Scholar等数据库进行，关键词包括“灾害准备、洪水、自然灾害和心理准备”。纳入的文献需关注灾害准备，并考察洪水相关危机中的应对机制、认知和准备行为，排除方法学不严谨的文献。综述通过主题分析法综合研究结果，识别洪水影响人群的心理韧性及应对策略、社会支持网络在准备和恢复中的作用，以及洪水的心理健康影响，包括焦虑、创伤和灾后恢复。这一综合为构建预测马来西亚人洪水心理准备因素的概念模型提供了依据。根据当代灾害风险减少和心理韧性理论，关键变量包括风险感知、结果预期、自我效能、焦虑和社会支持。

结果
研究表明，这些因素共同作用，决定个体的心理准备水平，增强其应对洪水灾害心理和情感压力的能力。

结论
通过提供这些视角，本研究为马来西亚心理准备方面的有限学术讨论做出了贡献，旨在提升易受洪水影响社区的心理韧性。所提出的框架强调将心理准备纳入现有灾害管理策略的重要性，以减少洪水造成的整体损害。
review_content_zh:
本文探讨了可能预测马来西亚洪水受害者心理准备的因素，鉴于洪水频率和严重性的增加，这一主题具有相当的相关性，洪水被认为是该国最具破坏性的自然灾害之一。作者对马来西亚过去的洪水事件及其相关影响进行了全面的概述。然而，尽管在马来西亚背景下对洪水心理准备的研究有限，但作者可以通过综合以往关于灾害心理准备的更广泛研究来加强他们的分析。值得注意的是，诸如博伊兰（Boylan，2016）对野火背景下心理准备的调查，以及祖尔克（Zulch，2019）对自然灾害心理准备的更广泛考察，可以为当前研究提供宝贵的见解。

文章采用了系统文献综述的方法，但作者并未提供足够详细的关于识别、评估和综合洪水受害者心理准备相关研究的过程。为了提高综述过程的透明度和严谨性，作者可以采用公认的指南，如PRISMA（系统综述和荟萃分析的首选报告项目）框架，该框架被广泛认为是进行系统综述的黄金标准。遵循PRISMA标准将提高综述过程的可重复性和可靠性，并确保与公认的方法学最佳实践保持一致。

尽管该研究在方法学透明度方面，特别是在系统综述过程的可靠性和严谨性方面有待改进，但它仍具有为灾害风险减少工作做出重要贡献的潜力，特别是在自然灾害心理准备领域。通过解决这些方法学上的不足，该研究可以提供宝贵的见解，为制定更有效、更全面的灾害准备策略提供信息。

paper_title: Current approaches for executing big data science projects -a systematic literature review
paper_abstract: There is an increasing number of big data science projects aiming to create value for organizations by improving decision making, streamlining costs or enhancing business processes. However, many of these projects fail to deliver the expected value. It has been observed that a key reason many data science projects don't succeed is not technical in nature, but rather, the process aspect of the project. The lack of established and mature methodologies for executing data science projects has been frequently noted as a reason for these project failures. To help move the field forward, this study presents a systematic review of research focused on the adoption of big data science process frameworks. The goal of the review was to identify (1) the key themes, with respect to current research on how teams execute data science projects, (2) the most common approaches regarding how data science projects are organized, managed and coordinated, (3) the activities involved in a data science projects life cycle, and (4) the implications for future research in this field. In short, the review identified 68 primary studies thematically classified in six categories. Two of the themes (workflow and agility) accounted for approximately 80% of the identified studies. The findings regarding workflow approaches consist mainly of adaptations to CRISP-DM (vs entirely new proposed methodologies). With respect to agile approaches, most of the studies only explored the conceptual benefits of using an agile approach in a data science project (vs actually evaluating an agile framework being used in a data science context). Hence, one finding from this research is that future research should explore how to best achieve the theorized benefits of agility. Another finding is the need to explore how to efficiently combine workflow and agile frameworks within a data science context to achieve a more comprehensive approach for project execution.
review_content: Reviewer 1 Basic reporting The manuscript presents a systematic review of frameworks for executing big data science projects. The contributions of the article are well presented. The manuscript concisely summarizes the current state of the art in data science project management frameworks. Furthermore, the findings and conclusions derived from the systematic review are of interest to the research community on organizational and management frameworks for big data science projects. The structure of the article is correct, and there are sufficient background details and literature references provided. The article introduces the topic adequately. The lack of established and mature methodologies justifies the need for information about how data science projects are organized, managed, and coordinated. Thus, it adequately justifies the need for a systematic review in this field. The paper is well written and well organized, uses professional, clear, and unambiguous English. Figures and tables in general are comprehensive and helpful. Experimental design The content of the article is consistent with the journal's Aims and Scope. Furthermore, the methodology for the systematic review is described with sufficient detail: both the search space, the search strategy, and the selection criteria & procedure are well justified and described to be reproducible by another investigator (given access to the mentioned digital libraries). The references are correctly cited. The review is also organized logically into coherent paragraphs. The reviewer noted a possible mismatch in the total number of papers: - In Figure 1, in the Google Scholar search space, the number of retrieved studies is 37600. However, the total number of retrieved papers in Table 1 is 44600 (9200 + 17800 + 17600). Is this mismatch due to repeated articles? This difference should be clarified. --- Thank you for noticing! It is a mistake in the calculations. The correct number is 44600. The picture is updated accordingly. - In line 262, it is mentioned that “After executing the title and abstract screen, 98 papers were selected for candidates for primary studies.”. The same number of articles (98) appears in Figure 1. However, the total number of candidate papers in table 2 is 135 (52+18+24+36+5). Again, is this mismatch due to repeated articles on different digital libraries? This difference should be clarified. --- Yes, the mismatch is due to duplicated papers across the digital libraries. Clarification regarding the numbers in table 2 is added in the revised version. Validity of the findings The novelty of the study is assessed in the manuscript. The conclusions are appropriately stated, connected to the three research questions, and are supported by the results. The conclusion identifies very interesting future directions for research in the field. The limitations of the study are also presented in the Discussion section. - Lines 299-304: "While the six themes that we identified in our SLR are all relevant to project execution, there was a wide range in the number of papers published for the different themes. Exploring this ratio of publications across the different themes provides a high-level view of research activity for the different themes. In other words, the number of articles for a particular theme is indicative of the current focus, with respect to current research efforts for that theme regarding the execution of data science projects." The reviewer found this paragraph not straightforward and difficult to read, with the same idea repeated twice. Therefore, the reviewer recommends simplifying this paragraph and making it easier to understand. --- Simplified and more readable explanation is provided in the revised version. Additional comments Typography errors: - Lines 511-513: "Another limitation is that while authors explored ACM Digital Library, IEEEXplore, Scopus, ScienceDirect, and Google Scholar databases, which index high impact journals and conference papers from IEEE, ACM, SpringerLink, and Elsevier to identify all possible relevant articles.": The while clause has not been appropriately used; there is no second part to the sentence. --- The comment is addressed in the revised version. - Line 387: the text should be in bold --- The comment is addressed in the revised version. - Caption Figure 1: csteps => steps --- The comment is addressed in the revised submission. - Table 4: There are unnecessary parentheses on Extension / CRISP-DM / Primary Studies --- The comment is addressed in the revised version. The same typo corrected in New/ CRISP-DM / Primary Studies.
paper_title_zh: 当前大数据科学项目执行方法——系统文献综述
paper_abstract_zh: 越来越多的大数据科学项目旨在通过改进决策、优化成本或提升业务流程为组织创造价值。然而，许多此类项目未能实现预期的价值。观察发现，许多数据科学项目未能成功的关键原因并非技术性质，而是项目的流程方面。缺乏成熟和确立的数据科学项目执行方法已被频繁指出为项目失败的原因。为了推动该领域的发展，本研究对专注于大数据科学流程框架采纳的研究进行了系统综述。综述的目标是识别：(1) 关于团队如何执行数据科学项目的当前研究的关键主题；(2) 数据科学项目组织、管理和协调的最常见方法；(3) 数据科学项目生命周期中涉及的活动；(4) 对该领域未来研究的启示。简而言之，综述识别了68项主要研究，主题上分为六类。其中两个主题（工作流和敏捷性）约占所识别研究的80%。关于工作流方法的发现主要涉及对CRISP-DM的适应性调整（而非全新的提议方法）。在敏捷方法方面，大多数研究仅探讨了在数据科学项目中使用敏捷方法的概念性益处（而非实际评估在数据科学背景下使用的敏捷框架）。因此，本研究的发现之一是未来研究应探索如何最佳实现敏捷性的理论益处。另一发现是需要探索如何在数据科学背景下高效结合工作流和敏捷框架，以实现更全面的项目执行方法。
review_content_zh: 审稿人1 基本报告 该手稿对执行大数据科学项目的框架进行了系统综述。文章的贡献阐述清晰。手稿简洁地总结了当前数据科学项目管理框架的最新进展。此外，从系统综述中得出的发现和结论对研究大数据科学项目组织和管理框架的研究社区具有兴趣。文章结构正确，提供了充分的背景细节和文献参考。文章对主题的引入适当。缺乏成熟的方法论证明了了解数据科学项目如何组织、管理和协调的必要性。因此，它充分证明了在这一领域进行系统综述的必要性。论文写作和组织良好，使用了专业、清晰且无歧义的英语。总体而言，图表全面且有帮助。 实验设计 文章内容与期刊的目标和范围一致。此外，系统综述的方法描述详尽：搜索空间、搜索策略以及选择标准和程序都得到了充分的论证和描述，其他研究者（在访问提到的数字图书馆的情况下）可以复现。参考文献引用正确。综述也逻辑清晰地组织成连贯的段落。审稿人注意到论文总数可能存在不匹配：- 在图1中，Google Scholar搜索空间中检索到的研究数量为37600。然而，表1中检索到的论文总数为44600（9200 + 17800 + 17600）。这种不匹配是由于重复文章造成的吗？这一差异应予以澄清。——感谢您的指出！这是计算中的错误。正确数字是44600。图片已相应更新。- 在第262行提到，“在执行标题和摘要筛选后，选择了98篇论文作为初步研究的候选。”图1中出现了相同数量的文章（98）。然而，表2中的候选论文总数为135（52+18+24+36+5）。同样，这种不匹配是由于不同数字图书馆中的重复文章造成的吗？这一差异应予以澄清。——是的，不匹配是由于数字图书馆中的重复文章造成的。修订版中已对表2中的数字进行了澄清。 研究发现的可靠性 手稿中评估了研究的创新性。结论陈述得当，与三个研究问题相关联，并得到了结果的支持。结论指出了该领域非常有趣的研究方向。研究的局限性也在讨论部分中呈现。- 第299-304行：“尽管我们在SLR中识别的六个主题都与项目执行相关，但不同主题发表的论文数量差异很大。探索不同主题间出版物的比例可以提供对不同主题研究活动的高层次视角。换句话说，特定主题的文章数量表明了当前研究的重点，相对于该主题在数据科学项目执行方面的当前研究努力。”审稿人发现这段话不直接且难以理解，同样的观点重复了两次。因此，审稿人建议简化这段话，使其更易理解。——修订版中提供了更简洁易懂的解释。 附加评论 排版错误：- 第511-513行：“另一个局限性是，尽管作者探索了ACM数字图书馆、IEEEXplore、Scopus、ScienceDirect和Google Scholar数据库，这些数据库索引了来自IEEE、ACM、SpringerLink和Elsevier的高影响力期刊和会议论文，以识别所有可能相关的文章。”：while从句使用不当；句子没有第二部分。——修订版中已解决该评论。- 第387行：文本应加粗——修订版中已解决该评论。- 图1标题：csteps => steps——修订版中已更正。- 表4：扩展/CRISP-DM/初步研究中有不必要的括号——修订版中已更正。同样的错别字在新/CRISP-DM/初步研究中也已更正。
