paper_title_zh: 棒球投手肌肉疲劳的表现：系统综述
paper_abstract_zh: 背景。棒球投手的疲劳是一个与体能和心智表现下降、受伤以及运动学变化相关联的过程。众多研究已将疲劳与过度使用、高球速、休息时间不足、不良机械动作以及自我满意度程度联系起来。本研究的目的是系统回顾文献，以识别棒球投球中结果与疲劳表现之间关系的理论框架。综合数据可能识别出需要进一步研究的领域。方法。该方案已在PROSPERO（ID: CRD42018114194）注册。通过SPORTDiscus、Medline、PubMed、Cochrane系统评价数据库和Google Scholar进行检索，使用关键词如投手疲劳和运动学变化（例如投球机械动作、外翻肘部扭矩）、表现（例如投球次数、投球类型）以及受伤（例如疼痛、肘部和肩部酸痛）。三名评审员独立筛选文章，根据摘要资格选择相关文献，并评估其中描述的方法以确定最终纳入。
review_content_zh:
审稿人2：这篇手稿写得很好，提供了关于棒球运动员疲劳、受伤和表现之间关系的显著背景和上下文。我对手稿中提供的基本报告提出了具体意见，并向作者提出了改进建议。感谢你们，我们非常感谢你们所有的反馈和建议。我们已在下方和手稿中逐一回应了每条意见。我们认为，通过这些建议的修改，我们的工作得到了很大改进。具体意见如下：

• 小型排版错误：第68行：在使用MLB缩写之前，应完整拼写“Major League Baseball”。感谢您的建议。我们选择将“MLB”改为“职业棒球”，因为我们的评论也涉及在小联盟投手身上进行的Tommy John手术。

• 引用错误：第434行：作者引用Passan（2016）来支持每年在Major League Baseball上花费15亿美元用于投球人才的论断。该参考文献未包含在参考文献列表中。此外，我认为作者指的是Jeff Passan（2016）的“The Arm: Inside Billion-Dollar Mystery of the Most Valuable Commodity in Sports”。该书中封底第一句提到的15亿美元数字，我建议作者从书中追踪该数字回其原始来源作为参考文献。我们已将该参考文献添加到我们的参考文献列表中。不幸的是，我们无法追踪到Passan数字的原始来源。

• 排版错误：第288-293行：作者描述了Freeston等人（2016）进行的“随机对照试验”，其中13名青少年棒球运动员在相隔七天的两个场合进行了测试。所引用的研究实际上描述的是“随机交叉试验”，正如所引用文章标题“Indicators of throwing arm fatigue in elite adolescent male baseball players: A Randomized crossover trial”所示。感谢这一更正，这是我们疏忽的地方，我们已在第238行将其更正为随机交叉研究。

• 文章结构：结果部分：感谢作者在补充文件中包含PRISMA清单。然而，尽管作者已包含有关投手疲劳的动力学（表2）和表现变化（表3）的综合表格，但系统综述（PRISMA清单第20项）需要一个更详细的综合表格。我建议将所有综述文章合并到一个大表格中，分为动力学变化、表现变化和与棒球投手疲劳相关的伤害等不同部分。该表格还应包括每篇综述文章的偏倚风险评分（见实验设计中的评论）。感谢这一宝贵反馈。我们已为表格增加了大量细节。此外，我们的方法现在包含了一个关于偏倚风险评估的完整部分（第168-181行）。这包括根据Lopes等人2012年的工作新增了一个风险评估表（表2）。我们还包含了一个关于方法学质量的完整部分（第154-166行）。这包括一个使用Downs和Black 1998质量评估的新表格（表1）。我们包含的所有论文被分为3类（动力学、表现和伤害）。每篇论文及其特定类别的发现分别列在表3、4和5中。表1和2现在解决了我们的方法学质量和风险评估问题。这些也是审稿人1的意见。如果审稿人认为需要一个大的总结表，而不是分成3类，我们可以考虑这一想法。然而，我们已提供了3个修订后的表格，包含更多信息，包括作者、年份、研究信息、疲劳协议、主要发现等。

paper_title: An integrative review on physical restraint in adult critical care unit
paper_abstract:
Background 
     Physical restraints (PRs) are frequently used in adult critical care units to protect staff and prevent self-harm, despite the fact that they represent significant safety risks. Restraint complications may have an impact on the patient’s long- and short-term outcomes. This integrative review aimed to meticulously evaluate existing evidence pertaining to physical restraint practices in adult critical care settings. The review was specifically geared towards examining the prevalence of PR, identifying influential factors, elucidating the role of nurses in PR implementation, exploring nurses’ experiences in caring for patients under restraint, and scrutinizing the complications associated with PR application 
   
   
     Method 
     This integrative review included the studies published between January 2009 and December 2019 and the literature search was conducted in July 2020. The databases searched included EBSCOhost, Ovid, ProQuest, PubMed, Wiley Online Library, SCOPUS, and ScienceDirect. The keywords included in the search were restraint, critical care, intensive care, ICU, mechanical ventilation, intubation, nursing, and experience. A checklist based on the CASP checklist and the JBI Critical Appraisal Tool was used to assess the methodological quality. 
   
   
     Results 
     The findings were evaluated and summarized into seven key topics after twenty-one publications were found to be evaluated. i) High prevalence of PR application in adult critical care unit; ii) determinants of PR applications; iii) types of PR in adult critical care units; iv) decision maker of PR; v) moral and ethical dilemma in PR application; vi) awareness and guidelines for PR applications; vii) common complications and use of sedation, analgesics, antipsychotic drugs in PR application. 
   
   
     Conclusion 
     The number of days PR is used is related to the risk of an adverse event. In order to standardize nursing practice, ICU nurses require greater training on the ideas of PR use. Evidence-based recommendations will assist critical care nurses in making the best judgments possible concerning the use of PR.
review_content:
Thank you for the opportunity to review this manuscript. The aim of this integrative review was to examine recent evidence on the use of physical restraints (PR) in adult critical care. This is an important topic, and while I appreciate the work conducted, I wonder about the novelty of the study, i.e., what does this review add to the literature? Are the methods/findings of this study novel? How do the findings of this review differ, expand, or complement the findings of the following reviews: Perez D, et. al. 2019 (ref 1), Alostaz Z, et. al. 2022 (ref 2).
The rationale for and objective of the review is stated, but I would recommend more consistency. For example, while the abstract states the aim is to "examine the recent evidence on the use of PR in adult critical care," the body of the manuscript states that "with the use of the following questions, this review will look into the best available evidence on the use of PR in adult critical care in regard to: 1) prevalence of PR; 2) factors that influence PR; 3) the role the nurse plays in the implementation of PR; 4) the nurse’s experience caring for the patient with PR; and 5) the complications of applying PR." Furthermore, under the search methods, it was stated that "the goal of this study is to conduct a thorough assessment of the available evidence on PR in the adult critical care unit."
Please note that there were no questions reported to support the sentence "with the use of the following questions."
More details are needed to allow the replication of this review. For example, it would be helpful to provide the full search strategy for one of the databases (e.g., Medline).
In the section discussing exclusion criteria, it appears that researchers primarily outlined how they limited the search rather than explicit criteria for excluding studies from the review. To enhance the reproducibility of this review, I recommend explicitly stating the predetermined criteria for exclusion. For example, exclusion of chemical restraints studies, studies conducted in any other setting outside ICUs, previous literature reviews, editorials, and conference abstracts, etc.
Finally, I would recommend a review of the grammar used in the article as there was a mix-up of tenses (present, past, future). For example, under the aim it says "this review will look into...". Past tense should be used here, and there are many instances throughout.
paper_title_zh: 成人重症监护单元中身体约束的综合性回顾
paper_abstract_zh:
背景
物理约束（PRs）在成人重症监护单元中频繁使用，以保护工作人员并防止患者自伤，尽管它们存在显著的安全风险。约束并发症可能对患者的长期和短期结局产生影响。本综合性回顾旨在细致评估现有关于成人重症监护环境中物理约束实践的证据。该回顾特别针对检查PR的流行率、识别影响因素、阐明护士在PR实施中的作用、探讨护士在照顾受约束患者中的经验，以及审查与PR应用相关的并发症。

方法
本综合性回顾包括2009年1月至2019年12月间发表的研究，文献检索于2020年7月进行。检索的数据库包括EBSCOhost、Ovid、ProQuest、PubMed、Wiley Online Library、SCOPUS和ScienceDirect。检索关键词包括约束、重症监护、重症护理、ICU、机械通气、插管、护理和经验。使用基于CASP清单和JBI关键评估工具的清单来评估方法学质量。

结果
在评估了21篇出版物后，发现结果被评估并总结为七个关键主题：i）成人重症监护单元中PR应用的高流行率；ii）PR应用的决定因素；iii）成人重症监护单元中PR的类型；iv）PR的决策者；v）PR应用中的道德和伦理困境；vi）PR应用的意识和指南；vii）PR应用中的常见并发症及镇静剂、镇痛剂、抗精神病药物的使用。

结论
PR使用天数与不良事件风险相关。为了标准化护理实践，ICU护士需要接受更多关于PR使用理念的训练。基于证据的建议将帮助重症监护护士在PR使用方面做出最佳判断。
review_content_zh:
感谢您提供机会审阅这篇手稿。这篇综合性综述的目的是考察近期关于在成人重症监护中使用物理约束（PR）的证据。这是一个重要的话题，尽管我赞赏所进行的工作，但我对研究的创新性感到疑惑，即这篇综述对文献有何贡献？该研究的方法/发现是否新颖？这篇综述的发现与以下综述的发现有何不同、扩展或补充：Perez D等人，2019年（参考文献1），Alostaz Z等人，2022年（参考文献2）。
综述的理据和目标已陈述，但我建议增强一致性。例如，尽管摘要中提到目的是“考察近期关于在成人重症监护中使用PR的证据”，但手稿正文中却提到“通过使用以下问题，本综述将探讨关于在成人重症监护中使用PR的最佳可用证据：1）PR的患病率；2）影响PR的因素；3）护士在实施PR中的作用；4）护士照顾使用PR的患者的经验；以及5）应用PR的并发症。”此外，在搜索方法部分，提到“本研究的目的是对成人重症监护单元中PR的可用证据进行全面评估。”
请注意，没有报告问题来支持句子“通过使用以下问题”。
需要更多细节以允许复制这篇综述。例如，提供其中一个数据库（如Medline）的完整搜索策略将有所帮助。
在讨论排除标准的部分，研究人员似乎主要概述了他们如何限制搜索，而不是明确排除研究的标准。为了提高这篇综述的可复制性，我建议明确陈述预定的排除标准。例如，排除化学约束研究、在ICU以外任何其他环境中进行的研究、以往的文献综述、社论和会议摘要等。
最后，我建议审查文章中使用的语法，因为时态（现在时、过去时、将来时）存在混淆。例如，在目标部分提到“本综述将探讨……”。这里应使用过去时，且全文中有多处类似情况。

reasons: The authors performed an integrative review which included comprehensively all research designs -i.e., quantitative, qualitative, mixed methodologies, and quality improvement projects.

Twenty-one published articles were scrutinized according to the PRISMA protocols and the findings were evaluated and summarized into seven key topics which are insightful for future researchers to consider when it comes to adult critical care.
Finally, I would recommend a review of the grammar used in the article as there was a mix-up of tenses (present, past, future).
For example, under the aim it says "this review will look into...".
Past tense should be used here, and there are many instances throughout.

paper_title: Information and communication integration in smart factory design
paper_abstract: Strategic smart factory design is essential to utilize Industry 4.0 technologies in production environments effectively. Although a series of earlier reviews in the context of smart manufacturing have been published, so far none addresses smart factory design, i. e. the planning and operation of smart factories.  This review provides an overview of recent research in the field by systematizing opportunities, risks and success factors of smart factory design as available from recent empirical studies (2018-2022). Businesses are informed how smart factory design should be approached and implemented to realize cost advantages and increase competitiveness. Academic research benefits of a classification of relevant issues and open research fields are outlined.
review_content:

paper_title_zh: 智能工厂设计中的信息与通信集成

paper_title: Dual mechanisms governing reward-driven perceptual learning
paper_abstract: In this review, we explore how reward signals shape perceptual learning in animals and humans. Perceptual learning is the well-established phenomenon by which extensive practice elicits selective improvement in one’s perceptual discrimination of basic visual features, such as oriented lines or moving stimuli. While perceptual learning has long been thought to rely on ‘top-down’ processes, such as attention and decision-making, a wave of recent findings suggests that these higher-level processes are, in fact, not necessary.  Rather, these recent findings indicate that reward signals alone, in the absence of the contribution of higher-level cognitive processes, are sufficient to drive the benefits of perceptual learning. Here, we will review the literature tying reward signals to perceptual learning. Based on these findings, we propose dual underlying mechanisms that give rise to perceptual learning: one mechanism that operates ‘automatically’ and is tied directly to reward signals, and another mechanism that involves more ‘top-down’, goal-directed computations.
review_content:
I have greatly enjoyed reading this engaging and inspiring review article. The authors of the article provide a concise and highly focused review of the recent literature on visual perceptual learning, and notably of the so-called task-irrelevant perceptual learning (TIPL). The main thrust of the article is to draw a distinction between an automatic form of TIPL, whereby the repeated occurrence of reward in close temporal contiguity with a visual stimulus (feature) determines perceptual learning of that stimulus (feature), and a more complex and cognitively demanding form of perceptual learning, whereby perceptual learning occurs as a result of the task-dependent contingency between a given stimulus (feature) and reward.

I find this dichotomous view of perceptual learning, and of its modulation by reward, especially captivating and important, especially because we have recently elaborated a similar distinction between types of reward-dependent learning in the attentional domain that conform to classical conditioning and types that conform to operant conditioning (Chelazzi et al., 2013). Similar to what elaborated here, in prior studies (Della Libera et al., 2011) we could detect an impact of reward on attentional learning that conformed to classical conditioning using task variants in which participants were led to believe that rewards were received independently of their performance, in a lottery-like fashion. Conversely, in other work (Della Libera & Chelazzi, 2009) we could detect an impact of reward on attentional learning that conformed to operant conditioning using task variants in which participants were led to believe that rewards received in relation to specific stimuli depended on their attentional performance towards the same stimuli. I actually encourage the authors to note such remarkable consistency between notions that are being developed within the domain of perceptual learning and similar notions that are being developed within the domain of attentional learning. In this regard, it is important to eliminate any potential confusion. Perceptual learning refers to improvements in perceptual performance (increased sensitivity) in relation to specific stimuli (features) as a result of prolonged practice with/exposure to the stimuli (features). In contrast, attentional learning refers to an increase in the efficiency with which participants are able to select, or sometimes ignore, specific stimuli within multi-elements displays. It might well be the case that the two learning phenomena are intimately related, but such a possibility has never been formally tested, at least to the best of my knowledge.

One aspect that the authors of the present article might want to elaborate on further is the way in which they conceive the task goal-dependency of the perceptual learning effects necessitating top-down control. In operant conditioning, the key link between a given stimulus and reward is the behavioral response directed towards the stimulus. Reward can only be obtained to the extent that an instrumental response is produced towards the stimulus. Any contingency between the stimulus and reward is not sufficient to elicit operant conditioning. In keeping with this notion, in our own work (Chelazzi et al., 2013) we have proposed that in the operant conditioning-like context, the cognitive system is shaped by reward in such a way that particular attentional operations (either selection or suppression, which, in different terms, can be named prioritization or deprioritization) are reinforced in relation to specific stimuli. In this perspective, what is being learned is a specific cognitive act in relation to a given stimulus and the learning is guided by the reward contingency.

As a further development of the distinction put forward by the authors, I suggest that most likely the two forms of perceptual learning ought to differ in other important ways, including the resistance to extinction, the level of generalization across stimuli and tasks, and so forth.

One other aspect that the authors might want to consider is the extent to which the task-dependency of what they describe as the second and more complex form of perceptual learning actually requires that top-down control is exerted in relation to the stimulus for which learning is measured or whether for this type of learning to occur it is sufficient that top-down control is exerted in relation to any stimulus, not necessarily the one for which learning is measured. In the latter scenario, top-down control is engaged, though it is not directed towards the stimulus for which learning is measured, performance monitoring processes are at work, and any resulting reward is linked to ongoing performance. I suppose that this level of top-down control may be sufficient for the second type of perceptual learning to materialize.

Finally, Title and abstract are perfectly adequate.
paper_title_zh: 奖励驱动感知学习的双重机制
paper_abstract_zh: 在本综述中，我们探讨了奖励信号如何塑造动物和人类的感知学习。感知学习是一种确立已久的现象，通过大量练习可以引发个体对基本视觉特征（如定向线条或运动刺激）的感知辨别能力的选择性提升。虽然长期以来感知学习被认为依赖于“自上而下”的过程，如注意力和决策，但最近的一系列发现表明，这些更高级的过程实际上并非必要。相反，这些新发现指出，仅凭奖励信号，在没有更高级认知过程参与的情况下，足以驱动感知学习的益处。在此，我们将回顾将奖励信号与感知学习联系起来的文献。基于这些发现，我们提出了导致感知学习的双重潜在机制：一种“自动”运作且直接与奖励信号相关的机制，以及另一种涉及更多“自上而下”、目标导向计算的机制。
review_content_zh:
我非常享受阅读这篇引人入胜且富有启发性的综述文章。文章的作者们对近期关于视觉感知学习的文献进行了简洁且高度集中的回顾，尤其是对所谓的任务无关感知学习（TIPL）进行了重点讨论。文章的主要论点是区分两种TIPL形式：一种是自动形式的TIPL，即奖励在时间上与视觉刺激（特征）紧密连续重复出现，决定了该刺激（特征）的感知学习；另一种是更为复杂且认知需求较高的感知学习形式，即感知学习的发生依赖于任务相关的刺激（特征）与奖励之间的关联。

我发现这种对感知学习的二分法，以及其受奖励调节的观点，特别吸引人且重要，尤其是我们最近在注意力领域也阐述了类似的奖励依赖学习的区分，即符合经典条件反射的类型和符合操作性条件反射的类型（Chelazzi等人，2013年）。与本文所述类似，在我们之前的研究中（Della Libera等人，2011年），我们通过使用任务变体，使参与者相信奖励是独立于其表现以类似彩票的方式获得的，从而检测到符合经典条件反射的奖励对注意力学习的影响。相反，在另一项工作中（Della Libera & Chelazzi，2009年），我们通过使用任务变体，使参与者相信特定刺激相关的奖励取决于其对相同刺激的注意力表现，从而检测到符合操作性条件反射的奖励对注意力学习的影响。我实际上鼓励作者们注意感知学习领域和注意力学习领域正在发展的概念之间这种显著的连贯性。在这方面，消除任何潜在的混淆是很重要的。感知学习指的是通过长时间练习/暴露于特定刺激（特征）而导致的感知性能（敏感性增加）的改善。相比之下，注意力学习指的是参与者在选择或有时忽略多元素显示中的特定刺激时的效率增加。这两种学习现象可能密切相关，但据我所知，这种可能性从未经过正式测试。

本文作者可能希望进一步阐述的一个方面是他们如何理解感知学习效果的任务目标依赖性需要自上而下的控制。在操作性条件反射中，特定刺激与奖励之间的关键联系是针对刺激的行为反应。只有产生针对刺激的工具性反应，才能获得奖励。刺激与奖励之间的任何关联都不足以引发操作性条件反射。与这一观点一致，在我们自己的工作中（Chelazzi等人，2013年），我们提出在类似操作性条件反射的情境中，认知系统通过奖励以特定方式塑造，使得特定的注意力操作（无论是选择还是抑制，用不同术语可以称为优先化或去优先化）在与特定刺激相关时得到强化。从这个角度来看，所学习的是针对特定刺激的具体认知行为，且学习由奖励关联引导。

作为对作者提出的区分的进一步发展，我建议这两种感知学习形式很可能在其他重要方面也有所不同，包括对消退的抵抗力、跨刺激和任务的泛化水平等等。

作者可能还希望考虑的另一个方面是，他们所描述的更为复杂的第二种感知学习的任务依赖性，究竟是否需要自上而下的控制作用于所测量学习的刺激，还是这种类型的学习只需自上而下的控制作用于任何刺激，而不一定是所测量学习的刺激。在后一种情况下，虽然自上而下的控制被激活，但并未指向所测量学习的刺激，性能监控过程在起作用，任何由此产生的奖励都与当前表现相关联。我认为这种程度的自上而下控制可能足以使第二种感知学习实现。

最后，标题和摘要完全恰当。

reasons: The authors of the article provide a concise and highly focused review of the recent literature on visual perceptual learning, and notably of the so-called task-irrelevant perceptual learning (TIPL).
I have greatly enjoyed reading this engaging and inspiring review article.
Finally, Title and abstract are perfectly adequate.

What should be done next? Are additional experimental demonstrations for task-irrelevant perceptual learning required? At this moment a rather limited set of stimulus parameters have been used in task-irrelevant PL paradigms. Does one need additional tests, for example by using other stimulus features, other sensory modalities? What about comparative experiments including other species? What about causal experiments trying to identify structures driving PL-dependent plasticity?

paper_title: Benzydamine hydrochloride: an overview on a well-established drug with news in mechanisms of action
paper_abstract:
Pain and inflammation are the consequences of sore throat, dental and oral procedures, infections, ulcers and head and neck chemotherapy/radiotherapy, and their management is of fundamental importance to avoid distress in patients. 
  Benzydamine hydrochloride (HCl) is a topical indolic nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug, endowed with analgesic and anesthetic activity, and with antimicrobial (including both gram-positive and gram-negative bacteria) and antifungal properties (targeting Candida albicans and non-albicans strains), used in odontostomatology, otorhinolaryngology, and gynecology for its properties. This molecule has a lipophilic nature, showing high affinity with cell membranes and exhibiting membrane stabilization properties, resulting in local anesthesia, an effect related also to the interaction of the drug with cationic channels. Unlike other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs, benzydamine HCl is a weak inhibitor of cyclooxygenase or lipoxygenase and consequently its primary mechanisms of action are not related to arachidonic acid metabolism and do not affect the biosynthesis of the inflammation mediators prostanoids, prostacyclin, thromboxane and leukotrienes. Benzydamine HCl is able to inhibit the production of pro-inflammatory cytokines, with consequent analgesia. Moreover, benzydamine HCl is able to inhibit leukocyte-endothelial interactions and platelet aggregation. 
  Here we review the most updated clinical data available on benzydamine HCl local application as spray, mouthwash or gargling and evidence of its effectiveness in inflammatory and/or septic conditions in the otorhinolaryngology and odontostomatology settings, with particular reference to sore throat, oral inflammation, dental plaque, tonsillitis/tonsillectomy and chemo- or radiotherapy-induced oral mucositis. Novel formulations for oral and oromucosal/buccal/intraoral administration of benzydamine HCl are also reviewed, including in situ gelling formulations to be sprayed onto the damaged oral mucosa. Finally, novel data on the potential role of benzydamine HCl in nociceptor excitability are introduced.
review_content:
This review provides a comprehensive overview of the pharmacological properties, mechanisms of action, clinical efficacy, and novel formulations of benzydamine hydrochloride (HCl). The effects of topical use are discussed in detail, particularly in conditions such as oral and throat inflammations and chemotherapy-induced oral mucositis. The article is generally well-structured, clearly written, and supported by relevant literature. However, there are several points I would like to highlight:
  * Oral administration is typically associated with gastrointestinal (GI) delivery of a drug. However, the current review focuses on both oral and oromucosal/buccal/intraoral routes of administration. Therefore, I suggest reviewing the terminology used to ensure consistency and clarity in this context.
  * Including more recent publications (post-2020) is essential to enhance the timeliness and relevance of the review.
  * Although clinical trials are described in the text, they are not presented in a tabular format. Summarizing key details such as effect size, sample size, and statistical significance in a table would significantly improve readability and provide added value for the reader.
  * Most of the clinical data emphasize positive outcomes, while negative or inconclusive results (e.g., studies showing a lack of efficacy) are rarely discussed. It would be beneficial to include a discussion on studies where the treatment was ineffective and possible reasons behind those outcomes.
  * While novel formulations such as nanoparticles, gels, or films are briefly mentioned, experimental or clinical data supporting these formulations are limited. The review would be strengthened by a more detailed discussion of the advantages and limitations of these newer delivery systems. Additionally, recent formulation studies should be incorporated to reflect current research trends. Examples include (refer 1to 3).
paper_title_zh: 盐酸苄达明：一种成熟药物的作用机制新进展综述
paper_abstract_zh:
疼痛和炎症是咽喉痛、牙科和口腔手术、感染、溃疡以及头颈部化疗/放疗的后果，其管理对避免患者痛苦至关重要。盐酸苯佐卡因是一种局部应用的吲哚类非甾体抗炎药，具有镇痛和麻醉活性，以及抗菌（包括革兰氏阳性菌和革兰氏阴性菌）和抗真菌（针对白色念珠菌和非白色念珠菌菌株）特性，因其特性在牙科口腔学、耳鼻喉科和妇科中得到应用。该分子具有亲脂性，与细胞膜具有高亲和力，表现出膜稳定化特性，导致局部麻醉，这一效果也与药物与阳离子通道的相互作用有关。与其它非甾体抗炎药不同，盐酸苯佐卡因是环氧化酶或脂氧化酶的弱抑制剂，因此其主要的药理作用机制与花生四烯酸代谢无关，不影响炎症介质前列腺素、前列环素、血栓素和白三烯的生物合成。盐酸苯佐卡因能够抑制促炎细胞因子的产生，从而产生镇痛作用。此外，盐酸苯佐卡因能够抑制白细胞-内皮细胞相互作用和血小板聚集。

在此，我们回顾了关于盐酸苯佐卡因局部应用（喷雾、漱口或含漱）的最新临床数据，以及其在耳鼻喉科和牙科口腔学环境中治疗炎症和/或感染性条件的有效性证据，特别是针对咽喉痛、口腔炎症、牙菌斑、扁桃体炎/扁桃体切除术以及化疗或放疗引起的口腔黏膜炎。还回顾了盐酸苯佐卡因的口服和口腔黏膜/颊部/口腔内给药的新配方，包括用于喷洒在受损口腔黏膜上的原位凝胶配方。最后，介绍了关于盐酸苯佐卡因在痛觉感受器兴奋性中潜在作用的最新数据。
review_content_zh:
本综述全面概述了苯佐卡因氯化物（HCl）的药理特性、作用机制、临床疗效和新型制剂。详细讨论了局部使用的效果，特别是在口腔和咽喉炎症以及化疗引起的口腔黏膜炎等情况下。文章结构合理，写作清晰，并得到了相关文献的支持。然而，我有几个要点想强调：
  * 口服给药通常与药物胃肠道（GI）输送相关。然而，当前综述关注口服和口腔黏膜/颊/口腔给药途径。因此，我建议审查在此背景下使用的术语，以确保一致性和清晰性。
  * 包含更多近期的出版物（2020年之后）对于增强综述的时效性和相关性至关重要。
  * 虽然文中描述了临床试验，但它们并未以表格形式呈现。在表格中总结关键细节，如效应量、样本量和统计显著性，将显著提高可读性并为读者提供额外价值。
  * 大多数临床数据强调积极结果，而负面或不明确的结论（例如，显示缺乏疗效的研究）很少被讨论。包括讨论治疗无效的研究及其可能的原因将是有益的。
  * 虽然简要提到了新型制剂如纳米颗粒、凝胶或薄膜，但支持这些制剂的实验或临床数据有限。通过更详细地讨论这些较新给药系统的优缺点，综述将得到加强。此外，应纳入最新的制剂研究以反映当前的研究趋势。例如（参考1至3）。

Including more recent publications (post-2020) is essential to enhance the timeliness and relevance of the review.
Most of the clinical data emphasize positive outcomes, while negative or inconclusive results (e.g., studies showing a lack of efficacy) are rarely discussed.
It would be beneficial to include a discussion on studies where the treatment was ineffective and possible reasons behind those outcomes.

paper_title: Acedia, loneliness, and the mandatory celibacy of Catholic parish clergy: a theological-sociological exploratory analysis
paper_abstract: This article utilizes the analytical concept of acedia as the fundamental theoretical framework and applies a systematic literature review of peer-reviewed materials and documents on spiritual sloth, spiritual dryness, Catholic clerical celibacy, social bonding and communal spirituality. This article explores how the Catholic parish clergy’s mandatory celibacy intensifies loneliness and facilitates the spiritual sloth of parish clergy or what is theologically known as acedia. Unlike religious priests who live in religious communities, parish clerics fundamentally live, work, and pray alone in the parish, without strong communal support from fellow priests, bishops, and lay parishioners; thus, making them prone to loneliness, a main component of acedia. This article argues that mandatory celibacy further deprives parish clerics of the social and spiritual support necessary to enhance diocesan clerical spirituality and strengthen spiritual resistance against acedia. It recommends a structural adjustment in the social and spiritual life of parish priests, creating small communities of priests situated in similar territory or districts to allow them to live and work as a team with strong social and spiritual support in the spirit of “living baptismally” to overcome priestly acedia.
review_content:
The article offers a good systematic review on the topic of acedia in Catholic celibacy clergy. From this point of view the article is exhaustive and there is few we can add.

My own empirical work on consecrated men in the Catholic Church tells me about some more circumstances to take into account. Indeed, the main thesis that the article advances is that loneliness in diocesan clergy would be a main cause of distress and even abuses. There is some evidence that points in that direction, especially for the cases of abuses, but there are surely more factors involved. Indeed, it is quite intriguing that many priests in the communitarian religious life choose in the last years to leave this condition to become diocesan lonely priests; as if this other option would be perceived as more convenient. Other factor the article does not considers is the growing "homosexualization" in several areas of Catholic clergy, which adds another level of complexity.

In my opinion we need much more empirical research, beyond reviewing the available studies, to better address this question, and to help people in that condition to cope with it.
paper_title_zh: "懒惰、孤独与天主教堂区神职人员的强制性独身：一项神学-社会学的探索性分析"
paper_abstract_zh: 本文采用“懒惰”（acedia）的分析概念作为基本的理论框架，并系统性地回顾了关于精神懒惰、精神枯竭、天主教神职人员独身、社会联结和群体灵性的同行评审材料和文献。文章探讨了天主教堂区神职人员强制性独身如何加剧孤独感，并促成堂区神职人员的精神懒惰，即神学上所称的“懒惰”。与生活在宗教团体中的宗教神父不同，堂区神职人员基本上独自在堂区内生活、工作和祈祷，缺乏来自其他神父、主教和普通教友的强大群体支持；因此，他们更容易感到孤独，这是“懒惰”的主要成分。本文认为，强制性独身进一步剥夺了堂区神职人员所需的社会和精神支持，这些支持对于提升教区神职人员的灵性和增强对抗“懒惰”的精神抵抗力至关重要。文章建议对堂区神父的社会和精神生活进行结构性调整，创建位于相似地域或区域的小型神父团体，使他们能够作为一个团队生活和 工作，获得强大的社会和精神支持，以“活出洗礼精神”来克服神职人员的“懒惰”。
review_content_zh:
文章对天主教独身神职人员中的懒惰（acedia）问题进行了良好的系统综述。从这个角度来看，文章是详尽的，我们几乎没有什么可以补充的。

我自己在天主教教会中奉献男性的实证研究告诉我还有一些其他情况需要考虑。确实，文章提出的主要论点是教区神职人员的孤独感是造成压力甚至虐待的主要原因。有一些证据指向这个方向，尤其是在虐待案例中，但肯定还涉及更多因素。实际上，令人费解的是，许多在团体宗教生活中度日的神父在近年选择离开这种状态，成为孤独的教区神父；似乎这种选择被认为更为合适。文章未考虑的另一个因素是，天主教神职人员中某些领域的“同性恋化”现象日益增长，这增加了问题的复杂性。

在我看来，我们需要更多的实证研究，而不仅仅是回顾现有研究，以便更好地解决这个问题，并帮助处于这种状况的人们应对它。

reasons: The article offers a good systematic review on the topic of acedia in Catholic celibacy clergy.
From this point of view the article is exhaustive and there is few we can add.
Other factor the article does not considers is the growing "homosexualization" in several areas of Catholic clergy, which adds another level of complexity.
It’s redundant.
The reader is told at least seven times that living alone in a parish predicts loneliness, and in turn leads to spiritual sloth (or acedia).
There’s a causal order concern I have.
The author blames celibacy, and claims it causes loneliness, which in turn prompts acedia.
But others perceive a different etiology to it—that our habits (of thought, practice, etc.) can invite acedia, which in turn fosters despair (of God’s love and mercy) and sadness.
Hence, the causal order may not be as obvious as the author suggests.

The author poses an interesting answer—the end of priestly celibacy—that is arguably unnecessary if the Church enables the formation of the author’s back-up plan: the formation of communities for priests to live in.
I think the author points more frequently to the latter, but nevertheless considers the former the central problem.

paper_title: Mobile perceived trust mediation on the intention and adoption of FinTech innovations using mobile technology: A systematic literature review
paper_abstract: The banking and financial sectors have witnessed a significant development recently due to financial technology (FinTech), and it has become an essential part of the financial system. Many factors helped the development of this sector, including the pandemics such as Covid-19, the considerable increasing market value of the FinTech sector worldwide, and new technologies such as blockchain, artificial intelligence, big data, cloud computing and mobile technology. Moreover, changes in consumer's preferences, especially the Z-generation (digital generation). FinTech shifted the traditional business models to mobile platforms characterized by ease of access and swift transactions. Mobile technology became the main backbone for FinTech innovations and acts as a channel to deliver FinTech services that overcome all geographical and timing barriers, thus enhancing financial inclusion. Mobile perceived Trust (MPT), or the trust in using financial business models via mobile technology, is a crucial factor in the FinTech context that has mediation effects on the intention and adoption of different FinTech business models. Unfortunately, few studies have explored MPT mediations on consumers' intention to adopt FinTech innovations using mobile technology. Typically, many studies examined trust/MPT as an independent and unidirectional variable and investigated its effects on behaviour intention without predicting its mediation effects. This study aimed to develop a systematic literature review on MPT mediation in FinTech, focusing on the period from 2016 and 2021, in journals ranked Q1 and Q2, and known-based theories such as the technology acceptance model, the unified theory of acceptance and use of technology, and the mobile technology acceptance model. This study found that only four articles were published in Q1 and Q2 journals. In these articles, the MPT was used as a mediator, and its effects were measured on the intention and adoption of the behaviour.
review_content:
The article, 'Mobile perceived trust mediation on the intention and adoption of FinTech innovations using mobile technology: A systematic literature review', attempted to map the literature to provide evidence for Mobile perceived trust as a meditator. The article followed the PRISMA standards.

However, I believe the following improvements can enhance the readability of the article:
 1. Only 4 articles were selected to provide a systematic review. Authors need to provide justification of this number or maybe they can broaden their search using different keywords.
 2. Each table in the paper needs to be elaborated. Tables and figures are not self-explanatory and need to be explained in the article.
 3. Minor language corrections are required.
paper_title_zh: 移动感知信任对使用移动技术的金融科技创新意图和采纳的中介作用：系统文献综述
paper_abstract_zh: 近年来，由于金融科技（FinTech）的发展，银行和金融部门经历了显著的发展，并已成为金融体系的重要组成部分。许多因素促进了该部门的发展，包括诸如新冠疫情等大流行病、全球FinTech部门市场价值的显著增加以及区块链、人工智能、大数据、云计算和移动技术等新技术。此外，消费者偏好的变化，尤其是Z世代（数字一代）的变化，也起到了推动作用。FinTech将传统商业模式转变为以易于访问和快速交易为特征的移动平台。移动技术成为FinTech创新的主要支柱，并作为提供FinTech服务的渠道，克服了所有地理和时间障碍，从而增强了金融包容性。移动感知信任（MPT），即通过移动技术使用金融商业模式的信任，是FinTech背景下一个关键因素，对采用不同FinTech商业模式的意图和采纳具有中介效应。遗憾的是，很少有研究探讨MPT在消费者通过移动技术采纳FinTech创新意图中的中介作用。通常，许多研究将信任/MPT视为独立且单向的变量，并探讨其对行为意图的影响，而未预测其中介效应。本研究旨在对2016年至2021年间在Q1和Q2级别期刊上发表的、基于技术接受模型、技术接受与使用统一理论以及移动技术接受模型等知名理论的MPT在FinTech中的中介作用进行系统文献综述。研究发现，仅有四篇文章发表在Q1和Q2期刊上。在这些文章中，MPT被用作中介变量，其效应在行为意图和采纳上进行了测量。
review_content_zh:
文章《移动感知信任对使用移动技术的金融科技创新意图和采纳的中介作用：系统文献综述》试图梳理文献，为移动感知信任作为中介变量提供证据。该文章遵循了PRISMA标准。

然而，我认为以下改进可以提升文章的可读性：
1. 仅选取了4篇文章进行系统综述。作者需要对此数量进行合理性说明，或者可以通过使用不同的关键词来扩大搜索范围。
2. 文章中的每个表格都需要详细阐述。表格和图表并非自明，需要在文章中进行解释。
3. 需要进行一些小的语言修正。

reasons: 1. Only 4 articles were selected to provide a systematic review.
Authors need to provide justification of this number or maybe they can broaden their search using different keywords.

paper_title: Factors related to loss of appetite in postoperative cardiac surgery patients: A systematic review
paper_abstract:
Background 
    Postoperative cardiac surgery patients often experience appetite loss. Although nutritional status is known to be associated with time of recovery, functional status, and length of stay, less is known about factors related to patient’s loss of appetite after cardiac surgery. This review aimed to identify and understand factors related to loss of appetite in postoperative cardiac surgery patients, systematic review with narrative summary design was applied. Data sources including CINAHL, SCOPUS, PubMed, ProQuest, ScienceDirect, ThaiLIS, ThaiJo, and E-Thesis were searched without restriction on publication year through August 2020. 
  
  
    Methods 
    We conducted the review following the Joanna Briggs Institute methodology, using the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-analyses (PRISMA) checklist to categorize methodological quality and the PRISMA flow diagram to record the studies’ factors. 
  
  
    Results 
    Six studies reported one or more of 16 factors related to loss of appetite: older age, sex (female), illiteracy, history of chronic disease, not knowing someone in health field, pain score ≥ 7, pain medications containing codeine, constipation, depression, heart-lung machine ≥ 120 minutes, preoperative serum creatinine levels ≥ 179 µmol/L, emergency surgery, perfusion pressure ≤ 40 mmHg, low cardiac output syndrome, mechanical ventilation ≥ 96 hours, and a New York Heart Association class III and IV. 
  
  
    Conclusion 
    The small number of publications restrict our conclusions. Future research should focus on multiple factors related to appetite loss in postoperative cardiac surgery patients. Additional research will provide a foundation for evidence-based interventions to reduce appetite loss and improve patient nutritional status after cardiac surgery. Nurses and other health professionals should assess postoperative cardiac surgery patients for the presence of the 16 significant factors. To promote patients’ nutritional status, there should be evidence-based practice guidelines on the management of postoperative symptoms such as pain management, treatment of constipation, and reduction of emotional stress and depression.
review_content:
This manuscript is a well-organized systematic review summarizing loss of appetite in cardiac surgery patients, providing clinically valuable information. Furthermore, loss of appetite, and subsequent malnutrition, are highly likely to affect patient prognosis, making this an extremely important report. The methodology, synthesis, and presentation of results in this systematic review adhere to guidelines and are appropriate.

I have one point to raise:

Table 3 summarizes the included studies, but how was loss of appetite, the focus of this review, diagnosed? There is no clinical consensus on how to diagnose loss of appetite, and summarizing the diagnostic criteria used in previous studies would be very helpful. Please add this information to Table 3.
paper_title_zh: 术后心脏手术患者食欲丧失相关因素的系统综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景
术后心脏手术患者常经历食欲减退。尽管营养状况与恢复时间、功能状态和住院时长相关，但对心脏手术后患者食欲减退相关因素的了解较少。本综述旨在识别和理解术后心脏手术患者食欲减退的相关因素，采用系统综述与叙述性总结设计。数据来源包括CINAHL、SCOPUS、PubMed、ProQuest、ScienceDirect、ThaiLIS、ThaiJo和E-Thesis，检索时间截至2020年8月，无发表年份限制。

方法
我们按照乔安娜·布里格斯研究所的方法学进行综述，使用系统综述和荟萃分析优先报告项目（PRISMA）清单对方法学质量进行分类，并用PRISMA流程图记录研究的因素。

结果
六项研究报告了与食欲减退相关的16个因素中的一个或多个：高龄、性别（女性）、文盲、慢性病史、不认识医疗领域人士、疼痛评分≥7、含可待因的止痛药、便秘、抑郁、心肺机使用≥120分钟、术前血清肌酐水平≥179 µmol/L、急诊手术、灌注压≤40 mmHg、低心排综合征、机械通气≥96小时，以及纽约心脏协会III级和IV级。

结论
发表文献数量较少限制了我们的结论。未来研究应关注术后心脏手术患者食欲减退的多个相关因素。进一步研究将为基于证据的干预措施提供基础，以减少食欲减退并改善心脏手术后患者的营养状况。护士和其他卫生专业人员应评估术后心脏手术患者是否存在这16个显著因素。为促进患者营养状况，应有基于证据的实践指南来管理术后症状，如疼痛管理、便秘治疗以及减少情绪压力和抑郁。
review_content_zh:
该手稿是一篇组织良好的系统综述，总结了心脏手术患者食欲减退的情况，提供了具有临床价值的信息。此外，食欲减退以及随之而来的营养不良，极有可能影响患者的预后，使得这份报告极为重要。该系统综述的方法学、结果的综合与呈现均遵循指南，且适宜。

我有一点需要指出：

表3总结了所包含的研究，但作为本综述重点的食欲减退是如何诊断的？关于如何诊断食欲减退，临床上尚无共识，总结以往研究中使用的诊断标准将非常有帮助。请在表3中添加这一信息。

reasons: This manuscript is a well-organized systematic review summarizing loss of appetite in cardiac surgery patients, providing clinically valuable information.
Furthermore, loss of appetite, and subsequent malnutrition, are highly likely to affect patient prognosis, making this an extremely important report.
The methodology, synthesis, and presentation of results in this systematic review adhere to guidelines and are appropriate.
There is no clinical consensus on how to diagnose loss of appetite, and summarizing the diagnostic criteria used in previous studies would be very helpful.

paper_title: Youth athletes and wearable technology
paper_abstract: Wearable sensors have become integral tools for monitoring biomechanical and physiologic aspects of athletic training and performance. A prominent trend in fitness technology, wearable devices now measure a variety of health characteristics, including movement and posture, physiologic measures (eg, heart rate and energy expenditure), and fluid and electrolyte losses, to understand an athlete’s physiologic responses during activity. Sleep has proven integral to athletic performance, and sleep monitoring wearable devices (eg, watches, rings, and headbands) use various measures, such as actigraphy and pulse oximetry, to analyze sleep quality. Young athletes benefit from wearable devices during training sessions, where multimodal data are collected and analyzed to assess performance. Wearable devices are also useful for resistance training, biofeedback, and electrical muscle stimulation, providing athletes with tools to optimize their training regimens. Moreover, these devices play a crucial role in athlete safety by monitoring cardiac physiology, head impacts, and muscle rehabilitation after injury. We provide a comprehensive review of current wearable technology and its application in youth athletics, describe where and how these sensors are used to help enhance physiologic, biomechanical, and performance parameters, and discuss future directions for wearable devices to advance sports science and athlete management.
review_content:
Dear authors,
I commend you all for taking on what is a huge subject that requires much focus and dedication. However, I cannot recommend your indexing in its current form as much of your literature and topics simply do not provide a clear link to youth. Firstly, you need to define what you mean by youth. A youth athlete will vary significantly depending on their age - biomechanics, physiology, motor control, sleep, reaction time ... all will vary simply due to the level of maturation of the youth athlete. You need to consider these factors when reviewing why a wearable will be used, how it will be used, when it will be used, why it will be used (i.e., as a motivational tool?), and where (in school, out of school, recreational activity, sport).

I have provided examples below.

Abstract
Comment 1: Define Youth.

Assessment of activity and health
Comment 2: The subheading talks to movement and physical activity tracking, yet the opening paragraph mentions sport. There is a huge difference between sport, physical activity and movement tracking. I suggest you define these terms.

The information listed here is very informative, yet I cannot see a tangible link to youth. What evidence exists that youth are using wearables to monitor step count? A school-based intervention may increase youth participation in wearable usage, but it is unclear how your summary relates to youth either in an education setting or external (recreational).

Heart rate and heart rate variability monitoring
Comment 3: The same issue exists here I’m afraid as this reads more like a literature review of wearables and not a review of how, why, when, and how youth use them. For instance, you talk about an athlete’s heart. The youth heart and contractile elements are still growing depending on the child’s age. How would wearable technology be used here? And why would a youth athlete use it and not the coach? There is no linkage between the information presented and the contemporary youth athlete.

Energy expenditure, Sweat sensing and Sleep monitoring
Comment 4: And again. Great information, but why is this relevant for a youth athlete? It is highly debatable if a youth athlete would monitor sweat rates as this implies that the youth understands basic physiological changes and responses to activity. Moreover, given that youth athletes have immature physiological systems and varied responses to exercise intensity, how would the wearable data be used? There must be a stronger and more robust link to the information provided and the topic of youth athletes.

Performance feedback for training
Comment 5: You state that ‘most existing technology uses wearable inertial measurement unit (IMU) or force sensors to measure the joint angles, accelerations, and interaction forces of young athletes.’ This needs a citation. Also, an IMU won’t measure the joint angle but will provide angular acceleration or a velocity component.
You also state that ‘these devices then use data analysis methods and classification-based machine learning (ML) algorithms to assess performance during the training session.’ Is this correct? Many IMU do not rely on machine learning but simply require the transfer of raw data. Also, you are implying that this is real-time data analysis. How is the data being fed back to the youth athlete?
The rest of this section is confusing. You mention a Kalman filter but there is no context applied whatsoever. Also, laboratory wearable systems are mentioned. The general purpose of wearable systems is to avoid the lab environment. My biggest concern is that much of the literature stated here does not relate to youth. Many of the studies that you have cited are not based on youth activity or youth wearables.

Resistance training
Comment 6: How can “wearable devices can also improve the performance of young athletes during resistance training.”? Adolescent resistance training requires knowledge of sets, reps, recovery periods, relative strength of the youth, appropriate loading and correct technique. You’ve included studies that have not focused on youth.

Biofeedback
Comment 7: What wearables are being referred to? Biofeedback is hugely complex and there is no consideration for the age of the youth or level of maturation. Is the wearable being used as a educational tool for the youth athlete? How is the data being used?

Muscle stimulation
Comment 8: There are huge ethical considerations with muscle stimulation techniques in children under the age of 18, yet these are not mentioned.

Athletic motivation
Comment 9: This is arguably the most important section as wearables and relative data can be used as motivational tool and/or as a learner centric tool for youth, yet this isn’t expanded on. I would expect to see references for efficacy, goal-setting, self-determination theory, etc.

Rehabilitation of athletes
Comment 10:. Is “the US is experiencing a shortage of rehabilitation therapists”? If so, where is the citation?
There is no mention of tele-health or how wearables could be used by a therapist to monitor training loads or peaks with the athlete reporting back on progress.
Training and performance enhancement

Comment 11: Everything that you have stated is correct, but again the question is how? How does this relate to young athletes? How can young athletes uses wearables to monitor performance? How can this fit with long term athletic development models to progress performance?

Global positioning system
Comment 12: And here. Why would a young athlete use GPS? This has to link to a goal, a motivation or similar.

I reviewed the section on IMU sensors to Future directions of wearable technology in sports. The latter section at least makes a clear link to the youth athlete. The other sections simply do not provide a link or a rationale to the relevance of youth.
paper_title_zh: 青年运动员与可穿戴技术
paper_abstract_zh: 可穿戴传感器已成为监测运动训练和表现中生物力学和生理学方面的重要工具。作为健身技术的一个显著趋势，可穿戴设备现在能够测量多种健康特征，包括运动和姿势、生理指标（例如，心率和能量消耗）以及液体和电解质流失，以了解运动员在活动中的生理反应。睡眠已被证明对运动表现至关重要，睡眠监测可穿戴设备（例如，手表、戒指和头带）使用多种测量方法，如活动记录法和脉搏血氧仪，来分析睡眠质量。年轻运动员在训练期间从可穿戴设备中受益，其中收集和分析多模态数据以评估表现。可穿戴设备还适用于抗阻训练、生物反馈和电肌肉刺激，为运动员提供优化训练方案的工具。此外，这些设备通过监测心脏生理学、头部撞击和受伤后的肌肉康复，在运动员安全方面发挥着至关重要的作用。我们对当前可穿戴技术及其在青少年运动中的应用进行了全面综述，描述了这些传感器在何处以及如何用于帮助提升生理学、生物力学和表现参数，并讨论了可穿戴设备在推进运动科学和运动员管理方面的未来方向。
review_content_zh:
尊敬的作者们：

我赞赏你们所有人勇于承担这一需要大量专注和奉献的宏大课题。然而，在当前的形式下，我无法推荐你们的索引，因为你们的大量文献和主题并没有清晰地与青少年联系起来。首先，你们需要定义你们所指的“青少年”。青少年运动员的年龄差异会显著影响其生物力学、生理学、运动控制、睡眠、反应时间……所有这些都会仅仅因为青少年运动员的成熟水平而有所不同。在回顾为何使用可穿戴设备、如何使用、何时使用、为何使用（例如，作为激励工具？）以及在哪里使用（在学校、校外、娱乐活动、体育）时，你们需要考虑这些因素。

我在下方提供了示例。

摘要
评论1：定义“青少年”。

活动与健康评估
评论2：小标题讨论的是运动和身体活动追踪，然而开头段落提到了体育。体育、身体活动和运动追踪之间存在巨大差异。我建议你们定义这些术语。

此处列出的信息非常具有启发性，然而我看不到与青少年的具体联系。有什么证据表明青少年正在使用可穿戴设备来监测步数？基于学校的干预可能会增加青少年对可穿戴设备的使用，但你们摘要中的内容与教育环境内外的青少年之间的关联并不清晰。

心率及心率变异性监测
评论3：这里同样存在相同的问题，因为这部分读起来更像是对可穿戴设备的文献综述，而不是对青少年如何、为何、何时以及如何使用它们的综述。例如，你们提到了运动员的心脏。青少年的心脏和收缩元素仍在根据孩子的年龄而生长。在这种情况下如何使用可穿戴技术？为什么是青少年运动员使用它而不是教练？所提供的信息与当代青少年运动员之间没有联系。

能量消耗、汗水感应和睡眠监测
评论4：同样如此。信息很棒，但这与青少年运动员有何相关？青少年运动员是否会监测汗率是高度可质疑的，因为这暗示青少年理解基本的生理变化和对活动的反应。此外，鉴于青少年运动员的生理系统尚未成熟且对运动强度的反应各异，可穿戴数据将如何使用？所提供的信息与青少年运动员主题之间必须有一个更强健的联系。

训练性能反馈
评论5：你们指出“大多数现有技术使用可穿戴惯性测量单元（IMU）或力传感器来测量青少年运动员的关节角度、加速度和交互力。”这需要引用。此外，IMU不会测量关节角度，但会提供角加速度或速度分量。
你们还指出“这些设备然后使用数据分析方法和基于分类的机器学习（ML）算法来评估训练期间的表现。”这是正确的吗？许多IMU并不依赖机器学习，而只需传输原始数据。此外，你们暗示这是实时数据分析。数据是如何反馈给青少年运动员的？
本节的其余部分令人困惑。你们提到了卡尔曼滤波器，但完全没有应用任何上下文。还提到了实验室可穿戴系统。可穿戴系统的一般目的是避免实验室环境。我最担心的是，此处引用的许多文献与青少年无关。你们引用的许多研究并非基于青少年活动或青少年可穿戴设备。

抗阻训练
评论6：如何“可穿戴设备还可以提高青少年运动员在抗阻训练中的表现。”？青少年抗阻训练需要了解组数、次数、恢复期、青少年的相对力量、适当的负荷和正确的技术。你们包含的研究并未聚焦于青少年。

生物反馈
评论7：指的是哪些可穿戴设备？生物反馈极为复杂，且没有考虑到青少年的年龄或成熟水平。可穿戴设备是作为青少年运动员的教育工具吗？数据是如何使用的？

肌肉刺激
评论8：在18岁以下儿童中使用肌肉刺激技术存在巨大的伦理考量，然而这些并未被提及。

运动动机
评论9：这可以说是最重要的部分，因为可穿戴设备和相关数据可以作为激励工具和/或作为青少年的以学习者为中心的工具，然而这一点并未展开。我期望看到关于有效性、目标设定、自我决定理论等的引用。

运动员康复
评论10：美国是否“正在经历康复治疗师的短缺”？如果是，引用在哪里？
没有提到远程医疗或治疗师如何使用可穿戴设备来监测训练负荷或峰值，并由运动员报告进展。
训练和性能提升

评论11：你们所陈述的一切都是正确的，但问题还是如何？这与青少年运动员有何关系？青少年运动员如何使用可穿戴设备来监测表现？这如何与长期运动发展模型相结合以提升表现？

全球定位系统
评论12：同样在这里。为什么青少年运动员会使用GPS？这必须与目标、动机或类似因素联系起来。

我审阅了从IMU传感器到体育中可穿戴技术未来方向的章节。后一节至少清晰地与青少年运动员联系起来。其他部分 simply do not provide a link or a rationale to the relevance of youth.

I would expect to see references for efficacy, goal-setting, self-determination theory, etc.

What wearables are being referred to? Biofeedback is hugely complex and there is no consideration for the age of the youth or level of maturation. Is the wearable being used as a educational tool for the youth athlete? How is the data being used?
Firstly, you need to define what you mean by youth.

A school-based intervention may increase youth participation in wearable usage, but it is unclear how your summary relates to youth either in an education setting or external (recreational).

Moreover, given that youth athletes have immature physiological systems and varied responses to exercise intensity, how would the wearable data be used? There must be a stronger and more robust link to the information provided and the topic of youth athletes.

paper_title: Imaging the delayed complications of childhood Kawasaki disease
paper_abstract: This review will discuss the long-term complications of Kawasaki disease with a particular focus on imaging surveillance of the coronary arteries in adolescence and adult life. The relative advantages and disadvantages of each modality will be illustrated with practical examples, demonstrating that, in many cases, a multimodality imaging strategy may be required.
review_content:
Crean et al. have submitted their review of imaging the delayed complications of childhood KD. Authors have provided comprehensive review on the subject. However, I have few comments.
 1. Echo:
     1. Author should define difference between dilatation, ectasia, and aneurysms clearly for benefit of readers. Authors can add images of echocardiography differentiating among these terminologies.
     2. Though ECHO may be an initial modality of imaging at presentation, however as the child grows ECHO may be challenging due to smaller acoustic window, inability to demonstrate the CAAs in mid and distal segments and LCx. complications like thrombus. stenosis or mural calcifications.
     3. Ectasia is confusing terminology and nowadays not very common in use.
     4. Limitations of Echo need to be talked upon, especially identification of distal aneurysms, thrombosis, stenosis, calcifications.
 2. Nuclear scan: Role of nuclear imaging is need to be balanced in current era where CTCA, ECHO and CMR would be more important imaging.
 3. CMR: CMR is most useful imaging modality in the late phase of disease. Authors have detailed almost very aspect of that. However, Article is silent on MRCA. Role of MRCA needs more literature search and its role and comparison with CTCA.
 4. Cardiac CT:
     1. CTCA is definitely an imaging of choice for evaluation in an adult with history of KD.
     2. It would be important to highlight the strengths of CTCA in comparison to 2D-Echo in identification of distal coronary artery involvement, entire course of coronaries, LCX, complications, stenosis etc. Singhal M et al. Distal coronary artery abnormalities in Kawasaki disease: experience on CT coronary angiography in 176 children1.
     3. Radiation exposure optimization protocol.
     4. Authors describe CTCA as gate keeper modality: to be elaborated further

paper_title_zh: 儿童川崎病延迟并发症的影像学表现
paper_abstract_zh: 本综述将讨论川崎病的长期并发症，特别关注青少年和成年期冠状动脉的影像学监测。每种影像学检查方法的相对优缺点将通过实际案例进行说明，展示在许多情况下可能需要采用多模态影像学策略。
review_content_zh:
Crean等人提交了关于儿童川崎病（KD）延迟并发症成像的综述。作者对该主题进行了全面的综述。然而，我有几点评论。
1. 超声心动图（Echo）：
   1. 作者应明确区分扩张、 ectasia（扩张）和动脉瘤之间的差异，以便读者理解。作者可以添加区分这些术语的超声心动图图像。
   2. 尽管Echo可能是初始成像手段，但随着儿童成长，由于声窗较小、无法显示中远段和左旋支（LCx）的冠状动脉瘤（CAAs）以及血栓、狭窄或壁内钙化等并发症，Echo可能具有挑战性。
   3. ectasia是一个令人困惑的术语，如今并不常用。
   4. 需要讨论Echo的局限性，尤其是对远端动脉瘤、血栓、狭窄和钙化的识别。
2. 核素扫描：在当前时代，CT冠状动脉造影（CTCA）、Echo和心脏磁共振成像（CMR）更为重要，核素成像的作用需要平衡。
3. CMR：CMR是疾病晚期最有用的成像手段。作者几乎详细描述了所有方面。然而，文章未提及MR冠状动脉造影（MRCA）。MRCA的作用需要更多文献搜索，并与CTCA进行比较。
4. 心脏CT：
   1. CTCA无疑是评估有KD病史成人的首选成像手段。
   2. 强调CTCA相较于2D-Echo在识别远端冠状动脉受累、冠状动脉全程、左旋支（LCx）、并发症、狭窄等方面的优势很重要。Singhal M等人研究了176名儿童通过CT冠状动脉造影发现的远端冠状动脉异常1。
   3. 辐射暴露优化方案。
   4. 作者将CTCA描述为“守门人”成像手段：需进一步阐述。
   5. 需要更突出钙化的检测。Chakraborty R等人使用心脏计算机断层扫描在10年以上的儿童中检测到冠状动脉异常2。
5. 心导管：作者已明确特定KD患者的导管血管造影适应症。
6. 作者提供了一个复杂KD患者的成像方法。该图在文本中未引用。最好在结论部分之前以单独的小标题扩展这一内容。作者对铷应激PET、应激灌注CMR和踏车应激Echo给予了同等重视。由于铷应激PET伴随辐射暴露，作者可以解释其方法。
7. 小错误：作者应在全文中一致使用KD作为川崎病的缩写。请检查全文中的间距和缩写。

paper_title: The history of mesowear: A review Nicole L Ackermans
paper_abstract: publications, 707 species, 1396 data points). Mesowear is a widely applied tooth wear technique that can be used to infer a herbivore's diet by scoring the height and sharpness of molar tooth cusps with the naked eye. Established as a fast and efficient tool for paleodiet reconstruction, the technique has seen multiple adaptations, simplifications, and extensions since its establishment, which have become complex to follow. The present study reviews all successive changes and adaptations to the mesowear technique in detail, providing a template for the application of each technique to the research question at hand. In addition, the array of species to which mesowear has been applied, along with the equivalent recorded diets have been compiled here in a large dataset. This review provides an insight into the metrics related to mesowear publication since its establishment. The large dataset overviews whether the species to which the various techniques of mesowear are applied are extant or extinct, their phylogenetic classification, their assigned diets and diet stability between studies, as a resource for future research on the topic.

paper_title: Self-concept in poor readers: a systematic review and metaanalysis
paper_abstract: Background. Inconsistent findings in the literature obscure whether there is the association between poor reading and poor self-concept. The aims of this systematic review and meta-analyses were to determine if there is a statistically reliable association between poor reading and poor self-concept, and if such an association is moderated by domain of self-concept, type of reading impairment, or contextual factors including age, gender, reading instruction, and school environment.
review_content: Reviewer 2 In my mind there is only one bigger issue; the small amount of studies included in the analysis. Because of that some interesting subgroup analyses were not possible. On one hand this weakens the paper but on the other hand it also brings forth the need for more studies on this topic. I'm not sure if the choice to omit papers with non-validated or -standardized papers is the best one in this case. I can understand why the authors did this but I wonder if some of the omitted papers would have been of high quality despite this flaw. Self-concept is, in the end, assessed with few questions only and some papers may have used almost equal items to the validated scales? It would be interesting to see if the results would change after entering the studies with non-standardized measures in the analysis. However, I do understand the importance of reliability and validity of measures used and the authors choice in this matter. I certainly understand the reviewer's concern here. Like ourselves, I can see that the reviewer appreciates the importance of the quality of the data, but is concerned about the power. At this very early stage of understanding the association between poor reading and poor self-concept, we (very much) wanted to avoid sending people down the wrong track by making conclusions based on data without known quality (i.e., the data could well be fine, but we cannot be sure). That said, the reviewer's suggestion about including other studies using similar measures with unknown validity is a good one. Thus, we have added the following paragraph to the Discussion (line 775 to 783): It is noteworthy that we also excluded a handful of studies that assessed self-concept with non-standardised measures with unknown reliability and validity. It might be argued that this decision was too stringent, given that some non-standardised and non-validated assessments comprise items similar to standardised and validated measures. Our decision was guided by the same principle as the exclusion of studies that did not test participants' reading: maximising quality of data. Now that a statistically reliable association between poor reading and poor self-concept has been supported by good quality data, it might be of use to see if the same results emerged including studies that used non-validated self-concept measures employing similar items to validated measures. I have added the following text to the section suggested (Methods line 150 to 160): This review differed from the registered protocol in four respects (McArthur, Francis, Caruana, Boyes, & Badcock (2016). First, we stated that we would conduct a subgroup analysis (see XXX) to determine if the strength of the association between poor reading and self-concept differs for different types (i.e., subgroups) of self-concept (e.g., reading versus academic versus social versus parent/home). In the current review, a subgroup analysis involved: (1) allocating each accepted study to the appropriate subgroup (e.g., academic self-concept); (2) calculating the mean standardised mean difference (SMD) between poor readers and a control group across all studies in each subgroup; and (3) comparing the SMDs of the subgroups to identify any statistically significant differences. Unfortunately, as explained below, there were not enough studies (i.e., at least 10) to allow us to statistically compare the strength of the associations between poor reading and different domains of self-concept. -Beginning of method, line 134, sentence starting "First,": This was a difficult sentence to follow. However, I understand that this may well vary between fields of research, so in response to this comment, I have been through and rephrased test as "assessment" or "measure" throughout the manuscript unless the measure refers to a reading test, or testing an idea/hypothesis. - Please note in the limitations that only English-speaking samples were analyzed. paper_title_zh: 阅读困难者自我概念的系统综述与元分析
paper_abstract_zh: 背景。文献中的不一致发现模糊了是否存在阅读能力差与自我概念差之间关联的问题。本系统综述和元分析的目的是确定是否存在阅读能力差与自我概念差之间的统计学可靠关联，以及这种关联是否受到自我概念领域、阅读障碍类型或包括年龄、性别、阅读指导和学校环境在内的情境因素的调节。
review_content_zh:
审稿人2：在我看来，只有一个较大的问题，即纳入分析的研究数量较少。因此，一些有趣的亚组分析无法进行。一方面，这削弱了论文的力度；另一方面，这也凸显了对该主题进行更多研究的必要性。我不确定在此情况下，选择省略未验证或未标准化的论文是否为最佳选择。我能理解作者为何这样做，但我怀疑某些被省略的论文尽管存在这一缺陷，仍可能具有高质量。毕竟，自我概念是通过少数问题来评估的，有些论文可能使用了与验证量表几乎相同的条目。如果将使用非标准化测量的研究纳入分析后，结果是否会发生变化，这将是有趣的探讨。然而，我确实理解所用测量工具的信度和效度的重要性，以及作者在此事上的选择。我完全理解审稿人此处的担忧。与我们自己一样，我可以看出审稿人也重视数据质量的重要性，但担心统计功效。在理解阅读困难和自我概念不佳之间关联的早期阶段，我们（非常）希望避免基于未知质量的数据（即，数据可能很好，但我们无法确定）得出结论，从而误导人们。话虽如此，审稿人关于纳入使用类似测量但效度未知的其他研究的建议是很好的。因此，我们在讨论部分添加了以下段落（第775至783行）：

值得注意的是，我们还排除了少数使用非标准化且信度和效度未知的测量工具评估自我概念的研究。有人可能会认为，这一决定过于严格，因为一些非标准化和非验证的评估包含与标准化和验证测量类似的条目。我们的决定遵循与排除未测试参与者阅读能力的研究相同的原则：最大化数据质量。既然高质量的统计数据已经支持了阅读困难和自我概念不佳之间的可靠关联，那么看看在使用类似条目的非验证自我概念测量工具的研究中是否得出相同结果，可能是有益的。

其他较小的问题：
- 第98行：“proffer”应改为“offer”。抱歉，这是打字错误，已修订。
- 方法部分开头：在此处更清楚地说明什么是“亚组”会更有帮助，因为你也在比较阅读困难者与其他人。这里有点难以理解具体的亚组分析是什么。这是一个很好的观点。我在建议的部分（方法第150至160行）添加了以下文本：

本次综述与注册方案（McArthur, Francis, Caruana, Boyes, & Badcock, 2016）有四个方面的不同。首先，我们表示将进行亚组分析（见XXX），以确定阅读困难与自我概念之间的关联强度在不同类型（即亚组）的自我概念（例如，阅读与学术与社交与父母/家庭）之间是否存在差异。在本次综述中，亚组分析包括：（1）将每个接受的研究分配到适当的亚组（例如，学术自我概念）；（2）计算每个亚组中阅读困难者与对照组之间标准化均数差（SMD）的平均值；（3）比较各亚组的SMD，以识别任何统计学上的显著差异。不幸的是，如以下解释，由于研究数量不足（即至少10项），我们无法在统计学上比较阅读困难与不同自我概念领域之间关联的强度。

- 方法部分开头，第134行，以“首先，”开始的句子：这个句子难以理解。抱歉，这表述笨拙。该句子已修订。
- 第301行：“knew”位置不当？我已修订这个句子，它也很笨拙。
- 第311-312行：什么干预效果？我猜这不是本文的主题？这是由于大多数Cochrane综述是针对干预研究而无意中出现的。已修正。
- 作者将自我概念问卷条目称为“测试”。这似乎有点自大？读到这一点很有趣，因为在我的主要领域（阅读）中，我们经常使用“测试”一词，没有任何自大的意图。然而，我理解这在不同的研究领域中可能有所不同，因此为了回应这一评论，我通读全文，将“测试”重新表述为“评估”或“测量”，除非该测量指的是阅读测试，或测试某个想法/假设。
