paper_title: Aligning restricted access data with FAIR: a systematic review
paper_abstract: Understanding the complexity of restricted research data is vitally important in the current new era of Open Science. While the FAIR Guiding Principles have been introduced to help researchers to make data Findable, Accessible, Interoperable and Reusable, it is still unclear how the notions of FAIR and Openness can be applied in the context of restricted data. Many methods have been proposed in support of the implementation of the principles, but there is yet no consensus among the scientific community as to the suitable mechanisms of making restricted data FAIR. We present here a systematic literature review to identify the methods applied by scientists when researching restricted data in a FAIR-compliant manner in the context of the FAIR principles. Through the employment of a descriptive and iterative study design, we aim to answer the following three questions: 1) What methods have been proposed to apply the FAIR principles to restricted data?, 2) How can the relevant aspects of the methods proposed be categorized?, 3) What is the maturity of the methods proposed in applying the FAIR principles to restricted data?. After analysis of the 40 included publications, we noticed that the methods found, reflect the stages of the Data Life Cycle, and can be divided into the following Classes: Data Collection, Metadata Representation, Data Processing, Anonymization, Data Publication, Data Usage and Post Data Usage. We observed that a large number of publications used 'Access Control' and 'Usage & License Terms' methods, while others such as 'Embargo on Data Release' and the use of 'Synthetic Data' were used in fewer instances. In conclusion, we are presenting the first extensive literature review on the methods applied to confidential data in the context of FAIR, providing a comprehensive conceptual framework for future research on restricted access data.
review_content: Reviewer 2 (Anonymous) Basic reporting The paper analyzes various practices being followed in the research community to meet the data sharing proposed by FAIR principles. The manuscript provides a detailed survey of key mechanisms involved in applying FAIR principles on restricted research data. Experimental design The identi ed research questions look appropriate however the utility of RQ2 and RQ3 should be further elaborated, i.e., how research community may take advantage of proposed categorization and whether the mature practices can be converted into some kind of standards or standard operation procedures or not? We have extended the “Problem Statement & Contributions” section to better explain RQ2 and RQ3. Moreover, under the “Synthesis” section under Methods, we have given more details on the potential use of the ontology. The records show that majority of the papers are unable to meet the criteria set by the submitted manuscript and 40 articles are selected for investigation of research questions. Theses number suggests that research community is either not aware of FAIR or the principles are not believed to improve the quality of research. A survey may be used to contact the authors of the excluded papers to verify the intention of no following FAIR principles. We agree with this statement and appreciate the suggestion. We have added this as a potential future work because we do the bene t that a survey would have on our research. Nevertheless, we believe that this is out of scope in the context of this systematic reviews. It is suggested to target papers that have received awards in conferences or journals in the study as most of the conferences consider reproducibility as key condition for such awards. Also it can be found out whether compliance of FAIR principles is a requirement for the such awards or not? Recently a few journals have appeared that particularity target publication of datasets (Data in Brief). Authors may consider including journal or conference based criteria to evaluate further the research questions. We have targeted papers that have been peer-reviewed, but not necessarily awarded in conferences or similar. Actually, when dealing with restricted data, the reproducibility aspect is not a key requirements as in another research contexts. This is because if a research is presented that uses con dential data for their analysis, then such data cannot be made public. fi fi fi fi Validity of the ndings A comprehensive discussion has been provided based on the collected data along with limitations, however authors apparently have relied on the reader for developing the inferences related to the research questions. It is suggested to provide crisp response to the research questions particularly RQ2 and RQ3. As mentioned above, we have expanded the “Statement and Contribution” and the “Synthesis” sections. We have also re-iterated in the conclusion how our results can help the community with the compliance of FAIR when researching restricted data. Authors have discussed the aspect of anonymization of data however it is suggested to investigate the aspect keeping ner granularity in mind, i.e., what kind of anonymization principles should be or already part of FAIR? The systematic review set out as a goal to understand what are the methods used when dealing with restricted/ con dential data in a FAIR manner. Therefore, we have designed it to actually answer such questions as we did know yet what types of anonymisation were included in FAIR. fi fi ff fi fi fi fi fi fi fi fi Table 2 provides elds of research categories and no example can be found that belongs to multiple elds. As the manuscript is submitted in a computer science journal, it is therefore suggested to make e ort to nd a few paper that belong to either core computer science or its constituents eld, i.e. communication networks, social network analysis, software project management etc that usually include research works involving sharing of data. The papers found were mostly belonging to the biomedical domain, which would explain the connection with con dential/restricted data. The computer science elds mentioned did not appear in our nal set of included publications, possibly because there is still not much work done that connects the FAIR principles with restricted data and, for example, the eld of “software project management”.
paper_title_zh: "将受限访问数据与FAIR原则对齐：系统综述"
paper_abstract_zh: 理解受限研究数据的复杂性在当前开放科学的新时代至关重要。尽管FAIR指导原则已被引入，以帮助研究人员使数据可查找、可访问、可互操作和可重用，但在受限数据背景下如何应用FAIR和开放性的概念仍不清楚。为支持这些原则的实施，已提出许多方法，但科学界尚未就使受限数据符合FAIR原则的适当机制达成共识。本文通过系统文献综述，识别科学家在FAIR原则背景下以符合FAIR的方式研究受限数据所应用的方法。通过采用描述性和迭代的研究设计，我们旨在回答以下三个问题：1）已提出哪些方法将FAIR原则应用于受限数据？2）所提方法的相关方面如何分类？3）所提方法在将FAIR原则应用于受限数据方面的成熟度如何？在对40篇纳入的出版物进行分析后，我们发现所找到的方法反映了数据生命周期的各个阶段，可分为以下类别：数据收集、元数据表示、数据处理、匿名化、数据发布、数据使用和后数据使用。我们观察到大量出版物使用了“访问控制”和“使用与许可条款”方法，而“数据发布禁令”和使用“合成数据”等方法则较少使用。总之，我们首次对在FAIR背景下应用于保密数据的方法进行了广泛的文献综述，为未来关于受限访问数据的研究提供了一个全面的概念框架。
review_content_zh: 审稿人2（匿名）基本报告本文分析了研究社区为满足FAIR原则所提出的数据共享而采取的各种实践。手稿提供了关于在受限研究数据上应用FAIR原则的关键机制的详细调查。实验设计所确定的研究问题看起来是合适的，但RQ2和RQ3的实用性需要进一步阐述，即研究社区如何利用所提出的分类，以及成熟实践是否可以转化为某种标准或标准操作程序？我们扩展了“问题陈述与贡献”部分，以更好地解释RQ2和RQ3。此外，在“方法”部分的“综合”部分下，我们提供了更多关于本体潜在用途的细节。记录显示，大多数论文无法满足提交手稿所设定的标准，选择了40篇文章用于研究问题的调查。这些数字表明，研究社区要么不了解FAIR，要么不相信这些原则能提高研究质量。可以通过调查联系被排除论文的作者，以验证不遵循FAIR原则的意图。我们同意这一说法，并感谢这一建议。我们已经将其作为潜在的未来工作添加进来，因为我们认为调查会对我们的研究有好处。尽管如此，我们认为这在系统综述的背景下超出了范围。建议在研究中针对在会议或期刊中获得奖项的论文，因为大多数会议将可重复性视为此类奖项的关键条件。还可以查明遵守FAIR原则是否是此类奖项的要求？最近出现了一些特别针对数据集发表的期刊（如Data in Brief）。作者可以考虑包括基于期刊或会议的标准来进一步评估研究问题。我们针对的是经过同行评审的论文，但不一定是在会议或类似场合获得奖项的论文。实际上，在处理受限数据时，可重复性方面并不是像其他研究背景那样的关键要求。这是因为如果某项研究使用了机密数据进行分析，那么这些数据不能公开。发现的有效性基于收集的数据提供了全面的讨论，并指出了局限性，但作者显然依赖读者来推导与研究问题相关的推论。建议针对研究问题特别是RQ2和RQ3提供明确的回应。如上所述，我们扩展了“陈述与贡献”和“综合”部分。我们还在结论中重申了我们的结果如何帮助社区在研究受限数据时遵守FAIR。作者讨论了数据匿名化的方面，但建议在考虑更细粒度的情况下进行调查，即哪些匿名化原则应该或已经是FAIR的一部分？系统综述的目标是了解在以FAIR方式处理受限/机密数据时所使用的方法。因此，我们设计了它来实际回答这些问题，因为我们还不知道FAIR中包含了哪些类型的匿名化。表2提供了研究领域类别，但没有找到属于多个领域的例子。由于手稿提交在计算机科学期刊上，因此建议努力找到几篇属于核心计算机科学或其构成领域的论文，例如通信网络、社交网络分析、软件项目管理等，这些领域通常包括涉及数据共享的研究工作。找到的论文大多属于生物医学领域，这可以解释与机密/受限数据的关联。所提到的计算机科学领域没有出现在我们最终包含的出版物集中，可能是因为在将FAIR原则与受限数据以及例如“软件项目管理”领域联系起来方面，仍然没有太多工作。

reasons: The identi ed research questions look appropriate however the utility of RQ2 and RQ3 should be further elaborated, i.e., how research community may take advantage of proposed categorization and whether the mature practices can be converted into some kind of standards or standard operation procedures or not?

Authors have discussed the aspect of anonymization of data however it is suggested to investigate the aspect keeping ner granularity in mind, i.e., what kind of anonymization principles should be or already part of FAIR?

A comprehensive discussion has been provided based on the collected data along with limitations, however authors apparently have relied on the reader for developing the inferences related to the research questions.
It is suggested to provide crisp response to the research questions particularly RQ2 and RQ3.
There is a limitation heading found in the article in this regard.

First part is being presented very well. Covering subject area well e.g., introduction, problem statement, background etc. but when it comes to problem solution then some weak technical stu is being observed e.g., Methods, eligibility criteria etc.
The Results section contains nothing but the detailed explanation of the selected dataset.

paper_title: Translational regulation of cell invasion through extracellular matrix—an emerging role for ribosomes
paper_abstract: Many developmental and physiological processes require cells to invade and migrate through extracellular matrix barriers. This specialized cellular behavior is also misregulated in many diseases, such as immune disorders and cancer. Cell invasive activity is driven by pro-invasive transcriptional networks that activate the expression of genes encoding numerous different proteins that expand and regulate the cytoskeleton, endomembrane system, cell adhesion, signaling pathways, and metabolic networks. While detailed mechanistic studies have uncovered crucial insights into pro-invasive transcriptional networks and the distinct cell biological attributes of invasive cells, less is known about how invasive cells modulate mRNA translation to meet the robust, dynamic, and unique protein production needs of cell invasion. In this review we outline known modes of translation regulation promoting cell invasion and focus on recent studies revealing elegant mechanisms that expand ribosome biogenesis within invasive cells to meet the increased protein production requirements to invade and migrate through extracellular matrix barriers.
review_content:
The manuscript is constructed in a way that basics of cell translation is first introduced. However, this part reads rather lengthy and key points are buried in lines. I would suggest reorganize this part to provide better readability to the whole text.

I also suggest the authors to expand on the introduction of cell migration - from a more broad migration view down to the specific type of invading through extracellular migration. mTORC1 is activated at focal adhesions and localized mRNA translation has been suggested to occur at these sites ref [1]and [2]. The differences between matrix-degrading invasion and non-degrading confined migration can also be discussed and relate to ribosomal regulation.

As for the second half of the review, the authors focus on ribosomes - its biogenesis, dyregulation of ribosomal proteins and ribosomal heterogeneity. However, the part subtitled “Ribosomal protein misexpression can drive or inhibit cell invasion in cancer cells” is not as well organized as the rest. Logical presentation of evidences and clear enunciation of views are needed.

Overall, this review is informative and fills the gap between our understanding of the central dogma and cell migration. It will help researchers in cell biology and cancer biology to grasp new directions and will be of great interest to a broad audience.
paper_title_zh: 细胞侵袭通过细胞外基质的翻译调控——核糖体的新兴作用
paper_abstract_zh: 许多发育和生理过程需要细胞侵入并迁移通过细胞外基质屏障。这种特殊的细胞行为在许多疾病中也会失调，例如免疫疾病和癌症。细胞的侵入活性由促侵入转录网络驱动，这些网络激活编码多种不同蛋白质的基因表达，这些蛋白质扩展并调节细胞骨架、内膜系统、细胞粘附、信号通路和代谢网络。尽管详细的机制研究已经揭示了促侵入转录网络以及侵入细胞独特细胞生物学属性的重要见解，但对于侵入细胞如何调节mRNA翻译以满足细胞侵入过程中强健、动态和独特的蛋白质生产需求，了解较少。在这篇综述中，我们概述了已知的促进细胞侵入的翻译调控模式，并重点介绍了最近揭示的精致机制，这些机制在侵入细胞内扩展核糖体生物生成，以满足侵入和迁移通过细胞外基质屏障时增加的蛋白质生产需求。
review_content_zh:
该手稿的结构首先介绍了细胞翻译的基础知识。然而，这部分内容显得较为冗长，关键点被埋没在行文中。我建议重新组织这部分内容，以提高整篇文章的可读性。

我还建议作者扩展对细胞迁移的介绍——从更广泛的迁移视角到通过细胞外迁移的具体入侵类型。mTORC1在焦点黏附处被激活，并且有研究表明局部mRNA翻译在这些位点发生（参考文献[1]和[2]）。也可以讨论基质降解性入侵与非降解性受限迁移之间的差异，并将其与核糖体调控相关联。

至于综述的后半部分，作者聚焦于核糖体——其生物发生、核糖体蛋白的失调以及核糖体的异质性。然而，副标题为“核糖体蛋白的异常表达可以驱动或抑制癌细胞的入侵”的部分不如其他部分组织得那么好。需要逻辑清晰地呈现证据和明确阐述观点。

总体而言，这篇综述信息丰富，填补了我们对中心法则和细胞迁移之间理解上的空白。它将帮助细胞生物学和癌症生物学领域的研究者把握新方向，并且对广大读者具有极大的吸引力。

reasons: This manuscript is very clear and very well written, and it has the advantage of highlighting a new field of investigation.
This concept opens up a very interesting field of research, with the aim of identifying the molecular players that control the interactions between translation and cell invasion.
At the same time the second aim is to reveal new therapeutic avenues, given that these mechanisms control the formation of metastases, which remain the leading cause of cancer-related death.
I would suggest reorganize this part to provide better readability to the whole text.
I also suggest the authors to expand on the introduction of cell migration - from a more broad migration view down to the specific type of invading through extracellular migration.
However, the part subtitled “Ribosomal protein misexpression can drive or inhibit cell invasion in cancer cells” is not as well organized as the rest.

paper_title: A survey on exponential random graph models: an application perspective
paper_abstract: The uncertainty underlying real-world phenomena has attracted attention toward statistical analysis approaches. In this regard, many problems can be modeled as networks. Thus, the statistical analysis of networked problems has received special attention from many researchers in recent years. Exponential Random Graph Models known as ERGMs are one of the popular statistical methods for analyzing the graphs of networked data. ERGM is a generative statistical network model whose ultimate goal is to present a subset of networks with particular characteristics as a statistical distribution. In the context of ERGMs, these graph's characteristics are called statistics or configurations.
review_content: Reviewer 3 (Anonymous) ==================================================== ## Basic reporting It is suggested to add some tables, to compare each method in detail and make the article more clearer. Thank you for comment. We strongly agree that tables and figures are very helpful for classifying and presentation in survey paper. However, our paper is an introduction of papers from various fields and we were not able to find a meaningful relation between them other than the fact that they are all using ERGMs. Because of this lack of connection, we had no idea how to make tables etc. for them. If you have any suggestion, we are happy to take that and apply that in another review round. ## Experimental design It is suggested to cite some studies about engineering. There are some outstanding research by using ERGM on communication, electrical engineering, and so on, done by engineers. Thank you for comment. In the current version we have added a section named “Wireless network modelling” between lines 592-593: “Random Geometric Graphs also known as RGGs are defined as the group of graphs which are obtained by placing a number of nodes randomly in a geometrical space and draw vertices between those nodes which their distance is less than a threshold in a given norm (Penrose & others, 2003). One issue in the wireless sensor networks is that there is not a fixed placement for the nodes in most of times. The nodes are randomly distributed and therefore the shape of connecting graph tend to be volatile (Raghavendra, Sivalingam & Znati, 2006). Studying these graphs formation and the statistical dynamics behind their formation has been extensively investigated in the literature related to RGGs (Iyer & Manjunath, 2006). For example, exponential RGGs which are the RGGs that the distribution of their nodes is also exponential. (Gupta, Iyer & Manjunath, 2008). These graphs have been used for modeling wireless sensor networks (Shang, 2009; Kenniche & Ravelomananana, 2010). In the (Shang, 2009) the wireless sensors are assumed to be on a line and to evolve over time with respect to a dynamic RGG process. The effect of statistical properties for a particular time snapshot has also been considered in this paper. Such analysis with using one-dimensional RGG has also been done in the past in (Karamchandani et al., 2006). Vehicular Ad Hoc Network are yet another use case for RGGs (Zhang et al., 2014). Due to the movement of the vehicles and the rapid changes in the graph they have many similarities to previous applications of RGGs.” And also, the part that was previously named “biological science” was actually all about medical imaging which is an engineering application, so to prevent further confusions we renamed it to “medical imaging” with some extra citation added at the end. As you can see in the current version, we have a number of engineering works being introduced. We hope that you find the current version satisfying. However, if you have any specific paper in mind we are happy to add it to our work. We have also added the following line in the “conclusions” section to further clarify our goals in the current manuscript: “However, more in depth study for applications of ERGMs in each special area of study is still needed. These domain specific studies can do further analysis on the technical side of the ERGM modelling which was not a concern of our work.” ## Validity of the findings There are no clear conclusion presented by authors. It suggested to add some conclusion about what are the appropriate methods for different problems. We have added the followings to the conclusion at the end: “However, more in depth study for applications of ERGMs in each special area of study is still needed. These domain specific studies can do further analysis on the technical side of the ERGM modelling which was not a concern of our work. Some potential future directions for future research are: There are many good papers investigated the applications of Exponential Random Graphs from social science research community. However, there is a lack of interest among engineering community in these methods. Investigating the possibilities of using ERGMs in networked data in various field of engineering studies is a research path should be considered in the future. Some examples are studies on computer network topology, internet measurement which this statistical tool might be used for prediction of missing links or for the purpose of data augmentation etc. Multilayer networks are now widely studied in different disciplines e.g. transport and economical networks. Despite some good works using state of the art ERGMs methods for multi-layer networks there is still a lack of interest in using statistical tools like ERGMs for them comparing to other methods. The hype of deep learning (LeCun, Bengio & Hinton, 2015) has made many new possibilists for combining them with traditional methods to achieve better estimation. To the best of our knowledge no work has been done to this date trying to leverage graph based deep learning methods alongside ERGMs. Despite the existence of comprehensive libraries for ERGMs like statnet, there is still no library for it written in Python. Since Python is the most used programming language in data science it is worthwhile to implement a powerful library for ERGMs modelling in Python. One possible way is to extend current widely used libraries like NetworkX (Hagberg, Swart & S Chult, 2008) to include ERGMs in them. To the best of our knowledge there is no comprehensive research on comparison of ERGMs with newly presented generative graph models like NetGAN (Bojchevski et al., 2018).” ## Comments for the author The article is clear in logic and accurate in language. It is suggested that engineering-related reviews and citations be added. Thank you for your nice comments, see ## Experimental design answers about the engineering works. --------------------------------------
paper_title_zh: 指数随机图模型综述：应用视角
paper_abstract_zh: 现实世界现象中的不确定性引起了人们对统计分析方法的关注。在这方面，许多问题可以建模为网络。因此，网络问题的统计分析近年来受到了许多研究者的特别关注。指数随机图模型（ERGMs）是分析网络数据图的一种流行统计方法。ERGM是一种生成性统计网络模型，其最终目标是将以特定特征的网络子集呈现为统计分布。在ERGM的背景下，这些图的特性被称为统计量或配置。
review_content_zh:
审稿人3（匿名） ====================================================

## 基本报告

建议增加一些表格，详细比较每种方法，使文章更加清晰。感谢您的评论。我们强烈同意表格和图表在综述文章中对分类和展示非常有帮助。然而，我们的论文是介绍来自各个领域的论文，除了它们都使用ERGMs这一事实外，我们无法找到它们之间的有意义关联。由于这种缺乏联系，我们不知道如何为它们制作表格等。如果您有任何建议，我们非常乐意在下一轮评审中采纳并应用。

## 实验设计

建议引用一些关于工程学的研究。工程师在通信、电气工程等领域使用ERGM进行了一些杰出的研究。感谢您的评论。在当前版本中，我们在第592-593行之间增加了一个名为“无线网络建模”的部分：“随机几何图（Random Geometric Graphs，简称RGGs）被定义为通过在几何空间中随机放置若干节点，并在距离小于给定范数阈值的节点之间绘制顶点所获得的图组（Penrose & others, 2003）。无线传感器网络的一个问题是，大多数情况下节点没有固定的位置。节点是随机分布的，因此连接图的形状倾向于不稳定（Raghavendra, Sivalingam & Znati, 2006）。研究这些图的形成及其背后的统计动力学在有关RGGs的文献中已得到广泛探讨（Iyer & Manjunath, 2006）。例如，指数RGGs是指其节点分布也是指数分布的RGGs（Gupta, Iyer & Manjunath, 2008）。这些图已被用于建模无线传感器网络（Shang, 2009; Kenniche & Ravelomananana, 2010）。在（Shang, 2009）中，假设无线传感器位于一条线上，并随时间根据动态RGG过程演变。该论文还考虑了特定时间快照的统计特性影响。使用一维RGG进行此类分析在过去也有过（Karamchandani et al., 2006）。车载自组织网络（Vehicular Ad Hoc Network）是RGGs的另一个应用案例（Zhang et al., 2014）。由于车辆的运动和图的快速变化，它们与RGGs的先前应用有许多相似之处。”此外，之前名为“生物科学”的部分实际上全是关于医学成像的，这是工程应用，为防止进一步混淆，我们将其更名为“医学成像”，并在末尾增加了一些额外引用。如您在当前版本中所见，我们介绍了一些工程工作。我们希望您对当前版本感到满意。然而，如果您有任何特定的论文建议，我们非常乐意将其添加到我们的工作中。我们还 在“结论”部分增加了以下内容，以进一步阐明我们当前手稿的目标：“然而，仍需要对ERGMs在每个特定研究领域的应用进行更深入的研究。这些领域特定的研究可以进一步分析ERGM建模的技术方面，而这并非我们工作的关注点。”

## 结果的有效性

作者没有提出明确的结论。建议增加一些关于不同问题适用方法的结论。我们在结论末尾增加了以下内容：“然而，仍需要对ERGMs在每个特定研究领域的应用进行更深入的研究。这些领域特定的研究可以进一步分析ERGM建模的技术方面，而这并非我们工作的关注点。一些潜在的未来研究方向包括：有许多优秀论文研究了来自社会科学研究社区的指数随机图应用。然而，工程界对这些方法的兴趣不足。探讨在工程研究各个领域的网络数据中使用ERGMs的可能性是一条未来应考虑的研究路径。一些例子包括对计算机网络拓扑、互联网测量的研究，这些统计工具可能用于预测缺失链接或用于数据增强等。多层网络目前在不同的学科中得到了广泛研究，例如交通和经济网络。尽管有一些优秀的工作使用最先进的ERGMs方法研究多层网络，但与其它方法相比，使用ERGMs等统计工具的兴趣仍然不足。深度学习（LeCun, Bengio & Hinton, 2015）的热潮为将它们与传统方法结合以实现更好的估计提供了许多新的可能性。据我们所知，迄今为止尚未有工作尝试利用基于图的深度学习方法与ERGMs相结合。尽管存在如statnet等全面的ERGMs库，但仍然没有用Python编写的库。由于Python是数据科学中最常用的编程语言，因此实现一个强大的Python ERGMs建模库是值得的。一种可能的方法是扩展当前广泛使用的库如NetworkX（Hagberg, Swart & S Chult, 2008），以包括ERGMs。据我们所知，尚未有全面研究比较ERGMs与最新提出的生成图模型如NetGAN（Bojchevski et al., 2018）。”

## 对作者的建议

文章逻辑清晰，语言准确。建议增加工程相关的综述和引用。感谢您的良好评论，参见##实验设计中对工程工作的回答。

paper_title: Gender gaps in research: a systematic review
paper_abstract:
Background 
     Despite significant advancements in closing the global gender gap, there is still much progress to be made, particularly in the field of science and scientific research. Numerous studies have addressed this issue and identified a variety of factors that contribute to gender asymmetries in research. 
   
   
     Methods 
     This study aimed to identify the determinants of gender gaps in scientific research present in the most cited studies of the past ten years as a first step towards closing these differences. Through a systematic literature review that incorporated the Proknow-C Knowledge Development Process and Constructivism methodology. 
   
   
     Results 
     The results lead us to identify four dimensions to classify the determinants of the gaps in scientific research: academic supply, research policies, scientific production and researcher profile with their respective quantitative or qualitative indicators. 
   
   
     Conclusions 
     As a potential basis for further modeling that offers greater analytical and correlational depth, as well as the identification of targeted strategies aimed at reducing gender gaps in research.
review_content:
The research addresses a very interesting and relevant topic at this time as is the identification of the determinants of gender asymmetries in scientific research and provide ideas on how to close these gaps.
The dimensions they used to classify gender gaps: academic supply, research policies, scientific production and researcher profile, seem to me appropriate and based on the existing literature, so I congratulate the authors for their choice. The tables and figures help to understand all the information in the article. The conclusions are clear, well-structured and in accordance with the research objectives. The bibliography is well selected and well used throughout the document.

Additionally, the document is well structured and well written. As a suggestion I propose:

1. Consider the inclusion of more articles from other databases, in order to avoid some biases, such as selection bias. It could also help to broaden the discussion of the research.
2. Expand the introduction so that references from other countries can be included, so that this valuable information can be used in other countries and especially background information related to the dimension of the research.
Finally, I would like once again to congratulate the authors for their excellent work.
paper_title_zh: 性别差距在研究中的系统性综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景
尽管在缩小全球性别差距方面取得了显著进展，但仍有许多工作要做，特别是在科学和科学研究领域。众多研究已探讨这一问题，并识别出导致研究中的性别不对称的多种因素。

方法
本研究旨在识别过去十年中被引用最多的研究中存在的科学研究性别差距的决定因素，作为缩小这些差异的第一步。通过结合Proknow-C知识发展过程和建构主义方法论的系统性文献综述。

结果
研究结果使我们能够识别出四个维度来分类科学研究差距的决定因素：学术供给、研究政策、科学产出和研究者概况，以及它们各自的数量或质量指标。

结论
作为进一步建模的潜在基础，该模型提供更深入的分析和相关性，以及识别旨在减少研究中的性别差距的针对性策略。
review_content_zh:
该研究探讨了当前一个非常有趣且相关的话题，即识别科学研究中性别不对称的决定因素，并提供了如何缩小这些差距的思路。
他们用于分类性别差距的维度——学术供给、研究政策、科学产出和研究者画像，在我看来是恰当的，并且基于现有文献，因此我对作者的选择表示祝贺。表格和图表有助于理解文章中的所有信息。结论清晰、结构良好，与研究目标相符。参考文献选择得当，并在全文中得到了很好的运用。

此外，该文档结构合理，写作质量高。作为建议，我提出：

1. 考虑纳入更多来自其他数据库的文章，以避免一些偏差，如选择偏差。这也有助于拓宽研究的讨论范围。
2. 扩展引言部分，以便纳入其他国家的参考文献，从而使这一宝贵信息能够在其他国家使用，尤其是与研究维度相关的背景信息。
最后，我再次对作者们的出色工作表示祝贺。

paper_title: COVID-19 vaccinations and their side effects: a scoping systematic review
paper_abstract:
Introduction: The COVID-19 virus has impacted people worldwide, causing significant changes in their lifestyles. Since the emergence of the epidemic, attempts have begun to prepare a vaccine that can eliminate the virus and restore balance to life in the entire world. Over the past two years, countries and specialized companies have competed to obtain a license from the World Health Organization for the vaccines that were discovered. After the appearance of vaccines in the health community, comparisons and fears of their side effects began, but people don’t get an answer to the question of which is the best vaccine. 
   
     Methods: IEEE Xplore, ScienceDirect, the New England Journal of Medicine, Google Scholar, and PubMed databases were searched for literature on the COVID-19 vaccine and its side effects. we surveyed the literature on the COVID-19 vaccine’s side effects and the sorts of side effects observed after vaccination. Depending on data from the literature, we compared these vaccines in terms of side effects, then we analyzed the gaps and obstacles of previous studies and made proposals to process these gaps in future studies. 
   
     Results: Overall, 17 studies were included in this scoping systematic review as they fulfilled the criteria specified, the majority of which were cross-sectional and retrospective cross-sectional studies. Most of the side effects were mild, self-limiting, and common. Thus, they usually resolve within 1–3 days after vaccination. Factors associated with higher side effects included advanced age, allergic conditions, those taking other medications (particularly immunosuppressive ones), those with a history of type II diabetes, heart disease, hypertension, COVID-19 infection, and female sex. Our meta‐analyses also found that mRNA vaccines looked to be more effective, while inactivated vaccinations had fewer side effects. 
   
     Conclusion: This review shows that the COVID-19 vaccine is safe to administer and induces protection.
review_content:
COVID-19 VACCINATIONS AND THEIR SIDE EFFECTS: A SCOPING SYSTEMATIC REVIEW
It was evaluated according to the PRISMA 2020 Checklist. The article needs major revision before indexing. My recommendations:
Is the Grandini et al.2020 study included in the 17 selected studies? If so, it is not included in Table 5, where all studies are shown.
It is mentioned as if Hatmal et al.2021 was included in the study. Although it has an explanation and evaluation, its name is not in Table 5 and the list of studies.
It is recommended that notifications be made in accordance with PRISMA 8- “Indicate the methods used to decide whether a study meets the criteria for inclusion in the review, including how many reviewers screened each record and whether each report was worked on independently and, if appropriate, details of the automation tools used in the process.”
It is recommended to make notifications in accordance with PRISMA 9- “Specify the methods used to collect data from reports, how many reviewers collected data from each report, whether they worked independently, the process for obtaining or approving data from study investigators, and details of automation tools used in the process, if any.”
It is recommended to add a study in accordance with PRISMA 16-b “Cite studies that may appear to meet the inclusion criteria but were excluded and explain why they were excluded.”
PRISMA 17- “Cite each included study and provide its characteristics.” Ma’mon,2021 is mentioned in the study but its description is not included in the Review of the conducted studies section.
It is recommended to make notifications in accordance with PRISMA 18- “Provide assessments of risk of bias for each included study.”
It is recommended to make notifications in accordance with PRISMA 22- “Provide assessments of precision (or reliability) as evidence for each outcome assessed.”
paper_title_zh: "COVID-19疫苗接种及其副作用：一项范围系统性综述"
paper_abstract_zh:
引言：新冠病毒已对全球人民产生了影响，导致其生活方式发生了显著变化。自疫情爆发以来，人们开始尝试制备一种能够消除病毒并恢复全球生活平衡的疫苗。在过去两年中，各国和专业公司竞相获得世界卫生组织对所发现疫苗的许可。疫苗在卫生社区出现后，人们开始对其进行比较并担忧其副作用，但并未得到哪种疫苗最佳的确切答案。

方法：通过IEEE Xplore、ScienceDirect、新英格兰医学杂志、Google Scholar和PubMed数据库检索有关COVID-19疫苗及其副作用的相关文献。我们调查了关于COVID-19疫苗副作用的文献以及接种疫苗后观察到的副作用类型。根据文献数据，我们比较了这些疫苗的副作用，然后分析了先前研究的差距和障碍，并提出了在后续研究中处理这些差距的建议。

结果：总体而言，共有17项研究符合指定标准，被纳入本范围系统性综述，其中大多数为横断面研究和回顾性横断面研究。大多数副作用为轻度、自限性和常见，通常在接种后1-3天内自行缓解。与较高副作用相关的因素包括高龄、过敏状况、正在服用其他药物（尤其是免疫抑制剂）者、有II型糖尿病、心脏病、高血压、COVID-19感染史以及女性性别。我们的荟萃分析还发现，mRNA疫苗似乎更有效，而灭活疫苗的副作用较少。

结论：本综述表明，COVID-19疫苗是安全的，并能诱导保护作用。

paper_title: Molecular mediators involved in skin healing: a narrative review
paper_abstract:
Background: The expression of biological mediators, such as growth factors and cytokines, after skin damage, and their balance, is important to guarantee proliferation, differentiation and migration of cells and extracellular matrix, as well as to the homeostasis during tissue remodeling. The present review means to clarify their functions over inflammation, proliferation and remodeling stages of skin regeneration. 
 Methods: Reviews, experimental studies and clinical trials included in this paper were search on PubMed database using the following terms: platelet-derived growth factor, interleukin 1, tumor necrosis factor alpha, keratinocyte growth factor, transforming growth factor beta , endothelial vascular growth factor, matrix metalloproteinase 9, tissue metalloproteinase inhibitor 1, interferon gamma, transcription nuclear factor kappa B, skin inflammation, skin cell proliferation, skin extracellular matrix and skin regeneration. 
 Results and Discussion: Several studies on the signaling mechanism of these mediators in normal and impaired healing have already been developed and have shown promising results. Currently, some of these mediators are already direct focuses of potential clinical therapies that address the treatment of acute and chronic skin wounds. These mediators, basically synthetized by platelets, macrophages, vascular endothelial cells, fibroblasts and keratinocytes, act on epidermis and dermis proliferation, hypertrophy and cell migration, resulting in formation of granulation tissue, reepithelization and extracellular matrix remodeling and angiogenesis. A better understanding of the action of these mediators can provide greater knowledge not only of their roles in the natural healing process but also in the presence of disorders that affect skin repair. 
 Conclusion: Future studies aimed to understand the mechanism of action of these mediators in the different types of cells involved in wound healing may lead to the discovery of new therapeutics to optimize the treatment of skin pathologies.
review_content:
The manuscript by dos Santos Leite et al, presents a review of the “expression of biological mediators, such as growth factors and cytokines, after skin damage, and their balance… to guarantee proliferation, differentiation and migration of cells and extracellular matrix, as well as to the homeostasis during tissue remodeling”. The stated objective is to clarify the functions of ‘biological mediators’ over inflammation, proliferation, and remodeling stages of skin regeneration. It is assumed that the reader will know that this means mammalian skin tissue. Clearly, mammals are not the only organism possessing skin tissue that is subject to injury necessitating skin repair.

It is notable that mammalian skin does not ‘regenerate’; mammalian skin ‘heals’ and is ‘repaired’. The mechanism of 'repair' is distinct to ‘regeneration’; while it restores tissue form, it does not fully restore tissue function.

This subtle distinction has direct and substantial impact on the results returned from the described PubMed search strategy. It is also notable that few of the many known cytokines, lymphokines, chemokines, fibrotic, pro-inflammatory, and anti-inflammatory mediators were not included in the search strategy, and presumably, have been overlooked. Consequently, this review should not be considered to be ‘comprehensive’.

So what value does this review offer, that is not already covered by other recent reviews of this topic? In my opinion, this review adds little to an already well-provided literature in cutaneous wound healing.

I further interpret that the authors limited perspective of cutaneous wound healing is (mis)informed by literature other than those highly-cited works by authors from the cutaneous wound healing community. Why are so few recently published works (e.g. 3 of 121 are ≥2020) included among the cited works?

What is the keyword “olecular mediators”? (Obviously an editing widow)

Why is the text formatted as a newspaper article (each sentence as a paragraph)? This is inappropriate.

[Introduction]
  * The opening sentence “Wound healing involves three basic phases…” is controversial! The most widely respected publication “Cutaneous Wound Healing” by Singer & Clark (1999)1 recognises four phases contribute to the healing of cutaneous tissue (i.e., skin). I believe the majority of practitioners in this field accept coagulation as the first of four phases of mammalian cutaneous wound healing, these being: blood clotting (hemostasis); inflammation; proliferation (tissue growth), and remodeling (tissue maturation, restoration of function).
  * So what are the “biological mediators” involved in the early (initiating) events of tissue trauma and wounding? These have been well-described by others (see for example: 2,3), yet they are absent here.
  * I am confused by the antithetical statement; “quiescent cells” proliferate and migrate? (sic) How can quiescent cells proliferate and migrate?
[Methods]
  * What is the rationale for limiting this review to “the role of some molecular mediators: PDGF, IL-1, TNF-α, KGF, TGF-β, VEGF, MMP-9, TIMP-1, IFN-γ and NF-kB”? Ironically, nearly every one of these mediators requires interaction with glycosaminoglycans to realize their biological activity; however, this critical aspect is not mentioned.
  * What is the rationale for limiting searches of the PubMed databases to “references from 1980 to 2020”? The most significant recent advance in cutaneous wound healing occurred in 1962, when George D. Winter published evidence that re-epithelisation (aka wound closure) proceeded twice as fast in a moist environment than in a dry environment4. This is outside the author’s PubMed search terms.
  * The literature cited in support of the PDGF synthesis is inappropriate. These data are from mesenchymal cells (aka. fibroblasts). Cutaneous tissue comprises epidermis, dermis and hypodermis. In humans, the epidermis is dominated by keratinocytes, cells of epithelial origin. What is the evidence keratinocytes secrete, or more importantly, respond to PDGF isoforms? Should the reader presume that PDGF synthesised in the dermis somehow traverses the basement membrane into the epidermis to act as a paracrine mediator? Critically, the key event in humans that determines the speed and quality of cutaneous wound healing is wound closure (aka ‘re-epithelialisation’). What is the evidence PDGF regulates re-epithelialisation? Insufficient detail is provided that might allow the non-expert reader to comprehend the role of PDGF in human cutaneous wound healing.
[Results]
  * The description of the role of IL-1 is superficial, and incomplete. What are M2 macrophages? What is the origin of M2 macrophages? Is there no role for IL-1 regulating the activity of M1 macrophages? What of polymorphoneutrophils (PMNs, neutrophils), the first inflammatory cells to infiltrate the site? I understand that there is evidence that neutrophils also differentiate into N1 and N2 phenotype subpopulations? What of these cells?
  * The statement: “Keratinocyte growth factor is poorly synthesized in intact skin tissue but becomes highly active in fibroblasts and keratinocytes after epithelial injury” (sic) suggests that “synthesis” and “activity” are synonymous. This statement is inaccurate. Many, probably ‘most’, “biological mediators” are synthesised in a latent (inactive) form, and require activation (e.g. by proteolysis, co-factor binding / cations, pH) before biological activity can be measured.
  * I suggest that including “Transcription nuclear factor kappa B” under its own sub-heading confers it with equivalence to the aforementioned glycoprotein mediators. This is misleading; the “NF-kB family” (acronym undefined) are nuclear transcription factors and function via a mechanism that is unlike the mechanism of glycoprotein mediators. This needs to be revised.
  * No mention is included of recent discoveries and characterizations of specialized pro-resolving lipid mediators (SPMs), micro-RNAs (miRs) nor of long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs). SPMs are synthesized at the site of tissue injury via metabolism of 3-omega fatty acids. See 5,6,7. LncRNA and miRs are synthesised by all cells and regulate many physiological events, including wound healing and tissue repair. See 8,9,10)
[Discussion]
  * Why are new data (and citations) being introduced in the Discussion? These are more appropriately included in the Results. The evidence cited in support of the statement “IL-1α and IL-1β act in the proliferation, differentiation and migration of keratinocytes, resulting in reepithelization” is inappropriate. It is not clear to this reader, what role Nrf2 and NF-κB have in angiogenesis? (Hint, they are substantial!)
  * What is the evidence that “…accelerating the inflammatory phase… consequently closing the wound”?
  * What is the evidence “TGF-β1 contributes to epidermis and dermis thickness”?
  * What is the evidence “VEGF… increases rate of wound contraction (sic) and, consequently, early skin healing”? Is the author aware that cutaneous wound healing in mice (…most mammals!) is unlike cutaneous wound healing in humans? This statement has no relevance for cutaneous wound healing in humans?
  * I repeat [page 7 of 12], “NF-kB” is NOT a “pro-inflammatory cytokine”!
  * What is the evidence “high levels TNF-α inhibits cell migration, increases MMPs synthesis and ECM degradation”? Which cell population is inhibited by TNF-α?
  * How does “NF-kB also acts on inflammation, proliferation and cell migration during skin repair, through the mediation of growth factors, collagen synthesis and MMPs, promoting re-epithelialization and tissue remodeling”? What is meant by “mediation”?
  * It is not clear, to this reader, how “Generally, these mediators were able to induce fibroblast and keratinocytes proliferation, hypertrophy and migration, resulting in a regenerated skin with a new epidermis and dermis.” (sic) Mammalian skin includes many distinct cell populations (and phenotypically distinct sub-populations). I think that while it is convenient (for the sake of simplicity), it is disingenuous to claim that biological mediators are solely responsible for “regenerated skin”. Multiple sources of evidence indicate the ECM has an equivalent, if not dominating, role in mammalian skin repair. Elements of the ECM are also ‘molecular mediators’.
  * Finally, as stated above, skin does NOT regenerate. Rather skin 'heals' and 'repairs'. Please look up what is the difference?
paper_title_zh: 皮肤愈合过程中的分子介质：一项叙事综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：皮肤损伤后生物介质（如生长因子和细胞因子）的表达及其平衡对于保证细胞的增殖、分化和迁移，以及组织重塑过程中的稳态至关重要。本文综述旨在阐明这些介质在皮肤再生炎症、增殖和重塑阶段的职能。

方法：本文纳入的综述、实验研究和临床试验均通过PubMed数据库使用以下关键词进行检索：血小板衍生生长因子、白细胞介素1、肿瘤坏死因子α、角质细胞生长因子、转化生长因子β、内皮血管生长因子、基质金属蛋白酶9、组织金属蛋白酶抑制剂1、干扰素γ、转录核因子κB、皮肤炎症、皮肤细胞增殖、皮肤细胞外基质和皮肤再生。

结果与讨论：关于这些介质在正常和受损愈合中的信号机制的研究已经开展，并显示出有希望的结果。目前，其中一些介质已成为针对急性慢性皮肤伤口治疗的潜在临床疗法的直接焦点。这些介质主要由血小板、巨噬细胞、血管内皮细胞、成纤维细胞和角质细胞合成，作用于表皮和真皮的增殖、肥大和细胞迁移，导致肉芽组织形成、再上皮化和细胞外基质重塑及血管生成。对这些介质作用机制的更好理解不仅可以提供关于它们在自然愈合过程中的作用的知识，还可以提供关于影响皮肤修复的疾病存在时的知识。

结论：旨在理解这些介质在不同类型细胞中作用机制的未来研究可能会导致发现新的治疗方法，以优化皮肤病理的治疗。
review_content_zh:
dos Santos Leite等人的手稿综述了“生物介质（如生长因子和细胞因子）在皮肤损伤后的表达及其平衡……以保证细胞和细胞外基质的增殖、分化和迁移，以及组织重塑过程中的稳态”。其明确目标是阐明“生物介质”在皮肤再生过程中的炎症、增殖和重塑阶段的功能。假定读者已知这指的是哺乳动物的皮肤组织。显然，哺乳动物并非唯一拥有易受损伤并需修复的皮肤组织的生物。

值得注意的是，哺乳动物的皮肤并不“再生”；哺乳动物的皮肤“愈合”和“修复”。修复机制与“再生”有显著区别；尽管它恢复了组织的形态，但并未完全恢复组织的功能。

这一细微差别对所描述的PubMed搜索策略返回的结果有直接且重要的影响。同样值得注意的是，许多已知的细胞因子、淋巴因子、趋化因子、纤维化、促炎和抗炎介质并未包含在搜索策略中，推测已被忽略。因此，不应将此综述视为“全面”。

那么，这篇综述提供了哪些其他近期综述未涵盖的价值？在我看来，这篇综述对已经相当丰富的皮肤伤口愈合文献贡献甚微。

我进一步认为，作者对皮肤伤口愈合的有限视角受到了除皮肤伤口愈合领域高引用作品之外文献的（错误）影响。为何引用的作品中包含的近期发表作品如此之少（例如，121篇中有3篇是2020年及以后发表的）？

“分子介质”这个关键词是什么？（显然是编辑错误）

为何文本格式像报纸文章（每句一段）？这是不恰当的。

[引言]
  * 开头句子“伤口愈合涉及三个基本阶段……”是有争议的！广受尊敬的出版物《皮肤伤口愈合》（Singer & Clark, 1999）1认为四个阶段共同促进皮肤组织的愈合（即皮肤）。我相信该领域的大多数从业者接受凝血作为哺乳动物皮肤伤口愈合的四个阶段中的第一个，这些阶段包括：血液凝固（止血）；炎症；增殖（组织生长），以及重塑（组织成熟，功能恢复）。
  * 那么，在组织创伤和伤口早期（起始）事件中涉及的“生物介质”是什么？这些已被他人详细描述（例如：2,3），但在此处缺失。
  * 我对这句自相矛盾的话感到困惑；“静止细胞”增殖和迁移？（原文如此）静止细胞如何能增殖和迁移？
[方法] * 限制本综述仅讨论“某些分子介质的作用：PDGF、IL-1、TNF-α、KGF、TGF-β、VEGF、MMP-9、TIMP-1、IFN-γ和NF-kB”的依据是什么？讽刺的是，这些介质几乎每一个都需要与糖胺聚糖相互作用才能实现其生物活性；然而，这一关键方面并未提及。
* 限制PubMed数据库搜索范围为“1980年至2020年的参考文献”的依据是什么？皮肤伤口愈合方面最重大的近期进展发生在1962年，当时George D. Winter发表了证据，表明在湿润环境中再上皮化（即伤口闭合）的速度是在干燥环境中的两倍4。这超出了作者的PubMed搜索范围。
* 支持PDGF合成的文献引用不当。这些数据来自间充质细胞（即成纤维细胞）。皮肤组织包括表皮、真皮和皮下组织。在人类中，表皮主要由角质形成细胞组成，这些细胞起源于上皮。有何证据表明角质形成细胞分泌，或更重要的是，对PDGF亚型有反应？读者是否应假设在真皮中合成的PDGF以某种方式穿过基底膜进入表皮，作为旁分泌介质发挥作用？关键在于，决定人类皮肤伤口愈合速度和质量的关键事件是伤口闭合（即“再上皮化”）。有何证据表明PDGF调节再上皮化？提供的细节不足，无法让非专业读者理解PDGF在人类皮肤伤口愈合中的作用。
[结果]
* 对IL-1作用的描述过于肤浅且不完整。M2巨噬细胞是什么？M2巨噬细胞的来源是什么？IL-1在调节M1巨噬细胞活性方面没有作用吗？首先浸润伤口部位的多形核中性粒细胞（PMNs，中性粒细胞）呢？我了解到有证据表明中性粒细胞也会分化为N1和N2表型亚群？这些细胞的情况如何？
* “角质形成细胞生长因子在完整的皮肤组织中合成较差，但在上皮损伤后在成纤维细胞和角质形成细胞中变得高度活跃”这一说法（原文如此）暗示“合成”和“活性”是同义词。这一说法是不准确的。许多，可能是“大多数”，“生物介质”是以潜伏（不活跃）形式合成的，并且需要激活（例如通过蛋白水解、辅因子结合/阳离子、pH值）才能测量其生物活性。
* 我建议将“转录核因子κB”在其自己的小标题下进行讨论，会使其与上述糖蛋白介质具有等同性。这是误导性的；“NF-kB家族”（缩写未定义）是核转录因子，其作用机制与糖蛋白介质的机制不同。这一点需要修订。 * 未提及近期发现和表征的特异性促愈脂质介质（SPMs）、微小RNA（miRs）以及长链非编码RNA（lncRNAs）。SPMs通过3-ω脂肪酸的代谢在组织损伤部位合成。参见5,6,7。LncRNA和miRs由所有细胞合成，并调控许多生理事件，包括伤口愈合和组织修复。参见8,9,10。
[讨论]
  * 为什么在讨论部分引入新数据（及引用）？这些内容更适合包含在结果部分。支持“IL-1α和IL-1β在角质形成细胞的增殖、分化和迁移中起作用，从而导致再上皮化”这一陈述的证据不恰当。对于本读者而言，Nrf2和NF-κB在血管生成中扮演什么角色尚不清楚？（提示：它们的作用是显著的！）
  * 有何证据表明“加速炎症阶段……从而闭合伤口”？
  * 有何证据表明“TGF-β1有助于表皮和真皮的厚度”？
  * 有何证据表明“VEGF……增加伤口收缩率（原文如此），从而促进早期皮肤愈合”？作者是否意识到小鼠（……以及大多数哺乳动物！）的皮肤伤口愈合与人类的皮肤伤口愈合不同？这一陈述对人类皮肤伤口愈合有何相关性？
  * 我重申[第7页，共12页]，“NF-kB”不是“促炎细胞因子”！
  * 有何证据表明“高水平的TNF-α抑制细胞迁移，增加MMPs合成和ECM降解”？TNF-α抑制了哪种细胞群体？
  * “NF-kB还通过生长因子、胶原合成和MMPs的介导，在皮肤修复过程中作用于炎症、增殖和细胞迁移，促进再上皮化和组织重塑”是如何实现的？这里的“介导”是指什么？
  * 对于本读者而言，尚不清楚“通常，这些介质能够诱导成纤维细胞和角质形成细胞的增殖、肥大和迁移，从而形成具有新表皮和真皮的再生皮肤。”（原文如此）哺乳动物皮肤包含许多不同的细胞群体（以及表型不同的亚群体）。我认为，虽然为了简化而声称生物介质是“再生皮肤”的唯一责任者是方便的，但这种说法是不诚实的。多项证据表明，ECM在哺乳动物皮肤修复中具有同等甚至主导作用。ECM的元素也是“分子介质”。
  * 最后，如上所述，皮肤并不“再生”。而是皮肤“愈合”和“修复”。请查阅这两者之间的区别？

reasons: Consequently, this review should not be considered to be ‘comprehensive’.
Why are so few recently published works (e.g. 3 of 121 are ≥2020) included among the cited works?
Clearly, mammals are not the only organism possessing skin tissue that is subject to injury necessitating skin repair.

It is notable that mammalian skin does not ‘regenerate’; mammalian skin ‘heals’ and is ‘repaired’. The mechanism of 'repair' is distinct to ‘regeneration’; while it restores tissue form, it does not fully restore tissue function.
In my opinion, this review adds little to an already well-provided literature in cutaneous wound healing.
I think that while it is convenient (for the sake of simplicity), it is disingenuous to claim that biological mediators are solely responsible for “regenerated skin”.
I understand that there is evidence that neutrophils also differentiate into N1 and N2 phenotype subpopulations?
The opening sentence “Wound healing involves three basic phases…” is controversial!
Why are new data (and citations) being introduced in the Discussion?
These are more appropriately included in the Results.
I suggest that including “Transcription nuclear factor kappa B” under its own sub-heading confers it with equivalence to the aforementioned glycoprotein mediators.
This is misleading; the “NF-kB family” (acronym undefined) are nuclear transcription factors and function via a mechanism that is unlike the mechanism of glycoprotein mediators.
This needs to be revised.
Why is the text formatted as a newspaper article (each sentence as a paragraph)? This is inappropriate.

paper_title: Industry 4.0 solutions for preventive engine maintenance: a systematic review
paper_abstract:
Background: Industry 4.0 is about to revolutionize engine maintenance and support systems with predictive and analytical technologies. Available academic research probes into different expert technologies but lacks a comprehensive overview of available standards and their interaction 
 Methods: The study conducts a systematic review based on the PRISMA Concept 2020 to provide a systematic overview on articles empirically analyzing technologies for maintenance and repair using industry 4.0 technologies. 
 Results: The review identifies four key development fields of industry 4.0 solutions for preventive engine maintenance and repair: sensor equipment, digital networks, technology integration and augmented behavior. All four technologies can be intertwined to implement industry 4.0 based solutions in the industry shopfloor. A cycle model illustrating this is derived. 
 Conclusions:   Industry 4.0 based  maintenance and repair in the shopfloor is a promising technological development field but further research is required to utilize the individual technologies consistently and integrate them into a comprehensive  digital shopfloor environment.
review_content:
Q1 Are the rationale for, and objectives of, the Systematic Review clearly stated?

While Authors have tried to look into the solutions suggestive through engine maintenance by undertaking systematic review; the PRISM concept it is still not coming clear from the Article writing skills the clear purpose of doing the research. Though Fig 1 clearly mentions the keyword selection so How part is clear but not Why.

Q4 Are the conclusions drawn adequately supported by the results presented in the review?

Discussions and conclusions seems unsynchronized with results and even in results. Authors can explain the review outcomes derived through PRISMA.
paper_title_zh: "工业4.0预防性发动机维护解决方案：系统综述"
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：工业4.0即将通过预测和分析技术革新发动机维护和支持系统。现有的学术研究探讨了不同的专家技术，但缺乏对可用标准及其相互作用的全面概述。
方法：本研究基于PRISMA概念2020进行系统综述，以提供对使用工业4.0技术进行维护和修理的技术的实证分析文章的系统概述。
结果：综述确定了工业4.0解决方案在预防性发动机维护和修理中的四个关键发展领域：传感器设备、数字网络、技术集成和增强行为。这四种技术可以相互交织，以在工业车间实施基于工业4.0的解决方案。由此推导出一个循环模型。
结论：基于工业4.0的车间维护和修理是一个有前景的技术发展领域，但需要进一步研究以一致地利用各项技术，并将它们整合到一个全面的数字车间环境中。
review_content_zh:
Q1 系统评价的理据和目标是否明确陈述？

尽管作者试图通过进行系统评价来探讨通过发动机维护提出的解决方案；但从文章的写作技巧来看，PRISM概念仍未清晰地揭示研究的明确目的。尽管图1清楚地提到了关键词选择，因此“如何”部分是清晰的，但“为何”部分却不明确。

Q4 评价中得出的结论是否得到了所呈现结果的充分支持？

讨论和结论似乎与结果不同步，甚至在结果部分也是如此。作者可以解释通过PRISMA得出的评价结果。

reasons: 5. Need to add more references which in my opinion there are at least more than 35 articles related to the topics discussed.
The research questions in this article are not explained and make the research has no objective.
However a more detailed discussion is needed to explain the development of the Smart preventive maintenance cycle.
Authors can explain the review outcomes derived through PRISMA.
Discussions and conclusions seems unsynchronized with results and even in results.

paper_title: Tourette syndrome research highlights from 2022
paper_abstract: This is the ninth yearly article in the Tourette Syndrome Research Highlights series, summarizing selected research reports from 2022 relevant to Tourette syndrome. The authors briefly summarize reports they consider most important or interesting.
review_content:
This team of scholars and practitioners have once again provided a comprehensive summary of the scientific articles published in 2022 regarding Tourette syndrome (TS) and related disorders.

This article will be a valuable resource for clinicians and researchers interested in this topic. For example, I am in the midst of preparing a chapter on Tic Disorders for the 7th edition of the Rutter Textbook on Child and Adolescent Psychiatry, and this article has introduced me to a few recent scientific findings that I was unaware of.

I was a bit disappointed that there was no mention of the use of Traditional Chinese Herbal Medicines that are currently being used to treat TS. Given that there is strong evidence supporting use of the 5-Lin granule (TSupport) in treating tic disorders, my colleagues and I are about to start a multisite clinical trial in the US. However, since there were no relevant articles published on this topic in 2022, it is reasonable that this emerging area of research was not mentioned in the review.
paper_title_zh: 2022年图雷特综合征研究亮点
paper_abstract_zh: 这是《图雷特综合症研究亮点》系列中的第九篇年度文章，总结了2022年与图雷特综合症相关的研究报告。作者简要概述了他们认为最重要或最有趣的部分报告。
review_content_zh:
这组学者和从业者再次对2022年发表的关于图雷特综合症（TS）及相关疾病的科学文章进行了全面的总结。

本文将为对这一主题感兴趣的的临床医生和研究人员提供宝贵的资源。例如，我正在为《鲁特儿童与青少年精神病学教科书》第7版准备有关抽动障碍的章节，而本文向我介绍了一些我之前未知的最新科学发现。

我有点失望的是，文中没有提及目前正在用于治疗TS的传统中草药。鉴于有强有力的证据支持使用5-Lin颗粒（TSupport）治疗抽动障碍，我和我的同事们即将在美国开展一项多站点临床试验。然而，由于2022年没有发表相关主题的文章，因此这篇综述中没有提及这一新兴研究领域是合理的。

reasons: I was a bit disappointed that there was no mention of the use of Traditional Chinese Herbal Medicines that are currently being used to treat TS.
It is very well organized, and I recommend acceptance with minor changes.
In the comorbidities section, given that there are so many articles focusing on sleep, I would make sleep its own category

"Trau and colleagues" - Starting "Similarly, the Calgary group tested which symptoms" through "self-injurious actions" would benefit from being moved to the below paragraph as those findings are more consistent with teh subsequent paragraph.
Seems like the last sentence of the paragraph contradicts an earlier sentence in the paragraph

paper_title: Reconsidering the ethics of compulsive treatment in light of clinical psychiatry: A selective review of literature
paper_abstract: The ethics of compulsive treatment (CT) is a medical, social and legal discussion that reemerged after the ratification by 181 countries of the 2007 United Nations Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (UN-CRPD). The optional protocol of the UN-CRPD was ratified by 86 countries aiming to promote, protect and ensure the full and equal enjoyment of all human rights. It also determined the need to review mental health laws as under this light treatment of persons with disabilities, particularly those with mental disorders, cannot accept the use of CT. This selective review of literature aims to clarify inputs from clinical psychiatry adding evidence to the multi-disciplinary discussion. It provides contradictory evidence on how patients experience CT and its impact on their mental health and treatment programs, also which are main reasons for the use of CT and what efforts in psychiatry have been made to reduce, replace and refine it.
review_content:
Summary:

The selective literature review adresses the problem of coercive treatment (CT) in mental health, mainly the juxtaposition of coercion as a violation of rights with the clinical obligation to treat patients with mental disorders.

Firstly, the practice and impact of CT is presented with focus on risk asessment, impact on treatment. Secondly, the experience of coercion and how this may be ameliorated is shortly presented. And lastly, the article touches upon ways to reduce or ameliorate CT.

Critique and suggestions:

The focus on clinical inputs with regards to the ethical dilemma of CT is an important perspective. The very literal interpretation of the articles from the United Nations Convention on the rights of Persons with Disabilities seems not sufficiently nuanced - all articles cited in Table 2 provides caveats. If possible, nuance this point in the conclusion, as I am not, from the material provided, sufficiently convinced that stakeholders do not in fact "acknowledge these efforts and evidence"

"This is a review of literature which provides inputs from psychiatric practice..." – The article does not specify what literature has been reviewed and how the is sample created, and would benefit greatly from this tranparency in terms of validity.

Clear tables, that neatly summarise the points of the article. Very nice.

"Even after CT 25% of patients admitted to an adult psychiatry unit could be at risk of committing an act of violence" – Please clarify, after CT has ended, during CT?

"Yet while individual risk factors appeared for violent behaviors and CT decisions (Menculini et al. 2018) – e.g. male, diagnosis of schizophrenia, substance abuse and previous history of violence – their predictive value for violent behavior was not found. Of all the reasons the risk of occurrence or recurrence of violence seems the most liable to abuse (due to the subjective nature of risk in psychiatry) and perhaps the target of the CRPD worries and predicaments – that a measure aimed at the treatment of persons with mental disorders becomes a control mechanism for social risk situations. Indeed, some argue that it overlaid the true reason of CT need for treatment" – This argument is unclear.

"Yet for each country there are legal requirements which might not be under use – more than 40% patients failed to provide them in their records" – Did the patients fail to provide them or did the hospital/administration? Please clarify.

"This would allow health professionals to" – The rest of the sentence seems to be missing.

"CT for public health issues, such as tuberculosis, is of particular complexity and represents perhaps the clearest violation of the rights to liberty and privacy in persons whose competence might be unspoiled." – It seems strange to bring up CT for public health issues in an article focused on mental health, and, if this is a deliberate choice, without a mention of COVID and the moral dilemmas posed by the pandemic.

"Postmodern ethics suggest that forms of power and control (and the need to regulate them) are not only external to the subject but can rise from within." – Citation missing?

"When they experience satisfaction" – With what?

"Several patients admit" – Admit is a loaded concept (linked to admission of guilt), consider a more neutral “report“ or “consider”.

"Another paradox is the fact that CT in inpatient settings appears to be better regulated as other team members and patients can supervise what is happening to the patient" – To clarify, add “in comparison with Community Treatment Order”.

"interruption of forms of CT" – of certain forms? Be specific as to which forms.

Conclusion:

An interesting perspective, with relevant insights from clinical practice, that would benefit from a section on methodology.
paper_title_zh: 重新审视临床精神病学视角下的强制性治疗伦理：文献选择性综述
paper_abstract_zh: 强制性治疗（CT）的伦理问题是一个医学、社会和法律的讨论议题，在181个国家批准2007年《联合国残疾人权利公约》（UN-CRPD）后再次浮现。UN-CRPD的任择议定书由86个国家批准，旨在促进、保护和确保所有人权的充分和平等享受。它还确定了需要审查精神健康法律，因为在这一点上，对残疾人的治疗，尤其是对精神障碍者的治疗，不能接受使用CT。这篇文献的选评旨在澄清来自临床精神病学的研究成果，为多学科讨论提供证据。它提供了关于患者如何体验CT及其对其心理健康和治疗计划影响的矛盾证据，还探讨了使用CT的主要原因以及精神病学为减少、替代和改进CT所做的努力。
review_content_zh:
摘要：

选择性文献综述探讨了精神健康领域强制治疗（CT）的问题，主要将强制作为一种侵犯权利的行为与临床治疗精神障碍患者的义务进行对比。

首先，介绍了CT的实践和影响，重点关注风险评估和对治疗的影响。其次，简要介绍了强制体验及其可能的改善方法。最后，文章探讨了减少或改善CT的途径。

批评与建议：

关注CT伦理困境的临床输入是一个重要的视角。对《联合国残疾人权利公约》文章的字面解释似乎不够细致——表2中引用的所有文章都提供了警告。如果可能，在结论中细化这一点，因为从提供的材料来看，我并不完全相信利益相关者实际上“承认这些努力和证据”。

“这是一篇提供精神病学实践输入的文献综述……”——文章未具体说明已审查的文献及其样本的创建方式，若能在此方面增加透明度，将大大提升其有效性。

表格清晰，简洁地总结了文章的要点。非常好。

“即使在CT后，仍有25%的成人精神科病房患者可能存在暴力行为风险”——请澄清，是在CT结束后还是CT期间？

“然而，尽管出现了暴力行为和CT决策的个体风险因素（Menculini等人，2018年）——例如男性、精神分裂症诊断、物质滥用和既往暴力史——但它们对暴力行为的预测价值并未被发现。在所有原因中，暴力发生或复发的风险似乎最容易被滥用（由于精神病学中风险的主观性），或许这正是《残疾人权利公约》担忧和困境的目标——针对精神障碍患者治疗的措施变成了社会风险情况的控制机制。确实，有人认为这掩盖了CT需求的真正原因”——这一论点不清晰。

“然而，每个国家都有可能未使用的法律要求——超过40%的患者未能提供这些记录”——是患者未能提供还是医院/管理部门未能提供？请澄清。

“这将允许卫生专业人员”——句子的其余部分似乎缺失。

“针对公共卫生问题（如结核病）的CT尤为复杂，或许是对未受损能力人士自由和隐私权利的最明显侵犯。”——在专注于精神健康的文章中提及公共卫生问题的CT似乎有些奇怪，如果是刻意选择，未提及COVID及其带来的道德困境。

“后现代伦理学认为，权力和控制的形式（及其调控需求）不仅存在于主体之外，也可能从内部产生。”——缺少引用？

“当他们感到满意时”——对什么感到满意？

“一些患者承认”——“承认”是一个有负载的概念（与承认罪行相关），考虑使用更中性的“报告”或“认为”。

“另一个悖论是，住院环境中的CT似乎比其他团队成员和患者可以监督患者情况的监管更好”——为澄清，添加“与社区治疗令相比”。

“中断某些形式的CT”——特定形式？具体说明哪些形式。

结论：

一个有趣的视角，提供了来自临床实践的相关见解，若能增加方法论部分将更有益。

reasons: "Postmodern ethics suggest that forms of power and control (and the need to regulate them) are not only external to the subject but can rise from within." – Citation missing?
The focus on clinical inputs with regards to the ethical dilemma of CT is an important perspective.
An interesting perspective, with relevant insights from clinical practice, that would benefit from a section on methodology.
Clear tables, that neatly summarise the points of the article. Very nice.
The article does not specify what literature has been reviewed and how the is sample created, and would benefit greatly from this tranparency in terms of validity.

paper_title: Protocol for Conducting Scoping Review on Reliability and Validity of Low-Stakes Assessments in Medical Education
paper_abstract:
Low-stakes assessments (LSAs) are widely used in medical education to promote continuous learning by providing formative feedback and minimizing the high-stress environment associated with high-stakes assessments. While LSAs are recognized for their role in supporting student learning, questions remain about their reliability and validity. This scoping review aims to systematically identify and synthesize existing literature on the reliability and validity of LSAs within medical education contexts. This study aims to map the methodologies used to establish psychometric parameters, identify problems, and offer best practices. 
 The review will use the Joanna Briggs Institute methodology, encompassing a comprehensive search across six academic databases and grey literature to identify relevant studies published from 2000 onward. Two reviewers will independently screen and extract data, using the Covidence tool for systematic screening and data extraction. Data will be analyzed using qualitative and quantitative approaches to provide an overview of reliability and validity evidence for LSAs in medical education. Insights into motivational and psychometric theories, such as Self-Determination Theory, Classical Test Theory, and Generalizability Theory, that inform LSA design and implementation will be used to analyse the findings in this review. 
 Expected outcomes include a detailed map of the literature on LSA reliability and validity, identification of key challenges, theoretical underpinnings and recommended strategies for improving LSA practices in medical education. Findings will inform future research and provide guidelines for optimizing the use of LSAs to enhance student learning outcomes, assessment integrity, and the educational experience in medical training.
review_content:
A well written protocol for an essential study in assessment in Medical education.
You need to revise your list of types of Low-Stakes Assessments (LSAs) in the view that assessments are generally either formative or summative. You have listed formative assessments as an example of LSAs which then limits your list since all LSAs fall under formative assessments.
In order to clear the confusion, a definition of what you are referring to as LSAs would be essential.
Your list of LSAs includes Progress Committees, which should rather be mentioned as quality assurance checks in the implementation of LSAs.
paper_title_zh: 医学教育中低风险评估的信度和效度范围综述的开展协议
paper_abstract_zh:
低风险评估（LSAs）在医学教育中广泛使用，通过提供形成性反馈并最小化与高风险评估相关的高压力环境来促进持续学习。尽管LSAs在支持学生学习方面的作用得到认可，但其可靠性和有效性仍存在疑问。本范围综述旨在系统地识别和综合现有关于医学教育背景下LSAs可靠性和有效性的文献。本研究旨在绘制用于建立心理测量参数的方法论，识别问题，并提供最佳实践。

该综述将采用乔安娜·布里格斯研究所的方法论，涵盖对六个学术数据库和灰色文献的全面搜索，以识别自2000年以来发表的相关研究。两名评审员将独立筛选和提取数据，使用Covidence工具进行系统筛选和数据提取。数据将采用定性和定量方法进行分析，以提供医学教育中LSAs可靠性和有效性证据的概览。将使用动机和心理测量理论（如自我决定理论、经典测试理论和概化理论）的见解来分析本综述中的发现。

预期成果包括对LSA可靠性和有效性文献的详细图谱、关键挑战的识别、理论基础以及改善医学教育中LSA实践的建议策略。研究结果将为未来研究提供信息，并为优化LSAs的使用以增强学生学习成果、评估完整性和医学培训中的教育体验提供指导方针。
review_content_zh:

你的LSAs列表中包括了进展委员会，这更应该被提及为在LSAs实施中的质量保证检查。

paper_title: Influence of deep learning image reconstruction algorithm for reducing radiation dose and image noise compared to iterative reconstruction and filtered back projection for head and chest computed tomography examinations: a systematic review
paper_abstract:
Background 
    The most recent advances in Computed Tomography (CT) image reconstruction technology are Deep learning image reconstruction (DLIR) algorithms. Due to drawbacks in Iterative reconstruction (IR) techniques such as negative image texture and nonlinear spatial resolutions, DLIRs are gradually replacing them. However, the potential use of DLIR in Head and Chest CT has to be examined further. Hence, the purpose of the study is to review the influence of DLIR on Radiation dose (RD), Image noise (IN), and outcomes of the studies compared with IR and FBP in Head and Chest CT examinations. 
  
  
    Methods 
    We performed a detailed search in PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, and Embase to find the articles reported using DLIR for Head and Chest CT examinations between 2017 to 2023. Data were retrieved from the short-listed studies using Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-analysis (PRISMA) guidelines. 
  
  
    Results 
    Out of 196 articles searched, 15 articles were included. A total of 1292 sample size was included. 14 articles were rated as high and 1 article as moderate quality. All studies compared DLIR to IR techniques. 5 studies compared DLIR with IR and FBP. The review showed that DLIR improved IQ, and reduced RD and IN for CT Head and Chest examinations. 
  
  
    Conclusions 
    DLIR algorithm have demonstrated a noted enhancement in IQ with reduced IN for CT Head and Chest examinations at lower dose compared with IR and FBP. DLIR showed potential for enhancing patient care by reducing radiation risks and increasing diagnostic accuracy.
review_content:
Major comments:

The objective of this study is to evaluate the impact of the Deep learning image reconstruction (DLIR's) algorithm on Radiation Dose (RD), Image Noise (IN), and Image Quality (IQ) in Head and Chest CT examinations. This study addresses a crucial area of research in image reconstruction technology in CT. The comprehensive approach ensures a thorough understanding of DLIR’s impact on various aspects of CT Head and Chest imaging.
The study's methodology is well-structured and follows the PRISMA guidelines, ensuring a systematic and comprehensive approach to data collection and analysis. The inclusion of major databases ensures a comprehensive retrieval of relevant articles, enhancing the study’s credibility and readability.
Findings regarding CT head examinations, including the reduction in image noise, improved Image quality with better lesion detection, and reduced radiation dose with DLIR compared to IR and FBP, are well documented and supported by specific studies. Similarly, the observations related to CT chest examinations, such as higher image contrast, lower image noise, and substantial reduction in radiation dose with DLIR, are clearly stated and backed by relevant research. Results mentioned in the study such as a reduction in RD 25% in adult CT brain examinations and 62% to 97% in chest CT examinations add quantitative support to the significant impact of DLIR reducing radiation exposure while maintaining diagnostic accuracy.
Acknowledging the limitations of the study, such as the exclusion of phantom studies and heterogeneity provides transparency and enhances the credibility of acknowledging potential biases or gaps in the research process.

Minor comments:
Ensure that all abbreviations are clearly defined upon first use.
Suggestions to editor
The review article adds significant knowledge to the literature about the potential advantages of DLIR techniques to enhance diagnostic accuracy, minimize radiation exposure, and improve image quality in CT brain and Chest examinations. The review provides valuable insights into the advancements of DLIR in CT imaging, its benefits in reducing radiation dose and image noise while improving Image quality, and highlights the potential for further research and application of DLIR in clinical settings.
paper_title_zh: 深度学习图像重建算法在降低头部和胸部计算机断层扫描检查辐射剂量和图像噪声方面的影响：与迭代重建和滤波反投影的比较——系统综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景
最新的计算机断层扫描（CT）图像重建技术进展是深度学习图像重建（DLIR）算法。由于迭代重建（IR）技术存在诸如负图像纹理和非线性空间分辨率等缺点，DLIR逐渐取代了它们。然而，DLIR在头部和胸部CT中的潜在应用需要进一步研究。因此，本研究的目的是回顾DLIR对辐射剂量（RD）、图像噪声（IN）的影响，并与IR和FBP在头部和胸部CT检查中的研究结果进行比较。

方法
我们在PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science、Cochrane Library和Embase进行了详细检索，以找到2017年至2023年间使用DLIR进行头部和胸部CT检查的文章。根据系统评价和荟萃分析的首选报告项目（PRISMA）指南，从筛选出的研究中提取数据。

结果
在检索的196篇文章中，纳入了15篇文章。总样本量为1292。14篇文章被评为高质量，1篇文章被评为中等质量。所有研究都将DLIR与IR技术进行了比较。5项研究比较了DLIR与IR和FBP。综述显示，DLIR提高了图像质量（IQ），并降低了头部和胸部CT检查的辐射剂量和图像噪声。

结论
与IR和FBP相比，DLIR算法在较低剂量下显著提高了头部和胸部CT检查的图像质量，并降低了图像噪声。DLIR显示出通过减少辐射风险和提高诊断准确性来增强患者护理的潜力。
review_content_zh:
主要评论：

本研究的目标是评估深度学习图像重建（DLIR）算法对头部和胸部CT检查中的辐射剂量（RD）、图像噪声（IN）和图像质量（IQ）的影响。该研究解决了CT图像重建技术中的一个关键研究领域。其全面的方法确保了对DLIR在CT头部和胸部成像各方面影响的深入理解。
该研究的方法结构良好，遵循PRISMA指南，确保了数据收集和分析的系统性和全面性。纳入主要数据库确保了相关文章的全面检索，增强了研究的可信度和可读性。
关于CT头部检查的发现，包括图像噪声的减少、图像质量的提高以及病变检测的改善，以及与IR和FBP相比DLIR导致的辐射剂量降低，均有详细记录并得到具体研究的支持。同样，与CT胸部检查相关的观察结果，如更高的图像对比度、更低的图像噪声以及DLIR带来的辐射剂量显著减少，均明确陈述并得到相关研究的支持。研究中提到的结果，如在成人CT脑部检查中RD减少25%，在胸部CT检查中减少62%至97%，为DLIR在减少辐射暴露的同时保持诊断准确性方面的显著影响提供了定量支持。
承认研究的局限性，如排除 phantom 研究和异质性，提供了透明度，并增强了在研究过程中承认潜在偏差或差距的可信度。

次要评论：
确保所有缩写在首次使用时明确定义。
对编辑的建议
该综述文章为文献增添了关于DLIR技术在提高CT脑部和胸部检查诊断准确性、最小化辐射暴露以及改善图像质量方面的潜在优势的显著知识。该综述提供了关于DLIR在CT成像中的进展、其在减少辐射剂量和图像噪声同时提高图像质量方面的益处，并强调了DLIR在临床环境中进一步研究和应用的潜力。

reasons: The study's methodology is well-structured and follows the PRISMA guidelines, ensuring a systematic and comprehensive approach to data collection and analysis.

paper_title: State-of-the-art optimization methods for short-term mine planning
paper_abstract:
Maintaining short-term planning aligned with the ultimate long-term plan is challenging. This requires many details to be modelled on a daily or weekly basis to reach this target. Short-term planning is more challenging than medium- and long-term planning because it deals with daily challenges with block model changes, mining cut polygons variation, which increases the gap between medium- and long-term plans for each material to be mined. Short-term mine planning teams are expected to identify and manage potential risks to mitigate them, and eventually achieve the long-term objective of maximizing the Net Present Value (NPV). Very few studies have identified the problems that exist in short-term mine planning and provided technical solutions to overcome them for open-pit mines. One of the complexities associated with short-term planning is the creation of polygons or mining cuts by clustering before optimizing and scheduling the plan to reduce the computational expense of mine planning models. 
 The primary objective of this study is to review the latest papers describing short-term mine planning challenges and technical solutions proposed to optimize mine planning for open-pit mines.
review_content:
Dear authors,
Your article is quite interesting and addresses an issue that concerns every mining operation. Overall, the article discusses methods and techniques for optimizing short-term mine planning. However, I believe some areas require improvement.
 1. Introduction: In the text, you mention "quite a few" reviews on long-term planning and "very few" for short-term planning. However, Figure 1 indicates the opposite. Ultimately, is "monthly to yearly" time discretization considered long-term or short-term planning? Also, where exactly does medium-term planning fit in? If the plan duration is not the decisive factor for distinguishing short-term from long-term planning, please clearly explain what that factor is in your opinion.
 2. Introduction / Section 1.1: You mention certain available software while omitting others (additional software is mentioned in a later section).
 3. Introduction / Section 1.1: "algorithms have been are applied..." Please correct this sentence.
 4. Figure 1: The font size of the embedded diagrams is small.
 5. Tables: Please maintain consistent font type and size throughout.
 6. Scope of the research: Please add specific details on how you searched for the articles included in your review (e.g., keywords used in search engines, exclusion criteria for specific articles).
 7. Sections 3 and 4: In my opinion, the content of these sections should be enriched with more information so that your article becomes useful even to a mining engineer who has not previously dealt with improving short-term mine planning. In other words, more details on methods and techniques should be provided rather than simply listing case studies conducted by researchers worldwide. For better organization and presentation of this information, I believe you can start by revisiting the Discussion and Conclusions section, which is the most well-written and clear in the entire article.
Overall, your article holds promise, and addressing these points could significantly enhance its clarity and impact.
Best regards
paper_title_zh: 最先进的短期矿山规划优化方法
paper_abstract_zh: 保持短期规划与最终长期规划的一致性是一项挑战。这需要每天或每周对许多细节进行建模以达到这一目标。短期规划比中、长期规划更具挑战性，因为它涉及处理日常挑战，如区块模型变化、采矿切割多边形变化，这增加了每种待采矿物的中、长期规划之间的差距。短期矿山规划团队预计能够识别和管理潜在风险以减轻它们，并最终实现长期目标，即最大化净现值（NPV）。很少有研究确定了短期矿山规划中存在的问题，并为露天矿山提供了克服这些问题的技术解决方案。短期规划的一个复杂性在于，在优化和调度计划之前通过聚类创建多边形或采矿切割，以减少矿山规划模型的计算成本。本研究的主要目标是回顾描述短期矿山规划挑战的最新论文，以及为优化露天矿山规划而提出的解决方案。
review_content_zh:
尊敬的作者们，

您的文章非常有趣，并讨论了一个关乎每个采矿作业的问题。总体而言，文章讨论了优化短期矿山规划的方法和技术。然而，我认为有些方面需要改进。

1. 引言：在文本中，您提到“相当多”关于长期规划的评价，“非常少”关于短期规划的评价。然而，图1显示的是相反的情况。最终，“月度至年度”的时间离散化被认为是长期规划还是短期规划？此外，中长期规划究竟位于何处？如果计划持续时间不是区分短期和长期规划的决定性因素，请清楚地解释您认为的那个因素是什么。
2. 引言/第1.1节：您提到了某些可用的软件，而忽略了其他软件（在后面的章节中提到了额外的软件）。
3. 引言/第1.1节：“算法已经被应用...”请更正此句。
4. 图1：嵌入图标的字体大小较小。
5. 表格：请在整个文档中保持一致的字体类型和大小。
6. 研究范围：请添加关于您如何搜索您综述中包含的文章的具体细节（例如，在搜索引擎中使用的关键词，排除特定文章的标准）。
7. 第3节和第4节：在我看来，这些章节的内容应该更加丰富，以便您的文章对那些以前未曾处理过改进短期矿山规划的采矿工程师也具有参考价值。换句话说，应该提供更多关于方法和技术的细节，而不仅仅是列出全球研究人员进行的案例研究。为了更好地组织和展示这些信息，我相信您可以从重新审视讨论和结论部分开始，这是全文中写得最好、最清晰的部分。

总体而言，您的文章具有潜力，解决这些问题将显著增强其清晰度和影响力。

此致
敬礼

reasons: In the text, you mention "quite a few" reviews on long-term planning and "very few" for short-term planning. However, Figure 1 indicates the opposite.

Sections 3 and 4: In my opinion, the content of these sections should be enriched with more information so that your article becomes useful even to a mining engineer who has not previously dealt with improving short-term mine planning.
In other words, more details on methods and techniques should be provided rather than simply listing case studies conducted by researchers worldwide.

paper_title: State-of-the-art violence detection techniques in video surveillance security systems: A systematic review
paper_abstract: We investigate and analyze methods to violence detection in this study to completely disassemble the present condition and anticipate the emerging trends of violence discovery research. In this systematic review, we provide a comprehensive assessment of the video violence detection problems that have been described in state-of-the-art researches. This work aims to address the problems as state-of-the-art methods in video violence detection, datasets to develop and train real-time video violence detection frameworks, discuss and identify open issues in the given problem. In this study, we analyzed 80 research papers that have been selected from 154 research papers after identification, screening, and eligibility phases. As the research sources, we used five digital libraries and three high ranked computer vision conferences that were published between 2015 and 2021. We begin by briefly introducing core idea and problems of videobased violence detection; after that, we divided current techniques into three categories based on their methodologies: conventional methods, end-to-end deep learning-based methods, and machine learning-based methods. Finally, we present public datasets for testing video based violence detectionmethods' performance and compare their results. In addition, we summarize the open issues in violence detection in videoand evaluate its future tendencies.
review_content: Reviewer 1 (Anonymous) Basic reporting no comment Experimental design no comment Validity of the findings no comment Additional comments This paper provided a survey by the assessment of video violence detection problems that occurs in state-of-the-arts for both qualitative and quantitative studies in terms of procedure, datasets, and performance indicators. Some challenges and future directions are also covered. The topic seems to be very interesting, however, I have some major concerns about the paper that will further enhance the paper quality and its body structure. 1. The wording style of the abstract is too sloppy and instead of actual contents description, the background studies is largely covered. Authors need to make the abstract more compact and representative for the whole paper contents. Answer: Dear Reviewer, thank you for your advice. We changed the abstract by removing actual contents description and including the paper contributions. 2. A reader gets confuse when face the sections without numbering that is an important aspect of paper body. Resolve this issue. Answer: By considering the recommendation of the reviewer, we numbered each section and subsection. 3. I did not find any novelty after going through the contribution lists that are already the practice of existing surveys such as methods coverage, their features extraction sets, datasets, etc. Authors are suggested to clearly highlight their contributions and mention why this survey is needed if there already exist several violence detection surveys. Answer: In this study, our goal was to review of state-of-the-art researches for violence detection problem. In this paper we reviewed the papers for articles for last 7 years. We put four research questions and tried to answer to those questions in our study. In addition, we overviewed other review papers in this domain and compared the proposed systematic literature review. 4. I did not find the any visual statistical information of year-wise violence detection papers distribution. Authors need to include the details of paper coverage from each year, present their taxonomy, broadly categorize them into machine learning or conventional techniques and deep learning by investigating each year for the category. Similarly, authors are suggested to present visual or tabular representation of working flow of the survey for the ease of readers. Next, I did not most recent violence detection literature that authors need to includes such as: An intelligent system for complex violence pattern analysis and detection. International Journal of Intelligent Systems. 2021 Jul 5 AI assisted Edge Vision for Violence Detection in IoT based Industrial Surveillance Networks. IEEE Transactions on Industrial Informatics. 2021 Sep 29 Violence detection and face recognition based on deep learning. Pattern Recognition Letters. 2021. Answer: We included Figure 2 and Figure 3 for visual illustration of the obtained results. Figure 2a presents year-wise distribution of violence detection papers, Figure 2b demonstrates violence detection papers by applied methods, Figure 3 illustrates distribution of methods that used in violence detection papers. Moreover, we included the suggested papers into our study. 5. Challenges and future directions are not well-structured as they are explained in wordy manners. It is suggested to explain each challenge in separate small section. Answer: By recommendation of the reviewer, we explained each challenge in a separate small division in Section 8. 6. Finally, I recommend to consider the English proficiency in terms of spelling and grammatical corrections. Answer: Yes, we acknowledge that we are not native English speakers. By considering a recommendation of the reviewer, our manuscript was proofread by local English correction center.
paper_title_zh: 视频监控安全系统中最新暴力检测技术：系统综述
paper_abstract_zh: 在本研究中，我们调查和分析暴力检测方法，以全面剖析当前状况并预测暴力发现研究的新兴趋势。在这篇系统综述中，我们对现有研究中所描述的视频暴力检测问题进行了全面评估。这项工作旨在解决作为视频暴力检测最新方法的问题，开发并训练实时视频暴力检测框架的数据集，讨论并识别给定问题中的开放性问题。在本研究中，我们从154篇研究论文中经过识别、筛选和资格审核阶段后，选取了80篇进行分析。作为研究来源，我们使用了五个数字图书馆和三个在2015年至2021年间发表的高排名计算机视觉会议。我们首先简要介绍了基于视频的暴力检测的核心思想和问题；随后，根据方法论将当前技术分为三类：传统方法、基于端到端深度学习的方法和基于机器学习的方法。最后，我们介绍了用于测试基于视频的暴力检测方法性能的公共数据集，并比较了其结果。此外，我们总结了视频暴力检测中的开放性问题，并评估了其未来趋势。
review_content_zh:
审稿人1（匿名）

基本报告：无评论

实验设计：无评论

结果有效性：无评论

附加评论：

本文通过评估视频暴力检测问题，对当前定性研究和定量研究中的程序、数据集和性能指标进行了综述。还涵盖了一些挑战和未来方向。这个主题似乎非常有趣，然而，我对这篇论文有一些主要关切，这些关切将进一步提升论文的质量和结构。

1. 摘要的措辞风格过于草率，大量覆盖了背景研究，而不是实际内容描述。作者需要使摘要更加紧凑和具有代表性，以涵盖整篇论文的内容。答复：尊敬的审稿人，感谢您的建议。我们通过删除实际内容描述并包括论文贡献来修改了摘要。

2. 读者在遇到没有编号的章节时会感到困惑，这是论文主体的重要方面。请解决这个问题。答复：考虑到审稿人的建议，我们对每个章节和小节进行了编号。

3. 在浏览贡献列表后，我没有发现任何新颖性，这些已经是现有综述的实践，如方法覆盖、特征提取集、数据集等。建议作者明确突出他们的贡献，并说明为什么需要这篇综述，如果已经存在多个暴力检测综述。答复：在这项研究中，我们的目标是综述暴力检测问题的最新研究。在本文中，我们回顾了过去7年的论文。我们提出了四个研究问题，并试图在研究中回答这些问题。此外，我们还概述了该领域的其他综述论文，并比较了提出的系统文献综述。

4. 我没有找到按年份分布的暴力检测论文的任何视觉统计信息。作者需要包括每年论文覆盖的详细信息，呈现他们的分类法，广泛地将它们分类为机器学习或传统技术和深度学习，并逐年调查每个类别。同样，建议作者以视觉或表格形式呈现综述的工作流程，以便于读者理解。此外，我没有看到最新的暴力检测文献，作者需要包括如下内容：

- 基于深度学习的暴力检测和人脸识别。《模式识别快报》。2021年
