paper_title: Associative memory cells: Formation, function and perspective
paper_abstract: Associative learning and memory are common activities in life, and their cellular infrastructures constitute the basis of cognitive processes. Although neuronal plasticity emerges after memory formation, basic units and their working principles for the storage and retrieval of associated signals remain to be revealed. Current reports indicate that associative memory cells, through their mutual synapse innervations among the co-activated sensory cortices, are recruited to fulfill the integration, storage and retrieval of multiple associated signals, and serve associative thinking and logical reasoning. In this review, we aim to summarize associative memory cells in their formation, features and functional impacts.
review_content: In this review Dr. Jin-Hui Wang and Shan Cui proposed a model named “associative memory cells (AMCs)” that could be used to explain associative memory formation and functioning at the neuronal circuitry level. This novel cellular model was first established in Dr. Wang’s laboratory. Based on their serial studies, they proposed the hypothesis that AMCs encode both new and innate signals based on their mutual synapse innervation in the sensory cortical area. Furthermore, they suggested that the primary associative memory cells innervate the downstream neurons in associated brain areas, and the downstream neurons encode dual associative signals and serve as the secondary associative memory cells (sAMCs). The formation and functioning of the AMCs are very interesting and important as they may help to reveal novel mechanisms for learning, memory and cognition.
paper_title_zh: 关联记忆细胞：形成、功能及展望
paper_abstract_zh: 联想学习和记忆是生活中的常见活动，其细胞基础构成了认知过程的基础。尽管神经可塑性在记忆形成后出现，但存储和检索关联信号的基本单元及其工作原理仍有待揭示。当前的研究报告指出，联想记忆细胞通过其在共同激活的感觉皮层之间的相互突触支配，被招募来完成多个关联信号的整合、存储和检索，并服务于联想思维和逻辑推理。在本综述中，我们旨在总结联想记忆细胞的形成、特征及其功能影响。
review_content_zh: 在这篇综述中，王金辉博士和崔珊提出了一种名为“联想记忆细胞（AMCs）”的模型，该模型可用于解释联想记忆在神经元环路层面的形成和功能。这一新颖的细胞模型最初在王博士的实验室建立。基于他们的系列研究，他们提出了假设，即AMCs根据其在感觉皮层区域的相互突触支配，编码新信号和固有信号。此外，他们还提出，初级联想记忆细胞支配相关脑区中的下游神经元，而这些下游神经元编码双重联想信号，并作为次级联想记忆细胞（sAMCs）。AMCs的形成和功能非常有趣且重要，因为它们可能有助于揭示学习、记忆和认知的新机制。

reasons: P1: The definition for associative learning: ”Associative learning is a common approach for information acquisition” is a bit too general.
I suggest that using “Associative learning is the learning of associations between events” to replace it.
Give a definition for “associative memory cells” and provide evidence to support “associative memory cells”.
The present description for associative memory cells is a bit too general.

paper_title: Progress and challenges in TB vaccine development
paper_abstract: The Bacille Calmette Guerin (BCG) vaccine can provide decades of protection against tuberculosis (TB) disease, and although imperfect, BCG is proof that vaccine mediated protection against TB is a possibility. A new TB vaccine is, therefore, an inevitability; the question is how long will it take us to get there? We have made substantial progress in the development of vaccine platforms, in the identification of antigens and of immune correlates of risk of TB disease. We have also standardized animal models to enable head-to-head comparison and selection of candidate TB vaccines for further development.  To extend our understanding of the safety and immunogenicity of TB vaccines we have performed experimental medicine studies to explore route of administration and have begun to develop controlled human infection models. Driven by a desire to reduce the length and cost of human efficacy trials we have applied novel approaches to later stage clinical development, exploring alternative clinical endpoints to prevention of disease outcomes. Here, global leaders in TB vaccine development discuss the progress made and the challenges that remain. What emerges is that, despite scientific progress, few vaccine candidates have entered clinical trials in the last 5 years and few vaccines in clinical trials have progressed to efficacy trials. Crucially, we have undervalued the knowledge gained from our “failed” trials and fostered a culture of risk aversion that has limited new funding for clinical TB vaccine development. The unintended consequence of this abundance of caution is lack of diversity of new TB vaccine candidates and stagnation of the clinical pipeline. We have a variety of new vaccine platform technologies, mycobacterial antigens and animal and human models.  However, we will not encourage progression of vaccine candidates into clinical trials unless we evaluate and embrace risk in pursuit of vaccine development.
review_content:
I reviewed the manuscript “Progress and challenges in TB vaccine development” and it seems to me that the objective of this review is well defined and clearly stated.

The abstract is written clearly and objectively. Introduction is clear and presents a solid foundation for the review's objectives. The presentation of the various sub-topics is clear and the review of the bibliography is mostly complete and includes the main articles published in the area.

The section on animal models could be elaborated to discuss in greater details mouse and guinea pig TB models, in addition to the authors’ thoughtful perspective on the use of NHPs.

Some discussion of the intricate network of events modulating inflammation in the context of TB and how a better understanding of this will aid in the development of more effective vaccines and host-directed therapies to curb TB is warranted.

The review should also be updated given the recent report of the first efficacy trial evaluating prevention of infection results for BCG revaccination or H4:IC31.

Thank you for the opportunity to review this excellent work.
paper_title_zh: 结核病疫苗研发的进展与挑战
paper_abstract_zh: 卡介苗（BCG）疫苗可以提供长达数十年的结核病（TB）保护，尽管并不完美，但BCG证明了通过疫苗介导的TB保护是可能的。因此，新的TB疫苗的研发是必然的；问题在于我们还需要多久才能实现这一目标？我们在疫苗平台开发、抗原识别以及TB疾病风险免疫相关因素的确定方面取得了实质性进展。我们还标准化了动物模型，以实现头对头比较和选择进一步开发的候选TB疫苗。为了扩展我们对TB疫苗安全性和免疫原性的理解，我们进行了实验性医学研究，探索了给药途径，并开始开发受控的人类感染模型。为了减少人体效力试验的长度和成本，我们采用了新颖的方法进行后期临床开发，探索了预防疾病结果以外的替代临床终点。在此，全球TB疫苗开发的领导者们讨论了所取得的进展和仍面临的挑战。显而易见的是，尽管科学有所进步，但过去5年中进入临床试验的疫苗候选物寥寥无几，且临床试验中的疫苗很少进展到效力试验。关键在于，我们低估了从“失败”试验中获得的知识，并助长了一种规避风险的文化，这限制了临床TB疫苗开发的新资金投入。这种过度谨慎的意外后果是新TB疫苗候选物的多样性不足和临床管道的停滞。我们拥有多种新的疫苗平台技术、分枝杆菌抗原以及动物和人类模型。然而，除非我们在疫苗开发过程中评估和接受风险，否则我们不会鼓励疫苗候选物进入临床试验。
review_content_zh:
我审阅了手稿《结核病疫苗研发的进展与挑战》，在我看来，这篇综述的目标定义明确且表述清晰。

摘要撰写清晰且客观。引言部分清晰，为综述目标奠定了坚实的基础。各子主题的呈现清晰，文献综述基本完整，涵盖了该领域发表的主要文章。

关于动物模型的章节可以进一步展开，更详细地讨论小鼠和豚鼠结核病模型，此外还有作者对非人灵长类动物使用的深思熟虑的见解。

需要讨论在结核病背景下调节炎症的复杂事件网络，以及更好地理解这一网络将如何有助于开发更有效的疫苗和针对宿主的治疗方法以控制结核病。

鉴于最近发布的首个评估BCG复种或H4:IC31预防感染效果的效力试验报告，综述也应进行更新。

感谢有机会审阅这篇优秀作品。

reasons: The review should also be updated given the recent report of the first efficacy trial evaluating prevention of infection results for BCG revaccination or H4:IC31.

In this manuscript, the authors rationally assert that compelling biological evidence for the induction of protective immunity associated with BCG vaccination, as well as by natural exposure, strongly support the feasibility for development of an improved TB vaccine.

The manuscript highlights progress since the 2012 publication of the Blueprint for TB Vaccine Development, both in TB-specific and non-specific areas, that are critical to inform the design and testing of novel vaccines approaches.

Progress is highlighted in areas such as the understanding of the basis for protective immunity, vaccine design (i.e. antigens, platforms and adjuvants), and improved sophistication of clinical trial design (i.e. enhanced inclusion/exclusion criteria associated with specific endpoints) to reduce sample size and trial duration, and therefore costs.

Appropriately, the authors acknowledge the need to identify approaches that induce clinical efficacy (including via nascent human challenge models) to ‘back-validate’ non-clinical models and thereby improve their predictive value of clinical outcomes going forward.
The section on animal models could be elaborated to discuss in greater details mouse and guinea pig TB models, in addition to the authors’ thoughtful perspective on the use of NHPs.

Some discussion of the intricate network of events modulating inflammation in the context of TB and how a better understanding of this will aid in the development of more effective vaccines and host-directed therapies to curb TB is warranted.

paper_title: The Taxonomy of Blockchain-based Technology in the Financial Industry
paper_abstract: The decentralized approach of blockchain technology has resulted in innovations across various industries, including finance which is facing challenges due to the rise of decentralized finance (DeFi) in the market. Decentralization improves business processes and spurs product innovation through increased transparency and removing intermediaries. A taxonomy created through a literature review outlines the four dimensions of these advancements: key drivers, products, benefits, and emerging threats. Proposed solutions are also included to tackle the threats.
review_content:
The paper describes The Taxonomy of Blockchain-based Technology in the Financial Industry. The taxonomy of this context is interesting, and it is worth to be investigated.

Still, the paper seems more like a presentation of a theory report than a research paper. In the present form, the manuscript appears more like a white paper.

In particular, I have the following significant comments:
  * The advantages and disadvantages of adopting blockchain technology must be better described than other types of blockchain or other solutions not using the blockchain. There is a concise analysis for each section, but more is needed.
  * I recommend the authors create a specific section to analyse the advantages and disadvantages of adopting blockchain technology in this context.
  * The potential risk and vulnerabilities of the proposed approach should be discussed more. The principal vulnerabilities of the proposed system should be described together with the related countermeasures.
  * A new section could be created, or vulnerabilities and countermeasures could be discussed.
  * It would be interesting to link the DeFi concepts in the marketplace with the design description and how the taxonomy could be enhanced using blockchain technology and its records history.
  * It would be helpful to provide more details in Section 4 on the potential standards and protocols that could be used to implement the proposed approach.

paper_abstract_zh: 区块链技术的去中心化方法已在多个行业引发了创新，包括面临去中心化金融（DeFi）市场崛起挑战的金融行业。去中心化通过提高透明度和去除中介机构，改善了业务流程并促进了产品创新。通过文献综述创建的分类法概述了这些进步的四个维度：关键驱动因素、产品、益处和新兴威胁。同时还包括了应对这些威胁的解决方案。

paper_title: A survey on modeling dynamic business processes
paper_abstract: Dynamic and flexible systems offer huge advantages for businesses in addressing dynamic uncertain factors and implementing dynamic business processes (DBP). However, DBP remains a challenge from the perspectives of modeling, simulation, and implementation because of a nontrivial understanding of "What is a dynamic business process?". A variety of approaches for DBP modeling and implementation have been proposed over the past years, yet few comprehensive studies analyzing DBP from different particular perspectives (e.g., business process (BP) variability, aspect oriented BP, service compositions, etc.) and research questions that lay the foundation for the development of a meaning of a DBP have been reported. The motivation behind this review is to examine DBP meaning from a global perspective and, consequently, answer the previously presented research question. Therefore, in this paper, we present a systematic literature review (SLR) comprised of 67 papers from five respective digital libraries, which index Computer Science (CS), Information Systems (IS), and Software Engineering (SE) journals and conference proceedings. Two points of view are analyzed in the selected papers. First, we observe the similarities and differences between the proposed approaches to DBP modeling and implementation. From these observations, we define six main requirements for DBP (DBPR). In addition, the comparison of the selected papers according to DBPR shows that most of the approaches analyzed limit BP dynamicity, since they use partially predefined BP models. Secondly, we analyze the papers based on a visualization perspective that shows the less explored areas as follows: more flexible process modeling approach and its implementation in IS should be developed; usage of historic data should be extended; domain knowledge usage, like goal-orientation, multi-criteria optimization, domain knowledge, artificial intelligence, etc., should be included and extended to ensure BP dynamicity. As such, this study makes important contributions and serves as a useful resource for future DBP studies and practice. Moreover, we expect that our results could inspire researchers and practitioners towards further work aimed at bringing forward the field of DBP modeling and implementation.
review_content: Reviewer 2: Comment 4: Due to the length of the article process as well as the acceptance process and given that the publication of the article will take place in an optimistic state in 2021. It is better to update the resources so that the survey article can be used. Because now the article is for two years ago It is a good suggestion. We have performed the preliminary search using our search stings in the Web of Science database in order to evaluate the amount of the work hours needed to supplement the review by the newest (2019-2021) papers. According to this result, we can predict that the amount of the papers we have to review additionally will be >200. Thus, it is not possible to do this work in 10 days, given for the minor revision. paper_title_zh: 动态业务流程建模综述
paper_abstract_zh: 动态和灵活的系统在应对动态不确定因素和实施动态业务流程（DBP）方面为商业提供了巨大优势。然而，由于对“什么是动态业务流程？”这一问题的理解并非易事，DBP在建模、仿真和实施方面仍然是一个挑战。过去几年中，已经提出了多种DBP建模和实施方法，但很少有综合研究从不同特定视角（例如，业务流程（BP）的可变性、面向方面的BP、服务组合等）分析DBP，并探讨奠定DBP意义发展基础的研究问题。本综述的动机是从全局视角审视DBP的意义，并由此回答之前提出的研究问题。因此，在本文中，我们呈现了一项系统文献综述（SLR），涵盖来自五个相关数字图书馆的67篇论文，这些图书馆索引了计算机科学（CS）、信息系统（IS）和软件工程（SE）的期刊和会议论文集。选定的论文中分析了两个观点。首先，我们观察了提出的DBP建模和实施方法之间的相似性和差异性。基于这些观察，我们定义了DBP的六个主要需求（DBPR）。此外，根据DBPR对选定论文的比较显示，大多数分析的方法限制了BP的动态性，因为它们使用了部分预定义的BP模型。其次，我们从可视化视角分析论文，揭示了较少探索的领域：应开发更灵活的流程建模方法及其在IS中的实施；应扩展历史数据的使用；应包括并扩展领域知识的使用，如目标导向、多标准优化、领域知识、人工智能等，以确保BP的动态性。因此，本研究做出了重要贡献，并为未来的DBP研究和实践提供了有用资源。此外，我们期望我们的结果能够激励研究人员和从业者进一步开展工作，推动DBP建模和实施领域的发展。
review_content_zh: 审稿人2：评论4：鉴于文章处理过程和接受过程的长度，以及文章将在2021年乐观状态下发表，最好更新资源，以便该综述文章可以使用。因为现在文章是两年前的内容，这是一个很好的建议。我们已使用我们在Web of Science数据库中的搜索字符串进行了初步搜索，以评估补充综述所需的工作时长，包括最新的（2019-2021）论文。这为我们提供了34篇新论文，这些论文应使用本文中提出的综述过程进行审查。根据这一结果，我们可以预测，我们额外需要审查的论文数量将超过200篇。因此，在为期10天的小修期限内完成这项工作是不可能的。此外，在我们完成审查之前，还将出现新的论文，即这一过程将耗时更长。我们或许应指出，本文的主要任务是介绍DBP的新概念。这一任务已在文中完成，我们相信纳入新论文不会带来显著的附加值。此外，由于延迟，其他作者可能会发表类似论文，这将使本文完全失去相关性。同时，新冠病毒疫情也使正常的研究、论文撰写和发表过程复杂化。5.

paper_title: Humanistic burden and economic impact of chronic kidney disease: a systematic literature review
paper_abstract:
Background: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is increasing in prevalence worldwide. Progression of CKD to end-stage renal disease (ESRD) can result in the requirement for renal replacement therapy, which incurs considerable healthcare costs and imposes restrictions on patients’ daily living. This systematic review was conducted to inform understanding of the humanistic and economic burden of CKD by collecting quality of life (QoL), symptom burden, and cost and resource use data, with a focus on the impact of disease progression. 
 Methods: Embase, MEDLINE, the Cochrane Library, and conference proceedings were searched in May 2017 according to predefined inclusion criteria. Data were extracted for full publications reporting either QoL or symptom burden (published 2007–2017; reporting data from ≥ 100 patients) or costs and resource use (published 2012–2017). Relevant QoL studies were those that used the 6-dimension or 8-, 12-, or 36-item Short-Form Health Surveys, 5-dimension EuroQol questionnaire, Healthy Days/Health-Related Quality of Life questionnaire, or Kidney Disease Quality of Life Questionnaire. 
 Results: Data were extracted from 95 studies reporting QoL data, 47 studies reporting cost and resource use data, and eight studies reporting descriptions of symptoms; 12 studies (seven QoL; five costs/resource use) reported data for patients with and without CKD, and 15 studies (seven QoL; eight costs/resource use) reported data by disease stage. Patients with CKD, including those with ESRD, had worse QoL than those with normal kidney function, and incurred higher healthcare costs. Disease progression was associated with cost increases, particularly for later stages and in patients receiving dialysis. Increasing CKD severity was also associated with reductions in QoL, although not all studies identified showed a consistent decrease with increasing disease stage. 
 Conclusions: The presence of CKD and CKD progression are associated with reductions in patients’ QoL and increased economic impact. This may be mitigated by interventions that slow progression.
review_content:
This manuscript describes a systematic literature review on quality of life, symptom burden, and healthcare resource utilization and costs of CKD across different CKD stages and comparing to the general population without CKD. The literature search process, decisions on which publications to include, the summary of review results, and limitations are clearly stated.

My only suggestion is to remove the following sentence from Methods, Citation Screening and Full Text Review on page 3 because this information is duplicate from the previous subsection Systemic Literature Review:
  * "For the humanistic burden SR, study publication dates for data extraction were restricted to 2007–2017; for the economic burden SR, the relevant time period was restricted to 2012–2017."

I recommend acceptance with this minor edit.
paper_title_zh: 慢性肾脏病的人本负担和经济影响：系统文献综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：慢性肾脏病（CKD）在全球范围内的患病率正在增加。CKD进展至终末期肾病（ESRD）可能导致需要肾脏替代治疗，这不仅带来显著的健康保健成本，还对患者的日常生活造成限制。本系统评价旨在通过收集生活质量（QoL）、症状负担以及成本和资源使用数据，了解CKD的人本和经济负担，重点关注疾病进展的影响。

方法：根据预定义的纳入标准，于2017年5月检索了Embase、MEDLINE、Cochrane图书馆和会议论文。提取了全文出版物中报告QoL或症状负担（发表于2007-2017年；报告数据来自≥100名患者）或成本和资源使用（发表于2012-2017年）的数据。相关的QoL研究是那些使用6维度或8、12、36项简短健康调查表、5维度EuroQol问卷、健康天数/健康相关生活质量问卷或肾脏病生活质量问卷的研究。

结果：从95项报告QoL数据的研究、47项报告成本和资源使用数据的研究以及8项报告症状描述的研究中提取了数据；12项研究（7项QoL；5项成本/资源使用）报告了有和无CKD患者的数据，15项研究（7项QoL；8项成本/资源使用）按疾病阶段报告了数据。CKD患者，包括ESRD患者，其QoL比肾功能正常者差，且医疗保健成本更高。疾病进展与成本增加相关，尤其是后期阶段和接受透析的患者。CKD严重程度的增加也与QoL的降低相关，尽管并非所有研究都显示随着疾病阶段的增加QoL持续下降。

结论：CKD的存在及其进展与患者QoL的降低和经济影响的增加相关。通过减缓进展的干预措施可能减轻这一影响。
review_content_zh:
该手稿描述了一项关于慢性肾脏病（CKD）不同阶段的生活质量、症状负担以及医疗资源利用和成本的系统文献综述，并与无CKD的普通人群进行了比较。文献检索过程、决定纳入哪些出版物、综述结果的总结以及局限性均明确陈述。

我的唯一建议是从第3页的“方法、引文筛选和全文审查”部分删除以下句子，因为该信息与前一节“系统文献综述”中的内容重复：
  * “对于人文负担的系统综述，数据提取的研究发表日期限制在2007年至2017年；对于经济负担的系统综述，相关时间段限制在2012年至2017年。”

我建议在做出这一微小修改后接受该稿件。

reasons: In the “Introduction” the authors refer to a meta-analysis on CKD prevalence suggesting 11-13% of population having the disease.
A more recent study on global CKD prevalence is available that estimates the CKD prevalence as substantially lower 9.1% (https://doi.org/10.1016/S0140-6736(20)30045-3).
It is unclear why the authors limited their systematic search by May 2017.

The search strategy (described in detail in the supplement at https://figshare.com/articles/Freeman_et_al_Supplementary_content_1_Table_S1/10011476) has a potential pitfall of low sensitivity because it applies exclusion of bibliographic records based on the presence of the word “acute” in a title or an abstract.
However, in the abstract of data sources describing the QoL or economy of CKD the word “acute” could occur just to identify that acute kidney diseases were not considered in a given data source.

The exact influence of this feature applied by the authors is not known, but it should be discussed in the “Limitations” as a potential reason for lowering search strategy sensitivity, or additional searches should be performed to demonstrate this feature has not led to the exclusion of useful data sources.

The authors identified a list of countries they used as the inclusion/exclusion criteria but this list is not inclusive: it includes some countries of Western Europe but not others, it includes China but not includes Taiwan which has great data on the topic.

paper_title: The genomic and clinical features of the COVID-19 Omicron variant: a narrative review
paper_abstract: Coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) is a major cause of morbidity and mortality worldwide. Since late November 2021, the Omicron variant has emerged as the primary cause of COVID-19 and caused a huge increase in the reported incidence around the world. To date, 32-34 spike mutations have been reported to be present in the Omicron variant, 15 of which were located in the receptor-binding domain that interacts with the cell surface of the host cells, while the rest were located in the N-terminal domain and around the furin cleavage site. Recent studies have suggested that those mutations could have a major role in the transmissibility and pathogenicity of the Omicron variant. Additionally, some mutations might contribute to the change of viral tropism of this novel variant. Here, we aim to discuss the recent reports on the transmissibility and severity of the Omicron variant from both the genetic and clinical perspectives. Afterward, we also take the chance to deliver our personal view on the topic.
review_content:
Hertanto and colleagues wrote a comprehensive review on the genomic and clinical features of the SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant. While they performed a nice literature review, this is a moving topic and there are some important new data which I believe should be added to the revised version of the manuscript.

In the "existing Omicron subvariants" section, the authors should discuss the characteristics of the BQ.1.1 subvariant, particularly regarding its resistance to monoclonal antibodies.

Some changes should be Added to the "Clinical features of the Omicron variant" section, where important references were not cited:
  * Vieillard-Baron et al. (AJRCCM 2022) showed that there were more immunocompromised patients among ICU Omicron-infected patients than among Delta-infected patients.
  * Bouzid (Ann Internal Med 2022) showed that Omicron patients presenting to the emergency room had better in-hospital outcomes than those with Delta
  * de Prost et al. (Nat Commun 2022) showed that ICU Omicron-infected patients who were immunosuppressed had a two times higher mortality than immunocompetent and that they had a poor humoral response to vaccination.
In the highlights section: a larger perspective should be provided regarding the problem of monoclonal antibody resistance of current circulating variants.
paper_title_zh: 新冠病毒奥密克戎变异株的基因组及临床特征：叙述性综述
paper_abstract_zh: 2019冠状病毒病（COVID-19）是全球发病率和死亡率的主要原因。自2021年11月底以来，奥密克戎变异株已成为COVID-19的主要致病原因，并导致全球报告发病率大幅上升。迄今为止，已报道奥密克戎变异株中存在32-34个刺突蛋白突变，其中15个位于与宿主细胞表面相互作用的受体结合域，其余则位于N端结构域和弗林蛋白酶切割位点周围。近期研究表明，这些突变可能在奥密克戎变异株的传播性和致病性中起重要作用。此外，一些突变可能有助于改变该新变异株的病毒嗜性。本文旨在从遗传和临床角度讨论近期关于奥密克戎变异株传播性和严重性的报告。随后，我们也借此机会发表我们对这一话题的个人观点。
review_content_zh:
Hertanto及其同事撰写了一篇关于SARS-CoV-2奥密克戎变异株的基因组及临床特征的综合性综述。尽管他们进行了一次良好的文献回顾，但这是一个不断发展的主题，并且有一些重要的新数据，我认为这些数据应添加到修订版的手稿中。

在“现有奥密克戎亚变异株”部分，作者应讨论BQ.1.1亚变异株的特征，尤其是其对抗单克隆抗体的耐药性。

“奥密克戎变异株的临床特征”部分应进行一些修改，其中未引用一些重要参考文献：
  * Vieillard-Baron等人（AJRCCM 2022）表明，在ICU中感染奥密克戎的患者中，免疫抑制患者的比例高于感染德尔塔的患者。
  * Bouzid（Ann Internal Med 2022）表明，奥密克戎患者在急诊室的院内预后优于德尔塔患者。
  * de Prost等人（Nat Commun 2022）表明，ICU中感染奥密克戎的免疫抑制患者死亡率是免疫正常患者的两倍，并且他们对疫苗的体液反应较差。

在亮点部分：应提供更广阔的视角，讨论当前流行变异株对单克隆抗体耐药的问题。

reasons: While they performed a nice literature review, this is a moving topic and there are some important new data which I believe should be added to the revised version of the manuscript.
Some changes should be Added to the "Clinical features of the Omicron variant" section, where important references were not cited:
* Vieillard-Baron et al. (AJRCCM 2022) showed that there were more immunocompromised patients among ICU Omicron-infected patients than among Delta-infected patients.
* Bouzid (Ann Internal Med 2022) showed that Omicron patients presenting to the emergency room had better in-hospital outcomes than those with Delta

* de Prost et al. (Nat Commun 2022) showed that ICU Omicron-infected patients who were immunosuppressed had a two times higher mortality than immunocompetent and that they had a poor humoral response to vaccination.
There are more than just the mutations found in these three regions that account for the mutations present in the Omicron variant. The authors do not cover these mutations or their effect.
The data presented in Table 3 might have been better served if presented in graph/chart form. It would have had a better impact if that data was presented differently.
Legend for Table 2 mentions the mutations that are potentially suitable for Omicron screening but no where in the body of the text is there mention of using the mutations for screening purposes.
In the highlights section: a larger perspective should be provided regarding the problem of monoclonal antibody resistance of current circulating variants.

paper_title: Methods and guidance on conducting, reporting, publishing and appraising living systematic reviews: a scoping review protocol
review_content:
Thank you for the invitation to review this scoping review protocol. This is an interesting and well presented protocol on a timely topic.

I do not have many comments on this manuscript:
  * I would be interested in why the authors cite Arksey & O'Malley as the scoping review methodology when there is more up to date and expanded scoping review methodology available (e.g. JBI Scoping review methodology- Peters et al. 2020).
  * Why was 2013 chosen as the starting search date?
  * For the grey literature search - what are the amended search terms that will be used? From the manuscript, I would not be able to replicate this aspect of the search as currently presented.
paper_title_zh: 进行、报告、发表和评估动态系统综述的方法与指南：一项范围综述协议
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：生活系统评价（LSR）方法基于对文献的持续监测和不断更新。一些指导文件涉及系统评价（SRs）的执行、报告、发表和质量评估，但所描述的方法要么不是最新的，要么不适合LSR，且缺少针对LSR的额外考虑。本范围综述的目的是系统地整理关于如何执行、报告、发表和评估LSR质量的方法学文献和指导。范围综述将允许绘制现有关于该主题的证据，以支持寻求指导的LSR作者并识别相关空白。

方法：为达成我们的目标，我们将采用标准范围综述方法进行范围综述，以调查和评估现有证据。我们将通过OVID界面搜索MEDLINE、EMBASE和Cochrane数据库。搜索策略由一位经验丰富的研究者制定，并在信息专家的帮助下完成。至于灰色文献的搜索，我们将在Lens.org网站上寻找现有关于LSR的指南和手册，这些文献来自进行证据综合的组织。两位综述作者将提取和编目关于LSR方法学方面的研究数据，并将其录入标准化且经过试测的数据提取表中。主要类别将反映提出的LSR方法：（i）执行LSR，（ii）报告LSR，（iii）发表LSR和（iv）评估LSR质量。

数据综合与结论：通过收集来自方法学调查和论文以及现有LSR指导文件和手册的数据，我们可能会识别出当前LSR方法中缺乏的特定问题和组成部分。因此，范围综述系统获得的发现可用作修订现有LSR方法工具的基础，例如为LSR扩展的PRISMA声明。
review_content_zh:
感谢您邀请我审阅这份范围综述协议。这是一个关于及时话题的有趣且表述良好的协议。

我对这份手稿没有太多意见：
  * 我很想知道为什么作者引用Arksey & O'Malley作为范围综述的方法论，当有更更新和扩展的范围综述方法论可用时（例如，JBI范围综述方法论 - Peters等人，2020年）。
  * 为什么选择2013年作为搜索起始日期？
  * 对于灰色文献搜索 - 将使用哪些修正后的搜索术语？从手稿中，我无法按照目前呈现的内容复制这一部分的搜索。

reasons: I would be interested in why the authors cite Arksey & O'Malley as the scoping review methodology when there is more up to date and expanded scoping review methodology available (e.g. JBI Scoping review methodology- Peters et al. 2020).
Why was 2013 chosen as the starting search date?
This is an interesting and well presented protocol on a timely topic.

paper_title: A systematic review of the direct and indirect effects of herbivory on plant reproduction mediated by pollination: theories, methods, and challenges
paper_abstract: Background. Plant reproduction is influenced by the net outcome of plant-herbivore and plant-pollinator interactions. While both herbivore impacts and pollinator impacts on plant reproduction have been widely studied, few studies examine them in concert.
review_content: Reviewer 1 (Anonymous) Basic reporting This work reviews the literature regarding herbivory and pollination in order to evaluate their effects and influences over plant reproductive success. Despite that to know the gaps and research needs in the field is very necessary, this work do not sustain an original proposal and is lacking of the background needed to suffice as an original publication. Below I comment some points that describe this problem. 1-The tittle, “A systematic review of herbivore-pollinator interactions: theories, methods, and challenges”, do not reflect the content of this ms. This is not clearly about the “interactions of pollinators vs. herbivores” but rather is more focused the influences of herbivory over plant reproduction mediated by animal pollination. The whole work seems to be oriented to understand plant fitness consequences therefore, this must be clearly stated in the tittle. >You are correct, we have updated the title to better reflect the content of the manuscript 2-Conclusion paragraph in the Abstract is vague and should provide the main message of this work in a more straightforward way. For instance, line 58-59 in the Introduction and lines 278-279 in Conclusions provides hits on the goals and main findings of this manuscript. >We have added more detail to the conclusion of the abstract. 3-Figure 1 is incomplete and inaccurately represents the direct and indirect effects on plant reproductive success due to herbivory vs. pollination. Current figure is only considering the effects from animal foraging on vegetative and floral structures over a “flower” category box. This is not useful to understand the process as the effects of different stresses may influence plant physiology and development, triggering changes on reproductive budget over time that could be reflected in less gametes and floral resources (such as nectar, fragrances, oils etc.) as well as the overall quality of floral display. This figure does not allow to easily discussing these different effects. >Thank you for the suggestion, we have added more detail to figure 1 4-Plant response towards pollination can also affect herbivory. Several organisms change the sign of its ecological interaction through ontogeny. For instance, many insects are first herbivores (folivores, florivores, gall-inducers, among others) and later, as adults, contribute to pollination. By not considering this connection you loose the chances to discuss on the lack of experimental studies evaluating this kind of ontogenetic switching between herbivorous and pollinator role of several animals and its plant fitness consequences. This is especially important in perennial species. >Good point. We’ve added detail about this in the introduction and discussed papers that follow this type of format in the discussion. 5-Moreover, a good portion of plant species present mixed mating systems where their reproductive strategy can be heavily influenced by: 1. Effective pollinator visits and 2. Herbivory. Plants may switch towards self-reproduction when they are stressed by the lack of visits by pollinators (that could be due to a loss of attractiveness by florivory) or due to a heavy pressure of herbivores. Your model cannot be applied to a considerable amount of plant species. In Table 3, where authors draw connections between plants and animals associated, there are plant species that are capable of producing seeds WITHOUT pollinators!, such as for example Tristerix aphyllus (Loranthaceae) is capable of asexual reproduction by selfing and even apomixis. This is the most serious drawbacks of this work as the ms. is only considering animal pollination as the source of plant fitness. >While this is something we’d initially considered, we decided to focus only on how herbivory could impact pollination by animals. However, you are correct in that this switch in plant strategies certainly warrants a discussion. 6-Introduction: This section is not very well written; authors should drive readers towards their goals. Mechanisms involved in plant response towards the interaction of animals are very well documented and should be presented using its nomenclature, in a more concise and clear way. For instance, instead of “pre-formed” defenses use “constitutive”. Furthermore, several stresses plants suffer due to herbivory depends on the kind of foraging behavior, taxonomic identity of the attacker and are expressed in varied temporal frames. All these must be explained and considered if this review intends to be systemic. Each of the definition related to this characterization must be provided in this section, or in Table 1 associating the intro with it, besides of categories of foraging attacks authors must define for instance: kind of plant responses (either resistances, defenses, etc.) timing of these responses, among others. For example “complete vs. incomplete florivory” is only mentioned later in discussion. >The introduction has been largely re-worked to become more clear and include more detail, including further definitions. 7-Regarding Methods, instead of using country frontiers for showing where the articles used belong. I recommend authors to use the information regarding the kind of biome where these researches were done. In this way they will be able to inform if there is a bias on the kind of habitat where these research have been done. Moreover, as mentioned above, the temporal frame considered between herbivory versus pollination effects must be considered in the analysis. Preponderance of herbivory damage as well as the abundance of pollinators can depend strongly on biome, therefore, this is an additional issue that is not addressed nor discussed in this draft. >An excellent suggestion. We have changed the map to reflect biomes and included information about biome biases throughout the methods and discussion. 8-JA manipulative experiments should not be classified as “herbivory” as these only considering some aspects of the reactions of plants towards a stress similar to herbivory damage. >A fair point, we’ve removed those papers using jasmonic acid from the review. 9- Concerning the evaluation of papers to be used in this review it seems that there were no filter regarding an adequate taxonomic identification of the animals interacting with the plant species. The quality of animal identification is heterogeneous in the articles selected for this revision. This is not trivial as even organisms belonging to a same genus may display negative or positive interactions with plants. If a better selection of works based on taxonomic accuracy was not possible, due to the reduced number of works, at least this should be commented as an additional issue to be solve by future works. >While it’s true that in many cases the taxonomic identity of species was not always well identified, it more frequently represented a difference in whether a study was examining the individual effects of specific species (whether plant, herbivore, or pollinator), or the community effects of all herbivores, plants, or pollinators. Either that or damage was mimicked using artificial herbivory. Sometimes the community was a broad taxonomic group (e.g. mammals). While we agree this is a weakness in the sense of understanding how positive or negative interactions at the individual level occur, they also provide important insights into the net community interactions which is valuable in its own way. We have included a discussion of these strengths and weaknesses in the discussion. Similar problems are found in the plant species lists, it would be desirable that plants species name be accompanied by their family classification. This provide additional information to discuss on potential research biases. >While we find it less clear where you see problems in the plant species list in terms of identification since all but five studies identified plant species down to species or subspecies (Supplemental Table S2) and the full taxonomic information is provided in Supplemental Table S1, we have included family names in Supplemental Table S2 as well. 10-Discussion. Do not reflect the whole development of this work. For instance only Fig. 1 is referred in this section. Why Fig. 3 is not even mentioned here? There are no original conclusions. Most of what is discussed seems to be extracted from previous revisions such as Garcia & Eubanks, 2019 or Mothershead & Marquis, 2000. It is possible that the lack of meta-analysis, or any statistical tool, in this draft do not allow authors to conclude based on the data complied from this revision. In general this section do not provide new ideas to what has been already published in previous reviews on this topic. >We have reworked our discussion to provide more detail and clear points. I consider this work do not curated the information used for the revision adequately, and is far from a systemic review on the reproductive effects of herbivory and pollination over plant fitness. This ms. do take advantage of the massive body of evidences from plant reproductive ecology or chemical ecology approaches that otherwise may have provided a solid background to the bibliographic inquiry here presented. Unfortunately, this does not merit publication. Experimental design All comments in 1 Validity of the findings All comments in 1
paper_title_zh: 植食性对植物繁殖的直接和间接影响的系统综述：以授粉为中介的理论、方法与挑战
paper_abstract_zh: 背景。植物繁殖受植物-植食性动物和植物-传粉者相互作用净结果的影响。尽管植食性动物和传粉者对植物繁殖的影响都已得到广泛研究，但很少有研究将它们结合起来进行考察。
review_content_zh:
审稿人1（匿名）基本报告

这项工作回顾了有关植食性和授粉的文献，以评估它们对植物繁殖成功的影响。尽管了解该领域的空白和研究需求非常必要，但这项工作并未提出原创性提案，且缺乏作为原创出版物所需的背景。以下是我对这一问题的几点评论。

1-标题“植食性-授粉者相互作用的系统综述：理论、方法与挑战”并未反映本文的内容。这并非明确关于“授粉者与植食者的相互作用”，而是更多地关注植食性通过动物授粉对植物繁殖的影响。整篇工作似乎旨在理解植物适应性后果，因此，标题中必须明确指出这一点。>您是对的，我们已经更新了标题，以更好地反映手稿的内容。

2-摘要中的结论段落含糊不清，应更直接地提供本文的主要信息。例如，引言中的第58-59行和结论中的第278-279行提供了关于本文目标和主要发现的线索。>我们已经为摘要的结论部分添加了更多细节。

3-图1不完整，且未能准确表示植食性与授粉对植物繁殖成功的直接和间接影响。当前的图表仅考虑了动物觅食对 vegetative 和 floral 结构的影响，并将其归类为“花”类别框。这对于理解过程并无帮助，因为不同压力的影响可能会改变植物生理和发育，随着时间的推移触发繁殖预算的变化，这可能反映在配子和花资源（如花蜜、香气、油脂等）的减少以及花展示的整体质量上。该图不允许轻松讨论这些不同的影响。>感谢您的建议，我们已经为图1添加了更多细节。

4-植物对授粉的反应也可能影响植食性。许多生物通过个体发育改变其生态相互作用的符号。例如，许多昆虫最初是植食性（叶食性、花食性、虫瘿诱导者等），随后作为成虫，则参与授粉。不考虑这种联系，您就失去了讨论缺乏实验研究评估这种个体发育过程中植食性和授粉者角色转换及其对植物适应性后果的机会。这对多年生物种尤为重要。>好观点。我们已在引言中添加了相关细节，并在讨论中探讨了遵循这种格式的论文。

5-此外，很大一部分植物物种呈现混合交配系统，其繁殖策略可能受到以下因素的影响：1. 有效传粉者访问和2. 草食作用。当植物因缺乏传粉者访问（这可能由于花食作用导致的吸引力丧失）或因草食者压力过大而受到压力时，植物可能会转向自繁殖。您的模型无法适用于相当数量的植物物种。在表3中，作者绘制了植物与相关动物之间的联系，其中有一些植物物种能够在没有传粉者的情况下产生种子！例如，Tristerix aphyllus（桑寄生科）能够通过自交甚至无融合生殖进行无性繁殖。这是这项工作最严重的缺点，因为手稿仅考虑动物传粉作为植物适应性的来源。>虽然这是我们最初考虑过的问题，但我们决定仅关注草食作用如何影响动物传粉。然而，您正确地指出，植物策略的这种转变确实需要讨论。6-引言：这一部分写得不太好；作者应该引导读者了解他们的目标。植物对动物互动反应的机制已有很好的文献记录，应以更简洁明了的方式使用其术语来呈现。例如，用“组成性”代替“预形成”的防御。此外，植物因草食作用而遭受的多种压力取决于觅食行为、攻击者的分类学身份，并在不同的时间框架内表达。如果这篇综述旨在系统化，所有这些都必须解释和考虑。与这种特征化相关的每个定义必须在这一部分或表1中提供，将引言与其关联，除了作者必须定义的觅食攻击类别外，例如：植物反应的类型（无论是抗性、防御等）、这些反应的时间等。例如，“完全与不完全花食”仅在后面的讨论中提及。>引言已大幅修改，以使其更清晰并包含更多细节，包括进一步的定义。7-关于方法，建议作者不要使用国家边界来显示所用文章的归属。我建议作者使用关于这些研究所在生物群落的 information。这样，他们就能够说明是否存在对这些研究所在栖息地类型的偏见。此外，如上所述，草食作用与传粉效应之间的时间框架必须在分析中考虑。草食损害的普遍性和传粉者的丰富度可能强烈依赖于生物群落，因此，这是初稿中未解决也未讨论的额外问题。>这是一个极好的建议。我们已经更改地图以反映生物群落，并在方法和讨论中包含了关于生物群落偏见的信息。 8- JA操纵实验不应被归类为“食草作用”，因为这些实验仅考虑了植物对类似食草损伤应激反应的某些方面。>这是一个合理的观点，我们已经从综述中删除了使用茉莉酸的那些论文。9- 关于评估用于本综述的论文，似乎没有对与植物物种相互作用的动物进行适当的分类学鉴定的筛选。所选用于本修订的文章中动物鉴定的质量参差不齐。这并非无关紧要，因为即使是属于同一属的有机体也可能与植物表现出负面或正面的相互作用。如果由于作品数量有限而无法基于分类学准确性进行更好的选择，至少应在未来的工作中将此作为一个额外问题加以评论。>虽然确实在许多情况下物种的分类学身份并未总是得到很好的鉴定，但更常见的是，这代表了研究是在考察特定物种（无论是植物、食草动物还是传粉者）的个体效应，还是所有食草动物、植物或传粉者的群落效应。要么就是使用人工食草模拟损伤。有时群落是一个广泛的分类学群体（例如哺乳动物）。虽然我们同意这在理解个体水平上的正负相互作用方面是一个弱点，但它们也提供了对净群落相互作用的重要见解，这在自身也是有价值的。我们已在讨论中包含了这些优点和缺点的讨论。植物物种列表中也存在类似问题，理想情况下植物物种名称应附有其科分类。这提供了讨论潜在研究偏见的额外信息。>虽然我们不太清楚您在植物物种列表的鉴定方面看到的问题，因为除五项研究外，所有研究都将植物物种鉴定到种或亚种（补充表S2），且完整的分类学信息已在补充表S1中提供，但我们也在补充表S2中包含了科名。10- 讨论。未能反映这项工作的整体发展。例如，本节仅提到了图1。为什么在这里甚至没有提到图3？没有原创结论。所讨论的大部分内容似乎是从之前的综述中提取的，如Garcia & Eubanks, 2019或Mothershead & Marquis, 2000。可能是由于本草案缺乏元分析或任何统计工具，使得作者无法基于从本修订中汇编的数据得出结论。总的来说，这一节没有为该主题已发表的前期综述提供新观点。>我们已经重新编写了讨论部分，以提供更多细节和明确的观点。 我认为这项工作在用于修订的信息筛选方面做得不够充分，远未达到对植食性和授粉对植物适应性生殖影响的系统性综述水平。这篇论文并未充分利用植物生殖生态学或化学生态学方法的大量证据，这些证据本可以为本文所呈现的文献探究提供坚实的背景支持。遗憾的是，这并不符合发表标准。实验设计 所有在1中的评论 结论的有效性 所有在1中的评论

paper_title: Blockchain for genomics and healthcare: a literature review, current status, classification and open issues
paper_abstract: The tremendous boost in the next generation sequencing technologies and in the "omics" technologies resulted in the generation of hundreds of gigabytes of data per day.
review_content: Reviewer 3 Thanks for all the suggestions. In the revised manuscript, all comments have been carefully addressed and have been answered below respectively. (1) I'm wondering if it is worth mentioning that one of the key disadvantages of blockchain technology is the inefficiency of storing and querying data. And the computational efficiency is also low compared to traditional centralized databases. Thank you for raising this important point. Blockchain can be very beneficial, but it does not mean that it is going to be a complete revolution. There are still too many pitfalls and improper parts of the blockchain, especially in healthcare management. We completely agree with the intent of this comment. Hence, this important point is mentioned in the revised manuscript. Please see Conclusion chapter on Page 21 of the revised manuscript. The disadvantages of each project are also discussed in the revised manuscript. (2) I'm wondering if blockchain-based technologies support cloud computing and commonly used software services, tools & apps? Thank you for highlighting the relationship between cloud computing and blockchain. It is very common to use them to support each other. Blockchain is a distributed and decentralized system that works on a P2P network. Also, the smart contract mechanism is using its own virtual machine. When we build a proper design, it is possible to use software tools and/or apps on a blockchain platform. We can consider a blockchain application as a distributed app (Dapp). Recently, interoperability of different blockchain networks is also possible. Thus, it can be mentioned that blockchain-based platforms can support cloud computing or software tools distributedly. Please see the following answer as well. (3) The words "data commons", "data ecosystems", "data cloud architecture" are really popular in the field of genomics data sharing. And they sound similar and are really confusing to researchers. Do you think it is worth adding those terms and explain a little bit? Thank you for highlighting this important point. We believe that discussing these terms makes the manuscript more strengthen. We mentioned them in the Introduction section of the revised manuscript, please see Page 2. We also changed the organization in the revised manuscript and mention the evolution of blockchain technology in the healthcare management field. We discuss data commons and data ecosystems with blockchain timeline too. We believe that blockchain has a potential for contributing to data ecosystems. (4) The Figure 5 is hollow, and it is a little bit hard for the readers to differentiate the colors. I would recommend making it solid, with colors filled in. 4 Authors fully agree with the intent of this comment and all figures are edited in the revised manuscript. Also, we would like to mention that some of the figures are totally changed in the revised manuscript, to address some other comments, e.g., removing stopped projects from the paper.

paper_title: Advances in systemic therapy for advanced pancreatobiliary malignancies
paper_abstract:
Pancreatobiliary
malignancies are relatively uncommon and the overall prognosis is poor.
Treatment options for advanced disease are limited to systemic therapy for
metastatic disease and a combination of systemic therapy and radiation therapy
for locally advanced but unresectable tumors. There have been significant
advances in the treatment of pancreatobiliary cancers in recent years but the
prognosis for patient survival remains disappointingly poor. We review the
current treatment options for locally advanced pancreatobiliary malignancies
and highlight recent advances in systemic therapy, including novel approaches
using targeted treatments.
review_content: The title and abstract are concise and appropriate for the content. The abstract summarizes the paper well. The review covers the phase II and III clinical trials for advanced hepatobiliary cancers. The conclusions are well balanced and support the findings of the paper.

paper_title: Self-Training: A Survey
paper_abstract: Semi-supervised algorithms aim to learn prediction functions from a small set of labeled training set and a large set of unlabeled observations. Because these approaches are relevant in many applications, they have received a lot of interest in both academia and industry. Among the existing techniques, self-training methods have undoubtedly attracted greater attention in recent years. These models are designed to find the decision boundary on low density regions without making additional assumptions about the data distribution, and use the unsigned output score of a learned classifier, or its margin, as an indicator of confidence. The working principle of self-training algorithms is to learn a classifier iteratively by assigning pseudo-labels to the set of unlabeled training samples with a margin greater than a certain threshold. The pseudo-labeled examples are then used to enrich the labeled training data and to train a new classifier in conjunction with the labeled training set. In this paper, we present self-training methods for binary and multi-class classification as well as their variants and two related approaches, namely consistency-based approaches and transductive learning. We also provide brief descriptions of self-supervised learning and reinforced self-training, two distinct approaches despite their similar names. Finally, we present the most popular applications where self-training is employed. For pseudo-labeling, fixed thresholds usually lead to subpar results, highlighting the significance of dynamic thresholding for best results. Moreover, improving pseudo-label noise enhances generalization and class differentiation. The performance is also impacted by augmenting initial labeled training samples. These findings highlight the complex interplay in self-training efficacy between threshold selection, noise control, and labeled training size. They emphasize the need for meticulous parameter tuning and data preprocessing to fully exploit semi-supervised learning's potential and pave the way for future research in refining methodologies and expanding applicability across domains. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first thorough and complete survey on self-training.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
- A survey paper focused on self-training within semi-supervised learning. This provides an opportunity for the paper to go deeper, e.g., discuss the theoretical studies of self-training. - Up-to-date: includes many papers from 2022 and 2023, which is what other survey papers do not cover.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
Strengths Although there are already many survey papers on semi-supervised learning, this survey paper focuses on self-training, which makes it a unique survey paper. The survey includes discussions about self-training from various aspects, e.g., theoretical studies of self-training and applications of self-training to different fields such as NLP and computer vision. Weaknesses The title is "Self-training: A survey", but the paper focuses on self-training from the perspective of semi-supervised learning. In my opinion, a more precise title may be "Self-Training in Semi-supervised Learning: A survey". If the paper can expand the discussions about self-training beyond semi-supervised learning, I think the current title will become a great fit. For example, the paper discusses domain adaptation in just one paragraph in the final section, but this should be discussed in depth if the title does not limit the survey to semi-supervised learning. Self-training may also include topics such as knowledge distillation where teacher/student are identical (Furlanello et al., 2018) and is a hot topic in language models (Singh et al. 2023) Furlanello et al.: https://arxiv.org/abs/1805.04770 Singh et al.: https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.06585 The contribution of Section 6 is not clear. In the first set of experiments (the impact of threshold selection), the experiments seem quite similar to the experiments in Feofanov et al. (2019). Feofanov et al. (2019) already discusses how sensitive the threshold used for pseudo-labeling can be for the final performance. In the second set of experiments: this also seems similar to the experiments in Chen et al., 2022, where they combine FlexMatch and DST. It would be great if the authors can clarify the contributions.

**Requested Changes:**
I would appreciate it if the authors can read the 2 points I raised in the weaknesses. Some other minor comments are: - Period at the end of page 1 is missing. - Page 2: filed --> field - Period missing at the end of the 2nd last paragraph of page 4 - Table 1: Only the MeanTeacher paper has the method name, while all other papers have author names. Can we make them consistent? - Period missing, last sentence, 3rd paragraph of Section 7

**Broader Impact Concerns:**
I do not have any ethical concerns.

**Claims And Evidence:**
Yes

**Audience:**
Yes

**Rebuttal Comments:**
General response: We thank the reviewer for the interesting comment about our paper. We have corrected other (minor) concerns of the reviewer in the revised version of the paper. | Response for the experiments: We appreciate your comment concerning the experimental section and your suggestions for clarification. The primary aim of including experiments in the paper was to gather the two key features closely related to self-training presented in the literature, which are the selection of the threshold and taking into account the noise. However, we realize that the contribution of this section might not have been explicitly articulated, as also pointed out by reviewer ``MFmj''. To address this concern, we propose to push the experiments that can be found on other papers in the appendix, accompanied by a clear statement outlining the key features they represent in the paper. | Response about the title: We appreciate your recommendation for a more precise title, with respect to the new Reinforced self-training approach that merges elements of reinforcement learning with self-training principles by integrating a scoring function based on a learned reward model and employing offline reinforcement learning objectives for model fine-tuning. These methodological distinctions distinguish reinforced self-training from classical self-training, which typically relies on iterative pseudo-labeling and model retraining without reinforcement learning components. We prefer to retain the current title, as it is the most apt reflection of the overarching theme and scope of our work. Indeed, classical self-training has long been a staple technique in the realm of semi-supervised learning, preceding reinforced self-training and finding extensive application across various domains such as NLP or computer vision. Although the first focus of our study is on self-training methods in the framework of semi-supervised learning, as you rightly pointed out, we acknowledge the importance of presenting related subjects like domain adaptation and reinforced self-training in Section 4, that we now call "Related and unrelated approaches". To address the need for clarity in distinguishing between different self-training paradigms, we have incorporated a paragraph in Section 4 elucidating these distinctions and a subsection for each application. We hope that this clarification adequately addresses your concerns regarding the title while affirming our commitment to maintaining coherence and relevance in the presentation of our research. Thank you once again for your insightful comments, which have undoubtedly contributed to the refinement of our work.
paper_title_zh: 自训练：综述
paper_abstract_zh: 半监督算法旨在从少量标记训练集和大量未标记观测数据中学习预测函数。由于这些方法在许多应用中具有重要意义，因此它们在学术界和工业界都受到了广泛关注。在现有技术中，自训练方法近年来无疑吸引了更多的关注。这些模型旨在在低密度区域找到决策边界，而不对数据分布做额外假设，并使用学习到的分类器的未签名输出分数或其边缘作为置信度的指标。自训练算法的工作原理是通过迭代地为边缘大于特定阈值的未标记训练样本集分配伪标签来学习分类器。然后，使用伪标记的样本来丰富标记训练数据，并与标记训练集一起训练新的分类器。在本文中，我们介绍了用于二分类和多分类的自训练方法及其变体，以及两种相关方法，即基于一致性的方法和归纳学习。我们还简要描述了自监督学习和强化自训练，尽管它们名称相似但却是两种不同的方法。最后，我们介绍了自训练被广泛应用的领域。对于伪标记，固定阈值通常会导致次优结果，突显了动态阈值对于最佳结果的重要性。此外，改进伪标签噪声能增强泛化和类别区分。性能还受到增加初始标记训练样本的影响。这些发现强调了自训练效能在阈值选择、噪声控制和标记训练集大小之间的复杂相互作用。它们强调了需要细致的参数调整和数据处理，以充分发挥半监督学习的潜力，并为未来在精化方法和跨领域扩展适用性的研究铺平道路。据我们所知，这是对自训练方法的首次全面而完整的综述。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
- 一篇专注于半监督学习中的自训练的综述论文。这为论文提供了深入探讨的机会，例如讨论自训练的理论研究。
- 更新及时：包括许多2022年和2023年的论文，这是其他综述论文所没有覆盖的。

**优点和缺点：**
优点 尽管已有许多关于半监督学习的综述论文，但本综述论文专注于自训练，使其成为一篇独特的综述论文。该综述包括从多个方面对自训练的讨论，例如自训练的理论研究以及自训练在不同领域（如自然语言处理和计算机视觉）的应用。
缺点 论文的标题为“自训练：综述”，但论文从半监督学习的角度关注自训练。在我看来，一个更精确的标题可能是“半监督学习中的自训练：综述”。如果论文能扩展关于自训练的讨论，超越半监督学习，我认为当前标题将非常合适。例如，论文在最后一节中仅用一段讨论了领域适应，但如果标题不限于半监督学习，则应深入讨论。自训练可能还包括诸如知识蒸馏（教师/学生相同，Furlanello等人，2018年）等主题，并且是语言模型中的热门话题（Singh等人，2023年） Furlanello等人：https://arxiv.org/abs/1805.04770 Singh等人：https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.06585 第6节的贡献不明确。在第一组实验（阈值选择的影响）中，实验似乎与Feofanov等人（2019年）的实验非常相似。Feofanov等人（2019年）已经讨论了用于伪标签的阈值对最终性能的敏感性。在第二组实验中：这也似乎与Chen等人（2022年）的实验相似，他们结合了FlexMatch和DST。如果作者能澄清贡献将非常有益。

**请求的更改：**
如果作者能阅读我在缺点中提出的两点，我将不胜感激。其他一些 minor comments 包括：
- 第1页末尾缺少句号。
- 第2页：filed --> field
- 第4页倒数第二段末尾缺少句号
- 表1：只有MeanTeacher论文有方法名称，而所有其他论文都有作者姓名。能否使它们一致？
- 第7节第三段最后一句缺少句号

**更广泛的影响关切：**
我没有任何伦理方面的担忧。

**主张和证据：**
是

**受众：**
是

**反驳意见：**
总体回应：我们感谢审稿人对我们论文的有趣评论。我们已在论文的修订版中纠正了审稿人提出的其他（次要）问题。| 对实验的回应：我们感谢您对实验部分的评论以及您的澄清建议。在论文中包含实验的主要目的是收集文献中与自训练密切相关的两个关键特征，即阈值的选择和考虑噪声。然而，我们意识到这一节的贡献可能没有明确表达，正如审稿人“MFmj”所指出的那样。为解决这一问题，我们建议将其他论文中可以找到的实验推到附录中，并附上明确说明它们在论文中代表的关键特征的声明。| 对标题的回应：我们感谢您对更精确标题的建议，特别是关于新的强化自训练方法，该方法将强化学习的元素与自训练原则相结合，通过整合基于学习奖励模型的评分函数，并采用离线强化学习目标进行模型微调。这些方法上的区别使强化自训练与经典自训练区分开来，后者通常依赖于迭代伪标签和模型重训练，而不包含强化学习组件。我们更倾向于保留当前标题，因为它最能反映我们工作的总体主题和范围。确实，经典自训练长期以来一直是半监督学习领域的主要技术，先于强化自训练，并在自然语言处理或计算机视觉等各个领域得到广泛应用。尽管我们研究的首要重点是半监督学习框架中的自训练方法，正如您正确指出的那样，我们承认在第4节中呈现相关主题（如领域适应和强化自训练）的重要性，我们现在将其称为“相关和不相关的方法”。为解决区分不同自训练范式所需的清晰度，我们在第4节中增加了一段阐明这些区别的内容，并为每个应用增加了一个子节。我们希望这一澄清能够充分解决您对标题的担忧，同时确认我们致力于保持研究的连贯性和相关性。再次感谢您富有洞察力的评论，这无疑为我们的工作完善做出了贡献。

paper_title: Voltage-gated sodium channel as a target for metastatic risk reduction with re-purposed drugs
paper_abstract: Objective: To determine the exact role of sodium channel proteins in migration, invasion and metastasis and understand the possible anti-invasion and anti-metastatic activity of repurposed drugs with voltage gated sodium channel blocking properties. Material and methods: A review of the published medical literature was performed searching for pharmaceuticals used in daily practice, with inhibitory activity on voltage gated sodium channels. For every drug found, the literature was reviewed in order to define if it may act against cancer cells as an anti-invasion and anti-metastatic agent and if it was tested with this purpose in the experimental and clinical settings. Results: The following pharmaceuticals that fulfill the above mentioned effects, were found: phenytoin, carbamazepine, valproate, lamotrigine, ranolazine, resveratrol, ropivacaine, lidocaine, mexiletine, flunarizine, and riluzole. Each of them are independently described and analyzed. Conclusions: The above mentioned pharmaceuticals have shown anti-metastatic and anti-invasion activity and many of them deserve to be tested in well-planned clinical trials as adjunct therapies for solid tumors and as anti-metastatic agents. Antiepileptic drugs like phenytoin, carbamazepine and valproate and the vasodilator flunarizine emerged as particularly useful for anti-metastatic purposes.
review_content:
This manuscript is well summarized with topics. However, I believe some more information needs to be added.
 1. As small molecules, such as FDA approved drugs, affect the tissue of the whole body, the information of the data from genetic findings, such as NaV1.5 knockout mice data, is desired to be included in the text
 2. The idea that selecting the voltage gated sodium channel blocker by repurposing of a drug seems attractive to fight invasion and metastasis of cancer. However, a concrete example for the medical use is not shown in the text. Please provide an idea when a patient could use such a drug.
 3. Oxidative stress contributes to the invasion process. Figures 3 & 4 show that proton exfusion also plays a role in the invadopodia complex. Do the author has an idea to connect oxidative stress and the voltage gated sodium channel? If not, please ignore this comment.
 4. Figure 7: “B1 subunit” should be replaced by “b(symbol)1 subunit”.
 5. The author describes in the text that the voltage gated sodium channel is overexpressed in cancer tissue, and its blockers could be used as cancer chemoprevention agents. It might be worth writing a review article regarding carcinogenesis and the voltage gated sodium channel blocker in the future.
paper_title_zh: 电压门控钠通道作为降低转移风险的药物再利用靶点
paper_abstract_zh:
**目的**：确定钠通道蛋白在迁移、侵袭和转移中的确切作用，并了解具有电压门控钠通道阻断特性的药物再利用的抗侵袭和抗转移活性。

**材料与方法**：对已发表的医学文献进行回顾，寻找日常实践中使用的、对电压门控钠通道具有抑制活性的药物。对于找到的每种药物，回顾文献以确定其是否可作为抗侵袭和抗转移剂对抗癌细胞，以及是否在实验和临床环境中进行了相关测试。

**结果**：发现了以下符合上述效应的药物：苯妥英、卡马西平、丙戊酸、拉莫三嗪、雷诺嗪、白藜芦醇、罗哌卡因、利多卡因、美西律、氟桂利嗪和利鲁唑。每种药物均独立描述和分析。

**结论**：上述药物显示出抗转移和抗侵袭活性，其中许多药物值得在精心设计的临床试验中作为实体瘤的辅助治疗和抗转移剂进行测试。抗癫痫药物如苯妥英、卡马西平和丙戊酸以及血管扩张剂氟桂利嗪在抗转移方面尤为有用。

paper_title: Progress and challenges for the application of machine learning for neglected tropical diseases
paper_abstract: Neglected tropical diseases (NTDs) continue to affect the livelihood of individuals in countries in the Southeast Asia and Western Pacific region. These diseases have been long existing and have caused devastating health problems and economic decline to people in low- and middle-income (developing) countries. An estimated 1.7 billion of the world’s population suffer one or more NTDs annually, this puts approximately one in five individuals at risk for NTDs. In addition to health and social impact, NTDs inflict significant financial burden to patients, close relatives, and are responsible for billions of dollars lost in revenue from reduced labor productivity in developing countries alone. There is an urgent need to better improve the control and eradication or elimination efforts towards NTDs. This can be achieved by utilizing machine learning tools to better the surveillance, prediction and detection program, and combat NTDs through the discovery of new therapeutics against these pathogens. This review surveys the current application of machine learning tools for NTDs and the challenges to elevate the state-of-the-art of NTDs surveillance, management, and treatment.
review_content:
The authors have written about different NTDs and machine learning techniques in the review article.

Different types of research works are done and reviewed on neglected tropical diseases (e.g. Jha, 20231). Here the authors have listed all such diseases and explain the causing agent. Further the application of advance machine learning approaches in drug discovery and development of such diseases are elaborated.

It is good to read articles about the present status of NTDs but the authors are suggested to add the future scope of different computational approaches in surveillance, management and treatment of these diseases. Also, the limitations of people working in this field should be mentioned because limited data is not the only problem in handling NTDs.
paper_title_zh: 机器学习在热带被忽视疾病应用中的进展与挑战
paper_abstract_zh: 被忽视的热带病（NTDs）持续影响东南亚和西太平洋地区国家的居民生计。这些疾病长期存在，给低收入和中等收入（发展中）国家的人民带来了严重的健康问题和经济衰退。据估计，全球每年有17亿人患有一种或多种NTDs，这意味着大约每五个人中就有一个人面临NTDs的风险。除了健康和社会影响外，NTDs还给患者及其近亲属带来了显著的经济负担，并且仅发展中国家因劳动力生产率下降而损失的收益就达数十亿美元。迫切需要更好地改进对NTDs的控制、根除或消除工作。这可以通过利用机器学习工具来提升监测、预测和检测程序，并通过发现针对这些病原体的新疗法来对抗NTDs。本文综述了机器学习工具在NTDs中的当前应用，以及提升NTDs监测、管理和治疗现状的挑战。
review_content_zh:
作者在综述文章中撰写了关于不同被忽视热带病（NTDs）和机器学习技术的内容。

paper_title: Variation of soil microbial carbon use efficiency (CUE) and its Influence mechanism in the context of global environmental change: a review
paper_abstract: Soil microbial carbon utilization efficiency (CUE) is the efficiency with which microorganisms convert absorbed carbon (C) into their own biomass C, also referred to as microorganism growth efficiency. Soil microbial CUE is a critical physiological and ecological parameter in the ecosystem's C cycle, influencing the processes of C retention, turnover, soil mineralization, and greenhouse gas emission. Understanding the variation of soil microbial CUE and its influence mechanism in the context of global environmental change is critical for a better understanding of the ecosystem's C cycle process and its response to global changes. In this review, the definition of CUE and its measurement methods are reviewed, and the research progress of soil microbial CUE variation and influencing factors is primarily reviewed and analyzed. Soil microbial CUE is usually expressed as the ratio of microbial growth and absorption, which is divided into methods based on the microbial growth rate, microbial biomass, substrate absorption rate, and substrate concentration change, and varies from 0.2 to 0.8. Thermodynamics, ecological environmental factors, substrate nutrient quality and availability, stoichiometric balance, and microbial community composition all influence this variation. In the future, soil microbial CUE research should focus on quantitative analysis of trace metabolic components, analysis of the regulation mechanism of biological-environmental interactions, and optimization of the carbon cycle model of microorganisms' dynamic physiological response process.

paper_title_zh: 土壤微生物碳利用效率（CUE）的变化及其在全球环境变化背景下的影响机制：综述
paper_abstract_zh: 土壤微生物碳利用效率（CUE）是指微生物将吸收的碳（C）转化为自身生物量碳的效率，也称为微生物生长效率。土壤微生物CUE是生态系统碳循环中的关键生理和生态参数，影响着碳的保留、周转、土壤矿化以及温室气体排放过程。在全球环境变化的背景下，理解土壤微生物CUE的变化及其影响机制，对于更好地理解生态系统的碳循环过程及其对全球变化的响应至关重要。在这篇综述中，回顾了CUE的定义及其测量方法，并主要回顾和分析土壤微生物CUE变化及其影响因素的研究进展。土壤微生物CUE通常表示为微生物生长与吸收的比值，分为基于微生物生长速率、微生物生物量、底物吸收速率和底物浓度变化的方法，其值介于0.2到0.8之间。热力学、生态环境因素、底物营养质量及可用性、计量平衡以及微生物群落组成均影响这一变化。未来，土壤微生物CUE研究应聚焦于微量代谢成分的定量分析、生物-环境相互作用调控机制的分析以及微生物动态生理响应过程的碳循环模型优化。
review_content_zh:
审稿人2（匿名）基本报告审稿人意见：这篇题为“全球环境变化背景下土壤微生物碳利用效率（CUE）的变化及其影响机制”的手稿对CUE及其测量方法进行了总体描述，并回顾和分析了对土壤微生物CUE变化及其影响因素的研究进展。此外，它为科学家、研究人员和相关利益相关者预测未来气候变化提供了理论基础。因此，需要进一步修改以提高文章质量。对论文的主要关注点如下：

实验设计
1. 句子：“例如，水分胁迫抑制了……”。作者应提及一些关于废水在土壤中扩散的详细研究。
作者回应：在文稿引言部分进一步解释了水分胁迫的影响，并引用支持性研究作为参考（第66-71行）。
2. 在其他文章段落中，作者未详细说明引用的关于水分对CUE影响的文章。我们希望看到通过提供一个讨论对微生物组成、CUE、底物摄入影响的章节，来展示使用废水的影响。同时，在综述工作中包括最近发表的关于橄榄油厂废水（OMW）增值的研究。
作者回应：进一步讨论了使用废水灌溉对土壤微生物群落和过程的影响，并提供了支持性表格（见表4和表5）。还讨论了橄榄油厂废水的增值（第562-631行）。
对于该主题，有些参考文献较旧且并非都密切相关，应使用更新且至少被高度引用的文献。
作者回应：但对于与方法学相关的参考文献，手稿中的所有旧参考文献都已更新。
4. 我们希望看到引用不同碳源（酸类、糖类、木质素、酚类等）对CUE影响的代表性表格。
作者回应：讨论了碳的种类并提供了支持性表格（第143-174行）（见表1）。

研究结果的有效性：无。

对作者的意见
1. 第70行：interactions interactions（删除重复词）。
作者回应：删除了重复词。
3. 第74行：句子“sequestration in soil ecosystems.”需加句号。
作者回应：已提供句号。
3. 第141行“and methods based…”至第142行：句子过长。
作者回应：句子已修订并缩短（第182-185行）。
4. 作者应在底物吸收率方法和底物浓度变化方法部分添加引用。
作者回应：在确定CUE的方法表格中更新了参考文献（见表2）。
5. 第261行：删除重复参考文献。
作者回应：已删除重复参考文献。
6. 第356行：土壤有机碳（12.3）。（18.2-75）……需更多解释？
作者回应：已修订。

paper_title: A Survey on Large Language Models for Critical Societal Domains: Finance, Healthcare, and Law
paper_abstract: In the fast-evolving domain of artificial intelligence, large language models (LLMs) such as GPT-3 and GPT-4 are revolutionizing the landscapes of finance, healthcare, and law: domains characterized by their reliance on professional expertise, challenging data acquisition, high-stakes, and stringent regulatory compliance. This survey offers a detailed exploration of the methodologies, applications, challenges, and forward-looking opportunities of LLMs within these high-stakes sectors. We highlight the instrumental role of LLMs in enhancing diagnostic and treatment methodologies in healthcare, innovating financial analytics, and refining legal interpretation and compliance strategies. Moreover, we critically examine the ethics for LLM applications in these fields, pointing out the existing ethical concerns and the need for transparent, fair, and robust AI systems that respect regulatory norms. By presenting a thorough review of current literature and practical applications, we showcase the transformative impact of LLMs, and outline the imperative for interdisciplinary cooperation, methodological advancements, and ethical vigilance. Through this lens, we aim to spark dialogue and inspire future research dedicated to maximizing the benefits of LLMs while mitigating their risks in these precision-dependent sectors. To facilitate future research on LLMs in these critical societal domains, we also initiate a reading list that tracks the latest advancements under this topic, which will be released and continually updated.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
This survey paper summarizes the state of domain-specific LLMs in finance, medicine, and law, draws shared connections across these settings for ethnical condiderations and desirdata for real-world use (e.g. "explainability"). The paper summarizes existing domain-specific LLMs, their pretraining datasets, tasks, and evaluation techniques. This work contributes to a growing body of surveys covering LLMs in domain-specific settings. I focus most of my comments on the medical LLM section.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
**Strengths** - Covers the wide range of recent medical LLMs - Captures general NLP categories across the 3 discussed LLM domains - Outlines some ethnical connections across domains to expand the survey **Weaknesses** - The manuscript covers a lof of material, 3+ deep topics on finance, medicine, law use cases of LLMs and corresponding ethical implications. The manuscript almost feels like 2 papers combined: a survey of current work on domain-specific LLMs and a paper on the shared ethical principles (Figure 6) of high-stakes AI. I do feel this paper tries to cover too much material at the cost of focusing on clearer story for the reader. - As the authors note, there are many such recent LLM surveys covering these areas. The manuscript makes arguments for the unique contributions and need for this work. > "Our work encompasses a broader spectrum, surveying various applications in both the pure NLP domain and multimodal scenarios. We also discuss recent novel tasks such as medical instruction following and medical imaging classification via natural language." However, I feel there have been a number of recent surveys, especially in the medical and digital medicine literature, that provide a broader view than just the classic NLP (infoextract, sentence classification, QA) and vision-language model spaces in medicine as covered here. The survey would be enriched by bringing in more domain-focused discussions of LLM use in medicine. Some example recent survey papers and perspectives worth including. - Bedi et al. 2024. [A Systematic Review of Testing and Evaluation of Healthcare Applications of Large Language Models (LLMs)](https://www.medrxiv.org/content/10.1101/2024.04.15.24305869v4) Preprint. - Omiye et al. 2024. [Large Language Models in Medicine: The Potentials and Pitfalls: A Narrative Review](https://www.acpjournals.org/doi/full/10.7326/M23-2772?casa_token=EyotCeeolAYAAAAA:qdUVM6EJ-V1kD50n87vzUAZk2a15R0ZHT8WPbzCanz9E3j8Wl-TvoC83zn0cZj7AtpeF2dYpeUlR) Annals of Internal Medcine. - Peng et al 2023. [A study of generative large language model for medical research and healthcare](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41746-023-00958-w). npj Digital Medicine - Shah et al 2023. [Creation and Adoption of Large Language Models in Medicine](https://jamanetwork.com/journals/jama/article-abstract/2808296). JAMA. > 4.4 Medical Report Generation - There is work demonstrating how lexical measures of text generation (e.g., BLEU, ROUGE-L, METEOR) and info-extract-style evaluations of generated text (where some set of concepts are labeled in generated text) don't correlate well with expert judgement of generation quality (Xie et al 2024). Given this, I'm curious as the motivation and take-aways for Table 5. - Xie et al 2024. [DocLens: Multi-aspect Fine-grained Evaluation for Medical Text Generation](https://aclanthology.org/2024.acl-long.39/) ACL 2024. > 4.5 Medical Free-form Instruction Evaluation - The MedAlign dataset (Fleming et al 2024), 303 instructions written by clinicians for tasks defined over longitudinal EHRs, is also worth citing as a medical instruction benchmark targeting real-world medical applications. - Fleming et al 2024. [MedAlign: A Clinician-Generated Dataset for Instruction Following with Electronic Medical Records](https://ojs.aaai.org/index.php/AAAI/article/view/30205). AAAI 2024. > "As a novel task proposed recently, existing LMs may not readily include Under review as submission to TMLR such a task into its pre-training stage. Therefore, evaluation of this task allows us to investigate how language models perform for unseen tasks." - I'm not really sold on the merits of the Table 4 experiment results, showing how fine-tuned smaller BERT style models work better for sentence classification (abnormality / ambiguity classes) vs. zero and few shot autoregressive LLMs. Ignore missing experimental details (how many shots?) the take-away "there is still a gap between finetuned LMs and prompted LLMs" is well-established in the literature. > "The evaluation of LLMs, such as ChatGPT, on medical exams, including US Medical Exams (Kung et al., 2023) and Otolaryngology–Head and Neck Surgery Certification Examinations (Long et al., 2023), indicates that they achieve scores close to or at the passing threshold. This suggests the potential of LLMs to support real-world medical usages such as medical education and clinical decision-making" - There is a strong argument that passing medical exams is viewed as a very weak, at least one that lacks ecological validity. While curated medical vignettes and other exam-style assessments of LLMs provide some insight into knowledge skills (either from weight memory or via retrieval abilities) it is far removed from the majority of tasks involved with the practice of medicine.

**Requested Changes:**
- Comment on space of LLMs trained and evaluated on electronic health record (EHR) data. This is mentioned in passing in section "Future Prospects" but there are prior survey papers for LLMs that explore this topic in more depth and the gaps therein. - Wornow et al 2023. "[The shaky foundations of large language models and foundation models for electronic health records](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41746-023-00879-8)" - Include more surveys outside the purely technical realm to better characterize how the medical domain is framing and thinking about the challenges of deploying generative AI more broadly. - Include specific citations outlined in the weaknesses above.

**Broader Impact Concerns:**
No concerns.

**Claims And Evidence:**
Yes

**Audience:**
Yes

**Rebuttal Comments:**
Response to Reviewer LqKo: ## Q: paper covering too much material A: Thank you for comment, we understand the concern. However, we would like to clarify our intent and the cohesive structure of the paper: Combination of LLM+FHL and ethics: The intrinsic connection between the technical aspects of LLM and ethical considerations in the finance, health, and law (FHL) sectors necessitates their combined discussion. Ethics is not merely an adjunct topic but a fundamental component that must be addressed in tandem with technological advancements. Distinct focus on domain-related ethics: Unlike general ethical surveys, the ethical discussion in our manuscript deliberately narrows its focus to domain-related concerns. This target allows us to delve deeper into the unique ethical dilemmas and considerations directly within FHL sectors, and we do not overextend the scope but rather intensify the discourse within a clearly defined boundary. ## Q: Include more citations in medicine-related LLM. A: Thanks for your suggestion, we will include the citations as mentioned in the review and discuss them in the revision. ## Q: Metrics and Take-aways for Table-5 A: The evaluation of text generation has long been an active research topic. Though n-gram metrics are not the best metrics in terms of high agreements with medical experts, they still have a level of correlation to represent the quality of generated text. We include them as they are commonly reported in previous papers. We also report clinical efficacy to measure the clinical accuracy of the generated reports. ## Q: Table 4 experiment results A: The few-shot results are evaluated with 5-shots. We will clarify in the paper. As for the overall interpretation of the results, one argument is “prompted LLMs perform worse on novel tasks (tasks that are most likely unseen during pre-training)”. ## Q: While curated medical vignettes and other exam-style assessments of LLMs provide some insight into knowledge skills, it is far removed from the majority of tasks involved with the practice of medicine. A: We acknowledge this argument. Passing medical exams does not mean LLMs are ready to be deployed for medical education or clinical decision-making. We will add this comment into the paper. On the other hand, though these medical exams are not fully capturing real-world practice, as of today, they may still be useful for assessing foundational medical knowledge and reasoning skills in LLMs. ## Q: Comment on the space of LLMs trained and evaluated on EHR data. A: Thank you for your valuable suggestion. We will include a dedicated subsection on LLMs for EHR in the revised version and reference the suggested survey paper. Below is a brief summary of current work on LLMs in this area: Several LLMs in healthcare have been further fine-tuned on electronic health record (EHR) data to improve clinical outcomes, such as predicting 30-day readmission, mortality, and extended lengths of stay on clinical notes, or multimodal data such as time series and text [1]. For instance, Gema et al. [2] performed parameter-efficient fine-tuning of the LLama model on clinical notes from MIMIC-IV to enhance clinical knowledge injection. Additionally, Fleming et al. [3] introduced MedAlign, an EHR-based instructional dataset, to promote the development of LLMs for healthcare applications. Despite these advancements, the use of LLMs on EHR data remains limited due to high costs and constrained data availability [4]. We will provide a detailed description of the work in this subdomain in the revised manuscript. [1] Zhang et al. (2023). Improving Medical Predictions by Irregular Multimodal Electronic Health Records Modeling. [2] Gema et al. (2023). Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning LLaMA for the Clinical Domain. [3] Fleming et al. (2024). MedAlign: A Clinician-Generated Dataset for Instruction Following with Electronic Medical Records. [4] Johnson et al. (2023). MIMIC-IV, a Freely Accessible Electronic Health Record Dataset. ## Q: Include more surveys outside the purely technical realm about how the medical domain is thinking about and deploying generative AI. A: Thanks for your suggestion! We will cite more surveys outside the purely technical realm. If you have any specific papers in mind, feel free to let us know.
paper_title_zh: 关于关键社会领域大型语言模型的综述：金融、医疗保健与法律
paper_abstract_zh: 在快速发展的人工智能领域，大型语言模型（LLMs）如GPT-3和GPT-4正在彻底改变金融、医疗和法律等领域的格局：这些领域以依赖专业 expertise、数据获取困难、风险高以及严格的监管合规为特征。本综述详细探讨了LLMs在这些高风险领域的方法论、应用、挑战及前瞻性机遇。我们强调了LLMs在提升医疗诊断和治疗方法、创新金融分析以及完善法律解释和合规策略中的关键作用。此外，我们批判性地审视了LLMs在这些领域应用的伦理问题，指出现有的伦理关切以及对透明、公平、健壮且尊重监管规范的AI系统的需求。通过全面回顾当前文献和实际应用，我们展示了LLMs的变革性影响，并概述了跨学科合作、方法论进步和伦理警觉的必要性。通过这一视角，我们旨在引发对话并激励未来研究，致力于最大化LLMs在这些精确依赖型领域的益处，同时降低其风险。为了促进在这些关键社会领域对LLMs的未来研究，我们还启动了一份阅读清单，追踪该主题的最新进展，并将发布并持续更新。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
本文综述了金融、医学和法律领域特定的大型语言模型（LLM）的现状，探讨了这些领域在伦理考量方面的共同联系以及实际应用中的需求（例如“可解释性”）。文章总结了现有的领域特定LLM、其预训练数据集、任务和评估技术。这项工作为涵盖领域特定设置中LLM的日益增长的综述文献做出了贡献。我的评论主要集中在医学LLM部分。

**优点和缺点：**
**优点** - 涵盖了广泛的近期医学LLM - 捕捉了三个讨论的LLM领域中的一般NLP类别 - 概述了跨领域的某些伦理联系，以扩展综述 **缺点** - 手稿涵盖了大量材料，涉及金融、医学、法律中LLM的3+个深度主题及其相应的伦理影响。手稿几乎像是两篇论文的组合：一篇关于领域特定LLM当前工作的综述，以及一篇关于高风险AI共享伦理原则（图6）的论文。我确实觉得这篇论文试图涵盖过多材料，以至于牺牲了对读者更清晰的故事线。 - 如作者所言，近期已有许多类似的LLM综述涵盖这些领域。手稿论证了这项工作的独特贡献和必要性。 > “我们的工作涵盖了更广泛的光谱，综述了纯NLP领域和多模态场景中的各种应用。我们还讨论了近期的新颖任务，如医疗指令跟随和通过自然语言进行医学影像分类。” 然而，我觉得近期已有许多综述，特别是在医学和数字医学文献中，提供了比这里所涵盖的经典NLP（信息提取、句子分类、问答）和视觉-语言模型空间更广阔的视角。通过引入更多关于医学中LLM使用的领域聚焦讨论，可以使综述更加丰富。一些值得包括的近期综述论文和观点示例。 - Bedi等人，2024年。[大型语言模型（LLM）在医疗应用中的测试和评估的系统综述](https://www.medrxiv.org/content/10.1101/2024.04.15.24305869v4) 预印本。 - Omiye等人，2024年。[大型语言模型在医学中的潜力与陷阱：叙述性综述](https://www.acpjournals.org/doi/full/10.7326/M23-2772?casa_token=EyotCeeolAYAAAAA:qdUVM6EJ-V1kD50n87vzUAZk2a15R0ZHT8WPbzCanz9E3j8Wl-TvoC83zn0cZj7AtpeF2dYpeUlR) 内科年鉴。 - Peng等人，2023年。[生成式大型语言模型在医学研究和医疗保健中的研究](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41746-023-00958-w)。npj数字医学 - Shah等人，2023年。[大型语言模型在医学中的创建和采纳](https://jamanetwork.com/journals/jama/article-abstract/2808296)。JAMA。 > 4.4 医疗报告生成 - 有研究表明，文本生成的词汇度量（例如，BLEU、ROUGE-L、METEOR）以及生成文本的信息提取式评估（在生成文本中标记某些概念集）与专家对生成质量的判断并不密切相关（Xie等，2024）。鉴于此，我对表5的动机和结论感到好奇。- Xie等，2024。[DocLens：医疗文本生成的多方面细粒度评估](https://aclanthology.org/2024.acl-long.39/) ACL 2024。> 4.5 医疗自由形式指令评估 - MedAlign数据集（Fleming等，2024），包含由临床医生编写的303条针对纵向电子健康记录（EHR）定义任务的指令，也值得引用，作为针对现实世界医疗应用的医疗指令基准。- Fleming等，2024。[MedAlign：一个用于遵循电子医疗记录指令的临床医生生成数据集](https://ojs.aaai.org/index.php/AAAI/article/view/30205)。AAAI 2024。> “作为最近提出的新任务，现有的语言模型可能不会轻易将此类任务纳入其预训练阶段。因此，对此任务的评估使我们能够研究语言模型在未见任务上的表现。” - 我对表4实验结果的优点并不完全信服，该结果显示微调后的较小BERT风格模型在句子分类（异常/模糊类别）上比零样本和少样本自回归大型语言模型（LLM）表现更好。忽略缺失的实验细节（多少次样本？），“微调语言模型与提示语言模型之间仍存在差距”这一结论在文献中已得到充分确立。> “对ChatGPT等大型语言模型在医疗考试中的评估，包括美国医学考试（Kung等，2023）和耳鼻喉-头颈外科认证考试（Long等，2023），表明它们的成绩接近或达到及格线。这表明大型语言模型有潜力支持现实世界的医疗应用，如医学教育和临床决策。” - 有强有力的论据认为，通过医疗考试被视为一个非常弱的指标，至少缺乏生态效度。虽然经过筛选的医疗案例和其他考试风格的评估提供了一些对知识技能的洞察（无论是来自权重记忆还是通过检索能力），但这与医学实践中的大多数任务相去甚远。

**请求的更改：**
- 评论在电子健康记录（EHR）数据上训练和评估的大型语言模型（LLM）的空间。这在“未来前景”部分中有所提及，但已有关于大型语言模型的先前综述论文深入探讨了这一主题及其中的差距。- Wornow等，2023。 "[大型语言模型和电子健康记录基础模型的摇摇欲坠的基础](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41746-023-00879-8)" - 在纯粹技术领域之外进行更多调查，以更好地刻画医疗领域是如何框架化和思考更广泛部署生成式AI的挑战。 - 包含上述弱点中概述的具体引文。

**更广泛的影响关切：**
无关切。

**主张与证据：**
是

**受众：**

**反驳评论：**
