paper_title: Melatonin: The potential avenues in dentistry
paper_abstract:
Melatonin, the “sleep hormone,” shows significant promise in dentistry owing to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory properties. It is beneficial for treating periodontal disorders and aiding osseointegration of dental implants. Additionally, melatonin helps to manage dental anxiety, offering an alternative to traditional sedatives. 
  Periodontal disease is orchestrated by bacterial plaques along with an exaggerated immune-inflammatory host response. Treatment of periodontitis not only involves the removal of plaque, but also aims to minimize the cytokine load and control the reactive oxygen species burden in the tissues, which would re-establish a healthy periodontium and a balanced bone metabolism. 
  Melatonin is known to exert beneficial effects, such as regulation of circadian rhythm, bone remodeling, and antimicrobial effects. 
  Recent studies have demonstrated the successful use of melatonin as an adjunct to mechanical debridement for the treatment of periodontal disease. Its various uses include systemic administration of melatonin after one-stage full-mouth Non-Surgical Periodontal Therapy in healthy subjects as well as patients. 
  This article provides a summary of the various clinical applications of melatonin, describing its mechanism of action, uses, and potential avenues for future research in dentistry.
review_content:
Summary and Relevance
This article reports on melatonin which is of interest in dentistry today due to its multiple properties like antimicrobial, anti inflammatory, antioxidant and immunomodulation. The article highlights the possibility of melatonin playing a role in management of periodontal diseases and also possibly enhancing the osseointegration of dental implants ,which is making rapid strides as a treatment modality for replacement of missing teeth.
Evidence based literature is available today on the multiple beneficial effects of melatonin and hence this article is relevant as a review on the current status of melatonin and its potential benefits in periodontal and implant therapy.
Strengths and Weaknesses
The strength of this article is its narration of the therapeutic benefits of melatonin, a hormone which is ignited interest in the field of dentistry , in the oral cavity and the advantages of its application in a variety of oral diseases including oral carcinoma.
The weakness of this article is that it is just a narrative review and hence no conclusion can be drawn from it, only some possibilities and future prospects can be stated. Hence it is only of limited interest.
paper_title_zh: 褪黑素：牙科中的潜在途径
paper_abstract_zh:
褪黑素，即“睡眠激素”，因其抗氧化、抗炎和免疫调节特性，在牙科领域展现出显著的应用前景。它有助于治疗牙周疾病并促进牙科植入物的骨整合。此外，褪黑素还能帮助管理牙科焦虑，为传统镇静剂提供了替代方案。
牙周病的发病机制由细菌菌斑以及过度的宿主免疫炎症反应共同作用所致。牙周炎的治疗不仅涉及去除菌斑，还旨在减少组织中的细胞因子负荷和控制活性氧负担，以重建健康的牙周组织和平衡的骨代谢。
褪黑素已知具有多种有益效应，如调节昼夜节律、骨重塑和抗菌作用。
近期研究表明，褪黑素作为机械清创术的辅助手段，在治疗牙周病方面取得了成功。其应用方式包括在健康受试者和患者接受单阶段全口非手术牙周治疗后进行褪黑素的系统性给药。
本文总结了褪黑素在临床上的各种应用，描述了其作用机制、用途以及在牙科领域未来研究的潜在方向。
review_content_zh:
摘要与相关性
本文报道了褪黑素在当今牙科领域的多重特性，如抗菌、抗炎、抗氧化和免疫调节。文章强调了褪黑素在牙周病管理中可能发挥的作用，以及可能增强牙科植入物的骨整合，后者作为缺失牙齿替代治疗手段正在迅速发展。目前已有基于证据的文献表明褪黑素的多重益处，因此本文作为对褪黑素当前状态及其在牙周和植入治疗中潜在益处的综述，具有重要相关性。

优点与缺点
本文的优点在于叙述了褪黑素这一激素在口腔内的治疗益处，以及在包括口腔癌在内的多种口腔疾病中的应用优势，激发了牙科领域的兴趣。
本文的缺点在于它仅是一篇叙述性综述，因此无法从中得出结论，只能陈述一些可能性和未来前景。因此，其兴趣价值有限。

reasons: It is very well written review article on Melatonin - the potential avenues in dentistry.

limitation of previous studies to identify the standard Therapeutic dosage in periodontal therapy, recommendation regarding one time or multiple administration in pocket (local drug delivery) , long term evaluation of clinical results can be incorporated in discussion part.

paper_title: Phytochemical profiling of Piper crocatum and its antifungal mechanism action as Lanosterol 14 alpha demethylase CYP51 inhibitor: a review
paper_abstract: Mycoses or fungal infections are a general health problem that often occurs in healthy and immunocompromised people in the community. The development of resistant strains in Fungi and the incidence of azole antibiotic resistance in the Asia Pacific which reached 83% become a critical problem nowadays. To control fungal infections, substances and extracts isolated from natural resources, especially in the form of plants as the main sources of drug molecules today, are needed. Especially from Piperaceae , which have long been used in India, China, and Korea to treat human ailments in traditional medicine. The purpose of this review is to describe the antifungal mechanism action from Piper crocatum and its phytochemical profiling against lanosterol 14a demethylase CYP51. The methods used to search databases from Google Scholar to find the appropriate databases using Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-analyses (PRISMA) Flow Diagram as a clinical information retrieval method. From 1.150.000 results searched by database, there is 73 final results article to review. The review shows that P. crocatum contains flavonoids, tannins, terpenes, saponins, polyphenols, eugenol, alkaloids, quinones, chavibetol acetate, glycosides, triterpenoids or steroids, hydroxychavikol, phenolics, glucosides, isoprenoids, and non-protein amino acids. Its antifungal mechanisms in fungal cells occur due to ergosterol, especially lanosterol 14a demethylase (CYP51) inhibition, which is one of the main target sites for antifungal activity because it functions to maintain the integrity and function of cell membranes in Candida . P. crocatum has an antifungal activity through its phytochemical profiling against fungal by inhibiting the lanosterol 14a demethylase, make damaging cell membranes, fungal growth inhibition, and fungal cell lysis.
review_content:
I have received the following manuscript for review from F1000Research: "Phytochemical profiling of Piper crocatum and its antifungal mechanism action as Lanosterol 14 alpha demethylase CYP51 inhibitor".

General comments:
  * I think overall the manuscript need a proof reading for the English language and grammar.
The following sections required revisions:
  * Results and Discussion; and Conclusion
Results and Discussion
  * Table 1:
    - The name of the species P. crocatum suddenly was changed into betel plant? In the introduction section can be mentioned that betel plant is a common name for P. crocatum.
  * The betel leaf extract was extracted using which solvent (alcohol or other organic solvents?)
  * I suggest the bioactive compounds contained in P. crocatum should be derived from more than 1 references.
  * A sentence below Figure 2 here: "The bioactive compound of P. crocatum as follows Table 1 and Figure 2".

    This sentence is missing a verb (grammatically incorrect).
  * Figure 3 caption: "Illustrating of cell wall…", should be 'an Illustration of cell wall…'.

    Also there are capital letters in Figure 3: A1, A2, A3, B, C, D, E, F, and these are not mentioned in the Figure caption. What are those?
  * A sentence here above Figure 3:
    - "Ergosterol is a key enzyme in fungal-specific sterols, cytochrome P450 enzyme in fungi derived from S. cerevisiae, belonging to the CYP51 (lanosterol 14-α-demethylase) family, so with inhibition of biosynthesis in ergosterol, caused intermediates toxic sterol accumulation (14-α-methyl-3,6-diol) by ERG3, by binding the nitrogen atom containing heterocyclic moiety in the core ring to the iron atom of the heme domain group in the active site and preventing the formation of lanosterol demethylation, will damage cell membranes (Arthington-Skaggs et al.1999; Flowers et al. 2015)."

    This sentence is too long and unclear. Authors should break this sentence into 2-3 sentences.
  * All the phytochemical content in P. crocatum, do they have activities as Lanosterol 14 alpha demethylase CYP51 inhibitor? This is because in the explanations of phytochemicals like polyphenols, tannins, saponins, it seems they don’t have activities as inhibitor for demethylase CYP51. Or these are different activities as anti fungi?
  * These sentences before conclusion section:
    - "Based on the results of the review, it was found that P. crocatum contain compounds that have activity as an antifungal agent so it is expected to become a new antifungal agent that can slowly replace the extensive use of antibiotics. Therefore, new antifungal agents that safer, few side effects, cheaper, easier to get, and more potent against fungal infections are needed."

    I think these sentence need to be revised, since the sentences are unclear in particular the last sentence.
Conclusions
  * The conclusion section need to be revised since there are grammatical error and unclear. For example: INatural products are an important resource…", should be “Natural products are important resources…"
  * Conclusion should emphasize the antifungal activities of P. crocatum. Does P. crocatum have antifungal activities by inhibiting ergosterol synthesis or as a lanosterol 14 α demethylase CYP51 inhibitor?
paper_title_zh: 《胡椒红素（Piper crocatum）的植物化学成分分析及其作为羊毛甾醇14α-脱甲基酶CYP51抑制剂的抗真菌机制作用：综述》
paper_abstract_zh: 真菌病或真菌感染是社区中健康人群和免疫受损人群常见的健康问题。真菌中耐药菌株的发展以及亚太地区唑类抗生素耐药发生率高达83%，成为当今的严重问题。为了控制真菌感染，需要从自然资源中分离出的物质和提取物，尤其是以植物形式作为当今药物分子的主要来源。特别是胡椒科植物，长期以来在印度、中国和韩国被用于传统医学治疗人类疾病。本综述的目的是描述 Piper crocatum 的抗真菌机制作用及其对羊毛甾醇14α去甲基化酶CYP51的植物化学成分分析。使用的方法是通过Google Scholar搜索数据库，利用系统综述和荟萃分析优先报告条目（PRISMA）流程图作为临床信息检索方法来找到合适的数据库。从数据库搜索的1,150,000个结果中，有73篇最终结果文章用于综述。综述显示，P. crocatum 含有黄酮类、鞣质、萜类、皂苷、多酚、丁香酚、生物碱、醌类、乙酸卡维醇、苷类、三萜类或甾体、羟基卡维醇、酚类、葡萄糖苷、异戊二烯类和非蛋白氨基酸。其在真菌细胞中的抗真菌机制是由于抑制麦角甾醇，尤其是羊毛甾醇14α去甲基化酶（CYP51），这是抗真菌活性的主要靶点之一，因为它能维持念珠菌细胞膜的完整性和功能。P. crocatum 通过其植物化学成分分析对真菌具有抗真菌活性，通过抑制羊毛甾醇14α去甲基化酶，破坏细胞膜，抑制真菌生长和真菌细胞裂解。
review_content_zh:
我已从F1000Research收到以下稿件进行评审：“Piper crocatum的植物化学成分分析及其作为羊毛甾醇14α去甲基化酶CYP51抑制剂的抗真菌机制”。

总体意见：
* 我认为整体上稿件需要校对英语语言和语法。
以下部分需要修订：
* 结果与讨论；以及结论
结果与讨论
* 表1：
  - 物种P. crocatum的名称突然变成了槟榔植物？在引言部分可以提到槟榔植物是P. crocatum的常见名称。
* 槟榔叶提取物是用哪种溶剂提取的（酒精或其他有机溶剂？）
* 我建议P. crocatum中含有的生物活性化合物应引用多于1篇的参考文献。
* 图2下方的一句话：“P. crocatum的生物活性化合物如下表1和图2所示”。

  这句话缺少动词（语法错误）。
* 图3标题：“细胞壁的图示…”，应为“细胞壁的示意图…”。

  此外，图3中有大写字母A1、A2、A3、B、C、D、E、F，而这些在图标题中未提及。这些是什么？
* 图3上方的一句话：
  - “麦角甾醇是真菌特异性甾醇中的关键酶，来源于S. cerevisiae的真菌细胞色素P450酶，属于CYP51（羊毛甾醇14-α-去甲基化酶）家族，因此通过抑制麦角甾醇的生物合成，导致中间有毒甾醇（14-α-甲基-3,6-二醇）通过ERG3积累，通过将含氮杂环部分的核心环中的氮原子与活性位点血红素域组中的铁原子结合，并防止羊毛甾醇去甲基化的形成，将损害细胞膜（Arthington-Skaggs等，1999；Flowers等，2015）”。

  这句话过长且不清晰。作者应将其分成2-3句话。
* P. crocatum中的所有植物化学成分，它们是否具有羊毛甾醇14α去甲基化酶CYP51抑制剂的活性？这是因为在对多酚、单宁、皂苷等植物化学物质的解释中，似乎它们没有作为去甲基化酶CYP51抑制剂的活性。或者这些是不同的抗真菌活性？
* 结论部分之前的这些句子：
  - “根据综述结果，发现P. crocatum含有具有抗真菌活性的化合物，因此有望成为一种新的抗真菌剂，逐步替代抗生素的广泛使用。因此，需要新的抗真菌剂，它们更安全、副作用少、价格便宜、易于获取，且对真菌感染更有效”。

  我认为这些句子需要修订，因为句子不清晰，尤其是最后一句。
结论
* 结论部分需要修订，因为存在语法错误且不清晰。例如：“INatural products are an important resource…”，应为“Natural products are important resources…”
* 结论应强调P. crocatum的抗真菌活性。P. crocatum是通过抑制麦角甾醇合成还是作为羊毛甾醇14α去甲基化酶CYP51抑制剂来发挥抗真菌活性？

reasons: I suggest the bioactive compounds contained in P. crocatum should be derived from more than 1 references.
Table 1: - The name of the species P. crocatum suddenly was changed into betel plant?
A sentence below Figure 2 here: "The bioactive compound of P. crocatum as follows Table 1 and Figure 2".
Also there are capital letters in Figure 3: A1, A2, A3, B, C, D, E, F, and these are not mentioned in the Figure caption. What are those?
For example: INatural products are an important resource…", should be “Natural products are important resources…" *
Conclusion should emphasize the antifungal activities of P. crocatum.

paper_title: Leisure-Based Interventions in Adults with Schizophrenia: A Scoping Review
paper_abstract:
Background 
     Schizophrenia is a severe mental illness characterized by psychosis, apathy, social withdrawal, and cognitive impairment, which results in impaired functioning in work, school, parenting, self-care, independent living, interpersonal relationships, and leisure time. 
   
   
     Method 
     A systematic search was conducted using Arksey and O’Malley’s framework with studies published on leisure-based intervention from January 1990 to December 2023. 
   
   
     Results 
     The review included 11 articles in the study. In total two studies were pilot interventional study, one randomized controlled study, one case-control, one retrospective study, three were cross sectional, one was cross sectional longitudinal study and two were qualitative in nature. Studies used different types of leisure activities like cooking group, discussions, board games, arts and craft, painting, beading, sewing, clay work, paper craft, etc were used as an intervention. Qualitative studies found that individuals with schizophrenia spent less time in social and leisure activities and more time relaxing and doing nothing. 
   
   
     Conclusion 
     The study highlights the need to conduct further research on leisure-based interventions using various study designs like randomized controlled trials and mixed methods to understand its effectiveness among individuals with schizophrenia.
review_content:
Overall of good scoping review drawing on the limited research available to the authors based on their inclusion exclusion Criteria.
In the Second paragraph of the introduction mentions "leisure/recreational activities" leisure is defined but recreation is not nor is the relationship between the two. Either define recreation or remove it as for the rest of the article the authors use leisure almost exclusively.
Quality of life and study design sections could be put into a table and summarized for easy review.
No mention is made of recreation therapy as a potential avenue for increasing access to leisure for people with schizophrenia and despite being mentioned in relation to Snethen et al (2012) no explanation of what RT is is provided. I would suggest the article below as a means of offering
paper_title_zh: 基于休闲的成人精神分裂症干预措施：一项范围综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景
精神分裂症是一种严重的精神疾病，其特征包括精神病性症状、冷漠、社交退缩和认知障碍，导致在工作、学习、育儿、自我照顾、独立生活、人际关系和休闲时间等方面的功能受损。

方法
采用Arksey和O'Malley的框架进行了系统检索，纳入了1990年1月至2023年12月发表的关于基于休闲的干预研究。

结果
该综述共纳入11篇文章。其中，两项为试点干预研究，一项为随机对照研究，一项为病例对照研究，一项为回顾性研究，三项为横断面研究，一项为横断面纵向研究，两项为质性研究。研究采用了不同类型的休闲活动作为干预措施，如烹饪小组、讨论、棋盘游戏、艺术和手工、绘画、串珠、缝纫、陶艺、纸艺等。质性研究发现，精神分裂症患者在社会和休闲活动上花费的时间较少，而更多时间用于放松和无所事事。

结论
该研究强调了需要采用多种研究设计，如随机对照试验和混合方法，进一步研究基于休闲的干预措施，以了解其在精神分裂症患者中的有效性。
review_content_zh:
总体而言，这是一篇基于作者根据其纳入排除标准所获得的有限研究而撰写的良好范围综述。
在引言的第二段中提到了“休闲/娱乐活动”，其中对“休闲”进行了定义，但“娱乐”未定义，也未说明两者之间的关系。建议要么定义“娱乐”，要么将其删除，因为文章其余部分作者几乎只使用了“休闲”一词。
生活质量和研究设计部分可以制成表格并进行总结，以便于快速审查。
文中未提及娱乐疗法作为增加精神分裂症患者休闲活动途径的潜在方法，尽管在提及Snethen等人（2012）的研究时提到了娱乐疗法，但未提供对娱乐疗法的解释。我建议以下文章作为提供解释的途径。

reasons: No mention is made of recreation therapy as a potential avenue for increasing access to leisure for people with schizophrenia and despite being mentioned in relation to Snethen et al (2012) no explanation of what RT is is provided.
The study topic is timely and interesting. However, according to the comments provided below, some important issues should be addressed.
In the Second paragraph of the introduction mentions "leisure/recreational activities" leisure is defined but recreation is not nor is the relationship between the two.
Either define recreation or remove it as for the rest of the article the authors use leisure almost exclusively.
Quality of life and study design sections could be put into a table and summarized for easy review.

paper_title: Nitric oxide for the prevention and treatment of viral, bacterial, protozoal and fungal infections
paper_abstract: Although the antimicrobial potential of nitric oxide (NO) is widely published, it is little used clinically. NO is a key signalling molecule modulating vascular, neuronal, inflammatory and immune responses. Endogenous antimicrobial activity is largely mediated by high local NO concentrations produced by cellular inducible nitric oxide synthase, and by derivative reactive nitrogen oxide species including peroxynitrite and S-nitrosothiols. NO may be taken as dietary substrate (inorganic nitrate, L-arginine), and therapeutically as gaseous NO, and transdermal, sublingual, oral, intranasal and intravenous nitrite or nitrate. Numerous preclinical studies have demonstrated that NO has generic static and cidal activities against viruses (including β-coronaviruses such as SARS-CoV-2), bacteria, protozoa and fungi/yeasts  in vitro . Therapeutic effects have been seen in animal models  in vivo , and phase II trials have demonstrated that NO donors can reduce microbial infection. Nevertheless, excess NO, as occurs in septic shock, is associated with increased morbidity and mortality. In view of the dose-dependent positive and negative effects of NO, safety and efficacy trials of NO and its donors are needed for assessing their role in the prevention and treatment of infections. Trials should test dietary inorganic nitrate for pre- or post-exposure prophylaxis and gaseous NO or oral, topical or intravenous nitrite and nitrate for treatment of mild-to-severe infections, including due to SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19). This review summarises the evidence base from  in vitro, in vivo  and early phase clinical studies of NO activity in viral, bacterial, protozoal and fungal infections.
review_content:
Nitric oxide (NO) is one of the ten smallest molecules found in nature. It is released intracellularly when L-arginine is oxidized by the enzyme nitric oxide synthase (NOS), of which there are three isoforms. Neuronal (nNOS, NOS1) and endothelial (eNOS, NOS3) are constitutive calcium-dependent forms of the enzyme regulated by negative feedback and release low fluxes of NO over a short period regulating neural and vascular function, respectively. The third isoform (iNOS, NOS2) is calcium-independent, inducible, produces supra-physiological concentrations of NO, and is involved in immune surveillance. NO can also be produced through the reduction of nitrite/nitrate under low oxygen conditions.

NO has important roles in normal physiology, exemplified by regulation of vascular relaxation, control of inflammation by inhibiting NF-κB activation, and suppression of pro-inflammatory mediators in mast cells, macrophages, and vascular smooth muscles. In addition, NO regulates blood flow, modulates platelet and leukocyte activation, adhesion, and aggregation.

In this review, the authors have focused on NO's role in defense against multiple microbial pathogens [including viruses, bacteria, SARS-CoV (COVID-19), protozoa, and fungi/yeast]. In addition, they have highlighted the possibility that exogenous NO might have therapeutic potential as a broad-spectrum antimicrobial. Finally, they have also summarized various NO donating/releasing platforms.

In general, I do not think that there is a "right" or "wrong" way of presenting a review, as long as it is accurate, balanced, and gives adequate historical background. I found this review to be quite compelling and of interest to those starting in this field and an update for the seasoned investigators. In short, it is an authoritative review. For the novice, the review gives the directions for further in-depth reading. Finally, I would like to make some suggestions to the text for the authors to consider as I believe it would add to the overall body of this work.
  * Throughout the text, when you talk about “NO may be taken as dietary substrate (inorganic nitrate, L-arginine)….", please also discuss L-citrulline as a source of NO. We recently reviewed this topic and you may want to use this review as a source to expand on this1.
  * In Table 1, please add L-citrulline as a substrate and give the appropriate biochemical equation.
  * Under Therapeutic inorganic nitrite and nitrate, please consider adding the use of nitrite/nitrate in animal models of wound healing. Refer to Afzali et al. 20202 for an introduction to this.
  * Under novel nitric oxide agents, please add RRx-001, which is a novel NO modulator3.
  * As summarized in the review, dietary intake of foods such as beetroot that are rich as a source of nitrate have many health benefits. And as mentioned, "Dietary nitrate has profound metabolic effects and appears to have the potential for reversing the metabolic syndrome and have anti-diabetic effects.". However, although the beneficial metabolic effects of inorganic nitrate and nitrite in type 2 diabetes mellitus have been documented in animal experiments, this is not the case for humans. Perhaps this should be mentioned on page 18 of the review4.
paper_title_zh: 一氧化氮用于预防和治疗病毒、细菌、原虫和真菌感染
paper_abstract_zh: 尽管一氧化氮（NO）的抗菌潜力已被广泛报道，但其在临床上的应用却很少。NO是一种关键的信号分子，调节血管、神经、炎症和免疫反应。内源性抗菌活性主要通过与细胞诱导型一氧化氮合酶产生的高局部NO浓度，以及包括过氧亚硝酸盐和S-亚硝基硫醇在内的衍生物反应性氮氧化物种介导。NO可以作为饮食底物（无机硝酸盐、L-精氨酸）摄入，并且可以作为气态NO以及经皮、舌下、口服、鼻内和静脉注射的硝酸盐或亚硝酸盐进行治疗。大量临床前研究表明，NO在体外对病毒（包括β-冠状病毒如SARS-CoV-2）、细菌、原生动物和真菌/酵母具有普遍的静态和杀灭活性。在动物模型体内也观察到了治疗效果，并且II期试验表明NO供体可以减少微生物感染。然而，过量的NO，如在败血症休克中，与增加的发病率和死亡率相关。鉴于NO剂量依赖性的正负效应，需要开展NO及其供体的安全性和有效性试验，以评估其在预防和治疗感染中的作用。试验应测试饮食无机硝酸盐用于暴露前或暴露后的预防，以及气态NO或口服、局部或静脉注射的硝酸盐和亚硝酸盐用于治疗轻度至重度感染，包括由SARS-CoV-2（COVID-19）引起的感染。本综述总结了来自体外、体内和早期临床研究关于NO在病毒、细菌、原生动物和真菌感染中的活性的证据基础。
review_content_zh:
一氧化氮（NO）是自然界中发现的十个最小分子之一。当L-精氨酸被一氧化氮合酶（NOS）氧化时，它会在细胞内释放，NOS有三种同工酶。神经型（nNOS，NOS1）和内皮型（eNOS，NOS3）是受负反馈调节的钙依赖性酶形式，在短时间内释放低通量的NO，分别调节神经和血管功能。第三种同工酶（iNOS，NOS2）是钙非依赖性、可诱导的，产生超生理浓度的NO，并参与免疫监视。在低氧条件下，NO也可以通过亚硝酸盐/硝酸盐的还原产生。

NO在正常生理学中具有重要作用，例如调节血管舒张、通过抑制NF-κB激活控制炎症，以及抑制肥大细胞、巨噬细胞和血管平滑肌中的促炎介质。此外，NO调节血流，调节血小板和白细胞激活、粘附和聚集。

在这篇综述中，作者重点关注了NO在防御多种微生物病原体（包括病毒、细菌、SARS-CoV（COVID-19）、原生动物和真菌/酵母）中的作用。此外，他们还强调了外源性NO作为广谱抗菌剂可能具有的治疗潜力。最后，他们还总结了各种NO供体/释放平台。

总的来说，我认为只要综述准确、平衡且提供充分的历史背景，就没有“正确”或“错误”的呈现方式。我发现这篇综述非常有说服力，对初入该领域的人和资深研究者都有参考价值。简而言之，这是一篇权威的综述。对于新手来说，这篇综述指明了进一步深入阅读的方向。最后，我想对作者提出一些建议，以完善这篇作品。
  * 在全文中，当提到“NO可以作为膳食底物（无机硝酸盐，L-精氨酸）……”时，请也讨论L-瓜氨酸作为NO的来源。我们最近综述了这一主题，您可能希望使用这篇综述作为扩展这一点的来源1。
  * 在表1中，请添加L-瓜氨酸作为底物，并给出相应的生化方程式。
  * 在“治疗性无机亚硝酸盐和硝酸盐”部分，请考虑添加亚硝酸盐/硝酸盐在动物伤口愈合模型中的使用。参考Afzali等人20202的介绍。
  * 在“新型一氧化氮剂”部分，请添加RRx-001，这是一种新型NO调节剂3。
  * 如综述中总结的，摄入富含硝酸盐的食物（如甜菜根）具有许多健康益处。正如所述，“膳食硝酸盐具有深远的代谢效应，似乎有逆转代谢综合征和抗糖尿病的潜力。”然而，尽管无机硝酸盐和亚硝酸盐在2型糖尿病动物实验中的有益代谢效应已有文献记载，但在人类中并非如此。或许应在综述的第18页提及这一点4。

reasons: Under Therapeutic inorganic nitrite and nitrate, please consider adding the use of nitrite/nitrate in animal models of wound healing.
Refer to Afzali et al. 20202 for an introduction to this.
Under novel nitric oxide agents, please add RRx-001, which is a novel NO modulator3.

I found this review to be quite compelling and of interest to those starting in this field and an update for the seasoned investigators.
In short, it is an authoritative review. For the novice, the review gives the directions for further in-depth reading.

In Table 1, please add L-citrulline as a substrate and give the appropriate biochemical equation.
Under Therapeutic inorganic nitrite and nitrate, please consider adding the use of nitrite/nitrate in animal models of wound healing.

paper_title: Immunopathology of galectin-3: an increasingly promising target in COVID-19
paper_abstract: The pandemic brought on by the outbreak of severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV2) has become a global health crisis, with over 22 million confirmed cases and 777,000 fatalities due to coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) reported worldwide. The major cause of fatality in infected patients, now referred to as the “Cytokine Storm Syndrome” (CSS), is a direct result of aberrant immune activation following SARS-CoV2 infection and results in excess release of inflammatory cytokines, such as interleukin (IL)-1, tumor necrosis factor α (TNF-α), and IL-6, by macrophages, monocytes, and dendritic cells. Single cell analysis has also shown significantly elevated levels of galectin 3 (Gal-3) in macrophages, monocytes, and dendritic cells in patients with severe COVID-19 as compared to mild disease. Inhibition of Gal-3 reduces the release of IL-1, IL-6, and TNF-α from macrophages in vitro , and as such may hold promise in reducing the incidence of CSS. In addition, Gal-3 inhibition shows promise in reducing transforming growth factor ß (TGF-ß) mediated pulmonary fibrosis, likely to be a major consequence in survivors of severe COVID-19. Finally, a key domain in the spike protein of SARS-CoV2 has been shown to bind N- acetylneuraminic acid (Neu5Ac), a process that may be essential to cell entry by the virus. This Neu5Ac-binding domain shares striking morphological, sequence, and functional similarities with human Gal-3. Here we provide an updated review of the literature linking Gal-3 to COVID-19 pathogenesis. Dually targeting galectins and the Neu5Ac-binding domain of SARS-CoV2 shows tentative promise in several stages of the disease: preventing viral entry, modulating the host immune response, and reducing the post-infectious incidence of pulmonary fibrosis.
review_content:
The authors here describe the role of Galectin 3 in mediating inflammatory cytokine signaling as a possible source of disease pathogenesis in SARS-CoV-2 infection. The review is well written and describes the relevant literature supporting the role of Gal-3 in COVID-19.

The following suggestions would improve the strength of the work:
  * The authors have published a similar article entitled: A potential role for Galectin-3 inhibitors in the treatment of COVID-19 https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC7301894/[ref-1]; the title of this current article should clearly reflect how these two works are non-overlapping; the authors describe that this is an update of the prior work.
  * The authors write: “Recent discoveries have begun to shed light on its role in viral infections (Wang et al. 2019) but should go into further detail about what role(s) it plays; there is a literature on HIV (Wang 2014, Okamoto 2019, Fogel 1999).
  * The introduction provides very little information about Galectin 3 besides that it is an animal lectin and exerts pleiotropic effects. Some more description should be provided as to the function of this molecule, its tissue expression, and any literature about epigenetics as it pertains to infection and inflammation.
  * On page 3, the authors state: “Several studies to date have referred to the “galectin fold” present on the NTD of coronaviruses (Behloul et al., 2020; Li, 2016; Li et al., 2017; Peng et al., 2011; Peng et al., 2012; Tortorici et al., 2019). The structures are so similar, in fact, that it is hypothesized that coronaviruses incorporated a host galectin gene into their genome (and then the NTD) at some point in their evolution (Li, 2015).” The structures of ‘what’ are so similar? NTD to Gal-3? This should be more explicitly defined. This should refer back to Figure 1 in Caniglia PeerJ 2020.
  * On page 4, the authors state “Notably, a study of nearly 4,000 patients has found the levels of IL-1, IL-6, and TNF-α to be significantly elevated in the sera of patients suffering from severe COVID-19 as compared to those with mild disease (Wang et al., 2020a).” The authors should additionally cite Del Valle et al. Nature Medicine 2020 that noted similar findings in 1500 patients.2
  * Figure 1 does not add richly to this work and perhaps could be a panel combined with Figure 2.
  * The authors state “Several studies to date have shown the effects of anti-Gal-3 therapy on cytokine release.” These studied should be cited.
  * Figure 2 figure legend should address the tissue sites where Gal-3 is produced in macrophages, monocytes, and dendritic cells. Is it lung? Plasma?
  * The authors note on p. 5 “A study found that tests for SARS-CoV2 RNA in the serum of infected individuals did not become negative until a median of 24 days post-symptom onset, with some individuals remaining positive even greater than a month from the beginning of symptoms (Gombar et al., 2020). This indicates that for some, COVID-19 infection may run a particularly long course. Findings such as this have led to the question of whether or not anti fibrotic therapy would be beneficial for such patients (George et al., 2020).” The persistence of SARS-CoV-2 RNA should not be equated with replication competent virus; there is significant literature to suggest residual nucleic acid that does not represent infectious virus. This should not be equated with long term infection or increased risk of fibrotic disease and these patients should not be treated with anti-fibrotic therapy for that reason. Severe lung injury from ARDS would be much more plausible an explanation for fibrotic lung disease than persistent SARS-CoV2 RNA.
paper_title_zh: 半乳糖凝集素-3的免疫病理学：COVID-19中日益有前景的靶点
paper_abstract_zh: 由严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2（SARS-CoV2）爆发引发的大流行已成为全球健康危机，全球报告的2019冠状病毒病（COVID-19）确诊病例超过2200万例，死亡777,000例。感染患者的主要死因，现称为“细胞因子风暴综合征”（CSS），是SARS-CoV2感染后异常免疫激活的直接结果，导致巨噬细胞、单核细胞和树突状细胞过量释放炎症细胞因子，如白细胞介素（IL）-1、肿瘤坏死因子α（TNF-α）和IL-6。单细胞分析还显示，与轻度疾病患者相比，重症COVID-19患者的巨噬细胞、单核细胞和树突状细胞中半乳糖凝集素3（Gal-3）水平显著升高。体外抑制Gal-3可减少巨噬细胞释放IL-1、IL-6和TNF-α，因此可能在降低CSS发生率方面具有前景。此外，Gal-3抑制在减少转化生长因子β（TGF-β）介导的肺纤维化方面显示出前景，这可能是重症COVID-19幸存者的主要后果。最后，SARS-CoV2刺突蛋白中的一个关键结构域已被证明可结合N-乙酰神经氨酸（Neu5Ac），这一过程可能是病毒进入细胞的关键。这一Neu5Ac结合结构域在形态、序列和功能上与人类Gal-3具有显著相似性。本文提供了关于Gal-3与COVID-19发病机制相关性的最新文献综述。双重靶向半乳糖凝集素和SARS-CoV2的Neu5Ac结合结构域在疾病的多个阶段显示出初步前景：预防病毒进入、调节宿主免疫反应以及减少感染后肺纤维化的发生率。
review_content_zh:
作者在此描述了半乳糖凝集素3（Galectin 3）在介导炎症细胞因子信号传导中的作用，作为SARS-CoV-2感染中疾病发病机制的可能来源。该综述写得很好，描述了支持Gal-3在COVID-19中作用的相关文献。

以下建议将增强该工作的力度：
  * 作者已发表一篇类似文章，题为《半乳糖凝集素-3抑制剂在COVID-19治疗中的潜在作用》https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC7301894/[ref-1]；当前文章的标题应明确反映这两篇工作的非重叠性；作者描述这是对先前工作的更新。
  * 作者写道：“最近的发现已经开始揭示其在病毒感染中的作用（Wang等，2019），但应进一步详细说明其扮演的角色；有关HIV的文献（Wang 2014, Okamoto 2019, Fogel 1999）。
  * 引言部分除了说明Galectin 3是一种动物凝集素并具有多效性外，几乎没有提供其他信息。应提供更多关于该分子功能、组织表达以及与感染和炎症相关的表观遗传学文献的描述。
  * 在第3页，作者指出：“迄今为止，多项研究提到了冠状病毒NTD上存在的‘半乳糖凝集素折叠’（Behloul等，2020；Li，2016；Li等，2017；Peng等，2011；Peng等，2012；Tortorici等，2019）。这些结构如此相似，以至于有人假设冠状病毒在进化过程中的某个点将宿主半乳糖凝集素基因整合到其基因组中（然后是NTD）（Li，2015）。”哪些结构的相似性？NTD与Gal-3？这应更明确地定义。这应参考Caniglia PeerJ 2020中的图1。
  * 在第4页，作者指出：“值得注意的是，一项对近4000名患者的研究发现，与轻度疾病患者相比，患有严重COVID-19的患者血清中IL-1、IL-6和TNF-α的水平显著升高（Wang等，2020a）。”作者还应引用Del Valle等在Nature Medicine 2020中的研究，该研究在1500名患者中发现了类似结果。
  * 图1并未显著丰富该工作，或许可以与图2合并为一个面板。
  * 作者指出“迄今为止，多项研究已显示抗Gal-3疗法对细胞因子释放的影响。”这些研究应被引用。
  * 图2的图例应说明Gal-3在巨噬细胞、单核细胞和树突状细胞中产生的组织部位。是肺部？血浆？
  * 作者在第5页指出：“一项研究发现，感染个体的血清中SARS-CoV2 RNA检测直到症状出现后24天中位数才转为阴性，有些个体甚至在症状开始后一个月以上仍为阳性（Gombar等，2020）。这表明对某些人来说，COVID-19感染可能持续特别长的时间。此类发现引发了是否抗纤维化疗法对这些患者有益的问题（George等，2020）。”SARS-CoV-2 RNA的持续存在不应等同于具有复制能力的病毒；大量文献表明残留核酸不代表传染性病毒。这不等于长期感染或增加纤维化疾病风险，因此这些患者不应因此接受抗纤维化治疗。ARDS导致的严重肺损伤比持续的SARS-CoV2 RNA更可能是纤维化肺疾病的合理解释。

reasons: The review is well written and describes the relevant literature supporting the role of Gal-3 in COVID-19.
The authors should additionally cite Del Valle et al. Nature Medicine 2020 that noted similar findings in 1500 patients.2
These studied should be cited.
Some more description should be provided as to the function of this molecule, its tissue expression, and any literature about epigenetics as it pertains to infection and inflammation.

paper_title: A review of common methods used in the analysis of human microbiome sequencing data
paper_abstract: The past two decades have seen a rapid rise in the development and use of sequencing technologies. The advent of high-throughput sequencing (HTS) has allowed scientists sequence the genomic content of entire microbial communities rapidly and affordably. Methods for data management, visualization, and analysis of this microbiome sequencing data are now widespread in open and closed source software tools. In this review, we identify common analysis methods used in microbiome sequencing studies, including methods for normalisation of abundance table data, visualization of high-dimensional microbiome data and the analysis of longitudinal microbiome sequencing data. In particular we find that a very small proportion of metagenomic studies made use of compositional data analysis methods and none that made use of compositional methods for longitudinal microbiome data.
review_content:
This manuscript aims to identify common analysis methods used in microbiome sequencing studies, including methods for data normalization and visualization, and compositional methods for association testing, with a focus on compositional methods in the analysis of longitudinal microbiome data. It was found that a very small proportion of microbiome studies made use of compositional data analysis methods.


Major Comments:

-. Timeliness of Literature Search: The manuscript limited the search of literature to studies published before January 2022, which was two and a half years ago. This approach misses a large number of more recent publications and fails to serve as a timely review of the literature.

-. Clarity of Search Terms: The search terms should be explained in plain language rather than computer code to improve readability and accessibility.

-. Summary Table: It would be more readable and informative to provide a table that summarizes the type of analysis, common methods for the analysis, and proportions of papers that used these methods.

-. Scope of Review: The review was limited to a very small proportion of the articles (e.g., 381 abstracts, 38 full articles) that satisfied the search criteria. It would be more informative to expand the review to include more articles.
paper_title_zh: 人类微生物组测序数据分析常用方法的综述
paper_abstract_zh: 在过去的二十年里，测序技术的发展和使用迅速增加。高通量测序（HTS）的出现使科学家能够快速且经济地测序整个微生物群的基因组内容。用于管理、可视化和分析这些微生物组测序数据的方法现在在开源和闭源软件工具中广泛存在。在这篇综述中，我们识别了微生物组测序研究中常用的分析方法，包括丰度表数据标准化方法、高维微生物组数据的可视化方法以及纵向微生物组测序数据的分析方法。特别是我们发现，极少数宏基因组研究使用了组成数据分析方法，且没有研究使用组成方法来分析纵向微生物组数据。
review_content_zh:
本文旨在识别微生物组测序研究中常用的分析方法，包括数据标准化和可视化的方法，以及用于关联测试的组成方法，重点关注纵向微生物组数据分析中的组成方法。研究发现，极少数微生物组研究采用了组成数据分析方法。

主要意见：

- 文献检索的时效性：本文献综述将文献检索范围限制在2022年1月之前发表的研究，这是两年半前的时间点。这种方法遗漏了大量较新的出版物，未能作为文献的及时回顾。

- 检索词的清晰度：检索词应以通俗易懂的语言解释，而非计算机代码，以提高可读性和可访问性。

- 摘要表格：提供一个总结分析类型、常用分析方法和使用这些方法的论文比例的表格，将更具可读性和信息量。

- 综述范围：综述仅限于极少数符合检索条件的文章（例如，381篇摘要，38篇全文）。扩大综述范围以包括更多文章将更具信息量。

reasons: The manuscript limited the search of literature to studies published before January 2022, which was two and a half years ago.
This approach misses a large number of more recent publications and fails to serve as a timely review of the literature.
The review was limited to a very small proportion of the articles (e.g., 381 abstracts, 38 full articles) that satisfied the search criteria.
It would be more informative to expand the review to include more articles.

The article will be useful, particularly to researchers new to the microbiome field, in understanding many of the pitfalls of microbiome analysis, and may also be useful in courses and workshops designed to introduce trainees to microbiome analysis methods.

The article highlights the need for continued development of statistical methods that are designed to analyze microbiome data, particularly longitudinal compositional data, statistical methods that have rarely been used during the period covered by the review.
It would be more readable and informative to provide a table that summarizes the type of analysis, common methods for the analysis, and proportions of papers that used these methods.

paper_title: What do we know about grant peer review in the health sciences?
paper_abstract:
Background : Peer review decisions award an estimated >95% of academic medical research funding, so it is crucial to understand how well they work and if they could be improved. 
 Methods : This paper summarises evidence from 105 papers identified through a literature search on the effectiveness and burden of peer review for grant funding. 
 Results : There is a remarkable paucity of evidence about the efficiency of peer review for funding allocation, given its centrality to the modern system of science. From the available evidence, we can identify some conclusions around the effectiveness and burden of peer review. 
The strongest evidence around effectiveness indicates a bias against innovative research. There is also fairly clear evidence that peer review is, at best, a weak predictor of future research performance, and that ratings vary considerably between reviewers. There is some evidence of age bias and cronyism. 
Good evidence shows that the burden of peer review is high and that around 75% of it falls on applicants. By contrast, many of the efforts to reduce burden are focused on funders and reviewers/panel members. 
 Conclusions : We suggest funders should acknowledge, assess and analyse the uncertainty around peer review, even using reviewers’ uncertainty as an input to funding decisions. Funders could consider a lottery element in some parts of their funding allocation process, to reduce both burden and bias, and allow better evaluation of decision processes. Alternatively, the distribution of scores from different reviewers could be better utilised as a possible way to identify novel, innovative research. Above all, there is a need for open, transparent experimentation and evaluation of different ways to fund research. This also requires more openness across the wider scientific community to support such investigations, acknowledging the lack of evidence about the primacy of the current system and the impossibility of achieving perfection.
review_content:
This is a very useful review of an area that is vitally important for science and that is constantly being examined by funding agencies. It included some papers that I had not read, but there were a few additional papers that I thought could be included (detailed below).

The results once again highlight the incredible lack of studies in this area. The paper ends with some sensible recommendations, including the need for funders to experiment more and make their data available to researchers.

I was surprised that some of the more innovative solutions to funding peer review were not included, specifically using prediction markets 1 and using the “wisdom of the crowd”2.

Why was 2009 chosen as the time threshold? Is it because that was the year of the previous review?

This paper should be included in the discussion on interdisciplinary research: Interdisciplinary research has consistently lower funding success, Lindell Bromham, Russell Dinnage & Xia Hua. Nature 534, 684–687 doi:10.1038/nature18315 3. This paper agrees with the other two mentioned, as there are lower success rates for applications with more cross-disciplinary researchers.

One force against “cognitive particularism” is that strict conflict of interest rules from funding bodies can often rule out reviewers with the greatest knowledge, particularly in small fields or small countries. This study may touch on this issue: Abdoul H et al, Non-Financial Conflicts of Interest in Academic Grant Evaluation: A Qualitative Study of Multiple Stakeholders in France, PLoS ONE, 7/4: e35247.4

In terms of using technology in the review process, some researchers have suggested that videos may produce more reliable peer reviewer ratings and take less time to prepare: Doran MR, Lott WB, Doran SE. Trends Biochem Sci. 2014 Apr;39(4):151-3. doi: 10.1016/j.tibs.2014.01.004. Multimedia: a necessary step in the evolution of research funding applications5.

Minor comments
  * Introduction, 1st paragraph. As an Australian researcher I would argue that the ERA has not really measured research quality, rather it has simply measured research output. Maybe you could say “Funders have attempted to gather evidence…”
  * The “>95%” figure in the abstract feels about right, but is there a reference for this?
  * For the Google search terms, “fellowship” could also have been added, so “Fellowship OR funding”.
  * The link to this paper did not work: The Novelty Paradox & Bias for Normal Science: Evidence from Randomized Medical Grant Proposal Evaluations
  * Page 6, “when reviewing research closer to application”, I didn’t understand this.
  * Page 7, “only affects the funding decision for around 10 per cent of applications relative to original scores” but that could still be an important percentage, particularly if it’s those near the funding line
  * Page 9, “found that panel assessments of full proposals and shorter anonymised versions of the same proposals showed weak correlations” do you need to add, “implying that knowledge of the applicants influences the score”. Although as well as a change in blinding there was also a change in the size of the application, so it may be hard to conclude anything about cronyism here.
  * Footnote 9, the NZ Health Research Council has been using random allocation for this scheme since at least April 2015
  * I agree that giving more feedback would improve the value of the process (page 12), but our experience with the NHMRC is that this also opens them up to appeals which can take a lot of time for their staff. This doesn’t mean that we shouldn’t try, and giving frank feedback was a feature of a funding scheme we designed (already cited paper “Streamlined research funding using short proposals and accelerated peer review: an observational study”).
  * This paper may be of interest: Scientometrics, July 2016, Volume 108, Issue 1, pp 263–288, The consequences of competition: simulating the effects of research grant allocation strategies.6
  * This parody of a grant application may be useful for the section on peer reviewers being biased against innovative proposals: doi:10.1097/ede.0000000000000453 “John Snow’s Grant Application”7
  * This paper examined the costs of applying for NIH funding and could be included in the section on the costs to applicants: Nursing Outlook, Volume 63, Issue 6, November–December 2015, Pages 639-649, Time and costs of preparing and submitting an NIH grant application at a school of nursing, https://doi.org/10.1016/j.outlook.2015.09.0038
paper_title_zh: 我们对健康科学领域的资助同行评审了解多少？
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：同行评审决定分配了估计超过95%的学术医学研究资金，因此了解其运作效果及是否可以改进至关重要。

方法：本文总结了通过文献检索获得的105篇关于同行评审在资助分配中的有效性和负担的论文证据。

结果：鉴于同行评审在现代科学体系中的核心地位，关于其效率的证据却异常匮乏。根据现有证据，我们可以得出一些关于同行评审有效性和负担的结论。最强烈的证据表明存在对创新研究的偏见。也有相当明确的证据显示，同行评审充其量只是未来研究表现的弱预测因子，且评审者之间的评分差异很大。存在一些年龄偏见和任人唯亲的证据。

良好的证据表明，同行评审的负担很重，其中约75%落在申请人身上。相比之下，许多减轻负担的努力都集中在资助者和评审者/评审小组成员身上。

结论：我们建议资助者应承认、评估和分析同行评审的不确定性，甚至将评审者的不确定性作为资助决策的输入。资助者可以考虑在资助分配过程的某些部分引入抽签元素，以减少负担和偏见，并更好地评估决策过程。或者，更好地利用不同评审者的评分分布，作为识别新颖、创新研究的一种可能方式。最重要的是，需要进行开放、透明的实验和评估不同的研究资助方式。这也需要更广泛的科学界更加开放，以支持此类调查，承认当前体系首要性的证据不足以及实现完美的不可能性。
review_content_zh:
这是一篇对科学至关重要的领域进行的非常有用的综述，该领域不断受到资助机构的审视。它包含了一些我尚未阅读的论文，但也有一些我认为可以包含在内的额外论文（具体如下）。

研究结果再次凸显了该领域研究的惊人匮乏。论文最后提出了一些合理的建议，包括资助者需要更多地实验并使其数据对研究人员开放。

令我惊讶的是，一些更具创新性的资助同行评审的解决方案并未被包括在内，特别是使用预测市场1和利用“群体智慧”2。

为什么选择2009年作为时间阈值？是因为那是前一次综述的年份吗？

这篇论文应被纳入跨学科研究的讨论中：跨学科研究的一致资助成功率较低，Lindell Bromham, Russell Dinnage & Xia Hua. Nature 534, 684–687 doi:10.1038/nature18315 3。这篇论文与提到的其他两篇论文一致，因为跨学科研究人员更多的申请成功率较低。

反对“认知特殊主义”的一个力量是，资助机构严格的利益冲突规则往往排除了最具知识的评审者，特别是在小领域或小国家。这项研究可能触及了这个问题：Abdoul H等人，学术资助评估中的非财务利益冲突：法国多方利益相关者的定性研究，PLoS ONE, 7/4: e35247.4

在评审过程中使用技术方面，一些研究人员建议视频可能产生更可靠的同行评审评分，且准备时间更短：Doran MR, Lott WB, Doran SE. Trends Biochem Sci. 2014 Apr;39(4):151-3. doi: 10.1016/j.tibs.2014.01.004. 多媒体：研究资助申请进化的必要步骤5。

次要评论
  * 引言，第一段。作为一名澳大利亚研究员，我认为ERA并没有真正衡量研究质量，而只是衡量了研究产出。或许你可以说“资助者试图收集证据…”
  * 摘要中的“>95%”数字感觉差不多，但有参考文献吗？
  * 对于Google搜索词，“fellowship”也可以添加，所以是“Fellowship OR funding”。
  * 这篇论文的链接无效：The Novelty Paradox & Bias for Normal Science: Evidence from Randomized Medical Grant Proposal Evaluations
  * 第6页，“在评审更接近应用的研究时”，我不明白这一点。
  * 第7页，“仅影响约10%的申请的资助决策相对于原始评分”，但这仍然可能是一个重要的百分比，尤其是那些接近资助线的申请。
  * 第9页，“发现评审小组对完整提案和同一提案的简短匿名版本的评估显示出弱相关性”，你需要添加“这意味着对申请人的了解影响了评分”吗？尽管除了盲审的改变外，申请规模也有所改变，所以在这里很难得出关于任人唯亲的结论。
  * 脚注9，新西兰健康研究委员会至少自2015年4月以来一直在使用随机分配这一方案。
  * 我同意给予更多反馈会提高过程的价值（第12页），但我们与NHMRC的经验是，这也使他们容易受到上诉，这可能会耗费他们员工的大量时间。这并不意味着我们不应该尝试，而且坦率的反馈是我们设计的资助计划的一个特点（已引用的论文“使用简短提案和加速同行评审的精简研究资助：一项观察性研究”）。
  * 这篇论文可能感兴趣：Scientometrics, 2016年7月，第108卷，第1期，第263–288页，竞争的后果：模拟研究资助分配策略的效果6。
  * 这篇对资助申请的讽刺可能对关于同行评审者对创新提案存在偏见的部分有用：doi:10.1097/ede.0000000000000453 “John Snow的资助申请”7。
  * 这篇论文研究了申请NIH资助的成本，可以包含在关于申请人成本的部分中：Nursing Outlook, 第63卷，第6期，2015年11月–12月，第639-649页，在一所护理学校准备和提交NIH资助申请的时间和成本，https://doi.org/10.1016/j.outlook.2015.09.0038。

reasons: Page 6, “when reviewing research closer to application”, I didn’t understand this.
Why was 2009 chosen as the time threshold?
Is it because that was the year of the previous review?
Maybe you could say “Funders have attempted to gather evidence…”

paper_title: Know Your Self-supervised Learning: A Survey on Image-based Generative and Discriminative Training
paper_abstract: Although supervised learning has been highly successful in improving the state-of-the-art in the domain of image-based computer vision in the past, the margin of improvement has diminished significantly in recent years, indicating that a plateau is in sight. Meanwhile, the use of self-supervised learning (SSL) for the purpose of natural language processing (NLP) has seen tremendous successes during the past couple of years, with this new learning paradigm yielding powerful language models. Inspired by the excellent results obtained in the field of NLP, self-supervised methods that rely on clustering, contrastive learning, distillation, and information-maximization, which all fall under the banner of discriminative SSL, have experienced a swift uptake in the area of computer vision. Shortly afterwards, generative SSL frameworks that are mostly based on masked image modeling, complemented and surpassed the results obtained with discriminative SSL. Consequently, within a span of three years, over $100$ unique general-purpose frameworks for generative and discriminative SSL, with a focus on imaging, were proposed. In this survey, we review a plethora of research efforts conducted on image-oriented SSL, providing a historic view and paying attention to best practices as well as useful software packages. While doing so, we discuss pretext tasks for image-based SSL, as well as techniques that are commonly used in image-based SSL. Lastly, to aid researchers who aim at contributing to image-focused SSL, we outline a number of promising research directions.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
This paper surveys image-based discriminative unsupervised learning. This survey aims to cover image-oriented frameworks for discriminative SSL, some of which may not be covered by the previous survey due to the fast progress in this field. They briefly explain the SSL pretext task, a list of clustering approaches, contrastive learning approaches, distillation, and information maximization.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
Strength 1. This survey is well organized. Each section is easy to follow. 2. This submission gives a good overview of the recent discriminative self-supervised learning on images. Weakness 1. One large weakness is that they focus on discriminative self-supervised learning and do not pay much attention to recent methods, such as Masked Autoencoder (MAE). Such approaches are shown to perform well on this task, they need more discussion to clarify the difference from other approaches. Considering that survey in this field already exists, the contribution from this paper can be marginal. 2. Overall, this survey is a bit superficial in that they provide only the list of methods and do not show any comparison in the performance. It is hard to know what approaches are promising for this task. Also, each approach can show strengths and weaknesses depending on the training dataset or downstream task, yet, this paper does not discuss much of it. Although their focus may be to give an overview of this field, I am unsure whether such a survey can be above the bar of acceptance. 3. They lack a discussion on what kind of dataset is used for training and evaluation and the impact of such factors. SSL methods should rely a lot on the dataset they are trained on. ImageNet1K is probably standard in this task, yet increasing the dataset size should further improve the performance, which they do not discuss much.

**Requested Changes:**
Including MAE papers for more discussion is important. Also, see weaknesses for other changes.

**Broader Impact Concerns:**
No concern.

**Claims And Evidence:**
Yes

**Audience:**
Yes

**Rebuttal Comments:**
Author response to xZKh: We would like to express our gratitude to the reviewer for providing valuable feedback from angles we did not initially consider. We are also pleased to hear that the reviewer finds our work well organized. In what follows we will address the comments of the reviewer: **Generative SSL:** As pointed out by the reviewer _(also by reviewers UR1h and euRx)_, our goal was to focus on the developments for discriminative SSL and guide inexperienced researchers that are interested in the field. Nevertheless, this exclusion of generative SSL created a gap in the content of the manuscript which we will address in the revised version. **Depth of the content:** Due to the number of frameworks covered as well as page limitations, we had to keep the depth of the manuscript at a maintainable level. In the revised manuscript we will extend discussions on key areas such as: limitations of evaluation metrics, datasets, as well as frameworks. **Datasets of evaluation:** Indeed, we have only provided details on ImageNet performance for the frameworks covered since it was the only common dataset of evaluation for many frameworks. Yet, we agree with the reviewer that expanding this information to cover all datasets evaluated in respective papers will be useful for readers. **Proposed changes:** - Similar to other self-supervision techniques, we will introduce generative SSL as a subsection into Section 4 and cover advances in this direction extensively. We will also expand benchmarks, abbreviations, as well as metadata information to encompass generative frameworks. - We will Increase the depth of content by discussing the limitations and shortcomings of discriminative SSL frameworks as well as evaluation methods used in SSL research. - We will create a detailed table describing downstream transfer evaluations for SSL frameworks. Apart from the changes requested by the reviewer, we will also make the following major additions: - _(cf. feedback of M91J)_ We will detail the loss functions employed by SSL frameworks with the notation introduced in Section 3 in order to improve formality. With these changes, we hope to address the reviewer's comments appropriately. Given the magnitude of the changes, we are planning to submit the revised manuscript within the first week of April and hope that this timeline suits the reviewer.
paper_title_zh: 了解你的自监督学习：基于图像的生成式与判别式训练综述
paper_abstract_zh: 尽管监督学习在过去极大地提升了基于图像的计算机视觉领域的最新技术水平，但近年来改进的幅度已显著减小，表明即将达到一个平稳期。与此同时，自监督学习（SSL）在自然语言处理（NLP）领域的应用在过去几年中取得了巨大成功，这种新的学习范式产生了强大的语言模型。受NLP领域卓越成果的启发，依赖于聚类、对比学习、蒸馏和信息最大化的自监督方法，这些均属于判别性SSL范畴，在计算机视觉领域迅速得到应用。不久之后，主要以掩码图像建模为基础的生成性SSL框架，补充并超越了判别性SSL所获得的结果。因此，在短短三年内，提出了超过100种独特的通用框架，涵盖生成性和判别性SSL，重点关注成像领域。在这篇综述中，我们回顾了大量针对图像导向SSL的研究工作，提供了一个历史视角，并关注最佳实践以及有用的软件包。在此过程中，我们讨论了基于图像的SSL的预训练任务，以及图像SSL中常用的技术。最后，为了帮助那些致力于图像聚焦SSL的研究人员，我们概述了一些有前景的研究方向。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
本文综述了基于图像的判别无监督学习。该综述旨在涵盖面向图像的判别半监督学习（SSL）框架，其中一些框架可能由于该领域的快速进展而未被之前的综述覆盖。他们简要解释了SSL预训练任务、一系列聚类方法、对比学习方法、蒸馏和信息最大化。

**优点和缺点：**
优点1. 该综述组织良好。每个部分都易于理解。2. 该投稿对近期图像判别自监督学习进行了良好的概述。缺点1. 一个主要的缺点是他们专注于判别自监督学习，而未对近期方法（如掩码自编码器（MAE））给予足够关注。这些方法已被证明在此任务上表现良好，需要更多讨论以澄清与其他方法的差异。考虑到该领域已有综述，本文的贡献可能较为边缘。2. 总体而言，该综述略显肤浅，仅提供了方法列表，未展示任何性能比较。难以了解哪些方法在此任务上具有潜力。此外，每种方法在不同训练数据集或下游任务中可能表现出不同的优缺点，而本文对此讨论不足。尽管他们的重点可能是对该领域进行概述，但我不确定这样的综述是否能达到接受标准。3. 他们缺乏对训练和评估所用数据集类型及其影响的讨论。SSL方法应很大程度上依赖于其训练的数据集。ImageNet1K可能是此任务的标准数据集，但增加数据集大小应能进一步提升性能，而他们对此讨论不足。

**请求的修改：**
包括MAE论文进行更多讨论很重要。另请参阅缺点部分以了解其他修改。

**更广泛的影响担忧：**
无担忧。

**主张和证据：**
是

**受众：**
是

**反驳意见：**
对xZKh的作者回应：我们感谢审稿人从我们最初未考虑的角度提供了宝贵的反馈。我们也很高兴听到审稿人认为我们的工作组织良好。以下我们将回应审稿人的意见：**生成式SSL：**正如审稿人（以及审稿人UR1h和euRx）所指出的，我们的目标是专注于判别式SSL的发展，并为对此领域感兴趣的不熟练研究人员提供指导。尽管如此，生成式SSL的排除在文稿内容上造成了空白，我们将在修订版中加以解决。**内容深度**由于涵盖的框架数量以及篇幅限制，我们不得不将文稿的深度保持在可维护的水平。在修订稿中，我们将扩展对关键领域的讨论，如评估指标的局限性、数据集以及框架。**评估数据集：**确实，我们仅提供了所涵盖框架在ImageNet上的性能细节，因为这是许多框架唯一共同的评估数据集。然而，我们同意审稿人的观点，扩大这一信息以涵盖各篇论文中评估的所有数据集将对读者有益。**拟议的修改：**- 与其他自监督技术类似，我们将在第4节中引入生成式SSL作为子节，并广泛涵盖这一方向的进展。我们还将扩展基准测试、缩写以及元数据信息，以包含生成式框架。- 我们将通过讨论判别式SSL框架的局限性和不足以及SSL研究中使用的评估方法，增加内容深度。- 我们将创建一个详细表格，描述SSL框架的下游迁移评估。除了审稿人请求的修改外，我们还将进行以下主要添加：- （参见M91J的反馈）我们将详细说明SSL框架所使用的损失函数，并采用第3节中引入的符号，以提高形式化程度。通过这些修改，我们希望能够适当回应审稿人的意见。鉴于修改的幅度，我们计划在4月的第一周提交修订稿，希望这一时间表适合审稿人。

reasons: This submission gives a good overview of the recent discriminative self-supervised learning on images.
One large weakness is that they focus on discriminative self-supervised learning and do not pay much attention to recent methods, such as Masked Autoencoder (MAE).
Such approaches are shown to perform well on this task, they need more discussion to clarify the difference from other approaches.
They lack a discussion on what kind of dataset is used for training and evaluation and the impact of such factors.
Considering that survey in this field already exists, the contribution from this paper can be marginal.
Overall, this survey is a bit superficial in that they provide only the list of methods and do not show any comparison in the performance.
It is hard to know what approaches are promising for this task.
Also, each approach can show strengths and weaknesses depending on the training dataset or downstream task, yet, this paper does not discuss much of it.
Although their focus may be to give an overview of this field, I am unsure whether such a survey can be above the bar of acceptance.

paper_title: Freely available compound data sets and software tools for chemoinformatics and computational medicinal chemistry applications
paper_abstract: We have generated a number of  compound data sets and programs  for different types of applications in pharmaceutical research. These data sets and programs were originally designed for our research projects and are made publicly available. Without consulting original literature sources, it is difficult to understand specific features of data sets and software tools, basic ideas underlying their design, and applicability domains. Currently, 30 different entries are available for download from our website. In this data article, we provide an overview of the data and tools we make available and designate the areas of research for which they should be useful. For selected data sets and methods/programs, detailed descriptions are given. This article should help interested readers to select data and tools for specific computational investigations.
review_content:
This article takes a valuable step in the direction of improved scientific communication by making compound data sets and software, which have been created by the authors in the course of their research over a number of years, available to the scientific community in machine-readable format.

This step dramatically lower barriers for reproducing, using, and building upon this research and sets an important standard for other authors who write papers about digital collections and software.

Currently, the downloads are provided at the authors’ institutional web-site. Given the possibility that this URL may change, it may be helpful to assign a stable digital object identifier (DOI) to the entire collection of 30 data sets and programs; or potentially to assign a separate DOI to each data set and program, so that they can be referenced and accessed in a more fine-grained manner.
paper_title_zh: 自由可用的化合物数据集及化学信息学与计算药物化学应用软件工具
paper_abstract_zh: 我们已生成了一系列化合物数据集和程序，用于药物研究中的不同类型应用。这些数据集和程序最初是为我们的研究项目设计的，并已公开提供。如果不参考原始文献来源，很难理解数据集和软件工具的特定特征、其设计背后的基本理念以及适用领域。目前，我们的网站上有30个不同的条目可供下载。在这篇数据文章中，我们概述了我们提供的数据和工具，并指出了它们应有助于的研究领域。对于选定的数据集和方法/程序，提供了详细描述。本文应有助于感兴趣的读者为特定的计算研究选择数据和工具。
review_content_zh:
本文通过将作者们在多年研究过程中创建的复合数据集和软件以机器可读的格式提供给科学界，朝着改进科学交流的方向迈出了宝贵的一步。

这一步极大地降低了复制、使用和在此研究基础上进一步发展的障碍，并为撰写关于数字收藏和软件论文的其他作者树立了重要的标准。

目前，下载内容在作者所在机构的网站上提供。鉴于该URL可能会发生变化，为整个30个数据集和程序集合分配一个稳定的数字对象标识符（DOI）可能会有所帮助；或者可能为每个数据集和程序分别分配一个DOI，以便它们可以以更细致的方式被引用和访问。

paper_title: The nectar report: Quantitative review of nectar sugar concentrations offered by bee visited flowers in agricultural and non-agricultural landscapes
paper_abstract: There is growing concern that some bee populations are in decline, potentially threatening pollination security in agricultural and non-agricultural landscapes. Among the numerous causes associated with this trend, nutritional stress resulting from a mismatch between bee nutritional needs and plant community provisioning has been suggested as one potential driver. To ease nutritional stress on bee populations in agricultural habitats, agrienvironmental protection schemes aim to provide alternative nutritional resources for bee populations during times of need. However, such efforts have focused mainly on quantity (providing flowering plants) and timing (flower-scarce periods), while largely ignoring the quality of the offered flower resources. In a first step to start addressing this information gap, we have used literature data to compile a comprehensive geographically explicit dataset on nectar quality (i.e. total sugar concentration), offered to bees both within fields (crop and weed species) as well as off field (wild) around the globe. In particular social bees are sensitive to nectar sugar concentrations, which directly impact calorie influx into the colony and consequently their fitness. We find that the total nectar sugar concentrations in general do not differ between the three plant communities studied. In contrast we find increased quality variability in the wild plant community compared to crop and weed community, which is likely explained by the increased phylogenetic diversity in this category of plants. In a second step we explore the influence of local habitat on nectar quality and its variability utilizing a detailed sunflower (Helianthus annuus L.
review_content: Reviewer 1 (Anonymous) Basic reporting Pamminger et al present an extensive dataset on nectar concentrations in 322 species of wild, cultivated and weedy plant species from across the major world continents. The paper is well structured and well written throughout, with only a few areas that need to have their phrasing polished up which I detail below. We would like to thank the reviewer for the overall positive evaluation of the manuscript. The results are interesting (a very consistent average nectar concentration found in insect pollinated plants across all regions) and highlight particular crop genera that may benefiine: from additional nectar sources in the surrounding landscape to benefit bee populations. The figures and tables are clear and the statistical techniques used are well described. The literature is reasonably well covered, but I would like more discussion of the evidence base as to why the sugar concentration in nectar is important, and which species of bee this evidence is drawn from (predominantly social bees). I go into this point in more detail in section 3. Experimental design The research question is well defined (the importance of sugar concentrations in nectar) but as detailed in the next section I would like some more discussion of whether or not this is valid to apply to all bees. See below Validity of the findings I have a few more major comments that I would like to see addressed. The major point is that the manuscript talks about the importance of nectar to 'bees', but almost all the evidence we have that nectar concentrations are important comes from social bees (Bombus, Apis, etc). I think the data presented is really interesting, but I find it hard to argue that nectar concentrations are quite so important for solitary bee species (the vast majority of bee species) that have mainly had their fitness linked to the type and quantity of pollen available to them. I think a slight rewrite that shifts the focus (and justification for choosing nectar as the response variable) onto social bees would make the manuscript more representative of our current understanding of how important nectar is to bees, given the substantial knowledge deficit that exists for solitary bee species. We agree with the reviewer that most of the direct evidence linking nectar sugar concentrations to fitness stem from social bees and we have made this more clear in all parts of the MS. However, we believe that quality interventions will, at least to some degree, support wild bees as well. We no make these distinctions more clear in all relevant sections of the MS. Line 22-24, 85-90, 339-343, 573-577 L69-71. I would argue strongly that maintaining a diverse bee community has not been the focus of agri-environment schemes targeted at bees. Early work in the UK focused strongly on bumble bees and their foraging requirements Carvell et al 2004; 2006; 2007 leading to currently incarnations of flower-rich field margins containing predominantly bumble bee food plants (e.g. Trifolium, Centaurea, Vicia and so on). Until recently, few pollinator-focused schemes were appraised for their ability to provide resources to a wide variety of wild bee species e.g. Scheper et al 2015 JAE We thank the reviewer for this clarification and we have adapted the paragraph accordingly and have included the reference as well. Line: 79-84 L72-75. I think you need to be careful here. Most of the work that has be conducted on floral resource quality (especially nectar) has been on social bees. Next to nothing is known about how nectar quality affects solitary bee fitness, and if it even does at all. Pollen quality has been more extensively studied, but still predominantly on social bees (Vaudo, recent work on polyfloral/monofloral pollen diets for B. terrestris colonies from the Michez lab). For solitary bees, the limited amount of work suggests that it is the quality of the landscape (i.e. density of floral resources) that determines bee fitness e.g Persson et al 2018 Ecology and Evolution. I would lay out a couple of these issues in a little more detail in the introduction to highlight that most of the nectar work comes from social bees, which are of course very important as pollinators due to their abundance in most ecosystems. We absolutely agree with the reviewer that the ecological needs of solitary bees are very different from social bees. We have consequently reworded this section to better reflect these differences. In addition, we now emphasize the need to collect pollen quality markers as well as an important next step. Despite these fundamental differences we believe that sugar concentration (admittedly understudied) is likely also an important quality marker for solitary bees. This is due to three main reasons: 1. The higher caloric value of nectar will decrease time investment to fulfill the adult and larval nutritional requirements and will consequently benefit wild bees. 2. The argument of Kim et al 2011 is based on the physiology and physics of food uptake which holds for solitary bees as well. 3. By suggesting complementary food resources within agricultural landscapes plant diversity would be increased, which in turn likely helps solitary bees as well at least to some degree. We now make our argumentation clearer in the relevant sections of the MS. Line 22-24, 85-90, 339-343, 573-577 L152. This dataset from Kim et al 2011 is restricted to a narrow selection of bees in Apinae, e.g. Bombus, Apis, Meliponini and Euglossini, all but the Euglossines being social bees. These bees, whilst capturing a lot of the social diversity, are not necessarily representative of the other 19,000+ bee species and so statements such as “However, all evidence suggests that bees avoid foraging on nectar sources below 20% sugar concentration, likely because the caloric intake cannot support sustained foraging activity with potentially detrimental effects for the bee colony” are not necessarily true for solitary species. An earlier discussion of the ecological differences between social and solitary bees seems warranted. If the paper was to state that the focus on nectar was to better inform management for social bees (as is implied by the focus on nectar and references to colony health) this would resolve many of these issues. As it is currently written, the paper refers to ‘bees’ but focuses mostly on social bee examples and on a problem (nectar concentration) that has not empirically been demonstrated to be an issue in solitary species. The main argument of Kim et al is focused on the physiological and physical effects of nectar sugar concentrations on food uptake. Their argument revolves around optimal viscosity and caloric uptake. While we agree that the ecological parameters are very important we believe that the basic augment likely holds for the majority of bees. We have emphasized the important differences between solitary and social bees throughout the MS including the materials and method section. See above L326-327. I was interested to read this reference to see what evidence the authors present, but it is incomplete and gives only the title of the book without publisher information. Looking it up online, the subtitle is ‘the most important food sources for the honey bee’. As written, the current sentence “While it is well-known that pears (Pyrus) are not considered attractive to bees due to their low nectar (Fig.3) quality (Maurizio and Grafl 1980)” is misleading, since the evidence is for honey bees only, and pear is known to have attractive pollen for spring-flying wild bees, particularly Andrena (Chambers 1946 J Animal Ecology; Westrich 1989 Die Wildbienen Baden-Württembergs). Focusing the manuscript more explicitly on honey bees, bees known to be sensitive to nectar concentrations, would seem more appropriate. We agree with the reviewer and have reworded this section to emphasis it’s important to social bees in this context. Line 560-565 Comments for the Author Formatting of references – I have not seen the first and second author et al citation structure before. Please check against PeerJ standards L11. “some bee populations are in decline,” add comma Done L14. “associated with this trend, nutritional stress resulting from a mismatch between bee nutritional needs and plant community provisioning has been suggested as one potential driver.” change placement of commas Done L19. “this information gap,” add comma Done L42. Are in decline, or seem to be declining Done L44. rephrase to ‘are declining in only a few geographic regions and over certain time periods’ Done L48. correct to “intensification, habitat loss- or fragmentation and emerging pathogens” check use of Done L60. cornucopia – perhaps a more scientific and slightly less flowery word? (no pun intended) Changed to plethora L61. Discreet – perhaps change to relatively short? Changed L65. I’m not quite sure what you mean by ‘selective’ in this context. Is it the habitat that is selective, or the criteria used to determine the kind of habitat type that is selective? ‘Specific’ may be a more appropriate word choice if you intend the latter meaning Changed L82-83. Add comma ‘developing bees, sugar concentration’ Done L86. Check second quality Done L126-133. Check formatting e.g. double parentheses, underlining etc Done L147-149. Repetition of ‘for bees’ Done L213. Check capitalisation of genus Done L223. Check PeerJ formatting for Tab. or Table 1 Done L248. Check spelling of variety Done L249. Check spelling of hybrid Done L254. Difference singular Done L273. Check spelling of Pyrus Done L308. Repetition of findings, consider rephrasing Done L331-335. Repetition of high-quality, consider rewriting. In fact, both sentences could be rewritten for clarity. Done L347. Check capitalizations Done Figure 2. Check spelling of Wilcoxon Changed Figure 3 legend. Check spelling of border Changed Figure 3. Hoffmannseggia and Hoffmanseggia seems to be listed twice, are these different genera? We thank the reviewer for pointing out this error. It turned out to be caused by a coding error in the raw data. We have corrected this mistake updated the associated statistics. All other results were unaffected. ________________________________________
paper_title_zh: 花蜜报告：农业和非农业景观中蜜蜂访问花朵提供花蜜糖浓度的定量综述
paper_abstract_zh: 日益增长的担忧表明，一些蜜蜂种群正在衰退，这可能威胁到农业和非农业景观中的授粉安全。在与此趋势相关的众多原因中，蜜蜂营养需求与植物群落供给之间的不匹配所导致的营养压力，被认为是其中一个潜在驱动因素。为了缓解农业栖息地中蜜蜂种群的这种营养压力，农业环境保护计划旨在在蜜蜂需要时为其提供替代性营养资源。然而，这些努力主要集中在数量（提供开花植物）和时机（花朵稀缺期）上，而很大程度上忽视了所提供花朵资源质量。为了开始填补这一信息空白，我们首先利用文献数据编制了一个关于全球范围内蜜蜂可获得花蜜质量（即总糖浓度）的综合地理明确数据集，包括田间（作物和杂草种类）以及田外（野生）的花蜜。特别是社会性蜜蜂对花蜜糖浓度非常敏感，这直接影响热量流入蜂群，进而影响其适应性。我们发现，所研究的三个植物群落之间的花蜜总糖浓度总体上没有差异。相比之下，我们发现野生植物群落的质量变异性比作物和杂草群落更高，这很可能是由该类植物系统发育多样性的增加所解释的。在第二步中，我们利用详细的向日葵（Helianthus annuus L.）数据，探讨了当地栖息地对花蜜质量及其变异性的影响。
review_content_zh:
审稿人1（匿名）基本报告
Pamminger等人提供了一个关于322种野生、栽培和杂草植物物种花蜜浓度的广泛数据集，这些物种来自世界各大洲。论文结构良好，通篇写作出色，只有少数地方需要润色，具体如下。我们感谢审稿人对稿件的总体积极评价。结果很有趣（在所有地区昆虫授粉植物中发现了非常一致的平均花蜜浓度），并突出了某些作物属，这些作物属可能受益于周围景观中额外的花蜜来源，以利于蜜蜂种群。图表清晰，所使用的统计技术描述得当。文献覆盖较为全面，但我希望更多地讨论花蜜中糖浓度为何重要，以及这一证据来自哪些蜜蜂物种（主要是社会性蜜蜂）。我在第3部分中更详细地讨论了这一点。

实验设计
研究问题定义明确（花蜜中糖浓度的重要性），但正如下一部分所详述，我希望更多地讨论这是否适用于所有蜜蜂。见下文

研究结果的有效性
我有几条更重要的评论希望得到解决。主要问题是，稿件讨论了花蜜对“蜜蜂”的重要性，但我们几乎所有关于花蜜浓度重要的证据都来自社会性蜜蜂（如Bombus、Apis等）。我认为所呈现的数据非常有趣，但我很难认同花蜜浓度对独居蜜蜂物种（占蜜蜂物种的绝大多数）同样重要，这些物种的适应性主要与可获取的花粉类型和数量相关。我认为稍作改写，将焦点（以及选择花蜜作为响应变量的理由）转移到社会性蜜蜂上，会使稿件更能代表我们目前对花蜜对蜜蜂重要性的理解，鉴于独居蜜蜂物种存在较大的知识缺口。我们同意审稿人的观点，即大多数直接将花蜜糖浓度与适应性联系起来的证据来自社会性蜜蜂，我们已在稿件的各个部分中对此进行了更清晰的说明。然而，我们相信高质量的干预措施至少在一定程度上也会支持野生蜜蜂。我们已在稿件的相应部分更清晰地做出了这些区分。第22-24行、85-90行、339-343行、573-577行
L69-71。我强烈认为，维持多样化的蜜蜂群落并不是针对蜜蜂的农业环境计划的重点。英国早期的工作强烈关注大黄蜂及其觅食需求（Carvell等人，2004年；2006年；） 2007年，导致目前富含花卉的田边地带主要包含大黄蜂食物植物（例如三叶草、矢车菊、巢菜等）。直到最近，很少有以传粉者为重点的计划被评估其能否为多种野生蜜蜂物种提供资源，例如Scheper等人2015年在JAE上的研究。我们感谢审稿人对此的澄清，并已相应地修改了段落，并添加了参考文献。行：79-84，L72-75。我认为这里需要谨慎。大多数关于花蜜资源质量（尤其是花蜜）的研究都是在社会性蜜蜂上进行的。关于花蜜质量如何影响独居蜜蜂适应性以及是否真的有影响，几乎一无所知。花粉质量的研究较为广泛，但仍然主要集中在社会性蜜蜂上（Vaudo，Michez实验室最近关于多花/单花花粉饮食对B. terrestris蜂群的研究）。对于独居蜜蜂，有限的研究表明，决定蜜蜂适应性的是景观质量（即花资源的密度），例如Persson等人2018年在Ecology and Evolution上的研究。我建议在引言中更详细地阐述这些问题，以突出大多数花蜜研究来自社会性蜜蜂，这些蜜蜂当然非常重要，因为它们在大多数生态系统中数量丰富。我们完全同意审稿人关于独居蜜蜂的生态需求与社会性蜜蜂非常不同的观点。因此，我们已重新措辞这一部分，以更好地反映这些差异。此外，我们现在强调收集花粉质量标记也是一个重要的下一步。尽管存在这些根本差异，我们认为糖浓度（诚然研究不足）可能也是独居蜜蜂的一个重要质量标记。这主要基于三个原因：1. 花蜜的高卡路里价值将减少满足成虫和幼虫营养需求的时间投入，从而有利于野生蜜蜂。2. Kim等人2011年的论点基于食物摄取的生理学和物理学原理，这对独居蜜蜂同样适用。3. 通过建议在农业景观中补充食物资源，植物多样性将增加，这反过来至少在一定程度上也有助于独居蜜蜂。我们现在在MS的相关部分使我们的论证更加清晰。行：22-24，85-90，339-343，573-577，L152。Kim等人2011年的数据集仅限于Apinae中狭窄选择的蜜蜂，例如Bombus、Apis、Meliponini和Euglossini，除Euglossines外都是社会性蜜蜂。 这些蜜蜂虽然捕捉到了很多社会多样性，但并不一定代表其他19,000多种蜜蜂物种，因此诸如“然而，所有证据表明蜜蜂避免在糖浓度低于20%的花蜜来源上觅食，可能是因为卡路里摄入量无法支持持续的觅食活动，对蜜蜂群体可能产生有害影响”的说法并不一定适用于独居物种。早期关于社会性蜜蜂和独居蜜蜂之间生态差异的讨论似乎是必要的。如果论文能说明对花蜜的关注是为了更好地为管理社会性蜜蜂提供信息（正如对花蜜的关注和对群体健康的引用所暗示的），这将解决许多此类问题。目前论文的写法是，虽然提到“蜜蜂”，但主要关注的是社会性蜜蜂的例子以及一个（花蜜浓度）问题，该问题在独居物种中尚未通过实证证明是一个问题。Kim等人主要论点集中在花蜜糖浓度对食物摄取的生理和物理影响上。他们的论点围绕最佳粘度和卡路里摄取展开。虽然我们同意生态参数非常重要，但我们认为基本论点可能适用于大多数蜜蜂。我们在全文中强调了独居蜜蜂和社会性蜜蜂的重要差异，包括材料和方法部分。参见上文L326-327。我本想阅读这一参考文献，看看作者提供了什么证据，但该引用不完整，只给出了书名而没有出版信息。在网上查找后，发现副标题是“蜜蜂最重要的食物来源”。当前句子“众所周知，梨（Pyrus）由于花蜜质量低（图3）而不被蜜蜂视为有吸引力（Maurizio和Grafl 1980）”是有误导性的，因为证据仅针对蜜蜂，而梨已知对春季飞行的野生蜜蜂，尤其是Andrena（Chambers 1946 J Animal Ecology; Westrich 1989 Die Wildbienen Baden-Württembergs）具有吸引力的花粉。更明确地将手稿聚焦在已知对花蜜浓度敏感的蜜蜂上，似乎更为合适。我们同意审稿人的意见，并已重写这部分内容，强调其在社会性蜜蜂中的重要性。第560-565行 对作者的评论 参考文献格式——我之前未见过第一和第二作者等人引用结构。请对照PeerJ标准检查 L11。“一些蜜蜂种群正在减少”，添加逗号 完成 L14。“与此趋势相关，由于蜜蜂营养需求与植物群落供给之间的不匹配导致的营养压力被提出作为潜在驱动因素。”改变逗号位置 完成 L19。“这一信息缺口”，添加逗号 完成 L42. 是在减少，还是似乎在减少 完成 L44. 仅在少数地理区域和特定时间段内呈下降趋势 已完成 L48。更正为“集约化、栖息地丧失或破碎化以及新兴病原体” 检查使用 已完成 L60。cornucopia – 是否可以使用更科学且略显简洁的词汇？（无意双关）已改为plethora L61。Discreet – 是否改为relatively short？已更改 L65。我不太确定在此上下文中“selective”的含义。是指栖息地具有选择性，还是用于确定栖息地类型标准的选择性？如果是指后者，“specific”可能是一个更合适的词 已更改 L82-83。添加逗号“developing bees, sugar concentration” 已完成 L86。检查第二个质量 已完成 L126-133。检查格式，例如双括号、下划线等 已完成 L147-149。重复“for bees” 已完成 L213。检查属名的首字母大写 已完成 L223。检查PeerJ格式中的Tab.或Table 1 已完成 L248。检查品种的拼写 已完成 L249。检查杂交种的拼写 已完成 L254。差异单数 已完成 L273。检查Pyrus的拼写 已完成 L308。重复发现，考虑改写 已完成 L331-335。重复高质，考虑重写。实际上，两个句子都可以重写以清晰表达 已完成 L347。检查首字母大写 已完成 图2。检查Wilcoxon的拼写 已更改 图3图例。检查border的拼写 已更改 图3。Hoffmannseggia和Hoffmanseggia似乎被列了两次，这是不同的属吗？我们感谢审稿人指出这一错误。这原来是原始数据中的编码错误造成的。我们已纠正这一错误并更新了相关统计数据。所有其他结果均未受影响。

paper_title: Automated language essay scoring systems: A Literature Review
paper_abstract: Background.Writing composition is a significant factor for measuring test-takers' ability in any language exam. However, the assessment (scoring) of these writing compositions or essays is a very challenging process in terms of reliability and time. The need for objective and quick scores has raised the need for a computer system that can automatically grade essay questions targeting specific prompts. Automated Essay Scoring (AES) systems are used to overcome the challenges of scoring writing tasks by using Natural Language Processing (NLP) and machine learning techniques. The purpose of this paper is to review the literature for the AES systems used for grading the essay questions.Methodology.We have reviewed the existing literature using Google Scholar, EBSCO and ERIC to search for the terms "AES", "Automated Essay Scoring", "Automated Essay Grading", or "Automatic Essay" for essays written in English language. Two categories have been identified: handcrafted features and automatically featured AES systems. The systems of the former category are closely bonded to the quality of the designed features. On the other hand, the systems of the latter category are based on the automatic learning of the features and relations between an essay and its score without any handcrafted features. We reviewed the systems of the two categories in terms of system primary focus, technique(s) used in the system, the need for training data, instructional application (feedback system), and the correlation between e-scores and human scores. The paper includes three main sections.
review_content: Reviewer 2 Basic reporting The topic of the article is important, and the evaluation of the different approaches/systems is required in the presence of huge use of AES systems especially in English Language Assessment and standardized exam all over the world. The article has a good introduction and background to demonstrate the importance of the work and how it fits into the field of knowledge. Also, the structure of the article is logical and in an acceptable format. In general, the language of the article is clear and the ideas are well organized. Yet, there are few English mistakes (See below). I suggest reviewing the article by a native speaker. The tables and figures are clear and useful as well.
paper_title_zh: 自动化语言作文评分系统：文献综述

paper_title: Open science approaches to COVID-19
paper_abstract: In only a matter of months, the coronavirus disease of 2019 (COVID-19) has spread around the world. The global impact of the disease has caused significant and repeated calls for quick action towards new medicines and vaccines. In response, researchers have adopted open science methods to begin to combat this disease via global collaborative efforts. We summarise here some of those initiatives, and have created an updateable list to which others may be added. Though open science has previously been shown as an accelerator of biomedical research, the COVID-19 crisis has made openness seem the logical choice. Will openness persist in the discovery of new medicines, after the crisis has receded?
review_content:
This is a very timely, excellent manuscript that both highlights and supports open drug discovery research especially for COVID-19 and possible future pandemics. The authors provide a nice overview of different types of open research activities related to the research response to COVID-19.

There has been indeed an unprecedented level of sharing data and resources since the beginning of the pandemic and it is difficult to cover all of these developments in a short review. I would nevertheless suggest a few additions. Thus, I recommend adding a statement on the availability of computational resources besides Folding@home such as COVID-19 HPC consortium (https://www.xsede.org/covid19-hpc-consortium).

I would also suggest a broader acknowledgment of multiple journals and publishers that agreed to provide open access to all papers on the topic of COVID-19. A possibly complete list is available from the Wellcome Trust (https://wellcome.org/press-release/publishers-make-coronavirus-covid-19-content-freely-available-and-reusable).

Finally, I would recommend that the authors expand on the important issue of the quality of research publications. The authors mention that even preprint servers stopped accepting manuscripts with countless purely computationally repurposed drugs against the disease with no experimental confirmation. It would be prudent to cite a recent publication in Nature Biotechnology on the need for automated peer review of the publications tsunami (https://www.nature.com/articles/s41587-020-0686-x)1 and perhaps, emphasize the importance of rigor, experimental support, and reproducibility of research findings reported in both preprint servers and peer-reviewed publications.
paper_title_zh: 开放科学方法应对COVID-19
paper_abstract_zh: 在短短几个月内，2019年冠状病毒病（COVID-19）已在全球范围内传播。该疾病的全球影响引发了对于新药物和疫苗快速行动的显著且反复的呼吁。作为回应，研究人员采用了开放科学方法，通过全球协作努力开始对抗这一疾病。我们在本文中总结了其中一些倡议，并创建了一个可更新的清单，以便添加更多内容。尽管开放科学已被证明是生物医学研究的加速器，但COVID-19危机使开放性显得成为逻辑上的选择。在危机消退后，开放性是否会在新药物的发现中持续存在？
review_content_zh:
这是一篇非常及时、优秀的稿件，既突出了又支持了开放药物发现研究，尤其是针对COVID-19和可能出现的未来大流行病。作者对与COVID-19研究响应相关的不同类型的开放研究活动进行了很好的概述。

自大流行病开始以来，确实出现了前所未有的数据共享和资源共享水平，在一篇简短的综述中很难涵盖所有这些进展。尽管如此，我还是建议做一些补充。因此，我建议除了 Folding@home 之外，增加关于计算资源可用性的声明，例如 COVID-19 HPC 联盟（https://www.xsede.org/covid19-hpc-consortium）。

我还建议更广泛地认可多家期刊和出版商同意提供对COVID-19主题所有论文的开放获取。Wellcome Trust提供了一个可能的完整列表（https://wellcome.org/press-release/publishers-make-coronavirus-covid-19-content-freely-available-and-reusable）。

最后，我建议作者扩展关于研究出版物质量的重要问题。作者提到，即使是预印本服务器也停止接受无数纯粹通过计算重新定位的药物稿件，这些药物没有实验验证。引用《自然·生物技术》上最近一篇关于出版物海啸需要自动化同行评审的文章（https://www.nature.com/articles/s41587-020-0686-x）1，并强调在预印本服务器和同行评审出版物中报告的研究成果的严谨性、实验支持和可重复性的重要性，将是明智的。
