paper_title: Neurocognitive endophenotypes in CGG KI and Fmr1 KO mouse models of Fragile X-Associated disorders: an analysis of the state of the field
paper_abstract: It has become increasingly important that the field of behavioral genetics identifies not only the gross behavioral phenotypes associated with a given mutation, but also the behavioral endophenotypes that scale with the dosage of the particular mutation being studied. Over the past few years, studies evaluating the effects of the polymorphic CGG trinucleotide repeat on the FMR1 gene underlying Fragile X-Associated Disorders have reported preliminary evidence for a behavioral endophenotype in human Fragile X Premutation carrier populations as well as the CGG knock-in (KI) mouse model. More recently, the behavioral experiments used to test the CGG KI mouse model have been extended to the Fmr1 knock-out (KO) mouse model. When combined, these data provide compelling evidence for a clear neurocognitive endophenotype in the mouse models of Fragile X-Associated Disorders such that behavioral deficits scale predictably with genetic dosage. Similarly, it appears that the CGG KI mouse effectively models the histopathology in Fragile X-Associated Disorders across CGG repeats well into the full mutation range, resulting in a reliable histopathological endophenotype. These endophenotypes may influence future research directions into treatment strategies for not only Fragile X Syndrome, but also the Fragile X Premutation and Fragile X-Associated Tremor/Ataxia Syndrome (FXTAS).
review_content:
This is a well written review on an important topic. Fmr1 knock-out mice have been used as a best approximation of a genetically accurate model of fragile X syndrome, despite the fact that the patients have a tandem repeat expansion rather than a null mutation. The systematic comparison of knock-in and knock-out Fmr1 mice is important not just for our understanding of fragile X syndrome, FXTAS and related disorders, but also for the role of this fascinating tandem repeat polymorphism in healthy brain development and cognitive function. Whilst the maintenance of very long tandem repeat mutations in mouse lines has been a technical challenge (particularly for fragile X syndrome), this can no doubt be overcome so that such tandem repeat disorders are modeled with optimal genetic construct validity.

The article summarises and integrates a large body of data. The integration of cognitive endophenotypes with information on cellular and molecular mechanisms is informative. I think it is a useful addition to the literature on tandem repeat polymorphisms and associated disorders, and their effects on the healthy and diseased brain.
paper_title_zh: 脆性X相关障碍的CGG KI和Fmr1 KO小鼠模型中的神经认知内表型：领域现状分析
paper_abstract_zh: 行为遗传学领域越来越需要识别的不仅是与特定突变相关的大体行为表型，还包括与所研究突变剂量成比例的行为内表型。在过去的几年里，评估多态性CGG三核苷酸重复对脆性X相关障碍中FMR1基因影响的研究报告了初步证据，表明在人类脆性X前突变携带者群体以及CGG敲入（KI）小鼠模型中存在行为内表型。最近，用于测试CGG KI小鼠模型的行为实验已扩展到Fmr1敲除（KO）小鼠模型。综合这些数据，为脆性X相关障碍小鼠模型中存在明确的神经认知内表型提供了有力证据，即行为缺陷与基因剂量成可预测的比例。同样，CGG KI小鼠似乎有效模拟了脆性X相关障碍中跨越CGG重复直至完全突变范围的病理组织学，从而形成了一个可靠的病理组织学内表型。这些内表型可能会影响未来对脆性X综合征、脆性X前突变以及脆性X相关震颤/共济失调综合征（FXTAS）治疗策略的研究方向。
review_content_zh:
这是一篇关于重要主题的写得很好的综述。尽管患者具有串联重复扩展而非无效突变，Fmr1基因敲除小鼠仍被用作脆性X综合征遗传学准确模型的最佳近似。系统地比较Fmr1基因敲入和敲除小鼠，不仅对我们理解脆性X综合征、FXTAS及相关疾病至关重要，而且对于这一引人注目的串联重复多态性在健康脑发育和认知功能中的作用也具有重要意义。尽管在鼠系中维持非常长的串联重复突变一直是一个技术挑战（尤其是对于脆性X综合征），但这无疑是可以克服的，以便以最佳的遗传结构效度模拟此类串联重复疾病。

文章总结并整合了大量数据。将认知内表型与细胞和分子机制的信息相结合，具有启发性。我认为这是对串联重复多态性及相关疾病文献的有益补充，以及它们对健康和疾病大脑的影响。

reasons: This review by Michael Hunsaker covers a large body of literature to which he has significantly contributed related to behavioral assay development in Fragile X spectrum disorder mouse models.
The author does a nice job of accumulating histological findings in premutation patients and mouse models.
However, the discussion of current hypotheses around the development of inclusion formation and disease pathogenesis is lacking.

There are many theories in the FXTAS field that the increase of FMR1 mRNA can cause protein sequestration, and may also trigger production of aberrant protein products which could contribute to inclusion formation.
The mechanistic data for both of these hypotheses should be at least mentioned here.

Whilst the maintenance of very long tandem repeat mutations in mouse lines has been a technical challenge (particularly for fragile X syndrome), this can no doubt be overcome so that such tandem repeat disorders are modeled with optimal genetic construct validity.
I think it is a useful addition to the literature on tandem repeat polymorphisms and associated disorders, and their effects on the healthy and diseased brain.

paper_title: Risk factors for premature coronary artery disease (PCAD) in adults: a systematic review protocol
paper_abstract:
PCAD possesses a public health challenge resulting in years of productive life lost and an escalating burden on health systems. Objective of this review is to compare modifiable and non-modifiable risk factors for PCAD compared to those without PCAD. This review will include all comparative observational studies conducted in adults aged > 18 years with confirmed diagnosis of PCAD (on angiography) compared to those without PCAD. Databases to be searched include; PubMed, CINAHL, Embase, Web of Science, and grey literature (Google Scholar). All identified studies will be screened for title and abstract and full-text against the inclusion criteria on Covidence software. Data relevant to exposures and outcomes will be extracted from all included studies. All studies selected for data extraction will be critically appraised for methodological quality. Meta-analysis using random-effects model will be performed using Review Manager 5.3. Effect sizes for categorical risk factors will be expressed as odds ratios with 95% confidence intervals. For risk factors measured in continuous form, mean difference (if units are consistent) otherwise standardized mean difference (if units are different across studies) will be reported. Heterogeneity between 
studies will be assessed using I 2 test statistics. GRADE will be used to assess the certainty of the findings. 
 
 Systematic review registration number:  PROSPERO Registration # CRD42020173216
review_content:
Summary:
It is a study protocol of a systematic review to assess the risk factors for premature coronary artery disease (PCAD) in adults. Understanding modifiable and non-modifiable risk factors is critical for preventing morbidity and mortality from PCAD. All major risk factors, both modifiable and non-modifiable, have not been thoroughly investigated in previous systematic reviews among patients with PCAD. They either included specific risk factors for PCAD, targeted specific subgroups, or were limited to a single country. There has been no comprehensive appraisal of the evidence to date, despite the fact that there have been a number of published observational studies on PCAD risk factors, a comprehensive systematic review of the evidence is lacking. The findings of this systematic review will contribute to existing scientific knowledge and inform current clinical practice guidelines.

Comments:
Data Synthesis:
1. The authors have mentioned that for dichotomous variables odds ratio will be reported, however odds ratio may not be applicable for cohort studies and cross sectional studies for which the appropriate measures of association are relative risk and prevalence ratio respectively.
2. The authors have mentioned in the title that it will be a systematic review, however in the methodology they have mentioned they will perform meta-analysis. Please make it consistent with the title.
paper_title_zh: 成年人早发性冠状动脉疾病（PCAD）的危险因素：系统综述方案
paper_abstract_zh:
PCAD构成一项公共卫生挑战，导致生产性寿命年数的损失，并对卫生系统造成日益加重的负担。本综述的目的是比较PCAD患者与无PCAD人群的可修改和不可修改风险因素。本综述将包括所有在年龄大于18岁的成年人中进行的比较性观察研究，这些研究对象经血管造影确诊为PCAD，并与无PCAD人群进行比较。将检索的数据库包括：PubMed、CINAHL、Embase、Web of Science以及灰色文献（Google Scholar）。所有识别出的研究将通过Covidence软件进行标题和摘要的筛选，以及全文对照纳入标准进行筛选。将从所有纳入的研究中提取与暴露和结果相关的数据。所有选入数据提取的研究将对其方法学质量进行严格评估。使用Review Manager 5.3进行随机效应模型的Meta分析。分类风险因素的效应大小将以优势比及其95%置信区间表示。对于以连续形式测量的风险因素，若单位一致则报告均值差，若单位在不同研究间不一致则报告标准化均值差。研究间的异质性将通过I²检验统计量进行评估。将使用GRADE评估研究结果的确定性。

系统综述注册号：PROSPERO注册号# CRD42020173216
review_content_zh:
摘要：
这是一项系统评价的研究方案，旨在评估成人早发性冠状动脉疾病（PCAD）的风险因素。了解可修改和不可修改的风险因素对于预防PCAD引起的发病率和死亡率至关重要。在以往针对PCAD患者的系统评价中，所有主要风险因素（包括可修改和不可修改的）尚未得到彻底研究。它们要么仅包括特定风险因素，要么针对特定亚组，或仅限于单一国家。尽管已有大量关于PCAD风险因素的观察性研究发表，但至今仍缺乏对证据的全面评估。这项系统评价的发现将有助于现有科学知识的积累，并为当前的临床实践指南提供信息。

评论：
数据合成：
1. 作者提到对于二元变量将报告优势比，然而优势比可能不适用于队列研究和横断面研究，对于这些研究，适当的关联度量分别是相对风险和患病率比。
2. 作者在标题中提到这将是一项系统评价，然而在方法学部分他们提到将进行Meta分析。请与标题保持一致。

reasons: This seems a very interesting and comprehensive systematic review protocol targeting modifiable and non-modifiable risk factors for patients with premature coronary artery disease and comparing it to those without premature coronary artery disease.
I also like the thought that four different databases will be included as part of this systematic review.
Understanding modifiable and non-modifiable risk factors is critical for preventing morbidity and mortality from PCAD.
Please make it consistent with the title.
The authors have mentioned in the title that it will be a systematic review, however in the methodology they have mentioned they will perform meta-analysis.
Please make it consistent with the title.

paper_title: Prevalence of stress and its relevance on psychological well-being of the teaching profession:  A scoping review
paper_abstract:
Background 
    Well-being among teachers contributes toward quality work and better student support. Teachers’ well-being persists to be a concern in school settings; there is a lacuna in understanding the concept of well-being among them. This scoping review identifies the stress factors and map their association with the psychological well-being of teachers employed in schools. Additionally, to identify the methodology and the interventions used in reducing teachers’ stress and their relevance on their psychological well-being. 
  
  
    Methods 
    First, Pubmed, Web of Science, and Scopus databases were searched for eligible studies with MeSH terms for stress factors, well-being, and teachers from 2010 to 2022. Identified studies were screened thoroughly and excluded or included based on prior established criteria. Data from the included studies were extracted and summarized according to the study protocol. 
  
  
    Results 
    Among the 60 studies that met our inclusion criteria, the majority were quantitative, with cross-sectional studies. Several studies focused on emotional exhaustion, depersonalization, and diminished personal accomplishment aspect among teachers. Almost half of the included studies focused on organizational and social pressures such as administration workload, classroom management issues, lack of supervisor and team support, students’ behaviour, and pressure from parents. The most used interventions to overcome stress were coping strategies and mindfulness training intervention tools. 
  
  
    Conclusions 
    The findings from the current scoping review will reveal the different stressors which impact psychological well-being. Focus on the most used interventions to overcome stress among schoolteachers. This will also provide recommendations to regulators and management to identify the factors causing stress among teachers and their relevance to their psychological well-being, overcome employee turnover and absenteeism issues. Also, different alternatives available to reduce the stress may benefit the stakeholders and policymakers to confirm a suitable intervention that will benefit the teaching profession.
review_content:
Review for the paper:
Prevalence of stress and its relevance on the psychological well-being of the teaching profession: A scoping review
  * The review covers the period between 2010 to 2022.
  * Although the title implies all the teaching professions, the study sample includes only school teachers.
  * The study scope is well-defined, identifying the stress factors and the interventions/measures followed to overcome the stress in the teaching profession.
  * The criteria for selecting the sample and the exclusion was well defined.
  * I believe the topic of the study is significant as it takes the school teachers as a sample, and the procedures used are suitable for this kind of study.
  * The statistics and layout of the results clarify the scope of the study.
  * The discussion includes increased research in the field (from three countries), theoretical perspective and stress intervention.
  * The authors clearly clarify the limitations of the study.
  * The conclusion: The paper identifies the benefit of higher psychological well-being of the teachers' profession. Also, they stress that the study results help managers working in consultancies and organisations think and apply the intervention better to harmonise our real drivers of the education sector.
  * It seems that the English language may need revision.
  * Finally, this paper is critical and worth for approving, as it touches on an essential societal profession. The scientific procedure followed in this study is well-defined and appropriate for such a study.
paper_title_zh: 压力的普遍性及其对教师职业心理健康的相关性：范围综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景
教师福祉有助于高质量工作和对学生的更好支持。教师的福祉在学校环境中持续受到关注；对教师福祉概念的理解存在空白。本范围综述识别了学校教师的压力因素，并绘制了这些因素与教师心理福祉之间关联的图谱。此外，旨在识别用于减轻教师压力的方法论和干预措施，以及这些措施对教师心理福祉的相关性。

方法
首先，在PubMed、Web of Science和Scopus数据库中搜索2010年至2022年间符合条件的研究，使用MeSH术语检索压力因素、福祉和教师相关研究。识别出的研究经过彻底筛选，根据预先设定的标准进行排除或纳入。从纳入的研究中提取数据，并根据研究方案进行总结。

结果
在符合我们纳入标准的60项研究中，大多数为定量研究，以横断面研究为主。几项研究关注教师的情感耗竭、去人格化和个人成就感降低方面。几乎一半的纳入研究关注组织和社交压力，如行政工作负担、课堂管理问题、缺乏上级和团队支持、学生行为以及来自家长的压力。最常用于克服压力的干预措施是应对策略和正念训练干预工具。

结论
当前范围综述的发现将揭示影响心理福祉的不同压力源。重点关注学校教师中最常用于克服压力的干预措施。这还将为监管者和管理层提供建议，以识别导致教师压力的因素及其与心理福祉的相关性，克服员工流失和缺勤问题。此外，减少压力的不同替代方案可能使利益相关者和政策制定者受益，以确定适合教学职业的干预措施。
review_content_zh:
对论文的评论：
《压力的普遍性及其对教师职业心理健康的相关性：一项范围综述》
* 综述涵盖了2010年至2022年期间的研究。
* 尽管标题暗示涵盖所有教师职业，但研究样本仅包括学校教师。
* 研究范围明确，识别了教师职业中的压力因素以及为克服压力所采取的干预/措施。
* 选择样本和排除的标准定义明确。
* 我认为研究的主题具有重要意义，因为它以学校教师为样本，所使用的程序适合此类研究。
* 统计数据和结果布局清晰地阐明了研究范围。
* 讨论部分包括该领域（来自三个国家）的增量研究、理论视角和压力干预。
* 作者明确澄清了研究的局限性。
* 结论：论文确定了教师职业更高心理健康的益处。此外，他们强调研究结果有助于咨询公司和组织中的管理人员更好地思考和应用干预措施，以协调教育领域的真正驱动力。
* 似乎英语语言可能需要修订。
* 最后，这篇论文至关重要，值得批准，因为它触及了一个重要的社会职业。本研究遵循的科学程序定义明确，适合此类研究。

reasons: I believe the topic of the study is significant as it takes the school teachers as a sample, and the procedures used are suitable for this kind of study.
The discussion includes increased research in the field (from three countries), theoretical perspective and stress intervention.
The conclusion: The Paper identifies the benefit of higher psychological well-being of the teachers' profession.
Also, they stress that the study results help managers working in consultancies and organisations think and apply the intervention better to harmonise our real drivers of the education sector.
Finally, this paper is critical and worth for approving, as it touches on an essential societal profession.

paper_title: The product science of electrically heated tobacco products: a narrative review of the scientific literature
paper_abstract:
Heated tobacco products represent a novel category of tobacco products in which a tobacco consumable is heated to a temperature that releases nicotine from the tobacco leaf but not to a temperature sufficient to cause combustion. Heated tobacco products may therefore have the potential to be a less harmful alternative for adult smokers that would otherwise continue to smoke conventional cigarettes. Given the rapid development of this product category, the aim of this review was to examine the available peer-reviewed scientific evidence related to heated tobacco products and highlight any research gaps. 
In recent years, manufacturers of heated tobacco products have published a number of studies on their respective heated tobacco products. Whilst there is limited research that is independent of commercial interests, the available scientific evidence indicates that heated tobacco products produce a much simpler aerosol than conventional cigarette smoke, with fewer and substantially lower levels of harmful toxicants. Toxicology assessments indicate these reductions in aerosol toxicants translate to reduced biological effects. Biomarker and clinical data from studies in which product use is controlled within a clinical setting, indicate changes in biomarker levels and clinical end-points similar to observations in cessation studies, indicating the potential for reduced harm. The scientific evidence also indicates that exposure of non-users to emissions from heated tobacco products in indoor environments is significantly reduced compared to exposure resulting from smoking conventional cigarettes. 
Overall, the available scientific evidence indicates that heated tobacco products hold promise as a less harmful alternative to conventional cigarettes, but more independent data is required to validate industry findings. As a growing product category, epidemiological studies and independent population modelling studies are outstanding, and empirical data on how dual tobacco product category use by consumers affects their risk profile is lacking.
review_content:
The current review is a very comprehensive review of the toxicological and risk assessment of electronically heated tobacco products. The authors have done a commendable job in putting together all the existing literature comparing the toxicology and health effects of aHTPs with conventional cigarettes. However this reviewer feels that the length of this review with so many different aspects being discussed makes it a tough read.

Here are a few suggestions to improve upon this manuscript:
 1. The way the review is structured it might as well be structured as a systematic review. Authors must check the guidelines and restructure the manuscript accordingly.
 2. The manuscript will benefit much with some serious editing. Repetitions and redundant statements and studies can be removed from discussion and key ideas should be focused on in terms of the public health risk.
 3. The quality of Tables could be improved.
paper_title_zh: 电加热烟草产品产品科学：科学文献的叙述性综述
paper_abstract_zh:
加热烟草产品代表了一类新型烟草产品，其中烟草可消费品被加热到释放烟草叶中尼古丁的温度，但不足以引起燃烧的温度。因此，加热烟草产品可能成为继续吸传统香烟的成年吸烟者的较无害替代品。鉴于该产品类别的快速发展，本综述的目的是审查有关加热烟草产品的现有同行评审科学证据，并突出任何研究空白。

近年来，加热烟草产品的制造商们发表了大量关于其各自加热烟草产品的研究。尽管独立于商业利益的研究有限，但现有科学证据表明，加热烟草产品产生的气溶胶比传统香烟烟雾简单得多，有害毒物的种类和水平都显著降低。毒理学评估显示，这些气溶胶毒物的减少转化为生物效应的降低。在临床环境中控制产品使用的生物标志物和临床数据显示，生物标志物水平和临床终点的变化与戒烟研究中的观察结果相似，表明具有减少危害的潜力。科学证据还表明，非用户在室内环境中接触加热烟草产品排放物的暴露量显著低于吸传统香烟的暴露量。

总体而言，现有科学证据表明，加热烟草产品作为传统香烟的较无害替代品具有前景，但需要更多独立数据来验证行业发现。作为一个不断增长的产品类别，流行病学研究以及独立的群体建模研究尚待进行，且缺乏关于消费者双重使用烟草产品类别如何影响其风险状况的实证数据。
review_content_zh:
当前综述是对电子加热烟草产品的毒理学和风险评估的非常全面的回顾。作者在汇总所有现有文献，比较加热烟草制品（aHTPs）与传统香烟的毒理学和健康影响方面做得值得称赞。然而，本审稿人认为，这篇综述篇幅较长，讨论了众多不同方面，使得阅读较为困难。

以下是几条改进该手稿的建议：
1. 综述的结构方式完全可以按照系统综述来构建。作者必须查阅相关指南并相应地重新组织手稿。
2. 手稿将大大受益于一些认真的编辑工作。可以从讨论中删除重复和冗余的陈述及研究，并应重点关注公共卫生风险的关键观点。
3. 表格的质量可以提升。

reasons: The current review is a very comprehensive review of the toxicological and risk assessment of electronically heated tobacco products.
The authors have done a commendable job in putting together all the existing literature comparing the toxicology and health effects of aHTPs with conventional cigarettes.
The conclusions about where research in this field needs to go are correc
However this reviewer feels that the length of this review with so many different aspects being discussed makes it a tough read.
The manuscript will benefit much with some serious editing.
Repetitions and redundant statements and studies can be removed from discussion and key ideas should be focused on in terms of the public health risk.
The way the review is structured it might as well be structured as a systematic review.
Authors must check the guidelines and restructure the manuscript accordingly.

paper_title: Oral squamous cell carcinoma: metastasis, potentially associated malignant disorders, etiology and recent advancements in diagnosis
paper_abstract: Oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC) is a commonly occurring head and neck cancer. It has a high prevalence in certain parts of the world, and is associated with a high mortality rate. In this review, we describe metastasis related to OSCC, and disorders that could lead to OSCC with common etiological factors. In addition, a brief account of the diagnosis of OSCC and role of salivary biomarkers in its early detection has also been highlighted. Google Scholar and PubMed search engines were searched with keywords including “oral squamous cell carcinoma”, “OSCC”, “oral cancer”, “potentially malignant disorders in oral cavity”, “etiological factors of OSCC”,  “diagnosis of OSCC”, and “salivary biomarkers and OSCC” to gather the literature for this review. The review concludes that OSCC has the potential for regional as well as distant metastasis, and many potentially malignant diseases can transform into OSCC with the help of various etiological factors. Diagnosis of OSCC involves traditional biopsy, but salivary biomarkers could also be utilized for early recognition.
review_content:
1. In etiology section: it has been mentioned that there is a various etiological factors that cause OSCC, most of the articles that have been cited are based on epidemiological statistics. So I think it is better to specify that these are based on epidemiological statistics.
 2. It has been mentioned that early detection of cancer using certain techniques like salivary bio markers will lead to successful prognosis and treatment, are there any studies showing that there is improved prognosis after early detection? If not then this would be a good way to mention this as a suggestion and future trend to establish studies to show the essential role of early diagnosis.
 3. Suggestions to add diagnostic criteria for early detection of OSCC.
paper_title_zh: 口腔鳞状细胞癌：转移、潜在相关恶性疾病、病因及诊断的最新进展
paper_abstract_zh: 口腔鳞状细胞癌（OSCC）是一种常见的头颈部癌症。在某些地区，其患病率较高，且与高死亡率相关。在本综述中，我们描述了与OSCC相关的转移，以及可能导致OSCC的具有共同病因因素的疾病。此外，还简要介绍了OSCC的诊断及其早期检测中唾液生物标志物的作用。通过Google Scholar和PubMed搜索引擎，使用包括“口腔鳞状细胞癌”、“OSCC”、“口腔癌”、“口腔潜在恶性疾病”、“OSCC的病因因素”、“OSCC的诊断”以及“唾液生物标志物与OSCC”等关键词，收集了本综述的文献。综述得出结论，OSCC具有区域性和远处转移的潜力，许多潜在恶性疾病在各种病因因素的帮助下可转化为OSCC。OSCC的诊断涉及传统活检，但唾液生物标志物也可用于其早期识别。
review_content_zh:
1. 在病因学部分：已提及有多种病因因素导致口腔鳞状细胞癌（OSCC），所引用的大部分文章基于流行病学统计数据。因此，我认为最好明确指出这些是基于流行病学统计的数据。
2. 已提及使用某些技术（如唾液生物标志物）进行癌症的早期检测将导致成功的预后和治疗，是否有研究表明早期检测后预后有所改善？如果没有，那么可以将其作为一个建议和未来趋势提出，建立研究以展示早期诊断的重要作用。
3. 建议增加OSCC早期检测的诊断标准。

reasons: Recheck reference 1, I have not found any content related to the incidence of OSCC or Head and neck cancer.
The review on Oral squamous cell carcinoma is a well written comprehensive article. It summarises the aetiology, metastasis and current diagnostic methods of OSCC.
All the information provided is scientifically valid.
If not then this would be a good way to mention this as a suggestion and future trend to establish studies to show the essential role of early diagnosis.
Suggestions to add diagnostic criteria for early detection of OSCC.

paper_title: Research on emotional intelligence among Indian teachers: A Systematic Review and meta-analysis of its correlation with health parameters and impact of gender
paper_abstract:
Background 
     Emotional intelligence is the self-perception related to identification and regulation of emotions. Several studies have been done among Indian teachers evaluating emotional intelligence in relation to demographic, professional and various psychological parameters, but the variety of scales, teacher types, and conflicting results makes it difficult to draw any meaningful conclusions from this heterogeneous data. 
     The present work aims to synthesize the available data by both qualitative and quantitative analysis and is the first such attempt to include only Indian studies in this field. The main objectives were to determine the correlation of emotional intelligence with teachers’ health parameters and to study the gender difference in emotional intelligence. 
   
   
     Methods 
     After a thorough literature search in Google, Google scholar, Scopus, Web of science and Pubmed, fifty-five Indian studies were selected which empirically examined teachers’ emotional intelligence, either alone or in association with another parameter evaluating teachers’ psychological health and performance. After qualitative assessment of major findings, quantitative analysis was performed. Three separate meta-analysis were carried out. The first one with fifteen effect sizes among 3291 participants evaluated correlation with personal health parameters. The second with nineteen effect sizes in 4165 participants evaluated correlation with professional health parameters. The third with twenty-six studies involving 6005 participants assessed effect of gender. 
   
   
     Results 
     The results show that almost all studies have used a trait measure, teachers’ emotional intelligence is positively correlated with both personal and professional health parameters and gender has no effect on emotional intelligence. 
   
   
     Conclusion 
     Major limitations are a very high degree of heterogeneity of the data, incomplete description of the scales, inadequate randomization and small sample sizes in many studies. The results indicate the importance of emotional intelligence in both personal and professional life of teachers and no effect of gender preparing a solid base for future research.
review_content:
This paper is a good attempt to explore the status of research on emotional intelligence in India. The following are some points suggested to the author-

1. The paper is too long in comparison to the normal length of the research paper.
2. The rationale behind choosing the Indian research only, needs a more logical background.
3. Methodology is sufficient and clear for a layman.
4. I am unable to understand why researchers used two different methods in a single paper i.e. meta-analysis and survey.
5. References are relevant to the present study.
paper_title_zh: 印度教师情绪智力的研究：与健康参数相关性的系统综述与元分析及性别影响
paper_abstract_zh:
背景
情绪智力是指与情绪识别和调节相关的自我感知。已有若干研究针对印度教师评估情绪智力与人口统计学、职业及各种心理参数之间的关系，但由于量表种类、教师类型及结果冲突的多样性，使得从这些异质数据中得出任何有意义的结论变得困难。当前研究旨在通过定性和定量分析综合现有数据，并且是首次仅包含该领域印度研究的尝试。主要目标是确定情绪智力与教师健康参数之间的相关性，并研究情绪智力中的性别差异。

方法
在谷歌、谷歌学术、Scopus、Web of Science和PubMed进行彻底的文献检索后，选取了五十五项印度研究，这些研究实证考察了教师的情绪智力，无论是单独考察还是与评估教师心理健康和绩效的其他参数相结合。在对主要发现进行定性评估后，进行了定量分析。进行了三项独立的元分析。第一项涉及3291名参与者的十五个效应量，评估与个人健康参数的相关性。第二项涉及4165名参与者的十九个效应量，评估与职业健康参数的相关性。第三项涉及二十六项研究，包括6005名参与者，评估性别的影响。

结果
结果显示，几乎所有研究都使用了特质测量，教师的情绪智力与个人和职业健康参数均呈正相关，且性别对情绪智力无影响。

结论
主要局限性在于数据的高度异质性、量表描述不完整、随机化不足以及许多研究中样本量较小。结果表明情绪智力在教师个人和职业生活中的重要性，且性别无影响，为未来研究奠定了坚实基础。
review_content_zh:
本文是探讨印度情绪智力研究现状的一次良好尝试。以下是对作者的一些建议：

1. 相较于研究论文的正常长度，本文过长。
2. 仅选择印度研究的理由需要一个更合理的背景。
3. 研究方法对普通人来说足够且清晰。
4. 我无法理解为何研究人员在同一篇论文中使用了两种不同的方法，即元分析和调查。
5. 参考文献与当前研究相关。

reasons: 5. References are relevant to the present study.

paper_title: Food supplements to complement brain functioning: the benefits of a combination of magnesium, folic acid, omega-3 fatty acids and vitamin E
paper_abstract: Diet and nutrition play a fundamental role not only in human body composition and in physiology, but have also relevant effects on mood, mental well-being and cognitive performance. In particular, the preservation of mental well-being through a healthy lifestyle, including a well-balanced diet and, in case, through the intake of specific food supplements, is of particular relevance in the perspective of global human ageing, as the brain is affected significantly by a persistent presence of stress factors. Due to the increasing burden of mental and neurological disorders and to the universality of food as a modifiable risk factor, even limited improvements in nutritional habits may translate to a considerable rise of well-being and mental health in the global population. Moreover, the use of targeted, well-balanced food supplements aiming to support the mental health and well-being will probably represent a relevant tool in future decades, together with an increased awareness of the importance of nutrition, also considering the COVID-19 pandemic and the related stressful events and limitations we are still experiencing at global level. The aim of this review is to summarize the experimental and clinical data reported in the literature concerning the beneficial effects of a subset of micro- and macronutrients contained both in food and in supplements, namely magnesium, folic acid, docosahexaenoic acid, eicosapentaenoic acid, and alpha-tocopherol, on a series of disorders, including stress, anxiety, low sleep quality, and low cognitive performance.
review_content:
This is an interesting, well written and timely article focused on the fundamental role of diet/nutrition on brain function. The importance of improved nutritional habits is also discussed, specifically the beneficial effects of micro- and macronutrients in food and supplements.

Some clarifications on the following would improve the manuscript.
  * Please add rationale for the focus only on magnesium, folic acid, docosahexaenoic acid (DHA), eicosapentaenoic acid (EPA), and alpha-tocopherol.
  * A short discussion on the impact of the gut microbiome on brain metabolome would be interesting.
  * Is there any evidence that other free fatty acids besides omega 3 influence brain function and well being?
  * Is magnesium the only ion known to impact cognitive responses?
paper_title_zh: 补充食品以促进大脑功能：镁、叶酸、ω-3脂肪酸和维生素E组合的益处
paper_abstract_zh: 饮食和营养不仅在人体组成和生理学中起着基础性作用，而且对情绪、心理健康和认知表现也有显著影响。特别是，通过健康生活方式，包括均衡饮食以及必要时通过摄入特定食物补充剂来维持心理健康，在全球人口老龄化的背景下尤为重要，因为大脑会显著受到持续压力因素的影响。鉴于精神和神经系统疾病的负担日益加重，以及食物作为可修改风险因素的普遍性，即使是营养习惯的有限改善也可能转化为全球人口福祉和心理健康的显著提升。此外，使用针对性强、均衡的食物补充剂以支持心理健康和福祉，可能在未来几十年内成为一个重要工具，同时提高对营养重要性的认识，也考虑到我们仍在全球范围内经历的COVID-19大流行及其相关的压力事件和限制。本综述的目的是总结文献中报道的实验和临床数据，涉及食物和补充剂中含有的部分微量和宏量营养素，即镁、叶酸、二十二碳六烯酸、二十碳五烯酸和α-生育酚，对一系列疾病（包括压力、焦虑、低睡眠质量和低认知表现）的益处。
review_content_zh:
这是一篇有趣、文笔流畅且适时的文章，专注于饮食/营养对大脑功能的基本作用。文章还讨论了改善营养习惯的重要性，特别是食物和补充剂中微量营养素和宏量营养素的益处。

对以下几点进行澄清将提升稿件质量：
  * 请补充仅关注镁、叶酸、二十二碳六烯酸（DHA）、二十碳五烯酸（EPA）和α-生育酚的理由。
  * 简要讨论肠道微生物群对大脑代谢组的影响将是有趣的。
  * 是否有证据表明除ω-3以外的其他游离脂肪酸会影响大脑功能和健康？
  * 镁是唯一已知影响认知反应的离子吗？

reasons: This is an interesting, well written and timely article focused on the fundamental role of diet/nutrition on brain function.

Some clarifications on the following would improve the manuscript. * Please add rationale for the focus only on magnesium, folic acid, docosahexaenoic acid (DHA), eicosapentaenoic acid (EPA), and alpha-tocopherol. * A short discussion on the impact of the gut microbiome on brain metabolome would be interesting. * Is there any evidence that other free fatty acids besides omega 3 influence brain function and well being? * Is magnesium the only ion known to impact cognitive responses?

paper_title: Synergistic review of automation impact of big data, AI, and ML in current data transformative era
paper_abstract: The convergence of automation, big data analytics (BDA), artificial intelligence (AI), and machine learning (ML) has ushered in a new era of technological advancement, reshaping industries, and societies worldwide. This review research work delves into the transformative impact of these technologies, focusing on their applications across various sectors. The study covers six key sectors: healthcare, banking, finance, retail, real estate, and agriculture, highlighting how these industries leverage automated systems and data analytics to enhance operations, manage risks, and improve decision-making processes. Drawing results from over 1,000 research papers and categorizing them into 100 key studies specifics, this survey-based review underscores the critical role of big data in enabling predictive analytics, improving outcomes, and driving innovation across sectors. The review research work explores how industries utilize vast data volumes from diverse sources to derive actionable insights, forecast trends, and optimize processes. Key applications included in the review are from the domains of disease prediction and electronic health record management in healthcare , fraud detection and credit risk assessment in banking and finance, consumer behavior analysis and inventory optimization in retail, market trend forecasting in real estate, and disaster risk management in agriculture. The paper also discusses the challenges including data quality, scalability, and privacy paving way towards future directions of big data analytics, emphasizing the need for machine-independent solutions, data security, and ethical considerations in the evolving landscape of data-driven decision-making.
review_content:
Thank you for your contribution. Your manuscript has a serious flaw in the methodology. Please address the followings.
Please apply PRISMA and PICO approaches under a separate section called Methodology which outlines the scientific approach that you have taken for this study. You can cite the below papers to support the use of PRISMA and PICO approaches as the methodology.
Please see [Ref 1 to 6].
paper_title_zh: 大数据、人工智能和机器学习在当前数据转型时代自动化影响的协同综述
paper_abstract_zh: 自动化、大数据分析（BDA）、人工智能（AI）和机器学习（ML）的融合迎来了技术进步的新时代，重塑了全球各行业和社会。本综述研究深入探讨了这些技术的变革性影响，重点关注其在各个领域的应用。研究涵盖了六个关键领域：医疗保健、银行、金融、零售、房地产和农业，突显了这些行业如何利用自动化系统和数据分析来提升运营效率、管理风险并改进决策过程。通过分析超过1000篇研究论文，并将其归类为100项关键研究细节，这项基于调查的综述强调了大数据在实现预测分析、改善结果和推动各领域创新中的关键作用。综述研究探讨了各行业如何利用来自不同来源的大量数据来获取可操作的洞察、预测趋势和优化流程。综述中包括的关键应用领域有：医疗保健中的疾病预测和电子健康记录管理，银行和金融中的欺诈检测和信用风险评估，零售中的消费者行为分析和库存优化，房地产中的市场趋势预测，以及农业中的灾害风险管理。论文还讨论了包括数据质量、可扩展性和隐私在内的挑战，为大数据分析的未来方向铺平道路，强调在数据驱动决策不断发展的背景下，需要机器独立解决方案、数据安全和伦理考量。
review_content_zh:
感谢您的贡献。您的手稿在方法论上存在严重缺陷。请解决以下问题。
请在名为“方法论”的独立部分中应用PRISMA和PICO方法，概述您为本研究采取的科学方法。您可以引用以下论文来支持将PRISMA和PICO方法作为方法论的使用。
请参阅[参考文献1至6]。

reasons: You can cite the below papers to support the use of PRISMA and PICO approaches as the methodology.
Please see [Ref 1 to 6].
However, several conclusions lack robust evidence.
Claims about the transformative impact of AI/ML are overstated, as the review does not quantify outcomes (e.g., healthcare efficacy improvements) or critically assess real-world adoption.
Challenges like data quality and ethics are mentioned but not deeply explored, failing to link ethical concerns to sector-specific examples.
Recommendations for machine-independent solutions or future directions lack empirical backing from the reviewed studies.
There is no comparative analysis of AI/ML adoption barriers across sectors (e.g., healthcare vs. retail), undermining claims of cross-sector synergies.
The review superficially addresses limitations like data privacy, without synthesizing evidence on their prevalence or severity.
Overreliance on publication metrics (e.g., paper counts) conflates research activity with technological impact, ignoring study quality or practical implementation.
For instance, trends in healthcare publications (Figure 1) do not confirm whether AI tools are clinically effective or widely adopted.
The systematic review partially clarifies its rationale and objectives but requires refinement for greater precision.

To enhance clarity, the review should explicitly state its unique contribution (e.g., synthesizing cross-sector insights), structure objectives as distinct research questions, and define scope (e.g., peer-reviewed studies from 2018–2025).
Additionally, statistical protocols (e.g., variable selection, regression assumptions) are inadequately described.

The application of EFA and regression is unconventional for systematic reviews unless synthesizing primary data, and the manuscript does not clarify whether these methods were applied to the reviewed studies or a separate dataset.

To improve, the review should clarify the methodology (e.g., specify if statistical tests were applied to reviewed studies or original data), validate assumptions (e.g., residual analysis for regression), and contextualize results (e.g., discuss effect sizes like Cohen’s f²).
While the review’s intent is evident, sharper articulation of gaps, objectives, and methods would bolster its academic rigor and practical relevance.
Your manuscript has a serious flaw in the methodology.
Please apply PRISMA and PICO approaches under a separate section called Methodology which outlines the scientific approach that you have taken for this study.

paper_title: The challenges and mental health issues of academic trainees
paper_abstract:
In the last decade, mental health issues have come to the foreground in academia. Literature surrounding student mental health continues to grow as universities try to implement wellness services and study the mental health of their students. Studies vary greatly in terms of measurement tools, timeframe, sample demographics, as well as the chosen threshold of symptom severity for diagnosis. This review attempts to summarize, contextualize and synthesize papers that pertain to the challenges faced by academic trainees at the undergraduate, graduate and post-graduate level. 
The evidence for, and against, the common claim of increasing prevalence of mental health issues among students in recent years is discussed. While some studies support this claim, it is difficult to reach a definitive conclusion due to numerous confounding factors such as increased help-seeking behaviour, greater awareness of mental health issues and weak methodology. The prevalence of depression, anxiety, suicidal and self-injurious behaviour, distress and general mental illness diagnoses are discussed. Other issues known to influence mental health, such as sexual assault and bullying, are briefly addressed. 
Finally, select studies on a few wellness strategies that may improve mental health of trainees, such as mindfulness, are summarised, along with diverse recommendations for individual students, universities, and academia as a whole.
review_content:
The Introduction of the article points to the 2007 recession as a key event regarding the financial concerns of today’s students. I believe that updating this text to incorporate the Covid-19 related economic conditions will allow this article to remain relevant for a much longer time.

Some of the cited papers actually diagnosed patients with mental illness (such as depression or anxiety). Others were epidemiologic studies which relied on psychometric tools that provided evidence of symptomology but did not actually diagnose patients. It may be helpful to make this distinction in the current review when relevant. For example, the Garlow et al. paper (reference #50) repeatedly refers to “depressive symptoms” while the relevant section of the current review (end of page 5 and beginning of page 6) refers to mild, moderate, and severe depression—not symptomology. I would encourage the authors to use language consistent with the referenced papers.

Both Liu et al. (reference #111) and Kerr et al. (reference #116) described sexual minorities as gay/lesbian. Yet on page 14 the authors used the term “homosexual” in the phrase “There is evidence that homosexual students experience poorer mental health and higher suicidality compared to heterosexual students111,116.” This term is outdated and should be replaced in that paragraph and the following paragraph.
paper_title_zh: 学术培训生的挑战与心理健康问题
paper_abstract_zh:
在过去的十年中，心理健康问题在学术界逐渐凸显。随着大学试图实施健康服务并研究学生的心理健康状况，围绕学生心理健康问题的文献持续增长。研究在测量工具、时间框架、样本人口统计特征以及诊断症状严重程度的选定阈值方面存在很大差异。本综述试图总结、背景化并综合与本科生、研究生和博士后学术培训生所面临的挑战相关的论文。

本文讨论了近年来学生心理健康问题普遍增加这一常见说法的支持和反对证据。尽管一些研究支持这一说法，但由于诸如寻求帮助行为增加、对心理健康问题的认识提高以及研究方法薄弱等多种混杂因素的影响，难以得出明确结论。本文讨论了抑郁症、焦虑症、自杀和自伤行为、心理困扰和一般心理健康诊断的患病率。其他已知影响心理健康的因素，如性侵犯和欺凌，也简要提及。

最后，本文总结了关于可能改善培训生心理健康的一些健康策略（如正念）的选定研究，并提出了针对个体学生、大学以及整个学术界的多样化建议。
review_content_zh:
文章的引言指出，2007年的经济衰退是当今学生财务担忧的关键事件。我认为，更新文本以纳入与新冠疫情相关的经济状况，将使这篇文章在更长时间内保持相关性。

一些引用的论文实际上对病人进行了精神疾病（如抑郁症或焦虑症）的诊断。其他则是依赖心理测量工具的流行病学研究，这些工具提供了症状学的证据，但并未实际诊断病人。在当前综述中，在相关部分明确这一区分可能是有帮助的。例如，Garlow等人（参考文献#50）的论文反复提到“抑郁症状”，而当前综述的相关部分（第5页末尾和第6页开头）则提到轻度、中度和重度抑郁症——而非症状学。我建议作者使用与引用论文一致的语言。

Liu等人（参考文献#111）和Kerr等人（参考文献#116）都将性少数群体描述为同性恋/女同性恋。然而在第14页，作者使用了“同性恋”一词，在短语“有证据表明，同性恋学生与异性恋学生相比，心理健康状况较差，自杀风险更高111,116”中。这一术语已过时，应在该段落及下一段落中予以替换。

reasons: It is also important to note that the authors provide a strong overview of the data present for medical and health students as well.

paper_title: PERMA well-being and innovative work behaviour : A systematic literature review
paper_abstract:
Background: The purpose of this research is to examine at how the literature measures the relationship between PERMA (positive emotion, engagement, relationships, meaning, and accomplishments) well-being and innovative work behaviour (IWB). 
  
    Methods: This systematic literature review examines peer-reviewed English research papers published in 2012 that investigate the relationship between PERMA well-being and IWB. A total of 37 publications were discovered in 32 journals. 
  
    Results: A total of 220 articles were initially retrieved from the database. 37 studies out of 220 satisfied the inclusion criteria and were thoroughly examined. Our findings present a comprehensive overview of the types of PERMA well-being related to IWB in different countries and industries. Literature-based research approaches are also discussed. Research methods from the previous literature are also discussed. 
  
    Conclusions: This study is one of the first to conduct a systematic literature review (PRISMA) method on the relationship between PERMA well-being and IWB. This review suggests constructive future research directions.
review_content:
Thank you for providing the opportunity to review the manuscript titled "PERMA Well-being and Innovative Work Behaviour: A Systematic Literature Review." Overall, I found this manuscript to be of good quality. However, there is always room for improvement, and I would like to highlight the following points:
 1. In the abstract section, the authors did not mention the implications.
 2. The introduction lacks a proper rationale and research gap. It is essential to include the latest references in the rationale and research gap.
 3. The theoretical background discussed in the manuscript is insufficient. Add some relevant theories and literature to support the theoretical background.
 4. In the methods section, the authors mentioned the period from 1st November to 31 December. Why only this period? Is there any valid reason?
 5. The rest of the methodology section seems good.
 6. Implications should cover practical implications, theoretical implications, and managerial implications.
 7. Future recommendations and the conclusion are good.
paper_title_zh: PERMA幸福感和创新工作行为：系统文献综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：本研究旨在探讨文献如何衡量PERMA（积极情绪、投入、人际关系、意义和成就）幸福感和创新工作行为（IWB）之间的关系。

方法：本系统文献综述考察了2012年发表的、探讨PERMA幸福感和IWB之间关系的同行评审英文研究论文。共在32种期刊中发现了37篇相关出版物。

结果：从数据库中初步检索到220篇文章。其中37项研究符合纳入标准并进行了详细分析。我们的发现全面概述了不同国家和行业中与IWB相关的PERMA幸福感类型。还讨论了基于文献的研究方法以及先前文献中的研究方法。

结论：本研究是首次采用系统文献综述（PRISMA）方法探讨PERMA幸福感和IWB之间关系的少数研究之一。本综述提出了建设性的未来研究方向。
review_content_zh:
感谢提供机会审阅题为“PERMA幸福感和创新工作行为：系统文献综述”的手稿。总体而言，我认为这份手稿质量良好。然而，总有改进的空间，我想强调以下几点：
1. 在摘要部分，作者未提及研究意义。
2. 引言缺乏适当的理由和研究空白。在理由和研究空白中包含最新的参考文献至关重要。
3. 手稿中讨论的理论背景不足。添加一些相关的理论和文献以支持理论背景。
4. 在方法部分，作者提到的时间段为11月1日至12月31日。为什么仅限于此时间段？是否有任何合理的理由？
5. 其余的方法部分看起来不错。
6. 研究意义应涵盖实践意义、理论意义和管理意义。
7. 未来建议和结论部分良好。

reasons: The introduction lacks a proper rationale and research gap.
It is essential to include the latest references in the rationale and research gap.
The theoretical background discussed in the manuscript is insufficient.
Add some relevant theories and literature to support the theoretical background.

paper_title: Depression diagnosis using Artificial Intelligence: a systematic review
paper_abstract:
Background 
 Depression is a prevalent mental health disorder that affects a significant proportion of the global population, posing a major public health challenge. In recent years, the application of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to mental health diagnosis has garnered increasing attention. This systematic review aims to provide a comprehensive overview of the current state of research on AI-based approaches for depression diagnosis, identifying both advancements and gaps in the literature that can guide future studies. 
 
 
 Methods 
 A comprehensive search was conducted across leading research databases to identify relevant studies published up to July 2024. A combination of automated and manual filtering was employed to refine the initial set of records. Eligibility criteria were applied to ensure that only studies directly addressing the use of AI for depression diagnosis were included in the final analysis. 
 
 
 Results 
 The initial search yielded 1,179 records. Following a rigorous selection process, 145 studies were deemed eligible for inclusion in the review. These studies represent a diverse array of AI techniques and data sources, with a predominant focus on supervised learning algorithms. The most common data sources were social networks, followed by clinical data integrated with psychological assessments. 
 
 
 Conclusion 
 The results highlight the growing interest in leveraging AI for depression diagnosis, particularly through the use of supervised learning methods. Social network data has emerged as the most frequently used data source, though clinical data combined with validated psychological tests remains a key area of focus. Despite these advancements, several challenges persist, including data availability and quality, which present opportunities for future research to improve diagnostic accuracy and generalizability.
review_content:
1. The keyword combinations list is quite large. Please consider concising it by using a bulleted list or a text box for better readability.
 2. The literature review covers studies only up to July 2024. The authors should clarify why they did not extend it until January 2025 and specify the starting date of the literature collection.
 3. Figure 4 is missing percentage values and a mention of “Text Message”. Please update accordingly.
 4. To enhance the survey section, the authors could:
     1. List feature types from different sources.
     2. Include datasets (as listed in Reference 4 ).
     3. Discuss how validation techniques work. (This is only a suggestion.)
 5. I would like to recommend some references that could be valuable for citations as well as for your future work:
     1. Dalal S, et al., 2024 (Ref 1)
     2. Dalal S, et al., 2024 (Ref 2)
     3. Dalal S, et al., 2024 (Ref 3)
     4. Dalal S, et al., 2025 (Ref 4)
The references to my work are proposed as they provide insights directly relevant to the manuscript's discussion on AI-based depression detection. Specifically, my studies contribute to this domain by developing and analyzing performances of AI models for depression detection from social media data. The suggested references present neuro-symbolic techniques for explainable AI models for depression detection.
By including these citations, the manuscript will offer a more comprehensive review of the field, ensuring that important advancements are acknowledged.
paper_title_zh: 使用人工智能进行抑郁症诊断：系统综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景
抑郁症是一种常见的心理健康障碍，影响着全球相当大比例的人口，构成了重大的公共卫生挑战。近年来，人工智能（AI）在心理健康诊断中的应用引起了越来越多的关注。本系统综述旨在全面概述基于AI的抑郁症诊断方法的当前研究现状，识别文献中的进展和空白，以指导未来的研究。

方法
在领先的研究数据库中进行了全面的搜索，以识别截至2024年7月发表的相关研究。结合自动和手动过滤方法对初始记录集进行了精炼。应用了纳入标准，以确保只有直接探讨AI用于抑郁症诊断的研究被纳入最终分析。

结果
初步搜索产生了1,179条记录。经过严格的筛选过程，145项研究被认为符合纳入综述的条件。这些研究代表了多样化的AI技术和数据来源，主要集中在监督学习算法上。最常见的数据来源是社交网络，其次是与心理评估相结合的临床数据。

结论
结果表明，利用AI进行抑郁症诊断的兴趣日益增长，尤其是通过监督学习方法。社交网络数据已成为最频繁使用的数据来源，尽管与经过验证的心理测试相结合的临床数据仍是一个关键的关注领域。尽管取得了这些进展，但仍存在一些挑战，包括数据可用性和质量问题，这为未来研究提高诊断准确性和普适性提供了机会。
review_content_zh:

4. 为增强调查部分，作者可以：

5. 我推荐一些可能对引用及未来工作有价值的参考文献：
   1. Dalal S, 等，2024（参考文献1）

推荐我的工作作为参考文献，是因为它们直接相关于手稿中关于基于AI的抑郁症检测的讨论。具体而言，我的研究通过开发和分析从社交媒体数据中检测抑郁症的AI模型性能，为该领域做出贡献。所推荐的参考文献展示了用于可解释AI模型的神经符号技术，用于抑郁症检测。
通过包含这些引用，手稿将提供对该领域的更全面综述，确保重要进展得到认可。

paper_title: Dance/movement therapy as a holistic approach to diminish health discrepancies and promote wellness for people with schizophrenia: a review of the literature
paper_abstract: Individuals with a diagnosis of schizophrenia face a myriad of obstacles to wellness, beginning with diagnostic discrepancies including over- and misdiagnoses on the schizophrenia spectrum. People with schizophrenia experience profound amounts of stigmatization from the general population, their healthcare providers, and even themselves. Such stigmatization creates a barrier for wellness, poorer prognoses, and often limits adherence to physical and mental healthcare. Moreover, it can exacerbate the already stifling symptomatology of their diagnoses, including specific bodily-related symptomatology. Oftentimes, a diagnosis of schizophrenia disrupts one’s relationship with their body including a diminished mind-body connection, decreased interoceptive awareness, and thus unsuccessful intra- and interpersonal relationships. Some recent research suggests the use of mind-body therapies, however, if these practices are internalizing, they may not be appropriate for people with schizophrenia experiencing more acute symptomatology excluding them from treatment. Dance/movement therapy (DMT) is an embodied psychotherapeutic treatment option that can support participants in improving mind-body connection, social relationships, and self-regulatory skill development. Research on DMT has shown promising results for people with schizophrenia, however such research is limited and would benefit from increased studies that particularly measure the effects of DMT on mind-body connection and increased interoception for people with schizophrenia. Moreover, integrative and collaborative treatment models that couple DMT and biofeedback may further our understanding of the physiological and neurological effects of DMT interventions for people with schizophrenia and beyond. This review will examine the recent literature on health inequities for people with schizophrenia, their specific body-based disruptions and needs, and DMT as a promising treatment model, particularly when coupled with biofeedback.
review_content:
Overall, the article focuses on a timely issue of offering DMT to clients with schizophrenia, which is generally an under-investigated field.

In the Discussion, address clearly the unique contribution of DMT to this population, and how modality-specific change factors are reasoned to lead to outcome. In other words, based on the literature reviewed, it will be meaningful if you specify your own theory of change with respect to DMT for this population.

Also, the polyvagal theory has been criticized in the literature, and this has to be mentioned.

The abbreviation CATs should appear in the first time the term "creative arts therapies" - it appears under: "Contributing factors". This should be followed by CATs.

The Conclusion section can be more concise in highlighting the take home message of this review to strengthen the impact of the paper.
paper_title_zh: 舞蹈/动作疗法作为减少精神分裂症患者健康差异并促进其整体健康的整体方法：文献综述
paper_abstract_zh: 被诊断为精神分裂症的个体在追求健康的过程中面临着诸多障碍，首先是从诊断上的差异，包括精神分裂症谱系的过度诊断和误诊。精神分裂症患者从普通人群、他们的医疗保健提供者甚至自身经历着深重的污名化。这种污名化构成了健康的障碍，导致预后较差，并常常限制了对身体和心理健康保健的依从性。此外，它还可能加剧已经令人窒息的诊断症状，包括特定的与身体相关的症状。通常情况下，精神分裂症的诊断会破坏个体与其身体的关系，包括心身连接的减弱、内感觉意识的下降，从而导致内在和人际关系的失败。一些近期研究表明，心身疗法的使用可能有所帮助，然而，如果这些实践是内化的，它们可能不适合那些经历更急性症状的精神分裂症患者，从而将他们排除在治疗之外。舞蹈/动作治疗（DMT）是一种体现心理治疗的治疗选择，可以支持参与者改善心身连接、社会关系和自我调节技能的发展。关于DMT的研究对精神分裂症患者显示了有希望的结果，但此类研究有限，并将从更多特别测量DMT对精神分裂症患者心身连接和内感觉增加影响的研究中受益。此外，将DMT与生物反馈相结合的综合和协作治疗模式，可能进一步加深我们对DMT干预对精神分裂症患者及更广泛人群的生理和神经效应的理解。本综述将考察有关精神分裂症患者健康不平等、他们特定的基于身体的干扰和需求，以及DMT作为一种有前景的治疗模式（尤其是与生物反馈结合时）的近期文献。
review_content_zh:
总体而言，文章聚焦于一个及时的问题，即向精神分裂症患者提供舞蹈动作治疗（DMT），这是一个通常被较少研究的领域。

在讨论部分，清晰地阐述了DMT对这一人群的独特贡献，以及如何通过特定治疗方式的变化因素推理出结果。换句话说，基于所回顾的文献，如果你能具体说明你自己的关于DMT对这一人群的变化理论，将是有意义的。

此外，多迷走神经理论在文献中受到了批评，这一点必须提及。

“创造性艺术治疗”这一术语首次出现时应使用缩写CATs——它出现在“影响因素”下。此后应使用CATs。

结论部分可以更加简洁地突出本综述的要点，以增强论文的影响力。

reasons: Discussion – I feel that there needs to be more research cited, and more diversity of sources for the important discussion of mental health disparities.
Currently there is sole dependence on Metzl & Roberts (2014).
Also the discussion on stigmatization – other sources should be cited as there is dependence on Rossler (2016).
The abbreviation CATs should appear in the first time the term "creative arts therapies" - it appears under: "Contributing factors".
This should be followed by CATs.
The Conclusion section can be more concise in highlighting the take home message of this review to strengthen the impact of the paper.
Also, the polyvagal theory has been criticized in the literature, and this has to be mentioned.

paper_title: Tourette syndrome research highlights from 2016
paper_abstract: This article presents highlights chosen from research that appeared during 2016 on Tourette syndrome and other tic disorders. Selected articles felt to represent meaningful advances in the field are briefly summarized.
review_content:
The manuscript submitted by Dr. Black is a very thorough and comprehensive review of the recent literature on Tourette Syndrome. It is exceptionally well written and organized.

There is one error that needs to be corrected. In the following sentence, there is a missing word and simply a citation number.

"Another potentially useful approach to TS genetic research was illustrated by 28, who sequenced candidate genes suggested by previous research in order to identify potential functional variants linked to TS."

Other than this, I could find no errors or modifications that I would recommend before publishing this manuscript.
