paper_title: The predictive value of PRDM2 in solid tumor: a systematic review and meta-analysis
paper_abstract: Background. Many studies have reported the presence of Positive Regulatory/Su(var)3-9,Enhancer-of-zeste and Trithorax Domain 2 (PRDM2) downregulation in cancer. However, its potential as a diagnostic biomarker is still unclear. Hence, a systematic review and metaanalysis were conducted to address this issue.
review_content: Reviewer 2 (Anonymous) Basic reporting The predictive value of PRDM2 in solid tumor: a systematic review and meta-analysis by Tanadi et. al., is a nicely written review presenting a meta-analyses and investigating the potential of PRDM2 downregulation as a diagnostic biomarker in solid tumor. There are no grammatical errors and the writing is crisp. The figures and tables are of high quality. The review addresses important questions and findings pertaining to relationship between PRDM2 and solid tumors and I think it will be of general interest to a reader in cancer research. I have highlighted few important points, which, I believe, need to be addressed before the manuscript is deemed fit to be published in PeerJ. Experimental design Within aims and scope of the journal. Validity of the findings Meets standards. I have listed a few points in the next section which I believe need to be addressed before it makes it into PeerJ. Comments for the Author 1. Line 61-63: Can the authors give a new recent reference if it is available. Or is the 2018 reference the latest? According to World Health Organization, 2018 is the latest reference for global cancer statistics. American Cancer Association does have an estimate of new cancer cases (1,806,590 estimated new cases in 2020 or 4,950 new cases each day) and deaths (606,530 estimated cancer deaths in 2020 or 1,600 deaths each day) for 2020. However, this is only limited to United States of America alone. Since our research aim to address cancer in general, we decided that global statistics was best suited. 2. Line 66-68: Can the authors comment or add few lines on why the implementation in clinical setting is lacking? It would be of general interest to the reader. For example, highlight the bottlenecks that prevents biomarker discovery translating into clinical setting. Main reasons for the lack of clinical setting can be attributed to weak clinical performances such as low sensitivty, low specificity and low predictive values. An example of this is cancer antigen 19-9 (CA 19-9) which is used for diagnosis of pancreatic cancer. Although it has a high sensitivity (80%) and specificity (90%), it has a low positive predictive value (0.9%). Moreover, CA 19-9 also increases in other conditions such as biliary obstruction. Revised Introduction: Thus, cancer control… This could be attributed to weak clinical performances, such as low sensitivity, low specificity or low predictive values. Hence… 3. General question pertaining to the Introduction: What is rationale behind selection of PRDM2 for this study over other candidates. Also, cancer is a very broad term. Which specific types of cancer are associated with PRDM2? Or is it a universal biomarker for all cancers? PRDM2 plays a role in numerous developmental processes, such as driving cell division and controlling cell fate. These are closely associated with carcinogenesis. Furthermore, PRDM2 have also been reported in a vast number of malignancies, including those that exhibit high incidence and mortality globally (i.e bladder cancer, breast cancer, cervical cancer, colorectal cancer, endometrial cancer, esophageal squamous cell carcinoma, gastric carcinoma, hepatocellular carcinoma, lung cancer, pancreatic cancer, prostate cancer, T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia and thyroid carcinoma). In a meta analysis by Zhang et al., out of 22 genes that were found to be methylated in hepatocellular carcinoma, PRDM2 was one of the genes with the most significant results (P<0.00001), on par with the well-known APC and p16. Thus, we believe that PRDM2 might have an important role in malignancies. 4. Line 105-107: “Each step of the process was performed by two independent reviewers (AB and IPW), and any differences were solved through a discussion” – This line seems confusing and I think it’s better to omit this line from the manuscript because the search criteria has been elaborated in the first and third paragraphs of the sub section. Agreed. I have corrected this. 5. Line124-126, Line 154-155: Similar to the previous comment, the author contributions can be listed at the end of the manuscript. Listing them inside the actual text is not a preferred way. I have also corrected this. 6. Line173: Could the authors comment on when they mean by “studies being irrelevant”? We meant to say ineligbile, or in other words, unable to meet the inclusion criteria. Original Results: Using the search… Out of these 58 studies, 52 were excluded due to the studies being irrelevant, in vitro and/or in vivo, used unsuitable methods, written in non-English, or is a review. The remaining… Revised Results: Using variants of… Out of these 58 studies, 52 were excluded due to the studies being unable to meet the inclusion criteria (ineligible), in vitro and/or in vivo, used unsuitable methods, written in non-English, or is a review. The remaining six… 7. Line 181-184: Why is there so vast difference between the sample size and the control size? We believe that the vast difference between sample size and control size is because some of the studies did not obtain their sample and control from the same subject (i.e sample taken from group A while control taken from group B). This made obtaining the control (normal ovaries or normal adrenal cells) more difficult, especially if the patient is normal and has no indication for such invasive procedures. On the other hand, if for example a patient has lung cancer, while taking a sample of the lung cancer for diagnosis purposes, it is also possible to take samples of the adjacent normal cells as control. I have added this explanation in the discussion. Revised Discussion: Following these findings… In addition, there was also a vast difference between the sample and control size, whereby the sample size is much larger. We believe that this was because some of the studies did not obtain their sample and control from the same subject. This made acquirement of control samples, such as normal ovaries or normal adrenal cells, much more difficult when compared to pathological samples that are readily retrieved for examination. Although… 8. Line 274-277: The authors state that PRDM2 downregulation occurs in solid tumors. What do the authors mean by saying they could not find relationship between PRDM2 and several solid tumors such as neuroblastoma, breast cancers, melanoma, parathyroid adenoma and Merkel cell carcinoma? Is the downregulation? Or no expression of PRDM2 at all? Also, it would important to specify which type of solid tumors show downregulated PRDM2. We meant to say that we did not find any studies that investigated PRDM2 in neuroblastoma, breats cancer, melanoma, parathyroid adenoma and Merkel cell carcinoma (the solid tumors that were investigated in our 6 included studies did not include neuroblastoma, breast cancer, etc). It is not that there was no downregulation of PRDM2 or no expression of PRDM2 at all. I have tried rephrasing the statement to make it more understandable. I have also included the types of solid tumors that showed PRDM2 downregulation in the discussion. Original Discussion: In line with… However, compared to the findings of Sorrentino et al. (2018), we did not find the relationship between PRDM2 and several solid tumors such as neuroblastoma, breast cancers, melanoma, parathyroid adenoma and Merkel cell carcinoma. Another… Revised Discussion: In line with previous studies, our results demonstrated that PRDM2 downregulation occurs in ovarian cancer, esophageal squamous cell carcinoma, hepatoma and lung cancer. According to Sorrentino et al. (2018), PRDM2 downregulation has also been reported in neuroblastoma, breast cancers, melanoma, parathyroid adenoma and Merkel cell carcinoma. However, our included studies did not investigate those solid tumors. Another… 9. Line 286-297: Have the authors tried to analyze whether PRDM2 downregulation can be used as potential diagnostic biomarker in particular type of solid tumor i.e what happens when you don’t group all the solid tumors, what if you analyze solid tumors (for example breast, lung etc.) independently? No, we did not analyze the tumors separately since all of the studies included used different types of solid tumor (i.e there was no two studies or more that investigated PRDM2 downregulation in lung cancer). Hence, we believe that it is not meaningful to do so. In fact, the results of the individual studies presented on figure 6 are the results of analyzing the solid tumors separately. 10. Line 315-317: Are there no studies that have used RT-PCR (for example), to quantify the levels of PRDM2 in normal vs solid tumors? There are studies that used RT-PCR to quantify levels of PRDM2 in normal and solid tumors. However, these studies used the level of PRDM2 in the control as the ‘cut-off’. As long as the PRDM2 level is lower than the one expressed in control, it is considered downregulated. Meanwhile, all of the included studies investigated different types of solid tumor and therefore used different controls (i.e lung cancer vs normal lung tissue, esophageal cancer vs normal esophagus tissue). Thus, the levels of PRDM2 expressed in the different controls, which act as a cut-off, will be different and not standardized (i.e normal lung tissue = 0.6, normal esophageal tissue = 0.18).
paper_title_zh: PRDM2在实体肿瘤中的预测价值：系统综述与荟萃分析
paper_abstract_zh: 背景。许多研究已报道在癌症中存在阳性调节/Su(var)3-9、Enhancer-of-zeste和Trithorax结构域2（PRDM2）的下调现象。然而，其作为诊断生物标志物的潜力仍不明确。因此，进行了系统综述和荟萃分析以解决这一问题。
review_content_zh:
审稿人2（匿名）

基本报告

Tanadi等人撰写的《PRDM2在实体肿瘤中的预测价值：系统综述与荟萃分析》是一篇写得很好的综述，展示了荟萃分析，并探讨了PRDM2下调作为实体肿瘤诊断生物标志物的潜力。文章没有语法错误，文笔简洁。图表质量高。该综述涉及了PRDM2与实体肿瘤之间关系的重要问题和发现，我认为这对癌症研究领域的读者具有普遍兴趣。我已highlight了一些重要观点，我认为在稿件被认为适合在PeerJ发表之前，这些问题需要得到解决。

实验设计

在期刊的目标和范围内。发现的有效性符合标准。我在下一节中列出了一些我认为在文章进入PeerJ之前需要解决的问题。

对作者的意见

1. 第61-63行：作者能否提供一个新的近期参考文献（如果有的话）？还是2018年的参考文献是最新的？根据世界卫生组织的数据，2018年是全球癌症统计数据的最新参考文献。美国癌症协会确实有2020年新癌症病例（估计为1,806,590例，或每天4,950例）和死亡（估计2020年癌症死亡606,530例，或每天1,600例）的估计。然而，这仅限于美国。由于我们的研究目标是普遍的癌症，我们决定全球统计数据最为合适。

2. 第66-68行：作者能否评论或增加几行关于为什么在临床应用中缺乏实施的原因？这对读者具有普遍兴趣。例如，突出那些阻碍生物标志物发现转化为临床应用的瓶颈。缺乏临床应用的主要原因可归因于较弱的临床表现，如低敏感性、低特异性和低预测值。一个例子是用于胰腺癌诊断的癌抗原19-9（CA 19-9）。尽管其敏感性（80%）和特异性（90%）较高，但其阳性预测值较低（0.9%）。此外，CA 19-9在其他情况下也会增加，如胆道梗阻。修订后的引言：因此，癌症控制……这可能是由于较弱的临床表现，如低敏感性、低特异性或低预测值。因此……

3. 关于引言的一般问题：选择PRDM2作为本研究的理由是什么，而不是其他候选者？此外，癌症是一个非常广泛的概念。哪些特定类型的癌症与PRDM2相关？或者它是一种适用于所有癌症的通用生物标志物？PRDM2在许多发育过程中发挥作用，如驱动细胞分裂和控制细胞命运。这些与癌变密切相关。 此外，PRDM2在大量恶性肿瘤中也有报道，包括那些在全球范围内具有高发病率和死亡率的肿瘤（即膀胱癌、乳腺癌、宫颈癌、结直肠癌、子宫内膜癌、食管鳞状细胞癌、胃癌、肝细胞癌、肺癌、胰腺癌、前列腺癌、T细胞前淋巴细胞白血病和甲状腺癌）。在张等人进行的荟萃分析中，在肝细胞癌中发现有22个基因被甲基化，PRDM2是结果最显著的基因之一（P<0.00001），与众所周知的APC和p16相当。因此，我们认为PRDM2在恶性肿瘤中可能具有重要作用。

4. 第105-107行：“每个步骤由两名独立评审员（AB和IPW）进行，任何差异通过讨论解决”——这一行似乎有些混乱，我认为最好从手稿中删除这一行，因为搜索标准已在小节的第1段和第3段中详细说明。同意。我已经进行了更正。

5. 第124-126行，第154-155行：与前一条评论类似，作者贡献可以在手稿末尾列出。在正文内列出并不是首选方式。我也已经进行了更正。

6. 第173行：作者能否解释一下“研究不相关”的意思？我们是指不符合条件，换句话说，无法满足纳入标准。原始结果：使用搜索……在这58项研究中，52项因研究不相关、体外和/或体内、使用不合适的方法、非英文撰写或为综述而被排除。剩余的……修订结果：使用变体……在这58项研究中，52项因研究无法满足纳入标准（不符合条件）、体外和/或体内、使用不合适的方法、非英文撰写或为综述而被排除。剩余的六项……

7. 第181-184行：样本量和对照组量之间为何存在如此大的差异？我们认为样本量和对照组量之间存在巨大差异的原因是，一些研究并未从同一受试者中获取样本和对照组（即样本来自A组而对照组来自B组）。这使得获取对照组（正常卵巢或正常肾上腺细胞）更加困难，尤其是如果患者正常且无此类侵入性手术的指征。另一方面，例如，如果患者患有肺癌，在进行诊断性取样时，也可以取相邻的正常细胞作为对照组。我已在讨论中添加了这一解释。修订后的讨论：根据这些发现……此外，样本和对照组量之间也存在巨大差异，其中样本量要大得多。 我们认为这是因为一些研究并未从同一受试者中获取样本和对照。这使得获取对照样本（如正常卵巢或正常肾上腺细胞）相较于容易获取的病理样本而言，变得更加困难。尽管…… 8. 第274-277行：作者指出PRDM2下调发生在实体瘤中。作者说他们无法找到PRDM2与神经母细胞瘤、乳腺癌、黑色素瘤、甲状旁腺腺瘤和默克尔细胞癌等几种实体瘤之间的关系，这是什么意思？是PRDM2的下调吗？还是PRDM2完全没有表达？此外，明确哪种类型的实体瘤显示PRDM2下调也很重要。我们想说的是，我们没有找到任何研究调查PRDM2在神经母细胞瘤、乳腺癌、黑色素瘤、甲状旁腺腺瘤和默克尔细胞癌中的情况（我们纳入的6项研究中调查的实体瘤并未包括神经母细胞瘤、乳腺癌等）。并不是说没有PRDM2的下调或完全没有PRDM2的表达。我尝试重新措辞以使表述更易理解。我也在讨论中包括了显示PRDM2下调的实体瘤类型。原始讨论：与……一致。然而，与Sorrentino等人（2018）的研究结果相比，我们未发现PRDM2与神经母细胞瘤、乳腺癌、黑色素瘤、甲状旁腺腺瘤和默克尔细胞癌等几种实体瘤之间的关系。另一个……修订后的讨论：与先前研究一致，我们的结果显示PRDM2下调发生在卵巢癌、食管鳞状细胞癌、肝细胞癌和肺癌中。根据Sorrentino等人（2018）的研究，PRDM2下调也在神经母细胞瘤、乳腺癌、黑色素瘤、甲状旁腺腺瘤和默克尔细胞癌中有报道。然而，我们纳入的研究并未调查这些实体瘤。另一个…… 9. 第286-297行：作者是否尝试分析PRDM2下调是否可以作为特定类型实体瘤的潜在诊断生物标志物，即如果不将所有实体瘤分组，而是独立分析实体瘤（例如乳腺癌、肺癌等）会发生什么？没有，我们并未单独分析肿瘤，因为所有纳入的研究使用了不同类型的实体瘤（即没有两项或更多研究调查肺癌中的PRDM2下调）。因此，我们认为这样做没有意义。实际上，图6中展示的各单项研究结果是单独分析实体瘤的结果。 10. 第315-317行：是否有研究使用RT-PCR（例如）来量化正常与实体瘤中PRDM2的水平？有研究使用RT-PCR来量化正常和实体瘤中PRDM2的水平。 然而，这些研究使用了对照组中的PRDM2水平作为“临界值”。只要PRDM2水平低于对照组中的表达水平，就被认为是下调的。同时，所有纳入的研究调查了不同类型的实体瘤，因此使用了不同的对照组（即肺癌与正常肺组织，食管癌与正常食管组织）。因此，不同对照组中表达的PRDM2水平作为临界值，将会不同且未标准化（即正常肺组织=0.6，正常食管组织=0.18）。

paper_title: Emerging pneumococcal serotypes in Iraq: scope for improved vaccine development
paper_abstract: Pneumococcal disease is a global public health concern as it affects the young, aged and the immunocompromised. The development of pneumococcal vaccines and their incorporation in the immunization programs has helped to reduce the global burden of disease. However, serotype replacement and the emergence of non-vaccine serotypes as well as the persistence of a few vaccine serotypes underscores the need for development of new and effective vaccines against such pneumococcal serotypes. In the Middle East, places of religious mass gatherings are a hotspot for disease transmission in addition to the global risk factors. Therefore, the periodic surveillance of pneumococcal serotypes circulating in the region to determine the effectiveness of existing prevention strategies and develop improved vaccines is warranted. Currently, there is a lack of serotype prevalence data for Iraq due to inadequate surveillance in the region. Thus, this review aims to determine the pneumococcal serotypes circulating in Iraq which may help in the development and introduction of improved pneumococcal vaccines in the country.
review_content:
The authors sought to describe the Streptococcus pneumoniae serotype landscape in Iraq where there is inadequate surveillance for this pathogen. Published data from Iraq's neighbors is extensively used. Citations are properly done for all data used in the article. Two suggestions for the authors to consider:
 1. I would strengthen the conclusion by stating that the serotypes in Iraq are likely to be similar to those circulating in the neighboring countries due to similarities including ecological conditions, cultural practices (like mass gatherings during worship).
 2. Is burden data available for any of Iraq's neighbors (Iran, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia etc.). If so, how does that compare with Iraq's IPD incidence of 0.62/100,000?
Minor issue:
The opening statement in the Introduction could be rewritten as follows;
"....for devastating morbidity and mortality among children below five years of age, adolescents, adults above 60 years of age, the immunocompromised population...".
paper_title_zh: 伊拉克新兴肺炎球菌血清型：改进疫苗开发的范围
paper_abstract_zh: 肺炎球菌疾病是全球公共卫生关注的问题，因为它影响年轻人、老年人和免疫功能低下者。肺炎球菌疫苗的研发及其纳入免疫接种计划已帮助减轻了全球疾病负担。然而，血清型替换、非疫苗血清型的出现以及少数疫苗血清型的持续存在，凸显了开发针对这些肺炎球菌血清型的新型有效疫苗的必要性。在中东地区，宗教大规模集会地点除了全球风险因素外，也是疾病传播的热点。因此，定期监测该地区流行的肺炎球菌血清型，以确定现有预防策略的有效性并开发改进的疫苗是必要的。目前，由于该地区监测不足，伊拉克缺乏血清型流行数据。因此，本综述旨在确定伊拉克流行的肺炎球菌血清型，这可能有助于该国改进肺炎球菌疫苗的研发和引入。
review_content_zh:
作者旨在描述伊拉克肺炎链球菌血清型的分布情况，该国对此病原体的监测不足。文章广泛使用了伊拉克邻国的已发表数据。所有在文章中使用的数据都正确引用了。对作者有两点建议：

paper_title: The perspectives of patients and their caregivers on self-management interventions for chronic conditions: a protocol for a mixed-methods overview
paper_abstract:
Introduction : Self-management (SM) interventions are complex interventions and one of the main components of high-quality chronic disease care for which the incorporation of the perspectives of patients and their informal caregivers is crucial. We aim to identify, appraise and synthesise the evidence exploring patients’ and caregivers’ perspectives on SM interventions. More precisely, we aim to 1) describe how they value the importance of outcomes of SM interventions, and 2) identify the factors that might impact on acceptability and feasibility of SM interventions based on their preferences and experiences. 
 Methods and analysis : We will conduct four mixed-methods overviews as part of COMPAR-EU, a European Union (EU) funded project aimed to identify the most effective and cost-effective SM interventions for chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), heart failure (HF), obesity, and type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM). We will search in MEDLINE, CINAHL, and PsycINFO for systematic reviews of studies addressing patients’ preferences on outcomes, or their experiences with SM alongside their disease trajectory or with SM interventions, published in English. Selection of studies and data extraction will be conducted in pairs. We will assess the overlap of studies and methodological quality. We will follow a three-step synthesis process: 1) narrative synthesis for quantitative evidence, 2) thematic synthesis for qualitative evidence, and 3) integration of findings in the interpretation phase. Additionally, we will consult on the relevance of findings with patients and their caregivers. 
 Systematic review registration : PROSPERO CRD42019117867
review_content:
The article presents the study protocol for a systematic review of the reviews dealing with 4 main chronic diseases.

The methods that this group of authors intend to apply are innovative and comprehensive.

The only minor suggestions regard the language proofreading (for instance see the use of connects as a noun) and if the authors expect to publish a review per disease or a unique comprehensive review also comparing the 4 (potentially overlapping) diseases.
paper_title_zh: 慢性病自我管理干预措施中患者及其照护者视角的混合方法综述方案
paper_abstract_zh:
引言：自我管理（SM）干预是复杂干预措施之一，也是高质量慢性病护理的主要组成部分，其中融入患者及其非正式照顾者的观点至关重要。我们旨在识别、评估和综合探讨患者及其照顾者对SM干预观点的证据。更具体地说，我们旨在1）描述他们如何评估SM干预结果的重要性，以及2）基于他们的偏好和经验，识别可能影响SM干预可接受性和可行性的因素。

方法和分析：我们将作为COMPAR-EU项目的一部分进行四项混合方法综述，该项目是由欧洲联盟（EU）资助的，旨在识别针对慢性阻塞性肺病（COPD）、心力衰竭（HF）、肥胖和2型糖尿病（T2DM）最有效且最具成本效益的SM干预措施。我们将在MEDLINE、CINAHL和PsycINFO中搜索以英语发表的系统性综述，这些综述涉及患者对结果的偏好，或他们在疾病轨迹中或与SM干预相关的SM经验。研究选择和数据提取将由双人进行。我们将评估研究的重叠和方法学质量。我们将遵循三步综合过程：1）定量证据的叙述性综合，2）定性证据的主题综合，以及3）在解释阶段整合发现。此外，我们将与患者及其照顾者就发现的相关性进行咨询。

paper_title: Prevalence and risk factors of posttraumatic stress disorder in COVID-19
paper_abstract: Posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD) has a prevalence of 2%–5% in the general population. COVID-19 is regarded as a traumatic agent that can increase the prevalence of this disorder to up to 30%. A documentary review was thus conducted, which included 13 studies on the presence of PTSD in patients who have survived COVID-19 infection and the possible associated factors. Female and young age, as well as other aspects associated with economic losses or living alone, could influence the appearance of this psychological sequela. A preventive mental healthcare program could be implemented during infection in such patients with COVID-19 who show the characteristics described in most studies.
review_content: The article is a documentary review of studies on the prevalence of PTSD in patients who have survived COVID-19 infection. In addition to the prevalence, it also provided more context by discussing risk factors that predispose patients to PTSD. The method was adequately described and seems to be methodologically fine, however, the review did not sufficiently discuss protective factors of PTSD or factors that help patients cope with PSTD resulting from COVID-19. In particular, discussing Posttraumatic Growth (PTG) after COVID-19 will provide more practicable insights into how patients progress from PTSD to normal functioning after encounter with COVID-19.

paper_title: Nicotine products relative risk assessment: an updated systematic review and meta-analysis
paper_abstract:
Background: The nicotine products relative risk assessment estimates the relative risk of tobacco-related diseases due to use of 15 nicotine products. This update adds new data to the original analysis and creates separate categories for United States and rest of world varieties of smokeless tobacco, as well as bidi cigarettes. 
 Methods: The PubMed®, MEDLINE and Clinicaltrials.gov databases were searched systematically. The study lists were exported, screened at the title, abstract and full-text level according to pre-defined inclusion/exclusion criteria. The study quality was assessed, and risk of bias was accounted for in the screening criteria. The extracted data was synthesized into a toxin emissions/content analysis for 12 Group 1 carcinogens, used to estimate lifetime cancer risk, and epidemiological meta-analysis of over 40 tobacco-related diseases. The two analyses were integrated into a combined risk score for each nicotine product, weighted by the risk of bias due to missing data, and incorporated into the relative risk spectrum. 
 Results:  
In this update, 70 new studies were added to the synthesis, making a total of 123 studies included. All combustible tobacco products score between 40 and 100, with bidis and smokeless (rest of world) also in this range. All other products have a combined risk score of 10 or less, including U.S. chewing tobacco, U.S. dipping tobacco, snus, heat-not-burn tobacco, electronic cigarettes, non-tobacco pouches and nicotine replacement therapy. 
 Discussion: Consistent with previous studies, we define a group of high-risk nicotine products, scoring between 40 and 100 on the spectrum, and reduced risk nicotine products, scoring less than 10. Limitations of this study include the potential for bias due to missing data, the heterogeneity of the data included in the relative risk hierarchy synthesis, and the assumed consumption levels.
review_content: This study adds to the growing literature that vaping [e-cigarettes] are an important advance in the treatment of tobacco related health harms and in the prevention of these in future. Tobacco use leads to about 7 million premature deaths per year and is estimated to kill over a billion people globally this century. Initial estimates 1,2 suggested that vaping is 25 x less harmful than cigarettes which was incorporated into UK tobacco harm reduction policy 3. So if the world switched fully to it there would be a saving nearly a billion deaths, then this would be the greatest health impact of any intervention in history. But there is resistance to the concept of harm reduction in tobacco dependence with most governments and medical authorities advocating abstinence – even though this approach has clearly failed – especially in the developing world. A powerful anti-vaping lobby has developed and influenced decision-makers against its use in harm reduction claiming that it could be a harmful as tobacco. They have disseminated misinformation about the harms of vaping that in just a few years have significantly changed smokers perception of its harms and so reduced its use. This paper provides a more recent and more detailed analysis of relative harms that confirms the original 25x less harmful estimate and so should give new impetus to the vaping approach.
paper_title_zh: 尼古丁产品相对风险评估：一项更新的系统综述与荟萃分析
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：尼古丁产品相对风险评估估计了由于使用15种尼古丁产品导致的烟草相关疾病的相对风险。此次更新在原始分析中添加了新数据，并为美国和其他地区的无烟烟草以及比迪香烟创建了单独的分类。

方法：系统检索了PubMed®、MEDLINE和Clinicaltrials.gov数据库。导出研究列表，根据预先定义的纳入/排除标准在标题、摘要和全文层面进行筛选。评估研究质量，并在筛选标准中考虑偏倚风险。提取的数据被综合成12种1类致癌物的毒素排放/含量分析，用于估计终身癌症风险，以及对40多种烟草相关疾病的流行病学荟萃分析。将这两种分析整合为每种尼古丁产品的综合风险评分，并根据缺失数据的偏倚风险进行加权，纳入相对风险谱。

结果：
在此更新中，综合分析中新增了70项研究，总计纳入123项研究。所有可燃烟草产品的评分在40到100之间，比迪烟和无烟烟草（其他地区）也在这一范围内。其他所有产品的综合风险评分均不超过10，包括美国咀嚼烟草、美国鼻烟烟草、口含烟、加热不燃烧烟草、电子烟、非烟草袋和尼古丁替代疗法。

讨论：与以往研究一致，我们定义了一组高风险尼古丁产品，在风险谱上评分介于40到100之间，以及低风险尼古丁产品，评分低于10。本研究的局限性包括因缺失数据导致的潜在偏倚、纳入相对风险层级综合的数据异质性，以及假设的消耗水平。
review_content_zh: 本研究为日益增长的文献增添了新的内容，表明电子烟（电子香烟）在治疗烟草相关健康危害和预防未来这些危害方面是一个重要的进步。烟草使用每年导致约700万人过早死亡，预计本世纪全球将有超过10亿人因此死亡。最初的估计1,2表明，电子烟的危害比香烟小25倍，这一观点被纳入了英国的烟草减害政策3。因此，如果全世界完全转向电子烟，将能挽救近10亿人的生命，这将是历史上任何干预措施的最大健康影响。然而，在烟草依赖的减害概念上存在阻力，大多数政府和医疗权威机构主张禁欲——尽管这种方法显然已经失败，尤其是在发展中国家。一个强大的反电子烟游说团体已经形成，并影响了决策者，反对在减害中使用电子烟，声称其可能和烟草一样有害。他们散布了关于电子烟危害的虚假信息，在短短几年内显著改变了吸烟者对其危害的认知，从而减少了电子烟的使用。本文提供了更近期、更详细的相关危害分析，确认了最初的25倍减害估计，因此应给予电子烟方法新的动力。

reasons: This study adds to the growing literature that vaping [e-cigarettes] are an important advance in the treatment of tobacco related health harms and in the prevention of these in future.
This paper provides a more recent and more detailed analysis of relative harms that confirms the original 25x less harmful estimate and so should give new impetus to the vaping approach.

paper_title: Photoperiodic and circadian bifurcation theories of depression and mania
paper_abstract: Seasonal effects on mood have been observed throughout much of human history.  Seasonal changes in animals and plants are largely mediated through the changing photoperiod (i.e., the photophase or duration of daylight).  We review that in mammals, daylight specifically regulates SCN (suprachiasmatic nucleus) circadian organization and its control of melatonin secretion.  The timing of melatonin secretion interacts with gene transcription in the pituitary pars tuberalis to modulate production of TSH (thyrotropin), hypothalamic T3 (triiodothyronine), and tuberalin peptides which modulate pituitary production of regulatory gonadotropins and other hormones.  Pituitary hormones largely mediate seasonal physiologic and behavioral variations.  As a result of long winter nights or inadequate illumination, we propose that delayed morning offset of nocturnal melatonin secretion, suppressing pars tuberalis function, could be the main cause for winter depression and even cause depressions at other times of year.  Irregularities of circadian sleep timing and thyroid homeostasis contribute to depression.  Bright light and sleep restriction are antidepressant and conversely, sometimes trigger mania.  We propose that internal desynchronization or bifurcation of SCN circadian rhythms may underlie rapid-cycling manic-depressive disorders and perhaps most mania.  Much further research will be needed to add substance to these theories.
review_content: This comprehensive review of seasonality, mood, circadian regulation, and their inter-relatedness is of great value for the creation of new hypotheses in the field and gives impetus for a number of new studies. The title is appropriate even though the paper touches on a number of additional subjects such as separate morningness and eveningness oscillators and the regulation of thyroid function in relation to mood. The abstract covers the content of the paper. Many theories are presented and perhaps the red thread is sometimes a little difficult to follow in the narrative. Of the many ideas presented the hypothesis regarding separate oscillators for morningness and eveningness is of immediate interest. It should be investigated how this phenomenon is reflected in the rating scales used to assess chronotype and time-dependent preferences. Do we need separate scales for morningness and eveningness? In the quest for understanding the higher prevalence of suicide in springtime authors do not include the widely accepted psychological concept that for a person with persistent depression, the contrast of seeing other persons elation and increased energy in springtime, could contribute to the phenomenon. This raises a more general point: why is the interaction or cascading effect between cognition (thought and emotion) and circadian physiology not included in our understanding of the regulation of mood? A few critical points: Authors uses the word sleep restriction for sleep deprivation (wake therapy). Sleep restriction in the sense of a continuous reduction in sleep time does not induce an antidepressant effect. The effect of sleep deprivation depends on sleep abstinence for a substantial part or the whole of a single night AND the timing of recovery sleep days. Also the effect of sleep deprivation probably relates to the relation between sleep and the activity of the raphe nuclei on the brain-stem and this should be mentioned. Figure 1 is rather busy and could be simplified to enhance readability. On page 5 the effect of darkness as an antimanic treatment is defined as “effective”. At this point we should probably regard the evidence of dark therapy, however interesting, as preliminary (and difficult to carry out). The statement, also on page 5, that the effect of sleep deprivation is partly caused by light, is not quite substantiated by the one reference dealing with this issue. Finally, references should be checked for content in relation to their relation to issues discussed in the paper with a more critical attention to the quality of the studies (case reports and pilot studies).
paper_title_zh: 光周期与昼夜节律分岔理论的抑郁症与躁狂症研究
paper_abstract_zh: 季节性对情绪的影响在人类历史的很大一部分中已被观察到。动植物的季节性变化主要通过光周期的变化（即光相或日照时长）来介导。我们回顾了在哺乳动物中，日光特异性地调节SCN（视交叉上核）的昼夜节律组织及其对褪黑素分泌的控制。褪黑素分泌的时间与垂体结节部的基因转录相互作用，以调节TSH（促甲状腺激素）、下丘脑T3（三碘甲状腺原氨酸）和结节肽的产生，这些肽类调节垂体产生调节性促性腺激素和其他激素。垂体激素在很大程度上介导季节性生理和行为变化。由于漫长的冬夜或光照不足，我们提出夜间褪黑素分泌的早晨偏移延迟，抑制结节部功能，可能是冬季抑郁症甚至其他时间抑郁症的主要原因。昼夜节律睡眠时相和甲状腺稳态的异常会导致抑郁。明亮光线和睡眠限制具有抗抑郁作用，反之，有时会引发躁狂。我们提出，内部去同步化或SCN昼夜节律的分支可能是快速循环性躁郁症甚至大多数躁狂的基础。需要更多的研究来充实这些理论。
review_content_zh: 这篇关于季节性、情绪、昼夜节律及其相互关系的综合性综述，对于该领域新假设的创建具有重要价值，并推动了多项新研究的开展。标题是恰当的，尽管论文涉及了一些额外主题，如独立的早晨型和夜晚型振荡器以及甲状腺功能与情绪的调节。摘要涵盖了论文的内容。提出了许多理论，或许在叙述中有时难以追踪到主线。在众多观点中，关于独立的早晨型和夜晚型振荡器的假设立即引起了兴趣。应研究这一现象在用于评估昼夜节律类型和时间依赖性偏好的评分量表中的反映。我们需要为早晨型和夜晚型分别设立不同的量表吗？在探究春季自杀率较高的问题时，作者未包括一个广泛接受的心理概念，即对于持续抑郁的人来说，看到其他人在春季的愉悦和能量增加的对比，可能对这一现象有所贡献。这引发了一个更普遍的问题：为什么认知（思维和情感）与昼夜生理之间的相互作用或级联效应未包含在我们对情绪调节的理解中？几点批评意见：作者使用“睡眠限制”一词来指代“睡眠剥夺”（觉醒疗法）。连续减少睡眠时间的睡眠限制并不会产生抗抑郁效果。睡眠剥夺的效果取决于整夜或大部分时间的睡眠禁绝以及恢复睡眠的时间安排。此外，睡眠剥夺的效果可能与睡眠和脑干中缝核活动的关联有关，这一点应提及。图1较为复杂，可以简化以提高可读性。在第5页，黑暗作为抗躁狂治疗的效果被定义为“有效”。在这一点上，我们或许应将暗疗的证据视为初步的（且难以实施）。同样在第5页，关于睡眠剥夺效果部分由光照引起的说法，并未完全由涉及此问题的单一参考文献所证实。最后，应更批判性地关注研究质量（案例报告和初步研究），检查参考文献内容与论文讨论问题的相关性。

The effect of sleep deprivation depends on sleep abstinence for a substantial part or the whole of a single night AND the timing of recovery sleep days.
The statement, also on page 5, that the effect of sleep deprivation is partly caused by light, is not quite substantiated by the one reference dealing with this issue.
Authors uses the word sleep restriction for sleep deprivation (wake therapy).
Many theories are presented and perhaps the red thread is sometimes a little difficult to follow in the narrative.

The title is appropriate even though the paper touches on a number of additional subjects such as separate morningness and eveningness oscillators and the regulation of thyroid function in relation to mood.
The abstract covers the content of the paper.

paper_title: Conceptual review of consumer satisfaction theories with expectation-confirmation and disconfirmation paradigm for business sustainable growth and decision making
paper_abstract:
Consumer satisfaction is an outcome of business marketing activities, bridging the buying and usage phases with subsequent consequences such as attitude changes, recurring purchases, and brand loyalty. Most studies have utilized variations of the disconfirmation paradigm, which posits that satisfaction is influenced by the degree and type of disconfirmation experienced and initial expectations. Despite the importance of satisfaction, there remains a paucity of evidence on the cause and effect leading to expectation-confirmation and disconfirmation paradigm. 
 This paper explores the reasons and the key factors in the perspectives of the relevant literature and aims to identify the intention of confirmation and disconfirmation in satisfaction theories. This conceptual paper also suggests various critical analyses based on the arguments for and against the paradigm in customer satisfaction. Consequently, the paper seeks to examine existing gaps in the literature regarding customer satisfaction theories for business sustainability and decision making, which may need to be more concise in the satisfaction generation process.
review_content:
Review comments
While the article provides a valuable theoretical perspective on consumer satisfaction and its connection to business sustainability, it lacks empirical evidence, practical applicability, and novel contributions. Addressing these concerns and providing a clearer link between theory and practice would significantly enhance its relevance and impact.
  * The article is purely conceptual, which limits its practical application and relevance to real-world business scenarios. Include empirical validation of the theories discussed by presenting case studies, surveys, or meta-analyses to enhance the paper's applicability.
  * The paper revisits well-established paradigms without presenting significant advancements or novel insights. paper_title: A snapshot of the ongoing clinical research on COVID-19
paper_abstract:
The pandemic of coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) presents an unprecedented challenge to rapidly develop new diagnostic, preventive and therapeutic strategies. Currently, thousands of new COVID-19 patients are quickly enrolled in clinical studies. We aimed to investigate the characteristics of the COVID-19 studies registered in ClinicalTrials.gov and report the extent to which they have incorporated features that are desirable for generating high-quality evidence. 
On April 28, 2020, a total of 945 studies on COVID-19 have been registered in ClinicalTrials.gov; 586 studies are interventional (62.0%), the most frequent allocation scheme is the parallel group assignment (437; 74.6%), they are open-label and the most common primary purpose is the research on treatment. 
Too many of the ongoing interventional studies have a small expected sample size and may not generate credible evidence at completion. This might lead to a delayed recognition of effective therapies that are urgently needed, and a waste of time and resources. In the COVID-19 pandemic era, it is crucial that the adoption of new diagnostic, preventive and therapeutic strategies is based upon evidence coming from well-designed, adequately powered and carefully conducted clinical trials.
review_content:
This brief report is a survey of the current COVID-19 clinical research landscape. The number of clinical studies on COVID-19 is rapidly growing and it is important the investigation of whether these studies are incorporating features that are desirable for generating high-quality evidence.
This survey performed this investigation and found that too many of the ongoing interventional studies have a small expected sample size. This might lead to delayed recognition of effective therapies and a waste of time and resources. This important evidence should guide the design of any future clinical study on COVID-19 and the decision of any funding body as well as the approval of any bioethics committee. For this reason, I consider this brief report important for the scientific community.
There are a few minor suggestions for the authors:
  * Table 1: The presentation of the studies' characteristics will be improved if they are presented separately for interventional and observational studies (particularly for the intervention type and expected study size). In this way, the table will provide more information about the studies' characteristics for each study type (interventional and observational).
  * Table 1: It will be useful to report the type of randomization (such as blocking and block size).
paper_title_zh: COVID-19正在进行临床研究的快照
paper_abstract_zh:

paper_title: A brief review of simulated Kalman Filter Algorithm – variants and applications
paper_abstract: Simulated Kalman Filter (SKF) solves optimization problems by finding the estimate of the optimum solution. As a multi-agent algorithm, every agent in the population acts as a Kalman filter by using a standard Kalman filter framework, which includes a simulated measurement process and a best-so-far solution as a reference. This paper presented an overview of the research progress in SKF from the day it was introduced until the present day, discussing the progress, improvements, modifications, and applications of SKF. The fundamental and standard algorithm were first introduced. Then, the work on the algorithm improvements was surveyed. Finally, the remaining unresolved problems and some directions of SKF research were discussed. We reviewed 57 SKF papers. 16 of them on fundamental improvements, 9 on extension of the algorithm to discrete problems and 25 on their applications. Researchers have worked on ideas to improve exploration capability to prevent premature convergence by trying prediction operators, opposition-based learning, and different iteration strategies. There were also attempts to hybridize SKF with other famous algorithms such as Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Gravitational Search Algorithm (GSA), and Sine Cosine Algorithm (SCA) to improve its performance. Lastly, a single-agent variant of SKF and a multi-objective SKF were introduced. SKF algorithms and its variants have been implemented in at least nine areas of applications: drill path optimization, airport gate allocation problem (AGAP), assembly sequence planning (ASP), system identification, feature selection, image template matching, controller tuning, wireless sensor network, and engineering design problem. The literature reviewed solely depended on the keyword search that contained the terms simulated Kalman filter from December 2015 to the present date. This is the first review paper on SKF. It is hoped that this survey would be beneficial for the researchers of this area and attracting interest towards the algorithm.
review_content:
In my opinion, the methods in 57 papers will be compared together. Their advantages and disadvantages need to be listed in a table. Some simulation and example can make the topic clearer and help the readers to make a difference between the presented algorithms. I am also wondering if there is any work related to the nonlinear SKF. I think the literature review has not been covered completely.

Also, the structure and organization of the paper needs to be modified. In case, the abstract is too long, and the introduction is too short.

paper_abstract_zh: 模拟卡尔曼滤波器（SKF）通过寻找最优解的估计值来解决优化问题。作为一种多智能体算法，种群中的每个智能体都通过使用标准卡尔曼滤波器框架来充当卡尔曼滤波器，该框架包括一个模拟测量过程和一个迄今为止最佳解作为参考。本文概述了从SKF引入之初到目前的研究进展，讨论了SKF的进展、改进、修改和应用。首先介绍了基本和标准算法。然后，对算法改进的工作进行了综述。最后，讨论了尚未解决的问题和SKF研究的一些方向。我们回顾了57篇SKF论文，其中16篇关于基础改进，9篇关于算法在离散问题上的扩展，25篇关于其应用。研究人员致力于通过尝试预测算子、基于对立的学习和不同的迭代策略来提高探索能力，以防止早熟收敛。还有尝试将SKF与其他著名算法如粒子群优化（PSO）、引力搜索算法（GSA）和正弦余弦算法（SCA）进行混合，以提高其性能。最后，介绍了SKF的单智能体变体和多目标SKF。SKF算法及其变体已在至少九个应用领域中得到实施：钻进路径优化、机场登机口分配问题（AGAP）、装配序列规划（ASP）、系统识别、特征选择、图像模板匹配、控制器调优、无线传感器网络和工程设计问题。所回顾的文献仅依赖于从2015年12月至今包含“模拟卡尔曼滤波器”关键词的搜索。这是第一篇关于SKF的综述论文。希望这次调研对这一领域的研究人员有所帮助，并吸引对这一算法的兴趣。
review_content_zh:

此外，论文的结构和组织需要修改。例如，摘要过长，而引言过短。

paper_title: A systematic approach to mapping longitudinal data usage: Reflections on tracking Millennium Cohort Study activity
paper_abstract:
Background: The Millennium Cohort Study is the youngest of the UK’s four national birth cohort studies, but the only study (to our knowledge) where a systematic approach to exploring data usage has been undertaken. 
 Methods: In this paper we: (i) explore previous exercises and provide justification for our approach; (ii) share headline findings of our research, (iii) outline the challenges of intersecting systematic review methods with survey design methods; and (iv) discuss the implications for future survey design as well as for future exercises tracking survey data usage. All of the results were obtained through undertaking systematic searches across 30 databases which generated over 4000 results. We then searched these records, first on title and abstract and then on the full text and extracted data on studies that fell within our specific areas of interest. 
 Results: A total of 481 studies were identified as using MCS data in novel analyses. Among these studies, measures that have been collected across sweeps—diet, BMI, SDQ and screen time—are all comparatively well used. Data that were collected from the child’s own reports (e.g. friendships and feelings) have seldom been utilised in comparison to data collected through parental reports and using validated tools (e.g. SDQ). Imposing thresholds on data was found to be problematic in some cases, for example for BMI, where a number of different thresholds for overweight and obesity were in use. The use of different thresholds can lead to substantial differences in the results obtained. 
 Conclusions: Longitudinal consistency in measures is key to identifying change over time, and the review helped map the degree of consistency in measures, and their utility. The findings shaped decisions around inclusion of variables in MCS7 (age 17 years), as well as the way in which existing data were deposited.
review_content:
This is a very interesting and useful article, which makes a contribution to the knowledge about the use of the Millennium Cohort Study data in general and a utilisation of the sub-set of child-level measures overtime specifically; and to the methodology of applying systematic mapping techniques to reviewing longitudinal data use. The aims of this article are: to firstly identify all the unique studies that use MCS for primary data analysis; and, secondly, to explore the way the data was used (under-explored areas/rarely used response categories), focusing on a subset of areas of interest. I feel that the authors have fully accomplished their aims and I am certain that this article will prove to be of benefit to a wide range of readers. On the whole I found it a pleasant and easy read, which provides the right amount of detail, and is well structured and coherent. I would therefore recommend it for indexing after considering some of my minor suggestions listed below:

Detailed comments:

The abstract:

I would suggest the authors to be a little bit more specific in writing so that it is more obvious what their study did from reading the abstract alone.
  * I am not sure I understand the “background” section - do the authors mean to say that their paper is the only one that systematically explored MCS data? If so, perhaps re-phrase the sentence to make it clearer.
  * In the “methods” section of the abstract: when the authors refer to “(i) explore previous exercises”, I think the authors should be a little more explicit and say something like “(i) explore previous exercises which examined the use of MCS data”. Otherwise it sounds like there were other systematic mapping exercises.
  * Again, in the “methods” section of the abstract: when referring to own approach, expand a little to say something along the lines of: “our approach, namely systematic mapping” to be precise.
Methods & results sections:
  * The method of the systematic mapping is clearly described within the methods section, helpfully contrasted with the systematic review.
  * The term “systematic mapping”, which is the review method used in this work, does not appear in the paper until quite far along in the methods section (with the exception of a brief mentioning of it at the end of the introduction). I think it should come up earlier: for example, the end of the first paragraph of the section “Previous approaches in reviewing longitudinal data usage”, could, in my opinion, benefit from explicitly referring to the manuscript’s approach as “systematic mapping”.
  * Although it is understandable that to review all the areas of MCS data collection would not be within the scope of this work, it would be useful to get a sense of the reasons for choosing these particular topics, even if briefly. And perhaps, later in the paper to say something, about the focus of studies not included in the in-depth analysis (even if it is just to name a few big obvious areas that the MCS data is used for in those publications).
  * I thought that the authors did a good job in clearly describing their search methodology, specifying search terms, providing the description of the way the initial screening and subsequent screenings took place and the information extracted with a supplementary flow diagram. My one suggestion would be for the authors to make the total number of studies identified, which is mentioned in the text of the article (n=481), more visible in the flow chart (Figure 1) as it currently takes some figuring out and adding two numbers together to get to it.
  * In terms of reproducing the results and for the full transparency of the review, I think a date (dates) when the searches were undertaken and the CLS list of studies was obtained should be included within the methodology description. It would also be good to see to see a full list of studies (all 481 of them), as well as the identified selected studies for the in-depth analysis, in a separate appendix.
  * I think specifying exactly which sweeps of data the measures are available in would be useful for Table 2.
  * I would also suggest to move the introduction of new information – the fact that studies using age 11 sweep were excluded from the review - from the discussion section of the article to the methodology.
paper_title_zh: 系统化方法绘制纵向数据使用图：对追踪千年队列研究活动的反思
paper_abstract_zh:
**背景**：千年队列研究（Millennium Cohort Study）是英国四大国家级出生队列研究中最年轻的一项，但据我们所知，它是唯一一个系统性地探索数据使用情况的研究。

**方法**：在本文中，我们：（一）探讨以往的实践并为我们方法提供合理性依据；（二）分享我们研究的主要发现；（三）概述将系统综述方法与调查设计方法相结合的挑战；（四）讨论对未来调查设计以及追踪调查数据使用情况的未来实践的启示。所有结果均通过在30个数据库中进行系统性检索获得，生成了超过4000条结果。我们随后对这些记录进行了检索，首先根据标题和摘要，然后根据全文，提取了符合我们特定兴趣领域的研究数据。

**结果**：共识别出481项研究使用了MCS数据进行创新性分析。在这些研究中，跨多个阶段收集的测量指标——如饮食、BMI、SDQ（儿童行为量表）和屏幕时间——都得到了相对充分的使用。相比之下，从儿童自身报告（如友谊和情感）收集的数据很少被利用，而通过父母报告和使用验证工具（如SDQ）收集的数据则使用较多。在某些情况下，对数据施加阈值被发现存在问题，例如对于BMI，存在多种不同的超重和肥胖阈值在使用中。使用不同的阈值可能导致获得的结果存在显著差异。

**结论**：测量指标的纵向一致性是识别随时间变化的关键，本次综述有助于映射测量指标的一致性程度及其效用。这些发现影响了关于MCS7（17岁年龄段）变量纳入的决策，以及现有数据的存储方式。
review_content_zh:
这是一篇非常有趣且有用的文章，它对一般性使用千年队列研究（Millennium Cohort Study, MCS）数据的知识以及特定地利用儿童水平测量子集的长期数据做出了贡献；同时，也对应用系统映射技术审查纵向数据使用的方法论有所贡献。本文的目标是：首先，识别所有使用MCS进行初级数据分析的独特研究；其次，探讨数据的使用方式（未被充分探索的领域/很少使用的响应类别），重点关注感兴趣的子集区域。我认为作者们已经完全实现了他们的目标，并且我相信这篇文章将对广泛的读者群体有益。总体而言，我发现这篇文章读起来愉快且容易理解，提供了适量的细节，结构良好且连贯。因此，在考虑以下列出的一些我的小建议后，我推荐对其进行索引。

详细评论：

摘要：

我建议作者在写作时稍微具体一些，以便仅通过阅读摘要就能更明显地了解他们的研究内容。
* 我不太确定我理解“背景”部分——作者是否意味着他们的论文是唯一系统地探索MCS数据的论文？如果是这样，或许可以重新措辞以使其更清晰。
* 在摘要的“方法”部分：当作者提到“(i) 探索之前的练习”时，我认为作者应该更明确一些，比如说“(i) 探索之前检查MCS数据使用的练习”。否则，听起来好像还有其他系统映射练习。
* 同样，在摘要的“方法”部分：在提到自己的方法时，稍微扩展一下，比如说“我们的方法，即系统映射”，以更精确。

方法和结果部分：
* 系统映射的方法在方法部分中得到了清晰的描述，并与系统审查进行了有益的对比。
* “系统映射”这一术语是本文使用的审查方法，但在方法部分中相当靠后的位置才出现（除了在引言末尾简要提及）。我认为它应该更早出现：例如，在“审查纵向数据使用的前期方法”部分的第一个段落的末尾，在我看来，可以明确提到本文的方法为“系统映射”。
* 虽然可以理解审查MCS数据收集的所有领域不在本文的范围内，但简要了解选择这些特定主题的原因会很有用。并且或许在文章的后面部分可以提及未包含在深入分析中的研究的重点（即使只是列举一些MCS数据在这些出版物中使用的明显大领域）。
* 我认为作者在清晰描述他们的搜索方法方面做得很好，指定了搜索术语，提供了初始筛选和后续筛选方式的描述以及提取的信息，并附有补充流程图。我的一个建议是，作者应使文章文本中提到的识别出的研究总数（n=481）在流程图（图1）中更明显，因为目前需要一些推断和将两个数字相加才能得到。
* 为了结果的再现和审查的完全透明，我认为应在方法描述中包括进行搜索和获取CLS研究列表的日期（日期）。此外，最好在单独的附录中看到完整的研究列表（全部481项），以及为深入分析所识别选定的研究。
* 我认为具体说明测量数据可用的具体数据扫描会在表2中很有用。
* 我还建议将新信息的介绍——即使用11岁扫描的研究被排除在审查之外的事实——从文章的讨论部分移至方法部分。

On the whole I found it a pleasant and easy read, which provides the right amount of detail, and is well structured and coherent. I would therefore recommend it for indexing after considering some of my minor suggestions listed below:

If so, perhaps re-phrase the sentence to make it clearer.

My one suggestion would be for the authors to make the total number of studies identified, which is mentioned in the text of the article (n=481), more visible in the flow chart (Figure 1) as it currently takes some figuring out and adding two numbers together to get to it.
I think specifying exactly which sweeps of data the measures are available in would be useful for Table 2.
Again, in the “methods” section of the abstract: when referring to own approach, expand a little to say something along the lines of: “our approach, namely systematic mapping” to be precise.

I think it should come up earlier: for example, the end of the first paragraph of the section “Previous approaches in reviewing longitudinal data usage”, could, in my opinion, benefit from explicitly referring to the manuscript’s approach as “systematic mapping”.

paper_title: Systematic review and meta-analysis of 50 years of coral disease research visualized through the scope of network theory
paper_abstract: Coral disease research encompasses five decades of undeniable progress. Since the first descriptions of anomalous signs, we have come to understand multiple processes and environmental drivers that interact with coral pathologies. In order to gain a better insight into the knowledge we already have, we explored how key topics in coral disease research have been related to each other using network analysis. We reviewed 719 papers and conference proceedings published from 1965 to 2017. From each study, four elements determined our network nodes: 1) studied disease(s); 2) host genus; 3) marine ecoregion(s) associated with the study site; and 4) research objectives. Basic properties of this network confirmed that there is a set of specific topics comprising the majority of research. The top five diseases, genera, and ecoregions studied accounted for over 48% of the research effort in all cases. The community structure analysis identified 15 clusters of topics with different degrees of overlap among them. These clusters represent the typical sets of elements that appear together for a given study. Our results show that while some coral diseases have been studied considering multiple aspects, the overall trend is for most diseases to be understood under a limited range of approaches, e.g. bacterial assemblages have been considerably studied in Yellow and Black band diseases while immune response has been better examined for the aspergillosis-Gorgonia system. Thus, our challenge in the near future is to identify and resolve potential gaps in order to achieve a more comprehensive progress on coral disease research.
review_content: Reviewer 2: Experimental design ● “This appears to be a standard approach. My only concern is that they define "white syndrome" as tissue discoloration and loss. White syndrome is a tissue loss disease regardless of whether the lesion has discolorations or not. Not sure if that would effect the categorization of their clusters or not” This would not have an effect in the construction of the network, however, we agree with the observation and removed the word ‘discoloration’. ● This is an interesting approach with the intent to determine where research efforts have been in coral disease research identifying potential gaps. The concept is interesting and I think there is valuable information presented. Table 1 is clear and informative although I would request a full Table with all of the information even as a supplemental file. From the full Table one could better evaluation which corals, regions, etc are completely missing. Agreed. We added two additional supplementary materials at https://github.com/luismmontilla/CoDiRNet​, including the topics from the raw network that were excluded from the backbone and the combinations of research questions and diseases that always were zero. ● The authors, however, need a better visual representation of their findings (Fig. 5-7) or perhaps better, more detailed information in the Figure legends. Perhaps something along the lines of Fig. 2? We left the figures unchanged, as that was the simplest representation of the community communities, however, we agree with the observation of the reviewer and we added more information to the figure captions to make figures self explanatory. ● In order for this paper to be useful there needs to be a better explanation of what these “communities” are and what they tell us in terms of research gaps. Discussion needs to be developed more fully explaining the major new understanding of coral disease research efforts. For example, in the discussion it is stated that “For example, Black Band Disease occupies a preponderant place in coral disease research. “ but they don’t explain how the Figures support this. Is it because BBD is linked across 5 clusters (c2, c4, c5, c12, c14)? If so, then they need to spell that out so readers can better understand these results. We agree, we extended the discussion included more information about the gaps, in summary,. the need to extend research about coral immunity to other coral-disease systems, and the consideration of the role of host symbionts and microbiome in the coral defense against pathogens; also, the scarcity of research about the effects of multiple stressors on diseased corals and the need to diversify the studied stressors beyond high temperature and low pH, and finally, the need to embrace open science practice and make data about disease prevalence more open and machine readable.
paper_title_zh: "基于网络理论视角的系统综述与元分析：50年珊瑚疾病研究可视化"
paper_abstract_zh: 珊瑚疾病研究涵盖了五个十年的不可否认的进展。自首次描述异常迹象以来，我们已逐渐理解了多种过程和环境驱动因素与珊瑚病理学的相互作用。为了更好地洞察我们已经掌握的知识，我们利用网络分析探讨了珊瑚疾病研究中的关键主题是如何相互关联的。我们回顾了1965年至2017年间发表的719篇论文和会议记录。每项研究的四个要素决定了我们网络的节点：1）研究的疾病；2）宿主属；3）与研究地点相关的海洋生态区；以及4）研究目标。该网络的基本属性证实，存在一组特定主题构成了研究的大部分内容。研究最多的前五种疾病、属和生态区在所有情况下占据了超过48%的研究努力。社区结构分析识别出15个主题集群，它们之间有不同的重叠程度。这些集群代表了在给定研究中一起出现的典型元素集合。我们的结果表明，尽管一些珊瑚疾病已经从多个方面进行了研究，但总体趋势是大多数疾病在有限的研究范围内被理解，例如，在黄带病和黑带病中已对细菌群落进行了相当多的研究，而在曲霉病-柳珊瑚系统中则更好地考察了免疫反应。因此，我们在不久的将来面临的挑战是识别和解决潜在差距，以实现珊瑚疾病研究的更全面进展。
review_content_zh: 审稿人2：实验设计 ● “这似乎是一个标准的方法。我唯一的担忧是他们将‘白化综合症’定义为组织变色和丧失。白化综合症是一种组织丧失疾病，无论病变是否有变色。不确定这是否会影响他们对簇的分类。” 这不会影响网络的构建，然而，我们同意这一观察并删除了“变色”一词。 ● 这是一种有趣的方法，旨在确定珊瑚疾病研究中的研究重点，识别潜在的空白。这个概念很有趣，我认为呈现的信息很有价值。表1清晰且信息丰富，尽管我请求提供包含所有信息的完整表格，即使是作为补充文件。从完整表格中可以更好地评估哪些珊瑚、地区等完全缺失。同意。我们在https://github.com/luismmontilla/CoDiRNet添加了两个额外的补充材料，包括从原始网络中排除的主题和始终为零的研究问题与疾病的组合。 ● 然而，作者需要更好地视觉呈现他们的发现（图5-7），或者更好的是，在图例中提供更详细的信息。也许可以参考图2的样式？我们保留了图表不变，因为这是社区社区最简单的表示，然而，我们同意审稿人的观察，并在图注中添加了更多信息，使图表自解释。 ● 为了使这篇论文有用，需要更好地解释这些“社区”是什么，以及它们在研究空白方面告诉我们什么。讨论需要更充分地展开，解释对珊瑚疾病研究努力的主要新理解。例如，在讨论中提到“例如，黑带病在珊瑚疾病研究中占据重要地位。”但他们没有解释图表如何支持这一点。是因为BBD跨越5个簇（c2, c4, c5, c12, c14）吗？如果是这样，那么他们需要明确指出，以便读者更好地理解这些结果。我们同意，我们扩展了讨论，包括更多关于空白的信息，总结来说，需要将珊瑚免疫研究扩展到其他珊瑚-疾病系统，并考虑宿主共生体和微生物组在珊瑚防御病原体中的作用；此外，关于多重压力对患病珊瑚影响的研究稀缺，需要多样化研究的压力因素，而不仅仅是高温和低pH；最后，需要拥抱开放科学实践，使疾病流行数据更加开放和机器可读。

My only concern is that they define "white syndrome" as tissue discoloration and loss. White syndrome is a tissue loss disease regardless of whether the lesion has discolorations or not.
If so, then they need to spell that out so readers can better understand these results.
In order for this paper to be useful there needs to be a better explanation of what these “communities” are and what they tell us in terms of research gaps.

paper_title: Inflatable penile prosthesis in the radical prostatectomy patient: a review
paper_abstract: In the population of patients with prostate cancer, survivorship has come to the forefront of continuity-of-care. In addition to urinary control, erectile function is a significant issue after radical pelvic surgery. Penile prosthesis surgery remains an excellent option for restoring erectile function to those for whom more conservative measures have failed. This review article outlines the anatomical, surgical and post-operative consideration involved in the placement of a penile prosthesis in this special patient population.
review_content:
Well put together manuscript reviewing the literature in penile prosthesis placement after radical prostatectomy. I commend the authors on their thorough summary. There are several points I would recommend clarified.
1. Page 2 paragraph 3 first sentence – “The initiating factor in the development…” This singular cause is debatable. There was a paper by Box et al.1 that showed no difference with preservation of the APAs. I would recommend softening the tone.
2. Page 2 paragraph 4 – when discussing the potency rates I would recommend stating that those numbers include patients with and without the use of PDE5Is.
3. Page 2 – surgical considerations – 1st paragraph, last sentence – spell check – Dilamezinsert is the name listed in the Cooper Surgical catalog.
4. Page 3 – 3rd paragraph, prevention and management of perforation – Please clarify how the ‘U-type’ suture is used to prevent cylinder migration.

paper_title: Graph Reinforcement Learning for Combinatorial Optimization: A Survey and Unifying Perspective
paper_abstract: Graphs are a natural representation for systems based on relations between connected entities. Combinatorial optimization problems, which arise when considering an objective function related to a process of interest on discrete structures, are often challenging due to the rapid growth of the solution space. The trial-and-error paradigm of Reinforcement Learning has recently emerged as a promising alternative to traditional methods, such as exact algorithms and (meta)heuristics, for discovering better decision-making strategies in a variety of disciplines including chemistry, computer science, and statistics. Despite the fact that they arose in markedly different fields, these techniques share significant commonalities. Therefore, we set out to synthesize this work in a unifying perspective that we term Graph Reinforcement Learning, interpreting it as a constructive decision-making method for graph problems. After covering the relevant technical background, we review works along the dividing line of whether the goal is to optimize graph structure given a process of interest, or to optimize the outcome of the process itself under fixed graph structure. Finally, we discuss the common challenges facing the field and open research questions. In contrast with other surveys, the present work focuses on non-canonical graph problems for which performant algorithms are typically not known and Reinforcement Learning is able to provide efficient and effective solutions.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
The paper provides a comprehensive overview of applying reinforcement learning (RL) techniques to solve combinatorial optimization problems on graphs. It introduces a unifying perspective called Graph Reinforcement Learning (Graph RL), which it posits as a novel decision-making method for addressing various graph-based problems. The authors also discuss challenges and research opportunities in the field.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
Pros: 1. The paper thoroughly surveys a range of works across different domains, providing a broad understanding of the state of research in Graph RL. 2. The introduction of Graph RL as a unifying framework is ambitious and presents a potential new direction for future research. 3. The discussion on common challenges and open research questions is well-articulated, offering a clear roadmap for future explorations in the domain. Cons: Weaknesses 1. Despite the extensive review, the paper spends considerable time reiterating basic concepts and fundamentals of graphs and RL, which could be considered well-known among the target audience (TMLR readers and potential researchers in the field). 2. The novelty seems limited primarily to the proposed conceptual framework of Graph RL. The practical impact or distinct advantages of this framework over existing methods are not convincingly demonstrated. 3. The paper lacks empirical results that compare Graph RL methods against traditional RL approaches or other baselines. This omission makes it difficult to gauge the practical effectiveness or efficiency of the proposed framework. 3. The survey could benefit from a deeper technical analysis or critical comparison of specific RL algorithms applied in the graph context, rather than a broad categorization. Also, the discussion of challenges is generic, covering well-known issues like scalability and generalization but missing deeper, problem-specific challenges that are critical for advancing the field.

**Requested Changes:**
While the paper does an goodjob of surveying a broad range of applications and proposing a unifying framework, it needs to deepen its technical discussions and focus more on specific challenges and empirical validations to maximize its relevance and impact in the field of Graph RL.

**Claims And Evidence:**
Yes

**Audience:**
Yes

**Rebuttal Comments:**
Response to Reviewer KJw5: We thank the reviewer for taking the time to consider our paper. Please find below our responses to the points that were raised. > Despite the extensive review, the paper spends considerable time reiterating basic concepts and fundamentals of graphs and RL, which could be considered well-known among the target audience [...] Thanks for this suggestion. Our intention in reiterating fundamental concepts was to provide a sort of primer of the area, but we do agree that we ended up introducing basic concepts and this was completely unnecessary given the audience of TMLR. **Changes made**: we have made modifications throughout the Background section to cut “basic” content. Notably, we have reduced and merged Sections 2.1 (Graph Fundamentals) and 2.2 (Combinatorial Optimization on Graphs); removed Section 2.3 (Complexity of Combinatorial Optimization Problems); cut irrelevant content from Section 2.5 (Decision-making Processes and Solution Methods). > The novelty seems limited primarily to the proposed conceptual framework of Graph RL. The practical impact or distinct advantages of this framework over existing methods are not convincingly demonstrated. We agree that there is a gap in the literature regarding empirical comparisons of RL versus non-RL methods for CO problems. This point was also raised by Reviewer YnH3. The focus of our article is the proposal of a unifying paradigm and a critical survey of the existing literature. In the previous version of the paper, we failed to underline the fact that the superiority of RL vs non-RL solutions for certain problems has been proven in the literature through several experimental studies. Empirical comparisons are typically carried out within the evaluations of the papers themselves so as to argue for the adoption of RL as a superior approach for certain classes of CO problems. Some examples worth mentioning (which we have underlined in the revised version of the article) are: - *Attacking GNNs via rewiring*: Dai et al. 2018 and Ma et al. 2021 show superior performance over random rewiring and (in some settings) a genetic algorithm. - *Network design*: Yang et al. 2023b outperform hill climbing, simulated annealing, greedy search, and an evolutionary algorithm. - *Network games*: Darvariu et al. 2021b outperform simulated annealing, a distributed search algorithm, the standard game-theoretic best-response technique, and heuristics based on local node properties (targeting high-degree nodes and lower-cost nodes). - *Spreading processes*: Meirom et al. 2021 outperform heuristics based on local node properties (degree, discounted-degree, and eigenvector centralities) and the LIR algorithm for influence maximization. - *Search and navigation*: for knowledge base completion, Shen et al. 2018 outperform several widely used methods that learn vector representations of entities and relations (TransE, TransR, DistMult, ComplEx, ConvE). **Changes made**: we have added examples of problems for which RL can do better than non-RL to the Introduction, as these were missing entirely. We have also added a discussion in the newly formed Section 6 about problems for which a RL solution is preferrable and those for which it is not, in order to provide a balanced view of the landscape in this area. This section also points to the gap in the literature regarding comparisons of RL and non-RL approaches beyond the scope of each individual paper. > The paper lacks empirical results that compare Graph RL methods against traditional RL approaches or other baselines. This omission makes it difficult to gauge the practical effectiveness or efficiency of the proposed framework. We would like to thank the reviewer for the comment. It happens that our message was not sufficiently clear: we introduced Graph RL as unifying framework encompassing all RL algorithms designed for optimizing graph structures and the dynamics of processes happening over them. Regarding comparisons of Graph RL and traditional RL methods: Graph RL cannot be distinguished from traditional RL solutions since they are essentially RL approaches adapted to graph problems. We believe that it is difficult to define a “traditional” approach: there are many RL solutions that can be successfully applied to graph problems, but they require specific modeling assumptions, formal definitions, and adaptations. The survey discusses the particularities of these techniques, i.e., how combinatorial optimization problems over graphs have been formulated as MDPs and the details of the RL algorithms used. On the topic of comparing Graph RL methods and standard baselines: these were discussed in the preceding answer. **Changes made**: We have added an additional clarification to the Introduction section to note that Graph RL methods are RL methods, but that problem formulations and RL techniques that are adopted can differ substantially, and the survey seeks to elucidate these differences.
paper_title_zh: 图强化学习在组合优化中的应用：综述与统一视角
paper_abstract_zh: 图是表示基于连接实体之间关系的系统的自然形式。组合优化问题在考虑与离散结构上感兴趣的过程相关的目标函数时出现，通常由于解空间迅速增长而具有挑战性。近年来，强化学习的试错范式作为一种有前景的替代方法，脱颖而出，用于在化学、计算机科学和统计学等多个学科中发现更好的决策策略，以取代传统方法，如精确算法和（元）启发式算法。尽管这些技术起源于截然不同的领域，但它们之间存在显著的共性。因此，我们着手从统一视角综合这项工作，我们称之为图强化学习，将其解释为图问题的建设性决策方法。在涵盖相关技术背景之后，我们回顾了沿着以下分界线的研究：目标是优化给定感兴趣过程的图结构，还是优化在固定图结构下过程本身的结局。最后，我们讨论了该领域面临的共同挑战和开放性研究问题。与其他综述不同，当前工作聚焦于非典型图问题，对于这些问题，通常没有已知的高效算法，而强化学习能够提供高效且有效的解决方案。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
本文全面概述了将强化学习（RL）技术应用于图上的组合优化问题的方法。它引入了一个统一的视角，称为图强化学习（Graph RL），并将其定位为解决各种基于图的问题的新颖决策方法。作者还讨论了该领域的挑战和研究机会。

**优点和缺点：**
优点：1. 本文彻底调查了不同领域的一系列工作，提供了对Graph RL研究现状的广泛理解。2. 将Graph RL作为统一框架引入是雄心勃勃的，为未来研究提出了潜在的新方向。3. 对常见挑战和开放研究问题的讨论表述清晰，为该领域未来的探索提供了明确的路线图。
缺点：1. 尽管进行了广泛的综述，但本文花费了大量时间重述图和RL的基本概念和原理，这些内容在目标受众（TMLR读者和该领域的潜在研究人员）中可能被认为是众所周知的。2. 新颖性似乎主要限于提出的Graph RL概念框架。该框架相对于现有方法的实际影响或独特优势并未得到令人信服的展示。3. 本文缺乏将Graph RL方法与传统RL方法或其他基线进行比较的实证结果。这一遗漏使得难以评估所提出框架的实际有效性或效率。4. 该综述可以从对特定RL算法在图上下文中应用的更深入技术分析或批判性比较中受益，而不仅仅是广泛的分类。此外，对挑战的讨论是泛泛的，涵盖了众所周知的诸如可扩展性和泛化等问题，但缺少对推进该领域至关重要的更深层次、特定问题的挑战。

**请求的更改：**
尽管本文在调查广泛的应用并提出统一框架方面做得不错，但它需要深化技术讨论，并更专注于特定挑战和实证验证，以最大化其在Graph RL领域的相关性和影响力。

**主张和证据：**
是

**受众：**
是

**反驳意见：**
对评审员KJw5的回应：感谢评审员花时间考虑我们的论文。以下是对提出问题的回应。> 尽管进行了广泛的综述，但本文花费了大量时间重述图和RL的基本概念和原理，这些内容在目标受众 [...] 中可能被认为是众所周知的。感谢这一建议。我们重述基本概念的意图是为该领域提供一个入门指南，但我们同意，考虑到TMLR的受众，我们最终引入了基本概念，这完全是多余的。**已做的更改**：我们对背景部分进行了全面修改，以删除“基本”内容。特别是，我们缩减并合并了第2.1节（图的基础知识）和第2.2节（图上的组合优化）；删除了第2.3节（组合优化问题的复杂性）；从第2.5节（决策过程和解决方案方法）中删除了无关内容。> 新颖性似乎主要限于提出的Graph RL概念框架。该框架相对于现有方法的实际影响或独特优势并未得到令人信服的展示。我们同意文献中关于RL与非RL方法在CO问题上的实证比较存在空白。这一点也被评审员YnH3提出。我们文章的重点是提出一个统一范式并对现有文献进行批判性综述。在之前的版本中，我们未能强调RL在某些问题上优于非RL解决方案的事实已在文献中通过多项实验研究得到证明。实证比较通常在论文本身的评估中进行，以论证在某些类别的CO问题上采用RL作为更优方法。一些值得提及的例子（我们在修订版中已强调）包括：- *通过重新布线攻击GNNs*：Dai等人2018年和Ma等人2021年展示了优于随机重新布线和（在某些设置中）遗传算法的性能。- *网络设计*：Yang等人2023b优于爬山算法、模拟退火、贪婪搜索和一种进化算法。- *网络博弈*：Darvariu等人2021b优于模拟退火、分布式搜索算法、标准博弈论最佳响应技术和基于局部节点属性（针对高度节点和低成本节点）的启发式方法。- *传播过程*：Meirom等人2021年优于基于局部节点属性（度、折扣度和特征向量中心性）的启发式方法和用于影响力最大化的LIR算法。- *搜索和导航*：在知识库补全方面，Shen等人2018年优于几种广泛使用的学习实体和关系向量表示的方法（TransE、TransR、DistMult、ComplEx、ConvE）。**已做的更改**：我们在引言中添加了RL在某些问题上优于非RL的例子，因为这些内容完全缺失。我们还在新形成的第6节中添加了讨论，关于哪些问题更适合RL解决方案以及哪些不适合，以提供对该领域格局的平衡看法。这一节还指出了文献中关于比较RL和非RL方法超出每篇论文范围的空白。> 本文缺乏将Graph RL方法与传统RL方法或其他基线进行比较的实证结果。这一遗漏使得难以评估所提出框架的实际有效性或效率。我们感谢评审员的评论。我们的信息显然不够清晰：我们引入Graph RL作为涵盖所有为优化图结构和其上发生过程动力学而设计的RL算法的统一框架。关于Graph RL和传统RL方法的比较：Graph RL与传统RL解决方案无法区分，因为它们本质上是为图问题适配的RL方法。我们认为很难定义一个“传统”方法：有许多RL解决方案可以成功应用于图问题，但它们需要特定的建模假设、形式定义和适配。综述讨论了这些技术的特殊性，即组合优化问题如何在图上被表述为MDP以及所用RL算法的细节。关于比较Graph RL方法和标准基线的话题：这些在前面的回答中已讨论过。**已做的更改**：我们在引言部分添加了额外的澄清，指出Graph RL方法是RL方法，但所采用的问题表述和RL技术可能存在显著差异，综述旨在阐明这些差异。

paper_title: Effect of music interventions on anxiety during labor: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
paper_abstract: Background. Anxiety is commonly experienced during the delivery process and has shown to have adverse effects on maternal and infant health outcomes. paper_title: Tapping into the plasticity of plant architecture for increased stress resilience
paper_abstract: Plant architecture develops post-embryonically and emerges from a dialogue between the developmental signals and environmental cues. Length and branching of the vegetative and reproductive tissues were the focus of improvement of plant performance from the early days of plant breeding. Current breeding priorities are changing, as we need to prioritize plant productivity under increasingly challenging environmental conditions. While it has been widely recognized that plant architecture changes in response to the environment, its contribution to plant productivity in the changing climate remains to be fully explored. This review will summarize prior discoveries of genetic control of plant architecture traits and their effect on plant performance under environmental stress. We review new tools in phenotyping that will guide future discoveries of genes contributing to plant architecture, its plasticity, and its contributions to stress resilience. Subsequently, we provide a perspective into how integrating the study of new species, modern phenotyping techniques, and modeling can lead to discovering new genetic targets underlying the plasticity of plant architecture and stress resilience. Altogether, this review provides a new perspective on the plasticity of plant architecture and how it can be harnessed for increased performance under environmental stress.
review_content: This is a very well written review paper describing genetic control of plant architecture traits (root and shoot architecture) and their effect on plant performance under environmental stress. There is a very useful Figure 1 summarizing the molecular regulators of the plant architecture as well as 3 supplemental figures! This review is very relevant and provides further understanding of genetic and molecular regulation of plant architecture for improved crop resilience in the changing climate.
paper_title_zh: 利用植物构型的可塑性提高抗逆性
paper_abstract_zh: 植物构型在胚胎后发育，并源于发育信号与环境线索之间的对话。自植物育种早期以来，营养组织和生殖组织的长度及分枝一直是提高植物性能的重点。当前的育种优先事项正在改变，因为我们需要在日益严峻的环境条件下优先考虑植物生产力。尽管人们普遍认识到植物构型会响应环境变化，但其对气候变化下植物生产力的贡献仍有待全面探索。本综述将总结先前关于植物构型性状的遗传控制及其在环境压力下对植物性能影响的发现。我们回顾了表型分析的新工具，这些工具将指导未来发现有助于植物构型、其可塑性及其对压力抗性的基因。随后，我们提供了一个视角，探讨如何通过整合新物种研究、现代表型分析技术和建模，发现植物构型可塑性和压力抗性背后的新遗传靶点。总体而言，本综述为植物构型可塑性及其在环境压力下提高性能的利用提供了新视角。
