paper_title: One step further in biomechanical models in palaeontology: A nonlinear finite element analysis review Jordi Marcé-Nogué
paper_abstract: Finite Element Analysis (FEA) is no longer a new technique in the fields of palaeontology, anthropology, and evolutionary biology. It is nowadays a well-established technique within the virtual functional-morphology toolkit. However, almost all the works published in these fields have only applied the most basic FEA tools i.e., linear materials in static structural problems. Linear and static approximations are commonly used because they are computationally less expensive, and the error associated with these assumptions can be accepted. Nonetheless, nonlinearities are natural to be used in biomechanical models especially when modelling soft tissues, establish contacts between separated bones or the inclusion of buckling results. The aim of this review is to, firstly, highlight the usefulness of non-linearities and secondly, showcase these FEA tool to researchers that work in functional morphology and biomechanics, as non-linearities can improve their FEA models by widening the possible applications and topics that currently are not used in palaeontology and anthropology.
review_content: Reviewer 2 (Emily Rayfield) Basic reporting This is a useful review and one that I would like to see published. Following the first review, my main concern was that the author make it clear that they are showcasing the overlooked potential and importance of non-linear FE models rather than appearing to advocate without bias for their use. In this revised version, I am happy to see that the author has modified the text to make the review closer to the former rather than the latter. This is particularly clear in the Abstract and at the end of the Introduction. As it stands, I am content that this revised manuscript serves the purpose of outlining the usefulness of non-linear models. There are still a few queries and adjustments I would like the author to make before publication - outlined below. I thank the reviewer for being supportive. I addressed most of the changes she proposed or clarified them. Line 32 - when you say "mathematical nonlinearities are natural in physical models and the assumption of nonlinearilty...[etc]" by 'physical models', do you mean organisms and biological systems? When I see the word 'models' I think of mathematical/computational constructs, but I think you mean something different here? "Model" means the law of the physics that we are using to model the behaviour of a body, so to avoid the misunderstanding I used "physical laws" instead of physical models Line 38 onwwards - if palaeontologists are unaware of non-linear models, then they cannot ignore something they are not aware of. I suggest instead of ignore, phrase this as something like: "...most palaeontologists do not have a deep understanding of how FEA problems are defined and solved, and many are not aware of the potential of non-linear modelling." Change accepted Line 41 onwards: "Including non-linearities in palaeoanthropological models can improve the results obtained in skulls when modelling skulls by considering sutures, thus making the behaviour of the model closer to reality." If you want to convince palaeo/anthro people to use non-linear models, you need to add a reference to show how this is indeed the case (maybe from the human/medical literature?). I included a reference Line 103 onwards: "In most of the biological models modelling bone structures, shells have been the prefered option." Preferred on what basis? Accurate geometry or performance? I can see how this will work for a thin later of cortex and underlying cancellous bone, but surely shells are not preferred when dealing with thick cortical bone for example? This sentence needs clarifying why shells are preferred and whether this is the case for all bony structures. The preference of shells is on front of plates. I clarified it in the text 4.2 Non-linearities in Geometry: Buckling - this section should refer to Figure 4 I presume (not figure 3). 4.3 Non-linearities in contacts - likewise in this section should refer to Figure 5. Both solved 5.1 Non-linear soft tissues - it would be great at the end of this section to include some references of biomedical models that have succesfully included non-linear materials - to guide the reader to further recommended reading. Most of the references the reviewer is asking are in the previous section 4.1 Regarding buckling - the modified figure is helpful. And I understand how buckling may be important for the slender long bones of some birds and pterosaurs. Arthropod cuticle could be another good model strucutre. However I'm still not convinced that buckling is an important selective criterion for the thick long bones of high body mass dinosaurs and proboscideans. Are buckling injuries recorded in the human and veterinary literature? I need some more evidence before dinosaurs and mammals are used as exemplars. You can find what is called as "buckle fracture" in humans https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Torus_fracture. They result from trabecular compression due to an axial loading force along the long axis of the bone, so what we understand as buckling. There is also some literature in other bones https://link-springer-com.sabidi.urv.cat/article/10.1007/s10439-009-9751-9 and I included it in the main text. In structural mechanics, buckling is very important in columns under compression, and it is the most important criterion to design these columns. The column will fail under buckling much before cracking for yield or fracture of the material properties. If the force applied against the column is very high, the only way to avoid buckling is modifying the connections/joints (difficult but not impossible), the material properties (difficult because it is bone), or the cross-section. So, my point here is that the cross section (and the other parameters) of heavy animals should be designed under this criterion. In fact, citing Currey and Alexander (1985) "If tubes are very thin-walled in relation to their diameter, they are liable to fail by local buckling" and also, they say "That is, they were more than sufficiently thick-walled for local buckling not to be a possible mode of failure". So, my point here is that buckling may be a criterion in the design of this bones (by increasing the thickness) to avoid buckling, because much before fracture or much before yield, buckling appears in these bones. I know form literature that Alexander and Currey raised this problem in birds, and I really do not know why the question is not raised in heavy animals. Probably because there is no evidence of fracture in the fossil record, but it does not mean that buckling could be important in understanding the design of their bones. In fact in the article from Currey (2003) “How Well Are Bones Designed to Resist Fracture?” buckling is discussed. Moreover, scratching a little bit I found in Currey (2003) information of preventing buckling in horse metacarpals. I think that this example can fix your doubts and I included in the text. Currey JD, Alexander RMN. 1985. The thickness of the walls of tubular bones. Journal of Zoology 206:453–468. DOI: 10.1111/j.1469-7998.1985.tb03551.x. Currey JD. 2003. How Well Are Bones Designed to Resist Fracture? Journal of Bone and Mineral Research 18:591–598. DOI: 10.1359/jbmr.2003.18.4.591. Additional comments Line 80: kind should be kinds : Solved Finally - the review ends abruptly. It would benefit from a short conclusion paragraph. I suggest the author add this to summarise their ideas and suggestions. (I should have suggested this in the first review - it was an oversight on my part). I included a paragraph at the end by writing some new text and moving some text from the introduction.
paper_title_zh: 古生物学中生物力学模型再进一步：非线性有限元分析综述  Jordi Marcé-Nogué
paper_abstract_zh: 有限元分析（FEA）在古生物学、人类学和进化生物学领域已不再是一项新技术。如今，它已成为虚拟功能形态学工具包中的一项成熟技术。然而，在这些领域发表的大部分研究仅使用了最基本的FEA工具，即线性材料在静态结构问题中的应用。线性静态近似之所以普遍使用，是因为它们在计算上成本较低，且这些假设相关的误差是可以接受的。尽管如此，非线性在生物力学模型中是自然应用的，尤其是在模拟软组织、建立分离骨骼间的接触或包含屈曲结果时。本综述的目的是，首先强调非线性的实用性，其次向功能形态学和生物力学领域的研究者展示这些FEA工具，因为非线性可以通过拓宽当前在古生物学和人类学中未应用的潜在应用和主题，来改进他们的FEA模型。
review_content_zh:
审稿人2（Emily Rayfield）基本报告

这是一篇有用的综述，我希望看到它被发表。继第一次审稿后，我主要的担忧是作者需要明确他们是在展示非线性有限元模型被忽视的潜力和重要性，而不是无偏见地倡导其使用。在这份修订版中，我很高兴看到作者修改了文本，使综述更接近前者而非后者。这在摘要和引言的结尾部分尤为明显。就目前情况来看，我满意这份修订稿达到了概述非线性模型有用性的目的。在发表之前，我仍希望作者对以下几点进行修改和澄清——具体如下。感谢审稿人的支持。我对她提出的大部分修改建议进行了处理或澄清。

第32行——当你说“数学非线性在物理模型中是自然的，非线性的假设……[等等]”时，你所说的“物理模型”是指生物体和生物系统吗？当我看到“模型”这个词时，我会想到数学/计算构造，但我想你在这里指的是别的意思？“模型”指的是我们用来模拟物体行为的物理定律，为了避免误解，我用“物理定律”代替了“物理模型”。

从第38行开始——如果古生物学家不知道非线性模型，那么他们无法忽视他们不知道的东西。我建议不要用“忽视”，而是改用类似的说法：“……大多数古生物学家对有限元分析问题的定义和解决方法没有深入了解，许多人也不知道非线性建模的潜力。”接受修改。

从第41行开始：“在古人类学模型中包含非线性可以提高模拟颅骨时获得的结果，通过考虑骨缝，从而使模型的行为更接近现实。”如果你想说服古人类学/人类学领域的人使用非线性模型，你需要添加一个参考文献来证明这一点（可能来自人类/医学文献？）。已添加参考文献。

从第103行开始：“在大多数模拟骨结构的生物模型中，壳体是首选选项。”基于什么标准是首选？准确的几何形状还是性能？我能理解这对于薄层皮质骨和下方的松质骨是可行的，但在处理厚皮质骨时，壳体肯定不是首选吗？这句话需要澄清为什么壳体是首选以及这是否适用于所有骨结构。壳体的偏好是在板面前。我在文本中进行了澄清。

4.2 几何非线性：屈曲——这一节应该指的是图4（不是图3）。已解决。

4.3 接触非线性——同样，这一节应该指的是图5。已解决。

5.1 非线性软组织——在这一节的结尾，最好能包括一些成功包含非线性材料的生物医学模型的参考文献，以引导读者进一步阅读。审稿人要求的大部分参考文献在之前的4.1节中已有。

关于屈曲——修改后的图很有帮助。我理解屈曲对于一些鸟类和翼龙细长的长骨可能很重要。节肢动物的表皮可能是另一个好的模型结构。然而，我仍然不相信屈曲是高体重恐龙和长鼻类动物厚长骨的重要选择性标准。人类和兽医文献中有记录屈曲损伤吗？我需要更多证据才能将恐龙和哺乳动物作为例证。你可以在人类中找到所谓的“屈曲骨折”（https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Torus_fracture）。它们是由于沿骨长轴的轴向载荷力导致的松质骨压缩而引起的，即我们理解的屈曲。其他骨骼也有一些文献（https://link-springer-com.sabidi.urv.cat/article/10.1007/s10439-009-9751-9），我将其纳入了正文。

在结构力学中，屈曲在受压柱中非常重要，是设计这些柱子的最重要标准。柱子在屈曲失效之前，远不会因材料属性的裂缝或屈服而失效。如果施加的力非常大，避免屈曲的唯一方法是修改连接/接点（困难但并非不可能）、材料属性（困难，因为它是骨）或横截面。所以，我的观点是，重型动物的横截面（和其他参数）应根据这一标准进行设计。事实上，引用Currey和Alexander（1985）的话：“如果管壁相对于其直径非常薄，它们容易因局部屈曲而失效”，他们还说道：“也就是说，它们的壁厚足以使局部屈曲不成为一种可能的失效模式”。因此，我的观点是，屈曲可能是设计这些骨骼（通过增加厚度）以避免屈曲的一个标准，因为在骨折或屈服之前，屈曲会出现在这些骨骼中。我从文献中知道，Alexander和Currey在鸟类中提出了这个问题，我真的不知道为什么在重型动物中没有提出这个问题。可能是因为化石记录中没有骨折的证据，但这并不意味着屈曲在理解其骨骼设计上不重要。事实上，在Currey（2003）的文章《骨骼设计抵抗骨折的能力如何？》中讨论了屈曲。此外，稍作挖掘，我在Currey（2003）中找到了关于防止马掌骨屈曲的信息。我认为这个例子可以解决你的疑问，我将其纳入了文本。

Currey JD, Alexander RMN. 1985. The thickness of the walls of tubular bones. Journal of Zoology 206:453–468. DOI: 10.1111/j.1469-7998.1985.tb03551.x.
Currey JD. 2003. How Well Are Bones Designed to Resist Fracture? Journal of Bone and Mineral Research 18:591–598. DOI: 10.1359/jbmr.2003.18.4.591.

附加评论

第80行：kind应改为kinds。已解决。

最后——综述突然结束。增加一个简短的结论段落会更有益。我建议作者添加这一段来总结他们的想法和建议。（我应该在前一次审稿中提出这一点——这是我的疏忽）。我在结尾添加了一个段落，通过写入一些新文本并从引言中移动了一些文本。

reasons: If you want to convince palaeo/anthro people to use non-linear models, you need to add a reference to show how this is indeed the case (maybe from the human/medical literature?).

5.1 Non-linear soft tissues - it would be great at the end of this section to include some references of biomedical models that have succesfully included non-linear materials - to guide the reader to further recommended reading.
Are buckling injuries recorded in the human and veterinary literature?
I need some more evidence before dinosaurs and mammals are used as exemplars.
So, my point here is that the cross section (and the other parameters) of heavy animals should be designed under this criterion.
I really do not know why the question is not raised in heavy animals.
4.2 Non-linearities in Geometry: Buckling - this section should refer to Figure 4 I presume (not figure 3). 4.3 Non-linearities in contacts - likewise in this section should refer to Figure 5.
Line 80: kind should be kinds
4.2 Non-linearities in Geometry: Buckling - this section should refer to Figure 4 I presume (not figure 3).
4.3 Non-linearities in contacts - likewise in this section should refer to Figure 5.
Finally - the review ends abruptly.
It would benefit from a short conclusion paragraph.
I suggest the author add this to summarise their ideas and suggestions.

paper_title: Epidemiological behavior of childhood obesity: A continental point of view
paper_abstract: Weight excess during the childhood has been one of the most critical public health problems worldwide in the past few decades. It is considered a significant predictor of adulthood obesity, increased cardiometabolic diseases, and premature mortality. Since the Industrial Revolution, childhood obesity has risen due to sedentary lifestyles and poor eating habits, contributing to the development of obesogenic environments around children in different parts of the world. In this regard, Oceania is positioned as the continent with the highest prevalence globally; however, these results did not consider Australia and New Zealand’s data, probably due to the significant differences in population sizes. America has the second highest percentage of children under five who are overweight. Curiously, Asia’s obesity rates are more significant in higher socioeconomic statuses and urban areas than in children aged 2-4 years. Likewise, Africa displays similar epidemiologic behaviour. Qatar and Kuwait are the countries with the highest obesity prevalence on the continent. Moreover, Europe exhibits a notable South-North gradient, which establishes a higher prevalence of obesity in Mediterranean countries than the Nordic ones. In this regard, various prevention and interventional programs have been developed to combat this silent epidemic, focusing their efforts on nutritional education, improving children’s and parents’ lifestyles, and fighting the influence of the media on their behaviour, and decisions. Therefore, the objective of this review was to describe the epidemiological behaviour of childhood obesity from a continental perspective.
review_content: Congratulations on your article. I consider that they have made a great effort and great job compiling all the data related to the current state of obesity and overweight. Despite this, the data included is not completely up to date and should be updated, since in recent years the trend has been increasing. In any case, the article is correct, written in simple and easy to understand language. In addition, numerous data are included that allow the reader to get an idea of the global problem such as overweight and obesity.
paper_title_zh: 儿童肥胖的流行病学行为：大陆视角
paper_abstract_zh: 儿童期体重超标在过去几十年中已成为全球最严重的公共卫生问题之一。它被认为是成年肥胖、心血管代谢疾病增加和过早死亡的重要预测因素。自工业革命以来，由于久坐不动的生活方式和不良饮食习惯，儿童肥胖症有所上升，导致世界各地儿童周围形成了致胖环境。在这方面，大洋洲被认为是全球儿童肥胖症患病率最高的地区；然而，这些结果并未考虑澳大利亚和新西兰的数据，可能是因为人口规模的显著差异。美洲在五岁以下超重儿童的比例中位居第二。有趣的是，亚洲的肥胖率在高社会经济地位和城市地区比2-4岁儿童中更为显著。同样，非洲也表现出类似的流行病学行为。卡塔尔和科威特是非洲大陆上肥胖症患病率最高的国家。此外，欧洲呈现出明显的南-北梯度，地中海国家的肥胖症患病率高于北欧国家。为此，已开发出多种预防和干预项目来对抗这一无声的流行病，重点放在营养教育、改善儿童及其家长的生活方式，以及对抗媒体对其行为和决策的影响。因此，本综述的目的是从大陆视角描述儿童肥胖症的流行病学行为。
review_content_zh: 祝贺您的文章。我认为他们在汇编与当前肥胖和超重状况相关的所有数据方面付出了巨大努力，并做得非常出色。尽管如此，所包含的数据并非完全最新，应进行更新，因为近年来这一趋势一直在上升。无论如何，文章是正确的，语言简洁易懂。此外，文中还包含了大量数据，使读者能够了解超重和肥胖这一全球性问题的概况。

reasons: Despite this, the data included is not completely up to date and should be updated, since in recent years the trend has been increasing.
In any case, the article is correct, written in simple and easy to understand language.

paper_title: A Scoping Review of Existing Policy Instruments to Tackle Overweight and Obesity in India: Recommendations for a Social and Behaviour Change Communication Strategy
paper_abstract:
Background 
 The Indian government is committed to addressing various manifestations of malnutrition, including overweight and obesity, inorder to improve individual health and well-being. The scoping review aims to map existing national policy instruments (programmes, schemes, regulations and guidelines) addressing overweight and obesity in India and analysing them for Social and Behaviour Change Communication (SBCC) strategies. 
 
 
 Methods 
 Systematic identification and selection of policy instruments using ‘Arksey and O’Malley’ framework was conducted from central government ministry websites, between March and June 2023. These instruments focused on nutrition and/or physical activity, targeting specific demographic groups like pregnant women, lactating mothers, children (0-5 years and 5-9 years), or adolescents (10-19 years); excluding those focusing on specific diseases like micronutrient deficiencies, wasting, and stunting. Based on search strategy six policy instruments were included and analysed for SBCC strategies. 
 
 
 Results 
 While many policy instruments incorporated SBCC plans; the ‘National Programme for Prevention of Non-Communicable Diseases (NP-NCD)’ stands out as a significant policy initiative specifically targeting the prevention of overweight and obesity within the broader context of Non-Communicable Diseases. It adopts a comprehensive approach addressing key drivers contributing to overweight/obesity across multiple levels of behavioural influence i.e., individual, interpersonal, community and organisation for health promotion. However, there’s need to strengthen SBCC strategies related to prevention and management of obesity, especially screening and counselling, to cover all age groups with a particular focus on adolescents and youth. SBCC strategies can also be incorporated into India’s Integrated Nutrition Support Programme (POSHAN 2.0) and/or Reproductive, Maternal, New-born, Child, Adolescent Health and Nutrition (RMNCAH+N) under the National Health Mission. 
 
 
 Conclusion 
 This paper underscores the necessity for comprehensive strategies to address multifaceted origins of overweight and obesity. The NP-NCD stands out as a noteworthy initiative, and there is considerable potential for other programmes to emulate SBCC strategies to bolster their overall effectiveness. 
 
 
 Note 
 : *Policy instruments throughout the paper have been used to cover programmes, schemes, regulations and guidelines.
review_content:
Thank you for the opportunity to review this article. I appreciate the effort put into this work. However, I have a few comments regarding the methods and conclusions.

Methods:
Was this scoping review registered anywhere (e.g., PROSPERO)?

The eligibility criteria for inclusion need further clarification. How were the articles screened, and who was responsible for the screening process? This should be clearly outlined to ensure transparency.

the methodology could benefit from clarification on how comprehensiveness was ensured. Researchers started with 49 and narrowed to 7 policies. Were there any search terms or Boolean logic used? Did the researchers consult any experts to validate that all relevant ministries and policies were included?

the decision to exclude policies focused on micronutrient deficiencies and wasting/stunting could be elaborated upon, given the connection between malnutrition and obesity. A more detailed rationale for exclusion would strengthen this section. Also, clarifying whether this exclusion was based on a theoretical framework, or stakeholder consultation would add strengthen this section.

Conclusion:
The conclusion can be strengthened- How your findings contribute to your overarching goals?

To create a stronger conclusion, consider adding a call-to-action directed at policymakers.
paper_title_zh: 印度应对超重和肥胖现有政策工具的范畴性综述：社会与行为改变传播策略建议
paper_abstract_zh:
背景
印度政府致力于解决各种形式的营养不良问题，包括超重和肥胖，以改善个人健康和福祉。该范围综述旨在梳理印度现有的针对超重和肥胖的国家政策工具（项目、计划、法规和指南），并分析其中的社会和行为改变传播（SBCC）策略。

方法
使用“Arksey和O’Malley”框架，从2023年3月至6月期间中央政府部门网站上系统地识别和选择政策工具。这些工具重点关注营养和/或体育活动，针对特定人口群体，如孕妇、哺乳期母亲、儿童（0-5岁和5-9岁）或青少年（10-19岁）；排除那些专注于特定疾病如微量营养素缺乏、消瘦和发育迟缓的工具。基于搜索策略，纳入并分析了六项政策工具的SBCC策略。

结果
虽然许多政策工具纳入了SBCC计划，但“国家预防非传染性疾病计划（NP-NCD）”作为一个显著的政策倡议，特别针对在非传染性疾病更广泛背景下预防超重和肥胖。它采用综合方法，针对导致超重/肥胖的关键驱动因素，在多个行为影响层面（即个体、人际、社区和组织层面）促进健康。然而，需要加强预防和管理肥胖相关的SBCC策略，特别是筛查和咨询，以覆盖所有年龄组，特别是青少年和青年。SBCC策略也可以纳入印度的综合营养支持计划（POSHAN 2.0）和/或国家健康使命下的生殖、母亲、新生儿、儿童、青少年健康和营养（RMNCAH+N）。

结论
本文强调了制定综合策略以解决超重和肥胖多方面起源的必要性。NP-NCD作为一个值得注意的倡议脱颖而出，其他项目在借鉴SBCC策略以增强其整体有效性方面具有相当大的潜力。

注
：*本文中的政策工具涵盖项目、计划、法规和指南。
review_content_zh:
感谢有机会审阅这篇文章。我赞赏这项工作中所付出的努力。然而，我对方法和结论有一些意见。

方法：
这项范围综述是否在任何地方注册过（例如，PROSPERO）？

纳入的资格标准需要进一步澄清。文章是如何筛选的，谁负责筛选过程？这应该清楚地概述以确保透明度。

方法论可以从如何确保全面性的澄清中受益。研究人员从49个开始，缩小到7项政策。是否使用了任何搜索词或布尔逻辑？研究人员是否咨询了任何专家以验证所有相关部委和政策都已包括在内？

决定排除专注于微量营养素缺乏和消瘦/发育迟缓的政策可以进一步阐述，鉴于营养不良与肥胖之间的联系。更详细的排除理由将加强这一部分。此外，澄清这种排除是基于理论框架还是利益相关者咨询，也将增强这一部分。

结论：
结论可以加强——你的发现如何有助于你的总体目标？

为了得出更有力的结论，考虑添加一个针对政策制定者的行动号召。

paper_title: Preparedness components of health systems in the Eastern Mediterranean Region for effective responses to dust and sand storms: a systematic review
paper_abstract:
Background: Dust and Sand Storm (DSS), according to estimates by global reports, will increase dramatically in the Eastern Mediterranean Region (EMR). Numerous health problems caused by DSS will be severely affected regions and vulnerable groups. This study aimed to identify the components of the preparedness of health systems for the DSS phenomenon in EMR. 
 Methods: In this systematic review, the peer-reviewed papers in four electronic databases, including Medline through PubMed, Scopus, ISI Web of Science and the Cochrane library, as well as available grey literature, were searched and selected. The research process was carried out by including papers whose results were related to the potential health effects caused by desert dusts in EMR. Was used the combination of three groups of keywords: the exposure factor, health effects as outcomes, and the countries located in EMR. The focus was on the PRISMA checklist, with no time limitations until December 2017. Finally, through 520 related citations, 30 articles were included. Descriptive and thematic content analyses were evaluated. 
 Results: The preparedness components were divided into three and ten main categories and subcategories, respectively. The three categories covered the areas of DSS hazard identification, planning and policy-making, and risk assessment. 
 Conclusions: Recognition of the health system preparedness factors for DSS in EMR will help policy-makers and managers perform appropriate measures when dealing with this hazard. More studies should be conducted to understand these factors in other parts of the world. 
 Registration: PROSPERO registration number CRD42018093325 .
review_content:
General
The paper tackles an important topic on preparedness for dust and sand storm, a common phenomenon in the EMR that has not been much studied. The authors have done a systematic review on the topic and reviewed 30 articles in a comprehensive manner. I have some specific comments:

Abstract
  * Expand results section and reduce methods.
  * Line 2: “Numerous health problems caused by DSS will be severely affected regions”: Something missing in the statement.
  * Line 2, results: The preparedness components were divided into three and ten main categories and subcategories: Revise to “The preparedness components were divided into three main categories and ten subcategories”.
Introduction
  * The introduction is concise and organized, however I feel that that the last lines “The findings of the study, with proposed recommendations, can directly help health policymakers in preparedness promotion for this phenomenon, pave the way for further studies, and add to the richness of the current knowledge” better be moved to discussion.
.Results
  * “Using of keffiyeh” in end of results, better to write what it means in brackets (Arab Headdress).
Discussion
  * Move some parts of the discussion to the introduction where they are more relevant particularly from the first paragraph.
  * The authors can also mention in the limitations that some articles might have been published in local scientific journals that are not indexed and thus were missed from the review.
paper_title_zh: 东地中海地区卫生系统应对沙尘暴的有效准备要素：系统综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：根据全球报告的估计，中东地中海地区（EMR）的沙尘暴（DSS）将显著增加。由DSS引发的大量健康问题将严重影响相关地区和脆弱群体。本研究旨在识别EMR卫生系统对DSS现象的应对准备成分。

方法：在这项系统综述中，检索并筛选了四个电子数据库中的同行评审论文，包括通过PubMed的Medline、Scopus、ISI Web of Science和Cochrane图书馆，以及可获取的灰色文献。研究过程包括结果与EMR中沙漠尘埃潜在健康影响相关的论文。使用了三组关键词的组合：暴露因素、作为结果的健康影响以及位于EMR的国家。重点关注PRISMA清单，时间不限，直至2017年12月。最终，通过520条相关引文，纳入了30篇文章。进行了描述性和主题内容分析。

结果：应对准备成分分为三个主要类别和十个子类别。三个类别涵盖了DSS危害识别、规划与政策制定以及风险评估领域。

结论：识别EMR中DSS的卫生系统应对准备因素将有助于政策制定者和管理者在应对这一危害时采取适当措施。应开展更多研究以了解世界其他地区的这些因素。

注册：PROSPERO注册号CRD42018093325。
review_content_zh:
一般
本文探讨了尘沙暴防范这一重要议题，这是中东地区常见但研究不足的现象。作者对这一主题进行了系统综述，并全面审查了30篇文章。我有以下几点具体意见：

摘要
  * 扩展结果部分，缩减方法部分。
  * 第2行：“由DSS引起的众多健康问题将严重影响地区”：该陈述中缺少内容。
  * 第2行，结果：防范要素被分为三个和十个主要类别及子类别：修改为“防范要素被分为三个主要类别和十个子类别”。
引言
  * 引言简洁有序，但我认为最后几行“研究的发现，连同提出的建议，可以直接帮助卫生政策制定者提升对此现象的防范，为后续研究铺平道路，并丰富当前知识”最好移至讨论部分。
结果
  * 结果末尾的“使用keffiyeh”，最好在括号中注明其含义（阿拉伯头巾）。
讨论
  * 将讨论中某些部分移至引言，尤其是第一段中更相关的内容。
  * 作者还可以在局限性中提到，一些文章可能发表在未索引的本地科学期刊上，因此未纳入综述。

paper_title: Socio-cultural aspects of gender-based violence and its impacts on women’s health in South Asia
review_content:
The article is on an important subject for reviews and studies, however it needs major revision.

As one looks at the title and tries to understand what the authors wish to share, the expectations given by the title are different than what the article provides. The review methodology mentions the Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews – the expectation was that they would be ordered in relation to title, socio-cultural aspects of gender based violence and relevant information, the introduction of the subject as per the title, the frequency of GBV, which socio-cultural aspects affect GBV in the proper order, what are the effects on women’s health, and to what extent.

However, as one goes through the article (if one overlooks issues related to grammar, language, and the repetition of sentences) it seems a lot was needed, and that the study format as it was designed executed and discussed is different to the design as per the title. The current structure of Introduction, Incidence, Risk Factors, Attitude aspects (with studies based on interviews, about GBV, visible, invisible), the Impact of GBV on non-pregnant and pregnant women’s health, means that some paragraphs are not really relevant to the title.

In addition, there are also references included in the Conclusion section.

Overall, in my opinion both the design and execution could have been much better, and the discussion should be more orderly also. The grammar and language should have been looked over, for example avoiding repeated sentences.
paper_title_zh: 南亚基于性别的暴力的社会文化方面及其对妇女健康的影响
paper_abstract_zh:
本文综述旨在探讨性别暴力（GBV）的社会文化根源及其对妇女健康，特别是南亚背景下生殖健康的影响。同时，识别阻碍性别相关发展目标实施的政策和能力差距，并根据当前情况提出建议。随着对妇女和儿童健康在国家发展过程中至关重要性的认识日益增强，性别暴力（GBV）相关问题在全球公共卫生议程中的重要性也在不断提升。然而，南亚和撒哈拉以南非洲等发展中地区在这方面远远落后，未能优先考虑和实施性别相关的发展策略。南亚国家在追求性别相关目标时，面临着融资、政策指导、实施和立法方面的诸多基础设施问题。本研究强调，GBV本质上是一个社会文化问题，需要制定性别敏感的社会政策，并进行战略投资，以促进特别针对提升对妇女健康和人权更为细致理解的社会资本。

方法：检索Cochrane系统评价数据库、Embase、Ovid MEDLINE、PsycINFO和Web of Science，收集2000年1月至2015年7月间发表的原著和综述文章。通过布尔搜索，使用以下关键词识别与南亚（孟加拉国、印度、尼泊尔、巴基斯坦、斯里兰卡）进行的GBV相关研究文章：南亚、GBV、IPV（亲密伴侣暴力）、家庭暴力、妇女健康、生殖健康、风险因素、施暴者、性虐待。手动检索参考文献列表以获取与本研究相关的文章（滚雪球法）。研究包含的每个国家的一名志愿者帮助审查了当地知名媒体报道和宪法，以收集与GBV问题相关的政策信息。
review_content_zh:
文章探讨了评论和研究的重要主题，但需要进行重大修订。

从标题来看，试图理解作者想要分享的内容时，标题所给出的期望与文章实际提供的内容不符。评论方法提到了Cochrane系统评价数据库——预期是它们会按照标题、性别暴力的社会文化方面和相关信息、根据标题引入主题、性别暴力的频率、哪些社会文化方面以正确顺序影响性别暴力、对女性健康的影响以及影响程度进行排序。

然而，通读文章后（如果忽略语法、语言和句子重复的问题），似乎需要补充很多内容，且研究的设计、执行和讨论格式与标题所示的设计不同。目前的结构包括引言、发生率、风险因素、态度方面（基于访谈的研究，关于性别暴力，可见和不可见的）、性别暴力对非孕和孕妇健康的影响，这意味着有些段落与标题并不真正相关。

此外，结论部分也包含了一些参考文献。

总体而言，在我看来，设计和执行本可以更好，讨论也应更有条理。语法和语言应进行审查，例如避免重复句子。

paper_title: An overview of biomass conversion: Exploring new opportunities
paper_abstract: Recycling biomass is indispensable these days not only because fossil energy sources are gradually depleted, but also because pollution of the environment, caused by the increasing use of energy, must be reduced. This paper intends to overview the results of plant biomass processing methods that are currently in use. Our aim was also to review published methods that are not currently in use. It is intended to explore the possibilities of new methods and enzymes to be used in biomass recycling. The results of this overview are perplexing in almost every area. Advances have been made in the pre-treatment of biomass and in the diversity and applications of the enzymes utilized. Based on molecular modeling, very little progress has been made in the modification of existing enzymes for altered function and adaptation for the environmental conditions during the processing of biomass. There are hardly any publications in which molecular modeling techniques are used to improve enzyme function and to adapt enzymes to various environmental conditions. Our view is that using modern computational, biochemical, and biotechnological methods would enable the purposeful design of enzymes that are more efficient and suitable for biomass processing.
review_content: Reviewer 1: Huiying Luo Dear Huiying Luo, We thank you for your helpful comments on our manuscript “An overview of biomass conversion: Exploring new opportunities”. We have seriously edited our manuscript to address your concerns. Basic reporting This paper intended to overview the plant biomass processing methods and intend to explore the possibilities of new methods and enzymes to be used in biomass recyclization. But the structure and logic of the whole manuscript is not very clear, and the authors should have thought more deeply and provide more own perspective and important conclusions. Our aim was to review the diversity of plant biomass degradation methods and to present the different options for the production of the final product. Almost all options have been reviewed, "Mechanical, physico-chemical and biotechnological modifications of substrates"; "Application of new and special enzymes"; "Modify the enzymes and increase their efficiency". The latter was evaluated from two perspectives: "Modification and utilization of enzymes by molecular biological, biotechnological, and computational methods" and "Modification of enzymes using molecular modeling methods". There are very few articles on the latter. In an existing biomass degradation technique, the enzyme could also be modified to better adapt to the given conditions, such as increased pH stability, increased enzyme efficiency under the given conditions, thermal stability, and so on. All this is possible using special molecular modeling methods. There are still very few examples of their exploitation. We would like to draw attention to this. We’ve reworked the manuscript accordingly, adding 50 new articles, most of which are from the last two years! paper_title_zh: 生物质转化概述：探索新机遇
paper_abstract_zh: 如今，回收生物质不仅因为化石能源逐渐枯竭而不可或缺，还因为必须减少由于能源使用增加而导致的环境污染。本文旨在概述目前使用的植物生物质处理方法的结果。我们的目标也是回顾那些目前未使用但已发表的方法。本文意在探索用于生物质回收的新方法和酶的可能性。这一概述的结果在几乎所有领域都令人困惑。在生物质的预处理以及所用酶的多样性和应用方面已取得进展。基于分子建模，在改造现有酶以改变其功能以及适应生物质处理过程中的环境条件方面，进展非常有限。几乎没有出版物使用分子建模技术来改善酶功能并使酶适应各种环境条件。我们认为，利用现代计算、生化及生物技术方法，能够有目的地设计出更高效、更适用于生物质处理的酶。

审稿人1：罗慧英

结果有效性 无评论

paper_title: Nutrition transition in South Asia: the emergence of non-communicable chronic diseases
paper_abstract: Overview: South Asian countries have experienced a remarkable economic growth during last two decades along with subsequent transformation in social, economic and food systems. Rising disposable income levels continue to drive the nutrition transition characterized by a shift from a traditional high-carbohydrate, low-fat diets towards diets with a lower carbohydrate and higher proportion of saturated fat, sugar and salt. Steered by various transitions in demographic, economic and nutritional terms, South Asian population are experiencing a rapidly changing disease profile. While the healthcare systems have long been striving to disentangle from the vicious cycle of poverty and undernutrition, South Asian countries are now confronted with an emerging epidemic of obesity and a constellation of other non-communicable diseases (NCDs). This dual burden is bringing about a serious health and economic conundrum and is generating enormous pressure on the already overstretched healthcare system of South Asian countries.   Objectives : The Nutrition transition has been a very popular topic in the field of human nutrition during last few decades and many countries and broad geographic regions have been studied. However there is no review on this topic in the context of South Asia  as yet. The main purpose of this review is to highlight the factors accounting for the onset of nutrition transition and its subsequent impact on epidemiological transition in five major South Asian countries including Bangladesh, India, Nepal, Pakistan and Sri Lanka. Special emphasis was given on India and Bangladesh as they together account for 94% of the regional population and about half world’s malnourished population.  Methods : This study is literature based. Main data sources were published research articles obtained through an electronic medical databases search.
review_content:
This is a widespread, well-balanced and comprehensive review of study over the last two decades on the nutrition transition. The manuscript reads well and has important findings. The introduction clearly defines the purpose of the manuscript and the relevance to the policy practice.

However, the author does not clearly describe the literature search strategies in the methods section as he mentioned it in the objective of the study. He stated that he used several electronic databases including COCHRANE library. Has he fulfilled the COCHRANE checklist? He also did not clearly state the inclusion and exclusion criteria. Even he stated that there were no special exclusion criteria (why there are no special exclusion criteria?). My concerns are while the method of review paper is unclear, it will dilute the findings and the discussion later. I found that some of findings are diluted and unclear.

In revising the manuscript, the author should:
 1. Divide the published studies between review studies and empirical studies, and bring to light emerging evidence from existing review studies and clarify what new evidence is learnt from their review.
 2. Divide evidence regarding different terms of transition that he focused on and explanatory factors contributing to the nutrition transition in South Asia.
 3. In the "Methods" section, clarify which are the inclusion and exclusion criteria, the agreement for selecting the published articles used for review, the indicator(s) are used to evaluate the nutrition transition or lack of it, and attempt in the presentation of the findings to interpret the sensitivity of the findings to alternative specification of indicator for measuring the timing and stage of transitions.
 4. Summarise in a table the evidences (and number of studies) for the nutrition transition by country coverage (rural, urban, sub-national, national); then address the extent to which the predictive article expected from the nutrition transition has varied across study countries.
paper_title_zh: 南亚的营养转型：非传染性慢性疾病的出现
paper_abstract_zh:
概述：在过去的二十年里，南亚国家经历了显著的经济增长，随之而来的是社会、经济和食品系统的转型。不断上升的可支配收入水平继续推动营养转型，其特征是从传统的富含碳水化合物、低脂肪的饮食转向低碳水化合物和高饱和脂肪、糖和盐的饮食。在人口、经济和营养方面的各种转型推动下，南亚人口正在经历快速变化的疾病谱。尽管医疗保健系统长期以来一直在努力摆脱贫困和营养不良的恶性循环，但南亚国家现在面临着肥胖流行和其他一系列非传染性疾病（NCDs）的涌现。这种双重负担带来了严重的健康和经济困境，并对已经过度紧张的南亚国家医疗保健系统产生了巨大压力。

目标：在过去的几十年里，营养转型一直是人类营养领域非常热门的话题，许多国家和广泛的地理区域都进行了研究。然而，迄今为止还没有关于南亚背景下这一主题的综述。本综述的主要目的是突出导致营养转型开始的因素及其对孟加拉国、印度、尼泊尔、巴基斯坦和斯里兰卡等五个主要南亚国家的流行病学转型的后续影响。特别强调了印度和孟加拉国，因为它们共同占该地区人口的94%和全球营养不良人口的大约一半。

方法：本研究基于文献。主要数据来源是通过电子医学数据库搜索获得的已发表研究文章。
review_content_zh:
这是一篇广泛、均衡且全面的综述，回顾了过去二十年间关于营养转型的相关研究。手稿读起来流畅，并包含重要发现。引言部分清晰地定义了手稿的目的及其与政策实践的相关性。

然而，作者在方法部分并未清晰地描述文献检索策略，尽管他在研究目标中提及了这一点。他提到使用了包括Cochrane图书馆在内的多个电子数据库。他是否完成了Cochrane清单？他也没有明确说明纳入和排除标准。即使他提到没有特别的排除标准（为何没有特别的排除标准？）。我的担忧是，综述论文的方法不明确，将会削弱后续的发现和讨论。我发现一些发现被稀释且不清晰。

在修订手稿时，作者应：
1. 将已发表的研究分为综述研究和实证研究，并揭示现有综述研究中出现的新证据，并明确从他们的综述中了解到的新证据。
2. 将他关注的不同转型阶段的证据及其对南亚营养转型贡献的解释性因素进行分类。
3. 在“方法”部分，明确纳入和排除标准，选择用于综述的已发表文章的协议，用于评估营养转型或其缺乏的指标，并在呈现发现时尝试解释发现对替代指标规格的敏感性，以衡量转型的时机和阶段。
4. 在表格中总结营养转型的证据（及研究数量），按国家覆盖范围（农村、城市、次国家级、国家级）分类；然后讨论预测文章中预期的营养转型在不同研究国家间的变异程度。

Has he fulfilled the COCHRANE checklist?
He also did not clearly state the inclusion and exclusion criteria. Even he stated that there were no special exclusion criteria (why there are no special exclusion criteria?).
While the article and its content are poignant additions to literature on nutrition and NCDs, and the manuscript is in large part quite well-written, it could greatly benefit from a few improvements.

I would like to commend the author on making a very important point about the economic burden of NCDs, especially on vulnerable households; that NCDs are both a socioeconomic determinant of health, as well as a result of poor socioeconomic status.
The manuscript reads well and has important findings.
My concerns are while the method of review paper is unclear, it will dilute the findings and the discussion later. I found that some of findings are diluted and unclear.

paper_title: Food sovereignty: an alternative paradigm for poverty reduction and biodiversity conservation in Latin America
paper_abstract: Strong feedback between global biodiversity loss and persistent, extreme rural poverty are major challenges in the face of concurrent food, energy, and environmental crises. This paper examines the role of industrial agricultural intensification and market integration as exogenous socio-ecological drivers of biodiversity loss and poverty traps in Latin America. We then analyze the potential of a food sovereignty framework, based on protecting the viability of a diverse agroecological matrix while supporting rural livelihoods and global food production. We review several successful examples of this approach, including ecological land reform in Brazil, agroforestry, milpa , and the uses of wild varieties in smallholder systems in Mexico and Central America. We highlight emergent research directions that will be necessary to assess the potential of the food sovereignty model to promote both biodiversity conservation and poverty reduction.
review_content:
Drawing upon a systematic review of existing literature, this article evaluates the popular claim that the food sovereignty agenda will not only democratize food provisioning, but also alleviate the poverty of food producers and encourage the conservation of biodiversity in agrarian landscapes. In so doing, it represents a valuable contribution to the academic debate and carries important ramifications for envisioning and implementing future agricultures. The authors effectively deploy the concept of poverty traps to challenge the common claim that environmental degradation, including biodiversity loss, is an inevitable consequence of rural poverty alleviation, thereby contributing to a growing literature demonstrating that economic and political democracy can, in fact, promote sustainable agricultural practices (see, for example James Boyce’s work on natural assets). Their survey of the relevant literature also demonstrates how two tenants of the food sovereignty framework, small-scale peasant-based agriculture and agro-ecological practices, are associated with higher levels of biodiversity and more resilient food systems. Overall, it’s an insightful article that effectively and concisely analyzes the relevant literatures in the social and natural sciences.

The title and abstract of the article are appropriate and accurately reflect the content of the paper. The article is logically structured and well-written. The analysis is impressive and draws upon a comprehensive review of the relevant literatures. It’s an important contribution and I highly recommend its indexing.
paper_title_zh: 食物主权：拉丁美洲减贫与生物多样性保护的替代范式
paper_abstract_zh: 全球生物多样性丧失与持续、极端的农村贫困之间的强烈反馈，在面对同时发生的粮食、能源和环境危机时，构成了重大挑战。本文探讨了工业农业集约化和市场一体化作为拉丁美洲生物多样性丧失和贫困陷阱的外生社会-生态驱动因素的作用。随后，我们分析了基于保护多样化农业生态矩阵的可行性，同时支持农村生计和全球粮食生产的粮食主权框架的潜力。我们回顾了这一方法的几个成功案例，包括巴西的生态土地改革、农林复合系统、米尔帕（milpa）以及墨西哥和中美洲小农系统中野生品种的利用。我们强调了新兴的研究方向，这些方向对于评估粮食主权模式在促进生物多样性保护和减少贫困方面的潜力将是必要的。
review_content_zh:
本文通过对现有文献的系统回顾，评估了这样一种流行观点：食物主权议程不仅将民主化食物供应，还将减轻食物生产者的贫困，并鼓励在农业景观中保护生物多样性。在此过程中，它为学术辩论提供了宝贵的贡献，并对设想和实施未来农业具有重要意义。作者有效地运用了贫困陷阱的概念，挑战了环境退化（包括生物多样性丧失）是农村贫困缓解不可避免后果的常见观点，从而为日益增长的文献做出了贡献，这些文献表明经济和政治民主实际上可以促进可持续农业实践（例如，参见詹姆斯·博伊斯关于自然资产的研究）。他们对相关文献的综述还展示了食物主权框架的两个要素，即小规模农民基础农业和农业生态实践，与更高水平的生物多样性和更具韧性的食物系统相关联。总体而言，这是一篇富有洞察力的文章，有效地、简洁地分析了社会科学和自然科学中的相关文献。

文章的标题和摘要恰当且准确地反映了论文的内容。文章逻辑结构清晰，文笔流畅。分析令人印象深刻，基于对相关文献的全面回顾。这是一项重要贡献，我强烈建议对其进行索引。

paper_title: COVID-19, Cation Dysmetabolism, Sialic Acid, CD147, ACE2, Viroporins, Hepcidin and Ferroptosis: A Possible Unifying Hypothesis
paper_abstract:
Background: iron and calcium dysmetabolism, with hyperferritinemia, hypoferremia, hypocalcemia and anemia have been documented in the majority of COVID-19 patients at later/worse stages. Furthermore, complementary to ACE2, both sialic acid (SA) molecules and CD147 proved relevant host receptors for SARS-CoV-2 entry, which explains the viral attack to multiple types of cells, including erythrocytes, endothelium and neural tissue. Several authors advocated that cell ferroptosis may be the core and final cell degenerative mechanism. 
 Methods : a literature research was performed in several scientific search engines, such as PubMed Central, Cochrane Library, Chemical Abstract Service. More than 500 articles were retrieved until mid-December 2021, to highlight the available evidence about the investigated issues. 
 Results : based on COVID-19 literature data, we have highlighted a few pathophysiological mechanisms, associated with virus-based cation dysmetabolism, multi-organ attack, mitochondria degeneration and ferroptosis. Our suggested elucidated pathological sequence is: a) spike protein subunit S1 docking with sialylated membrane glycoproteins/receptors (ACE2, CD147), and S2 subunit fusion with the lipid layer; b) cell membrane morpho-functional changes due to the consequent electro-chemical variations and viroporin action, which induce an altered ion channel function and intracellular cation accumulation; c) additional intracellular iron concentration due to a deregulated hepcidin-ferroportin axis, with higher hepcidin levels. Viral invasion may also affect erythrocytes/erythroid precursors, endothelial cells and macrophages, through SA and CD147 receptors, with relative hemoglobin and iron/calcium dysmetabolism. AB0 blood group, hemochromatosis, or environmental elements may represent possible factors which affect individual susceptibility to COVID-19.     
 Conclusions : our literature analysis confirms the combined role of SA molecules, ACE2, CD147, viroporins and hepcidin in determining the cation dysmetabolism and final ferroptosis in the cells infected by SARS-CoV-2. The altered ion channels and electrochemical gradients of the cell membrane have a pivotal role in the virus entry and cell dysmetabolism, with subsequent multi-organ immune-inflammatory degeneration and erythrocyte/hemoglobin alterations.
review_content:
Attilio et al. did a short review connecting the link between COVID-19 and ferroptosis.

In fact, the association between SARS-CoV-2 infection and Ferroptosis was firstly proposed by Yang et al. 20201. Therefore, citing this paper to further support this review is essential.

Ferroptosis was firstly proposed in 2012 and currently three pathways have been proposed: GPX-4, FSP1, and DHODH. The author should write a section summarizing recent advances about ferroptosis. It would also be useful to discuss how exactly COVID-19 links to any of them.

It has been shown that ACE2, CD147, viroporins and hepcidin are cell membrane targets of SARS-CoV-2 spikes. On the other hand, Transferrin and ferriportin are in the charge of iron influx and efflux. How to link the two in COVID-19 patients is also worth a discussion.

Delta and Omicron have much more spike mutations, it is important to analysis potential novel receptors other than ACE2, CD147 and viroporins that the virus may bind to.
paper_title_zh: COVID-19、阳离子代谢紊乱、唾液酸、CD147、ACE2、病毒孔蛋白、肝素和铁死亡：一个可能的统一假说
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：在大多数晚期/重症COVID-19患者中，已记录到铁和钙代谢紊乱，表现为高 ferritin血症、低铁血症、低钙血症和贫血。此外，除了ACE2外，唾液酸（SA）分子和CD147也被证实是SARS-CoV-2进入宿主细胞的相关受体，这解释了病毒对包括红细胞、内皮和神经组织在内的多种类型细胞的攻击。一些作者主张细胞铁死亡可能是核心和最终的细胞退变机制。

方法：在多个科学搜索引擎（如PubMed Central、Cochrane Library、Chemical Abstract Service）进行了文献研究。截至2021年12月中旬，检索到500多篇相关文章，以突出所研究问题的现有证据。

结果：基于COVID-19的文献数据，我们突出了几种与病毒引起的阳离子代谢紊乱、多器官攻击、线粒体退变和铁死亡相关的病理生理机制。我们提出的病理序列为：a）S1亚单位与唾液酸化的膜糖蛋白/受体（ACE2、CD147）结合，S2亚单位与脂质层融合；b）由于随后的电化学变化和病毒孔蛋白作用导致的细胞膜形态功能变化，诱导离子通道功能改变和细胞内阳离子积累；c）由于肝素-铁转运蛋白轴失调导致细胞内铁浓度进一步增加，肝素水平升高。病毒入侵还可能通过SA和CD147受体影响红细胞/红系前体、内皮细胞和巨噬细胞，导致相应的血红蛋白和铁/钙代谢紊乱。AB0血型、血色病或环境因素可能是影响个体对COVID-19易感性的可能因素。

结论：我们的文献分析证实了SA分子、ACE2、CD147、病毒孔蛋白和肝素在决定SARS-CoV-2感染细胞中阳离子代谢紊乱和最终铁死亡中的联合作用。细胞膜上改变的离子通道和电化学梯度在病毒进入和细胞代谢紊乱中起关键作用，随后导致多器官免疫炎症退变和红细胞/血红蛋白改变。
review_content_zh:
阿蒂利奥等人进行了一项简短的综述，探讨了COVID-19与铁死亡之间的联系。

事实上，SARS-CoV-2感染与铁死亡之间的关联最早由杨等人于2020年提出。因此，引用这篇论文以进一步支持本综述是必要的。

铁死亡最早于2012年提出，目前已有三种途径被提出：GPX-4、FSP1和DHODH。作者应撰写一节总结铁死亡的最新进展。讨论COVID-19如何确切地与其中任何一种途径相关联也将是有益的。

研究表明，ACE2、CD147、病毒孔蛋白和肝素是SARS-CoV-2刺突蛋白的细胞膜靶点。另一方面，转铁蛋白和铁转运蛋白负责铁的流入和流出。如何将这两者在COVID-19患者中联系起来也值得讨论。

Delta和Omicron变异株具有更多的刺突突变，分析病毒可能结合的除ACE2、CD147和病毒孔蛋白之外的新型潜在受体是非常重要的。

Ferroptosis was firstly proposed in 2012 and currently three pathways have been proposed: GPX-4, FSP1, and DHODH.

To make it more precise, the authors may add in Fig.1 that they mean the membrane potential as the absolute value of the difference between electric potential inside and outside the cell, but it is not necessary.

paper_title: Smartphone applications are used for self-management, telerehabilitation, evaluation and data collection in low back pain healthcare: a scoping review
paper_abstract:
Background 
     Smartphone use has grown in providing healthcare for patients with low back pain (LBP), but the literature lacks an analysis of the use of smartphone apps. This scoping review aimed to identify current areas of smartphone apps use for managing LBP. We also aimed to evaluate the current status of the effectiveness or scientific validity of such use and determine perspectives for their potential development. 
   
   
     Methods 
     We searched PubMed, PEDro and Embase for articles published in English up to May 3rd, 2021 that investigated smartphone use for LBP healthcare and their purpose. All types of study design were accepted. Studies concerning telemedicine or telerehabilitation but without use of a smartphone were not included. The same search strategy was performed by two researchers independently and a third researcher validated the synthesis of the included studies. 
   
   
     Results 
     We included 43 articles: randomised controlled trials (RCTs) (n=12), study protocols (n=6), reliability/validity studies (n=6), systematic reviews (n=7), cohort studies (n=4), qualitative studies (n=6), and case series (n=1). The purposes of the smartphone app were for 1) evaluation, 2) telerehabilitation, 3) self-management, and 4) data collection. Self-management was the most-studied use, showing promising results derived from moderate- to good-quality RCTs for patients with chronic LBP and patients after spinal surgery. Promising results exist regarding evaluation and data collection use and contradictory results regarding measurement use. 
   
   
     Conclusions 
     This scoping review revealed a notable interest in the scientific literatures regarding the use of smartphone apps for LBP patients. The identified purposes point to current scientific status and perspectives for further studies including RCTs and systematic reviews targeting specific usage.
review_content:
First of all, I would like to complement the authors on this clearly written and relevant scoping review. It's nice to read a review with a broader scope than just evidence of treatment effect.

The rationale and objectives of the study are clear for me. The introduction gives good context on the topic.

The methods used are quite clear and repeatable, but with some remarks:
- In the exclusion criteria, it's not fully clear if you also excluded physical activity promotion or lifestyle advise for people with low back pain (or only for healthy people).
- You included study protocols, but what did you do when those studies were performed and published? Since they can describe the exact same study, can you mention if you excluded protocols when the article of the finished study was published for example. Or any other way of handling them if you included them both.
- In the synthesis, can you explain how you drew conclusions like 'promising'. Did you draw those conclusions yourselves or did you take (copy-paste) these conclusions from the included article (like you do mention in table 2 under 'author's conclusion')?

This last point applies for the results and discussion/conclusion as well. Quite often you use conclusions like 'promising'. To me, it's too subjective (and perhaps biased). It would be nice if you can give some clarity on that. I understand it's not the main goal like in a systematic review or meta-analysis.
paper_title_zh: 智能手机应用程序在腰背痛健康管理中的自我管理、远程康复、评估和数据收集应用：一项范围综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景
智能手机在为腰背痛（LBP）患者提供医疗保健方面的应用日益增长，但文献中缺乏对智能手机应用程序使用的分析。本范围综述旨在确定当前智能手机应用程序在管理LBP方面的应用领域。我们还旨在评估此类应用的有效性或科学有效性的当前状态，并确定其潜在发展的前景。

方法
我们在PubMed、PEDro和Embase数据库中搜索了截至2021年5月3日发表的英文文章，这些文章研究了智能手机在LBP医疗保健中的应用及其目的。接受所有类型的研究设计。涉及远程医疗或远程康复但未使用智能手机的研究不包括在内。两名研究人员独立进行相同的搜索策略，第三名研究人员验证了所包含研究的综合。

结果
我们纳入了43篇文章：随机对照试验（RCTs）（n=12）、研究方案（n=6）、可靠性/有效性研究（n=6）、系统综述（n=7）、队列研究（n=4）、定性研究（n=6）和病例系列（n=1）。智能手机应用程序的用途包括1）评估、2）远程康复、3）自我管理和4）数据收集。自我管理是最常研究的用途，显示出从中等到高质量RCTs中得出的有希望的结果，适用于慢性LBP患者和脊柱手术后患者。评估和数据收集用途存在有希望的结果，而测量用途的结果存在矛盾。

结论
本范围综述揭示了科学文献中对智能手机应用程序用于LBP患者的显著兴趣。确定的用途指向当前科学状态和进一步研究的视角，包括针对特定用途的RCTs和系统综述。
review_content_zh:
首先，我想对作者在这篇清晰撰写且相关范围广泛的综述表示赞赏。很高兴读到一篇范围不仅仅局限于治疗效果证据的综述。

该研究的理论基础和目标对我来说是明确的。引言部分很好地提供了主题的背景。

所使用的方法相当清晰且可重复，但有一些需要指出的问题：
- 在排除标准中，是否也排除了针对下腰痛患者的体力活动促进或生活方式建议（或仅针对健康人群）这一点并不完全清楚。
- 你们纳入了研究方案，但当这些研究完成并发表时，你们是如何处理的？由于它们可能描述完全相同的研究，你们能否说明例如当完成研究的文章发表时是否排除了方案，或者如果两者都纳入，是否有其他处理方式。
- 在综合分析中，你们能否解释是如何得出“有前景”这样的结论的？是你们自己得出的这些结论，还是从所纳入的文章中摘录（如你们在表2中的“作者结论”下所提到的）？

最后一点也适用于结果和讨论/结论部分。你们经常使用“有前景”这样的结论。对我来说，这显得过于主观（或许有偏见）。如果你们能对此提供一些明确说明会更好。我理解这并非像系统综述或元分析那样的主要目标。

paper_title: Recycling of collagen from solid tannery waste and prospective utilization as adhesives.
paper_abstract:
Abstract 
   This study explores the innovative potential of recycled collagen derived from tannery waste for use in high-performance adhesive formulations. The leather industry generates significant amounts of solid waste, primarily from chromium-tanned leather, which poses substantial environmental challenges. Recent advancements in recycling techniques have opened new avenues for repurposing this waste, particularly through collagen extraction, which comprises about 30-35% of tannery residues. This research systematically reviews the methods and applications of collagen extraction, highlighting the material’s versatility and environmental benefits when used as a bio-adhesive. 
   The review identifies key challenges such as low water resistance, shear strength, and adhesiveness in collagen-based adhesives compared to synthetic counterparts. However, innovative solutions are emerging, including the incorporation of silane coupling agents and cross-linking technologies that significantly improve the water resistance and mechanical properties of these adhesives. Economic analyses further support the viability of using tannery waste-derived collagen in adhesive production, aligning with global sustainability goals and reducing reliance on petrochemical-based adhesives. 
   Despite these advancements, the transition from laboratory research to commercial applications remains a significant challenge. Current studies primarily focus on small-scale experiments, with limited pilot-scale studies available. Nonetheless, the potential for collagen-based adhesives to replace harmful chemicals in industrial applications is promising, especially in sectors requiring biodegradable and non-toxic materials. This review concludes that while significant progress has been made, further research is necessary to overcome existing limitations and fully realize the commercial potential of collagen-based adhesives derived from tannery waste.
review_content:
I fully agree with the issues raised by the first reviewer Ali Yorgancioglu from Ege Üniversitesi, Bornova, Turkey. The topic of the review is very important, but the paper has its scientific limitations. I will not repeat here the topics that have already been addressed and precisely outlined by reviewer 1.
Additional topics are:
  * Literature source missing for the statement that Typ I Col is the best Col type for glueing (p. 7)
  * The intended uses of adhesives, technical and medical, should not be mixed and should be clearly separated, ideally with their respective specific challenges for the use of collagen or gelatine as an adhesive. If possible, the market data should also refer to these two very different applications.
  * Practical data is lacking, especially for the technical application. Gelatine as an adhesive is already used industrially. It would be instructive to discuss where the actual limits to increased use are (price?, properties?, and how the respective deficits can be overcome)
  * Captions should be more precise (e.g. Fig. 4: Explain a - d)
paper_title_zh: 从固体制革废料中回收胶原蛋白及其作为粘合剂的潜在应用
paper_abstract_zh:
摘要
本研究探讨了源自制革废料的再生胶原蛋白在高性能粘合剂配方中的创新潜力。皮革行业产生了大量的固体废物，主要来自铬鞣皮革，这对环境构成了重大挑战。近年来，回收技术的进步为重新利用这些废物开辟了新途径，特别是通过胶原蛋白提取，这约占制革废渣的30-35%。本研究系统地综述了胶原蛋白提取的方法和应用，强调了将该材料用作生物粘合剂时的多功能性和环境效益。
综述识别了胶原蛋白基粘合剂与合成粘合剂相比存在的主要挑战，如低水 resistance、剪切强度和粘附性。然而，创新解决方案正在涌现，包括引入硅烷偶联剂和交联技术，这些技术显著提高了这些粘合剂的水 resistance 和机械性能。经济分析进一步支持了使用源自制革废料的胶原蛋白进行粘合剂生产的可行性，这与全球可持续发展目标一致，并减少了对石油化工基粘合剂的依赖。
尽管取得了这些进展，但从实验室研究到商业应用的转变仍然是一个重大挑战。当前研究主要集中在小规模实验，有限的 pilot-scale 研究可供参考。尽管如此，胶原蛋白基粘合剂在工业应用中替代有害化学品的潜力是令人期待的，尤其是在需要可生物降解和无毒材料的领域。本综述得出结论，尽管已取得显著进展，但仍需进一步研究以克服现有局限，并充分实现源自制革废料的胶原蛋白基粘合剂的商业潜力。
review_content_zh:
我完全同意来自土耳其博尔诺瓦爱琴大学的首位审稿人阿里·约尔甘乔卢提出的问题。这篇综述的主题非常重要，但论文在科学上存在局限性。我将不再重复审稿人1已经详细阐述过的内容。
其他需要关注的问题包括：
  * 关于“Typ I Col是最佳粘合用Col类型”的陈述缺少文献来源（第7页）
  * 粘合剂的预期用途，包括技术和医疗用途，不应混淆，应明确区分，理想情况下应分别讨论使用胶原蛋白或明胶作为粘合剂的具体挑战。如果可能，市场数据也应针对这两种截然不同的应用进行说明。
  * 缺乏实际应用数据，尤其是技术应用方面。明胶作为粘合剂已在工业中使用。讨论实际限制其更广泛应用的因素（价格？性能？以及如何克服相应的缺陷）将具有指导意义。
  * 图注应更加精确（例如，图4：解释a - d）

paper_title: A Concept of Air Quality Mitigation through the Planned Behavior of University Students Towards Sustainable Campuses
paper_abstract:
Background 
 Increased awareness of sustainability has renewed academic interest in understanding perception. The objective was to determine the expected behavior among university students concerning air quality mitigation. The theory of planned behavior (TPB) was used as a theoretical framework to understand students’ attitudes toward air quality mitigation along with subjective norms and perceived behavioral control. 
 
 
 Method 
 This study uses the systematic literature review (SLR) methodology to provide an understanding of current studies regarding the aspect of air quality and behavior from databases reviewed by experts. The research highlights the gap in the current study area and provides a need for more detailed empirical research. 
 
 
 Result 
 The study reviewed 24 articles and proposed a conceptual model based on the TPB framework to understand the means of air quality mitigation behaviors in a campus environment. 
 
 
 Conclusion 
 This model aims to guide future research to improve air quality in higher education institutions. The findings also focuses on theoretical contributions by applying TPB.
review_content:
Reviewer Comments:
The paper presents a well-structured methodology, which is commendable given the limited number of available articles supporting the research. However, there are areas that require further refinement to strengthen the study's contribution.
Major Comments:
 1. Discussion and Conclusions: A greater focus is needed on the discussion section and conclusions. It would be beneficial to expand on how contextual differences influence behaviour to provide a broader understanding of the applicability of the theory of planned behaviour.
 2. Introduction:
      + The term "planetary boundary areas" is not clearly defined. Please clarify its meaning and relevance to the study.
      + The introduction requires additional supporting references to enhance the background information.
      + In the second paragraph, the term "Theory of Planned Behaviour" should be fully spelled out the first time it appears for clarity.
      + In section 1.1, if possible, provide a contextual definition of the campus under study to offer better insight into the research setting.
      + In some instances, multiple references are required. For example, the sentence listing the harmful effects of air pollutants on students would be more credible with additional citations.
 3. Section 1.2:
      + A footnote should be added to the NAAQS references to clarify their origin and the contexts in which they apply.
 4. Section 1.3:
      + The objectives of the research should be elaborated upon to provide a clearer understanding of the study’s goals.
 5. Methodology:
      + After section 2.3, a transition should be added before describing the systematic review. This will improve the logical flow of the research.
      + More background is needed on how the 54 articles included in the systematic review were selected to ensure transparency and reliability in the study.
 6. Results and Analysis:
      + This section is well-executed, demonstrating strong research rigor.
      + The diagrams are well-represented and enhance the clarity of the findings.
 7. Discussion (Section 4):
      + This section should highlight the main discussion points more clearly.
      + The current structure contains many sections that introduce various concepts, but they need to be better linked to each other to provide a coherent narrative.
      + The diagram in section 4.1 should be more explicitly reflected in the accompanying discussion.
 8. Future Research Directions (Section 7):
      + This section should provide a clearer roadmap on how researchers can build upon the current study.
      + It should explicitly outline how future research could utilize these findings for further advancements.
 9. Conclusion:
      + The conclusion should summarize key lessons learned from the study more directly.
Final Remarks: This research contributes significantly to the understanding of air quality mitigation in university campuses through the Theory of Planned Behaviour. The methodology is strong, and the results are well-presented. However, improvements in the discussion, introduction, and conclusion sections, along with a clearer connection between concepts, will further enhance the paper’s impact. Thank you for your research efforts.
paper_title_zh: 通过大学生对可持续校园的规划行为实现空气质量缓解的概念
paper_abstract_zh:
背景
对可持续性意识的提升重新激发了学术界对理解感知的兴趣。本研究旨在确定大学生在空气质量缓解方面的预期行为。计划行为理论（TPB）被用作理论框架，以理解学生对空气质量缓解的态度，以及主观规范和感知行为控制。

方法
本研究采用系统文献综述（SLR）方法，以了解专家审查的数据库中关于空气质量和行为方面的当前研究。研究突出了当前研究领域的空白，并提出了需要更详细的实证研究。

结果
本研究回顾了24篇文章，并基于TPB框架提出了一个概念模型，以理解校园环境中空气质量缓解行为的方式。

结论
该模型旨在指导未来研究，以改善高等教育机构的空气质量。研究结果还通过应用TPB聚焦于理论贡献。
review_content_zh:
审稿人意见：
本文提出了一种结构良好的方法论，鉴于支持该研究的可用文章数量有限，这一点值得称赞。然而，为了加强研究的贡献，某些方面仍需进一步改进。
主要意见：
1. 讨论与结论：需要更加关注讨论部分和结论。扩展关于情境差异如何影响行为的讨论，将有助于更广泛地理解计划行为理论的适用性。
2. 引言：
   + “行星边界区域”这一术语未明确定义。请澄清其含义及其与研究的关联性。
   + 引言部分需要增加支持性参考文献，以增强背景信息。
   + 在第二段中，首次出现“计划行为理论”时应完整拼写，以保持清晰。
   + 在1.1节中，如有可能，请提供所研究校园的情境定义，以便更好地了解研究背景。
   + 在某些情况下，需要多个参考文献。例如，列举空气污染物对学生有害影响的句子，若有更多引用将更具可信度。
3. 1.2节：
   + 应在NAAQS参考文献中添加脚注，以澄清其来源及适用情境。
4. 1.3节：
   + 应详细阐述研究目标，以便更清晰地理解研究目的。
5. 方法论：
   + 在2.3节后，应在描述系统综述之前添加过渡段落，以改善研究的逻辑流程。
   + 需要更多背景信息，说明系统综述中包含的54篇文章是如何选定的，以确保研究的透明度和可靠性。
6. 结果与分析：
   + 本节执行得很好，展示了强大的研究严谨性。
   + 图表呈现良好，增强了发现结果的清晰度。
7. 讨论（第4节）：
   + 本节应更清晰地突出主要讨论点。
   + 当前结构包含许多介绍不同概念的部分，但它们需要更好地相互关联，以提供连贯的叙述。
   + 4.1节中的图表应在伴随讨论中更明确地反映出来。
8. 未来研究方向（第7节）：
   + 本节应提供更清晰的路线图，说明研究者如何基于当前研究进行拓展。
   + 应明确概述未来研究如何利用这些发现以实现进一步进展。
9. 结论：
   + 结论应更直接地总结研究中的关键教训。
最终评论：本研究通过计划行为理论，对大学校园空气质量缓解的理解做出了重要贡献。方法论扎实，结果呈现良好。然而，改进讨论、引言和结论部分，以及更清晰地连接概念，将进一步增强论文的影响力。感谢您的研究努力。

paper_title: A blended model of interior design studio practice due to COVID-19
paper_abstract:
Background: The coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic upended the educational system around the globe. During this challenging period, universities and colleges looked for other effective alternative methods of learning, such as Virtual Learning Environments (VL). Besides, Ahlia University has implemented E-learning in response to COVID-19. There needs to be more attention given to the challenges associated with technology adoption facing interior design and architecture programs, where over 60% of courses are practical, especially design studios, which form the core of the curriculum. According to a review of the relevant literature, there needs to be more research on blended learning in interior design and architecture. In order to enhance the teaching and learning of interior design and architecture, further research is required to combine cutting-edge techniques and technology. The aim of this study was to review the classroom materials for Ahlia University’s interior design studio. 
   
     Methods: After completing the INTD 212, INTD 216, INTD 311, and INTD 404 studios in mid-March 2022, a short Qualtrics poll was done to assess the difficulties of e-learning and offer potential consequences. 
   
     Results: Though students were conveniently attending courses online, there was not much discussion and interaction like in the face-to-face model. Blended teaching in design studio courses offered many benefits. The results showed that blended design studios achieved pedagogical results as students developed their knowledge. 
   
     Conclusions: Based on the findings, this research concludes that teaching and learning should be shifted from face-to-face and online learning to the best practice of a blended format.
review_content:
I enjoyed the article and agree with you that the way forward is blended learning. It is an interesting study and it is thorough but the paper needs to be reviewed again and properly edited.

The method has a biased outlook in the way that it is written. “After completing the INTD 212, INTD 216, INTD 311, and INTD 404 studios in mid-March 2022, a short Qualtrics poll was done to assess the difficulties of e-learning and offer potential consequences.” To say that you assess for the DIFFICULTIES of e-learning is showing anticipation that you will find difficulties and that might have influenced the way you did the observation/ designed the survey. One would rather say “to assess the implementation of e-learning”. You put it better put here “this study’s primary goal is to evaluate the effectiveness and standard of blended learning in design studio procedures as a result of COVID-19”.

In general: Make sure that everything is in the past tense. E.g. you would need to change sentences such as “However, to finish the academic year without squandering the current semester, colleges worldwide are switching to online and e-learning methods.” Some sentences are not clear in what it means, such as “McGee and Reis18 estimates that 30% and 79% of blended learning lessons are provided online.” There are strange sentences such as “None of the patients withdrew or dropped out of the study”. You are using “however” too much.

I cannot find evidence that Schon wrote about the virtual design studio, as cited under the heading “Designing blended learning courses”.

There are statements made and conclusion reached under the methodological section headings “Data analysis” and “Integration of Moodle and MS Teams”, such as “They discovered its effectiveness in the delivery of the courses.”

The results section is interesting but not well organised and there are sentences and information that repeat.
paper_title_zh: 因新冠疫情导致的室内设计工作室实践混合模式
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：2019年冠状病毒病（COVID-19）大流行颠覆了全球教育体系。在这一充满挑战的时期，大学和学院寻求其他有效的替代学习方式，如虚拟学习环境（VL）。此外，阿利亚大学已实施电子学习以应对COVID-19。需要更多地关注室内设计和建筑专业在技术采纳方面面临的挑战，这些专业超过60%的课程是实践性的，尤其是设计工作室，它们是课程的核心。根据相关文献综述，室内设计和建筑领域的混合学习研究仍显不足。为了提升室内设计和建筑的教学和学习效果，需要进一步研究将前沿技术与技术相结合。本研究旨在回顾阿利亚大学室内设计工作室的课堂材料。

方法：在2022年3月中旬完成INTD 212、INTD 216、INTD 311和INTD 404工作室课程后，进行了一次简短的Qualtrics调查，以评估电子学习的困难并提出潜在后果。

结果：尽管学生可以方便地在线上课，但与面对面模式相比，讨论和互动较少。设计工作室课程的混合教学提供了许多好处。结果显示，混合设计工作室在学生知识发展方面取得了教学成果。

结论：基于研究结果，本研究认为教学和学习应从面对面和在线学习转向混合模式的最佳实践。
review_content_zh:
我 enjoyed 这篇文章，并同意你的观点，认为前进的方向是混合式学习。这是一项有趣且详尽的研究，但论文需要再次审查并进行适当的编辑。

该方法的书写方式存在偏见。“在2022年3月中旬完成INTD 212、INTD 216、INTD 311和INTD 404工作室后，进行了一次简短的Qualtrics调查，以评估电子学习的困难并提供潜在的后果。”说你要评估电子学习的“困难”表明你预期会找到困难，这可能影响了你进行观察/设计调查的方式。人们更愿意说“评估电子学习的实施”。你在这里表达得更好：“本研究的主要目标是评估由于COVID-19而在设计工作室程序中混合式学习的有效性和标准”。

总的来说：确保所有内容都使用过去时态。例如，你需要改变诸如“然而，为了在不浪费当前学期的情况下完成学年，全球的大学正在转向在线和电子学习方式”之类的句子。有些句子意思不明确，例如“McGee和Reis18估计30%和79%的混合式学习课程是在线提供的”。有些句子很奇怪，例如“没有患者退出或放弃研究”。你使用“然而”的频率过高。

我找不到证据证明Schon写了关于虚拟设计工作室的内容，正如在“设计混合式学习课程”标题下所引用的。

在方法学部分标题“数据分析”和“Moodle和MS Teams的整合”下，有一些陈述和结论，例如“他们发现了其在课程交付中的有效性”。

结果部分很有趣，但组织得不够好，有些句子和信息重复。

paper_title: Pathophysiology of risk factors for post operative complications
paper_abstract:
Postoperative complications lead to an increase in morbidity and mortality, increase in hospital length of stay and costs for health care. Understanding the pathophysiology of various risk factors causing post-operative complications, helps in better understanding of the subject and perioperative patient assessment. 
The risk factors selected for the purpose of the study include modifiable risk factors and includes results from various single centre and multi-centre cohort studies, and systematic reviews and data from various meta-analysis by various authors on different subjects. 
The importance of optimizing the modifiable risk factors like hypoalbuminemia, anemia, obesity and smoking can be understood from the above study. It is important to remember that morbidity is multifactorial and taking into account only a single risk factor will not improve the outcomes. This signifies the importance of multidisciplinary approach when treating the patient.
review_content:
This article while it does talk about some of the pathophysiology and modifiable risk factors it appears very superficial. It glances over some key words and does not provide depth to these factors. It has some superficial merit but it lacks detailed discussion of its key topics.

The methods section needs some expansion. How were these studies selected still seems nebulous to me. How did they get to the 21 total studies? How many studies came up when these key words were searched and how was this narrowed to 21 studies? There should also be some exclusion criteria for studies that did not meet their criteria of what information the authors are looking for?

In the discussion the section Age the term frailty is used but without context and not defined here. It would be good to know how frailty was measured, this is important and speaks to the author glancing over key wording and details.

The discussion on anemia is a stretch. The claim that " An elderly patient is unable to compensate for loss of hemoglobin due to inability to increase cardiac output." Is partly true yes there is less reserve but to claim that an elderly patient has no ability to increase cardiac output is categorically false.
The ideas need to be defined and expanded upon it reads as a flight of ideas. There are only minor details that are incorrect the overall idea of the paper is sound however it needs some major fleshing out of the ideas presented.
paper_title_zh: 术后并发症风险因素的病理生理学
paper_abstract_zh:
术后并发症导致发病率、死亡率增加，住院时间延长和医疗成本上升。了解导致术后并发症的各种风险因素的病理生理学，有助于更好地理解该主题和围术期患者评估。

本研究选择的风险因素包括可改变的风险因素，并包括来自各种单中心和多中心队列研究、系统综述以及不同作者针对不同主题的元分析数据。

从上述研究中可以理解优化可改变风险因素（如低蛋白血症、贫血、肥胖和吸烟）的重要性。重要的是要记住，发病率是多因素的，仅考虑单一风险因素不会改善结果。这表明在治疗患者时采取多学科方法的重要性。
review_content_zh:
这篇文章虽然讨论了一些病理生理学和可修改的风险因素，但显得非常肤浅。它只是简单提及了一些关键词，并未对这些因素进行深入探讨。文章有一定的表面价值，但缺乏对其关键主题的详细讨论。

方法部分需要扩展。这些研究是如何被选定的，对我来说仍然显得模糊不清。他们是如何得出总共21项研究的？在搜索这些关键词时出现了多少项研究，又是如何缩小到21项的？还应该有一些排除标准，用于剔除不符合作者所寻找信息标准的研究。

在讨论部分的“年龄”一节中，使用了“脆弱性”这一术语，但未提供上下文且未在此定义。了解脆弱性是如何测量的将很有帮助，这一点很重要，也说明了作者对关键词和细节的草率处理。

关于贫血的讨论有些牵强。文章声称“老年患者由于无法增加心输出量，无法补偿血红蛋白的损失。”这一说法部分正确，确实储备较少，但断言老年患者完全无法增加心输出量是绝对错误的。

这些观点需要被定义并加以扩展，目前的读起来像是思想的跳跃。虽然只有一些细节错误，但文章的整体思路是合理的，然而需要对提出的观点进行更多的充实。
